source_long: 101 Flights finds flights that actually fit your trip, not just the cheapest ticket. Tell it your itinerary, dates, and preferences, and get flight routes matched to your whole plan: arrival times that work with your hotel check-in, layovers that don't kill a travel day, and multi-city routes built around the places you'll visit. Compare everything from Ryanair to Turkish Airlines — prices, direct flights, and budget alternatives — then book wherever works best. Don't have an itinerary yet? 101 Flights helps you build the trip around the flight too. A smart alternative to Skyscanner — figure out the right route for your trip first, then book at the best price.
plugin_details.target_long: 101 Flights 会找到真正适合您旅行的航班，而不仅仅是最便宜的机票。告诉它您的行程、日期和偏好，并获取与您的整个计划相匹配的航班路线：与您的酒店入住时间相匹配的到达时间、不会浪费旅行时间的中途停留以及围绕您将要访问的地点建立的多城市航线。比较从瑞安航空到土耳其航空的所有航班 — 价格、直飞航班和预算选择 — 然后预订最合适的航班。还没有行程吗？ 101 Flights 还可以帮助您围绕航班构建旅程。 Skyscanner 的明智替代方案 — 首先找出适合您旅行的路线，然后以最优惠的价格预订。

source_long: 101 TRIP! turns your travel ideas into custom, ready-to-go trip plans. Get a complete day-by-day itinerary with flights, trains, buses, ferries, hotels, activities, restaurants, budget breakdown, and maps for any destination. Plan a weekend getaway, road trip, or multi-week vacation. No forms or rigid templates, just tell 101 TRIP! where you want to go and get a personalized travel plan instantly. 101 TRIP! brings it all together in one place — the routes you'd piece together on Rome2Rio or Omio and the activities you'd hunt for on GetYourGuide or Viator, already built into your itinerary.
plugin_details.target_long: 101 旅行！将您的旅行想法变成定制的、随时可用的旅行计划。获取完整的每日行程，包括航班、火车、公共汽车、渡轮、酒店、活动、餐厅、预算明细以及任何目的地的地图。计划周末度假、公路旅行或多周假期。没有表格或严格的模板，只需告诉101 TRIP！您想去的地方，立即获得个性化的旅行计划。 101 旅行！将所有内容汇集到一处 — 您在 Rome2Rio 或 Omio 上拼凑的路线以及您在 GetYourGuide 或 Viator 上寻找的活动，这些都已纳入您的行程中。

source_long:
Travel the World with 12Go

The 12Go ChatGPT app helps you find and compare travel options in seconds. Just type what you need, and we’ll handle the rest. We cover buses, ferries, flights, trains and more to solve all your travel needs. 

No more jumping between tabs, filters, or travel sites. Just ask something like: “What’s the cheapest way to get from A to B for 3 people this Friday?” We’ll instantly surface the best matches and let you sort by price, departure time, currency, or recommended picks, including routes that combine multiple modes of transport.
plugin_details.target_long:
与 12Go 一起环游世界

12Go ChatGPT 应用程序可帮助您在几秒钟内找到并比较旅行选择。只需输入您需要的内容，剩下的事情我们会处理。我们涵盖巴士、渡轮、航班、火车等，满足您的所有旅行需求。 

不再需要在选项卡、过滤器或旅游网站之间跳转。只需问这样的问题：“本周五 3 人从 A 地到 B 地最便宜的方式是什么？”我们将立即显示最佳匹配，并让您按价格、出发时间、货币或推荐选择（包括结合多种交通方式的路线）进行排序。

source_long:
1to1 Mate is a relationship management app built around 1:1 meetings.

It is an "external memory" tool for people whose work depends on stacking one-on-one conversations — sales professionals,
community builders, managers, founders, advisors, and anyone who runs recurring 1:1s.

CORE FEATURES

・Member management: Structured storage of each person's goals, values, skills, referral needs, background, and tags
・AI meeting notes: Automatic transcription of meeting audio with AI-generated summaries and action items
・Dashboard: Chronological view of who you met, when, and what you discussed
・Profile import: Extract member information from business cards or web pages
・Referral matching: AI suggests who to introduce to whom based on past conversations

Note: the above are features of the 1to1 Mate app itself. Audio transcription, new meeting note creation, and member
registration all happen inside the 1to1 Mate app. The MCP / ChatGPT integration only provides read-only access to data already
 recorded through those features.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH CHATGPT

Once you connect 1to1 Mate to ChatGPT, you can ask things like:

・"Draft the next agenda for my 1:1 with Tanaka based on what we discussed last time."
・"Find members who are struggling with marketing."
・"Who on my member list would be a good introduction for Yamada, given her goals?"
・"Summarize the action items I committed to across last month's 1:1s."

The AI reads your data on a strictly read-only basis. Nothing is modified or deleted through this connection.

PERMISSIONS & DATA HANDLING

・A Pro plan subscription is required to connect
・Authentication via OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; sign in with your Google account
・Raw contact details (phone numbers, email addresses, messaging IDs) are never exposed to the AI. Not even the channel type label is returned — the MCP layer simply omits all contact-related fields
・You can disconnect the integration at any time from your account settings

See https://1to1mate.com/guide/mcp for the full connection walkthrough and the exact fields each tool returns.
plugin_details.target_long:

社区建设者、经理、创始人、顾问以及任何进行定期一对一交流的人。

核心特点

・会员管理：结构化存储每个人的目标、价值观、技能、推荐需求、背景和标签
・人工智能会议记录：自动转录会议音频以及人工智能生成的摘要和行动项目
・仪表板：按时间顺序显示您遇到的人、时间以及讨论的内容

注：以上是1to1 Mate应用程序本身的功能。音频转录、新会议记录创建和成员
注册全部发生在 1to1 Mate 应用程序内。 MCP / ChatGPT 集成仅提供对已存在数据的只读访问
 通过这些功能记录下来。

您可以使用 CHATPT 做什么

将 1to1 Mate 连接到 ChatGPT 后，您可以询问以下问题：

source_long:
@imqueue is an open-source TypeScript framework for building microservices that
talk over a message queue instead of HTTP — you write a class, decorate the
methods you want to publish, and callers get a fully-typed client generated from
the running service.

This server gives your assistant first-hand knowledge of it, so it writes real
@imqueue code instead of plausible-looking code.

search_docs covers the guides, the tutorial, the CLI manual, the articles, and
every exported symbol of every @imqueue package that publishes an API reference —
so you can ask a question in plain words ("how do I expose a service method?") or
look up an exact signature ("RedisQueue.send", "IMQOptions.safeDelivery").
Results carry page URLs, and get_doc returns any page as plain markdown for
reading and quoting. list_packages returns the current package catalogue with
install commands, which is how an assistant picks the right one rather than
guessing at a name. Where two packages cover the same ground — tracing, or the
database layer — the results carry the rule for choosing exactly one, because
installing both breaks quietly rather than loudly.

scaffold_service generates an idiomatic service — an IMQService subclass with
@expose()d, JSDoc-typed methods plus a bootstrap that starts it — from the method
signatures you describe. A custom return type comes back with the @classType() and
@property() decorators it needs, which matters because a field that lacks them
reaches the generated client typed any and still compiles. scaffold_client shows
how to generate and use the typed client for a service. Both return source text
for you to review and paste; neither writes a file.

All six tools are read-only. The server has no accounts, no authentication and no
storage: each request is handled statelessly, and the only data it sees is the
argument you send — a search query, a doc URL, a service name. Nothing is
retained, and no conversation content is collected or used for training.

Tools that would act on your own machine — driving the imq CLI, creating projects
on disk, starting and stopping your services, reading their logs — are
deliberately not part of this server, because a hosted server cannot reach your
machine and should not claim to. They ship in the local install instead
(npx -y @imqueue/mcp), and local_install_guide returns the setup steps for it.
plugin_details.target_long:

source_long: ABRAMS Trade Intelligence is a read-only research app for customs, sourcing, sales, and market-analysis teams. It focuses on three workflows: finding the most likely catalog-verified HS code and related trade context, researching international suppliers for a product, and researching buyers or potential customers. Product classification may ask one grouped clarification round and then returns the best available official HS-6 result, with CN-8 or TARIC-10 context when verified. Results can include assumptions, confidence, import and export signals, markets, company names, countries, shipment scope, and verified ABRAMS World Trade Wiki links. The supporting company-profile tool is limited to companies represented in ABRAMS trade results and is not promoted as a standalone directory. The app does not contact companies, create leads, change records, create accounts, process payments, or complete transactions. Classifications and trade signals are informational research aids, not binding tariff rulings, legal advice, or compliance guarantees.

source_long:
Pick any color you like and talk about it with AI. 

Tap, drag, or click on the color picker to choose a color. Then ask questions, get ideas, and learn what makes that color special.

There is no right or wrong answer. Just pick a color and start the conversation.

This app makes colors easy to understand. You do not need to know art, design, or color theory. The AI explains things in simple words. Ask why a color feels calm. Ask why two colors look good together. Ask what a color might mean in different places or for different people. The AI helps you learn one step at a time.

Try bright colors, dark colors, soft colors, or bold colors. Move around the picker to see tiny changes. Even a small change can make a color feel very different. Talk about what you see. Ask what changed and why.

Need help choosing colors? The AI can suggest colors that work well together. Explore matching colors, opposite colors, warm colors, cool colors, and balanced color sets. Make palettes for websites, apps, games, logos, posters, drawings, rooms, clothes, or school projects.

Want a happy feeling? A calm feeling? A strong feeling? A fun feeling? Tell the AI what you want. It can suggest colors that fit your idea. You can also show the AI a color you already picked and ask what other colors match it.

Learn about color harmony in a simple way. Find complementary colors that stand out. Explore analogous colors that sit close together. Try triadic colors for a playful look. Build monochromatic palettes from light and dark shades of the same color. The AI explains each idea with easy examples.

Discover what colors can mean. Red can feel exciting. Blue can feel peaceful. Green can remind people of nature. Yellow can feel bright and cheerful. Purple can feel rich or magical. Black can feel bold. White can feel clean. These ideas are common, but they are not rules. The AI can explain different views from around the world.

Working on a design? Ask for ideas for buttons, backgrounds, text, icons, charts, banners, or menus. Building a brand? Explore colors for logos, products, packaging, and marketing. Decorating a room? Compare paint colors and ask how they might look together. Picking clothes? Ask which colors work well for outfits.

If you know color codes, the AI can help with those too. Talk about HEX, RGB, HSL, and other common color formats. Ask how colors change on screens. Learn how brightness, saturation, and hue work. If you are new to these ideas, the AI explains them in plain language.

Accessibility matters. Ask how easy it is to read text on a color. Learn why some color pairs are easier to see than others. Explore better color choices for people with different kinds of color vision. Small changes can make designs easier for everyone to use.

This app is great for students, teachers, artists, designers, developers, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who enjoys colors. You can ask simple questions or deep questions. You can explore for one minute or one hour. Every conversation starts with the color you choose.

Try fun games too. Ask the AI to guess what a color reminds you of. Ask for color trivia. Build a rainbow. Find colors that match the seasons. Explore colors from nature, space, oceans, forests, flowers, food, animals, or famous works of art. Make up stories inspired by colors or invent names for your favorite shades.

There is always something new to discover. Every color has its own story. Every small change creates a new idea. Pick a color, ask a question, and keep exploring. Whether you want to learn, create, compare, imagine, or simply play with colors, this app gives you an easy and friendly way to turn every color into a conversation.

点击、拖动或单击颜色选择器来选择颜色。然后提出问题，获取想法，并了解是什么让该颜色与众不同。

答案没有正确或错误之分。只需选择一种颜色即可开始对话。

这个应用程序使颜色易于理解。您不需要了解艺术、设计或色彩理论。人工智能用简单的语言解释事情。询问为什么某种颜色让人感觉平静。问为什么两种颜色搭配起来好看。询问颜色在不同的地方或对不同的人可能意味着什么。人工智能可以帮助您一次一步地学习。

尝试明亮的颜色、深色、柔和的颜色或大胆的颜色。移动选取器以查看微小的变化。即使是很小的变化也会使颜色感觉非常不同。谈谈你所看到的。询问发生了什么变化以及原因。

需要帮助选择颜色吗？人工智能可以建议搭配良好的颜色。探索匹配色、相反色、暖色、冷色和平衡色组。为网站、应用程序、游戏、徽标、海报、图画、房间、衣服或学校项目制作调色板。

想要幸福的感觉吗？平静的感觉？强烈的感觉？有趣的感觉吗？告诉人工智能你想要什么。它可以建议适合您想法的颜色。你还可以向人工智能展示你已经选择的颜色，并询问还有什么颜色可以匹配它。

以简单的方式了解色彩和谐。寻找突出的互补色。探索相邻的类似颜色。尝试三元色以获得俏皮的外观。从相同颜色的浅色和深色色调构建单色调色板。人工智能用简单的例子解释了每个想法。

探索颜色的含义。红色可以让人感到兴奋。蓝色可以让人感到平静。绿色可以让人想起自然。黄色给人明亮、欢快的感觉。紫色给人一种丰富或神奇的感觉。黑色给人一种大胆的感觉。白色给人干净的感觉。这些想法很常见，但它们不是规则。人工智能可以解释世界各地的不同观点。

正在进行设计？询问关于按钮、背景、文本、图标、图表、横幅或菜单的想法。打造品牌？探索徽标、产品、包装和营销的颜色。装修房间？比较油漆颜色并询问它们组合在一起看起来如何。挑衣服？询问哪种颜色适合服装。

如果您知道颜色代码，人工智能也可以提供帮助。讨论 HEX、RGB、HSL 和其他常见的颜色格式。询问屏幕上的颜色如何变化。了解亮度、饱和度和色调的工作原理。如果您对这些想法不熟悉，人工智能会用简单的语言解释它们。

可访问性很重要。询问阅读某种颜色的文字有多容易。了解为什么某些颜色对比其他颜色对更容易看到。为不同色觉的人探索更好的颜色选择。微小的改变可以使设计更易于每个人使用。

这个应用程序非常适合学生、教师、艺术家、设计师、开发人员、创作者、爱好者和任何喜欢色彩的人。您可以提出简单的问题或深入的问题。您可以探索一分钟或一小时。每次对话都从您选择的颜色开始。

也尝试有趣的游戏。让人工智能猜测一种颜色会让你想起什么。询问颜色琐事。筑起一道彩虹。寻找与季节相匹配的颜色。探索自然、太空、海洋、森林、花卉、食物、动物或著名艺术作品的色彩。以颜色为灵感编造故事，或为您最喜欢的颜色起个名字。

总有新的东西有待发现。每种颜色都有自己的故事。每一个微小的改变都会产生一个新的想法。选择一种颜色，提出问题，然后继续探索。无论您是想学习、创造、比较、想象，还是只是想玩转颜色，这个应用程序都能为您提供一种简单友好的方式，将每种颜色变成对话。

AI Lead Scout is designed for business owners, marketers, agencies, and sales teams that want a more focused and organized way to find B2B prospects that match their specific goals.

A paid ChatGPT subscription and an active AI Lead Scout account are required. Visit AILeadScout.net to learn more and create your account before using the plugin.

AI Lead Scout 专为企业主、营销人员、代理机构和销售团队而设计，他们希望以更有针对性和更有条理的方式来寻找符合其特定目标的 B2B 潜在客户。

需要付费 ChatGPT 订阅和活跃的 AI Lead Scout 帐户。在使用该插件之前，请访问 AILeadScout.net 了解更多信息并创建您的帐户。

source_long:
Talk to anyone, anytime, without the pressure.

This app lets you role play conversations with smart AI people so you can practice before real life.

Pick who you want to talk to, choose a situation, and start chatting. Practice a job interview, a first date, a hard talk with a friend, a meeting with your boss, small talk, customer service, school, travel, or almost any other conversation. The AI answers like a real person and keeps the conversation going. You can try again, change your words, and build confidence one chat at a time.

Talking to people is not always easy. Sometimes you do not know what to say. Sometimes you want to practice before an important moment. This app gives you a safe place to learn. There is no need to feel rushed. You can stop, start again, or try a different answer whenever you want. Every conversation is a chance to learn something new.

Choose from many different people and situations. Talk to a friendly coworker, a teacher, a customer, a neighbor, a family member, a hiring manager, a classmate, a travel guide, a doctor, or create your own character. You can make conversations easy, medium, or hard. You decide how the other person acts. They can be kind, serious, funny, shy, calm, excited, or challenging. Every chat feels fresh because the AI responds to what you say.

Practice for real life in a simple way. Get ready for interviews by answering common questions. Rehearse speeches and presentations. Learn how to ask for help. Practice saying no in a kind way. Prepare for school, work, meetings, travel, shopping, or everyday conversations. Try difficult talks before they happen so you feel more ready when the real moment comes.

Learning is easier when you can practice again and again. If you do not like your answer, try another one. See how different words can change the conversation. Explore different paths and discover new ways to communicate. Every practice session helps you become more comfortable speaking with other people.

The app is great for students, professionals, language learners, job seekers, teachers, parents, travelers, and anyone who wants to become a better communicator. Whether you are preparing for something important or simply want to improve your everyday conversation skills, there is always something new to practice.

You can create your own role play ideas too. Type in a situation, describe the person you want to talk with, and let the AI build a conversation just for you. Make fun stories, serious talks, fantasy adventures, business meetings, classroom lessons, or everyday life scenes. The possibilities are almost endless.

The AI listens to what you say and answers naturally. Each conversation changes based on your choices, making every session feel unique. Explore different ideas, ask questions, solve problems together, or simply enjoy a friendly chat. The more you practice, the more comfortable speaking can become.

Simple to use and easy to enjoy, this app is made for anyone who wants to practice conversations in a safe and private space. Open the app, choose a person, start talking, and learn by doing. Build confidence, improve communication, explore new situations, and get ready for real conversations one message at a time. Whether your goal is better social skills, stronger communication, interview success, language practice, or everyday confidence, this app helps you practice, learn, and grow through natural AI role play conversations whenever you are ready.
plugin_details.target_long:
随时随地与任何人交谈，没有压力。

这个应用程序可以让你与聪明的人工智能人进行角色扮演对话，这样你就可以在现实生活之前进行练习。

选择您想交谈的人，选择场景，然后开始聊天。练习工作面试、第一次约会、与朋友的激烈交谈、与老板的会面、闲聊、客户服务、学校、旅行或几乎任何其他对话。人工智能像真人一样回答并让对话继续进行。您可以再试一次，改变措辞，一次一次地通过聊天建立信心。

与人交谈并不总是那么容易。有时你不知道该说什么。有时你想在重要时刻之前练习一下。这个应用程序为您提供了一个安全的学习场所。无需感到匆忙。您可以随时停止、重新开始或尝试不同的答案。每次谈话都是学习新东西的机会。

从许多不同的人和情况中进行选择。与友好的同事、老师、客户、邻居、家庭成员、招聘经理、同学、旅行导游、医生交谈，或者创建自己的角色。您可以使对话变得简单、中等或困难。你决定对方如何行事。他们可以是友善的、严肃的、有趣的、害羞的、冷静的、兴奋的或具有挑战性的。每次聊天都感觉新鲜，因为人工智能会对您所说的话做出反应。

以简单的方式练习现实生活。通过回答常见问题为面试做好准备。排练演讲和演示。了解如何寻求帮助。练习以友善的方式说不。为上学、工作、会议、旅行、购物或日常对话做好准备。在困难的谈话发生之前尝试一下，这样当真正的时刻到来时你会感觉准备得更充分。

当你可以一次又一次地练习时，学习就会变得更容易。如果您不喜欢您的答案，请尝试另一个。看看不同的词语如何改变对话。探索不同的路径并发现新的沟通方式。每次练习都可以帮助您更轻松地与他人交谈。

该应用程序非常适合学生、专业人士、语言学习者、求职者、教师、家长、旅行者以及任何想要成为更好沟通者的人。无论您是在准备重要的事情还是只是想提高日常对话技巧，总有一些新的东西可以练习。

AI 会听你说的话并自然地回答。每个对话都会根据您的选择而变化，让每个会话都感觉独特。探索不同的想法，提出问题，一起解决问题，或者只是享受友好的聊天。练习得越多，说话就会变得越舒服。

该应用程序易于使用且易于享受，专为任何想要在安全且私密的空间中练习对话的人而设计。打开应用程序，选择一个人，开始交谈，并边做边学。建立信心，改善沟通，探索新情况，并为真正的对话做好准备，一次一条消息。无论您的目标是提高社交技能、加强沟通、面试成功、语言练习还是日常自信，只要您准备好，此应用程序都可以帮助您通过自然的人工智能角色扮演对话来练习、学习和成长。

source_long:
Vibe Prospecting brings live B2B data into ChatGPT for prospecting, lead research, and data enrichment. It draws on a database of 150M+ companies and 800M+ professional contacts aggregated from 50+ sources, so you can build lead lists, research accounts, and fill in missing contact data without leaving the conversation.

Search for companies. Describe your ideal customer profile in plain language and filter by industry (including LinkedIn industry, NAICS, and SIC classifications), employee count, revenue range, location, funding stage, and the technologies a company uses. Results come back as structured lists you can refine, rank, and export.

Find the right people. Search professional contacts by job title, seniority, department, location, skills, and work history. Look up a specific person by name and company, or map the decision-makers across a target account, including org structure and reporting lines, to plan multi-threaded outreach.

Get contact details. Retrieve business emails and phone numbers for the contacts you find, with verification status included, so outreach lists are ready to use. Fill gaps in partial records, for example a name and company with no email. Verify email addresses you already have before a send, and flag records that need replacing.

Track buying signals. See which companies raised funding, announced news, grew headcount, opened relevant job listings, or had key people change roles. Use these events to time outreach, score leads, and prioritize accounts.

Enrich your existing records. Paste or upload a list of companies or contacts and append firmographics, technographics, contact details, and recent signals. The app matches records to the right company or person, flags duplicates, and returns a clean table you can export to CSV for your CRM, ATS, or outreach tools.

Who it's for. Sales teams and SDRs building qualified pipeline. Recruiters sourcing candidates by role, skills, and location. RevOps and marketing teams segmenting accounts, sizing markets, and improving CRM data quality. It also supports market sizing and TAM analysis, lead scoring, territory planning, and account-based marketing list building.

Try prompts like:

"Find US SaaS companies with 100 to 1,000 employees that use HubSpot."
"Identify VP-level decision-makers at these accounts and get verified work emails."
"Enrich this list with industry, employee count, revenue, and tech stack."
"Which of these companies raised funding or grew headcount in the last 6 months?"
"Find backend engineers in Austin with fintech experience and get their profiles."
"Build a target account list for my ICP and rank it by fit."
"Map the sales leadership org chart at this company."
"Verify the emails in this list and flag the risky ones."
"Estimate how many US companies match this ICP."
"Write a personalized cold email opener for each contact based on their company's recent news."
Vibe Prospecting is built on Explorium's B2B data platform. Data is retrieved live at query time, not from a static export, so results reflect current company and contact information.
plugin_details.target_long:
Vibe Prospecting 将实时 B2B 数据引入 ChatGPT，以进行勘探、领先研究和数据丰富。它利用了从 50 多个来源汇总的 1.5 亿多家公司和 8 亿多个专业联系人的数据库，因此您可以在不离开对话的情况下构建潜在客户列表、研究帐户并填写缺失的联系人数据。

搜索公司。用通俗易懂的语言描述您理想的客户档案，并按行业（包括 LinkedIn 行业、NAICS 和 SIC 分类）、员工人数、收入范围、位置、融资阶段以及公司使用的技术进行筛选。结果以结构化列表的形式返回，您可以对其进行细化、排名和导出。

找到合适的人。按职位、资历、部门、地点、技能和工作经历搜索专业联系人。按姓名和公司查找特定人员，或在目标客户中映射决策者，包括组织结构和报告关系，以规划多线程外展。

source_long:
A Simple Way to Chat with Your Own Information.

AI Wisebase is your personal knowledge base. It allows you to use your saved files and chat history directly within ChatGPT to generate responses grounded in your own data.

1. Organize Your Files and Chats
Save Chat History: Save important ChatGPT chats as editable documents for future reference.

Upload Files: Add your personal files to your knowledge base to build your private library.

Easy Access: View and access your uploaded files and saved chats in one simple list.

2. Chat with Your Knowledge Base
Grounded Answers: Ask questions and get responses based on your saved data, complete with references to the source content. This helps ChatGPT write reports or summarize topics that matter to you.

3. Specialized Tools for Learning
Video Explanations: Transform concepts into easy-to-follow animations or video summaries.

Knowledge Graphs: Generate interactive knowledge graphs to visualize and explore your saved files and chats.

Study Aids: Turn your saved chats and files into flashcards or quizzes for review.

Document Translation: Translate PDF files and view original and translated text side-by-side.

How to Use:
Connect: Link AI Wisebase to your ChatGPT account.

Add Data: Upload your files or save chat history directly.

Trigger: Type @AI Wisebase followed by your request.

Sample Prompts:
Save History: "@AI Wisebase Save this discussion as a document."

Knowledge Base: "@AI Wisebase Draft a report using my knowledge base."

Knowledge Graph: "@AI Wisebase Generate an interactive knowledge graph for my files."

Video Learning: "@AI Wisebase Create a video explaining this concept."

Quiz/Flashcards: "@AI Wisebase Create flashcards from my saved chats."

Translate: "@AI Wisebase Translate this PDF into English."

source_long:
Memorize anything faster. Instantly turn your textbooks, PDFs, and notes into bite-sized flashcards for exam prep and language learning.
- Turn Files into Flashcards 
Upload textbooks or lecture notes. Our generator extracts key concepts and creates study decks in seconds.
- Save and Review 
Your decks are automatically saved. Revisit them anytime to test yourself and lock in knowledge.

Perfect Scenarios:
- Language Learning: Master vocabulary for Spanish, French, or Japanese. Create decks for definitions, pronunciation, and grammar rules.
- Exam Prep: Ace standardized tests like the SATs, Driver's License, or Medical Board exams. Convert huge study guides into bite-sized cards.

How to Use in ChatGPT
1. Connect App: Connect Ace Flashcard Maker to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type “@Ace Flashcard Maker ”.
Sample prompts:
From File: "@Ace Flashcard Maker Make flashcards from this study guide PDF, focusing on key definitions."
Language Practice: "@Ace Flashcard Maker Help me learn Spanish travel vocabulary. Create flashcards with definitions and pronunciation."
Exam Review: "@Ace Flashcard Maker I'm studying for the AWS Cloud Practitioner exam. Generate 20 practice flashcards for me."

2. Trigger: Type “@Ace Knowledge Graph”.

source_long:
Adobe unlocks more ways to create and get work done from the conversation. Previously available as Photoshop, the Adobe connector now brings creativity and productivity capabilities across Creative Cloud and Acrobat. Describe what you want to make or change, and Adobe can help turn ideas, images, videos, and documents into polished outputs — from editing photos and creating PDFs to designing social assets, resizing videos, searching Creative Cloud assets, and generating data-driven documents.
Key capabilities:

* Retouch portraits or edit photos in bulk: Drop in photos and describe the look you want — adjust color, lighting, and tone; remove distractions and generate new elements; apply Lightroom presets; remove backgrounds; blur, crop, resize, and expand images.
* Design from template: Start from an Express template, update text and colors, and then animate for social media or convert to PDF.
* Refine video for any platform: Upload a horizontal clip and ask to reformat it for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or any platform. You can also stitch clips into a single sequence.
* Search and organize creative work: Describe what you're looking for and surface assets from your Creative Cloud library — by subject, style, mood, or content — without browsing folders.
* Work with PDFs and documents: Create and convert polished PDFs and documents.
* Create data-driven documents: Describe your output and provide your data — the connector turns raw data or content into formatted, shareable PDFs, including badges, cards, catalogs, and more.

You can get started as a guest, and sign in with your Adobe account for more capabilities and tools, Creative Cloud storage, and saved work across sessions.

* 批量修饰肖像或编辑照片：放入照片并描述您想要的外观 - 调整颜色、光线和色调；消除干扰并产生新元素；应用 Lightroom 预设；删除背景；模糊、裁剪、调整大小和扩展图像。
* 从模板设计：从 Express 模板开始，更新文本和颜色，然后为社交媒体制作动画或转换为 PDF。
* 为任何平台优化视频：上传水平剪辑并要求重新格式化以适应 YouTube Shorts、Instagram Reels 或任何平台。您还可以将剪辑拼接成单个序列。

source_long:
The Advance America ChatGPT app is your go-to resource for everything Advance America. As a licensed and regulated lender, Advance America provides convenient loan options both online and in store — and now, getting the information you need is easier than ever.

Get instant answers about our financial products and services, find nearby store locations, and explore the lending solutions available to you — all in one convenient chat experience. Trusted for 25+ years, we're here to help you take the next step toward financial stability.
plugin_details.target_long:
Advance America ChatGPT 应用程序是您了解 Advance America 一切事务的首选资源。作为一家获得许可并受监管的贷款机构，Advance America 在网上和实体店提供便捷的贷款选择 — 现在，获取您所需的信息比以往任何时候都更加容易。

获得有关我们的金融产品和服务的即时答案，查找附近的商店位置，并探索适合您的贷款解决方案 - 所有这一切都在一种便捷的聊天体验中。 25 多年来，我们深受信赖，随时帮助您迈向财务稳定的下一步。

source_long: Provides real-time access to Advanced Web Ranking data and tools, enabling seamless keyword tracking, SERP insights, and reporting directly inside the chat session.
plugin_details.target_long: 提供对高级网络排名数据和工具的实时访问，从而实现无缝关键字跟踪、SERP 洞察并直接在聊天会话中生成报告。

source_long:
Adzviser brings your marketing data into ChatGPT.

Connect platforms like Google Ads, Meta Ads, Shopify, and more, then ask questions in plain language to retrieve live campaign data. Instead of exporting reports or switching between dashboards, you can explore performance, compare time periods, and analyze metrics directly in chat.

Popular data sources customers connect include: Google Ads, Meta (Facebook) Ads, Instagram, GA4, Google Search Console, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, YouTube Analytics, Google Business Profile, HubSpot, Salesforce, Snapchat Ads, Klaviyo, Amazon Ads, Microsoft Ads (Bing), Google Merchant Center, Apple Ads, DV360, Reddit Ads, WooCommerce, X (Twitter) Ads and more.
plugin_details.target_long:
Adzviser 将您的营销数据导入 ChatGPT。

连接 Google Ads、Meta Ads、Shopify 等平台，然后用简单的语言提出问题以检索实时营销活动数据。您无需导出报告或在仪表板之间切换，而是可以直接在聊天中探索性能、比较时间段并分析指标。

客户连接的热门数据源包括：Google Ads、Meta (Facebook) 广告、Instagram、GA4、Google Search Console、LinkedIn 广告、TikTok 广告、Pinterest 广告、YouTube Analytics、Google Business Profile、HubSpot、Salesforce、Snapchat 广告、Klaviyo、Amazon 广告、Microsoft 广告 (Bing)、Google Merchant Center、Apple 广告、DV360、Reddit 广告、WooCommerce、X (Twitter) 广告等。

source_long: Aerion helps authenticated users inspect their project, time tracking, staffing, approval, and analytics data from ChatGPT. Users can find and describe Aerion records, create or update permitted records, submit their own time entries, and perform approval workflows when their Aerion permissions allow it.
plugin_details.target_long: Aerion 帮助经过身份验证的用户检查来自 ChatGPT 的项目、时间跟踪、人员配置、审批和分析数据。用户可以查找和描述 Aerion 记录、创建或更新允许的记录、提交自己的时间条目以及在其 Aerion 权限允许时执行审批工作流程。

source_long: Bring your Affinity data into ChatGPT to search contacts, companies, and deals; prep for meetings using your actual notes and interaction history; and update records as deals progress. Every email captured, every meeting logged, every relationship scored by your firm is now available directly in the conversation.
plugin_details.target_long: 将您的 Affinity 数据带入 ChatGPT 以搜索联系人、公司和交易；使用您的实际笔记和互动历史记录准备会议；并随着交易的进展更新记录。现在，您公司捕获的每封电子邮件、记录的每次会议以及评分的每条关系都可以直接在对话中查看。

source_long: Affirm lets you pay for purchases over time in fixed installments with no late fees. Use this app to understand how Affirm works, see sample monthly payments for a purchase amount, and start an Affirm purchase when you're ready to buy.
plugin_details.target_long: Affirm 让您可以定期分期付款，无需支付滞纳金。使用此应用程序了解 Affirm 的工作原理，查看购买金额的每月付款示例，并在准备购买时开始 Affirm 购买。

source_long: Look up a known Agent Community member by exact name or slug, read the roughly-live community count, explicitly pre-register a proposed .agent identity, and verify live DMV certificate issuance. Broad directory search is intentionally unsupported. Pre-registration is free and non-binding, does not confer domain ownership, and the proposed .agent TLD remains pending ICANN approval.
plugin_details.target_long: 通过确切的名称或别名查找已知的代理社区成员，读取大致的实时社区计数，明确预注册提议的 .agent 身份，并验证实时 DMV 证书颁发。故意不支持广泛的目录搜索。预注册是免费且不具约束力的，不授予域名所有权，拟议的 .agent TLD 仍待 ICANN 批准。

source_long:
Agent Ready checks how readable any website is to AI agents, assistants, and crawlers. Give it a URL and it scans the site against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec, the llms.txt standard, and emerging agent protocols (MCP server cards, A2A agent cards, agents.json), then renders an interactive score card: a 0–100 agent-readability score, an llms.txt score, and a per-check breakdown grouped by site, page, llms.txt, and protocol - each failing check paired with a plain-English fix.

Use it to find out why AI tools can't read your content, validate your llms.txt and AGENTS.md, confirm your structured data and Markdown mirrors, and re-scan any time to check that your fixes landed. Each result links to a full, shareable report on agent-ready.dev. Free to use, no account required.
plugin_details.target_long:
Agent Ready 检查任何网站对于 AI 代理、助手和爬虫的可读性。给它一个 URL，它会根据 Vercel 代理可读性规范、llms.txt 标准和新兴代理协议（MCP 服务器卡、A2A 代理卡、agents.json）扫描站点，然后呈现交互式记分卡：0-100 代理可读性分数、llms.txt 分数以及按站点、页面、llms.txt 和协议分组的每次检查细分 - 每个失败的检查都配有简单的英语修复。

使用它可以找出 AI 工具无法读取您的内容的原因，验证您的 llms.txt 和 AGENTS.md，确认您的结构化数据和 Markdown 镜像，并随时重新扫描以检查您的修复是否已完成。每个结果都链接到 agent-ready.dev 上完整的、可共享的报告。免费使用，无需帐户。

source_long: AgentCollect connects your AR recovery data to your assistant. Ask "how much did we recover last quarter?", "what's my recovery rate?", or "which accounts paid the most?" and get a complete, business-framed answer scoped strictly to your own account. Read-only, OAuth-secured, no write access.
plugin_details.target_long: AgentCollect 将您的 AR 恢复数据连接到您的助手。问“上个季度我们收回了多少？”、“我的收回率是多少？”或“哪些账户支付最多？”并获得完整的、商业框架的答案，范围仅限于您自己的帐户。只读、OAuth 保护、无写访问权限。

source_long:
Agent Grid connects AI Agents to a collaborative workspace where agents and humans. Everyone works on the same live artifacts. Docs, reports, slides, apps, and designs, with shared context, controlled access, and full version history. All changes to artifacts get recorded and can be rolled back. 

Artifacts can be grouped into shared workspaces, while human ownership, agent authentication, granular permissions, and team-based entitlements keep collaboration governed and secure.
plugin_details.target_long:
代理网格将人工智能代理连接到代理和人类的协作工作空间。每个人都致力于相同的实时工件。文档、报告、幻灯片、应用程序和设计，具有共享上下文、受控访问和完整版本历史记录。对工件的所有更改都会被记录并可以回滚。 

工件可以分组到共享工作空间中，而人员所有权、代理身份验证、细化权限和基于团队的权利则可以保证协作的可控性和安全性。

source_long:
AgentMail gives AI agents their own email inboxes. Through this connector, an agent (or you, in ChatGPT) can spin up a dedicated inbox on the fly, then send, receive, reply to, and forward email, with full thread context, drafts, and attachments, entirely through tool calls.

Unlike traditional email APIs built for one-way notifications, AgentMail is built for two-way conversations: an agent can read an incoming thread, understand it, and respond in context, just like a person would. This makes email a first-class communication and identity channel for agents, letting them sign up for services, coordinate with people, and talk to other agents.

Key capabilities exposed over MCP:
• Inboxes: create, list, get, update, and delete agent inboxes
• Messages: send, reply, forward, list, and update
• Threads: list, read, label, and delete full conversation threads
• Search: full-text search across threads and messages
• Drafts: create, list, read, update, send (with scheduling), and delete
• Attachments: retrieve attachments by ID, with text extraction for PDF/DOCX

Connect in seconds via OAuth using your AgentMail console identity. No API key required in ChatGPT. Sign up free at console.agentmail.to.
plugin_details.target_long:
AgentMail 为人工智能代理提供了自己的电子邮件收件箱。通过此连接器，代理（或者您，在 ChatGPT 中）可以即时启动专用收件箱，然后完全通过工具调用发送、接收、回复和转发电子邮件，其中包含完整的线程上下文、草稿和附件。

与为单向通知构建的传统电子邮件 API 不同，AgentMail 是为双向对话构建的：代理可以读取传入线程、理解它并在上下文中进行响应，就像人一样。这使得电子邮件成为客服人员一流的沟通和身份渠道，使他们能够注册服务、与人员协调以及与其他客服人员交谈。

通过 MCP 公开的关键功能：
• 收件箱：创建、列出、获取、更新和删除代理收件箱
• 消息：发送、回复、转发、列出和更新
• 话题：列出、阅读、标记和删除完整对话话题
• 搜索：跨话题和消息的全文搜索
• 草稿：创建、列出、阅读、更新、发送（按计划）和删除
• 附件：按 ID 检索附件，并提取 PDF/DOCX 文本

使用您的 AgentMail 控制台身份通过 OAuth 在几秒钟内建立连接。 ChatGPT 中不需要 API 密钥。在 console.agentmail.to 免费注册。

source_long:
Liner is an agentic AI search that finds, verifies, and summarizes answers with real-time web data and cited sources. Ask a question and Liner searches the live web, scrapes and crawls current pages, and returns a grounded answer you can fact-check against the original source — the latest news and up-to-date information, not stale training data.

Use Liner to:

- Search the real-time web and get verified, cited answers
- Summarize PDFs, research papers, and long documents
- Fact-check and verify claims against primary sources
- Find and read academic papers and scholarly research
- Get the latest news and up-to-date information on any topic
- Create market, company, or product briefs
- Compare viewpoints across multiple sources
- Turn a broad question into a structured, cited report

Built for agents and builders: 

Liner works as a grounded search and retrieval layer for AI agents, MCP workflows, and anyone building with real-time information. A reliable alternative to Exa, Tavily, Elicit, SciSpace, and Scite for search, retrieval, and academic discovery.

Liner covers web search, academic search, fact-checking, summarization, PDF reading, paper discovery, real-time news, scraping, and crawling — all with verifiable citations.

Need a fast cited answer or a full report? Liner does both — quick research for speed, deep research when you need more context before a decision. Also available as an API, so teams building AI products can tap the same search and research capabilities directly.
plugin_details.target_long:
Liner 是一种代理人工智能搜索，可利用实时网络数据和引用来源查找、验证和总结答案。提出问题，Liner 会搜索实时网络，抓取和抓取当前页面，并返回一个有根据的答案，您可以根据原始来源进行事实检查 - 最新的新闻和最新信息，而不是过时的训练数据。

使用衬垫可以：

- 搜索实时网络并获得经过验证、引用的答案
- 总结 PDF、研究论文和长文档
- 根据主要来源进行事实检查和验证声明
- 查找并阅读学术论文和学术研究
- 获取有关任何主题的最新新闻和最新信息
- 创建市场、公司或产品简介
- 比较多个来源的观点
- 将广泛的问题转化为结构化的、引用的报告

专为代理商和建筑商打造： 

Liner 充当 AI 代理、MCP 工作流程以及使用实时信息进行构建的任何人的基础搜索和检索层。 Exa、Tavily、Elicit、SciSpace 和 Scite 的可靠替代品，用于搜索、检索和学术发现。

Liner 涵盖网络搜索、学术搜索、事实检查、摘要、PDF 阅读、论文发现、实时新闻、抓取和爬行 - 所有这些都带有可验证的引用。

需要快速引用的答案或完整的报告？ Liner 两者兼而有之——快速研究以提高速度，而深入研究则需要更多背景信息才能做出决定。还可以作为 API 提供，因此构建人工智能产品的团队可以直接利用相同的搜索和研究功能。

source_long:
Use SlidesGPT to generate presentations with AI. First, name a topic that the presentation should be about. Next, you'll receive a proposed outline for your presentation. After you agree to the outline, SlidesGPT will generate your presentation slides.  Finally you can export to PowerPoint

Try with a conversation starter like: "Make a presentation about the future of AI"

Available features include:
- Generate a structure and outline for a presentation
- Generate images, diagrams and illustrations for slides
- Turn your PDFs into presentations
- Choose layouts and themes
- Refine slide content in a chat-based conversation
- Export and download as PowerPoint, Google Slides, PDF
- and more...
plugin_details.target_long:
使用 SlidesGPT 通过 AI 生成演示文稿。首先，指定演示文稿应讨论的主题。接下来，您将收到演示文稿的拟议大纲。在您同意大纲后，SlidesGPT 将生成您的演示幻灯片。  最后就可以导出到PowerPoint了

尝试使用这样的对话开头：“做一个关于人工智能未来的演示”

可用的功能包括：
- 生成演示文稿的结构和大纲
- 生成幻灯片的图像、图表和插图
- 将您的 PDF 转换为演示文稿
- 选择布局和主题
- 在基于聊天的对话中优化幻灯片内容
- 导出和下载为 PowerPoint、Google 幻灯片、PDF
- 还有更多...

source_long: Agiflow is a shared project board for turning plans into trackable work. Create projects, break them into work units and tasks, set priorities and statuses, assign work, add comments and attachments, and review progress across your workspace. Use Agiflow to plan launches, organize backlogs, run standups, triage incoming work, and keep decisions connected to the tasks they affect. Changes are saved to your authenticated Agiflow workspace, where your team can review and continue the work.
plugin_details.target_long: Agiflow 是一个共享项目板，用于将计划转变为可跟踪的工作。创建项目，将其分解为工作单元和任务，设置优先级和状态，分配工作，添加评论和附件，并查看整个工作区的进度。使用 Agiflow 计划启动、组织待办事项、运行站立会议、对传入工作进行分类，并使决策与其影响的任务保持联系。更改将保存到经过身份验证的 Agiflow 工作区，您的团队可以在其中查看并继续工作。

source_long:
Agnic Gifts buys one real, physical gift and ships it — inside the conversation you are already having.

Tell ChatGPT who the gift is for and what you want to spend. It searches vetted shops in the US, UK, Canada and Australia and comes back with real items that are in stock, within budget and shippable to your address, not links to go and read later.

Two ways to use it.

Pick your own: see the candidates named and priced, ask about any of them — delivery cost, materials, size, whether it is still in stock — and choose the one you want.

Or be surprised: ChatGPT sees the options as anonymous descriptions with no brand, no product name and no shop attached. It ranks its top three, and the item stays sealed until it arrives at your door. You approve the spend without knowing what it is, then reveal it when it lands.

No purchase happens from a chat message. Every buy stops at a link to Agnic's own site, where you approve it with your passkey against a spending limit you signed in advance. That limit is enforced in code and cryptography rather than by instruction, so a £20 limit cannot become a £40 purchase no matter what is typed into the chat. Your card never enters the conversation: it is held in a PCI DSS certified vault and the model never sees a number.

Agnic never holds your money. The shop is the seller, the shop ships the order, and returns and refunds go through the shop under its own policy.

Physical goods only, one gift at a time, and any gift that has not been bought yet can be cancelled.
plugin_details.target_long:
Agnic Gifts 购买一件真实的实物礼物并将其寄出 - 在您已经进行的对话中。

告诉 ChatGPT 礼物是送给谁的以及您想花什么。它会搜索美国、英国、加拿大和澳大利亚经过审查的商店，并返回有库存、在预算范围内并且可以运送到您的地址的真实商品，而不是稍后再阅读的链接。

有两种使用方法。

选择您自己的：查看候选产品的名称和价格，询问其中任何一个——交货成本、材料、尺寸、是否仍有库存——然后选择您想要的。

或者感到惊讶：ChatGPT 将选项视为匿名描述，没有品牌、没有产品名称，也没有附加商店。它排名前三，并且该物品在到达您家门口之前一直处于密封状态。您在不知道支出是什么的情况下批准了支出，然后在支出落地时将其公布。

聊天消息不会发生任何购买行为。每次购买都会停在 Agnic 自己网站的链接上，您可以在其中使用您的密码根据您提前签署的支出限额进行批准。该限制是通过代码和密码学而不是指令来强制执行的，因此无论在聊天中输入什么内容，20 英镑的限制都不能变成 40 英镑的购买。您的卡永远不会进入对话：它保存在 PCI DSS 认证的保险库中，并且模型永远不会看到数字。

Agnic 永远不会持有你的钱。商店是卖家，商店发货，退货和退款根据商店自己的政策进行。

仅限实物商品，一次一件礼物，任何尚未购买的礼物都可以取消。

source_long:
Factagora — Explore Truth Through Interactive Argument Graphs

Don't just get an answer — see how it was reached.

Factagora turns claims and predictions into interactive knowledge graphs where adversarial AI agents debate opposing viewpoints and generate transparent verdicts. Each node represents a claim, piece of evidence, or argument; each connection shows how they relate. Click through the graph to understand the reasoning behind every conclusion.

What you get:
• Verdicts — TRUE / FALSE / UNCERTAIN with confidence scores from adversarial AI debate
• Evidence — Credibility-scored sources supporting or opposing the claim
• AI Debate — Multiple AI agents (Skeptic, Analyst, Optimist) argue their positions with cited reasoning
• Interactive Graph — Navigate the full argument map visually, not just as a list

Ideal for researchers, journalists, analysts, students, and anyone who wants to understand why something is true — not just that it is.

Sample prompts:
• "Is nuclear energy the safest large-scale energy source?"
• "Will AGI be achieved before 2040?"
• "Is Trump making money from his presidency?"
plugin_details.target_long:
Factagora — 通过交互式论证图探索真理

不要只是得到答案——看看它是如何得到的。

Factagora 将主张和预测转化为交互式知识图，其中对抗性人工智能代理辩论相反的观点并生成透明的判决。每个节点代表一个主张、证据或论点；每个连接都显示了它们之间的关系。单击图表以了解每个结论背后的推理。

你得到什么：
• 判决——正确/错误/不确定，以及来自对抗性人工智能辩论的置信度分数
• 证据——支持或反对该主张的可信度来源
• AI 辩论 — 多个 AI 代理（怀疑论者、分析师、乐观主义者）用引用的推理来论证自己的立场
• 交互式图表——直观地浏览完整的参数图，而不仅仅是列表

非常适合研究人员、记者、分析师、学生以及任何想要了解为什么某件事是真实的（而不仅仅是事实如此）的人。

提示示例：
• “核能是最安全的大规模能源吗？”
• “AGI 会在 2040 年之前实现吗？”
• “特朗普从他的总统任期中赚钱了吗？”

source_long:
Agree Zone brings real estate negotiation intelligence directly
into ChatGPT. Ask ChatGPT to analyze any active deal and instantly
receive a deal probability score, price gap breakdown, and market
insight — without leaving the conversation.

With one prompt, real estate agents and brokers can:

- Get a deal probability score (0–100) showing how likely a
  transaction is to close based on the spread between listing
  price and offer price
- See the exact price gap percentage and what it means in the
  current market
- Receive an AI-generated market insight explaining expected
  counter offer dynamics for that property type and location
- Get a direct path to Agree Zone's Deal Room, where sellers
  privately lock in their preferences before negotiations begin

The free negotiation analysis runs in seconds from any ChatGPT
conversation — no account required to get a score.

For agents ready to go further, Agree Zone offers a Deal Room
subscription that privately matches seller preferences with buyer
limits before the first counter offer is made. Founding Agent
pricing provides lifetime discounted access, and enterprise
brokerage licensing is available for teams managing multiple
active listings.

Built for residential real estate agents, buyer's
agents, listing agents, and broker teams who negotiate deals daily
and need fast, structured insight at the offer stage.
plugin_details.target_long:
Agree Zone直接带来房产谈判情报
进入 ChatGPT。让 ChatGPT 立即分析任何活跃交易
接收交易概率得分、价格差距细分和市场
洞察力——无需离开对话。

只需一个提示，房地产经纪人和经纪人就可以：

- 获取交易概率得分 (0–100)，显示交易发生的可能性
  交易将根据上市之间的价差结束
  价格和报价
- 查看确切的价格差距百分比及其含义
  当前市场
- 接收人工智能生成的市场洞察，解释预期
  该房产类型和位置的还盘动态
- 获得前往 Agree Zone 交易室的直接路径，卖家可以在那里
  在谈判开始前私下锁定他们的偏好

Airepoto connects ChatGPT to your meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries.

Find meetings across your workspaces and groups, read speaker-labeled transcripts, and get AI summaries with action items — all in natural language, without leaving the conversation.

What you can do
- Search and list meetings across workspaces, groups, and keywords
- Read full transcripts with speaker labels
- Read AI summaries, including decisions and action items
- Ask questions that span several meetings at once
- Create meeting minutes from an audio file, request a new AI summary, move minutes between groups, or move minutes to the trash

Access and privacy
Airepoto uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Every request is scoped to the signed-in user: the server resolves the verified email claim in the access token to an Airepoto member, and rejects any token without one. You only ever see the meetings your Airepoto account already has access to. Deletion moves minutes to the trash, where they can be restored.

Airepoto is a meeting recording, transcription, and AI-summary service by RSUPPORT Co., Ltd. An Airepoto account is required.

source_long:
The Allianz Direct Spain Car Insurance Explorer offers a transparent way to visualize and understand Allianz Direct car insurance options within ChatGPT. This tool helps you see how a car insurance policy could be structured, focusing on clarity and customization. Use this app to design a potential policy configuration, learn about protection details, and get an estimated price without any commitment.

Key Features:
• Detailed Coverage Analysis: Receive detailed breakdowns of what is included and what can be included in an Allianz Direct policy for a specific type of car.

• Clarified Terms: Request immediate definitions of insurance concepts (e.g., "additional coverage" or "exclusions") to ensure you fully understand the terminology used.

• Interactive Customization: Understand policy parameters, such as liability limits or specific coverage inclusions, to see how they influence the insurance estimate.

How it works:

Simply describe your car's characteristics and what you need (e.g., "A basic third-party car insurance for a Seat Ibiza"). The app will generate a corresponding non-binding policy outline. You can then ask the assistant for information about the coverage, request modifications to the details, or ask for explanations of specific clauses to see how the coverage adapts to your needs and what options are available. If you wish to proceed, the app will request the necessary details and provide a price estimate. For an official quote or policy issuance, users are directed to Allianz Direct's official purchasing channels.

Note: This tool is for informational and exploration purposes only, providing estimates based on the details shared in the chat. Official policy issuance requires verification through Allianz Direct Spain's official website. The insurance part of the Service that Allianz Direct operates is subject to human oversight by Allianz; you may contact human advisors at any time through Allianz Direct's official channels. 

Please bear in mind that AI systems may produce outputs that are inaccurate, incomplete or not fully adapted to specific circumstances, and the accuracy of any indicative quotation depends directly on the accuracy and completeness of the information provided.

Important: Do NOT provide payment data (bank account numbers, IBANs, payment card details), national identity documents (DNI/NIE), passport numbers or any other sensitive personal identification data through this chat. Such data should only be provided through Allianz Direct's secure contracting environment.

source_long:
Assessment Generator – powered by Colossyan is an AI-powered tool built for instructional designers who want to create high-quality assessments with speed and confidence. With minimal input and no complex setup, it turns source content (such as pasted text, files, or conversation context) into structured, high-quality assessment questions.

The app guides users through a single, focused interaction: choose what to assess, select question types and difficulty, and instantly receive a clean, editable set of assessment items. The outputs are presented in a document-like format with copy-ready questions, simple inline editing, and one clear next step: download as a PDF or continue building in Colossyan.

Supported assessment types
*  Multiple Choice (MCQ) - One or more correct answers from a list of options.
* Single Choice - Exactly one correct answer from multiple options.
* True / False - Binary statements evaluated as true or false.
plugin_details.target_long:
评估生成器 – 由 Colossyan 提供支持，是一款人工智能驱动的工具，专为希望快速、自信地创建高质量评估的教学设计师而设计。只需最少的输入，无需复杂的设置，它将源内容（例如粘贴的文本、文件或对话上下文）转换为结构化的高质量评估问题。

该应用程序引导用户进行单一、集中的交互：选择要评估的内容、选择问题类型和难度，并立即收到一组干净、可编辑的评估项目。输出以类似文档的格式呈现，包含可复制的问题、简单的内联编辑以及明确的下一步：下载为 PDF 或继续在 Colossyan 中构建。

支持的评估类型
* 多项选择 (MCQ) - 从选项列表中选出一个或多个正确答案。
* 单项选择 - 从多个选项中选出一个正确答案。
* True / False - 二进制语句评估为 true 或 false。

source_long:
Autocalls lets you build and run AI phone agents — and now you can do it straight from ChatGPT, without switching to a dashboard. Describe what you want, and your assistant takes it from there.

Build and refine assistants by chat: set the prompt, voice, language, model and call behaviour for both inbound agents (answer calls, take bookings, qualify leads) and outbound agents (follow-ups, reminders, lead qualification). Give them real abilities by attaching mid-call tools that call your APIs live during a conversation, and knowledgebases that ground their answers in your own documents.

Run outbound work at scale: create a campaign, add your leads, and start, pause or resume it whenever you like. Then close the loop — list your calls, open any one to read its full transcript and post-call evaluation, and update the assistant or its tools to fix what went wrong, all in the same conversation.

Manage the rest of your account too: knowledgebases and documents, phone numbers and SIP trunks, WhatsApp senders and templates, conversations, folders, labels and API keys.

You stay in control. Every tool works only on your own account, reading and writing are separate actions, anything that spends balance or deletes data is clearly marked, and your stored secrets are masked. You connect once with a secure sign-in — no API keys pasted into the chat.

大规模开展外拨工作：创建营销活动、添加潜在客户，然后随时开始、暂停或恢复。然后关闭循环 - 列出您的通话，打开任何通话以阅读其完整记录和通话后评估，并更新助手或其工具以修复出现的问题，所有这些都在同一对话中进行。

还可以管理帐户的其余部分：知识库和文档、电话号码和 SIP 中继、WhatsApp 发件人和模板、对话、文件夹、标签和 API 密钥。

您保持掌控。每个工具仅适用于您自己的帐户，读取和写入是单独的操作，任何花费余额或删除数据的行为都会被清楚标记，并且您存储的秘密都会被屏蔽。您可以通过安全登录进行连接，无需将 API 密钥粘贴到聊天中。

source_long:
The Autodesk® Product Help Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server connects AI agents directly to Autodesk’s official product documentation across 110+ products including Autodesk Fusion®, AutoCAD®, Revit®, Inventor®, Maya®, Civil 3D®, and more. As a secure, read-only interface, it allows AI tools to search, navigate, and retrieve trusted Autodesk help content. This enables support for natural language queries, accelerates onboarding, and provides a reliable foundation for intelligent agents built on authoritative Autodesk product documentation.

Key Features:
- Ask support questions using natural language.
- Learn and onboard to Autodesk products faster.
- Create a foundation for AI agents and automation.
- Available in 10 languages: English (United States), French (France), German (Germany), Spanish  (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), Italian (Italy), Japanese (Japan), Korean (Korea), Chinese (Simplified), and Russian (Russia)

Requirements:
No special requirements.

About Autodesk
The world's designers, engineers, builders, and creators trust Autodesk to help them design and make anything. From the buildings we live and work in, to the cars we drive and the bridges we drive over. From the products we use and rely on, to the movies and games that inspire us. Autodesk's Design and Make Platform unlocks the power of data to accelerate insights and automate processes, empowering our customers with the technology to create the world around us and deliver better outcomes for their business and the planet. For more information, visit https://www.autodesk.com.
plugin_details.target_long:
Autodesk® 产品帮助模型上下文协议 (MCP) 服务器将 AI 代理直接连接到 Autodesk 的 110 多种产品的官方产品文档，包括 Autodesk Fusion®、AutoCAD®、Revit®、Inventor®、Maya®、Civil 3D® 等。作为一个安全的只读界面，它允许 AI 工具搜索、导航和检索受信任的 Autodesk 帮助内容。这可以支持自然语言查询，加速入门，并为基于权威 Autodesk 产品文档构建的智能代理提供可靠的基础。

主要特点：
- 使用自然语言询问支持问题。
- 更快地学习和掌握 Autodesk 产品。
- 为人工智能代理和自动化奠定基础。
- 提供 10 种语言：英语（美国）、法语（法国）、德语（德国）、西班牙语（西班牙）、葡萄牙语（巴西）、意大利语（意大利）、日语（日本）、韩语（韩国）、中文（简体）和俄语（俄罗斯）

要求：
无特殊要求。

关于欧特克
全世界的设计师、工程师、建造者和创作者都信赖 Autodesk 可以帮助他们设计和制造任何东西。从我们生活和工作的建筑物，到我们驾驶的汽车和我们行驶的桥梁。从我们使用和依赖的产品，到激发我们灵感的电影和游戏。 Autodesk 的设计和制造平台释放了数据的力量，以加速洞察力和自动化流程，为我们的客户提供技术来创造我们周围的世界，并为他们的业务和地球带来更好的成果。欲了解更多信息，请访问 https://www.autodesk.com。

Autumn lets hotel operators ask about their property's performance, pricing, bookings, and marketing — and get answers straight from their own data.

Once you connect your Autumn account, you can ask things like:
- "How is occupancy for next month compared to last year?"
- "What are my ADR and RevPAR this quarter?"
- "Which room types look underpriced right now?"
- "Who were my top-spending guests last month?"

One-stop AI slide app: create, edit, and export slides as videos with voice-overs, all in one place.
Quickly turn any topic, text, PDF, or URL into a professionally designed PowerPoint presentation. With AI-powered content generation, you can edit every detail through conversation and export your work as an editable PPTX or a video with voiceover. 

Key Features
- Multi-source input: Create presentations from a simple topic, pasted text, an uploaded PDF, or a web URL.
- Automated slide design: The AI builds layouts, selects relevant images, and creates diagrams automatically.
- Conversational editing: Refine slides using natural commands to change the tone, shorten text, or add new sections.
- Precision control: Edit any text manually or ask the AI to revise it. Use your own images or generate new AI visuals.
- Export and share: Download a fully editable .pptx file or export your presentation as a video with embedded narration.

How to Use
1. Connect the Awesome Slides app
2. Type "@" and choose the AI Slides app, or type "AI Slides", then enter your prompt

Examples:
- Awesome Slides create a presentation about the history of AI
- Awesome Slides turn this PDF into a 10-slide deck
- Awesome Slides help me make a presentation for my Q3 marketing strategy

基于 MCP 的安全访问 CRM 和业务数据
AI 支持的查询、报告和数据分析
潜在客户、联系人、客户和机会管理
项目、任务和工作流程自动化
营销自动化和客户参与工作流程
文档生成、电子签名、报价和发票

source_long: Background Music turns a short description into instrumental music that plays right inside your chat. Ask for a vibe: "smoky Japanese jazz," "upbeat Berlin techno," or "lo-fi for focus" and it generates a fresh instrumental track and plays it in an embedded player, generating continuous music for about an hour. Every track is fully instrumental (no vocals) and generated on the spot with Google's AI music model; nothing is pulled from a catalog. All audio is AI-generated and carries an inaudible SynthID watermark. There are no accounts and no sign-up. Add the connector, ask for a vibe, and press play.
plugin_details.target_long: 背景音乐将简短的描述转变为在聊天中播放的器乐。如果需要一种氛围：“烟雾缭绕的日本爵士乐”、“欢快的柏林电子乐”或“专注的低保真音乐”，它会生成新鲜的器乐曲目并在嵌入式播放器中播放，产生大约一个小时的连续音乐。每首曲目都是纯器乐演奏（没有人声），并通过 Google 的 AI 音乐模型现场生成；没有从目录中提取任何内容。所有音频均由 AI 生成，并带有听不见的 SynthID 水印。没有帐户，也没有注册。添加连接器，请求氛围，然后按播放。

source_long:

source_long:
Follow every baseball game without leaving ChatGPT. Get live MLB scores, game schedules, standings, team records, and game results right inside your conversation. Ask about today’s games, check who won, see what is coming next, or look at the latest standings. You do not need to open another website or switch to another app. Just ask your question and get the baseball information you want in one place.

If you want to know what games are happening today, simply ask. If you want to see yesterday’s scores, ask that too. You can check upcoming games, recent results, and how every team is doing during the season. Whether you follow one favorite club or every team in Major League Baseball, finding information is quick and easy.

See live scores while games are being played. Find out who is winning, who has already finished, and which games have not started yet. Keep up with the action throughout the day without searching across different websites. Everything is shown inside your chat so you can spend more time enjoying baseball.

Need to check the standings? You can see how every team ranks in its division. Follow the race to the playoffs and watch teams move up or down as the season goes on. Check team records, wins, losses, and where clubs stand compared with their rivals.

You can also look ahead. Find upcoming games, see who plays next, and plan which matchups you want to watch. Whether you are getting ready for tonight’s game or looking several days ahead, schedules are easy to find.

This app is made for baseball fans of every kind. Maybe you watch every game. Maybe you only follow your hometown team. Maybe you just want to know today’s scores. No matter how closely you follow MLB, getting the information you need is simple.

Ask questions in your own words. You do not need special commands or complicated menus. Try questions like “Who won the Dodgers game?”, “What MLB games are on today?”, “Show me the AL East standings,” or “When do the Cubs play next?” The app understands natural questions and helps you find the answer.

Everything happens inside ChatGPT, so you can keep talking without changing apps. Ask one question or ask many. Compare teams, check schedules, see standings, and follow scores in the same conversation. It feels like talking with someone who is always ready to help with baseball information.

The app is useful all season long. Check Opening Day games, follow exciting division races, watch the push toward the playoffs, and keep up during the postseason. Whenever games are happening, you can quickly see what is going on.

Whether you cheer for the Yankees, Dodgers, Cubs, Braves, Mets, Red Sox, Phillies, Astros, Padres, Mariners, or any other MLB team, you can easily keep track of scores, schedules, standings, and results. Follow your favorite club or explore the whole league.

Use this app when you want baseball information that is fast, clear, and easy to understand. Stay up to date with live MLB scores, today’s games, completed results, upcoming schedules, team records, division standings, and season progress without leaving your conversation. Just ask a question, get the latest baseball information, and enjoy the game.

source_long:
Basic Memory gives you a persistent knowledge base: your notes, decisions, research, and project context, stored as plain Markdown files you own. Anything your AI saves to Basic Memory, you can open and edit. Anything you write, your AI can find and build on.

Save what matters. "Save our pricing decision and link it to the roadmap." Notes you save in one conversation are available everywhere.

Retrieve context from anywhere. "What did we decide about pricing? Check my notes first." Never re-explain a project.

Search by meaning. Semantic and hybrid search across everything you and your AI have saved.

Structured search. Filter by status, type, tags, or priority. "Show my open tasks, sorted by priority."

Follow connections. Linked notes let your AI traverse related context and surface relationships in a living knowledge graph.

Share a workspace with your team. Teammates and their AI tools read and write to one shared source of truth.

Notes are stored as ordinary Markdown that you own. Any AI tool can use and build on it, so your shared context follows you across the assistants and agents you use.

Subscription Required:

This connector requires a Basic Memory Cloud account (7-day free trial, then from $15/seat/month at https://basicmemory.com.

Use the Basic Memory Cloud app to view and edit your notes at: https://app.basicmemory.com
plugin_details.target_long:
基本记忆为您提供持久的知识库：您的笔记、决策、研究和项目背景，存储为您拥有的纯 Markdown 文件。您的人工智能保存到基本内存中的任何内容，您都可以打开和编辑。您编写的任何内容，您的人工智能都可以找到并进行构建。

保存重要的东西。 “保存我们的定价决定并将其链接到路线图。”您在一次对话中保存的笔记随处可见。

从任何地方检索上下文。 “我们对定价做了什么决定？先检查一下我的笔记。”永远不要重新解释一个项目。

按含义搜索。对您和您的人工智能保存的所有内容进行语义和混合搜索。

结构化搜索。按状态、类型、标签或优先级过滤。 “显示我的未完成任务，按优先级排序。”

遵循连接。链接笔记可让您的 AI 遍历动态知识图中的相关上下文和表面关系。

与您的团队共享工作空间。队友和他们的人工智能工具读取和写入一个共享的事实来源。

笔记存储为您拥有的普通 Markdown。任何人工智能工具都可以使用它并在其基础上进行构建，因此您的共享上下文会跟随您使用的助手和代理。

需要订阅：

此连接器需要 Basic Memory Cloud 帐户（7 天免费试用，然后从 https://basicmemory.com 上每个席位/月 15 美元起。

使用 Basic Memory Cloud 应用程序查看和编辑您的笔记：https://app.basicmemory.com

source_long: Connect Bastion to ChatGPT to manage your security and compliance posture through natural conversation. Review framework compliance status across SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR. Drill into failing tests, upload evidence, and submit controls for review. Ask your knowledge base security and compliance questions grounded in your own policies and documentation. Monitor code security findings and GitHub configuration status. All data is scoped to your authenticated account - you only ever see your own tenant.
plugin_details.target_long: 将 Bastion 连接到 ChatGPT，通过自然对话来管理您的安全性和合规性状况。审查 SOC 2、ISO 27001、HIPAA 和 GDPR 的框架合规性状态。深入研究失败的测试、上传证据并提交控制措施以供审查。询问基于您自己的政策和文档的知识库安全性和合规性问题。监控代码安全结果和 GitHub 配置状态。所有数据的范围仅限于您经过身份验证的帐户 - 您只能看到自己的租户。

source_long: Browse Bathhouse locations, view available experiences, check appointment availability, and start the booking process. Compare options, find a time that works for you, and continue to Bathhouse’s booking system to complete your reservation.
plugin_details.target_long: 浏览浴室地点、查看可用体验、检查预约可用性并开始预订流程。比较选项，找到适合您的时间，然后继续使用 Bathhouse 的预订系统完成预订。

source_long: Search the live Batoo marketplace, including Batoo and EasyMLS listings. Filter by builder, model, boat type, specific subcategory, country, price, year, dimensions, cabins, capacity, engine hours and speed. Open full public listing details, compare up to five boats and follow each result to its canonical page on batoo.it. The plugin is read-only and never creates leads or contacts brokers.
plugin_details.target_long: 搜索实时 Batoo 市场，包括 Batoo 和 EasyMLS 列表。按制造商、型号、船型、特定子类别、国家/地区、价格、年份、尺寸、舱室、容量、发动机运行时间和速度进行过滤。打开完整的公开列表详细信息，比较最多五艘船，并按照每个结果访问 batoo.it 上的规范页面。该插件是只读的，永远不会创建潜在客户或联系经纪人。

source_long:
Command your fleet and challenge a clever AI opponent in this modern take on the classic Battleships game.

Fire carefully aimed shots to locate and sink the opposing fleet before yours is destroyed. Every match is different, with the AI adapting its tactics and keeping the challenge fresh.

Whether you’re a longtime fan of Battleships or discovering the game for the first time, Battleships offers fast-paced naval strategy, tactical decision-making, and engaging gameplay directly in chat.

Features:

* Play Battleships against an intelligent AI
* Classic fleet-versus-fleet gameplay
* Strategic ship placement and tactical targeting
* Natural conversation-based game experience
* Quick matches with no setup required
* Suitable for beginners and experienced players alike

Deploy your fleet, plan your attacks, and prove your naval command skills in Battleships.
plugin_details.target_long:

无论您是《战舰》的长期粉丝还是第一次接触这款游戏，《战舰》都能提供快节奏的海军战略、战术决策以及直接在聊天中参与的游戏玩法。

特点：

* 与智能人工智能对战战舰

source_long: Baukosten-Cockpit helps homeowners and project stakeholders view and manage construction projects, cost forecasts, estimates, offers, payments, and related documents directly in ChatGPT.

source_long:

source_long:
Bayut KSA helps users explore residential, commercial, and short-term real estate listings across Saudi Arabia directly in ChatGPT.

Use Bayut KSA when you want to search for properties to buy, lease annually, or rent daily for short stays in cities such as Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Khobar, Makkah, Madinah, and other locations across the Kingdom. The app can help users discover apartments, villas, houses, furnished units, land, offices, and other available property types based on their preferences.

Users can search by location, property type, purpose (including buying, yearly renting, or daily rentals), price range, number of bedrooms, and other available filters. Bayut KSA provides listing details such as property descriptions, images, prices, amenities, locations, and agent or advertiser contact options where available.

Bayut KSA supports Arabic and English property search experiences and is designed to make real estate discovery easier for people looking for a home, investment opportunity, long-term rental property, short-term daily rental, or commercial space in Saudi Arabia.
plugin_details.target_long:
Bayut KSA 帮助用户直接在 ChatGPT 中探索沙特阿拉伯各地的住宅、商业和短期房地产列表。

当您想要在利雅得、吉达、达曼、胡拜尔、麦加、麦地那和王国其他地点等城市寻找可购买、按年租赁或按日租赁短期住宿的房产时，请使用 Bayut KSA。该应用程序可以帮助用户根据自己的喜好发现公寓、别墅、房屋、带家具的单元、土地、办公室和其他可用的房产类型。

用户可以按位置、房产类型、用途（包括购买、年租或日租）、价格范围、卧室数量和其他可用过滤器进行搜索。 Bayut KSA 提供列表详细信息，例如房产描述、图片、价格、便利设施、位置以及代理商或广告商联系方式（如果有）。

Bayut KSA 支持阿拉伯语和英语的房产搜索体验，旨在让在沙特阿拉伯寻找住房、投资机会、长期租赁房产、短期日租或商业空间的人们更轻松地发现房地产。

source_long: BeachFinder helps you find and compare 184,900 swimming spots worldwide — beaches, lakes and bathing places. Search by city and rank spots for swimming, family, warm water, low wind, surf, snorkeling, whitewater or vanlife, then pull current weather, water temperature, wind, UV and wave planning signals for the top results. It also surfaces localized guides, source-backed activity providers and an anonymous aggregate of community reports. Every result links to getbeachfinder.com. All tools are read-only, and no tool ever declares a spot safe to swim — BeachFinder defers to official closures, flags, lifeguards and local authorities.
plugin_details.target_long: BeachFinder 可帮助您查找并比较全球 184,900 个游泳地点 - 海滩、湖泊和沐浴场所。按城市搜索，并对游泳、家庭、温水、低风、冲浪、浮潜、白水或货车生活的地点进行排名，然后提取当前天气、水温、风力、紫外线和波浪规划信号以获得最佳结果。它还提供本地化指南、来源支持的活动提供商和匿名社区报告汇总。每个结果都链接到 getbeachfinder.com。所有工具都是只读的，并且没有任何工具会声明某个地点可以安全游泳——BeachFinder 遵守官方关闭规定、旗帜、救生员和地方当局的规定。

source_long:
Beamtrace is an AI visibility platform covering your visibility metrics, prompt tracking, website optimization, and reputation management in AI search. It's built to show how your business holds up when people turn to AI for recommendations.

The app puts your data into a conversation ChatGPT can work with: cross-reference numbers, explain what's behind a drop, and turn scores into something you can act on or hand off.

What you can do with it
#1 Spot the pattern behind your visibility
- "Why don't AI assistants recommend my business?" 
Reads across every prompt you're missing from and names what they have in common.

#2 Find your competitor's edge
- "Why did my competitor jump ahead this month?"
Pulls the competitor leaderboard, then narrows it to what they did or what changed to cause it.

#3 Prioritize your next content fix
- "I can fix only one thing this month, what should I do?”
Ranks your content improvements by impact rather than listing every gap flat, so you know exactly where to start and what to do.

#4 Understand what moved your score
- "What changed in my AI visibility this month?" 
Checks the score trend against the topic and prompt movement to tell you whether it's a real shift.

#5 Build a client-ready report
- "Build this month's AI visibility summary for my client" 
Draws the score, competitor standing, and top fixes, and writes it up as a report that you can paste anywhere.

#6 Know what a metric actually means
- "What does [metric] mean for my visibility, and should I care about it?"
Explains what a metric measures or gives a read on your visibility state in simple words.

How to get started
- Sign in with a Beamtrace account.
- The app reads live data from your connected website.
- No setup beyond that; start the conversation.

Ask a question in plain language and get an analysis scoped to your business.

Requirements
Your business needs an active subscription or trial. A website must be connected to the service. If it isn't, ChatGPT points you to Beamtrace's setup page instead of guessing at your data. 

It doesn't change your Beamtrace settings, tracked prompts, or account data. It reads your dashboard and hands the numbers to ChatGPT for analysis, reporting, and Q&A.
plugin_details.target_long:
Beamtrace 是一个 AI 可见性平台，涵盖 AI 搜索中的可见性指标、提示跟踪、网站优化和声誉管理。它旨在展示当人们向人工智能寻求建议时您的业务如何发展。

该应用程序将您的数据放入 ChatGPT 可以使用的对话中：交叉引用数字，解释掉落背后的原因，并将分数转化为您可以采取行动或移交的东西。

你可以用它做什么
#1 发现你的知名度背后的模式
- “为什么人工智能助手不推荐我的生意？” 
阅读您错过的每个提示并指出它们的共同点。

#2 找到竞争对手的优势
- “为什么我的竞争对手这个月领先了？”
拉出竞争对手排行榜，然后将其范围缩小到他们所做的事情或导致其发生的变化。

#3 确定下一个内容修复的优先顺序
- “这个月我只能解决一件事，我该怎么办？”
按影响对您的内容改进进行排名，而不是列出每个差距，以便您确切地知道从哪里开始以及做什么。

#4 了解是什么改变了你的分数
- “这个月我的人工智能可见度发生了什么变化？” 
根据主题检查分数趋势并提示移动，以告诉您这是否是真正的转变。

#5 构建可供客户使用的报告
-“为我的客户构建本月的人工智能可见度摘要” 
绘制得分、竞争对手排名和最佳修复，并将其写成可以粘贴到任何地方的报告。

#6 了解指标的实际含义
- “[指标] 对我的可见度意味着什么？我应该关心它吗？”
用简单的语言解释指标衡量的内容或了解您的可见性状态。

如何开始
- 使用 Beamtrace 帐户登录。
- 该应用程序从您连接的网站读取实时数据。
- 除此之外没有任何设置；开始对话。

用简单的语言提出问题并获得适合您业务的分析。

要求
您的企业需要有效的订阅或试用。网站必须连接到该服务。如果不是，ChatGPT 会将您引导至 Beamtrace 的设置页面，而不是猜测您的数据。 

它不会更改您的 Beamtrace 设置、跟踪提示或帐户数据。它读取您的仪表板并将数据传递给 ChatGPT 进行分析、报告和问答。

source_long:
All Ten – Beast Academy is a daily math puzzle families can solve together. Using only basic math operations and each of the four digits provided in the puzzle, your goal is to create every number from 1 through 10.

The challenge reflects Beast Academy’s approach to building number sense and problem-solving skills through playful, thought-provoking puzzles rather than rote practice.

With the ChatGPT app, the experience goes a step further. When families get stuck, they can use the conversational nature of AI to ask for hints, explore strategies, and work through ideas together without simply revealing the answers. It’s a simple, engaging way to turn math time into shared discovery and get a feel for Beast Academy’s problem-solving philosophy.

Think of it as Wordle, but for mathematical thinking.
plugin_details.target_long:
《All Ten – Beast Academy》是一个家庭可以一起解决的日常数学难题。仅使用基本数学运算和拼图中提供的四位数字中的每一个，您的目标是创建从 1 到 10 的每个数字。

这项挑战反映了野兽学院通过有趣、发人深省的谜题而不是死记硬背的练习来培养数字感和解决问题的能力的方法。

借助 ChatGPT 应用程序，体验更进一步。当家庭陷入困境时，他们可以利用人工智能的对话性质来寻求提示、探索策略并共同研究想法，而无需简单地透露答案。这是一种简单、引人入胜的方式，可以将数学时间转化为共享发现，并感受 Beast Academy 的解决问题哲学。

可以将其视为 Wordle，但用于数学思维。

source_long: Beat Breeze is a background-music platform for hotels, restaurants, cafes, and retail. Connect it to ChatGPT to manage the music in your venues just by asking: see what's playing in each zone, turn a zone up or down, switch playlists, temporarily play something for an event, or schedule a change for later. Every action respects the permissions of your signed-in Beat Breeze account: the assistant can only see and control the zones you're allowed to manage, scheduled changes require an explicit confirmation, and you can revoke the connection from your dashboard at any time. For existing Beat Breeze customers.
plugin_details.target_long: Beat Breeze 是一个适用于酒店、餐厅、咖啡馆和零售店的背景音乐平台。将其连接到 ChatGPT，只需询问即可管理场地中的音乐：查看每个区域中正在播放的内容、向上或向下调整区域、切换播放列表、为活动临时播放某些内容或安排稍后更改。每个操作都尊重您登录的 Beat Breeze 帐户的权限：助手只能查看和控制您有权管理的区域，计划的更改需要明确确认，并且您可以随时从仪表板撤销连接。对于现有 Beat Breeze 客户。

source_long:
The Beautiful.ai ChatGPT app helps you skip the blank slide and turn rough ideas into clear, work-ready presentations in seconds. Brainstorm, draft, and refine your content directly in ChatGPT, then instantly transform it into a beautifully designed presentation. Add slides, update content, or restructure the entire flow all within the chat, or open your deck in Beautiful.ai for full creative control. Perfect for pitches, reports, strategy discussions, or any deck you need fast without sacrificing quality. Use it to:

- Turn chat conversations into ready-to-share presentations
- Repurpose documents or notes as slides in minutes
- Quickly build polished sales, marketing, product, or leadership decks that stay on brand
- Convert rough ideas or bullet points into clear, actionable recap decks
- Generate new decks by mentioning or tagging @beautiful.ai in your chat

Stop spending hours designing slides. Connect the Beautiful.ai app, or simply tag @beautiful.ai in ChatGPT, and see your content come together instantly.
plugin_details.target_long:
Beautiful.ai ChatGPT 应用程序可帮助您跳过空白幻灯片，在几秒钟内将粗略的想法转变为清晰、可立即工作的演示文稿。直接在 ChatGPT 中集思广益、起草和完善您的内容，然后立即将其转换为设计精美的演示文稿。在聊天中添加幻灯片、更新内容或重组整个流程，或在 Beautiful.ai 中打开您的幻灯片以实现完全的创意控制。非常适合推介、报告、策略讨论或您快速需要的任何平台，而无需牺牲质量。用它来：

- 将聊天对话转变为可共享的演示文稿
- 在几分钟内将文档或笔记重新用作幻灯片
- 快速构建完善的销售、营销、产品或领导力平台，以保持品牌形象
- 将粗略的想法或要点转化为清晰、可操作的概述
- 通过在聊天中提及或标记 @beautiful.ai 来生成新牌组

停止花费大量时间设计幻灯片。连接 Beautiful.ai 应用程序，或在 ChatGPT 中简单地标记@beautiful.ai，然后立即查看您的内容。

source_long:
Bed-and-Breakfast.it is an app designed to help travelers discover and book authentic Italian accommodations directly with the property owners, without commissions or intermediaries.

The app provides access to thousands of bed and breakfasts, vacation rentals, agriturismi and guesthouses across Italy, all managed by independent hosts. Availability and prices are provided directly by the accommodations, ensuring transparency, direct contact and fair conditions for both travelers and hosts.

Users can search by destination, dates and preferences, explore detailed property profiles, and interact with real hosts for tailored information. Where available, instant booking allows travelers to confirm their stay immediately, while maintaining a direct relationship with the accommodation.

With over twenty years of experience in the Italian hospitality market, Bed-and-Breakfast.it focuses on simplicity, trust and sustainability, offering a practical alternative to large commission-based booking platforms.
plugin_details.target_long:
Bed-and-Breakfast.it 是一款应用程序，旨在帮助旅行者直接与业主发现并预订正宗的意大利住宿，无需佣金或中介。

该应用程序提供意大利各地数千家住宿加早餐酒店、度假出租屋、农家乐和宾馆的访问权限，所有这些均由独立房东管理。住宿供应情况和价格由住宿直接提供，确保游客和房东的透明度、直接联系和公平条件。

source_long:
Birdie helps you capture customer issues and turn them into clear context for troubleshooting.

Instead of relying on written descriptions, customers can record their screen to show the issue. Birdie captures the full context, including what happened, what they clicked, and technical evidence such as console logs, network requests, session data, device metadata, and reproduction steps.

This gives your agent the context it needs to understand the issue, troubleshoot it accurately, and move faster to a resolution.

With Birdie, your agent does not have to guess what the customer meant. It can see what the customer saw and use the right evidence to investigate the issue.

Built for support and technical teams, Birdie reduces back and forth and helps both humans and AI troubleshoot customer issues faster.
plugin_details.target_long:
Birdie 帮助您捕获客户问题并将其转化为清晰的上下文以进行故障排除。

客户可以录制屏幕来显示问题，而不是依赖书面描述。 Birdie 捕获完整的上下文，包括发生的事情、他们点击的内容以及控制台日志、网络请求、会话数据、设备元数据和再现步骤等技术证据。

这为您的代理提供了了解问题、准确排除故障并更快找到解决方案所需的背景信息。

有了 Birdie，您的客服人员就不必猜测客户的意思。它可以看到客户看到的内容并使用正确的证据来调查问题。

Bites is an AI-native ordering platform that lets people discover restaurants, browse full menus, and place direct orders from local restaurants — all from ChatGPT, without switching to a delivery app.

Customers get the convenience of AI-powered ordering while seeing in-store menu pricing, with no markups or hidden fees. They can search by cuisine or location, ask for recommendations, customize meals, and build group orders in natural language.

Examples:

"Order from Popeyes in San Jose."
"Order 2 Not So Fried Chicken sandwiches from Mendocino Farms, no sauce, with gluten-free bread."
"Build a vegetarian-friendly office lunch order for 10 people from Boltiful Santa Clara under $20 per person. Add few desserts for the team to share."
"Show me the menu for Curry Up Now and help me pick something spicy."

For restaurants, Bites enables direct, AI-powered ordering with no commissions, no markups, and full ownership of customer relationships. Restaurants can reduce reliance on third-party delivery apps while preserving margins and serving customers through the channels they already use.

In short, Bites combines the convenience of delivery apps with the economics of ordering directly from restaurants.

“来自圣何塞大力水手的订单。”
“从门多西诺农场订购 2 个不那么炸鸡三明治，不加酱汁，搭配无麸质面包。”
“为来自 Boltiful Santa Clara 的 10 个人制定素食友好的办公室午餐订单，每人 20 美元以下。添加一些甜点供团队分享。”
“给我看看 Curry Up Now 的菜单，帮我选一些辣的。”

source_long:
BranchDeploy connects ChatGPT to your existing Azure DevOps deployment workflow.

Preview a work item deployment, confirm the resolved ticket, branch, environment and pipeline, then queue the deployment only if BranchDeploy’s server-side rules allow it.

BranchDeploy does not let ChatGPT deploy arbitrary code. It resolves linked Azure Repos branches and pull requests from the work item, checks the configured environment and branch rules, and requires explicit confirmation before a deployment starts.

Use it to:
- Preview what branch and environment a work item will deploy to
- Confirm the deployment before anything runs
- Queue your existing Azure Pipeline
- Check deployment status
- View recent deployment history
- List configured deployment environments

BranchDeploy wraps your existing Azure Pipeline setup. No YAML changes are required, and deployment safety is enforced server-side using your configured project, environment and branch rules.
plugin_details.target_long:
BranchDeploy 将 ChatGPT 连接到现有的 Azure DevOps 部署工作流程。

预览工作项部署，确认已解析的票证、分支、环境和管道，然后仅在 BranchDeploy 的服务器端规则允许的情况下对部署进行排队。

BranchDeploy 不允许 ChatGPT 部署任意代码。它解析链接的 Azure Repos 分支和来自工作项的拉取请求，检查配置的环境和分支规则，并在部署开始之前需要显式确认。

用它来：
- 预览工作项将部署到的分支和环境
- 在运行任何内容之前确认部署
- 对现有的 Azure Pipeline 进行排队
- 检查部署状态
- 查看最近的部署历史记录
- 列出配置的部署环境

BranchDeploy 包装现有的 Azure Pipeline 设置。无需更改 YAML，并且使用您配置的项目、环境和分支规则在服务器端强制实施部署安全。
