根据您的输入创建个性化的 10 分钟引导冥想音频。

描述一种情况、活动或意图，Breethe 会根据您的要求生成定制的引导冥想。无论您是在准备重要的对话、放松休息，还是在忙碌的一天中休息一下，该应用程序都会创建专为该时刻设计的会话。

主要特点：
- 实时生成自定义冥想
- 支持放松、睡眠和集中注意力
- 固定 10 分钟格式以确保一致性和易用性

Breethe Meditations Made 4 You 提供了一种简单的方法，可以在您想要短暂重置时创建引导式冥想课程。

source_long:
Breeze brings your projects into ChatGPT, so you can manage work by describing what you need. Ask "what's overdue?", "give me an overview of the launch project", or "find the task about customer onboarding" — and get a clear, straight answer.

It doesn't just read — it does the work: create projects and cards, add checklists, post comments, log time, set estimates, move tasks forward, and see everything that changed today. Breeze figures out which people, columns, and projects you mean, so a quick sentence is enough to get things done.

Can't remember the exact title of a task? Search by meaning, not just keywords, and it still turns up. And because changes preview before they apply, you always see what's about to happen before it does.

From kicking off a launch to triaging your week, Breeze turns project management into a conversation.
plugin_details.target_long:
Breeze 将您的项目引入 ChatGPT，以便您可以通过描述您的需求来管理工作。询问“什么逾期了？”、“给我发布项目的概述”或“找到有关客户引导的任务”——然后得到清晰、直接的答案。

它不只是阅读——它还可以工作：创建项目和卡片、添加清单、发表评论、记录时间、设置估算、推进任务以及查看今天发生的所有变化。 Breeze 会弄清楚您指的是哪些人、哪些专栏和哪些项目，因此简短的一句话就足以完成工作。

不记得任务的确切标题？按含义搜索，而不仅仅是关键字，它仍然会出现。而且由于更改会在应用之前进行预览，因此您始终可以在应用之前看到即将发生的情况。

从启动发布到对一周进行分类，Breeze 将项目管理变成了一场对话。

source_long: Breeze helps authenticated users explore their organization's security posture, connected integrations, scan status, tenants, and entity risk data through ChatGPT and Codex.
plugin_details.target_long: Breeze 通过 ChatGPT 和 Codex 帮助经过身份验证的用户探索其组织的安全状况、连接集成、扫描状态、租户和实体风险数据。

source_long: Brex helps finance teams and employees review company spend through ChatGPT. Users can look up expenses, cards, limits, users, bills, vendors, and accounting records; analyze spend; attach receipts from HTTPS URLs; update memos and attendees; assign card expenses to limits; export expense data; and submit product feedback.
plugin_details.target_long: Brex 通过 ChatGPT 帮助财务团队和员工审查公司支出。用户可以查询费用、卡、限额、用户、账单、供应商和会计记录；分析支出；附加来自 HTTPS URL 的收据；更新备忘录和与会者；指定卡费用限额；导出费用数据；并提交产品反馈。

source_long: Brief helps product teams and coding agents retrieve product context, reason over strategy, find and manage decisions, browse workspace knowledge, and connect the tools their team uses.
plugin_details.target_long: Brief 帮助产品团队和编码代理检索产品背景、推理策略、查找和管理决策、浏览工作区知识以及连接团队使用的工具。

source_long: The BrightEdge app retrieves metrics from a user's connected BrightEdge account, covering both AEO and traditional SEO performance across LLMs. It returns AEO citations and mentions, AEO and SEO competitor benchmarking, keyword rank data, page-level performance, Share of Voice competitive scores, Google Search Console and web analytics metrics, AI Overview citation gap analysis, and recommendations. Invoke this app when a user requests prompt citations or mentions, keyword rankings, AEO and SEO competitive visibility, including queries phrased as improvement guidance that require account-specific data rather than general inference. ChatGPT helps users work with BrightEdge data more effectively by combining analyses across different datasets, asking follow-up questions, and turning SEO and AEO metrics into clear insights within a single conversation.
plugin_details.target_long: BrightEdge 应用程序从用户连接的 BrightEdge 帐户检索指标，涵盖法学硕士的 AEO 和传统 SEO 绩效。它返回 AEO 引用和提及、AEO 和 SEO 竞争对手基准测试、关键字排名数据、页面级性能、语音份额竞争分数、Google Search Console 和网络分析指标、AI 概述引用差距分析和建议。当用户请求及时引用或提及、关键字排名、AEO 和 SEO 竞争可见性（包括作为改进指导而需要特定帐户数据而不是一般推理的查询）时，调用此应用程序。 ChatGPT 通过结合不同数据集的分析、提出后续问题以及在单个对话中将 SEO 和 AEO 指标转化为清晰的见解，帮助用户更有效地使用 BrightEdge 数据。

source_long: BrightHire helps users search interview records, retrieve transcripts, AI notes, interview guides, scorecards, job descriptions, candidate summaries, scheduled interview context, and coaching reports they are authorized to view.
plugin_details.target_long: BrightHire 帮助用户搜索面试记录、检索笔录、人工智能笔记、面试指南、记分卡、职位描述、候选人摘要、安排的面试背景以及他们有权查看的辅导报告。

source_long: BrightSite is a website hosting and content management platform. Connect your BrightSite account to build and edit pages, layouts, and reusable components; write, publish, and organize blog posts; manage forms and review submissions; upload and organize media; configure SEO, structured data, redirects, and analytics settings; review site traffic; and manage team members and roles. Content edits are saved to a staged draft first, so you can review changes and then publish them to the live site when they are ready. A staging site and full version history let you preview larger changes and roll back if needed.
plugin_details.target_long: BrightSite 是一个网站托管和内容管理平台。连接您的 BrightSite 帐户以构建和编辑页面、布局和可重用组件；撰写、发布和组织博客文章；管理表格并审查提交的内容；上传和组织媒体；配置 SEO、结构化数据、重定向和分析设置；审查网站流量；并管理团队成员和角色。内容编辑首先保存到暂存草稿中，以便您可以查看更改，然后在准备就绪后将其发布到实时网站。暂存站点和完整版本历史记录可让您预览较大的更改并在需要时回滚。

source_long: The Brisk Teaching connector brings your classroom toolkit into ChatGPT. Create interactive student activities, engaging podcasts, and more right in the tools you already use. Just describe what you need, and Brisk builds it in your account with easy-to-share links, so you can turn your ideas into classroom-ready materials in seconds. Edit, refine, and bring them to your students whenever you're ready.
plugin_details.target_long: Brisk 教学连接器将您的课堂工具包带入 ChatGPT。使用您已使用的工具创建交互式学生活动、参与播客等。只需描述您的需求，Brisk 就会通过易于共享的链接在您的帐户中构建它，这样您就可以在几秒钟内将您的想法变成课堂准备的材料。编辑、完善它们，并在您准备好时将它们带给您的学生。

source_long:
Brokly answers the commercial-insurance questions small-business owners actually have — in plain English, right inside ChatGPT.

Tell Brokly your trade and state, and it pulls from state filings, statutes, and other official sources to lay out exactly what coverage you're required to carry.

Already have coverage or a few quotes? The Brokly Coverage Analysis Tool checks the limits you carry against what your state requires — or against the insurance section of a contract you've been handed — and tells you exactly where you clear the bar and where you fall short.

Try asking things like:
"What insurance does an electrician in Texas need?"
"What does workers' comp cost for a 3-person plumbing shop in Florida?"
"What's the difference between general liability and professional liability?"

With Brokly, figuring out business insurance is a conversation instead of a research project. No jargon, no sales pitch — just clear answers grounded in official sources, so you know where you stand before you buy, renew, or sign.
plugin_details.target_long:
Brokly 就在 ChatGPT 内用简单的英语回答了小企业主实际遇到的商业保险问题。

告诉 Brokly 您的行业和州，它会从州备案、法规和其他官方来源中提取信息，准确列出您需要承保的保险范围。

已经有报道或一些报价？ Brokly 承保分析工具会根据您所在州的要求（或您已收到的合同的保险部分）检查您的限额，并准确地告诉您哪些地方超出了标准，哪些地方不足。

尝试询问以下问题：
“德克萨斯州的电工需要什么保险？”
“佛罗里达州一家 3 人管道店的工人补偿费用是多少？”
“一般责任和专业责任有什么区别？”

对于 Brokly，了解商业保险是一次对话，而不是一个研究项目。没有行话，没有推销——只有基于官方来源的清晰答案，这样您在购买、续订或签署之前就知道自己的立场。

source_long:
BubblaV transform your site with intelligent customer conversations. BubblaV AI Chatbot delivers instant support, captures leads, and seamlessly hands off to live agents when needed.

This app allows ChatGPT to search your knowledge base and access analytics reports in real-time. It can even analyze your knowledge, identify content gaps and fill them in automatically.

Example Use Cases:
​
Customer Support Agent:
Create an agent that can search your documentation and provide analytics.

Reporting Bot
Build a bot that generates weekly performance reports.

Knowledge Search API
Create a simple search API for your internal tools.
plugin_details.target_long:
BubblaV 通过智能客户对话来改变您的网站。 BubblaV AI 聊天机器人提供即时支持、捕获线索，并在需要时无缝地移交给现场客服人员。

该应用程序允许 ChatGPT 搜索您的知识库并实时访问分析报告。它甚至可以分析您的知识，识别内容差距并自动填补。

示例用例：
​
客户支持代理：
创建一个可以搜索文档并提供分析的代理。

报告机器人
构建一个生成每周绩效报告的机器人。

知识搜索API
为您的内部工具创建一个简单的搜索 API。

source_long:
Craving wings, sauces, and game‑day favorites? Order Buffalo Wild Wings faster with ChatGPT. Start a chat, tell us what you’re craving, and build your perfect Buffalo Wild Wings order in seconds. Choose traditional or boneless wings, pick your favorite sauces, add sides and drinks, and customize everything your way.

Find a nearby Buffalo Wild Wings location, build your bag for pickup or delivery, and keep your order organized. When you’re ready, we'll complete your order on the Buffalo Wild Wings app or website.

From wing cravings to checkout, ordering Buffalo Wild Wings has never been easier.
plugin_details.target_long:
想吃鸡翅、酱汁和比赛日的最爱吗？使用 ChatGPT 更快地订购 Buffalo Wild Wings。开始聊天，告诉我们您想要什么，然后在几秒钟内建立您完美的 Buffalo Wild Wings 订单。选择传统或无骨鸡翅，选择您最喜欢的酱汁，添加配菜和饮料，并按照您的方式定制一切。

查找附近的 Buffalo Wild Wings 地点，组装您的行李以供取货或送货，并让您的订单井井有条。当您准备好后，我们将在 Buffalo Wild Wings 应用程序或网站上完成您的订单。

从对鸡翅的渴望到结帐，订购 Buffalo Wild Wings 从未如此简单。

source_long: Use Build Web Apps to create frontend application surfaces with Codex-generated visual assets, verify them with the Browser plugin and built-in app browser, compose shadcn/ui, wire Stripe payments, and design or tune Supabase/Postgres data flows.

source_long: Use Build Web Data Visualization to choose, design, implement, test, and export browser charts, dashboards, maps, WebGL/Three.js scenes, Canvas/D3 visuals, Gantt charts, UML/software diagrams, scrollytelling, reports, PDFs, and slide decks. It emphasizes source-backed data, accessible responsive layouts, URL-shareable analysis state, and concept-first design for advanced visual stories.
plugin_details.target_long: 使用构建 Web 数据可视化来选择、设计、实施、测试和导出浏览器图表、仪表板、地图、WebGL/Three.js 场景、Canvas/D3 视觉效果、甘特图、UML/软件图表、滚动讲述、报告、PDF 和幻灯片。它强调源支持的数据、可访问的响应式布局、URL 可共享的分析状态以及高级视觉故事的概念优先设计。

source_long: Use Build iOS Apps to design App Intents and App Shortcuts, build or refactor SwiftUI UI, render SwiftUI previews in the Codex in-app browser, adopt modern iOS patterns such as Liquid Glass, audit runtime performance, capture ETTrace profiles, investigate memory leaks, and debug apps on simulators with XcodeBuildMCP-backed workflows.

source_long: macOS development workflows for discovering local projects, building and running desktop apps, implementing native SwiftUI scenes, bridging into AppKit when necessary, adding lightweight Logger telemetry, triaging test failures, inspecting signing and entitlements, and debugging desktop-specific build or runtime errors.

source_long: BuildBetter helps teams find product and customer evidence context across signals, calls, transcripts, documents, knowledge pages, people, and schema metadata so product and engineering work can be grounded in authenticated workspace evidence.
plugin_details.target_long: BuildBetter 帮助团队跨信号、呼叫、文字记录、文档、知识页面、人员和模式元数据查找产品和客户证据上下文，以便产品和工程工作可以基于经过验证的工作区证据。

source_long: Buildfire helps app owners manage their Buildfire apps from ChatGPT. Users can list accessible apps, inspect installed features, search users, create users, assign or remove tags, review app and plugin analytics, inspect plugin memory, find push notification groups, and schedule push notifications with confirmation-oriented dry runs.
plugin_details.target_long: Buildfire 帮助应用程序所有者通过 ChatGPT 管理他们的 Buildfire 应用程序。用户可以列出可访问的应用程序、检查已安装的功能、搜索用户、创建用户、分配或删除标签、查看应用程序和插件分析、检查插件内存、查找推送通知组以及通过面向确认的试运行安排推送通知。

source_long: Buildory helps makers review project progress, search sections, tasks, parts, build logs and knowledge, and, with explicit write permission, create or update selected project records.
plugin_details.target_long: Buildory 帮助创客审查项目进度、搜索部分、任务、零件、构建日志和知识，并在具有明确的写入权限的情况下创建或更新选定的项目记录。

source_long: Buildy is a hosted runtime for personal web apps that users and their agents can share. An agent creates an app, Buildy gives it a URL, backend, and key-value storage, and the user keeps using the same app and data across ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents.
plugin_details.target_long: Buildy 是用户及其代理可以共享的个人 Web 应用程序的托管运行时。代理创建一个应用程序，Buildy 为其提供 URL、后端和键值存储，用户可以在 ChatGPT、Claude 和其他代理之间继续使用相同的应用程序和数据。

source_long: Bull AI brings company documents and data for NSE/BSE-listed Indian companies into ChatGPT and Codex. Explore annual reports, earnings materials and other company disclosures with citations; compare management guidance with later company-reported outcomes; examine management-claimed advantages alongside listed peers; understand revenue segments; review market transactions and corporate actions; and map disclosed customers, suppliers and partners. Bull AI is built for source-backed company research that clearly separates reported facts, management claims and interpretation.
plugin_details.target_long: Bull AI 将 NSE/BSE 上市印度公司的公司文件和数据引入 ChatGPT 和 Codex。探索年度报告、盈利材料和其他公司披露的引文；将管理层指导与公司后来报告的结果进行比较；与上市同行一起审查管理层声称的优势；了解收入细分；审查市场交易和公司行为；并地图披露了客户、供应商和合作伙伴。 Bull AI 专为有来源支持的公司研究而构建，明确区分报告的事实、管理层的主张和解释。

source_long:

source_long: BurnFat helps adults estimate daily calories and macros for fat loss, compare three safety-capped paces, and view an adaptive goal timeline through an interactive planner.
plugin_details.target_long: BurnFat 帮助成年人估计每日卡路里和减脂宏量，比较三种安全上限步速，并通过交互式计划器查看自适应目标时间表。

source_long:
The easiest way to travel by bus or train worldwide.

Busbud helps you book tickets for routes from thousands of bus and train companies, so you can quickly find and book the option that fits you best.

With Busbud on ChatGPT, you can:
• Explore schedules from thousands of bus and train companies
• Get up-to-date prices, amenities and availability
• Find the cheapest or fastest trips for your journey
• See key details at a glance: company profile, price, duration, and departure times

Why travelers choose Busbud:

• Coverage across 80+ countries and millions of routes, with strong presence in North America, Latin America, Europe, and Africa
• Trusted bus carriers like Greyhound, FlixBus, ADO, ALSA, BlaBlaCar, Trailways, Intercape, and many regional operators
• Train operators including VIA Rail, Amtrak, SNCF, Eurostar, and Renfe
• Clear, competitive pricing across bus and train carriers
plugin_details.target_long:
乘坐巴士或火车前往世界各地最简单的方式。

Busbud 帮助您预订数千家巴士和火车公司路线的车票，以便您可以快速找到并预订最适合您的选项。

通过 ChatGPT 上的 Busbud，您可以：
• 探索数千家巴士和火车公司的时刻表
• 获取最新价格、设施和供应情况
• 为您的旅程找到最便宜或最快的行程
• 关键详细信息一目了然：公司简介、价格、持续时间和出发时间

旅行者选择 Busbud 的原因：

• 覆盖80多个国家和数百万条航线，在北美、拉丁美洲、欧洲和非洲拥有强大影响力
• 值得信赖的巴士运营商，如 Greyhound、FlixBus、ADO、ALSA、BlaBlaCar、Trailways、Intercape 以及许多区域运营商
• 火车运营商包括 VIA Rail、Amtrak、SNCF、Eurostar 和 Renfe
• 巴士和火车运营商的清晰、有竞争力的定价

source_long:
Business Helper improves ChatGPT answers to business questions by adding reliable, source-
backed context from trusted expert materials.

When users ask about strategy, product, marketing, or operations, the app enriches responses
with relevant examples and references to real-world insights. Context is added only when it
clearly improves usefulness. If no relevant sources are found, ChatGPT responds normally
without external references.

Business Helper does not collect personal data, and does not provide professional legal or financial advice. Any external services are recommended based on user's intentions only.
plugin_details.target_long:
Business Helper 通过添加可靠的来源来改进 ChatGPT 对业务问题的回答
来自值得信赖的专家材料的背景背景。

当用户询问战略、产品、营销或运营时，该应用会丰富回复
包含相关示例和对现实世界见解的参考。仅在以下情况下才添加上下文
明显提高了实用性。如果没有找到相关来源，ChatGPT 会正常响应
无需外部参考。

生意帮不收集个人资料，也不提供专业的法律或财务建议。任何外部服务仅根据用户的意图推荐。

source_long:
Turn your business idea into a clear, shareable strategy.
Use this whether you are starting a new business or sharpening an existing one.
It helps you find the right words to explain what you do, for whom, and why it matters.
That gives you clarity for yourself before you bring others in.
It also helps you make real choices and trade-offs instead of keeping everything open.
You work toward a complete Business Strategy Canvas that fits on one page.
This one-page canvas becomes a simple reference you can use to align decisions and priorities.
At the end, you can export a PPTX presentation to share with co-founders, teammates, clients, or stakeholders.
Use the PPTX to pitch, get buy-in, or kick off a strategy session with everyone on the same page.
If your thinking feels scattered, this turns it into something you can communicate and act on.
plugin_details.target_long:
将您的经营理念转变为清晰、可共享的战略。
无论您是要开始一项新业务还是加强现有业务，都可以使用它。
它可以帮助您找到正确的词语来解释您所做的事情、为谁做以及为什么它很重要。
在你引入其他人之前，这可以让你清楚地了解自己。
它还可以帮助您做出真正的选择和权衡，而不是让一切都保持开放。
您致力于在一页上绘制完整的业务战略画布。

source_long:

With Buson on ChatGPT, you can:
• Explore schedules from hundreds of bus companies across Brazil
• Check real-time prices, seat availability, and onboard amenities
• Find the cheapest or fastest option for your trip
• View key details at a glance: bus company, price, duration, and departure times

Why travelers choose Buson:

plugin_details.target_long:
乘坐巴士穿越巴西最简单的方式

source_long:
Make the most informed real estate decision with a comprehensive Buy vs. Rent simulator. This app provides an objective, data-driven analysis to determine if buying a property is truly more profitable than renting and investing your capital elsewhere.

By integrating historical and projected IMF inflation data for your specific country, the simulator tracks the real value of your money year after year. It provides a complete financial breakdown from your first mortgage payment to the final resale, ensuring you stay objective based on your unique project.

Key features:
- Uses country-specific IMF inflation data for realistic long-term projections
- Compares the cost of buying with potential returns of alternative investments (stock market, savings, etc.)
- No account or registration required — start simulating immediately
- Toggle advanced parameters and view a full amortization table to understand every payment of your mortgage

Adjustable parameters:
- Property: Purchase price, notary fees, renovation costs, and agency fees
- Financing: Down payment, loan duration, mortgage rate, insurance, and prepayment penalties
- Rental: Monthly rent and projected annual rent increases
- Market Logic: Resale horizon, country-specific inflation (IMF), and alternative investment yield
- Costs: Local property taxes and maintenance

Get a clear, visual report on your break-even point and see exactly when ownership starts to pay off.
plugin_details.target_long:
通过全面的购买与租赁模拟器做出最明智的房地产决策。该应用程序提供客观的、数据驱动的分析，以确定购买房产是否真的比在其他地方租赁和投资更有利可图。

通过整合您所在国家/地区的历史和预测国际货币基金组织通胀数据，模拟器可以年复一年地跟踪您资金的实际价值。它提供了从您的第一笔抵押贷款付款到最终转售的完整财务明细，确保您根据自己的独特项目保持客观。

主要特点：
- 使用特定国家的国际货币基金组织通胀数据进行现实的长期预测
- 将购买成本与另类投资（股票市场、储蓄等）的潜在回报进行比较
- 无需帐户或注册 - 立即开始模拟
- 切换高级参数并查看完整的摊销表以了解您的抵押贷款的每笔付款

可调参数：
- 房产：购买价、公证费、装修费、中介费
- 融资：首付、贷款期限、抵押贷款利率、保险和提前还款罚款
- 租金：月租金和预计年租金上涨
- 市场逻辑：转售期限、特定国家通胀（IMF）和另类投资收益率
- 成本：当地财产税和维护费

获得关于收支平衡点的清晰、直观的报告，并准确了解所有权何时开始获得回报。

source_long:
BuyWise is a shopping assistant for comparing physical consumer products in ChatGPT. Tell BuyWise what you are looking for, including your budget, use case, preferred features, and constraints, and it helps compare relevant products from supported merchants.
BuyWise can help users:
• Search for products that match a shopping need or budget.
• Compare prices, availability, product details, and key purchase considerations across supported merchants.
• Summarize useful review signals and product tradeoffs to support a more informed purchase decision.
• Recommend suitable options for specific scenarios, such as gifts, home office setups, travel accessories, or consumer tech purchases.
• Direct users to external merchant pages to complete purchases outside ChatGPT.
BuyWise does not process payments inside ChatGPT, does not sell digital goods, and does not replace the merchant’s checkout, return, warranty, or support policies.
plugin_details.target_long:
BuyWise 是一款在 ChatGPT 中比较实物消费品的购物助手。告诉 BuyWise 您正在寻找什么，包括您的预算、用例、首选功能和限制，这有助于比较受支持商家的相关产品。
BuyWise 可以帮助用户：
• 搜索符合购物需求或预算的产品。
• 比较受支持商家的价格、库存情况、产品详细信息和主要购买注意事项。
• 总结有用的评论信号和产品权衡，以支持更明智的购买决策。
• 针对特定场景推荐合适的选项，例如礼物、家庭办公室设置、旅行配件或消费技术购买。
• 将用户引导至外部商家页面以在ChatGPT 之外完成购买。
BuyWise 不在 ChatGPT 内处理付款，不销售数字商品，也不取代商家的结账、退货、保修或支持政策。

source_long:
Bybit is a leading global cryptocurrency exchange. This plugin provides real-time public market data directly in your ChatGPT conversations — no account or API key required.

Capabilities:
• Real-time prices: Get the latest price, 24h change, and trading volume for any spot or futures pair on Bybit.
• K-line charts: Retrieve candlestick (OHLCV) data across multiple timeframes (1m to 1M), rendered as an interactive chart widget.
• Order book depth: View live bid/ask spread and market depth for any symbol.
• Contract specs: Look up minimum order quantity, tick size, and maximum leverage for any instrument.
• Funding rate: Check the current funding rate for USDT perpetual futures.

All data is sourced from Bybit's public REST API (v5). Provided for informational purposes only. Does not constitute investment advice, an offer, or a solicitation to engage in any transaction.
plugin_details.target_long:
Bybit 是全球领先的加密货币交易所。该插件直接在您的 ChatGPT 对话中提供实时公开市场数据 - 无需帐户或 API 密钥。

能力：
• 实时价格：获取Bybit上任何现货或期货对的最新价格、24小时变化以及交易量。
• K 线图表：检索跨多个时间范围（1m 到1M）的烛台(OHLCV) 数据，呈现为交互式图表小部件。
• 订单簿深度：查看任何品种的实时买/卖价差和市场深度。
• 合约规格：查找任何工具的最小订单数量、价格变动大小和最大杠杆。

source_long:
Detect signs of fraud, manipulation, and AI generation in images and PDF documents. Upload a file and the app analyzes it for authenticity signals such as possible edits, synthetic content, document tampering, and AI-generated visuals.

It helps teams quickly review suspicious images, identity documents, invoices, statements, screenshots, and PDFs before making decisions. Results are presented in a clear, easy-to-understand format so users can spot risks faster, reduce manual review time, and make more confident fraud checks.

Ideal for compliance teams, fraud analysts, marketplaces, fintech platforms, KYC providers, insurers, and anyone who needs a practical way to assess whether visual content or documents may have been altered, forged, or AI-generated.
plugin_details.target_long:
检测图像和 PDF 文档中的欺诈、操纵和 AI 生成的迹象。上传文件，应用程序会分析该文件的真实性信号，例如可能的编辑、合成内容、文档篡改和人工智能生成的视觉效果。

它可以帮助团队在做出决策之前快速审查可疑图像、身份证件、发票、报表、屏幕截图和 PDF。结果以清晰、易于理解的格式呈现，因此用户可以更快地发现风险，减少人工审核时间，并更自信地进行欺诈检查。

非常适合合规团队、欺诈分析师、市场、金融科技平台、KYC 提供商、保险公司以及任何需要实用方法来评估视觉内容或文档是否已被更改、伪造或人工智能生成的人。

source_long:

source_long:

source_long:
Unleash ChatGPT as your private markets research agent. Source companies, build market maps, draft investment memos, and monitor competitors — all powered by CB Insights’ predictive intelligence. Tap into 11M+ double-validated company profiles, leading coverage of recent equity deals, proprietary taxonomies, unique scores, hidden signals, and over 20 years of bleeding edge technology research to identify and analyze relevant, high-potential companies ahead of your competition.

Built for corporate strategists seeking acquisition targets, VCs screening deal flow, and business development teams hunting new partners. If your work involves private companies, CB Insights delivers the insight you need to make your next move first.
plugin_details.target_long:
让 ChatGPT 作为您的私人市场研究代理。寻找公司、绘制市场地图、起草投资备忘录以及监控竞争对手——所有这些都由 CB Insights 的预测情报提供支持。利用超过 1100 万家经过双重验证的公司简介、最新股权交易的领先报道、专有分类法、独特评分、隐藏信号以及 20 多年的前沿技术研究，以领先于竞争对手识别和分析相关的高潜力公司。

专为寻求收购目标的企业战略家、筛选交易流的风险投资家以及寻找新合作伙伴的业务开发团队而设计。如果您的工作涉及私营公司，CB Insights 可以为您提供下一步行动所需的见解。

source_long: Connect AI works with cloud data warehouses, relational databases, data lakehouses, analytics platforms and more so you can explore and analyze your data through conversation. Use your data as input to the work you're doing in ChatGPT, like correlating product telemetry with the release schedule to investigate user engagement. In Connect AI, you build virtual datasets across sources with defined relationships and semantic context, and surface them as purpose-built tools – so ChatGPT works with your data the way your business understands it, not just the way it’s stored. IT admins control access and monitor every query with full audit trails — so the right people reach the right data, nothing more.
plugin_details.target_long: Connect AI 可与云数据仓库、关系数据库、数据湖站、分析平台等配合使用，因此您可以通过对话探索和分析数据。使用您的数据作为您在 ChatGPT 中所做的工作的输入，例如将产品遥测与发布计划相关联以调查用户参与度。在 Connect AI 中，您可以跨具有定义的关系和语义上下文的源构建虚拟数据集，并将它们呈现为专用工具 - 因此 ChatGPT 以您的企业理解的方式处理您的数据，而不仅仅是其存储方式。 IT 管理员通过完整的审核跟踪来控制访问并监控每个查询，以便正确的人员获取正确的数据，仅此而已。

source_long:
Cosmos brings Consumer Edge's transaction data directly into ChatGPT. Ask questions in plain English and get analyst-grade answers built on near-real-time spend data from millions of US credit and debit cards, covering thousands of brands and merchants — weeks ahead of company reporting. Work directly with transaction-level data to build custom cohorts, run price-point analyses, and answer questions aggregates can't.

Each question runs through Cosmos, Consumer Edge's AI analytics engine, which selects the right metrics, handles panel weighting and merchant hierarchies, and returns a structured summary with the underlying data. Results come back as queryable tables, so ChatGPT can run follow-up analysis, calculate custom metrics, or build charts without re-querying.


Key features:

Natural language querying — no SQL or schema knowledge required; ask about brands, tickers, or merchant groups directly

Full KPI coverage — spend, transactions, average ticket, unique shoppers, visit frequency, and new customer acquisition

Demographic and cohort breakdowns — segment any brand's performance by customer income cohort

Flexible time grains — daily, monthly, or quarterly trends, including quarter-to-date reads on partial periods

Analyst-ready output — answers flag accelerations, decelerations, calendar shifts, and partial-month caveats automatically

Use it to:

Track brand performance ahead of earnings — monthly and quarter-to-date spend growth versus prior periods

Run competitive benchmarking — compare KPIs and market share shifts across any set of brands

Analyze customer behavior — see where new customer growth comes from and whether cohorts are trading down

Spot inflection points — decompose month-over-month changes into customer count, frequency, and ticket drivers

Requires a Consumer Edge subscription with MCP access enabled.
plugin_details.target_long:
Cosmos 将 Consumer Edge 的交易数据直接引入 ChatGPT。用简单的英语提出问题，并根据来自数百万张美国信用卡和借记卡的近实时支出数据（涵盖数千个品牌和商家）获得分析师级答案 - 比公司报告提前几周。直接使用交易级数据来构建自定义群组、运行价格点分析并回答聚合无法回答的问题。

每个问题都通过 Consumer Edge 的人工智能分析引擎 Cosmos 运行，该引擎会选择正确的指标、处理面板权重和商家层次结构，并返回包含基础数据的结构化摘要。结果以可查询表的形式返回，因此 ChatGPT 可以运行后续分析、计算自定义指标或构建图表，而无需重新查询。


主要特点：

自然语言查询——无需 SQL 或模式知识；直接询问品牌、股票代码或商家群体

全面的 KPI 覆盖——支出、交易、平均门票、独特购物者、访问频率和新客户获取

人口统计和群体细分——按客户收入群体对任何品牌的表现进行细分

灵活的时间粒度——每日、每月或每季度趋势，包括部分周期的季度至今读数

分析师就绪的输出 - 自动回答标记加速、减速、日历变化和部分月份的警告

用它来：

在盈利之前跟踪品牌表现——与前期相比的月度和季度至今的支出增长

运行竞争性基准测试 - 比较任何品牌组的 KPI 和市场份额变化

分析客户行为——了解新客户增长来自何处以及客户群体是否正在下降

拐点点——将逐月变化分解为客户数量、频率和票务驱动因素

需要启用 MCP 访问的消费者边缘订阅。

自然语言查询——无需 SQL 或模式知识；直接询问品牌、股票代码或商家群体

全面的 KPI 覆盖——支出、交易、平均门票、独特购物者、访问频率和新客户获取

人口统计和群体细分——按客户收入群体对任何品牌的表现进行细分

灵活的时间粒度——每日、每月或每季度趋势，包括部分周期的季度至今读数

分析师就绪的输出 - 自动回答标记加速、减速、日历变化和部分月份的警告

用它来：

在盈利之前跟踪品牌表现——与前期相比的月度和季度至今的支出增长

运行竞争性基准测试 - 比较任何品牌组的 KPI 和市场份额变化

分析客户行为——了解新客户增长来自何处以及客户群体是否正在下降

拐点点——将逐月变化分解为客户数量、频率和票务驱动因素

需要启用 MCP 访问的消费者边缘订阅。

source_long:
What can the CI HUB connector do for you:
- Get Previews for InDesign Files even if your system does not deliver them
- Browse your DAM, Purchase images with your Stock partner, and share with your preferred cloud storage. All in one Plug-In
- Browse folders and images you have access to. User permissions are mirrored within the plug-in.
- Supports all file formats
- Open your asset in the browser/original location
- Link directly to your asset
- Link to your asset and relink when needed, even in Premiere Pro
- Open and save Projects in Premiere Pro
- Switch between Versions and high/low-res renditions, use the FPO as long as you need, even in Premiere Pro if your DAM System supports it
- Upload PDF and InDesign Packages with one click.
- Check for updates on the placed assets
- NO C++, so no delay for new Adobe Versions. Always up to date
- Decentralized administration makes setting up CI HUB in your organization easy
- When the assets licensing permissions changed, you are warned.
plugin_details.target_long:
CI HUB 连接器可以为您做什么：
- 获取 InDesign 文件预览，即使您的系统未提供它们
- 浏览您的 DAM，与您的 Stock 合作伙伴购买图像，并与您首选的云存储共享。多合一插件
- 浏览您有权访问的文件夹和图像。用户权限镜像在插件内。
- 支持所有文件格式
- 在浏览器/原始位置打开您的资产
- 直接链接到您的资产
- 链接到您的资源并在需要时重新链接，甚至在 Premiere Pro 中也是如此
- 在 Premiere Pro 中打开和保存项目
- 在版本和高/低分辨率再现之间切换，根据需要使用 FPO，甚至在 Premiere Pro 中（如果您的 DAM 系统支持）
- 一键上传 PDF 和 InDesign 包。
- 检查已放置资产的更新
- 没有 C++，因此新的 Adobe 版本不会出现延迟。始终保持最新状态
- 去中心化管理使在您的组织中设置 CI HUB 变得容易
- 当资产许可权限发生变化时，您会收到警告。

source_long: OnStyle is a conversational shopping app connected to a Korean TV home-shopping platform, built for discovering products across fashion, beauty, food, and other lifestyle categories in ChatGPT. Users can describe what they want naturally — by style, season, budget, or context — and receive relevant product results with follow-up refinement across multiple turns. OnStyle also supports searching for broadcast products, helping users explore shopping options in a more intuitive way than traditional keyword search.
plugin_details.target_long: OnStyle 是一款连接到韩国电视家庭购物平台的对话式购物应用程序，旨在在 ChatGPT 中发现时尚、美容、食品和其他生活方式类别的产品。用户可以根据风格、季节、预算或背景自然地描述他们想要的东西，并通过多个回合的后续细化获得相关的产品结果。 OnStyle还支持搜索广播产品，帮助用户以比传统关键字搜索更直观的方式探索购物选项。

source_long: CLEATUS is the AI-native platform for government contractors. The CLEATUS app turns ChatGPT into a GovCon teammate with live access to your workspace: search federal, SLED, and Canadian opportunities plus pre-RFP forecasts across 40,000+ sources, manage your pipeline and pursuits, create and assign tasks, run saved searches, and draft and execute Workflows.
plugin_details.target_long: CLEATUS 是面向政府承包商的人工智能原生平台。 CLEATUS 应用程序将 ChatGPT 变成 GovCon 队友，可以实时访问您的工作空间：搜索联邦、SLED 和加拿大机会以及跨 40,000 多个来源的 RFP 预测、管理您的渠道和追求、创建和分配任务、运行保存的搜索以及起草和执行工作流程。

source_long: Navigate the TTB COLA Registry with COLA Cloud. This connector gives ChatGPT access to an enriched, daily-updated copy of the TTB Public COLA Registry of alcohol product label approvals. Search and retrieve COLA records, inspect permittee records, check current TTB processing-time metadata, and understand your COLA Cloud plan limits. COLA Cloud is for business, data, and compliance research workflows; it does not provide legal advice, sell alcohol, or modify TTB records.
plugin_details.target_long: 使用 COLA Cloud 浏览 TTB COLA 注册表。该连接器使 ChatGPT 能够访问酒精产品标签批准的 TTB 公共 COLA 注册表的丰富且每日更新的副本。搜索和检索 COLA 记录、检查被许可人记录、检查当前 TTB 处理时间元数据并了解您的 COLA Cloud 计划限制。 COLA Cloud 适用于业务、数据和合规性研究工作流程；它不提供法律建议、销售酒类或修改 TTB 记录。

source_long: COR helps users manage their COR workspace from ChatGPT by finding clients, projects, tasks, collaborators, labels, attachments, and time logs, and by creating or updating projects, tasks, comments, attachments, collaborators, labels, and logged time.
plugin_details.target_long: COR 通过查找客户、项目、任务、协作者、标签、附件和时间日志，以及创建或更新项目、任务、评论、附件、协作者、标签和记录时间，帮助用户从 ChatGPT 管理其 COR 工作区。

COROS MCP connects ChatGPT with COROS workout, activity, device, and training data, so users can ask natural-language questions about their performance trends. It helps users review workout records, analyze activity details, laps, segments, and FIT files, understand training load and schedules, and generate personal activity and training summaries. 

It is not for emergencies, clinical diagnosis, or medication advice.
plugin_details.target_long:
COROS MCP 将 ChatGPT 与 COROS 锻炼、活动、设备和训练数据连接起来，以便用户可以提出有关其表现趋势的自然语言问题。它可以帮助用户查看锻炼记录，分析活动详细信息、圈数、分段和 FIT 文件，了解训练负荷和日程安排，并生成个人活动和训练摘要。 

它不适用于紧急情况、临床诊断或药物建议。

source_long: CVpop helps you create and customize professional CVs directly in ChatGPT. Describe your experience and career goals to generate a structured CV, then refine its content through conversation and preview changes in an interactive editor. Explore templates, colors, fonts, and layouts in the widget, then continue securely in CVpop when you are ready.
plugin_details.target_long: CVpop 可帮助您直接在 ChatGPT 中创建和定制专业简历。描述您的经验和职业目标以生成结构化简历，然后通过对话完善其内容并在交互式编辑器中预览更改。探索小部件中的模板、颜色、字体和布局，然后在准备好后在 CVpop 中安全地继续。

source_long: Cactus turns commercial real estate due diligence into a conversation. Pull up your CRE deals and portfolio, review underwriting facts — NOI, rent rolls, cap rates, debt terms — and trace every number back to its source document. Verify what’s supported, flag what isn’t, and get a clean deal overview in seconds. Built for acquisitions teams, analysts, and investors who need answers they can defend.
plugin_details.target_long: 仙人掌将商业房地产尽职调查变成了一场对话。调出您的商业地产交易和投资组合，审查承保事实——NOI、租金清单、资本化率、债务条款——并将每个数字追溯到其源文件。验证支持的内容，标记不支持的内容，并在几秒钟内获得清晰的交易概述。专为需要可以捍卫的答案的收购团队、分析师和投资者而设计。

source_long:
Search for products as easily as texting a friend.

Shopping made simple, the way it should be.

source_long: Cal Plus is an AI calorie tracker and coach. Connect your Cal Plus account and ask ChatGPT about your own logged data in plain words: how your nutrition has been over any period and how it compares with your calorie, protein, carb and fat targets; what you ate on a given day; when you last logged a particular food; your step count and active energy from a connected health app; workout frequency, volume and consistency; your body-weight trend against your goal; habit streaks; and the dietary restrictions, allergies and preferences you have asked Cal Plus to remember, so suggestions respect them. Requires an active Cal Plus subscription.
plugin_details.target_long: Cal Plus 是一款人工智能卡路里追踪器和教练。连接您的 Cal Plus 帐户，并用简单的语言向 ChatGPT 询问您自己记录的数据：您在任何时期内的营养状况如何，以及与您的卡路里、蛋白质、碳水化合物和脂肪目标的比较情况；您在某一天吃了什么；您上次记录特定食物的时间；来自互联健康应用程序的步数和活跃能量；锻炼频率、锻炼量和一致性；您的体重趋势与目标的对比；习惯条纹；以及您要求 Cal Plus 记住的饮食限制、过敏和偏好，因此建议会尊重它们。需要有效的 Cal Plus 订阅。

source_long: Find out instantly whether it's worth filling up with ethanol (alcohol) or gasoline. You enter the price per liter of each fuel at your gas station and the calculator applies the 70% rule: if the ethanol price divided by the gasoline price is below 0.70, ethanol is worth it; otherwise, gasoline is the better choice. You can also enter each fuel's efficiency (km/l) for an even more precise cost-per-kilometer calculation. No sign-up and no personal data collected.
plugin_details.target_long: 立即了解是否值得添加乙醇（酒精）或汽油。您在加油站输入每种燃料每升的价格，计算器将应用 70% 规则：如果乙醇价格除以汽油价格低于 0.70，则乙醇是值得的；如果乙醇价格除以汽油价格低于 0.70，则乙醇是值得的；否则，汽油是更好的选择。您还可以输入每种燃料的效率（公里/升），以进行更精确的每公里成本计算。无需注册，也不会收集个人数据。

source_long:

source_long: CamScanner for ChatGPT helps you bridge the gap between physical documents and digital intelligence seamlessly. plugin_details.target_long: CamScanner for ChatGPT 可帮助您无缝弥合物理文档和数字智能之间的差距。上传、扫描并识别任何图像中的文本；使用 OCR 提取高精度数据供 ChatGPT 进行分析、总结或翻译；只需单击一下即可捕获手写或打印内容。您还可以将复杂的照片转换为结构化文本，以进行即时 AI 处理。非常适合学生、专业人士以及任何想要快速、可靠的图像到文本解决方案而无需打开其他应用程序的人。

source_long: Campaign Requirement Extractor extracts structured campaign requirement fields from campaign request text. source_long: Campiri helps you find the right motorhome for your trip in ChatGPT. plugin_details.target_long: CampusThreads 帮助组织管理员运行大使计划：审查操作、协调活动和轮班、管理任务和资源、与大使和潜在客户沟通以及配置他们的工作空间。

plugin_details.target_long:

该应用程序是只读且无状态的。它不会安排面试、发送邀请、联系候选人、更新 ATS 系统、对候选人进行排名或做出招聘决定。

source_long:
Canny’s app connects ChatGPT to your customer feedback data. Use it to uncover insights, take action, and stay organized.
Ask questions about your feedback:
- What are my top feature requests by ARR?
- What are enterprise customers asking for most?
- What did the product team ship last quarter?
Capture and triage feedback:
- Send a call transcript or support ticket and Autopilot will capture, deduplicate, and triage feedback automatically
- Attribute feedback to a specific user and/or company
- Link Salesforce opportunities or HubSpot deals to ideas
Manage your roadmap:
- Ensure feedback is organized so teams can access their feedback
- Create and update views to look at focused lists of feedback
- Update statuses and other custom fields to keep your team and customers in the loop
plugin_details.target_long:
Canny 的应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到您的客户反馈数据。用它来发现见解、采取行动并保持井井有条。
针对您的反馈提出问题：
- ARR 对我最重要的功能要求是什么？

捕获和分类反馈：

管理您的路线图：

source_long:
Canonical is verified company search for research and prospecting.

  - Get a precise, LLM-verified, domain-keyed shortlist of real companies instead of a page of links.
  - Search for companies that match specific criteria.
  - Find look-alike companies based on a company you already know.
  - Pull full company profiles, including founders and where they worked before.
  - Resolve a company name to its correct domain.
  - Check your Canonical credit balance.
  - Useful for sales prospecting, market research, competitor research, investor mapping, and sourcing.
  - Free to start, no credit card required.
plugin_details.target_long:
Canonical 是经过验证的公司搜索研究和勘探。

  - 用简单的语言描述公司，或使用结构化过滤器，例如位置、员工人数、融资阶段、投资者和创始人背景。

  - 免费开始，无需信用卡。

source_long:
Bring your Canva design workflow into Codex and create, refine, and review designs through natural conversation.
Available skills:
Resize for social media: Adapt a design for Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn in one step.
Bulk create: Generate multiple designs from spreadsheet data using a brand template.
Edit designs: Update text, media, and formatting, or reposition and resize elements.
Get design feedback: Receive structured feedback on visual hierarchy, layout, readability, consistency, and accessibility.
Implement feedback: Review comment threads and apply clear, actionable changes.
Brand check: Check colors, fonts, logo usage, and copy against your Brand Kit.
Once installed, describe what you want in plain language or invoke Canva directly with @Canva.
Try prompts like:
- @Canva, resize this design for social media.
- @Canva, create designs from this spreadsheet using my brand template.
- @Canva, update the headline in this design.
- @Canva, review this design’s visual hierarchy and readability.
- @Canva, implement the feedback in the comment threads.
- @Canva, check this design against my Brand Kit.

Requirements: Connect your Canva account to use the plugin. Bulk Create requires an eligible Canva Enterprise plan.

Want to take a more hands-on approach? Instantly open your design in Canva’s powerful editor for the final touches.
plugin_details.target_long:
将您的 Canva 设计工作流程引入 Codex，并通过自然对话创建、完善和审查设计。
可用技能：
调整社交媒体大小：一步调整 Facebook、Instagram 和 LinkedIn 的设计。
批量创建：使用品牌模板从电子表格数据生成多个设计。
编辑设计：更新文本、媒体和格式，或重新定位元素和调整元素大小。
获取设计反馈：接收有关视觉层次结构、布局、可读性、一致性和可访问性的结构化反馈。
实施反馈：查看评论线程并应用清晰、可操作的更改。
品牌检查：根据您的品牌套件检查颜色、字体、徽标使用和文案。
安装后，用简单的语言描述您想要的内容或直接使用 @Canva 调用 Canva。
尝试如下提示：
- @Canva，针对社交媒体调整此设计的大小。
- @Canva，使用我的品牌模板从此电子表格创建设计。
- @Canva，更新此设计中的标题。
- @Canva，检查此设计的视觉层次结构和可读性。
- @Canva，在评论线程中实施反馈。
- @Canva，根据我的品牌套件检查此设计。

要求：连接您的 Canva 帐户以使用该插件。批量创建需要符合条件的 Canva Enterprise 计划。

想要采取更实际的方法吗？立即在 Canva 强大的编辑器中打开您的设计进行最后的润色。

source_long: Canvs helps users create and edit collaborative whiteboards in ChatGPT. The app can generate new boards from shape layouts or Mermaid diagrams, inspect existing board elements, and update or delete saved canvas content inside the user's private Canvs workspace.
plugin_details.target_long: Canvs 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中创建和编辑协作白板。该应用程序可以从形状布局或美人鱼图生成新板，检查现有板元素，以及更新或删除用户私人 Canvs 工作区中保存的画布内容。

source_long:
Capmind connects your personal recordings and meeting intelligence to ChatGPT.

Use Capmind to search your past recordings, retrieve transcripts and summaries, review key decisions, and find action items from conversations stored in your Capmind account.

Capmind only accesses data belonging to the authenticated user. The app is read-only and does not create, edit, delete, publish, or share recordings on the user’s behalf.
plugin_details.target_long:
Capmind 将您的个人录音和会议情报连接到 ChatGPT。

使用 Capmind 搜索您过去的录音、检索文字记录和摘要、查看关键决策以及从 Capmind 帐户中存储的对话中查找操作项。

Capmind 仅访问属于经过身份验证的用户的数据。该应用程序是只读的，不会代表用户创建、编辑、删除、发布或共享录音。

source_long: Capacities brings together connected note-taking and structured data so everything you care about becomes an object, whether it’s a person, a book you’re reading, a project you’re working on or an idea you want to explore. Objects have structure, properties and connections that grow into a living network of your thoughts.
plugin_details.target_long: 能力将互联的笔记和结构化数据结合在一起，因此您关心的一切都成为一个对象，无论是一个人、您正在阅读的一本书、您正在开展的项目还是您想要探索的想法。物体具有结构、属性和联系，它们会成长为你思想的活生生的网络。

source_long:
CapitalDart matches your capital raise to institutional investors and delivers verified contacts with drafted outreach.

Describe your raise in plain language or upload your deck. CapitalDart structures the targeting criteria, ranks matching firms from a directory of more than 70,000 institutional investors, and explains the fit rationale for each. Select the firms you want and CapitalDart delivers verified contacts, including name, title, email, and LinkedIn, with a personalized introduction drafted in your voice. Outreach is drafted only. You review and send from your own accounts.

You can also request an Investor Readiness Report, an analysis of your deck covering readiness score, likely investor objections, and recommended changes, and track every contact through your pipeline from first outreach to closed.

Searches, rankings, and raise analysis are free. Verified contacts and reports use credits from your CapitalDart account, managed at capitaldart.com. Built for CEOs, CFOs, fund managers, and real estate sponsors raising institutional capital.
plugin_details.target_long:
CapitalDart 将您的融资与机构投资者进行匹配，并通过起草的外展活动提供经过验证的联系人。

用通俗易懂的语言描述您的加注或上传您的套牌。 CapitalDart 制定目标标准，从 70,000 多家机构投资者的目录中对匹配公司进行排名，并解释每个公司的匹配理由。选择您想要的公司，CapitalDart 会提供经过验证的联系人信息，包括姓名、职位、电子邮件和 LinkedIn，以及用您的声音起草的个性化介绍。外联仅起草。您可以从自己的帐户查看并发送。

您还可以索取投资者准备报告，对您的套牌进行分析，包括准备分数、可能的投资者反对意见和建议的更改，并跟踪从第一次联系到结束的整个管道中的每个联系。

搜索、排名和提升分析都是免费的。经过验证的联系人和报告使用您在 CapitalDart.com 上管理的 CapitalDart 帐户中的积分。专为筹集机构资本的首席执行官、首席财务官、基金经理和房地产赞助商而打造。

source_long: CapyCash helps users track income and expenses, organize categories and lists, and understand spending patterns from their own financial data. Users can ask for summaries, recurring expense detection, affordability checks, savings simulations, and goal-based scenario planning. It is designed to support financial planning and decision-making through a connected CapyCash account.
plugin_details.target_long: CapyCash 帮助用户跟踪收入和支出、组织类别和列表，并从自己的财务数据中了解支出模式。用户可以要求提供摘要、经常性费用检测、负担能力检查、储蓄模拟和基于目标的场景规划。它旨在通过连接的 CapyCash 账户支持财务规划和决策。

source_long: Find cars, SUVs, trucks, EVs, motorcycles, RVs, and trailers for sale from participating US dealerships. Search nearby or nationwide inventory by city, ZIP, budget, mileage, make and model, new, used, or certified condition, body style, fuel, drivetrain, transmission, and features such as AWD, third-row seating, heated seats, or Apple CarPlay. Compare returned listings by price, mileage, year, condition, dealer, and availability; open full listing details and source links; find participating dealership addresses and profiles; or ask which returned option best matches your needs. With explicit consent and confirmation, send the selected dealer a vehicle question, trade-in appraisal request, or test-drive appointment request; the dealer confirms any appointment. Coverage is limited to participating US dealerships and reflects each dealer's latest published inventory.

source_long:
Find and compare used cars with confidence. Help you make smarter buying decisions by finding better deals, reducing risk, and understanding true ownership costs.
Built for people who want help choosing the right used car, avoiding expensive mistakes, and making confident buying decisions.
Search live U.S. used-car inventory by budget, location, vehicle type, features, and lifestyle needs. Whether you're looking for a reliable family SUV, affordable commuter, first car, truck, hybrid, luxury vehicle, or the best value within your budget, CarClever helps you find vehicles that fit your goals.

Compare listings using Deal Scores, market value, reliability indicators, VIN-based vehicle history, and estimated ownership costs to identify the best overall value—not simply the lowest price.

Reduce buying risk with title, accident, ownership, odometer, and recall analysis. 
Understand the true cost of ownership with estimates for financing, insurance, fuel, maintenance, taxes, and depreciation.

Compare vehicles side by side, evaluate trade-offs between price, reliability,  ownership costs, and risk, and make more confident used-car buying decisions.

Use @CarClever when you want:
* Find me a reliable SUV under $40k near me.
* Show me family SUVs under $50k in Dallas that won't break the bank.
* What's the best value affordable sedan under 25k
* Find me a reliable truck under $35k for towing near Denver.
* Show me luxury cars under 30k with good reliability.
* Find me an AWD vehicle under $20k that's safe and dependable.

Find, evaluate, compare, and confidently buy used vehicles with data-backed decision support—not just another listing feed.
plugin_details.target_long:
充满信心地查找和比较二手车。通过寻找更好的交易、降低风险和了解真正的拥有成本，帮助您做出更明智的购买决策。
专为那些需要帮助选择合适的二手车、避免代价高昂的错误并做出自信的购买决定的人们而设计。
按预算、位置、车辆类型、功能和生活方式需求搜索实时美国二手车库存。无论您是在寻找可靠的家庭 SUV、经济实惠的通勤车、第一辆车、卡车、混合动力车、豪华车，还是预算内最超值的车辆，CarClever 都能帮助您找到适合您目标的车辆。

使用交易得分、市场价值、可靠性指标、基于 VIN 的车辆历史记录和估计拥有成本来比较列表，以确定最佳整体价值，而不仅仅是最低价格。

通过产权、事故、所有权、里程表和召回分析降低购买风险。 
通过对融资、保险、燃料、维护、税收和折旧的估算，了解真实的拥有成本。

并排比较车辆，评估价格、可靠性、拥有成本和风险之间的权衡，并做出更自信的二手车购买决策。

当你需要时使用@CarClever：
* 帮我找到一辆靠近我、价格低于 4 万美元的可靠 SUV。
* 向我展示达拉斯 5 万美元以下且不会倾家荡产的家庭 SUV。
* 25k以下最超值的经济型轿车是什么

* 向我展示 30k 以下、可靠性好的豪华车。
* 帮我找一辆 2 万美元以下、安全可靠的全轮驱动车辆。

通过数据支持的决策支持查找、评估、比较并自信地购买二手车，而不仅仅是另一个列表源。

source_long:
Find the right new or used car by describing what you're looking for in plain language.

Search vehicle listings using specific criteria like price, make, model, or mileage - or broader needs such as "cars that are safe in the snow," "great family cars," or "reliable commuter vehicles."

营销人员、分析师和企业领导者可以询问 Codex 战略问题，例如“上个季度哪些渠道推动了最高价值的参与？”或“我们应该在哪里重新分配预算以提高管道效率？”并获得由 Channel99 行业领先的性能数据支持的精确、上下文感知的结果。 

由 Channel99 开发，这是一家 B2B 营销技术公司，致力于提高投资回报率、降低收购成本并为数字营销投资带来财务透明度。

source_long: Chapka Assurances helps you find the right travel insurance and get an instant quote. Answer a few questions about your trip, compare products, and receive your quote by email, all in one conversation.
plugin_details.target_long: Chapka Assurances 可帮助您找到合适的旅行保险并获得即时报价。回答一些有关您旅行的问题、比较产品并通过电子邮件接收报价，所有这些都只需一次对话即可完成。

source_long: Charge Atlas helps you find EV charging stations worldwide from inside ChatGPT. Search by place, coordinate, map viewport, or route, then filter by charger speed, connector type, vehicle compatibility, and charging network. Results open in an interactive map and include source coverage context from NREL and Open Charge Map.
plugin_details.target_long: Charge Atlas 可帮助您从 ChatGPT 内部查找全球电动汽车充电站。按地点、坐标、地图视口或路线搜索，然后按充电器速度、连接器类型、车辆兼容性和充电网络进行过滤。结果在交互式地图中打开，包括来自 NREL 和 Open Charge Map 的源覆盖范围上下文。

source_long:
Connect ChatGPT to your live Chargebee subscription, invoice, customer, and payment data. Ask billing questions in natural language and get answers immediately: renewal risk, payment failure patterns, credit note gaps, LTV by billing cadence, trial conversion.

These cross-references work because Chargebee holds the full commercial event chain in one linked data model - payment events, plan changes, invoice records, cancellation reasons - all connected, all timestamped.
plugin_details.target_long:
将 ChatGPT 连接到您的实时 Chargebee 订阅、发票、客户和付款数据。用自然语言提出计费问题并立即获得答案：续订风险、付款失败模式、贷方票据缺口、按计费节奏计算的生命周期价值、试用转换。

这些交叉引用之所以有效，是因为 Chargebee 在一个链接的数据模型中保存了完整的商业事件链 - 付款事件、计划变更、发票记录、取消原因 - 所有这些都相互连接，都带有时间戳。

source_long: Charming is a hosted runtime for personal web apps that users and their agents can share. An agent creates an app, Charming gives it a URL, backend, and key-value storage, and the user keeps using the same app and data across ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents.
plugin_details.target_long: Charming 是用户及其代理可以共享的个人 Web 应用程序的托管运行时。代理创建一个应用程序，Charming 为其提供 URL、后端和键值存储，并且用户在 ChatGPT、Claude 和其他代理之间继续使用相同的应用程序和数据。

source_long: ChartMogul’s MCP server gives AI assistants secure access to your subscription analytics and customer data. Analyze MRR, ARR, churn, retention, cohorts, subscriptions, revenue trends, and customer activity using natural language. Investigate business performance, identify growth opportunities, uncover churn drivers, explore customer relationships, and answer complex questions about your SaaS business. Built for founders and go-to-market, product, and finance teams, it turns ChartMogul data into actionable insights and faster decisions.
plugin_details.target_long: ChartMogul 的 MCP 服务器使人工智能助手能够安全地访问您的订阅分析和客户数据。使用自然语言分析 MRR、ARR、流失、保留、群组、订阅、收入趋势和客户活动。调查业务绩效、识别增长机会、发现客户流失驱动因素、探索客户关系并回答有关 SaaS 业务的复杂问题。它专为创始人以及市场推广、产品和财务团队打造，可将 ChartMogul 数据转化为可操作的见解和更快的决策。

source_long:
Don't let your temporary conversations disappear. Chat2Doc helps you save, view, and chat with your history. Turn your chats into a permanent Knowledge Base of editable documents.
1. Save What Matters
- Save ChatGPT History: Save chats as editable documents to capture and refine insights.
2. View Saved History
- Instant Access: Click the "View History" button to browse your saved chat history directly in the chat window.
3. Chat with Your History
- Use Your Knowledge Base: Ask ChatGPT to generate new content based specifically on your collection.

How to Use in ChatGPT
1. Connect App: Connect Chat2Doc to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type “@Chat2Doc”.
Sample Prompts
- Save: "@Chat2Doc Save this conversation."
- Chat: "@Chat2Doc Research 'AI Trends' using my Knowledge Base to draft a comprehensive report."
plugin_details.target_long:
不要让临时谈话消失。 Chat2Doc 可帮助您保存、查看和聊天您的历史记录。将您的聊天变成可编辑文档的永久知识库。
1. 保存重要的东西
- 保存 ChatGPT 历史记录：将聊天保存为可编辑文档以捕获和完善见解。
2.查看保存的历史记录
- 即时访问：点击“查看历史记录”按钮，可直接在聊天窗口中浏览您保存的聊天记录。
3. 与你的历史聊天
- 使用您的知识库：要求 ChatGPT 根据您的收藏生成新内容。

如何在 ChatGPT 中使用
1. 连接应用程序：将 Chat2Doc 连接到 ChatGPT。
2. 触发器：输入“@Chat2Doc”。
示例提示
- 保存：“@Chat2Doc 保存此对话。”
- 聊天：“@Chat2Doc 使用我的知识库研究‘人工智能趋势’，起草一份综合报告。”

source_long: ChatData Sync turns ChatGPT into your personal tracking assistant. Describe what you want to track in plain English, and it creates a private structured tracker you can fill, search, and update directly in chat. One connection can manage multiple trackers for workflows like client invoices, garden logs, workouts, and maintenance records.
plugin_details.target_long: ChatData Sync 将 ChatGPT 变成您的个人跟踪助手。用简单的英语描述您想要跟踪的内容，它会创建一个私人结构化跟踪器，您可以直接在聊天中填写、搜索和更新。一个连接可以管理多个工作流程跟踪器，例如客户发票、花园日志、锻炼和维护记录。

source_long: Built for ChatGPT workspace owners and admins to manage members, groups, roles, permissions, GPTs, and Skills, and review Agents and audit logs. Monitor usage and billing across Chat, Codex, and Work, and manage usage limits and alerts. Available only in ChatGPT Work and Codex modes.
plugin_details.target_long: 专为 ChatGPT 工作区所有者和管理员而构建，用于管理成员、组、角色、权限、GPT 和技能，并查看代理和审核日志。监控 Chat、Codex 和 Work 的使用情况和计费，并管理使用限制和警报。仅在 ChatGPT 工作和 Codex 模式下可用。

source_long: Use Ads Manager to discover and manage ad accounts, campaigns, ad groups, and ads; analyze performance and conversions; upload creative images; and, when available, complete self-serve account setup. When multiple campaigns need selection, call list_campaigns with include_performance_metrics=true so the gated picker can show recent performance.
plugin_details.target_long: 使用广告管理器发现和管理广告帐户、广告系列、广告组和广告；分析绩效和转化；上传创意图片；并在可用时完成自助帐户设置。当需要选择多个广告系列时，请使用 include_performance_metrics=true 调用 list_campaigns ，以便门控选择器可以显示最近的效果。

source_long: Plan your next beach vacation with flexible package search across the Caribbean and Mexico. Compare destinations, travel dates, and prices in a single search to find the trip that fits your budget and schedule. Browse vacation packages that include both flights and hotels, explore the cheapest times to travel throughout the year, or narrow your search to specific dates. Whether you're deciding between Cancun, Punta Cana, Jamaica, or dozens of other beach destinations, you can compare your options side by side and find the vacay package that's right for you.
plugin_details.target_long: 通过加勒比海和墨西哥的灵活套餐搜索来计划您的下一个海滩假期。通过一次搜索即可比较目的地、旅行日期和价格，找到适合您的预算和日程的旅行。浏览包含航班和酒店的度假套餐，探索全年最便宜的旅行时间，或将搜索范围缩小到特定日期。无论您是在坎昆、蓬塔卡纳、牙买加还是其他几十个海滩目的地之间做出选择，您都可以并排比较您的选择，找到最适合您的度假套餐。

source_long: The CheapOair app allows users to search and compare airline flight options based on their origin, destination, travel dates, passenger details and cabin preference. The app does not collect payment or complete bookings within ChatGPT. When a user selects “Book on CheapOair,” they are redirected to Cheapoair.com, where fare validation, traveller information, payment, ticketing, cancellations and refunds are handled.
plugin_details.target_long: CheapOair 应用程序允许用户根据出发地、目的地、旅行日期、乘客详细信息和舱位偏好搜索和比较航空公司的航班选择。该应用程序不会在 ChatGPT 内收取付款或完成预订。当用户选择“在 CheapOair 上预订”时，他们会被重定向到 Cheapoair.com，在那里处理票价验证、旅客信息、付款、出票、取消和退款。

source_long: Search through a massive collection of video game cheats, codes, and walkthroughs. Cheat Database covers thousands of games across 30+ platforms — from classic retro consoles to modern systems. Just ask for cheats by game name and get instant results with cheat codes, tips, unlockables, and full walkthroughs. Whether you're stuck on a level or looking for hidden secrets, this app gives you quick access to one of the largest community-built cheat databases on the web.
plugin_details.target_long: 搜索大量视频游戏秘籍、代码和演练。作弊数据库涵盖 30 多个平台上的数千款游戏 - 从经典复古游戏机到现代系统。只需按游戏名称询问作弊即可立即获得包含作弊代码、提示、解锁内容和完整演练的结果。无论您是陷入困境还是寻找隐藏的秘密，此应用程序都可以让您快速访问网络上最大的社区构建的作弊数据库之一。

source_long: Ask ChatGPT about the events your Checkin account can access—without exporting reports. Find events, attendees, contacts, and orders; monitor ticket sales and check-ins; review payment status and revenue; and compare event performance. All tools are read-only and respect your existing Checkin account permissions.
plugin_details.target_long: 向 ChatGPT 询问您的 Checkin 帐户可以访问的事件，而无需导出报告。查找活动、参与者、联系人和订单；监控门票销售和签到；审查付款状态和收入；并比较活动表现。所有工具都是只读的，并尊重您现有的签入帐户权限。

source_long:
Travel Checklist Builder creates a FREE, personalized travel checklist based on your trip details and preferences.

Tell us where you’re going, how long you’ll be away, who’s traveling, and what activities you plan — and we’ll generate a clear, organized packing and planning list you can view, edit, and print.

This tool helps you:
- Prepare for any trip with tailored essentials
- Include climate, activity, and group-specific items
- Get pre-departure reminders and packing categories
- Print or export your checklist for offline use

No generic lists — every checklist is customized to your trip profile.
plugin_details.target_long:
旅行清单生成器根据您的旅行详细信息和偏好创建免费的个性化旅行清单。

告诉我们您要去哪里、您将离开多长时间、谁要旅行以及您计划进行哪些活动 - 我们将生成一份清晰、有条理的打包和计划清单，您可以查看、编辑和打印。

该工具可以帮助您：
- 为任何旅行准备量身定制的必需品
- 包括气候、活动和特定群体的项目
- 获取出发前提醒和包装类别
- 打印或导出您的清单以供离线使用

没有通用列表——每个清单都是根据您的旅行概况定制的。

source_long: ChefJoJo helps you save and use your favorite recipes. With ChatGPT, you can get help with your recipes like never before. Use ChatGPT to ask questions about your recipes and talk to it live while you're cooking. You can also use ChatGPT to create recipes for you and then save them in ChefJoJo.
plugin_details.target_long: ChefJoJo 帮助您保存和使用您最喜欢的食谱。借助 ChatGPT，您可以获得前所未有的食谱帮助。使用 ChatGPT 询问有关您的食谱的问题，并在烹饪时与其进行实时对话。您还可以使用 ChatGPT 为您创建食谱，然后将其保存在 ChefJoJo 中。

source_long: ChefPlan calculates your daily energy needs (BMR, TDEE, and macros) using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation and helps you find recipes with photos, ingredients, and step-by-step instructions. Enter your weight, height, age, gender, activity level, and goal to get a personalized calorie target. Search for recipes by name or get a random dish — all inside the chat.
plugin_details.target_long: ChefPlan 使用 Mifflin-St Jeor 方程计算您的日常能量需求（BMR、TDEE 和宏），并帮助您找到带有照片、成分和分步说明的食谱。输入您的体重、身高、年龄、性别、活动水平和目标，以获得个性化的卡路里目标。按名称搜索食谱或随机获取一道菜肴 - 一切都在聊天中。

source_long: The Chegg Study enables seamless access to curated question-and-answer content. Display a list of study questions to users, and allow subscribers to tap any question to instantly view the complete, expert-verified answer.
plugin_details.target_long: Chegg 研究可以无缝访问精选的问答内容。向用户显示学习问题列表，并允许订阅者点击任何问题即可立即查看完整的、经过专家验证的答案。

source_long: Chess Position Analyzer turns ChatGPT into a chess study partner. Load any position from FEN or start fresh, then drag pieces on the board to set up puzzles, try hypotheticals, or follow a line. Ask questions like "what's White's plan?", "why is this move better?", or "what changes if the rook were on d1?" — and get answers grounded in the exact position in front of you..
plugin_details.target_long: 国际象棋位置分析器将 ChatGPT 变成国际象棋学习伙伴。从 FEN 加载任何位置或重新开始，然后将棋子拖动到棋盘上以设置谜题、尝试假设或沿着一条线走。问诸如“白方的计划是什么？”、“为什么这一步棋更好？”或“如果车在 d1 上会有什么变化？”之类的问题。 — 并根据您面前的确切位置获得答案。

source_long: Chess by Max Health lets people play and study chess inside ChatGPT. Players can start a single-player game against the built-in Stockfish engine at a chosen difficulty (Beginner to Maximum) or against the conversation model, with selectable color and time controls, and can join a live multiplayer lobby to play other people (with optional ranked ELO and match history for signed-in Max Health users). The same Stockfish engine analyzes games: per-move accuracy, blunders and inaccuracies, the turning points, and the time spent on each move, shown on an interactive board the user can step through. Games to analyze can come from the current session, a signed-in user's stored matches, or any public chess.com or Lichess username fetched live. Single positions can also be evaluated for the best move and main line, and key positions can be illustrated on a board with the recommended move and an evaluation bar.
plugin_details.target_long: Max Health 的 Chess 让人们可以在 ChatGPT 内下棋和学习国际象棋。玩家可以以选定的难度（从初级到最高）或对话模型开始单人游戏，并可选择颜色和时间控制，并可以加入实时多人游戏大厅与其他人玩（可选排名 ELO 和登录 Max Health 用户的比赛历史记录）。同一个 Stockfish 引擎分析游戏：每一步的准确性、失误和不准确、转折点以及每一步所花费的时间，显示在用户可以逐步完成的交互式板上。要分析的游戏可以来自当前会话、登录用户存储的比赛或实时获取的任何公共 chess.com 或 Lichess 用户名。还可以评估单个位置的最佳走法和主线，并且可以在板上显示关键位置，并提供推荐的走法和评估栏。

source_long:
Explore a library of chess openings and their variations. See the exact move sequences for popular openings like the Sicilian Defense, Italian Game, and Queen's Gambit displayed on an interactive chess board.

Whether you're preparing for a game or studying opening theory, Chessvia Openings helps you quickly look up and visualize the key moves that define each opening line.
plugin_details.target_long:
探索国际象棋开局及其变体库。查看交互式国际象棋棋盘上显示的西西里防御、意大利棋和后弃兵等热门开局的确切走棋顺序。

无论您是准备比赛还是学习开局理论，Chessvia Openings 都可以帮助您快速查找并可视化定义每条开局线的关键动作。

source_long: Challenge yourself to a game of chess against ChatGPT that thinks through each move in real time. You play white, the ChatGPT plays black — make your move and watch it respond.
plugin_details.target_long: 挑战自己，与 ChatGPT 进行国际象棋比赛，实时思考每一步棋。你玩白棋，ChatGPT 玩黑棋——做出你的举动并观察它的反应。

source_long:
Chotot: One-stop marketplace for everything you need

Chotot is Vietnam's leading one-stop platform for buying and selling, designed to meet your needs at every stage of life. Whether you are looking for a new home, upgrading your vehicle, or decluttering your house, we connect you with millions of buyers and sellers nationwide to make trading simple, efficient, and reliable.

Why you will love using Chotot:

- Discover great-value items quickly: Explore a wide range of listings—from vehicles to home essentials—tailored to your budget and location.
- Shop smart for quality pre-owned goods: Find secondhand electronics, furniture, and fashion at wallet-friendly prices.
- Trade with more confidence: Review listing details and seller information to make more informed decisions.

As part of the Carousell Group, Chotot is committed to empowering Vietnamese daily life through recommerce. We strive to meet all your needs at every stage of life while promoting smart, sustainable consumption choices.
plugin_details.target_long:
Chotot：满足您所需一切的一站式市场

Chotot 是越南领先的一站式买卖平台，旨在满足您人生各个阶段的需求。无论您是在寻找新房、升级车辆还是整理房屋，我们都会为您与全国数百万买家和卖家建立联系，让交易变得简单、高效、可靠。

为什么您会喜欢使用 Chotot：

- 快速发现超值物品：探索根据您的预算和位置量身定制的各种列表（从车辆到家居必需品）。
- 明智地购买优质二手商品：以实惠的价格找到二手电子产品、家具和时装。
- 更加自信地进行交易：查看列表详细信息和卖家信息，以做出更明智的决定。

作为 Carousell 集团的一部分，Chotot 致力于通过电子商务赋能越南人的日常生活。我们努力满足您人生各个阶段的所有需求，同时促进明智、可持续的消费选择。

source_long:
ChristianaCare Careers helps you discover job opportunities at ChristianaCare in one place.

Instead of browsing multiple pages, you can search for roles by job title, specialty, or location and quickly explore available opportunities across the organization. The app makes it easy to understand what each role involves and identify positions that match your experience and interests.

The app is designed to simplify career exploration within ChristianaCare. Whether you’re actively applying or just learning about opportunities, it helps you navigate openings without unnecessary complexity.

When you find a role that interests you, you can review the details and proceed to the official application process.

Key features
• Search jobs by title, specialty, or location
• Explore opportunities across ChristianaCare
• View role details and requirements in one place
• Access official application pages for each role
plugin_details.target_long:
ChristianaCare Careers 可帮助您在一处发现 ChristianaCare 的工作机会。

您无需浏览多个页面，而是可以按职位、专业或地点搜索职位，并快速探索整个组织中的可用机会。该应用程序可以让您轻松了解每个角色所涉及的内容，并确定与您的经验和兴趣相匹配的职位。

source_long:
A complete legal research and firm-management toolkit inside ChatGPT.

Connect ChatGPT to CiteLaw’s U.S. legal database of millions of court opinions, statutes, regulations, court rules, standing orders, agency materials, and other legal authorities. ChatGPT retrieves CiteLaw’s source text instead of relying solely on model memory, producing answers grounded in identifiable authorities with direct citation links.

Legal research:
Ask legal questions in plain English and search cases, statutes, regulations, and rules across jurisdictions. Run Boolean, exact-phrase, metadata, and keyword searches. Retrieve an authority’s text and metadata, investigate how later courts have treated a case, and review a judge’s standing orders and practices. Paste a brief or citation list to verify authorities and identify possible, missing, or mismatched citations. Search documents and revisit prior research stored in your CiteLaw matters.

Firm management:
Review clients, contacts, tasks, deadlines, notes, documents, discovery, clauses, matters, saved workflows, team members, invitations, and workspace activity. Create and update leads, contacts, tasks, calendar events, discovery sets, clauses, matters, team workspaces, and reusable workflows. Run saved workflows in ChatGPT to follow your firm’s standardized research, review, and document processes. Use AI-assisted bulk imports to migrate contacts, matters, leads, tasks, deadlines, and notes from an existing case-management system in batches of 50, with source IDs that make reruns safe. Invite colleagues, manage workspace and matter access, assign roles, and set billing rates. Save notes and drafted Word documents to the active matter. Switch workspaces and matters so work remains in the correct team context.

Built for attorneys, law students, and legal scholars. CiteLaw retrieves and explains legal information; it does not provide legal advice, and using it does not create an attorney-client relationship.
plugin_details.target_long:
ChatGPT 内有完整的法律研究和公司管理工具包。

将 ChatGPT 连接到 CiteLaw 的美国法律数据库，其中包含数百万条法院意见、法规、法规、法院规则、常规命令、机构材料和其他法律权威。 ChatGPT 检索 CiteLaw 的源文本，而不是仅仅依赖模型记忆，生成基于具有直接引用链接的可识别权威的答案。

法律研究：
用简单的英语询问法律问题并搜索跨司法管辖区的案例、法规、法规和规则。运行布尔、精确短语、元数据和关键字搜索。检索权威的文本和元数据，调查后来法院如何处理案件，并审查法官的常规命令和做法。粘贴简短或引文列表以验证权威并识别可能的、缺失的或不匹配的引文。搜索文档并重新访问您的 CiteLaw 事务中存储的先前研究。

公司管理：
查看客户、联系人、任务、截止日期、注释、文档、发现、条款、事项、保存的工作流程、团队成员、邀请和工作区活动。创建和更新潜在客户、联系人、任务、日历事件、发现集、条款、事项、团队工作区和可重用工作流程。在 ChatGPT 中运行保存的工作流程，以遵循公司的标准化研究、审查和文档流程。使用 AI 辅助的批量导入功能，以 50 个为一组的方式从现有案例管理系统中迁移联系人、事务、潜在客户、任务、截止日期和注释，并使用可确保重新运行安全的源 ID。邀请同事、管理工作区和事务访问、分配角色并设置计费费率。将笔记和起草的 Word 文档保存到活动事项中。切换工作空间和事务，以便工作保持在正确的团队环境中。

专为律师、法律学生和法律学者而设计。 CiteLaw 检索并解释法律信息；它不提供法律建议，并且使用它不会建立律师与委托人的关系。

source_long:

source_long:
Manage, search, and transform your Cloudinary media library — directly from Codex.

The Cloudinary app connects your Cloudinary account to Codex, giving you full control over your visual assets through natural language. Upload, organize, tag, transform, and analyze images or videos without leaving the chat. 

What You Can Do
- Upload assets from URLs, local files, or base64 data — automatically analyze, tag, or moderate them.
- Browse and search your entire media library using smart filters or text queries (tags, format, date, size, etc.).
- Organize your library — create folders, rename files, manage metadata, and clean up obsolete assets.
- Transform images or videos with Cloudinary’s powerful syntax — resize, crop, watermark, apply filters, or optimize for delivery.
- Generate archives and backups, or restore previous versions when needed.
- Analyze assets with AI — detect faces, extract text, get color palettes, and accessibility scores.
- Monitor usage — track storage, bandwidth, and transformation credits in real time.
- Visual search — find visually similar images by uploading an example or describing it.

Perfect For
- Developers who want to experiment with Cloudinary API commands in natural language.
- Marketers & designers managing campaign visuals and brand assets.
- Teams automating content workflows with Codex or building multi-agent setups.

Turn Codex into a powerful media management assistant with the Cloudinary app.
plugin_details.target_long:
直接从 Codex 管理、搜索和转换您的 Cloudinary 媒体库。

Cloudinary 应用程序将您的 Cloudinary 帐户连接到 Codex，让您通过自然语言完全控制您的视觉资产。无需离开聊天即可上传、组织、标记、转换和分析图像或视频。 

你能做什么
- 从 URL、本地文件或 Base64 数据上传资产 — 自动分析、标记或审核它们。
- 使用智能过滤器或文本查询（标签、格式、日期、大小等）浏览和搜索整个媒体库。
- 组织您的库 - 创建文件夹、重命名文件、管理元数据并清理过时的资源。
- 使用 Cloudinary 强大的语法转换图像或视频 - 调整大小、裁剪、水印、应用滤镜或优化交付。
- 生成存档和备份，或在需要时恢复以前的版本。
- 使用 AI 分析资产 — 检测人脸、提取文本、获取调色板和可访问性分数。
- 监控使用情况 — 实时跟踪存储、带宽和转换积分。
- 视觉搜索 — 通过上传示例或描述来查找视觉上相似的图像。

完美适合
- 想要用自然语言试验 Cloudinary API 命令的开发人员。
- 营销人员和设计师管理活动视觉效果和品牌资产。

使用 Cloudinary 应用程序将 Codex 变成强大的媒体管理助手。
