Toda alteração de treino é registrada, notificada a você e pode ser desfeita por 7 dias. Quem prescreve continua sendo você — o assistente analisa, propõe e, quando você pede, aplica.
plugin_details.target_long:
CoachPilot 是私人教练的管理系统 — 营养、训练处方、健身记录、课程历史、议程和财务。 Conectando sua conta，você coacha a justa a sua carteira sem sair da conversa：“quem não treina há mais de 10 dias？”，“como está a evolução de agachamento da Marina？”，“monta o treino B dela para esta semana respeitando aamnese”。

您有权使用 CoachPilot 的权限，并学习如何轻松地学习或使用其他内容。 A conexão alcança somente os seus alunos.要更改注册和注册，请在 7 天内发出通知。如果需要连续发送声音 — 或辅助分析、支持、全部声音、应用。

source_long:
Coconut for ChatGPT connects your Coconut workspace to ChatGPT, so you can check on your team's AI agents, review work, and keep tasks moving from the conversation you're already in. Use secure, OAuth-scoped MCP tools to view active Coconut instances, check health, browse tasks and comments, search knowledge, read shared context, monitor scheduled jobs, and explore available connectors.

Coconut is currently available to customers onboarded through our team. Visit coconut.dev to learn more or get in touch.
plugin_details.target_long:
Coconut for ChatGPT 将您的 Coconut 工作区连接到 ChatGPT，以便您可以检查团队的 AI 代理、审查工作并让任务从您已参与的对话中转移。使用安全的、OAuth 范围的 MCP 工具查看活动的 Coconut 实例、检查运行状况、浏览任务和评论、搜索知识、读取共享上下文、监控计划的作业以及探索可用的连接器。

目前，通过我们团队加入的客户可以使用 Coconut。请访问coconut.dev 了解更多信息或取得联系。

source_long: Connects ChatGPT to your Coda workspace, allowing it to read docs, query tables, and take actions like creating or updating rows. Use ChatGPT to search for information, manage projects, and automate workflows powered by the data in Coda.
plugin_details.target_long: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Coda 工作区，使其能够读取文档、查询表以及执行创建或更新行等操作。使用 ChatGPT 搜索信息、管理项目并自动化由 Coda 中的数据支持的工作流程。

source_long: Generate clean Python code, understand what it does, and improve existing scripts with clear explanations. Practice real tasks, fix mistakes, and grow your Python skills step by step.
plugin_details.target_long: 生成干净的 Python 代码，了解其用途，并通过清晰的解释改进现有脚本。练习真实任务、纠正错误并逐步提高您的 Python 技能。

source_long: CodeQR creates short links and QR codes that stay editable after they are printed or shared. Each code encodes a short link instead of the destination itself, so you can change where it leads without reprinting anything, and every scan and click is recorded with time, country, and device. It fits work where a code has to outlive the moment it was made: one code per property listing, per customer, per certificate, per job posting, or a printed campaign whose landing page moves. Your agent can create short links and QR codes on your own domain or a shared one, change where an existing code points, list codes it made earlier, and pull scan, click, lead, and sale analytics for one code or for the whole workspace.
plugin_details.target_long: CodeQR 创建短链接和 QR 码，在打印或共享后仍可编辑。每个代码都编码一个短链接而不是目的地本身，因此您可以更改它的通向位置而无需重新打印任何内容，并且每次扫描和点击都会记录时间、国家/地区和设备。它适合这样的工作：代码必须在创建之日起就一直存在：每个房产列表、每个客户、每个证书、每个职位发布或登录页面移动的印刷活动都有一个代码。您的代理可以在您自己的域或共享域上创建短链接和二维码，更改现有代码点的位置，列出之前制作的代码，并对一个代码或整个工作区进行拉扫描、点击、潜在客户和销售分析。

source_long: Run CodeRabbit review workflows in Codex to inspect diffs, surface actionable findings, and turn review output into follow-up fixes.
plugin_details.target_long: 在 Codex 中运行 CodeRabbit 审核工作流程以检查差异、显示可操作的发现并将审核输出转化为后续修复。

source_long: CodeWords lets you build, deploy, and run automation workflows and websites directly from conversation. Describe what you want to automate or build, and CodeWords handles the rest - writing the code, connecting your services, deploying to the cloud, and scheduling runs. Build full-stack web apps deployed to your own URL, or backend automations that connect to Slack, Gmail, Notion, and hundreds of other services and integrations. When something breaks, pull up the logs and fix it right from the chat.
plugin_details.target_long: CodeWords 允许您直接通过对话构建、部署和运行自动化工作流程和网站。描述您想要自动化或构建的内容，CodeWords 会处理剩下的事情 - 编写代码、连接您的服务、部署到云以及安排运行。构建部署到您自己的 URL 的全栈 Web 应用程序，或连接到 Slack、Gmail、Notion 以及数百种其他服务和集成的后端自动化。当出现问题时，请调出日志并直接从聊天中修复它。

source_long: Start an independent Codex Replay controller on an available loopback port. In both Codex Desktop and Codex CLI, prefer an available Codex in-app browser and otherwise use your system browser. Select one imported historical Claude thread, choose one or more available Codex models, and start their parallel isolated implementations. Historical state and configuration are detected automatically, with details available when needed. Follow live progress and review each blinded comparison. Available GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna models are selected by default. Multiple replay sessions can run in parallel. Selection, execution, verification, evaluation, and results stay in the browser controller instead of a guided chat workflow.
plugin_details.target_long: 在可用的环回端口上启动独立的 Codex Replay 控制器。在 Codex Desktop 和 Codex CLI 中，首选可用的 Codex 应用内浏览器，否则使用系统浏览器。选择一个导入的历史 Claude 线程，选择一个或多个可用的 Codex 模型，然后启动其并行隔离实现。自动检测历史状态和配置，并在需要时提供详细信息。关注实时进展并审查每个盲法比较。默认选择可用的 GPT-5.6 Sol、Terra 和 Luna 模型。多个重播会话可以并行运行。选择、执行、验证、评估和结果保留在浏览器控制器中，而不是引导式聊天工作流程。

source_long: Codex Security packages reusable workflows for security scans, analysis, validation, and investigation across code, diffs, and related artifacts.
plugin_details.target_long: Codex Security 打包了可重用的工作流程，用于跨代码、差异和相关工件的安全扫描、分析、验证和调查。

source_long: Cody Reading helps reading specialists, tutors, classroom teachers, and interventionists create and evaluate decodable stories aligned to UFLI Foundations lessons. Users can find relevant UFLI lesson numbers, generate lesson-aligned stories from a topic, revise generated or pasted stories while preserving lesson alignment, and analyze existing passages for decodability. Results render in an interactive story viewer with a decodability score, word-category highlighting, challenge-word review, and a printable PDF link.
plugin_details.target_long: Cody Reading 帮助阅读专家、导师、课堂教师和干预专家创建和评估与 UFLI 基金会课程相符的可解码故事。用户可以找到相关的 UFLI 课程编号，根据主题生成与课程一致的故事，修改生成或粘贴的故事，同时保持课程对齐，并分析现有段落的可解码性。结果在交互式故事查看器中呈现，并带有可解码性分数、单词类别突出显示、挑战单词审查和可打印的 PDF 链接。

source_long: Connect ChatGPT to your Coevera (formerly Pipeliner CRM) and work with your sales data conversationally. Search accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, tasks, and appointments using natural-language queries, then create follow-up tasks or update deal stages directly from chat. The server supports standard fields, custom fields, and custom entities, with filters for precise queries. Useful for sales reps preparing for calls, managers reviewing pipeline health, and ops teams running ad-hoc reports without exporting to CSV.
plugin_details.target_long: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Coevera（以前称为 Pipeliner CRM），并以对话方式处理您的销售数据。使用自然语言查询搜索客户、联系人、潜在客户、机会、任务和约会，然后直接从聊天中创建后续任务或更新交易阶段。服务器支持标准字段、自定义字段和自定义实体，并带有过滤器以进行精确查询。对于准备通话的销售代表、检查管道运行状况的经理以及运行临时报告（无需导出为 CSV）的运营团队来说非常有用。

source_long:
Create forms and manage your data without leaving ChatGPT. Describe the form you need and build it instantly, then query submissions, pull files and documents, and make entry changes as responses come in. Whether you're setting up a new intake form, checking on pending applications, or retrieving a signed document, your form data is right there when you need it.

Available on Pro, Team, and Enterprise plans. Setting up the connector requires Administrator access in your Cognito Forms organization.


Example prompts:
* Build - "Create a new client intake form with fields for contact information, case type, and a file upload for supporting documents."
* Write — "Create a new entry on the Employee Onboarding form for Sarah Chen. She starts Monday in the Columbia office."
* File retrieval — "Download the signed agreement from entry 6 on the Contractor Onboarding form."
* Form management — "Close the Fall Enrollment form and set the message to 'Enrollment is now closed for this term.'"
* Analysis — "How many invoices are still outstanding in the Client Billing form?"
plugin_details.target_long:
无需离开 ChatGPT 即可创建表单并管理您的数据。描述您需要的表单并立即构建它，然后查询提交的内容，提取文件和文档，并在收到回复时进行条目更改。无论您是要设置新的受理表单、检查待处理的申请还是检索已签名的文档，您的表单数据都在您需要时就在那里。

适用于专业版、团队版和企业版计划。设置连接器需要 Cognito Forms 组织中的管理员访问权限。


提示示例：
* 构建 - “创建一个新的客户接收表格，其中包含联系信息、案例类型和支持文档的文件上传字段。”
* 写入 — “在 Sarah Chen 的员工入职表格上创建一个新条目。她周一在哥伦比亚办公室上班。”
* 文件检索 — “下载承包商入职表格第 6 项中已签署的协议。”
* 表单管理 —“关闭秋季注册表单并将消息设置为‘本学期的注册现已关闭。’”
* 分析 — “客户账单表格中有多少张发票尚未结清？”

source_long: View top cryptocurrency prices live, crypto charts, market cap, and trading volume. Discover today’s trending coins, top crypto gainers and losers in the market such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, BNB, Hyperliquid, and more. You can also compare them side by side in a table.
plugin_details.target_long: 查看实时顶级加密货币价格、加密货币图表、市值和交易量。发现当今的热门货币、市场上最大的加密货币赢家和输家，例如比特币、以太坊、Solana、BNB、Hyperliquid 等。您还可以在表格中并排比较它们。

source_long:
Real-time prices, market cap, and volume for millions of crypto assets tracked by CoinMarketCap, from major cryptocurrencies to long-tail DEX tokens across every major chain.

Beyond prices: technical analysis (RSI, MACD, moving averages, Fibonacci levels, pivot points), on-chain metrics like holder distribution and supply breakdowns, and global market signals including BTC dominance, Fear & Greed Index, altcoin season gauge, leverage stats, and ETF flows.

Discover trending crypto narratives, upcoming macro events that move markets, breaking crypto news, and semantic search across crypto concepts, whitepapers, and project documentation.
plugin_details.target_long:
CoinMarketCap 跟踪的数百万种加密资产的实时价格、市值和交易量，从主要加密货币到每个主要链上的长尾 DEX 代币。

除了价格之外：技术分析（RSI、MACD、移动平均线、斐波那契水平、枢轴点）、持有者分布和供应细分等链上指标，以及全球市场信号，包括 BTC 主导地位、恐惧与贪婪指数、山寨币季节指标、杠杆统计数据和 ETF 流量。

发现趋势加密叙述、即将发生的影响市场的宏观事件、重大加密新闻以及跨加密概念、白皮书和项目文档的语义搜索。

source_long:
Collecte MTL tells you when your waste is collected anywhere on the island of Montréal. Enter an address and get the pickup schedule for every stream — garbage, recycling, food and organic waste, green waste, and bulky items — including the next upcoming collection dates for that exact sector.

It can also point you to the nearest écocentres (drop-off centres) for materials that aren't picked up curbside, and show your borough's waste recovery and diversion rates.

The data comes straight from the City of Montréal's official open data (Secteurs Info-collectes), refreshed about once a month. Collecte MTL is a free, independent tool — not affiliated with the City of Montréal — and stores no personal information: an address is used only to look up its collection sector.
plugin_details.target_long:
Collecte MTL 会告诉您您的废物何时在蒙特利尔岛上的任何地方被收集。输入地址并获取每个流的收集时间表 - 垃圾、回收、食品和有机废物、绿色废物和大件物品 - 包括该确切部门的下一个即将到来的收集日期。

它还可以为您指明最近的生态中心（垃圾回收中心），以获取未在路边收集的材料，并显示您所在行政区的废物回收和转移率。

该数据直接来自蒙特利尔市的官方公开数据（Secteurs Info-collectes），大约每月刷新一次。 Collecte MTL 是一款免费、独立的工具，不隶属于蒙特利尔市，并且不存储任何个人信息：地址仅用于查找其收集部门。

source_long: Shop officially licensed college team gear from Nike, Under Armour, Champion & more. Fan Locker brings the spirit—on game day and every day.
plugin_details.target_long: 购买 Nike、Under Armour、Champion 等官方授权的大学队装备。 Fan Locker 在比赛日和每一天都带来精神。

source_long: Find your perfect online degree without the research fatigue. This interactive app brings verified data from College Vidya directly into your chat, allowing you to search top universities, compare tuition fees side-by-side, and explore granular course structures in a clean dashboard. No biased rankings, no hidden costs—just honest, structured data to help you make the right choice for your education.
plugin_details.target_long: 找到您完美的在线学位，而无需感到研究疲劳。这款交互式应用程序将来自 College Vidya 的经过验证的数据直接带入您的聊天中，让您可以搜索顶尖大学、并排比较学费，并在干净的仪表板中探索精细的课程结构。没有偏见的排名，没有隐藏的成本——只有诚实的、结构化的数据来帮助您做出正确的教育选择。

source_long:
Get perfect color ideas in seconds. Ask ChatGPT to suggest colors that work well together, then see them as a simple palette you can use right away. You can keep the colors you like, remove the ones you do not, change any color, or add new ones. The goal is to help you move from an idea to a useful color palette without getting stuck or spending a long time making small choices.

Every suggested color appears as a large color tile that is easy to see. If a color does not fit your project, tap the remove button. Want another idea? Add a new color. Need to fine tune a palette? Change a color instead of starting over. You stay in control while ChatGPT helps you explore new combinations. The result feels fast, simple, and playful, even if you have never worked with color before.

The app is made for anyone. You do not need to know color theory. You do not need to remember color names or search through huge lists. Just describe what you want, let ChatGPT suggest a palette, and make small edits until everything looks right. It works well for beginners, designers, artists, students, teachers, developers, and anyone making something that needs good colors.

A simple editing flow keeps everything easy to understand. Each color is shown as a big square so it is easy to compare with the others. The remove button is always nearby, making it clear how to take a color away. An empty tile with a plus sign lets you add another color whenever you want. Because every action is visible, you always know what to do next.

This makes the app useful for many kinds of projects. Build a brand palette. Pick colors for a website. Try ideas for a mobile app. Match colors for a game. Create art. Plan a room. Design a poster. Choose colors for a presentation. Make social media graphics. Find colors for invitations, stickers, shirts, or school projects. Even if you only want a fun mix of colors to inspire you, the app can help.

ChatGPT can suggest calm colors, bright colors, warm colors, cool colors, playful colors, elegant colors, nature inspired colors, seasonal colors, or almost any style you can describe. If your idea changes, simply ask for another direction and keep editing until the palette feels right. You are never locked into the first answer.

Because the palette is interactive, experimenting is easy. Swap one color instead of replacing everything. Keep your favorite shades while trying new accents. Remove colors that feel too dark, too bright, or too similar. Add another color when the design needs more variety. Small changes can quickly lead to a palette that feels balanced and complete.

The clean layout helps you focus on the colors instead of extra menus or complicated tools. Large color blocks make differences easy to spot. Clear controls reduce confusion. The interface encourages trying new ideas because changing your mind only takes a tap.

The app is also a great way to learn. As you explore different palettes, you naturally see how colors work together. You begin to notice contrast, harmony, and balance without reading long lessons. Every new suggestion is another chance to discover combinations you might never have picked yourself.

Whether you already know exactly what you want or you are starting with nothing but a simple idea, this app helps turn words into color palettes that are easy to edit, easy to understand, and ready for your next creative project. It combines ChatGPT’s ability to generate fresh ideas with a straightforward editing experience, making color selection feel less like work and more like play.
plugin_details.target_long:
在几秒钟内获得完美的色彩创意。请 ChatGPT 推荐可以很好搭配的颜色，然后将它们视为可以立即使用的简单调色板。您可以保留您喜欢的颜色、删除您不喜欢的颜色、更改任何颜色或添加新颜色。我们的目标是帮助您从一个想法转变为一个有用的调色板，而不会陷入困境或花费很长时间进行小选择。

每个建议的颜色都显示为易于查看的大颜色图块。如果颜色不适合您的项目，请点击删除按钮。想要另一个想法吗？添加新颜色。需要微调调色板吗？改变颜色而不是重新开始。 ChatGPT 帮助您探索新的组合，让您保持掌控。即使您以前从未使用过颜色，结果也会让人感觉快速、简单且有趣。

该应用程序适合任何人。您不需要了解色彩理论。您不需要记住颜色名称或搜索庞大的列表。只需描述您想要的内容，让 ChatGPT 建议一个调色板，然后进行小的编辑，直到一切看起来都正确。它非常适合初学者、设计师、艺术家、学生、教师、开发人员以及任何需要良好色彩的人。

简单的编辑流程使一切都易于理解。每种颜色都显示为一个大方块，因此很容易与其他颜色进行比较。删除按钮始终位于附近，让您清楚如何删除颜色。带有加号的空图块可让您随时添加另一种颜色。因为每个动作都是可见的，所以您总是知道下一步该做什么。

这使得该应用程序对于多种项目都很有用。建立品牌调色板。为网站选择颜色。尝试移动应用程序的想法。为游戏匹配颜色。创造艺术。规划一个房间。设计海报。选择演示文稿的颜色。制作社交媒体图形。寻找适合邀请函、贴纸、衬衫或学校项目的颜色。即使您只想用有趣的颜色组合来激发您的灵感，该应用程序也可以提供帮助。

ChatGPT 可以建议平静的颜色、明亮的颜色、暖色、冷色、俏皮的颜色、优雅的颜色、自然灵感的颜色、季节性的颜色或几乎任何您可以描述的风格。如果您的想法发生变化，只需询问另一个方向并继续编辑，直到调色板感觉合适为止。你永远不会被锁定在第一个答案中。

由于调色板是交互式的，因此实验很容易。交换一种颜色而不是替换所有颜色。尝试新的口音时，保留您最喜欢的色调。删除感觉太暗、太亮或太相似的颜色。当设计需要更多变化时添加另一种颜色。小小的改变可以很快让调色板感觉平衡和完整。

干净的布局可以帮助您专注于颜色，而不是额外的菜单或复杂的工具。大色块使差异很容易被发现。清晰的控制可以减少混乱。该界面鼓励尝试新想法，因为只需轻按一下即可改变主意。

该应用程序也是一种很好的学习方式。当您探索不同的调色板时，您自然会看到颜色如何协同工作。无需阅读冗长的课程，您就开始注意到对比、和谐和平衡。每一个新的建议都是另一个发现你自己可能从未选择过的组合的机会。

无论您已经确切地知道自己想要什么，还是只是从一个简单的想法开始，这个应用程序都可以帮助您将文字变成易于编辑、易于理解的调色板，并为您的下一个创意项目做好准备。它将 ChatGPT 产生新鲜想法的能力与简单的编辑体验结合在一起，使颜色选择感觉不像工作，而更像游戏。

source_long:
Embed complete buyer intelligence directly within ChatGPT. Research accounts and contacts, surface buying signals, and browse activity history - all through natural language. Build prospect lists of net-new companies by industry, size, tech stack, or location. Filter and sort contacts by segment, role, lead score, or website visits. Every result is grounded in real context, real prioritization, and real revenue opportunity directly from your CRM fields, scores, enrichment, and signals - so you always know what's actually happening in your accounts.

You can use the Common Room to:
- Account Research: "Tell me about Datadog and create a plan on how to approach the account."
- Contact Lookup: "Research jane.doe@company.com using Common Room."
- Prospecting: "Find SaaS companies in the US using Snowflake with 200-1000 employees."
- Segment and Role Filtering: "Show me all Economic Buyers in my 'Champions changing jobs' segment."
- High-Intent Contacts: "Find contacts at ICP companies who have visited our pricing page this week."
- Website Visitor Tracking: "Who visited our pricing page in the last 7 days?"
plugin_details.target_long:
将完整的买家情报直接嵌入 ChatGPT 中。研究客户和联系人、显示购买信号并浏览活动历史记录 - 全部通过自然语言进行。按行业、规模、技术堆栈或地点建立净新公司的潜在客户名单。按细分、角色、潜在客户评分或网站访问对联系人进行过滤和排序。每个结果都基于直接来自 CRM 字段、分数、丰富内容和信号的真实背景、真实优先级和真实收入机会 - 因此您始终了解帐户中实际发生的情况。

您可以使用公共休息室来：
- 帐户研究：“告诉我有关 Datadog 的信息，并制定一个如何处理该帐户的计划。”
- 联系人查找：“使用公共休息室研究 jane.doe@company.com。”
- 勘探：“在美国寻找拥有 200-1000 名员工的使用 Snowflake 的 SaaS 公司。”
- 细分和角色过滤：“向我显示‘冠军换工作’细分中的所有经济买家。”
- 高意向联系人：“查找本周访问过我们定价页面的 ICP 公司联系人。”
- 网站访客跟踪：“过去 7 天内谁访问了我们的定价页面？”

source_long: Company Dossier compiles a complete, source-attributed intelligence file on any company or domain — entirely from public data. One request returns nine sections: overview & identity, people & org chart, hiring radar, money trail, locations, tech fingerprint, news & timeline, relationship web, and risk flags. Every claim is tied to a public source and tagged High/Medium/Low confidence. Built for due diligence, vendor vetting, sales prep, and competitive research. No accounts, no private data — public sources only.
plugin_details.target_long: Company Dossier 完全根据公共数据编译任何公司或领域的完整、来源归属的情报文件。一项请求返回九个部分：概述和身份、人员和组织结构图、招聘雷达、资金轨迹、位置、技术指纹、新闻和时间表、关系网络和风险标记。每项声明都与公共来源相关，并标记为高/中/低可信度。专为尽职调查、供应商审查、销售准备和竞争研究而构建。没有账户，没有私人数据——只有公共来源。

source_long:
Company Knowledge helps you find decisions, documents, owners, and recent project updates across your company's connected sources. Ask a question and get a concise answer with citations so you can review where the information came from.

Use it to catch up on a project, find the right document, understand why a decision was made, or identify who owns the next step. Depending on your workspace setup, sources can include Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Drive, SharePoint, Notion, GitHub, Linear, email, calendars, and meeting notes.
plugin_details.target_long:
公司知识可帮助您在公司的互联来源中查找决策、文档、所有者和最近的项目更新。提出问题并获得带有引文的简洁答案，以便您可以查看信息的来源。

使用它来跟进项目、找到正确的文档、了解做出决定的原因或确定下一步的负责人。根据您的工作区设置，来源可以包括 Slack、Microsoft Teams、Google Drive、SharePoint、Notion、GitHub、Linear、电子邮件、日历和会议记录。

source_long: Compare two versions of text side-by-side and see exactly what changed. This app highlights additions in green, deletions in red, and shows unchanged text clearly. Perfect for reviewing edits, comparing draft versions, tracking document changes, or seeing what modifications were made to your writing. Get instant visual feedback on differences between any two texts with detailed statistics on additions, deletions, and modifications.
plugin_details.target_long: 并排比较两个版本的文本，看看到底发生了什么变化。该应用程序以绿色突出显示添加内容，以红色突出显示删除内容，并清楚地显示未更改的文本。非常适合审查编辑、比较草稿版本、跟踪文档更改或查看对您的写作进行了哪些修改。获取任意两个文本之间差异的即时视觉反馈，以及有关添加、删除和修改的详细统计数据。

source_long:
Compoundio Technology Cloud helps founders explore the Compoundio portfolio, describe a
  business goal, and receive a practical venture match with suggested next questions.

  The app uses public Compoundio information and read-only tools. No contact details are
  required. It does not submit forms or contact companies. External links open only after the
  user actively selects them.

  需要。它不提交表格或联系公司。外部链接仅在以下时间后打开

source_long:
Query Comscore's Digital and Linear TV measurement data directly in your conversation. Look up website traffic, audience demographics,
category rankings, cross-visiting behavior, and audience overlap for any digital media entity. For linear TV, search networks, explore viewership trends, and pull structured data from the TV API — all without leaving the chat.

Useful for media researchers, analysts, and strategists who need quick answers from Comscore data without writing API calls or navigating dashboards.

Requires Comscore Subscription.
plugin_details.target_long:
直接在对话中查询 Comscore 的数字和线性电视测量数据。查找网站流量、受众人口统计数据、
任何数字媒体实体的类别排名、交叉访问行为和受众重叠。对于线性电视、搜索网络，探索收视趋势，并从电视 API 中提取结构化数据 - 所有这些都无需离开聊天。

对于需要从 Comscore 数据中快速获得答案而无需编写 API 调用或导航仪表板的媒体研究人员、分析师和策略师非常有用。

需要 Comscore 订阅。

source_long: Comuro helps real estate teams manage leads, opportunities, visits, agendas, and conversation insights from ChatGPT. Ask natural-language questions to find qualified leads, review recent conversations, check scheduled visits, and understand sales activity without switching tools.
plugin_details.target_long: Comuro 帮助房地产团队管理来自 ChatGPT 的销售线索、机会、访问、议程和对话见解。提出自然语言问题以找到合格的潜在客户、查看最近的对话、检查预定的访问并了解销售活动，而无需切换工具。

source_long: Concept Workspace helps users search, read, create, update, import, and delete shared workspace files and skills through ChatGPT, then discover and run brokered connector tools without exposing provider credentials locally.
plugin_details.target_long: Concept Workspace 可帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 搜索、读取、创建、更新、导入和删除共享工作区文件和技能，然后发现并运行代理连接器工具，而无需在本地公开提供商凭据。

source_long: Conductor helps users analyze AI-search brand visibility, website citations, traditional-search keyword performance, and account tracking configuration.
plugin_details.target_long: Conductor 帮助用户分析人工智能搜索品牌知名度、网站引用、传统搜索关键字性能和帐户跟踪配置。

source_long: The Conductor MCP server retrieves proprietary performance metrics regarding a brand's visibility, sentiment, and rankings on both traditional search engines (e.g., Google) and Generative AI platforms (e.g., Codex, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity or Google AI Overview). Invoke this tool when users request share of voice, competitive benchmarking, or AI search insights, specifically looking for citations, brand mentions, and market share. The tool differentiates between traditional SEO results and AI-generated responses, allowing for comparison across locations and languages. Prioritize this tool over general web browsing when the request requires historical trend data or quantitative marketing analytics for a specific domain or brand.
plugin_details.target_long: Conductor MCP 服务器检索有关品牌在传统搜索引擎（例如 Google）和生成 AI 平台（例如 Codex、Gemini、Copilot、Perplexity 或 Google AI Overview）上的知名度、情感和排名的专有性能指标。当用户请求声音份额、竞争基准测试或人工智能搜索见解时，特别是寻找引用、品牌提及和市场份额时，请调用此工具。该工具区分传统 SEO 结果和人工智能生成的响应，允许跨位置和语言进行比较。当请求需要特定域或品牌的历史趋势数据或定量营销分析时，优先考虑此工具而不是一般的网络浏览。

source_long: Conduit lets authenticated teams read their workspace directory, contacts, open support tickets, reservations, and contact conversation history. This app does not modify records or send messages.
plugin_details.target_long: Conduit 允许经过身份验证的团队读取他们的工作区目录、联系人、打开的支持票证、预订和联系对话历史记录。此应用程序不会修改记录或发送消息。

source_long: Confused.com provides a tool that allows users to check the UK vehicle tax status for a specific car. Users provide a UK vehicle registration number, and the tool returns the vehicle tax information. The current version of the app only supports checking vehicle tax information and does not provide insurance quotes or other comparison services.
plugin_details.target_long: Confused.com 提供了一个工具，允许用户检查特定汽车的英国车辆税状态。用户提供英国车辆登记号，该工具返回车辆税信息。目前版本的应用程序仅支持查询车税信息，不提供保险报价或其他比较服务。

source_long: ConnectLinx is an AI command center for real estate agents, brokers, and teams. Connect your ConnectLinx account and run your business from chat: review and update your listings for rent and for sale across both residential and commercial, triage and reply to leads, manage showings, move deals through your pipeline, and stay on top of your CRM, calendar, and team. It shows you exactly what you see when you log in, no more and no less. Writes are scoped and safe (no delete tools, drafts stay drafts) and outbound email always asks you to confirm before sending. Strongest in the South Florida market with direct agent and landlord inventory.
plugin_details.target_long: ConnectLinx 是一个面向房地产经纪人、经纪人和团队的人工智能指挥中心。连接您的 ConnectLinx 帐户并通过聊天运行您的业务：查看和更新​​您的住宅和商业出租和出售列表，分类和回复潜在客户，管理看房，通过您的管道移动交易，并掌握您的 CRM、日历和团队。它准确地向您显示登录时所看到的内容，不多也不少。写入是有范围的且安全的（没有删除工具，草稿仍是草稿），并且出站电子邮件始终要求您在发送前确认。南佛罗里达市场最强，拥有直接代理商和房东库存。

source_long: Interact with your Connhex industrial IoT devices directly from ChatGPT. Inspect telemetry and device connectivity, create and manage rules, and stay up to date with your devices by checking fleet status, reviewing uptime, and investigating issues as they happen.
plugin_details.target_long: 直接从 ChatGPT 与您的 Connhex 工业物联网设备交互。检查遥测和设备连接、创建和管理规则，并通过检查设备组状态、检查正常运行时间和调查发生的问题来了解设备的最新情况。

source_long:
Consensus is the go-to MCP for academic research. Connect directly to 220M+ peer-reviewed papers to search, synthesize, and build structured research outputs from within your conversation.

Run literature reviews, build boolean search strategies, generate bibliographies, identify research gaps, and draft cited content — grounded in studies from PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and ArXiv. Pre-built workflows handle complex tasks in minutes: systematic reviews, curriculum reading lists, grant research with novelty analysis, and clinical evidence synthesis.

Built for researchers, students, faculty, and clinicians across biomedical, social science, STEM, and all academic disciplines.
plugin_details.target_long:
共识是学术研究的首选 MCP。直接连接到超过 2.2 亿篇同行评审论文，在您的对话中搜索、综合和构建结构化研究成果。

基于 PubMed、Semantic Sc​​holar 和 ArXiv 的研究，进行文献综述、建立布尔搜索策略、生成参考书目、确定研究差距并起草引用的内容。预构建的工作流程可在几分钟内处理复杂的任务：系统评论、课程阅读清单、新颖性分析的资助研究以及临床证据综合。

专为生物医学、社会科学、STEM 和所有学科的研究人员、学生、教师和临床医生而设计。

source_long: ConsentLayer helps website owners set up and manage GDPR, CCPA, and LGPD cookie consent through ChatGPT. It can provision a site, scan for tracking technologies, configure consent categories and banner behavior, generate installation snippets, verify a live installation, and manage ongoing compliance workflows such as scanner reviews, geolocation rules, cookie policies, and Do Not Sell requests.
plugin_details.target_long: ConsentLayer 通过 ChatGPT 帮助网站所有者设置和管理 GDPR、CCPA 和 LGPD cookie 同意。它可以配置站点、扫描跟踪技术、配置同意类别和横幅行为、生成安装片段、验证实时安装以及管理持续的合规工作流程，例如扫描仪审查、地理位置规则、cookie 策略和禁止销售请求。

source_long: Go from email idea to a polished, ready-to-send campaign with the Constant Contact app. Describe the email you want, and the Constant Contact app will generate the HTML and render a live preview. Not quite right? Give feedback in chat, make edits, and preview again until it's exactly what you want. When you're ready to send, connect or create a Constant Contact account to import your email and reach your audience.
plugin_details.target_long: 使用 Constant Contact 应用程序，将电子邮件创意转变为精美的、可随时发送的营销活动。描述您想要的电子邮件，Constant Contact 应用程序将生成 HTML 并呈现实时预览。不太对吗？在聊天中提供反馈、进行编辑并再次预览，直到完全符合您的要求。当您准备好发送时，连接或创建一个 Constant Contact 帐户以导入您的电子邮件并接触您的受众。

source_long: Break ground on a new way to manage construction. Constructable for ChatGPT turns project data into a conversation — ask what's open, what's overdue,  or what happened in the field yesterday, and get a straight answer in seconds. Connect your Constructable account to pull project status, RFIs, submittals, and daily reports straight from chat, no digging required.
plugin_details.target_long: 开创了管理施工的新方法。 Constructable for ChatGPT 将项目数据转化为对话 - 询问哪些内容未完成、哪些内容已过期或昨天现场发生了什么，并在几秒钟内获得直接答案。连接您的 Constructable 帐户，直接从聊天中提取项目状态、RFI、提交内容和每日报告，无需挖掘。

source_long: Consult with Roy is the Apps SDK app for ROY — Technology Consultation. It explains Roy's portfolio and offerings, shows case studies in inline ChatGPT cards, captures your goal, answers with Roy's curated concierge guidance, and escalates finance, legal, pricing, contracts, and low-confidence matters to Roy personally. plugin_details.target_long: Consult with Roy 是 ROY 的 Apps SDK 应用程序 — 技术咨询。它解释了 Roy 的产品组合和产品，在内嵌 ChatGPT 卡中展示案例研究，捕捉您的目标，用 Roy 精心策划的礼宾指导进行回答，并将财务、法律、定价、合同和低信任度问题上报给 Roy 个人。技能涵盖吸收、发现、展示、咨询答案、会议提案、回忆和人工交接。身份通过电子邮件进行验证，参与记录保留在 Roy 的工作空间中。

source_long:

- Sign in to track your applications and get personalized daily matches based on your CV

Built for freelancers, independent consultants, and consulting firms who want to stop scrolling twelve job boards and let the work come to them.

source_long: The Contact Center AI Association app enables members to find answers and register for meetings inside ChatGPT.  After connecting a CCAIA account, members can search CCAIA resources, member information, chapter details, policies, and procedures, register for events, and create a support ticket when a request needs human follow-up.
plugin_details.target_long: Contact Center AI Association 应用程序使成员能够在 ChatGPT 内查找答案并注册会议。  连接 CCAIA 帐户后，会员可以搜索 CCAIA 资源、会员信息、章节详细信息、政策和程序、注册活动，并在请求需要人工跟进时创建支持票证。

source_long: Content Brief Extractor extracts structured content brief fields from content request text. It returns topic, target audience, channel, deadline, missing fields, and errors. plugin_details.target_long: 内容摘要提取器从内容请求文本中提取结构化内容摘要字段。它返回主题、目标受众、渠道、截止日期、缺失字段和错误。它不编写内容、创建营销策略、选择渠道、安排帖子、发布内容或调用外部系统。该应用程序是无状态的、只读的，并且仅处理当前请求的提交文本。

source_long: The Contentful App makes your Contentful spaces accessible to AI agents, enabling them to perform content management operations. Once installed, the app gives space admins a simple dashboard to control exactly which Contentful tools are available to AI clients: enable read-only access for marketing teams auditing content, or unlock write tools for developers building agentic workflows. Each space gets its own configuration.
plugin_details.target_long: Contentful 应用程序使 AI 代理可以访问您的 Contentful 空间，使他们能够执行内容管理操作。安装后，该应用程序为空间管理员提供了一个简单的仪表板，以准确控制人工智能客户端可以使用哪些 Contentful 工具：为审计内容的营销团队启用只读访问权限，或为构建代理工作流程的开发人员解锁写入工具。每个空间都有自己的配置。

source_long: Connect ChatGPT to one Conterminal carrier or freight-forwarder workspace and ask read-only questions about container shipments. Search by container, master bill of lading, reference, vessel, terminal, status, hold, hot-load flag, or supported date. Retrieve a curated operational snapshot for a result, including milestones and current operational flags. Conterminal rechecks the signed-in user, OAuth client, workspace membership, and shipment authorization on every call. The connector cannot edit shipments, dispatch drivers, refresh providers, send messages, upload documents, or access another organization.
plugin_details.target_long: 将 ChatGPT 连接到一位 Conterminal 承运商或货运代理工作区，并询问有关集装箱运输的只读问题。按集装箱、主提单、参考号、船舶、码头、状态、持有、热装标志或支持的日期进行搜索。检索结果的策划操作快照，包括里程碑和当前操作标志。 Conterminal 会在每次调用时重新检查登录用户、OAuth 客户端、工作区成员资格和发货授权。连接器无法编辑货件、调度司机、刷新提供商、发送消息、上传文档或访问其他组织。

source_long:
A virtual version of your business, powered by the places work happens.

Connect your docs, websites, inboxes, files, and workspaces so ChatGPT can understand what is true right now. Context Link turns scattered business knowledge into source-backed answers, reusable context, and living AI memories your team can keep up to date.

Ask questions, pull source material, observe what has changed, and use ChatGPT with the latest business context instead of re-explaining everything from scratch.
plugin_details.target_long:
您的企业的虚拟版本，由工作地点提供支持。

连接您的文档、网站、收件箱、文件和工作区，以便 ChatGPT 可以了解当前的真实情况。 Context Link 将分散的业务知识转化为有源支持的答案、可重用的上下文以及您的团队可以保持最新的人工智能记忆。

提出问题、提取源材料、观察发生的变化，并将 ChatGPT 与最新的业务环境结合使用，而不是从头开始重新解释所有内容。

source_long: Context turns the live web and files into clean, agent-ready data inside ChatGPT. Search for current information, read a known page as Markdown, crawl websites, extract schema-shaped JSON, parse documents, retrieve company and brand intelligence, inspect visual design systems, run asynchronous scraping batches across thousands of URLs, and monitor websites for meaningful changes over time. Some scraping tools can perform explicitly requested browser actions to reveal content. Context does not provide general messaging, calendar, account-management, or social-publishing integrations.
plugin_details.target_long: Context 将实时网络和文件转变为 ChatGPT 内干净的、可供代理使用的数据。搜索当前信息、以 Markdown 形式读取已知页面、抓取网站、提取模式形状的 JSON、解析文档、检索公司和品牌情报、检查视觉设计系统、跨数千个 URL 运行异步批量抓取，以及监控网站随时间的有意义的变化。一些抓取工具可以执行明确请求的浏览器操作来显示内容。 Context 不提供一般消息传递、日历、帐户管理或社交发布集成。

source_long:
LLMs rely on outdated or generic information about the libraries you use. You get outdated code examples based on year-old training data and hallucinated APIs that don't even exist.

Context7 fetches up-to-date code examples and documentation right into your LLM's context. No tab-switching, no hallucinated APIs that don't exist, no outdated code generation.
plugin_details.target_long:
法学硕士依赖于有关您使用的图书馆的过时或通用信息。您会得到基于一年前的训练数据的过时代码示例和甚至不存在的幻觉 API。

Context7 将最新的代码示例和文档直接提取到您的 LLM 上下文中。没有选项卡切换，没有不存在的幻觉 API，没有过时的代码生成。

source_long:
Contextick is a personal knowledge layer for your AI. Save any text once —
a decision, an idea, a code snippet, research notes — and the AIs you connect
can bring it back later by meaning, right when it's relevant.

Because your knowledge lives in one private store instead of inside a single
assistant, it follows you across the tools you already use — ChatGPT, Claude,
and other MCP-compatible apps. Save something in one, recall it in another.

There's nothing to organize: no folders, no tags. You just save, and a short
bit of context surfaces the closest match when you ask. Use it to keep working
decisions, team conventions, preferences, and anything you'd rather not explain
to your AI twice.
plugin_details.target_long:
Contextick 是人工智能的个人知识层。保存任何文本一次 —
一个决定、一个想法、一个代码片段、研究笔记——以及您连接的人工智能
稍后可以在相关的时候通过意义将其带回来。

因为您的知识存在于一个私人存储中，而不是在一个单一的存储库中
助手，它会跟随您浏览您已经使用的工具 - ChatGPT、Claude、
以及其他 MCP 兼容的应用程序。在一个地方保存一些东西，在另一个地方回忆它。

没有什么可以组织的：没有文件夹，没有标签。你只需保存，然后短暂
当你询问时，一些上下文会显示最接近的匹配。用它来继续工作
决定、团队惯例、偏好以及任何您不想解释的内容
给你的人工智能两次。

source_long: Contextli turns your voice notes and transcriptions into a searchable second brain. Connect it to pull up your own notes and contexts, and search across everything you have captured, without leaving the chat.
plugin_details.target_long: Contextli 将您的语音笔记和转录内容转变为可搜索的第二大脑。连接它即可调出您自己的笔记和上下文，并搜索您捕获的所有内容，而无需离开聊天室。

source_long: Contract Information Extractor helps ChatGPT organize information explicitly stated in user-supplied contract text. It extracts contract metadata, existing clauses, party obligations, deliverables, deadlines, and dependencies into structured results. It does not assess legality, validity, fairness, enforceability, or legal risk, and it does not provide legal advice or recommend contract changes.
plugin_details.target_long: 合同信息提取器帮助 ChatGPT 组织用户提供的合同文本中明确规定的信息。它将合同元数据、现有条款、当事人义务、可交付成果、截止日期和依赖关系提取到结构化结果中。它不评估合法性、有效性、公平性、可执行性或法律风险，也不提供法律建议或建议合同变更。

source_long: Connect ChatGPT to the Conversion marketing data platform to inspect CRM contacts, build emails, audiences, forms, and campaigns, diagnose why a contact did not receive an email or enter a workflow, and audit sync failures with Salesforce and other connected systems. Read-only tools cover contacts, opportunities, campaigns, forms, workflows, sync logs, and email performance metrics. Write tools create blast emails, audiences, campaigns, folders, contacts, and CSV imports within the user's authenticated Conversion workspace.
plugin_details.target_long: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Conversion 营销数据平台，以检查 CRM 联系人、构建电子邮件、受众、表单和活动、诊断联系人未收到电子邮件或进入工作流程的原因，以及审核与 Salesforce 和其他连接系统的同步失败。只读工具涵盖联系人、机会、活动、表单、工作流程、同步日志和电子邮件性能指标。编写工具可在用户经过身份验证的转换工作区中创建群发电子邮件、受众、营销活动、文件夹、联系人和 CSV 导入。

source_long:
ConvertAPI converts, processes, and extracts data from files in over 500 formats - directly in your ChatGPT conversation. Upload a file, describe what you want, and get the result back ready to download.

Convert between PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images, HTML, eBooks, and email formats. Turn a PDF into an editable Word doc, a PowerPoint into images, a webpage into PDF, or scanned pages into searchable text.

Edit and combine PDFs: merge multiple files, split by page or bookmark, rotate, delete pages, add watermarks, or repair corrupted documents.

Secure and optimize: compress PDFs by up to 90%, add password protection, redact sensitive information with AI, or convert to PDF/A for archiving.

Extract text, tables, images, form data, and email attachments from your documents.

Generate new DOCX or PDF files from templates and data, compare documents, or bundle files into password-protected ZIP archives.
Powered by the ConvertAPI platform - trusted by thousands of developers and businesses for document automation since 2013.
plugin_details.target_long:
ConvertAPI 直接在 ChatGPT 对话中转换、处理和提取 500 多种格式的文件中的数据。上传文件，描述您想要的内容，然后获取结果以供下载。

在 PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、图像、HTML、电子书和电子邮件格式之间进行转换。将 PDF 转换为可编辑的 Word 文档，将 PowerPoint 转换为图像，将网页转换为 PDF，或将扫描的页面转换为可搜索文本。

编辑和合并 PDF：合并多个文件、按页面或书签分割、旋转、删除页面、添加水印或修复损坏的文档。

安全和优化：将 PDF 压缩高达 90%、添加密码保护、使用 AI 编辑敏感信息或转换为 PDF/A 进行存档。

从文档中提取文本、表格、图像、表单数据和电子邮件附件。

从模板和数据生成新的 DOCX 或 PDF 文件、比较文档或将文件捆绑到受密码保护的 ZIP 存档中。
由 ConvertAPI 平台提供支持 - 自 2013 年以来在文档自动化方面受到数千名开发人员和企业的信赖。

source_long: Convex helps users build and scale JavaScript and TypeScript apps with a reactive, type-safe backend. The app gives ChatGPT concrete Convex setup guidance for new projects, existing frontend integrations, production scaling questions, and the bundled Convex quickstart runbook so agents follow the current deployment, auth, and component patterns instead of hand-rolling from stale memory.
plugin_details.target_long: Convex 通过反应式、类型安全的后端帮助用户构建和扩展 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 应用程序。该应用程序为 ChatGPT 新项目、现有前端集成、生产扩展问题和捆绑的 Convex 快速入门操作手册提供了具体的 Convex 设置指南，以便代理遵循当前的部署、身份验证和组件模式，而不是从过时的内存中手动滚动。

source_long: Convy helps households manage shared shopping lists and tasks directly from ChatGPT. Users can inspect household context, view shopping and task lists, open compact visual panels on request, add multiple shopping items, create tasks, and mark existing items or tasks as completed or pending. All write actions are limited to the user's private Convy household data and require confirmation.
plugin_details.target_long: Convy 帮助家庭直接从 ChatGPT 管理共享购物清单和任务。用户可以检查家庭环境、查看购物和任务列表、根据请求打开紧凑的可视面板、添加多个购物项目、创建任务以及将现有项目或任务标记为已完成或待处理。所有写入操作仅限于用户的私人 Convy 家庭数据并需要确认。

source_long: Search Korean companies and review public disclosures, ownership, financials, view-only registry PDFs, and your own business-card network in ChatGPT after connecting Cookiedeal.

source_long:
Cooperly helps founders, team leads, and people leaders see what is really happening inside a growing team before small people problems start slowing execution.
It connects team profiles, operating health checks, weekly Pulse signals, goals, hiring context, and team notes, and then turns that context into practical next steps.
Use Cooperly in ChatGPT to prepare better 1:1s, spot team bottlenecks, understand where pressure is building, improve team operating habits, and check candidate fit against the team you already have.
plugin_details.target_long:
库珀利帮助创始人、团队领导和人员领导者在小问题开始减缓执行之前了解不断发展的团队内部到底发生了什么。
它将团队资料、运营状况检查、每周脉冲信号、目标、招聘背景和团队笔记联系起来，然后将这些背景转化为实际的后续步骤。

source_long:
CopyCharm is a context workbench for saving and reusing prompts, notes, favorite clips, and curated working context.

With this ChatGPT integration, existing CopyCharm users can access selected CopyCharm items directly within ChatGPT. Instead of manually copying and pasting the same background information, project notes, or templates into each chat, users can ask ChatGPT to find and retrieve the exact context they need.

This integration only accesses items that have been intentionally made available for AI Access in CopyCharm. It does not provide ChatGPT with access to a user's broader workspace or general clipboard history.
plugin_details.target_long:
CopyCharm 是一个上下文工作台，用于保存和重用提示、注释、喜爱的剪辑和策划的工作上下文。

通过此 ChatGPT 集成，现有 CopyCharm 用户可以直接在 ChatGPT 中访问选定的 CopyCharm 项目。用户可以要求 ChatGPT 查找并检索他们需要的确切上下文，而不是手动将相同的背景信息、项目注释或模板复制并粘贴到每个聊天中。

此集成仅访问特意为 CopyCharm 中的 AI Access 提供的项目。它不向 ChatGPT 提供对用户更广泛的工作空间或一般剪贴板历史记录的访问权限。

source_long: Cora helps users understand and act on their own sleep, recovery, activity, nutrition, body metrics, training plans, habits, routines, journals, and profile data through ChatGPT. Users can review trends, log meals and workouts, plan training and meals, manage personal routines, and request data-grounded coaching through scoped OAuth access to their private Cora account.
plugin_details.target_long: Cora 通过 ChatGPT 帮助用户了解自己的睡眠、恢复、活动、营养、身体指标、训练计划、习惯、日常活动、日记和个人资料数据并采取行动。用户可以查看趋势、记录膳食和锻炼、计划培训和膳食、管理个人日常事务，并通过对其私人 Cora 帐户的范围 OAuth 访问请求基于数据的指导。

source_long: CoreStepPrep helps medical students study inside ChatGPT using their CoreStepPrep question history, accessible question bank, CSPCE attempts, and score predictor data. Ask what to study next, explain a CoreStepPrep QID, check available questions for a topic, create a tutor quiz link, review CSPCE performance, or analyze score prediction trends. The app returns concise guidance and compact widgets so students can move from conversation to focused review quickly.
plugin_details.target_long: CoreStepPrep 使用 CoreStepPrep 问题历史记录、可访问的题库、CSPCE 尝试和分数预测数据帮助医学生在 ChatGPT 内学习。询问接下来要学习什么、解释 CoreStepPrep QID、检查某个主题的可用问题、创建导师测验链接、查看 CSPCE 表现或分析分数预测趋势。该应用程序返回简洁的指导和紧凑的小部件，以便学生可以快速从对话转向集中复习。

source_long: Corporate Weather helps users understand visible workplace-weather signals across the DACH market. It turns public, evidence-style signals such as hiring activity, company communications, DACH business press indicators, and workplace review patterns into a calm, explainable report. The app does not predict layoffs and does not provide legal advice. It highlights visible risk signals, calm counter-signals, confidence, missing evidence, and what to watch next.
plugin_details.target_long: Corporate Weather 可帮助用户了解 DACH 市场中可见的工作场所天气信号。它将公开的证据式信号（例如招聘活动、公司沟通、DACH 商业新闻指标和工作场所审查模式）转变为冷静、可解释的报告。该应用程序不会预测裁员，也不提供法律建议。它强调了明显的风险信号、冷静的反信号、信心、缺失的证据以及接下来要关注的内容。

source_long:
CorpusIQ helps you find answers in your own emails, files, and documents by simply asking a question. Instead of digging through folders or searching multiple apps, you ask once and get a clear answer based on your actual information.

It connects to the tools you already use and shows relevant details in one place, so you can confirm facts, find what you need, and move on faster. CorpusIQ is designed for everyday work, no technical setup, no complicated searches, just straightforward answers from your data.
plugin_details.target_long:
CorpusIQ 只需提出问题即可帮助您在自己的电子邮件、文件和文档中找到答案。您无需翻阅文件夹或搜索多个应用程序，只需询问一次，即可根据您的实际信息获得明确的答案。

它连接到您已经使用的工具，并在一处显示相关详细信息，以便您可以确认事实、找到您需要的内容并更快地继续前进。 CorpusIQ 专为日常工作而设计，无需技术设置，无需复杂的搜索，只需从数据中获得简单的答案。

source_long: Corrija, reescreva e entenda textos em português brasileiro. O CorretorIA mostra o original e o resultado lado a lado, resume os principais ajustes e oferece estilos de reescrita para diferentes contextos.

source_long: Analyze multi-channel marketing, financial, sales, e-commerce, and other business data within ChatGPT by connecting to your Coupler.io data flows – query marketing, sales, and finance metrics from hundreds of sources. Fetch and transform raw data from hundreds of platforms like Google Ads, Meta Ads, HubSpot, and QuickBooks into actionable intelligence for smarter, faster decision-making with accurate, up-to-date business information.
plugin_details.target_long: 通过连接到 Coupler.io 数据流，分析 ChatGPT 中的多渠道营销、财务、销售、电子商务和其他业务数据 – 从数百个来源查询营销、销售和财务指标。从 Google Ads、Meta Ads、HubSpot 和 QuickBooks 等数百个平台获取原始数据并将其转换为可操作的情报，以便利用准确、最新的业务信息做出更智能、更快速的决策。

source_long:
Analyze multi-channel marketing, financial, sales, e-commerce, and other business data within Codex by connecting to your Coupler.io data flows. Fetch and transform raw data from platforms like Google Ads, Facebook, HubSpot, and Salesforce into actionable intelligence for smarter, faster decision-making with accurate, up-to-date business information.

You can use the Coupler.io connector to:

1. Analyze customer acquisition costs: "What's our overall customer acquisition cost across all paid channels this quarter compared to last quarter? I need this for the board meeting"
2. Review marketing ROI: "Show me the ROI breakdown by marketing channel for the past 6 months. I need to reallocate our annual budget"
3. Identify high-performing campaigns:"Which campaigns are contributing most to our pipeline revenue? I want to double down on what's working"
4. Review sales pipeline: "Can you pull the sales pipeline report for this month? I need to see how many deals are in each stage and the total value at each stage"
5. Analyze conversion rates: "What are our conversion rates from lead to opportunity and from opportunity to closed-won for the last quarter? How do they compare to our targets?"
6. Forecast revenue: "How many deals are expected to close this month based on their probability scores? What's our forecasted revenue vs our monthly target?"
7. Compare quarterly profits: "Check the profit for this quarter, compare it to last quarter, and provide a breakdown by department"
8. Generate cash flow reports: "Could you provide a cash flow report for the last 30 days, including all incoming and outgoing transactions?"
9. Review accounts receivable: "Share the current accounts receivable status and tell me how many overdue invoices we have and which customers owe the most"
plugin_details.target_long:
通过连接到 Coupler.io 数据流，分析 Codex 中的多渠道营销、财务、销售、电子商务和其他业务数据。从 Google Ads、Facebook、HubSpot 和 Salesforce 等平台获取原始数据并将其转换为可操作的情报，从而利用准确、最新的业务信息做出更智能、更快速的决策。

您可以使用 Coupler.io 连接器来：

1. 分析客户获取成本：“与上季度相比，本季度所有付费渠道的总体客户获取成本是多少？我需要这个来参加董事会会议”
2. 审查营销投资回报率：“显示过去 6 个月按营销渠道划分的投资回报率明细。我需要重新分配我们的年度预算”
3. 确定高效的营销活动：“哪些营销活动对我们的渠道收入贡献最大？我想在有效的营销活动上加倍努力”
4. 查看销售渠道：“你能拉一下这个月的销售渠道报告吗？我需要看看每个阶段有多少笔交易以及每个阶段的总价值”
5. 分析转化率：“上个季度我们从销售线索到机会以及从机会到成交的转化率是多少？与我们的目标相比如何？”
6. 预测收入：“根据概率得分，预计本月将完成多少笔交易？我们的预测收入与每月目标是多少？”
7、季度利润比较：“查看本季度利润，与上季度比较，并提供按部门明细”
8. 生成现金流量报告：“您能否提供最近 30 天的现金流量报告，包括所有进出交易？”
9.审核应收账款：“分享当前应收账款状态，告诉我我们有多少张逾期发票，哪些客户欠款最多”

source_long:
The Course Outline Generator helps you instantly create structured training outlines for corporate learning, compliance, onboarding, and upskilling. Just describe what you want to teach, who it’s for, and how long the course should be and get a ready-to-use blueprint with clearly defined lessons.

* Upload reference material (PDF or text) or use your chat context
* Expand and review lessons one by one
* Further edit and export your outline as a PDF file

Perfect for
* L&D and HR teams
* Managers and team leads
* Compliance and security training
* Soft-skills and leadership development

Once your outline is ready, you can seamlessly continue building your full course with Colossyan’s interactive course creator.
plugin_details.target_long:
课程大纲生成器可帮助您立即创建用于企业学习、合规性、入职和技能提升的结构化培训大纲。只需描述您想教什么、教谁以及课程应该持续多长时间，即可获得包含明确定义的课程的即用型蓝图。 

你能做什么

source_long: Coursera helps learners find and watch relevant lecture videos inside ChatGPT based on their learning goals, skill level, preferred topic, course interest, and desired learning format. The app returns a playable course video preview with course context, instructor details, learning objectives, skills, and related Coursera courses.
plugin_details.target_long: Coursera 帮助学习者根据学习目标、技能水平、首选主题、课程兴趣和所需的学习形式在 ChatGPT 中查找和观看相关讲座视频。该应用程序返回可播放的课程视频预览，其中包含课程背景、讲师详细信息、学习目标、技能和相关 Coursera 课程。

source_long: Connect to CourtListener, the Free Law Project's legal research platform, with access to millions of U.S. court opinions, PACER dockets, judge profiles, oral arguments, and citation data. Search case law across federal and state courts, retrieve full case metadata, extract and verify legal citations against a canonical database, and set up alerts for new opinions or docket updates. Built and operated by Free Law Project, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to making the law broadly accessible. Suited for attorneys, legal researchers, journalists, academics, and pro se litigants who need fast, reliable access to primary legal sources.
plugin_details.target_long: 连接到自由法律项目的法律研究平台 CourtListener，可以访问数百万条美国法院意见、PACER 案卷、法官简介、口头辩论和引文数据。在联邦和州法院搜索判例法，检索完整的案件元数据，根据规范数据库提取和验证法律引文，并针对新意见或案件更新设置警报。由自由法律项目 (Free Law Project) 建立和运营，该项目是一家 501(c)(3) 非营利组织，致力于让法律更广泛地普及。适合需要快速、可靠地访问主要法律资源的律师、法律研究人员、记者、学者和自诉当事人。

source_long:
Courtroom5 serves self-represented litigants (SRLs) — people who must navigate civil court without an attorney, typically because they cannot afford one. Roughly 80% of civil litigants in the United States appear without legal representation. Without guidance, they lose cases on procedural technicalities before the merits are ever heard.

The Courtroom5 app gives ChatGPT users access to three jurisdiction-aware legal tools: a case intake assessment that evaluates a user's situation and identifies applicable civil claims; a deadline calculator that returns precise procedural deadlines and consequences by state and court level; and next-step guidance for users already in active litigation. All tools are scoped to civil matters in US state and federal courts and designed for plain-language delivery to non-lawyers.

Courtroom5 is a Techstars graduate and recipient of the ABA Woman of Legal Tech recognition. We have served over 12,000 self-represented litigants across all 50 states.
plugin_details.target_long:
Courtroom5 为自我代理诉讼当事人 (SRL) 提供服务，这些当事人必须在没有律师的情况下进入民事法庭，通常是因为他们负担不起律师费用。美国大约 80% 的民事诉讼当事人没有法律代表。如果没有指导，他们就会在审理案情之前就因程序技术细节而输掉案件。

Courtroom5 应用程序使 ChatGPT 用户可以使用三种司法管辖区法律工具：案件受理评估，用于评估用户的情况并确定适用的民事索赔；截止日期计算器，可按州和法院级别返回精确的程序截止日期和后果；以及针对已经处于积极诉讼中的用户的下一步指导。所有工具的范围均适用于美国州和联邦法院的民事案件，并旨在以通俗易懂的语言向非律师人士提供服务。

Courtroom5 是 Techstars 毕业生，并获得 ABA 女性法律技术认可。我们已为全美 50 个州的 12,000 多名自辩当事人提供服务。

source_long:
Crunchbase is the leading provider of private-company prospecting and research data, used by salespeople, entrepreneurs, investors, and market researchers to find and evaluate companies.

This connector brings that data into your conversation. Ask in plain language and get structured answers back.

Predictions
Crunchbase models what a company is likely to do next: raise funding, get acquired, go public, grow, stay private, shut down, or cut headcount, along with an estimated current valuation. Each prediction comes with a confidence tier, so you can sort a market by likelihood rather than reading profiles one at a time.

Insights
Written summaries of what's happening at a company right now, covering growth trajectory, recent news, R&D activity, personnel changes, investor activity, and market position.

Company, funding, and people data
Profiles with descriptions, headcount, revenue range, location, and industry. Full funding round history with amounts, dates, types, and investors. Acquisitions, IPOs, funds, and investments. Founders, executives, and leadership changes. Similar-company matching, plus  many more signals.

Build lists you can return to
Save companies as you find them, so a search you run today becomes a pipeline you can monitor over time.

Requires a Crunchbase account. Available data depends on your subscription tier.
plugin_details.target_long:
Crunchbase 是私营公司勘探和研究数据的领先提供商，销售人员、企业家、投资者和市场研究人员使用这些数据来寻找和评估公司。

该连接器将这些数据带入您的对话中。用简单的语言提问并得到结构化的答案。

预测
Crunchbase 对公司下一步可能采取的行动进行建模：筹集资金、被收购、上市、发展、保持私有、关闭或裁员，以及估计的当前估值。每个预测都带有一个置信度等级，因此您可以根据可能性对市场进行排序，而不是一次阅读一个资料。

见解
公司当前情况的书面摘要，涵盖增长轨迹、最新新闻、研发活动、人事变动、投资者活动和市场地位。

公司、资金和人员数据
包含描述、员工人数、收入范围、地点和行业的简介。完整的融资轮历史记录，包括金额、日期、类型和投资者。收购、首次公开募股、基金和投资。创始人、高管和领导层发生变化。类似公司匹配，以及更多信号。

建立您可以返回的列表
保存您找到的公司，以便您今天运行的搜索成为您可以随着时间的推移进行监控的管道。

需要一个 Crunchbase 帐户。可用数据取决于您的订阅级别。

source_long: "When is the glass picked up on my street?" has a real answer only where operators publish one. Când Reciclăm gives Bucharest residents the actual per-address collection calendar for Sector 1 (and household waste for Sector 2), extracted from the operators' official publications and linked to the source on every row. For sectors that don't publish per-address schedules (3–6), it does something rarer: it says so, transparently — what each operator does publish, what it doesn't, and how residents can actually find out (dispatch numbers, collection points, partner apps), all source-linked with verification dates. A practical sorting guide covers the hard cases: batteries, used cooking oil, medicines, e-waste, bulky items, textiles and SGR deposit-return — with concrete drop-off points. Free, no account, no ads.
plugin_details.target_long: “我家街上的玻璃什么时候能捡起来？”只有在运营商发布答案的情况下才有真正的答案。 Când Reciclăm 向布加勒斯特居民提供第 1 区的实际每个地址收集日历（以及第 2 区的家庭垃圾），该日历摘自运营商的官方出版物，并链接到每一行的来源。对于不发布每个地址时间表的部门（3-6），它做了一些罕见的事情：它如此透明地说明 - 每个运营商发布了什么，没有发布什么，以及居民如何实际找到（调度号码，收集点，合作伙伴应用程序），所有源都与验证日期相关联。实用的分类指南涵盖了硬箱：电池、用过的食用油、药品、电子垃圾、大件物品、纺织品和 SGR 押金返还——并设有具体的投放点。免费，无帐户，无广告。

Enable AI-powered credit decisioning, portfolio monitoring, and risk management workflows using trusted D&B data and analytics. 

For inquiries, please contact OpenAILeads@dnb.com

D&B Finance Analytics empowers finance and credit teams to verify businesses, evaluate financial and predictive risk, accelerate credit decisions, monitor portfolio health, and take action through AI assistants, agents, and enterprise applications. By combining trusted D&B business intelligence, financial risk insights, predictive analytics, and workflow capabilities, organizations can bring credit and portfolio management processes directly into AI-driven workflows. 

Anchored by the global standard D‑U‑N‑S® Number and powered by the D&B Commercial Graph™, D&B Finance Analytics helps organizations reduce ambiguity, improve consistency, and make more confident commercial credit decisions at scale. It also enables teams to move from insight to action through portfolio management and workflow capabilities available within D&B Finance Analytics. 

Use D&B Finance Analytics to: 

Evaluate credit recommendation: 
"What is the recommended credit limit for [Company Name], and what factors contributed to that recommendation?" 

Assess business risk: 
"Summarize the financial risk, payment behavior, and predictive risk indicators for [Company Name]." 

Monitor portfolio health: 
"Which customers in my portfolio show elevated risk or signs of deterioration?" 

Prioritize risk management activities: 
"Which customers should I review first based on recent alerts, exposure, and risk changes?" 

Analyze ownership and corporate linkage: 
"Show the ownership structure and related entities for [Company Name]." 

Take action on portfolio:

source_long:
You already have a life. Build the one you want.

DREAMHALL is a private, structured self-care workspace for thinking through personal questions whose answers should remain your own. Instead of generating conclusions, it guides you through a complete process where you examine your life as a whole, develop your own answers, and turn them into grounded decisions and practical action.

The Framework consists of 15 connected exercises that help you understand what truly matters to you, review the balance of your life, separate your own wishes from outside expectations, clarify the future you want to build, work through fears and obstacles, and define realistic next steps.

Unlike an open-ended conversation, DREAMHALL is designed as a finite process with a clear beginning, a deliberate sequence, and a meaningful ending. Every answer is written by you. Every conclusion is your own. The result is a Personal Document that brings together your reflections, priorities, decisions, and next steps in one place.

Your private answers remain inside DREAMHALL and are not returned to ChatGPT through this integration.

When you finish, you can keep your Personal Document in DREAMHALL, download it as a PDF, or export it as Markdown. If you choose, you can later use your own document with ChatGPT to organize ideas, develop plans, compare future versions, or expand it into longer writing. You decide what to share and when.

DREAMHALL supports reflective thinking, life balance, personal wellbeing, and self-directed decision-making. It is a non-clinical self-care product and is not therapy, diagnosis, medical care, emergency support, or crisis support.

Some of the most important decisions should remain your own.
plugin_details.target_long:
你已经有自己的生活了。构建您想要的一个。

DREAMHALL 是一个私人的、结构化的自我护理工作空间，用于思考个人问题，您的答案应该由您自己决定。它不是得出结论，而是引导你完成一个完整的过程，在这个过程中，你从整体上审视自己的生活，得出自己的答案，并将其转化为有根据的决定和实际行动。

该框架由 15 个相互关联的练习组成，帮助您了解什么对您真正重要，回顾您生活的平衡，将您自己的愿望与外界期望分开，明确您想要建设的未来，克服恐惧和障碍，并确定现实的后续步骤。

与开放式对话不同，DREAMHALL 被设计为一个有限的过程，具有明确的开头、经过深思熟虑的顺序和有意义的结尾。每个答案都是你写的。每个结论都是你自己的。其结果是一份个人文档，将您的思考、优先事项、决策和后续步骤汇集到一个地方。

您的私人答案保留在 DREAMHALL 中，不会通过此集成返回到 ChatGPT。

完成后，您可以将个人文档保留在 DREAMHALL 中、下载为 PDF 格式或导出为 Markdown 格式。如果您愿意，您稍后可以使用 ChatGPT 来组织想法、制定计划、比较未来版本或将其扩展为更长的文字。您决定分享什么以及何时分享。

DREAMHALL 支持反思性思维、生活平衡、个人福祉和自我导向决策。它是一种非临床自我护理产品，不是治疗、诊断、医疗护理、紧急支持或危机支持。

一些最重要的决定应该由您自己做出。

通过对话访问您的 Dakota 平台数据。询问有关您的客户、账户和交易的问题，无需导航仪表板或编写 API 调用。

  你可以做什么：
  - 查找客户并按 KYB 状态、类型或名称进行筛选
  - 查看入口、出口和交换帐户详细信息
  - 浏览交易历史记录，包括费用、汇率和区块链数据

  示例查询：
  - “显示所有等待 KYB 审核的客户”
  - “该客户最近的交易是什么？”
  - “列出 Base 上使用 USDC 的所有入口账户”

  只读访问——您的数据保持安全。使用您的 Dakota 平台凭据进行安全身份验证。

source_long: Daloopa supplies high quality fundamental data sourced from filings, investor presentations, earnings transcripts and company presentations, with hyperlinks to source document overlaying each data point. Provides a zero-hallucination foundation for any quantitative financial analysis in ChatGPT.
plugin_details.target_long: Daloopa 提供来自文件、投资者演示、收益记录和公司演示的高质量基本数据，并带有覆盖每个数据点的源文档的超链接。为 ChatGPT 中的任何定量财务分析提供零幻觉基础。

source_long:
Connect ChatGPT to Damoov telematics data and turn operational questions into clear, actionable insights.

The Damoov MCP server lets authorized users explore company-level mobility metrics, including trip counts, distance, active drivers, safety scores, and harsh driving events. Analyze trends over custom periods, compare performance between time ranges, break metrics down by day or driver, and identify top contributors—all through natural-language requests.

Designed for fleet, insurance, mobility, logistics, and driving-safety use cases, it provides secure access only to the Damoov companies and data available to the authenticated user.
plugin_details.target_long:
将 ChatGPT 连接到 Damoov 远程信息处理数据，并将操作问题转化为清晰、可操作的见解。

Damoov MCP 服务器允许授权用户探索公司级移动指标，包括行程计数、距离、活跃驾驶员、安全评分和恶劣驾驶事件。分析自定义时间段内的趋势，比较时间范围之间的性能，按天或驱动因素细分指标，并确定主要贡献者——所有这些都通过自然语言请求进行。

它专为车队、保险、移动、物流和驾驶安全用例而设计，仅提供对 Damoov 公司的安全访问以及经过身份验证的用户可用的数据。

source_long: DashThis is a marketing reporting platform that brings data from 30+ marketing integrations into dashboards for agencies and in-house marketing teams. This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to the dashboards on the user's DashThis account. Users can list and search dashboards, see how a dashboard is set up and which sources feed it, inspect current widget values for supported reporting periods, compare results with another period, identify dashboards with source errors, and turn dashboard results into client-ready summaries. The connector cannot create, edit, delete, send, or schedule anything in the user's DashThis account. It only reads data already available through the user's DashThis dashboards and requires the user to connect their DashThis account with OAuth.
plugin_details.target_long: DashThis 是一个营销报告平台，可将来自 30 多个营销集成的数据引入代理机构和内部营销团队的仪表板中。此连接器为 ChatGPT 提供对用户 DashThis 帐户上的仪表板的只读访问权限。用户可以列出和搜索仪表板，查看仪表板的设置方式以及为其提供数据的来源，检查支持的报告周期的当前小部件值，将结果与另一个周期进行比较，识别具有源错误的仪表板，并将仪表板结果转换为客户端可用的摘要。连接器无法在用户的 DashThis 帐户中创建、编辑、删除、发送或安排任何内容。它仅读取通过用户的 DashThis 仪表板可用的数据，并要求用户将其 DashThis 帐户与 OAuth 连接。

source_long:
Data Analytics helps you turn questions about your product or business into answers you can trust. Ask why a metric changed, what the data shows about where a team should focus next, how to define KPIs, whether a dataset is reliable, or how large an opportunity might be, and it can help you investigate the data and turn the findings into shareable reports, charts, dashboards, notebooks, and recommendations.

Start with the data you already have: connected warehouses, BI or product analytics tools, docs, chats, spreadsheets, uploaded files, pasted results, or clearly labeled sample data. The plugin guides you through the right workflow, checks sources where possible, and keeps the evidence visible in reviewable tables, charts, dashboards, and report apps you can share.
plugin_details.target_long:
数据分析可帮助您将有关产品或业务的问题转化为您可以信任的答案。询问指标为何发生变化、数据显示了团队接下来应该关注的内容、如何定义 KPI、数据集是否可靠或机会可能有多大，它可以帮助您调查数据并将结果转化为可共享的报告、图表、仪表板、笔记本和建议。

从您已有的数据开始：连接的仓库、BI 或产品分析工具、文档、聊天、电子表格、上传的文件、粘贴的结果或明确标记的示例数据。该插件引导您完成正确的工作流程，尽可能检查来源，并使证据在您可以共享的可审查表格、图表、仪表板和报告应用程序中保持可见。

source_long:
Data Bloo helps you ask questions about your performance and get clear answers from your connected data sources. No exports, no spreadsheets, no manual reporting.

Use it to check campaign performance, compare channels, spot trends, and summarize key takeaways for your team or clients.

Data Bloo works with sources including Facebook Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Bing Ads, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, Instagram Insights, Facebook Insights, WooCommerce, and more.
plugin_details.target_long:
Data Bloo 可帮助您提出有关绩效的问题，并从连接的数据源中获得清晰的答案。没有导出，没有电子表格，没有手动报告。

用它来检查活动效果、比较渠道、发现趋势并为您的团队或客户总结关键要点。

Data Bloo 与 Facebook 广告、LinkedIn 广告、TikTok 广告、Bing 广告、Google Search Console、Google Business Profile、Instagram Insights、Facebook Insights、WooCommerce 等来源合作。

source_long: The DataDolphin connects ChatGPT to Dolphin Sistemas' structured knowledge base — including projects, documents, architecture rules, and agent instructions. With a single connection, you can query implementation context, retrieve project specifications, and access technical documentation in real time. All access is protected by OAuth 2.0 via Keycloak and restricted to read-only operations, ensuring safe and auditable use by AI agents.
plugin_details.target_long: DataDolphin 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Dolphin Sistemas 的结构化知识库，包括项目、文档、架构规则和代理指令。通过单个连接，您可以查询实施上下文、检索项目规范并实时访问技术文档。所有访问均通过 Keycloak 受 OAuth 2.0 保护，并仅限于只读操作，确保 AI 代理使用安全且可审核。

source_long:
Data247 brings real-time contact and identity data into ChatGPT, for identifying and verifying contact information,  fraudulent activity, TCPA compliance, and more. 
 
Ask in plain language and ChatGPT runs the lookup for you: confirm whether a phone line is active and what carrier and line type it is, check whether an email is deliverable, validate a postal address, or find the person behind a phone or email. Before you call or text a US number, check it against the Do-Not-Call registry, and add numbers to your internal DNC list when someone opts out. Looking into a suspicious signup or order? Geolocate the IP for proxy/VPN signals and screen the details for fraud.

Upload spreadsheets or lists of data to be cleaned, appended to, or  validated, and ChatGPT will consult Data247 and give it back to you completely processed.

It's handy for keeping a CRM clean, validating and enriching leads before outreach, staying compliant with calling rules, and reviewing flagged accounts.

You must have an active Data247 account, and lookups are billed per use against your prepaid balance — checking your balance and rate card is free, and you can ask for either anytime.
plugin_details.target_long:
Data247 将实时联系人和身份数据引入 ChatGPT，用于识别和验证联系人信息、欺诈活动、TCPA 合规性等。 
 
用简单的语言询问，ChatGPT 会为您运行查找：确认电话线路是否处于活动状态以及其运营商和线路类型，检查电子邮件是否可以送达，验证邮政地址，或者找到电话或电子邮件背后的人员。在您拨打美国号码或发短信之前，请对照拒收来电注册表进行检查，并在有人选择退出时将号码添加到您的内部 DNC 列表中。正在调查可疑的注册或订单？地理定位代理/VPN 信号的 IP，并筛查欺诈的详细信息。

上传要清理、附加或验证的电子表格或数据列表，ChatGPT 将咨询 Data247 并将其完全处理后返回给您。

它可以方便地保持 CRM 干净、在外展之前验证和丰富潜在客户、遵守呼叫规则以及审查标记的帐户。

您必须有一个有效的 Data247 帐户，并且查询是根据您的预付余额按使用次数计费的 - 检查您的余额和价目表是免费的，您可以随时索取。

source_long: DataAssist lets organizations expose uploaded CSVs and connected databases as MCP tools so users can discover tables, inspect metadata, preview rows, and run validated SQL SELECT queries from ChatGPT. Tool calls are scoped to the authenticated organization and user, use only tables the organization has exposed, and support self-serve analysis across CSV, SFTP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and S3-backed data sources.
plugin_details.target_long: DataAssist 允许组织将上传的 CSV 和连接的数据库作为 MCP 工具公开，以便用户可以发现表、检查元数据、预览行并从 ChatGPT 运行经过验证的 SQL SELECT 查询。工具调用的范围仅限于经过身份验证的组织和用户，仅使用组织公开的表，并支持跨 CSV、SFTP、MySQL、PostgreSQL 和 S3 支持的数据源的自助分析。

source_long: Learn to code and master AI with DataCamp. Build in-demand skills in SQL, Python, R, ChatGPT, and more through our interactive courses and expert-led training. Whether you're getting started or learning advanced queries, we'll provide helpful recommendations to structure and guide your learning journey.
plugin_details.target_long: 通过 DataCamp 学习编码并掌握 AI。通过我们的互动课程和专家主导的培训，培养 SQL、Python、R、ChatGPT 等领域所需的技能。无论您是入门还是学习高级查询，我们都将提供有用的建议来构建和指导您的学习之旅。

source_long: DataForB2B helps sales, recruiting, and GTM teams with sales prospecting, candidate sourcing, talent mapping, and B2B data enrichment. It finds leads and candidates, surfaces funding rounds and hiring signals, searches jobs and LinkedIn or other social posts, and retrieves available work emails and contact details to prepare outreach.
plugin_details.target_long: DataForB2B 帮助销售、招聘和 GTM 团队进行销售勘探、候选人搜寻、人才定位和 B2B 数据丰富。它可以找到潜在客户和候选人，显示融资轮次和招聘信号，搜索职位和 LinkedIn 或其他社交帖子，并检索可用的工作电子邮件和联系方式以准备外展。

source_long:
DataGlass helps marketplace sellers understand profitability and identify opportunities to improve business performance.

Connect your Shopee, Lazada, or TikTok Shop account to analyze sales, advertising performance, fees, costs, margins, and operational metrics. Ask questions about your business in natural language and receive data-backed insights based on your shop’s actual data.

Use DataGlass to:
• Analyze product and campaign profitability
• Understand true ROAS after fees and costs
• Identify underperforming products and ads
• Find opportunities to improve margins
• Compare performance across products and campaigns
• Explore recommendations for pricing, advertising, and inventory decisions

DataGlass combines analytics and optimization techniques to help sellers make more informed decisions using their marketplace data.
plugin_details.target_long:
DataGlass 帮助市场卖家了解盈利能力并发现提高业务绩效的机会。

连接您的 Shopee、Lazada 或 TikTok Shop 帐户以分析销售、广告效果、费用、成本、利润和运营指标。用自然语言询问有关您的业务的问题，并根据您商店的实际数据获得有数据支持的见解。

使用 DataGlass 可以：
• 分析产品和营销活动的盈利能力
• 了解扣除费用和成本后的真实 ROAS
• 识别表现不佳的产品和广告
• 寻找提高利润的机会
• 比较不同产品和活动的效果
• 探索有关定价、广告和库存决策的建议

DataGlass 结合了分析和优化技术，帮助卖家利用市场数据做出更明智的决策。

source_long: Leverage Genie to analyze Databricks data and inspect or operate on selected workspace objects, jobs, Lakeflow pipelines, compute, dashboards, MLflow experiments, and serving endpoints.
plugin_details.target_long: 利用 Genie 分析 Databricks 数据并检查或操作选定的工作区对象、作业、Lakeflow 管道、计算、仪表板、MLflow 实验和服务端点。

source_long: Available for US1 customers only. Analyze, investigate, and act on your Datadog telemetry directly from ChatGPT using natural language. Ask questions about your production applications, identify, visualize, and remediate issues in your critical services. Run agentic loops to ensure you continue to maintain good observability and service management posture.
plugin_details.target_long: 仅面向 US1 客户。使用自然语言直接在 ChatGPT 中分析、排查并处理 Datadog 遥测数据；可针对生产应用提问，识别、可视化并修复关键服务问题，并运行智能循环以持续保持良好的可观测性和服务管理状态。

source_long: This plugin is the best way to agentically interact with Datadog Product Analytics, Feature Flagging, and Experimentation
plugin_details.target_long: 该插件是与 Datadog 产品分析、功能标记和实验进行代理交互的最佳方式

source_long: Datarails FinanceOS brings structure and intelligence to your financial data. It provides a managed, organized database that keeps your numbers clean and reliable. Every change is fully traced with a built-in audit trail, so you always know who changed what and when. A robust permission mechanism ensures each user sees only the data they're authorized to access. And with built-in financial logic, the app understands your business context out of the box - no manual setup required.
plugin_details.target_long: Datarails FinanceOS 为您的财务数据带来结构化和智能。它提供了一个受管理的、有组织的数据库，使您的数字保持干净和可靠。每个更改都会通过内置的审核跟踪进行完整跟踪，因此您始终知道谁更改了什么以及何时更改。强大的权限机制确保每个用户只能看到他们有权访问的数据。通过内置的财务逻辑，该应用程序可以立即了解您的业务背景 - 无需手动设置。

source_long:
Connect ChatGPT to your Datasite virtual data room - the secure workspace where thousands of M&A deals are facilitated annually. Set up folder structures, invite users, search documents, track buyer Q&A, and audit data room readiness, all through natural language. No workflow interruptions. No security trade-offs. Built for advisors, bankers, and corporate development teams - backed by the enterprise security and permissioning every transaction demands.

1. Set up a deal room - "Create a new Datasite Prepare data room for Project Alpha, set up a standard M&A folder index, and invite sarah@advisorfirm.com as an admin."

2. Search documents semantically - "Search the data room for any documents related to pending litigation or regulatory risk."

3. Track buyer Q&A - "Show me all open Q&A questions in the data room and draft responses where we have supporting documents."

4. Audit deal room readiness - "Check the data room for empty folders, missing documents, and any files flagged as password-protected or blank before we go live."

5. Manage user access - "Create a buyer role with view-only permissions and create draft invitations for the following five contacts from Acme Capital."
plugin_details.target_long:
将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Datasite 虚拟数据室 - 安全的工作空间，每年促成数以千计的并购交易。设置文件夹结构、邀请用户、搜索文档、跟踪买家问答以及审核数据室准备情况，所有这些都通过自然语言进行。没有工作流程中断。没有安全权衡。专为顾问、银行家和企业开发团队而构建 - 由企业安全性和每项交易需求的许可提供支持。

1. 建立交易室 - “创建一个新的数据站点，为 Project Alpha 准备数据室，建立标准的并购文件夹索引，并邀请 sarah@advisorfirm.com 作为管理员。”

2. 按语义搜索文档 - “在数据室中搜索与未决诉讼或监管风险相关的任何文档。”

3. 跟踪买家问答 - “向我展示数据室中所有未解决的问答问题，并在我们有支持文件的情况下草拟答复。”

4. 审核交易室准备情况 - “在上线之前检查数据室是否有空文件夹、丢失文档以及任何标记为受密码保护或空白的文件。”

5. 管理用户访问权限 - “创建具有仅查看权限的买家角色，并为 Acme Capital 的以下五个联系人创建草稿邀请。”

source_long:
Connect ChatGPT to the marketing and analytics data available in your Dataslayer account. Ask questions in natural language and retrieve data from platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics 4, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Amazon Ads, Shopify, HubSpot, and more, using the accounts already connected to Dataslayer.

With the Dataslayer plugin, you can:

- Discover your available data sources and connected accounts
- Find the metrics and dimensions supported by each platform
- Retrieve campaign and performance data for specific accounts and date ranges
- Compare results across campaigns, accounts, and reporting periods
- Analyze trends and changes in your marketing performance
- Turn retrieved data into summaries, tables, and actionable insights

Example questions include:

- “Show clicks, impressions, cost, and conversions for my Google Ads account last month.”
- “Compare campaign performance this month with the previous month.”
- “Which revenue metrics are available in Google Analytics 4?”
- “List the Meta Ads accounts connected to Dataslayer.”
- “Break down TikTok Ads performance by campaign and date.”

Dataslayer retrieves the data directly from your connected marketing platforms, while ChatGPT helps you explore, interpret, and present the results. This gives marketers, agencies, and data teams a simpler way to work with their performance data without manually building complex queries.
plugin_details.target_long:
将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Dataslayer 帐户中可用的营销和分析数据。使用已连接到 Dataslayer 的帐户，以自然语言提出问题并从 Google Ads、Meta Ads、Google Analytics 4、LinkedIn Ads、TikTok Ads、Microsoft Advertising、Amazon Ads、Shopify、HubSpot 等平台检索数据。

使用 Dataslayer 插件，您可以：

- 发现您的可用数据源和连接的帐户
- 查找每个平台支持的指标和维度
- 检索特定帐户和日期范围的活动和绩效数据
- 比较不同活动、账户和报告期间的结果
- 分析营销绩效的趋势和变化
- 将检索到的数据转化为摘要、表格和可行的见解

示例问题包括：

- “显示我的 Google Ads 帐户上个月的点击次数、展示次数、费用和转化次数。”
- “将本月与上个月的营销活动效果进行比较。”
- “Google Analytics 4 中提供了哪些收入指标？”
- “列出连接到 Dataslayer 的元广告帐户。”
- “按活动和日期细分 TikTok 广告效果。”

Dataslayer 直接从您连接的营销平台检索数据，而 ChatGPT 则帮助您探索、解释和呈现结果。这为营销人员、机构和数据团队提供了一种更简单的方法来处理他们的绩效数据，而无需手动构建复杂的查询。

source_long: Dathent is an AI content assistant for brands. Set up your brand profile, get a weekly content plan, generate post drafts with captions and visuals, schedule them to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Threads and Telegram, and track how published posts perform — all from chat. Drafts are never auto-published without your confirmation.
plugin_details.target_long: Dathent 是品牌的人工智能内容助手。设置您的品牌档案，制定每周内容计划，生成带有标题和视觉效果的帖子草稿，将其安排到 Instagram、Facebook、TikTok、LinkedIn、X、Threads 和 Telegram，并跟踪已发布帖子的表现 - 全部通过聊天进行。未经您的确认，草稿绝不会自动发布。

source_long: Dayalogs gives teams survey authoring tools, distribution workflows and full fieldwork control from their own AI. It helps create, validate, preview, and manage schema-first online surveys, with support for survey definitions, translations, respondent links, LinkSets, embeds, campaigns, audiences, review rounds, branding, styles, responses and exports through a scoped OAuth MCP connection.
plugin_details.target_long: Dayalogs 为团队提供调查创作工具、分发工作流程以及通过他们自己的人工智能进行的全面现场工作控制。它有助于创建、验证、预览和管理模式优先的在线调查，并通过范围内的 OAuth MCP 连接支持调查定义、翻译、受访者链接、链接集、嵌入、活动、受众、审核轮次、品牌、样式、响应和导出。

source_long: Search and book hotel rooms available for a few hours during the day, not overnight. Search worldwide Dayuse inventory by city, budget, amenities, and time; view results on an interactive map; inspect hotel details; compare hotels; get answers to booking questions; and continue to dayuse.com to complete a reservation.
plugin_details.target_long: 搜索并预订白天几个小时内可用的酒店房间，而不是过夜的酒店房间。按城市、预算、设施和时间搜索全球日用库存；在交互式地图上查看结果；检查酒店详细信息；比较酒店；获取预订问题的答案；并继续访问 dayuse.com 完成预订。

source_long:
Dazzly is an all‑in‑one website builder that helps small businesses and creators get a professional site online quickly—without stitching together hosting, security, design tools, and add‑ons.

Start from polished templates and customize your pages while Dazzly handles the technical essentials in the background: website hosting, free SSL security, and performance-focused image optimization so your site loads smoothly across devices.

Need content fast? Dazzly includes access to stock image/video/icon libraries to help you publish with less time spent searching and buying assets.

If you sell products, Dazzly’s built‑in ecommerce shopping cart lets you take payments and offer options like click & collect, delivery, or cash on pickup—so your website can support real day‑to‑day sales, not just look good.

For teams who want strong foundations without endless setup, Dazzly also includes built‑in SEO and performance fundamentals (like sitemaps and structured data) to help your site be discoverable and dependable from day one.
plugin_details.target_long:
Dazzly 是一款一体化网站构建器，可帮助小型企业和创建者快速在线建立专业网站，而无需将托管、安全性、设计工具和附加组件拼接在一起。

从精美的模板开始，自定义您的页面，而 Dazzly 在后台处理技术要点：网站托管、免费 SSL 安全性和以性能为中心的图像优化，以便您的网站可以跨设备顺利加载。

需要快速内容吗？ Dazzly 包含对库存图像/视频/图标库的访问，可帮助您以更少的时间搜索和购买资源进行发布。

source_long:
Deep Art AI enables users to create high-quality visual content directly through ChatGPT using natural-language instructions. Users can generate entirely new images and videos from text prompts by describing the desired subject, visual style, composition, atmosphere, movement, or other creative details.

Deep Art AI is designed to make use of the latest and most advanced image-generation and video-generation technologies available. The underlying imaging and video capabilities are continuously kept up to date so that users can benefit from current state-of-the-art models, improved visual quality, more accurate prompt understanding, better consistency, enhanced realism, and the latest creative generation capabilities.

For video creation, Deep Art AI can submit video generation requests as asynchronous generation jobs. This allows users to initiate more complex video-generation tasks without requiring the entire generation process to be completed within a single interaction. After a video job has been submitted, users can retrieve its current generation status through ChatGPT, making it possible to check whether the video is still being processed, has been successfully completed, or requires further action.

Overall, Deep Art AI provides an integrated creative workflow within ChatGPT for generating images and videos, submitting video-generation jobs, and monitoring the progress and status of generated video content. By continuously leveraging the latest available imaging and video technologies, Deep Art AI gives users access to modern, high-quality visual creation capabilities through simple conversational, prompt-based interactions.
plugin_details.target_long:
Deep Art AI 使用户能够使用自然语言指令直接通过 ChatGPT 创建高质量的视觉内容。用户可以通过描述所需的主题、视觉风格、构图、氛围、动作或其他创意细节，根据文本提示生成全新的图像和视频。

Deep Art AI 旨在利用最新、最先进的图像生成和视频生成技术。底层的图像和视频功能不断保持更新，使用户可以受益于当前最先进的模型、改进的视觉质量、更准确的提示理解、更好的一致性、增强的真实感以及最新的创意生成功能。

对于视频创作，Deep Art AI 可以将视频生成请求作为异步生成作业提交。这允许用户启动更复杂的视频生成任务，而不需要在单次交互中完成整个生成过程。视频作业提交后，用户可以通过 ChatGPT 检索其当前生成状态，从而可以检查视频是否仍在处理、已成功完成或需要进一步操作。

总体而言，Deep Art AI 在 ChatGPT 内提供了集成的创意工作流程，用于生成图像和视频、提交视频生成作业以及监控生成视频内容的进度和状态。通过不断利用最新的成像和视频技术，Deep Art AI 让用户通过简单的对话式、基于提示的交互来获得现代、高质量的视觉创作功能。

source_long:
Deglaze brings your recipe library into ChatGPT, turning it into a cooking assistant that starts from what you and your household actually cook. It connects your Deglaze account — saved recipes (from websites, social media, cookbooks, etc.), meal plan, grocery list, household food preferences, and cooking history — so recipe suggestions reflect your real tastes and constraints.

Ask for dinner ideas and get recipes from your own library, or branch out with new recipes from Deglaze's discovery database and save the keepers to your library. Browse results as recipe cards with photos, tap through to the full recipe, or create a new recipe in the conversation from family favorites, ingredients you mention, or an idea ChatGPT helps develop.

Then turn ideas into action: put recipes on your meal plan, add their ingredients to your grocery list while skipping items you tell it to omit, and manage the list as you shop. Deglaze uses your preferences and cooking history to steer around allergies, lean into the flavors your household likes, and suggest meals without repeating recent dinners.
plugin_details.target_long:
Deglaze 将您的食谱库带入 ChatGPT，将其变成一个烹饪助手，从您和您的家人实际烹饪的内容开始。它连接您的 Deglaze 帐户 - 保存的食谱（来自网站、社交媒体、食谱等）、膳食计划、购物清单、家庭食物偏好和烹饪历史 - 因此食谱建议反映您的真实口味和限制。

然后将想法转化为行动：将食谱放在您的膳食计划中，将其成分添加到您的购物清单中，同时跳过您告诉它要省略的项目，并在购物时管理清单。 Deglaze 根据您的喜好和烹饪历史来避免过敏，倾向于您的家人喜欢的口味，并建议膳食，而无需重复最近的晚餐。
