Instead of browsing through endless property listings, users can discover available houses, apartments, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This allows them to assess location, surroundings, and infrastructure much faster and more realistically.

By combining regional market expertise with modern technology, Klinger-Vogt Immobilien creates a transparent and user-friendly way to find suitable properties in the region.

Advantages at a Glance
Interactive property search through a modern map interface
Faster orientation in Ludwigshafen, Mannheim, and Neustadt an der Weinstraße
Better understanding of location, infrastructure, and surroundings
Focus on selected properties in the Rhine-Neckar region
Easier comparison of different residential areas
More efficient searching through visual navigation
Direct contact with experienced local real estate experts
Modern and intuitive mobile experience

Whether it’s a modern city apartment in Mannheim, a family home in Ludwigshafen, or an investment property in Neustadt an der Weinstraße, Klinger-Vogt Immobilien offers a contemporary and transparent gateway to the regional real estate market.
plugin_details.target_long:

用户无需浏览无休止的房产列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上发现可用的房屋、公寓和投资房产。这使他们能够更快、更现实地评估位置、周围环境和基础设施。

通过将区域市场专业知识与现代技术相结合，Klinger-Vogt Immobilien 创造了一种透明且用户友好的方式来在该地区寻找合适的房产。

优势一览
通过现代地图界面进行交互式财产搜索
在路德维希港、曼海姆和葡萄酒之路上的诺伊施塔特更快地进行定位
更好地了解位置、基础设施和周围环境
专注于莱茵-内卡地区的精选房产

source_long:

Actions run within the authenticated Kontainer tenant and follow the user’s Kontainer permissions.
plugin_details.target_long: Kontainer 将 ChatGPT 连接到您组织的 DAM 和 PIM 工作区。查找并检查图像、视频和文档；组织文件夹和收藏；管理资产元数据和 CDN 交付；维护产品记录和渠道数据；管理工作区用户和权限；并查看使用统计数据。操作在经过身份验证的 Kontainer 租户内运行，并遵循用户的 Kontainer 权限。

source_long:
Kopi creates on-brand marketing emails for e-commerce brands.

Kopi generates responsive HTML suitable for Klaviyo, Mailchimp, and other email platforms that accept HTML, optimized for Shopify brands.

Provide a brand URL (optional) and a campaign goal (e.g., “15% off”, “new product launch”, “gift guide”) to create an email for your brand.

Use Kopi for promotions, product launches, seasonal campaigns, and announcements. Modify emails by requesting changes (tone, sections, offers, product focus), then export the version you want.
plugin_details.target_long:
Kopi 为电子商务品牌创建品牌营销电子邮件。

Kopi 生成适合 Klaviyo、Mailchimp 和其他接受 HTML 的电子邮件平台的响应式 HTML，并针对 Shopify 品牌进行了优化。

提供品牌网址（可选）和活动目标（例如“15% 折扣”、“新产品发布”、“礼品指南”），为您的品牌创建电子邮件。

使用 Kopi 进行促销、产品发布、季节性活动和公告。通过请求更改（语气、部分、优惠、产品焦点）来修改电子邮件，然后导出您想要的版本。

source_long:
Korea Concierge helps people navigate Korean secondhand shopping and practical life tasks from chat. Search Bunjang listings, inspect listing details, calculate an item quote, and create a reviewed purchase request. Every order is reviewed before payment, and the buyer receives a private order page with the quote, payment step, status, proof, and tracking.

The plugin also provides free, deterministic checks based on official Korean apartment transaction data. Users can inspect recent sale and rent records, compare a jeonse deposit with sale prices, or compare a monthly rent offer with similar transactions. These tools provide transaction data and clearly disclosed calculations, not brokerage or advice.

Curated living guides cover arrival administration, housing contracts, banking, property purchase procedure, and schools. Users can also submit a settling, housing-support, or education request for founder review. Korea Concierge operates as the principal seller for secondhand resale orders and as the service provider for accepted concierge engagements.
plugin_details.target_long:
韩国礼宾服务帮助人们通过聊天导航韩国二手购物和实际生活任务。搜索 Bunjang 列表、检查列表详细信息、计算商品报价并创建经过审核的购买请求。每个订单在付款前都会经过审核，买家会收到一个私人订单页面，其中包含报价、付款步骤、状态、证明和跟踪。

该插件还根据韩国官方公寓交易数据提供免费的确定性检查。用户可以检查最近的销售和租赁记录，将全押金与销售价格进行比较，或将月租报价与类似交易进行比较。这些工具提供交易数据和明确披露的计算，而不是经纪或建议。

精心策划的生活指南涵盖抵达管理、住房合同、银行、房产购买程序和学校。用户还可以提交定居、住房支持或教育请求以供创始人审核。韩国礼宾部作为二手转售订单的主要卖家以及接受礼宾服务的服务提供商运营。

source_long: Kova gives ChatGPT a persistent home for a user's investment strategy. Users save their investment rules once, then ask ChatGPT to review a portfolio against the same plan whenever they need a check-in. Kova returns repeatable briefs with an alignment score, portfolio drift, strategy-rule checks when configured, and changes that would restore alignment. It keeps the user's plan anchored across sessions, so each review starts from the saved investment standard instead of a blank chat. Kova does not place trades, manage assets, provide financial advice, or predict markets.
plugin_details.target_long: Kova 为 ChatGPT 提供了用户投资策略的持久家园。用户保存一次投资规则，然后在需要签入时要求 ChatGPT 根据同一计划审查投资组合。 Kova 返回可重复的摘要，其中包含一致性分数、投资组合漂移、配置时的策略规则检查以及将恢复一致性的更改。它使用户的计划能够跨会话锚定，因此每次审核都从保存的投资标准开始，而不是从空白聊天开始。 Kova 不进行交易、管理资产、提供财务建议或预测市场。

source_long: Kpler brings maritime and commodities market intelligence into ChatGPT. Users can track vessels via AIS, look up port calls and voyage routes, analyze commodity trade flows and supply/demand balances, monitor refinery throughput and margins, follow LNG terminal capacity, inventories, utilization and outages, review freight-market fixtures and port congestion, run vessel compliance and sanctions-risk screening, and read Kpler Insights reports and market commentary. Every tool is a read-only query against Kpler's authenticated data, so the app answers analytical questions without creating, modifying, or deleting anything.
plugin_details.target_long: Kpler 将海事和大宗商品市场情报引入 ChatGPT。用户可以通过AIS跟踪船舶，查找港口停靠和航行路线，分析商品贸易流量和供需平衡，监控炼油厂吞吐量和利润，跟踪液化天然气接收站容量、库存、利用率和停运情况，审查货运市场固定情况和港口拥堵情况，运行船舶合规性和制裁风险筛查，并阅读Kpler Insights报告和市场评论。每个工具都是针对 Kpler 的经过身份验证的数据的只读查询，因此该应用程序可以回答分析问题，而无需创建、修改或删除任何内容。

source_long: Get real-time crypto market insights directly in your AI conversations. View top assets with live prices, 7-day price trends, and percentage changes. Drill into any coin for market narratives, sentiment analysis, and key stories—all in a beautiful, interactive widget.
plugin_details.target_long: 直接在人工智能对话中获取实时加密货币市场洞察。查看热门资产的实时价格、7 天价格趋势和百分比变化。深入研究任何货币，了解市场叙述、情绪分析和关键故事——所有这些都在一个漂亮的交互式小部件中。

source_long: Krea helps users generate and enhance images, create video and 3D assets, run shared node apps, and manage private files, moodboards, and styles through ChatGPT.
plugin_details.target_long: Krea 帮助用户生成和增强图像、创建视频和 3D 资产、运行共享节点应用程序以及通过 ChatGPT 管理私人文件、情绪板和样式。

source_long:
Kredit is a UAE-focused credit card comparison website that helps you quickly find cards that match how you actually spend. In one place, you can browse offers from multiple banks and compare key details side by side — like cashback rates, rewards, welcome bonuses, annual fees, eligibility requirements, and core benefits (travel perks, lounge access, dining discounts, and more).

Instead of digging through scattered pages, Kredit makes it easier to narrow your options with simple filters and clear explanations of what each feature means in practice. Whether you’re looking for everyday savings on groceries and fuel, better value on flights and hotels, or a low-fee card to keep things simple, you can sort and compare cards based on what matters most to you.
plugin_details.target_long:
Kredit 是一家专注于阿联酋的信用卡比较网站，可帮助您快速找到符合您实际消费方式的信用卡。在一个地方，您可以浏览多家银行的优惠并并排比较关键详细信息，例如现金返还率、奖励、欢迎奖金、年费、资格要求和核心福利（旅行福利、休息室使用权、餐饮折扣等）。

Kredit 无需挖掘分散的页面，而是通过简单的过滤器和对每个功能在实践中含义的清晰解释，让您更轻松地缩小选择范围。无论您是在寻找日常杂货和燃油方面的节省、更超值的航班和酒店价格，还是为了简单起见而使用低费用卡，您都可以根据对您来说最重要的内容对卡进行分类和比较。

source_long: Kreel connects ChatGPT to normalized ecommerce performance data from Shopify, Klaviyo, Meta Ads, and Google Ads. Users ask about revenue, ROAS, campaigns, creatives, email performance, and anomalies across their connected brands, keep a durable brand knowledge base, and publish hosted reports on request.
plugin_details.target_long: Kreel 将 ChatGPT 连接到来自 Shopify、Klaviyo、Meta Ads 和 Google Ads 的标准化电子商务绩效数据。用户询问其关联品牌的收入、ROAS、营销活动、创意、电子邮件性能和异常情况，保留持久的品牌知识库，并根据要求发布托管报告。

source_long: Animate Music Videos with Krikey AI Animation. Select a 3D character, a music genre, and a topic (for example a birthday card, a marketing video or a how-to tutorial), then animate your cartoon character using AI Text to Animation. Download a high-res video export and share these 3D visuals with AI-generated music, animations, anime and cute cartoon characters.
plugin_details.target_long: 使用 Krikey AI 动画制作音乐视频动画。选择 3D 角色、音乐流派和主题（例如生日贺卡、营销视频或操作教程），然后使用 AI 文本转动画为您的卡通角色制作动画。下载高分辨率视频导出并与 AI 生成的音乐、动画、动漫和可爱的卡通人物分享这些 3D 视觉效果。

source_long:
Krisp AI Meeting Assistant MCP gives your AI assistant secure access to your meeting history, including transcripts, summaries, action items, and upcoming meetings. It enables your AI to work with real context from your actual conversations.

Put your meetings to work:
Draft documents and proposals using decisions, feedback, and stakeholder input from past meetings. Prepare for upcoming meetings with quick briefs on previous discussions, pending items, and attendees. Track follow ups by surfacing open action items across all meetings, filtered by assignee, status, or date. Search for specific moments by topic, attendee, keyword, or date range. Build presentations and reports by combining insights from multiple conversations in one place.
How it works:
Your AI assistant searches and retrieves information from your Krisp meetings in real time. Ask in plain language, such as “What did we decide about pricing last week?” or “Show my open action items,” and get answers grounded in what was actually discussed. Full transcripts are available whenever you need deeper context.
Why it’s different:
Krisp captures complete meeting transcripts with noise cancelled audio clarity, so your AI works from accurate and comprehensive records. Instead of static notes, your meetings become a structured, searchable knowledge base your AI assistant can use whenever you need it.
plugin_details.target_long:
Krisp AI 会议助手 MCP 使您的 AI 助手可以安全地访问您的会议历史记录，包括记录、摘要、行动项目和即将召开的会议。它使您的人工智能能够与您的实际对话中的真实上下文一起工作。

让您的会议发挥作用：
使用过去会议的决策、反馈和利益相关者的意见起草文件和提案。通过有关先前讨论、待决项目和与会者的快速简介，为即将召开的会议做好准备。通过在所有会议中显示未完成的行动项目（按受托人、状态或日期进行筛选）来跟踪后续行动。按主题、与会者、关键字或日期范围搜索特定时刻。通过将多个对话的见解整合在一处来构建演示文稿和报告。
工作原理：
您的 AI 助手实时搜索并检索 Krisp 会议中的信息。用简单的语言提问，例如“上周我们对定价做了什么决定？”或“显示我未完成的行动项目”，并根据实际讨论的内容获得答案。当您需要更深入的背景信息时，可以获取完整的文字记录。
为什么不同：
Krisp 以消除噪音的音频清晰度捕获完整的会议记录，因此您的 AI 可以根据准确而全面的记录进行工作。您的会议不再是静态笔记，而是成为一个结构化、可搜索的知识库，您的人工智能助手可以在您需要时使用。

source_long: KrystalView helps users inspect real website behavior from ChatGPT. It can list recent visitor sessions, drill into session detail, summarize site stats, analyze scroll depth, show live visitors, explain anomalies, inspect funnels, report campaign attribution and ROAS, list browser errors, and retrieve recent analytics notifications.
plugin_details.target_long: KrystalView 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 检查真实的网站行为。它可以列出最近的访问者会话、深入了解会话详细信息、总结网站统计数据、分析滚动深度、显示实时访问者、解释异常、检查渠道、报告活动归因和 ROAS、列出浏览器错误以及检索最近的分析通知。

source_long:
Ask questions about your Kubera portfolio.

Connect your Kubera account to access your live balance sheet data, including net worth, assets, liabilities, and allocation.

The assistant uses this data to answer questions, surface patterns, and explain what’s in your portfolio.

Example questions:

- What is my current net worth?
- What stands out in my balance sheet?
- Where am I overly concentrated?
- Summarize my assets, liabilities, and entities

Kubera is the Balance Sheet for those who manage their own wealth. https://www.kubera.com/

连接您的 Kubera 账户以访问您的实时资产负债表数据，包括净值、资产、负债和分配。

助理使用这些数据来回答问题、揭示模式并解释您的投资组合中的内容。

示例问题：

Kubera 是那些管理自己财富的人的资产负债表。 https://www.kubera.com/

source_long:
Kukini is an all-in-one family organizer with everything you need to keep your family cared for and organized.

Easily view and manage your family’s shared calendar, adding new events based on a description or picture, updating existing events, and checking for schedule conflicts. Plan meals based on your family’s saved recipes, automatically syncing missing ingredients to your preferred shopping list.
plugin_details.target_long:
Kukini 是一款一体化家庭整理器，提供您照顾和整理家人所需的一切。

轻松查看和管理家人的共享日历、根据描述或图片添加新事件、更新现有事件以及检查日程冲突。根据家人保存的食谱计划膳食，自动将缺少的食材同步到您的首选购物清单。

source_long:
Bring your Kuliko study library into the conversation. Connect Kuliko to turn your own documents and notes into active study material — flashcards, summaries, practice quizzes, and mind maps — and review it all without leaving the chat.

Kuliko's methods are built on well-established learning science: spaced repetition and retrieval practice, two of the most studied techniques for moving knowledge into long-term memory. Ask to generate flashcards from a subject, pull up the summary of a document you uploaded, or run through a quiz and get your results. With Kuliko Pro, you can review flashcards on a spaced-repetition schedule that surfaces each card right when you're about to forget it, take full quizzes, and explore concepts visually with mind maps.

Everything stays tied to your Kuliko account, so the subjects, documents, and progress you build here show up in your dashboard too. Whether you're prepping for an exam or just trying to retain what you read, Kuliko keeps your studying grounded in how memory actually works.
plugin_details.target_long:
将您的 Kuliko 学习图书馆带入对话中。连接 Kuliko，将您自己的文档和笔记变成活跃的学习材料 - 抽认卡、摘要、练习测验和思维导图 - 无需离开聊天即可复习所有内容。

库里科的方法建立在完善的学习科学的基础上：间隔重复和检索练习，这是两种研究最多的将知识转移到长期记忆的技术。要求根据主题生成抽认卡，提取您上传的文档的摘要，或者进行测验并获取结果。借助 Kuliko Pro，您可以按间隔重复计划复习抽认卡，当您即将忘记时，每张卡片都会立即出现，进行完整的测验，并使用思维导图直观地探索概念。

一切都与您的 Kuliko 帐户相关联，因此您在此处构建的主题、文档和进度也会显示在您的仪表板中。无论您是在准备考试还是只是想记住所读内容，Kuliko 都能让您的学习立足于记忆的实际运作方式。

source_long: Kumbukum gives ChatGPT access to a user's authenticated private memory workspace. Users can search and retrieve notes, memories, and project metadata, then create new private notes and memories when requested.
plugin_details.target_long: Kumbukum 允许 ChatGPT 访问用户经过身份验证的私有内存工作区。用户可以搜索和检索笔记、记忆和项目元数据，然后根据请求创建新的私人笔记和记忆。

source_long: Kynra turns personalized fitness plans created with ChatGPT into workouts you can review and track on your iPhone. With your permission, ChatGPT can read your synced Kynra workout history, exercise performance, program progress, effort ratings, nutrition totals, hydration, and personal records to help tailor future general-wellness guidance. Every generated plan is reviewed in Kynra before it becomes active.
plugin_details.target_long: Kynra 将使用 ChatGPT 创建的个性化健身计划转化为您可以在 iPhone 上查看和跟踪的锻炼。在您的许可下，ChatGPT 可以读取您同步的 Kynra 锻炼历史记录、锻炼表现、计划进度、努力评级、营养总量、水分和个人记录，以帮助定制未来的一般健康指导。每个生成的计划在生效之前都会在 Kynra 中进行审核。

LASEC vous aide à structurer et piloter votre gouvernance cyber au même endroit : analyses de risques, audits, registres, mesures de sécurité, plans d’actions et synthèses.

source_long:
LDN Travel makes getting around London simple and stress-free. Quickly view the current status of the Tube, Overground, Elizabeth Line, DLR, and Tram, see upcoming departures from any station and plan journeys between two stations with ease. source_long:
LIAM is a personal memory assistant. It saves and recalls the facts, preferences, and notes you want to keep across conversations; stores and searches your contacts; keeps multi-step recipes and routines; and logs your meals and receipts with daily nutrition and spending summaries. You can type a request or just upload a photo — a receipt, a meal, a business card, or a note — and LIAM reads it and files it in the right place automatically (a restaurant receipt is logged as both an expense and a meal). Only extracted text/values are stored, never the raw image.
Example use cases
"Remember I prefer window seats on flights — tag it 'travel'."
"Who do I know at Nova Retail?" / "Add Sarah Chen from Acme as a contact."
"Log my lunch: chicken caesar salad" → "How much protein did I have today?"
"Log this receipt: Loblaws $87.43 groceries" → "How much did I spend today?"
Upload a business-card photo → contact created; upload a receipt photo → expense + meal logged.
plugin_details.target_long:

示例用例
“记住，我更喜欢飞机上靠窗的座位——把它标记为‘旅行’。”
“我在 Nova Retail 认识谁？” /“添加 Acme 的 Sarah Chen 作为联系人。”

source_long:
Lead Recorder shows you where your leads actually came from.

It tracks every phone click, form submission and enquiry on a website and matches each one back to the exact ad, Google search or post that produced it. This plugin lets you ask about that data in plain English instead of opening a dashboard.

Three read-only tools:

List Sites returns the client websites your account can report on.

Get Quiet Sites lists sites with no leads in the last few days. Useful if you manage a lot of client sites and want to catch a problem before the client does.

Get Monthly Report returns the numbers for one site in a given month: total leads, new versus returning visitors, the split between phone clicks, forms and email enquiries, the paid, organic and direct channel breakdown, top sources and campaigns, and the percentage of leads that arrived outside business hours.

Things you can ask:

"Which of my client sites had no leads this week?"
"How did Bob's Plumbing do last month and where did the leads come from?"
"Write this month's lead report for a client using the real numbers."

It's built for marketing agencies and the businesses they work with, particularly local service businesses where the enquiry is a phone call rather than an online checkout.

You'll need a Lead Recorder account with the tracking snippet installed on at least one site. There's a free plan and installation takes about thirty seconds. Nothing in your account can be modified through this plugin.

列出网站会返回您的帐户可以报告的客户网站。

获取月度报告返回一个网站在给定月份的数字：潜在客户总数、新访问者与回访者、电话点击次数、表格和电子邮件查询之间的比例、付费渠道、自然渠道和直接渠道细分、主要来源和营销活动，以及在工作时间之外到达的潜在客户的百分比。

使用自然语言搜索超过 120,000 款 Steam 游戏 - 只需描述您要查找的内容（“舒适的农场游戏”或“具有出色配乐的挑战性 Roguelike 游戏”），然后浏览包含预告片、屏幕截图和定价的结果。

获取 Steam 评论的即时 AI 总结，将数千名玩家的意见提炼成关于哪些有效、哪些无效的清晰见解。按情绪、游戏时间和语言进行过滤。

探索对 430 万个 Roguelite 游戏评论的更深入分析，了解玩家情绪在游戏时间内的变化情况，比较热门游戏，并搜索玩家对“难度”、“多人游戏”或“可重玩性”等特定主题的实际看法。

所有数据直接来自Steam，没有网络搜索，只有真实的玩家反馈。

source_long: Lians Memory stores project facts and decisions that users explicitly choose to keep, recalls bounded context with evidence, and permanently forgets a selected memory only after confirmation. It does not increase OpenAI usage quotas or bypass rate limits.
plugin_details.target_long: Lians Memory 存储用户明确选择保留的项目事实和决策，通过证据回忆有界上下文，并仅在确认后永久忘记所选记忆。它不会增加 OpenAI 使用配额或绕过速率限制。

source_long:
Get a Liberty Mutual Insurance quote estimate with Liberty Mutual-powered tools. Enter a few details to receive customized auto quote estimates. When you’re ready to buy, you will be redirected to Liberty Mutual’s secure website to complete the application, payment, and policy issuance. After purchase, Liberty Mutual provides full customer service, claims support, and policy management. 

Liberty Mutual is a leading national property & casualty insurer offering dependable auto insurance backed by decades of financial strength and customer service. With Liberty Mutual through ChatGPT you can get a fast, personalized auto insurance quote estimate by providing only a few simple details. 

No purchase is required to get estimates. By chatting with us through ChatGPT, the personal information you provide in this chat will be subject to ChatGPT Terms of Use and Privacy Policy and may be shared with Liberty Mutual, affiliates and service providers for the purpose of providing you with an auto insurance quote estimate. Please only share the personal information requested to the questions Liberty Mutual asks for providing you with a quote estimate. Please don’t provide any additional sensitive personal information. To learn more about how Liberty Mutual processes your personal information, please see our privacy policy.
plugin_details.target_long:
使用 Liberty Mutual 支持的工具获取 Liberty Mutual Insurance 报价估算。输入一些详细信息以接收定制的自动报价估算。当您准备好购买时，您将被重定向到 Liberty Mutual 的安全网站以完成申请、付款和保单签发。购买后，Liberty Mutual 提供全面的客户服务、索赔支持和保单管理。 

Liberty Mutual 是一家领先的全国财产和意外伤害保险公司，以数十年的财务实力和客户服务为后盾，提供可靠的汽车保险。通过 ChatGPT 使用 Liberty Mutual，您只需提供一些简单的详细信息即可获得快速、个性化的汽车保险报价估算。 

无需购买即可获得估价。通过 ChatGPT 与我们聊天，您在此聊天中提供的个人信息将受 ChatGPT 使用条款和隐私政策的约束，并且可能会与 Liberty Mutual、附属公司和服务提供商共享，以便为您提供汽车保险报价估算。请仅分享利宝互助为了向您提供估价而提出的问题时所要求的个人信息。请不要提供任何额外的敏感个人信息。要了解有关 Liberty Mutual 如何处理您的个人信息的更多信息，请参阅我们的隐私政策。

source_long: LibreJustice helps users research French and European case law and retrieve legal texts as they read on a specific date. It searches decisions from French administrative, judicial, constitutional, asylum and data-protection bodies as well as European courts, with filters for court, outcome, date and cited provisions. Users can open the full text of a decision, search French legislation and curated treaties or foreign codes, retrieve an article's version history, and review their own saved activity.
plugin_details.target_long: LibreJustice 帮助用户研究法国和欧洲判例法，并检索在特定日期阅读的法律文本。它搜索法国行政、司法、宪法、庇护和数据保护机构以及欧洲法院的决定，并过滤法院、结果、日期和引用的条款。用户可以打开决定的全文，搜索法国立法和精选条约或外国法规，检索文章的版本历史记录，并查看自己保存的活动。

source_long:
LicitaLAB permite encontrar, analizar y entender compras públicas de forma rápida y estructurada.
La plataforma extrae información clave desde documentos de licitación, incluyendo requisitos técnicos, plazos, montos y criterios de evaluación, facilitando la comprensión de cada oportunidad sin necesidad de revisar archivos extensos.
Los usuarios pueden explorar oportunidades, revisar documentos asociados y tomar decisiones informadas en menos tiempo. Además, pueden hacer preguntas en lenguaje natural sobre oportunidades específicas, proveedores, compradores y sobre el uso de la plataforma.
LicitaLAB está diseñada para profesionales y organizaciones que participan en compras públicas y necesitan evaluar múltiples procesos de manera eficiente, reduciendo el tiempo de análisis y mejorando la calidad de sus ofertas.
plugin_details.target_long:
LicitaLAB 允许进行快速和结构性的公开、分析和比较。
许可文件的额外信息平台，包括技术要求、广场、评估标准和标准，有助于理解扩展档案所需的机会。
我们经常探索机会，修改协会文件并在接下来的时间里提供信息。 Además, pueden hacer preguntas en lenguaje nature sobre Oportunidades específicas, proedores, compradores y sobre el uso de la plataforma.
LicitaLAB 是专业人士和组织参与公共比较和必要评估的多个过程，以有效管理、减少分析时间和提高工作效率。

source_long: Life Analytics IAS is the integrated analysis support system from Life Analytics for research teams. This ChatGPT app lets authorized users review IAS experiment records, analysis summaries, and report context from their workspace. It is read only, returns summarized research context only, and does not provide raw file export, personal data, diagnosis, treatment decisions, or clinical advice.
plugin_details.target_long: Life Analytics IAS 是 Life Analytics 为研究团队提供的集成分析支持系统。此 ChatGPT 应用程序允许授权用户从其工作区查看 IAS 实验记录、分析摘要和报告上下文。它是只读的，仅返回总结的研究背景，不提供原始文件导出、个人数据、诊断、治疗决策或临床建议。

source_long: Life Analytics Mail helps users create email campaign drafts, manage audiences and contacts, review recipient and deliverability readiness, send test messages, schedule or cancel approved campaigns, send approved campaigns, and analyze delivery and engagement results through ChatGPT.
plugin_details.target_long: Life Analytics Mail 可帮助用户创建电子邮件活动草稿、管理受众和联系人、查看收件人和送达准备情况、发送测试消息、安排或取消批准的活动、发送批准的活动以及通过 ChatGPT 分析送达和参与结果。

source_long: Use ChatGPT to plan a real trip with Life Happens Outdoors. We run premium small group expeditions, Kilimanjaro, Everest Base Camp, Annapurna, the Dolomites, and more, with airport-to-airport support and LHO Team Leaders on every departure. Ask the app to find a trip for the dates and difficulty you have in mind, pull up a full itinerary with inclusions and what to expect at altitude, check which departures still have availability, and submit a consultation request directly to our team. You confirm every consultation inside the chat before it is sent, and you see our safety disclaimer about fitness, medical readiness, and final clearance before anything goes through. Built for explorers who want to do the thinking with ChatGPT and the trip with people who run expeditions for a living.
plugin_details.target_long: 使用 ChatGPT 与 Life Happens Outdoors 一起计划一次真正的旅行。我们在乞力马扎罗山、珠穆朗玛峰大本营、安纳普尔纳峰、多洛米蒂山等地开展优质小团体探险活动，每次出发时都会提供机场到机场的支持和 LHO 团队负责人。要求应用程序查找适合您心目中的日期和难度的行程，调出完整的行程，其中包含内容以及在海拔高度的预期，检查哪些出发班次仍然可用，然后直接向我们的团队提交咨询请求。您在发送之前在聊天中确认每项咨询，并且在任何事情进行之前您都会看到我们关于健康、医疗准备和最终许可的安全免责声明。专为想要通过 ChatGPT 思考并与以探险为生的人一起旅行的探险家而打造。

source_long: Internal life-science research workflows that help Codex interpret a user's research question, normalize the relevant entities, choose the right skills, and synthesize evidence-backed answers across public resources. The plugin spans human genetics, functional genomics, expression, pathways, protein structure, chemistry, pharmacology, literature, clinical evidence, and public study discovery, with a research-router entrypoint for broad tasks and optional subagent-assisted parallel work when evidence lanes are independent.
plugin_details.target_long: 内部生命科学研究工作流程可帮助 Codex 解释用户的研究问题、规范相关实体、选择正确的技能并跨公共资源综合有证据支持的答案。该插件涵盖人类遗传学、功能基因组学、表达、通路、蛋白质结构、化学、药理学、文献、临床证据和公共研究发现，具有用于广泛任务的研究路由器入口点，以及当证据通道独立时可选的子代理辅助并行工作。

source_long: Helps you query and interpret structured public life-science resources across human genetics, variants, expression, functional genomics, proteins, structures, pathways, chemistry, pharmacology, clinical evidence, and public omics datasets. Use focused skills for source-specific lookups or combine a small set of orthogonal databases for evidence-backed research.
plugin_details.target_long: 帮助您查询和解释人类遗传学、变异、表达、功能基因组学、蛋白质、结构、通路、化学、药理学、临床证据和公共组学数据集的结构化公共生命科学资源。使用集中技能进行特定来源的查找，或结合一小组正交数据库进行有证据支持的研究。

source_long: Helps you discover and summarize biomedical literature using PubMed publication records, PMC Open Access availability, and bioRxiv or medRxiv preprints. Use it for focused searches, citation metadata, publication linkage, and source-backed comparisons between preprints and published articles.
plugin_details.target_long: 帮助您使用 PubMed 出版记录、PMC 开放获取可用性以及 bioRxiv 或 medRxiv 预印本发现和总结生物医学文献。使用它进行重点搜索、引文元数据、出版物链接以及预印本和已发表文章之间的来源支持比较。

source_long: A guided intake, routing, and execution plugin for next-generation sequencing workflows. It helps Codex inspect local sequencing inputs, ask only the missing assay-specific questions, choose public or freely accessible runtime-installable packages where possible, check existing tool availability before any install, and execute supported local workflows with validation, logs, manifests, QC reports, and artifact indexes. It includes deeper decision skills for BCL demultiplexing, FASTQ QC execution and interpretation, germline, somatic and UMI-panel DNA variants, bulk RNA-seq count generation and differential expression, ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq/CUT&RUN/CUT&Tag, and embedded post-count scRNA-seq QC.
plugin_details.target_long: 用于下一代测序工作流程的引导式摄入、路由和执行插件。它可以帮助 Codex 检查本地测序输入，仅询问缺失的特定于检测的问题，尽可能选择公共或可免费访问的运行时安装包，在安装之前检查现有工具的可用性，并通过验证、日志、清单、QC 报告和工件索引执行支持的本地工作流程。它包括 BCL 多路分解、FASTQ QC 执行和解释、种系、体细胞和 UMI-panel DNA 变体、批量 RNA-seq 计数生成和差异表达、ATAC-seq、ChIP-seq/CUT&RUN/CUT&Tag 以及嵌入式计数后 scRNA-seq QC 等更深入的决策技能。

source_long:
Lifespace Communities helps job seekers explore open roles at Lifespace Communities. Search by job title, location, or both — the assistant surfaces relevant opportunities and lets you dig into the details before applying. 
Powered by Appcast.
plugin_details.target_long:
Lifespace 社区帮助求职者探索 Lifespace 社区的空缺职位。按职位、地点或两者进行搜索 - 助理会显示相关机会，并让您在申请前深入了解详细信息。 
由 Appcast 提供支持。

source_long:
Lifestyle Helper improves ChatGPT answers to everyday life questions by adding reliable, up-to-date, source-backed context from trusted expert materials.

When users ask about cooking, travel, entertainment, education, or psychology, the app enriches responses with relevant examples and references to real-world insights. Context is added only when it clearly improves usefulness. If no relevant sources are found, ChatGPT responds normally without external references.

Lifestyle Helper does not collect personal data and does not provide professional legal or financial advice. Any external services are recommended based only on the user’s intentions.
plugin_details.target_long:
Lifestyle Helper 通过添加来自可信专家材料的可靠、最新、有来源支持的上下文，改进了 ChatGPT 对日常生活问题的回答。

当用户询问烹饪、旅行、娱乐、教育或心理学时，该应用程序会通过相关示例和对现实世界见解的参考来丰富回答。仅当上下文明显提高实用性时才添加上下文。如果没有找到相关来源，ChatGPT 会正常响应，无需外部参考。

生活帮手不收集个人数据，也不提供专业的法律或财务建议。任何外部服务都是仅根据用户的意图推荐的。

source_long:
LiftTrack is a strength training app for Garmin users that lets you build custom workouts on your phone, sync them to your Garmin watch, and track your progress over time. It's purpose-built for weightlifters — with features like an unlimited exercise library, superset support, rest timers, RPE logging, warmup calculators, and AI-powered workout creation. If you don't have the app yet, download LiftTrack on iOS or Android at lifttrackapp.com.

Once connected, ChatGPT can access your real workout templates and completed sessions, so you stay in one chat while your data does the work.

Goals you can accomplish

Plan your week — Ask "What did I do last week?" or "What's in my Push template?" and get answers from your actual workouts and templates so ChatGPT can suggest what to do next.

Stay on program — Have ChatGPT remind you what's in a given workout, what weight and sets you did last time, or what you're supposed to do today.

Review and adjust — Ask for summaries by week or month ("How many sessions did I do?" "How did my squat progress?") and use that to adjust volume or intensity.
plugin_details.target_long:
LiftTrack 是一款面向 Garmin 用户的力量训练应用程序，可让您在手机上构建自定义锻炼，将其同步到您的 Garmin 手表，并跟踪一段时间内的进度。它专为举重运动员打造，具有无限练习库、超级组支持、休息计时器、RPE 记录、热身计算器和人工智能驱动的锻炼创建等功能。如果您还没有该应用程序，请访问 lifttrackapp.com 下载 iOS 或 Android 版 LiftTrack。

连接后，ChatGPT 可以访问您真实的锻炼模板和已完成的训练，因此您可以在数据完成工作时保持在一个聊天中。

您可以实现的目标

计划你的一周——问“我上周做了什么？”或“我的推送模板中有什么？”并从您的实际锻炼和模板中获取答案，以便 ChatGPT 可以建议下一步该做什么。

坚持计划 — 让 ChatGPT 提醒您特定锻炼的内容、您上次的重量和组数，或者您今天应该做什么。

回顾和调整——要求按周或按月进行总结（“我做了多少次训练？”“我的深蹲进展如何？”）并用它来调整训练量或强度。

source_long:
Liftosaur is a scriptable workout app. It uses language "Liftoscript" to define workouts. The plugin lets users to write and manage Liftoscript programs, workout history, exercises, gym equipment, measurements, etc.

Free reference tools provide Liftoscript syntax, examples, program design guidance, built-in programs, and exercise names.

Private account tools require the user to authenticate with Liftosaur and have an active subscription before reading or changing programs, history, gyms, equipment, exercise settings, or measurements.
plugin_details.target_long:
Liftosaur 是一款可编写脚本的锻炼应用程序。它使用语言“Liftoscript”来定义锻炼。该插件允许用户编写和管理 Liftoscript 程序、锻炼历史、练习、健身器材、测量等。

免费参考工具提供 Liftoscript 语法、示例、程序设计指南、内置程序和练习名称。

私人帐户工具要求用户在阅读或更改程序、历史记录、健身房、设备、锻炼设置或测量结果之前通过 Liftosaur 进行身份验证并拥有有效订阅。

source_long:
Lightbringer helps technology companies manage the patent process end to end, combining an AI-native platform with patent professionals. The service covers invention capture, patent application drafting and filing, and prosecution through grant.

The Lightbringer plugin connects ChatGPT to your private organisation workspace. Use it to create and improve invention disclosures, get structured feedback on clarity and completeness, search and summarise inventions and patent documents, and review, comment on, and respond to work with your patent team.

Try questions like:
“Turn my notes about adaptive cooling fins into an invention disclosure”
“Check invention FIN0012 for gaps before I submit it”
“Find and summarise our patent application for adaptive fins”
“Show the reviews awaiting my response and help me act on them”
plugin_details.target_long:
Lightbringer 将人工智能原生平台与专利专业人员相结合，帮助科技公司端到端管理专利流程。该服务涵盖发明捕获、专利申请起草和提交以及通过授权进行起诉。

Lightbringer 插件将 ChatGPT 连接到您的私人组织工作区。使用它来创建和改进发明披露，获得有关清晰度和完整性的结构化反馈，搜索和总结发明和专利文件，以及审查、评论和回应与您的专利团队的合作。

尝试提出以下问题：
“将我关于自适应散热片的笔记变成一项发明披露”
“在提交之前检查发明 FIN0012 是否存在缺陷”
“查找并总结我们的自适应鳍专利申请”
“显示等待我回复的评论并帮助我采取行动”

source_long: Manage Lightmeter outbound campaign workspaces from ChatGPT, including campaigns, leads, email sequences, campaign creative drafts and approvals, Unibox replies, performance analytics, and deliverability insights.
plugin_details.target_long: 从 ChatGPT 管理 Lightmeter 出站营销活动工作区，包括营销活动、潜在客户、电子邮件序列、营销活动创意草稿和批准、Unibox 回复、绩效分析和交付能力见解。

source_long: Lightning Leads connects ChatGPT to field-sales workflows so users can understand the app, check onboarding progress, get coaching context, review route and performance context, prepare for appointments, append confirmed lead notes, and mark confirmed leads for follow-up through the Lightning Leads backend.
plugin_details.target_long: Lightning Leads 将 ChatGPT 连接到现场销售工作流程，以便用户可以了解应用程序、检查入职进度、获取辅导背景、查看路线和绩效背景、准备预约、附加已确认的潜在客户备注，并通过 Lightning Leads 后端标记已确认的潜在客户以进行后续跟进。

source_long: Lily Apple Ads connects ChatGPT to Apple Ads performance and keyword-level revenue attribution (RevenueCat, AppsFlyer, and more). Inspect apps, accounts, campaigns, ad groups, keywords, ROAS, and revenue by keyword. Diagnose recent performance, generate optimization plans, review campaign changes, and apply Apple Ads updates only after your confirmation.
plugin_details.target_long: Lily Apple Ads 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Apple Ads 效果和关键字级收入归因（RevenueCat、AppsFlyer 等）。按关键字检查应用程序、帐户、广告系列、广告组、关键字、ROAS 和收入。仅在您确认后才能诊断近期效果、生成优化计划、审查广告系列更改以及应用 Apple Ads 更新。

source_long: Limodia Marketplace helps users find and compare luxury chauffeur and car service operators in US cities, including verified route quotes when pickup and dropoff are provided. It returns links to operators' booking pages after the user supplies a pickup time.
plugin_details.target_long: Limodia Marketplace 帮助用户查找和比较美国城市的豪华司机和汽车服务运营商，包括提供接送服务时经过验证的路线报价。在用户提供接载时间后，它会返回运营商预订页面的链接。

source_long: Manage issues, projects, and team workflows in Linear from Codex.
plugin_details.target_long: 在 Codex 的 Linear 中管理问题、项目和团队工作流程。

source_long: Lingard Vocab brings ChatGPT into the Lingard way of learning: reading and listening to content you actually enjoy. Instead of studying disconnected flashcards, you can ask ChatGPT to build vocabulary around the real things you want to understand: books, articles, podcasts, movie and TV plots, travel plans, work topics, and everyday situations. Lingard Vocab can save polished study cards straight to your Lingard library with translations, pronunciation, part of speech, synonyms, grammar details, highlighted example sentences, and language-specific details such as German noun articles. Then you continue learning in Lingard with instant lookup, contextual translation, audio, spaced repetition, progress tracking, and sync across your devices. The app connects through scoped OAuth and only reads or updates your Lingard vocabulary when you ask.
plugin_details.target_long: Lingard Vocab 将 ChatGPT 带入 Lingard 学习方式：阅读和聆听您真正喜欢的内容。您可以要求 ChatGPT 围绕您想要理解的真实事物建立词汇表，而不是学习断开连接的抽认卡：书籍、文章、播客、电影和电视情节、旅行计划、工作主题和日常情况。 Lingard Vocab 可以将精美的学习卡直接保存到您的 Lingard 库中，其中包含翻译、发音、词性、同义词、语法详细信息、突出显示的例句以及特定于语言的详细信息（例如德语名词文章）。然后，您可以通过即时查找、上下文翻译、音频、间隔重复、进度跟踪和跨设备同步继续在 Lingard 中学习。该应用程序通过范围内的 OAuth 进行连接，并且仅在您询问时读取或更新您的 Lingard 词汇表。

source_long: LingoStar helps learners manage language learning tracks, change settings conversationally, and practice language information, listening, reading, writing, and speaking inside ChatGPT, using ChatGPT's intelligence.
plugin_details.target_long: LingoStar 利用 ChatGPT 的智能，帮助学习者在 ChatGPT 内管理语言学习轨迹、以对话方式更改设置以及练习语言信息、听、读、写和口语。

source_long: Linked Word looks up King James passages, Strong's Hebrew and Greek numbers, English-to-Strong's reverse lookups, verses that use a number, and KJV full-text search. Passage results are the text plus a citation URL unless Strong's word links are requested.

Tell the app your current headline, who you help, and one credential. That is all it needs. No account, no signup, nothing to install. Paste the version you like straight into LinkedIn.

source_long:
Lott Immobilien is a modern real estate company specializing in the region stretching from Leer through Augustfehn to Oldenburg. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in northwestern Germany.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, plots of land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to view a property's location, nearby infrastructure, and surrounding neighborhood at a glance, making the property search process simpler and more efficient.

With extensive local market expertise and personalized advice, Lott Immobilien combines innovative digital solutions with many years of experience in the regional real estate market.

Key Benefits
Interactive property search with a modern map-based interface
Faster navigation across the region from Leer through Augustfehn to Oldenburg
Better understanding of property locations, infrastructure, and neighborhoods
Focus on carefully selected residential and investment properties in the region
Easier comparison of different cities and municipalities
More efficient property searches through visual navigation
Direct access to experienced real estate professionals
Modern, user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for a detached family home in Leer, a condominium in Oldenburg, a property in Augustfehn, or an attractive investment opportunity in the region, Lott Immobilien offers a modern, transparent, and convenient way to access the regional real estate market.

凭借丰富的本地市场专业知识和个性化建议，Lott Immobilien 将创新的数字解决方案与区域房地产市场的多年经验相结合。

主要优点
使用基于地图的现代界面进行交互式财产搜索
从莱尔 (Leer) 经奥古斯特费恩 (Augustfehn) 到奥尔登堡 (Oldenburg) 的整个地区的导航速度更快
更好地了解房产位置、基础设施和社区

source_long:
Turn any topic into study-ready materials directly from ChatGPT. Lurna helps you generate interactive flashcard decks you can flip through in chat, plus structured Markdown study notes in a clean reader view. Review key concepts faster, then export decks and notes to app.lurna.co to keep learning with spaced repetition — making serious review a native part of your AI-study workflow.

You can use Lurna app to:

1. Exam prep — flashcards from a lecture topic
Use case: Turn a subject you’re studying into an interactive flashcard deck you can review in chat, then export to Lurna for spaced repetition.
Example prompt: “Create flashcards for my biology midterm on photosynthesis — cover the light reactions, Calvin cycle, and how ATP and NADPH are used. About 15 cards, exam-level.”

2. Deep-dive study notes from a conversation
Use case: After discussing a complex topic with AI, turn the explanation into structured, readable study notes with headings, tables, and summaries
Example prompt: “Write study notes on the causes and consequences of the 2008 financial crisis. Include key terms, a timeline, and a short summary I can review before class.”

3. Learn from uploaded materials — notes + flashcards
Use case: Upload readings, slides, or your own notes and convert them into study materials without reformatting by hand.
Example prompt: “Here are my uploaded lecture notes on CRISPR Cas9. First generate study notes, then create a flashcard set covering the most testable concepts.”

4. Quick review before an interview or certification
Use case: Rapidly build recall-focused flashcards for technical interviews, certifications, or vocabulary.
Example prompt: “Generate flashcards to help me prep for a AWS Solutions Architect interview — focus on S3, IAM, VPC, and common architecture tradeoffs.”
plugin_details.target_long:
直接从 ChatGPT 将任何主题转变为可供学习的材料。 Lurna 帮助您生成可在聊天中翻阅的交互式抽认卡组，以及在干净的读者视图中构建的结构化 Markdown 学习笔记。更快地复习关键概念，然后将卡片组和笔记导出到 app.lurna.co，以通过间隔重复来保持学习 - 让认真的复习成为人工智能学习工作流程的一部分。

您可以使用 Lurna 应用程序来：

1. 考试准备——讲座主题的抽认卡
使用案例：将您正在学习的主题变成交互式抽认卡，您可以在聊天中查看，然后导出到 Lurna 进行间隔重复。
示例提示：“为我的生物学期中考试制作有关光合作用的抽认卡，涵盖光反应、卡尔文循环以及如何使用 ATP 和 NADPH。大约 15 张卡片，考试级别。”

2. 对话中的深入学习笔记
用例：在与 AI 讨论复杂的主题后，将解释转化为带有标题、表格和摘要的结构化、可读的学习笔记
示例提示：“写关于 2008 年金融危机的原因和后果的学习笔记。包括关键术语、时间表和我可以在课前复习的简短摘要。”

3. 从上传的材料中学习——笔记+抽认卡
使用案例：上传阅读材料、幻灯片或您自己的笔记，并将其转换为学习材料，而无需手动重新格式化。
示例提示：“这是我上传的关于 CRISPR Cas9 的讲义。首先生成学习笔记，然后创建涵盖最可测试概念的抽认卡集。”

4. 面试或认证前快速审查
使用案例：快速构建用于技术面试、认证或词汇的以回忆为重点的抽认卡。
示例提示：“生成抽认卡以帮助我准备 AWS 解决方案架构师面试 - 重点关注 S3、IAM、VPC 和常见架构权衡。”

plugin_details.target_long:
MT Newswires 将实时全球金融新闻直接引入 Codex，提供 180 多个主题的资本市场和经济体的原创、公正和全面的多资产类别报道。

source_long:
Magnus is an analytics platform for mobile and web app publishers. It aggregates marketing spend from ad networks, subscription and in-app revenue, ad-network monetization, payment-provider outcomes and first-party product-analytics events into one place, so a publisher can ask how a campaign, an app or an experiment is actually performing.

Over MCP the app exposes that data read-only. Three tools answer questions: marketing_timeline_report for acquisition and monetization performance (installs, spend, revenue, ROMI, forecasts), finances_risk_report and finances_risk_approval_rates for payment risk (approval rate, refunds, fraud alerts, disputes, chargebacks). A second group answers product-analytics questions from the publisher's own SDK events: event counts, funnels, retention, user-property segments and A/B experiment configuration. Everything else is a lookup helper that exists to feed those tools with real ids, filter values and metric definitions, because app ids, event names and metric semantics are account-specific and cannot be guessed.

Access is scoped to the companies the signed-in user is an active member of, and that membership is re-checked on every single call, so the model can never reach another tenant's data. The OAuth scope the app requests, mcp:analytics.read, grants read access only: no tool in the server can create, update or delete anything.
plugin_details.target_long:
Magnus 是一个面向移动和网络应用程序发行商的分析平台。它将来自广告网络、订阅和应用内收入、广告网络货币化、支付提供商结果和第一方产品分析事件的营销支出聚合到一个地方，因此发布商可以询问广告系列、应用程序或实验的实际执行情况。

通过 MCP，应用程序以只读方式公开该数据。三个工具可以回答问题：marketing_timeline_report 用于获取和货币化绩效（安装、支出、收入、ROMI、预测），finances_risk_report 和 Finances_risk_approval_rates 用于支付风险（批准率、退款、欺诈警报、争议、退款）。第二组回答发布商自己的 SDK 事件中的产品分析问题：事件计数、渠道、留存率、用户属性细分和 A/B 实验配置。其他一切都是一个查找助手，它的存在是为了向这些工具提供真实的 ID、过滤器值和指标定义，因为应用程序 ID、事件名称和指标语义是特定于帐户的并且无法猜测。

访问范围仅限于登录用户所属的公司，并且每次调用都会重新检查该成员资格，因此该模型永远无法访问其他租户的数据。应用程序请求的 OAuth 范围 mcp:analytics.read 仅授予读取访问权限：服务器中的任何工具都无法创建、更新或删除任何内容。

source_long:
Medeloop Grants helps researchers and program teams move from “What should we apply for?” to a credible first draft without switching tools or starting from scratch.
Inside ChatGPT, it combines curated grant data, your professional context, and purpose-built drafting workflows into a single experience. You can ask for relevant funding opportunities, quickly understand whether you’re a good fit, and begin drafting a proposal in the same conversation.
What makes it useful in practice is how the pieces connect. Instead of returning a long list of generic results, Medeloop matches grants to your background and research focus, helping you prioritize opportunities that are actually feasible. It also surfaces key constraints like eligibility and deadlines early, so you spend less time chasing grants that are unlikely to work.
When you’re ready to write, the platform guides you through structured inputs and generates a solid first-pass draft that you can refine. The drafting process builds on the same context used for discovery, so you don’t have to repeat yourself or reframe your work each time.
People tend to value Medeloop Grants because it reduces the overhead around grant work. It helps them focus on the substance of their research instead of navigating fragmented tools, reformatting information, or second-guessing fit. Over time, as it learns from your inputs and past work, it becomes more tailored to how you search and write.
The result is a more continuous workflow from discovery to draft, with less friction and fewer wasted cycles.
plugin_details.target_long:
Medeloop Grants 帮助研究人员和项目团队摆脱“我们应该申请什么？”的问题。无需切换工具或从头开始即可获得可信的初稿。
在 ChatGPT 内部，它将精心策划的资助数据、您的专业背景和专门构建的起草工作流程整合为单一体验。您可以请求相关的资助机会，快速了解您是否适合，并在同一次对话中开始起草提案。
它在实践中的有用之处在于各个部分的连接方式。 Medeloop 不会返回一长串通用结果，而是将资助与您的背景和研究重点相匹配，帮助您优先考虑实际可行的机会。它还会尽早暴露资格和截止日期等关键限制，因此您可以花更少的时间去追逐不太可能起作用的资助。
当您准备好写作时，该平台会指导您完成结构化输入并生成可供您完善的可靠的初稿。起草过程建立在用于发现的相同上下文之上，因此您不必每次都重复自己或重新构建您的工作。
人们倾向于重视 Medeloop 资助，因为它减少了资助工作的管理费用。它帮助他们专注于研究的实质内容，而不是使用支离破碎的工具、重新格式化信息或事后猜测是否合适。随着时间的推移，当它从您的输入和过去的工作中学习时，它会变得更加适合您的搜索和写作方式。
其结果是从发现到草稿的工作流程更加连续，摩擦更少，浪费的周期也更少。

source_long:
Metronome

Need a steady beat? This metronome is ready to help. Pick a speed, press start, and follow the click. It is made for music practice that is easy, clear, and fun.

You can use it for almost any instrument. Play piano, guitar, drums, violin, bass, ukulele, flute, trumpet, saxophone, cello, or any other instrument. You can also use it for singing, dancing, clapping, marching, or learning rhythm. If you want to stay on the beat, this metronome can help.

Choose your tempo in BPM, which means beats per minute. Want to play slowly? Pick a low number. Want to play fast? Pick a high number. You are in control. Change the speed whenever you want until it feels just right.

If you do not know the BPM you need, use tap tempo. Tap along with the beat you hear in your head. The metronome will help find the speed for you. It is quick, simple, and useful.

Practice one step at a time. Start slow so your hands learn the notes. When you can play without mistakes, make the tempo a little faster. Keep doing this until you reach your goal. Small steps help you get better.

A steady beat is one of the best ways to improve. It helps your timing, rhythm, and confidence. It also helps you play with other people because everyone follows the same beat.

This metronome works well for beginners, students, teachers, hobby players, and professional musicians. It is useful during lessons, rehearsals, warm-ups, concerts, and daily practice. Whether you play for five minutes or five hours, a steady beat makes practice more helpful.

Use it to learn new songs. Use it to fix hard parts. Use it to build speed without rushing. Use it to make tricky rhythms easier to understand. You can even use it to keep a steady pace while reading music or practicing scales, chords, arpeggios, and exercises.

Different songs need different speeds. A slow ballad feels different from a fast rock song. Classical music, jazz, pop, folk, blues, country, hip-hop, and many other styles all use tempo. Finding the right BPM helps music sound the way it should.

Teachers can use this metronome in class. Students can use it at home. Bands can use it during rehearsal. Choirs can practice together. Drum lines can stay together. Solo musicians can improve their timing. Anyone who wants a steady beat can use it.

If you are learning rhythm, ask questions. If you are not sure what BPM to use, ask for help. If you want practice ideas, ask. You can also ask about note values, rests, counting, time signatures, subdivisions, swing feel, accents, or ways to practice difficult rhythms. Simple answers make learning easier.

Try setting small goals. Play one line correctly three times. Raise the BPM by a few beats. Repeat until you reach your target speed. Slow practice is not weak practice. It is smart practice.

Remember to relax while you play. Breathe normally. Keep good posture. Listen carefully to every click. Try to match each note to the beat instead of chasing it. Good timing comes from careful listening and steady practice.

This metronome is designed to be simple. You do not need special music knowledge to begin. Just choose a tempo, start the beat, and play. You can change the speed whenever you need. The goal is to make practice easier, clearer, and more enjoyable.

Whether you are learning your first song, preparing for an audition, practicing with a band, getting ready for a concert, or simply working on better rhythm, this metronome is here to help. Keep the beat. Stay steady. Practice a little every day. Small improvements grow into big results, and every beat brings you one step closer to becoming a stronger, more confident musician.
plugin_details.target_long:
节拍器

需要稳定的节拍吗？这个节拍器随时可以提供帮助。选择一个速度，按开始，然后按照点击键操作。它专为简单、清晰且有趣的音乐练习而设计。

您几乎可以将它用于任何乐器。演奏钢琴、吉他、鼓、小提琴、贝斯、四弦琴、长笛、小号、萨克斯管、大提琴或任何其他乐器。您还可以用它来唱歌、跳舞、拍手、行进或学习节奏。如果您想保持节拍，这个节拍器可以提供帮助。

选择 BPM 节奏，即每分钟节拍数。想慢慢玩吗？选择一个较低的数字。想玩得快吗？选择一个高的数字。你一切尽在掌握。随时改变速度，直到感觉合适为止。

如果您不知道所需的 BPM，请使用敲击速度。随着您在脑海中听到的节拍进行敲击。节拍器将帮助您找到速度。它快速、简单且有用。

一次练习一步。慢慢开始，这样你的手就能记住音符。当你可以不犯错误地弹奏时，把节奏调快一点。继续这样做，直到达到目标。小步骤可以帮助您变得更好。

稳定的节拍是提高水平的最佳方法之一。它有助于你的节奏、节奏和信心。它还可以帮助您与其他人一起玩，因为每个人都遵循相同的节奏。

这款节拍器非常适合初学者、学生、教师、业余爱好者和专业音乐家。它在课程、排练、热身、音乐会和日常练习中非常有用。无论您弹奏五分钟还是五个小时，稳定的节奏都会让练习更有帮助。

用它来学习新歌曲。用它来固定坚硬的零件。用它来提高速度而不着急。使用它可以使棘手的节奏更容易理解。您甚至可以用它来在阅读乐谱或练习音阶、和弦、琶音和练习时保持稳定的节奏。

不同的歌曲需要不同的速度。慢节奏的民谣与快节奏的摇滚歌曲感觉不同。古典音乐、爵士乐、流行音乐、民谣、蓝调、乡村音乐、嘻哈音乐和许多其他风格都使用节奏。找到正确的 BPM 有助于音乐听起来应有的样子。

教师可以在课堂上使用该节拍器。学生可以在家使用。乐队可以在排练时使用它。合唱团可以一起练习。鼓线可以保持在一起。独奏音乐家可以改善他们的节奏。任何想要稳定节奏的人都可以使用它。

如果您正在学习节奏，请提出问题。如果您不确定使用什么 BPM，请寻求帮助。如果您想要实践想法，请询问。您还可以询问音符值、休止符、计数、拍号、细分、摇摆感觉、重音或练习困难节奏的方法。简单的答案让学习变得更容易。

尝试设定小目标。一首诗正确弹奏三遍。将 BPM 提高几个节拍。重复直到达到目标速度。慢练并不是弱练。这是明智的做法。

记得玩的时候要放松。正常呼吸。保持良好的姿势。仔细聆听每一次点击。尝试使每个音符与节拍相匹配，而不是追逐它。好的时机来自于仔细的聆听和扎实的练习。

该节拍器设计得很简单。您无需具备特殊的音乐知识即可开始。只需选择一个节奏，开始节奏，然后演奏。您可以随时更改速度。我们的目标是让练习变得更容易、更清晰、更愉快。

无论您是在学习第一首歌、准备试镜、与乐队练习、准备音乐会，还是只是想掌握更好的节奏，这款节拍器都可以为您提供帮助。保持节拍。保持稳定。每天练习一点。小进步会变成大成果，每一个节拍都会让您更接近成为一名更强大、更自信的音乐家。

Speed up product development from ideation to launch. Align teams, break tool silos, and ship what customers need in one AI-powered visual platform.

Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Miro to summarize existing boards or build new ones from scratch. Run sharper workshops, sprint planning, and product strategy sessions with ChatGPT or Codex. Generate layouts, frames, sticky notes, images, docs, diagrams, tables, and more.

Key use cases: 
- Summarize and search boards: Drop a board URL into ChatGPT or Codex to pull out themes, decisions, and open questions from retros, planning sessions, and strategy maps. Search across every board you have access to.
- Build new boards from scratch: Generate ready-to-run layouts for retros, sprint planning, and product strategy with frames, sticky notes, cards, tables, docs, and images
- Bring research onto the canvas: Have  ChatGPT or Codex research a topic — competitors, user feedback, market trends, prior art — and lay the findings out on a fresh board as diagrams, sticky notes, tables, docs, and images, ready to share with your team.
- Visualize complex ideas: Turn a prompt, PR, or spec into architecture, sequence-flow, ERD, or user-journey diagrams directly on the canvas
- Act on feedback agentically: Read and resolve comments, reply in-thread, and convert scattered team discussion into a clear list of action items right on the board.
plugin_details.target_long:
加快产品开发从构思到发布的速度。在一个人工智能驱动的可视化平台中协调团队、打破工具孤岛并交付客户所需的内容。

将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到 Miro 以总结现有板或从头开始构建新板。使用 ChatGPT 或 Codex 举办更清晰的研讨会、冲刺计划和产品策略会议。生成布局、框架、便签、图像、文档、图表、表格等。

关键用例： 
- 总结和搜索看板：将看板 URL 放入 ChatGPT 或 Codex 中，以从回顾、规划会议和战略地图中提取主题、决策和开放问题。搜索您有权访问的每个面板。
- 从头开始构建新看板：使用框架、便签、卡片、表格、文档和图像生成用于回顾、冲刺计划和产品策略的可立即运行的布局
- 将研究成果带到画布上：让 ChatGPT 或 Codex 研究一个主题 - 竞争对手、用户反馈、市场趋势、现有技术 - 并将研究结果以图表、便利贴、表格、文档和图像的形式放在新的板上，准备与您的团队分享。
- 可视化复杂的想法：直接在画布上将提示、PR 或规范转化为架构、序列流、ERD 或用户旅程图
- 代理地根据反馈采取行动：阅读并解决评论，在线程中回复，并将分散的团队讨论转化为看板上清晰的行动项目列表。

source_long:
Extract design from any website

MiroMiro lets you pull real design data out of any live website from ChatGPT: brand colors, fonts, logos, design tokens, images, SVGs, and Lottie animations, plus production-ready code rebuilt from actual page sections. Everything comes from the site's real CSS and assets, not screenshots or guesses.

Use it to match a brand, rebuild a section you like, or collect assets for a moodboard, then drop the output straight into your project.

What you can do:

-Extract a complete brand profile from any URL: color palette with roles, fonts, logo and favicon URLs, social profiles, and theme
-Pull a site's design token system (colors, spacing, radii, shadows, typography) as CSS variables or a Tailwind config
-Turn any page section into clean React, Vue, or HTML with Tailwind classes
-List every font a site loads with file URLs, formats, and the CSS stack to replicate it
-Collect all SVG logos and icons as paste-ready code and direct file URLs
-Gather a page's image assets grouped by source (img, srcset, picture, background, favicon, social image) with direct URLs
-Find Lottie animations on a page and get their JSON files

Best for developers, designers, and AI builders who need real design data from live sites instead of eyeballing it.
plugin_details.target_long:
从任何网站提取设计

MiroMiro 可让您从 ChatGPT 的任何实时网站中提取真实的设计数据：品牌颜色、字体、徽标、设计令牌、图像、SVG 和 Lottie 动画，以及从实际页面部分重建的生产就绪代码。一切都来自网站的真实 CSS 和资源，而不是屏幕截图或猜测。

使用它来匹配品牌、重建您喜欢的部分或收集情绪板的资源，然后将输出直接放入您的项目中。

你可以做什么：

-从任何 URL 中提取完整的品牌资料：包含角色、字体、徽标和网站图标 URL、社交资料和主题的调色板
- 将站点的设计标记系统（颜色、间距、半径、阴影、版式）拉为 CSS 变量或 Tailwind 配置
- 使用 Tailwind 类将任何页面部分转换为干净的 React、Vue 或 HTML
-列出网站加载的每种字体以及文件 URL、格式和用于复制它的 CSS 堆栈
- 收集所有 SVG 徽标和图标作为可粘贴代码和直接文件 URL
- 使用直接 URL 收集按源（img、srcset、图片、背景、favicon、社交图像）分组的页面图像资源
- 在页面上查找 Lottie 动画并获取其 JSON 文件

最适合需要来自现场站点的真实设计数据而不是目测数据的开发人员、设计师和人工智能构建者。

source_long: Mnemom is trust infrastructure built for agents, not just the humans who run them. In one chat you can look up an agent's Continuous Trust Rating — the score, the grade, and the accountability evidence behind it — and confirm it's cryptographically signed, not merely asserted. Drop your own alignment card and get an instant trust read back; claim a verifiable identity with no human in the loop; and walk away with an embeddable Trust Rating badge for your README or agent card. Every read is honest about what it knows: a quiet record reads as quiet, never as a red flag. The system tells the truth — and view-source proves it.
plugin_details.target_long: Mnemom 是为代理构建的信任基础设施，而不仅仅是为运行它们的人构建的。在一次聊天中，您可以查找代理的持续信任评级（分数、等级及其背后的责任证据），并确认它是经过加密签名的，而不仅仅是断言的。放下您自己的校准卡并立即获得信任回读；声明可验证的身份，且无人参与；并在您的自述文件或代理卡上获得可嵌入的信任评级徽章。每一次阅读都诚实地表达了它所知道的内容：安静的记录读起来就像安静的，永远不会像危险信号一样。系统说的是事实——查看源代码也证明了这一点。

source_long: Moknah turns text and documents into natural-sounding speech and complete audiobooks, with especially strong support for Arabic alongside many other languages. Through the Mondoir.art app, users can explore curated artworks, learn about artists and collections, and access contextual information about artworks, valuation, provenance, and editions. The platform is designed to make the art world easier to navigate by organizing information that is often fragmented across galleries, marketplaces, and social platforms.

Collectors can use the app to research artworks, track editions, and explore how contemporary art is presented and documented. Artists and galleries can present their work in a structured environment that supports discovery and documentation.

By integrating with ChatGPT, the Mondoir.art app allows users to ask questions about artists, artworks, exhibitions, and collecting — turning complex art information into clear and accessible conversations.

source_long: Monoblend AI Barista matches a user's described taste to the six-coffee Monoblend specialty lineup and then supports the practical steps that follow. From a description such as chocolatey and low-acid, bright and fruity, a gift, or decaf for the evening, it returns a Safe, a Curious and a Wild pick with a match score and the reason each one fits, and refines those picks from plain feedback like 'too sour' or 'I want it fuller'. Beyond matching, it generates brewing recipes tuned per method and per bean, pairs coffee with a described dish or a photo of a plate, diagnoses a cup that came out bitter, sour or watery, compares two beans side by side, builds a guided tasting flight for guests and gifts, and explains acidity, body, roast and processing in plain language. The app is informational only: it does not sell coffee, display prices, take orders or report stock, and it declines rather than inventing commercial or store details it does not hold.
plugin_details.target_long: Monoblend AI Barista 将用户描述的口味与六种咖啡的 Monoblend 特色产品系列相匹配，然后支持后续的实际步骤。从巧克力味和低酸度、明亮的果味、礼物或晚上的无咖啡因咖啡等描述中，它会返回一个安全、一个好奇和一个狂野的选择，并附上匹配分数和每个选择的理由，并根据“太酸”或“我想要更饱满”等简单反馈来完善这些选择。除了匹配之外，它还可以根据方法和咖啡豆生成调整的冲泡配方，将咖啡与所描述的菜肴或盘子的照片搭配，诊断一杯咖啡的苦味、酸味或水样，并排比较两种咖啡豆，为客人和礼物构建引导品尝之旅，并用简单的语言解释酸度、醇度、烘焙和加工过程。该应用程序仅供参考：它不销售咖啡、显示价格、接受订单或报告库存，并且它会拒绝，而不是发明它不掌握的商业或商店详细信息。

source_long:
Moody's Credit MCP powers AI applications and analytics workflows with GenAI-ready data and research needed for comprehensive credit analysis.

Moody's Credit MCP provides a unified layer across core credit data categories commonly used in risk assessment, offering financial analysis, default risk metrics, and qualitative insights. It combines comprehensive entity information, such as financials, ownership, and management, with Moody's Ratings proprietary ratings and research, and probability of default metrics, all enhanced by unstructured data like company filings, earnings transcripts, news, and macroeconomic trends.

By bringing structured and unstructured credit inputs together in a single interface, Moody's Credit MCP enables faster data-to-insight workflows, supporting more rigorous, consistent credit assessment and continuous monitoring of entities, markets, and portfolios.

Data includes:
- Global entity firmographics and identifiers
- Entity hierarchies and ownership structures
- Detailed global entity financials
- Moody's Ratings credit ratings and research
- Expected default frequency
- Economic data and research
- News and media
- Annual reports

Use Moody's Credit MCP for:
- Credit Analysis - access comprehensive credit risk data and research to assess creditworthiness and compare risk across issuers and instruments
- Risk Management - monitor credit risk through forward-looking measures and scenario analysis
- Relationship Management - quickly evaluate credit health to support informed engagement and credit structuring
- Ratings Advisory - align issuer details with ratings methodologies and peer benchmarks
- Investment Research - get data-driven assessments to evaluate relative value and risk
- Market Analysis - analyze sector trends and credit risk signals to assess broader market conditions

source_long:
Finding a movie should be easy. This ChatGPT app helps you discover, explore, and learn about movies without leaving your conversation. Ask about almost any movie and get clear information in one place. Whether you already know what you want or just want ideas for movie night, this app makes it simple. Instead of opening many websites and searching over and over, you can ask in plain words and keep chatting. It feels natural, fast, and fun.

Once you find a movie, you can learn more about it. See the story, the main cast, the director, the release year, the running time, and other helpful details. Learn who plays each character. Find out what other movies an actor has been in. Explore the work of a director. Jump from one movie to another without starting a new search.

The app is great for quick questions too. See when a movie came out. See who stars in it. See who directed it. See how long it is. See what it is about before you decide to watch it. Everything stays inside your chat, making it easy to keep exploring.

If you enjoy learning about film, this app is a fun way to discover connections. See actors in different movies. See famous directors. Find movie series and collections. Compare different films. Learn about old classics and brand-new releases. Every question can lead to another interesting discovery.

The app works well for casual movie fans and people who love films. You do not need to know movie trivia or remember exact names. Just ask naturally. The conversation keeps going, so you can ask follow-up questions without repeating yourself. That makes exploring movies feel smooth and simple.

Everything is designed to help you spend less time searching and more time enjoying movies. Instead of jumping between pages, you can browse, discover, compare, and learn in one place. It is an easy way to explore the world of film through natural conversation.

Whether you want your next favorite movie, information about a classic, details about a new release, or help remembering a film from years ago, this ChatGPT app is ready to help. Ask simple questions, explore deeper, and enjoy discovering movies one conversation at a time.
plugin_details.target_long:

一旦找到一部电影，您就可以了解更多信息。查看故事、主要演员、导演、发行年份、运行时间和其他有用的详细信息。了解每个角色的扮演者。了解演员还出演过哪些其他电影。探索导演的作品。从一部电影跳到另一部电影，无需开始新的搜索。

该应用程序也非常适合快速提问。看看电影什么时候上映。看看都有哪些明星出演。看看是谁导演的。看看它有多长。在决定观看之前先了解一下它的内容。所有内容都保留在您的聊天中，让您可以轻松地继续探索。

如果您喜欢学习电影，这个应用程序是发现联系的有趣方式。查看不同电影中的演员。见著名导演。查找电影系列和收藏。比较不同的电影。了解旧经典和全新版本。每个问题都可以带来另一个有趣的发现。

该应用程序非常适合休闲电影迷和电影爱好者。您不需要了解电影琐事或记住确切的名字。就自然地问吧。对话会继续进行，因此您可以提出后续问题而不必重复自己。这使得探索电影变得顺畅而简单。

一切都是为了帮助您花更少的时间搜索，而有更多的时间欣赏电影。您无需在页面之间跳转，而是可以在一个地方浏览、发现、比较和学习。这是通过自然对话探索电影世界的简单方法。

source_long:
Music Block turns ChatGPT’s music-theory answers into real, engraved sheet music instead of ASCII text.

Ask for licks, scale fingerings, arpeggios, chord voicings or exercises — “give me 5 licks in melodic minor over B7alt”, “show me four ways to resolve B7alt into Em” — and Music Block renders each example as standard notation with guitar tablature underneath, directly in the conversation.

Every example is interactive: press play to hear it (MIDI synthesis with a real instrument sound), slow it down or speed it up from 50% to 150% without changing pitch, switch between examples, and copy the underlying alphaTex source into your own tools.

Music Block understands guitar-specific technique markings: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, half- and full-step bends, vibrato, palm muting and let-ring, plus time signatures from 4/4 to 12/8, rests, dotted rhythms and chords.

It is built for learning and teaching: short, original musical examples composed by ChatGPT in your conversation. It does not look up or reproduce copyrighted songs or published transcriptions, requires no account, and stores nothing you send it.
plugin_details.target_long:
Music Block 将 ChatGPT 的音乐理论答案转化为真实的、雕刻的乐谱，而不是 ASCII 文本。

要求舔音、音阶指法、琶音、和弦声部或练习——“给我 5 个旋律小调的 B7alt 舔音”，“向我展示将 B7alt 解析为 Em 的四种方法”——Music Block 会直接在对话中将每个示例呈现为标准记谱，下面有吉他指法谱。

每个示例都是交互式的：按播放即可听到它（带有真实乐器声音的 MIDI 合成），在不改变音高的情况下减慢或加快速度从 50% 到 150%，在示例之间切换，并将底层 alphaTex 源复制到您自己的工具中。

Music Block 了解吉他特定的技术标记：击弦、拉弦、滑音、半音和全音弯曲、颤音、手掌静音和 let-ring，以及从 4/4 到 12/8 的拍号、休止符、附点节奏和和弦。

它专为学习和教学而设计：由 ChatGPT 在您的对话中创作简短的原创音乐示例。它不会查找或复制受版权保护的歌曲或已发布的转录，不需要帐户，也不存储您发送的任何内容。

source_long: NORMS assesses whether structured, ratified normative records have sufficient verified grounds for a declared purpose. It checks explicit authority, temporal applicability, scope, verification, provision segmentation and structured conditions, then reports blockers, unknowns and unexamined areas. Missing or unverified required grounds fail closed. NORMS does not provide legal advice, certify compliance, parse PDFs or documents, retrieve laws, infer normative conditions from free text, approve contracts or modify external data.
plugin_details.target_long: NORMS 评估结构化的、经批准的规范性记录对于所声明的目的是否有足够的经过验证的依据。它检查明确的权限、时间适用性、范围、验证、规定分段和结构化条件，然后报告阻碍因素、未知因素和未经检查的领域。缺少或未经验证的所需理由无法关闭。 NORMS 不提供法律建议、证明合规性、解析 PDF 或文档、检索法律、从自由文本推断规范条件、批准合同或修改外部数据。

source_long:
Namify turns a spark of an idea into a brandable, available domain — without the back and forth of typing variations into a search bar. It is domain discovery built for people who want a name that actually works as a brand — not just a URL that happens to be unregistered.

Best used for naming a new business, side project, app, or product launch — and going from idea to a domain you can register in a single conversation.

source_long:
Pier39 enables a new kind of shopping experience: agent-to-agent commerce.

Instead of manually browsing stores and negotiating with sellers, users can describe what they want and their budget. Pier39 discovers participating negotiate.v1 merchants, finds matching products, opens negotiations with merchant AI sales agents, and works toward the best possible deal on the user's behalf.

The app can:

• Search across participating stores for products matching user intent
• Discover product catalogs and pricing automatically
• Negotiate discounts, bundles, shipping, warranties, and other concessions
• Compare offers across multiple merchants
• Summarize negotiated outcomes and savings opportunities
• Help users make more informed purchasing decisions

Pier39 is built on the negotiate.v1 protocol, an open standard that allows AI shopper agents and AI merchant agents to negotiate without prior integration or coordination.
plugin_details.target_long:
Pier39 实现了一种新的购物体验：代理商对代理商的商务。

用户可以描述他们想要的东西和预算，而不是手动浏览商店并与卖家谈判。 Pier39 发现参与 negotiate.v1 的商家，找到匹配的产品，与商家 AI 销售代理展开谈判，并代表用户争取最佳交易。

该应用程序可以：

• 在参与商店中搜索符合用户意图的产品
• 自动发现产品目录和定价
• 协商折扣、捆绑、运输、保修和其他优惠
• 比较多个商家的报价
• 总结谈判成果和节省机会
• 帮助用户做出更明智的购买决策

Pier39 基于 negotiate.v1 协议构建，这是一种开放标准，允许 AI 购物代理和 AI 商家代理无需事先集成或协调即可进行协商。

source_long:

This app provides quote information only. It does not offer advice, recommend coverage amounts, or make coverage decisions.

Important Information

ChatGPT is not an insurance agent, broker, or representative of Neptune Flood. The information presented is based on the details provided at the time of the quote request. This quote does not constitute a binder of coverage, an offer to insure, or a guarantee of coverage. Coverage is subject to underwriting review, eligibility requirements, policy terms, conditions, exclusions, and applicable state regulations.

If you have questions about coverage, limits, deductibles, or whether this policy is appropriate for your needs, please consult a Neptune agent or other insurance professional.

Quotes are valid for sixty (60) days from the date generated, unless otherwise indicated. Pricing, eligibility, and terms are subject to change.
