source_long: Quickly and easily integrate NetSuite to ChatGPT. The NetSuite AI Connector Service provides a protocol-driven integration service supporting Model Context Protocol (MCP), that gives customers a flexible and scalable way to connect AI assistants to NetSuite. Once connected, ChatGPT can directly access and interact with NetSuite data and functionality – quickly unlocking insights, generating reports, streamlining processes., and more. A comprehensive set of tools enable interactions and maintains NetSuite’s existing role-based security model.
plugin_details.target_long: 快速轻松地将 NetSuite 集成到 ChatGPT。 NetSuite AI 连接器服务提供支持模型上下文协议 (MCP) 的协议驱动集成服务，为客户提供灵活且可扩展的方式将 AI 助手连接到 NetSuite。连接后，ChatGPT 可以直接访问 NetSuite 数据和功能并与之交互 - 快速解锁见解、生成报告、简化流程等。一套全面的工具可实现交互并维护 NetSuite 现有的基于角色的安全模型。

source_long: Use Netlify to inspect deployment state, manage sites, and pair the Netlify app with the curated deployment skill for preview and production workflows.
plugin_details.target_long: 使用 Netlify 检查部署状态、管理站点，并将 Netlify 应用程序与预览和生产工作流程的策划部署技能配对。

source_long:
The Network Solutions Domain Search Assistant makes finding an available domain fast, simple, and conversational. Instead of searching one name at a time, users can describe their idea in plain language and instantly check domain availability across relevant extensions. The assistant helps refine names, suggest alternatives, and quickly identify options that are ready to register.

Built to remove friction and frustration from domain discovery, this chat-powered experience keeps users moving forward when names are taken and surfaces smarter, brand-ready options in real time. Whether you’re launching a business, starting a personal project, or exploring new ideas, Network Solutions helps you go from concept to available domain with confidence.
plugin_details.target_long:
网络解决方案域搜索助手可以快速、简单且对话式地查找可用域。用户无需一次搜索一个名称，而是可以用简单的语言描述他们的想法，并立即检查相关扩展中的域可用性。助手可以帮助完善名称、提出替代方案并快速识别准备注册的选项。

这种聊天驱动的体验旨在消除域名发现过程中的摩擦和挫败感，让用户在域名被取名后继续前进，并实时显示更智能、品牌就绪的选项。无论您是要创办企业、启动个人项目还是探索新想法，网络解决方案都可以帮助您充满信心地从概念转变为可用领域。

source_long: Neura Relay MCP helps ChatGPT-connected workflows review proposed agent actions before execution. It returns Decision Receipts, trace refs, and Registry context without executing downstream actions or exposing private payloads.
plugin_details.target_long: Neura Relay MCP 帮助 ChatGPT 连接的工作流程在执行之前审查建议的代理操作。它返回决策收据、跟踪引用和注册表上下文，而不执行下游操作或暴露私有有效负载。

source_long: Neurnav helps you manage long-form documents—like research notes and reports—with Git-style workflows inside ChatGPT. Open a report, see exactly which branch and revision you’re working on, and collaborate with clear diffs, staged edits, and review-ready integration requests. Every change can carry provenance metadata (AI suggestion vs. human approval) so you can publish and share with confidence. You can share a public link to the latest snapshot—all without losing traceability or context.
plugin_details.target_long: Neurnav 通过 ChatGPT 内的 Git 风格工作流程帮助您管理长篇文档（例如研究笔记和报告）。打开报告，准确查看您正在处理的分支和修订版本，并与清晰的差异、分阶段编辑和审查就绪的集成请求进行协作。每个更改都可以携带来源元数据（人工智能建议与人工批准），以便您可以放心地发布和共享。您可以共享最新快照的公共链接，而不会丢失可追溯性或上下文。

source_long: Inspect and manage your NeuronSearchLab recommendation workspace from ChatGPT. Search catalogue items, understand rankings, configure contexts, pipelines, rules and segments, run experiments and model training, and review performance analytics.
plugin_details.target_long: 从 ChatGPT 检查和管理您的 NeuronSearchLab 推荐工作区。搜索目录项，了解排名，配置上下文、管道、规则和细分，运行实验和模型训练，以及查看性能分析。

source_long: Never86'd helps restaurant operators see what delivery apps charged and whether the payout math works. Upload a redacted statement or supported POS export to separate commission, fees, ads, restaurant-funded discounts, refunds, credits, and adjustments; compare matching periods; and see exactly what proof is still missing. It never asks for marketplace or bank logins and does not call something an overcharge without the contract and matching payout evidence. Built from firsthand operating work inside a 28-location, private-equity-backed restaurant group.
plugin_details.target_long: Never86d 帮助餐厅经营者了解送货应用程序的收费情况以及付款数学是否有效。上传经过编辑的报表或支持的 POS 导出以单独的佣金、费用、广告、餐厅资助的折扣、退款、积分和调整；比较匹配期间；并准确查看还缺少什么证据。它从不要求市场或银行登录，也不会在没有合同和匹配的支付证据的情况下将某些费用称为多收费。由一家拥有 28 个地点、由私募股权支持的餐饮集团内部的第一手运营工作打造而成。

source_long: Everything your AI needs to work with your winery's data. Explore Commerce7, RedChirp, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, and more. Use it for reporting, segmentation, and identifying revenue opportunities.
plugin_details.target_long: 人工智能处理酒厂数据所需的一切。探索 Commerce7、RedChirp、Klaviyo、Mailchimp 等。使用它来报告、细分和识别收入机会。

source_long:
Just formed an LLC in New York? Find out the publication requirement, how much it costs to publish by county, and which newspapers you need — before the 120-day deadline. Live pricing for all 62 NY counties. Works for domestic LLCs, foreign LLCs, and PLLCs.

What you can do:
- Check if your LLC needs to publish and what happens if you don't
- Get county-specific pricing and designated newspaper lists
- Generate a legally compliant publication notice
- Verify an existing notice for compliance issues
- Review your filing package before mailing to the state
- Get step-by-step guidance for the full process

 Data sourced from NY LLC Law §206, county clerk offices, and llcpublishers.com — updated regularly.
plugin_details.target_long:
刚刚在纽约成立了一家有限责任公司？在 120 天的截止日期之前查明出版要求、按县出版的费用以及您需要哪些报纸。纽约州所有 62 个县的实时定价。为国内有限责任公司、国外有限责任公司和 PLLC 工作。

你可以做什么：
- 检查您的有限责任公司是否需要发布，如果不发布会发生什么
- 获取特定县的定价和指定报纸列表
- 生成合法合规的发布通知
- 验证现有通知的合规性问题
- 在邮寄到州之前检查您的归档包
- 获得整个过程的分步指导

 数据来源于 NY LLC Law §206、县书记员办公室和 llcpublishers.com — 定期更新。

source_long: NewHomeSource helps users discover new construction homes and communities by location, price, bedrooms, builder, and floorplan preferences. Search Over 12,000 New Home Communities - the World's Largest New Construction Database. Compare Pricing, Pictures, and Floor Plans for New Homes for Sale.
plugin_details.target_long: NewHomeSource 帮助用户根据位置、价格、卧室、建筑商和平面图偏好发现新建住宅和社区。搜索超过 12,000 个新住宅社区 - 世界上最大的新建数据库。比较待售新房的价格、图片和平面图。

source_long: NewTwos is a fast place to write things down. This connector lets ChatGPT add to-dos and notes to the right list, set reminders, complete and organize items, and search everything you've captured — working on the same data as the NewTwos apps, scoped to the permissions you approve.
plugin_details.target_long: NewTwos 是一个快速记下事情的地方。此连接器允许 ChatGPT 将待办事项和注释添加到正确的列表、设置提醒、完成和组织项目以及搜索您捕获的所有内容 - 处理与 NewTwos 应用程序相同的数据，范围仅限于您批准的权限。

source_long:
Users can search for products on Newegg and view detailed information. 
When they are ready to purchase, they are redirected to the Newegg website to complete checkout.
plugin_details.target_long:
用户可以在Newegg上搜索产品并查看详细信息。 
当他们准备购买时，他们会被重定向到 Newegg 网站以完成结账。

source_long: Stay on top of what the world is talking about. Newsify brings you today's trending news from any country, in any language — summarized and ready to read. Ask about any place and get fresh, relevant stories instantly. No searching, no scrolling. Just news.
plugin_details.target_long: 掌握世界正在谈论的话题。 Newsify 以任何语言为您提供来自任何国家/地区的当今热门新闻 — 已汇总并可供阅读。询问任何地方并立即获得新鲜、相关的故事。无需搜索，无需滚动。只是新闻。

source_long: Newsmind connects your RSS subscriptions to ChatGPT. Ask what's new and get briefings from the sources you chose; search your feeds by keyword or by meaning; group the same story across outlets; star and organize articles; and set watches on topics so matches are waiting next time you ask. Read position syncs across conversations, and existing subscriptions import in one step via OPML.
plugin_details.target_long: Newsmind 将您的 RSS 订阅连接到 ChatGPT。询问最新消息并从您选择的来源获取简报；按关键字或含义搜索您的提要；将同一个故事分组到各个渠道；为文章加注星标并进行组织；并设置对主题的关注，以便下次您询问时匹配正在等待。跨对话读取位置同步，并通过 OPML 一步导入现有订阅。

source_long:
Nexafin is an AI-powered personal finance and expense tracking assistant that helps you understand your spending, budget, and cash flow using natural language.

Securely connect your accounts to instantly check bank balances, review recent transactions, track recurring bills, and analyze spending by category without digging through dashboards or statements.

Nexafin is privacy-first and read-only. It cannot move money or access sensitive credentials. You stay in control of what data is shared and can disconnect at any time.

Try asking:

“Show my account balances”

“What bills are coming up?”

“How much did I spend on food last month?”

“Where is most of my money going?”
plugin_details.target_long:
Nexafin 是一款基于人工智能的个人财务和费用跟踪助手，可帮助您使用自然语言了解您的支出、预算和现金流。

安全地连接您的帐户，以立即检查银行余额、查看最近的交易、跟踪经常性账单并按类别分析支出，而无需深入查看仪表板或报表。

Nexafin 是隐私第一且只读的。它无法转移资金或访问敏感凭证。您可以控制共享哪些数据，并且可以随时断开连接。

尝试询问：

“显示我的账户余额”

“有什么账单？”

“我上个月在食物上花了多少钱？”

“我的大部分钱都花到哪里去了？”

source_long: Nexoya connects ChatGPT to a Nexoya workspace so marketers can ask natural-language questions about marketing portfolios, campaign or adset contents, funnel steps, labels, events, performance metrics, daily trends, regression-based attribution, and budget optimization recommendations. The app helps users summarize marketing performance, compare periods and channels, inspect ROI and ROAS, reason about trends, and explain the latest optimization proposal without leaving ChatGPT. Access is scoped to the signed-in user's Nexoya account and team permissions.
plugin_details.target_long: Nexoya 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Nexoya 工作区，以便营销人员可以提出有关营销组合、营销活动或广告集内容、漏斗步骤、标签、事件、绩效指标、每日趋势、基于回归的归因和预算优化建议的自然语言问题。该应用程序可以帮助用户在不离开 ChatGPT 的情况下总结营销绩效、比较周期和渠道、检查 ROI 和 ROAS、推理趋势并解释最新的优化建议。访问权限仅限于登录用户的 Nexoya 帐户和团队权限。

source_long:
Next Stock – Market Insights helps users explore stock market data through structured analysis and historical performance metrics.

The app delivers short-term and long-term stock picks, categorized stock rankings, portfolio breakdowns, and educational market insights based on publicly available financial data.

Users can explore different investment styles such as growth, value, dividend, and conservative strategies, while accessing curated market summaries, earnings highlights, and financial transcripts.

Designed to support independent research and financial literacy, Next Stock – Market Insights provides clear, data-driven tools to help users better understand market trends and investment strategies. The app does not provide personalized financial advice.
plugin_details.target_long:
Next Stock – 市场洞察帮助用户通过结构化分析和历史业绩指标探索股市数据。

该应用程序提供短期和长期选股、股票分类排名、投资组合细分以及基于公开财务数据的教育市场洞察。

用户可以探索不同的投资风格，例如增长、价值、股息和保守策略，同时访问精选的市场摘要、收益亮点和财务记录。

Next Stock – Market Insights 旨在支持独立研究和金融知识，提供清晰的数据驱动工具，帮助用户更好地了解市场趋势和投资策略。该应用程序不提供个性化的财务建议。

source_long: Connect to your Nexvio workspace to manage AI agents, contacts, support tickets, analytics, and help documentation through our MCP App.
plugin_details.target_long: 连接到您的 Nexvio 工作区，通过我们的 MCP 应用程序管理 AI 代理、联系人、支持票证、分析和帮助文档。

source_long: NiceBabyName reads and compares baby names with Holistic Nameology — the "Four Aspects" method from the book The Four Aspects. Give it one name and it returns that name's Governing Planet, Temperament, Rising Sign, and Rising Degree, with meanings, a personality reading, and newborn-favorability notes. Give it two to five names and it compares them side by side and flags which are most favorable for a newborn, with each name's strengths and pitfalls. It can also search a database of 160,000+ names by starting letters, gender, and cultural origin to gather candidates. English names are read from their pronunciation, which the app asks the user to confirm; Persian and Arabic names are read exactly from their own letters. The parents' names can be included to refine the reading. Works in English, Persian, and Arabic. For guidance and reflection only.
plugin_details.target_long: NiceBabyName 使用整体姓名学（《四个方面》一书中的“四个方面”方法）来读取和比较婴儿的名字。给它一个名字，它就会返回该名称的主宰行星、气质、上升星座和上升程度，以及含义、个性解读和新生儿好感度注释。给它两到五个名字，它会并排比较它们，并标记出最适合新生儿的名字，以及每个名字的优点和缺点。它还可以通过开头字母、性别和文化起源来搜索包含 160,000 多个姓名的数据库，以收集候选人。英文名字是根据发音读出的，应用程序会要求用户确认；波斯语和阿拉伯语的名字完全是根据它们自己的字母来读的。可以包括父母的名字以完善阅读。支持英语、波斯语和阿拉伯语。仅供指导和反思。

source_long:
Connect Nifty to ChatGPT to analyze your reselling business across every marketplace you sell on. ChatGPT can search and filter your inventory, pull full details on any item, check inventory health, review order history with financial detail, and break down sales, profit, and sell-through by marketplace, brand, and category. Useful for spotting what's selling, finding stale listings, comparing margins across platforms, and understanding your P&L without exporting spreadsheets. 

Nifty unifies inventory and sales for resellers on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Etsy, and Whatnot..
plugin_details.target_long:
将 Nifty 连接到 ChatGPT，以分析您在其销售的每个市场上的转售业务。 ChatGPT 可以搜索和过滤您的库存、提取任何商品的完整详细信息、检查库存状况、查看包含财务详细信息的订单历史记录，并按市场、品牌和类别细分销售额、利润和销售情况。对于发现畅销产品、查找过时的列表、比较跨平台的利润以及了解您的损益表而无需导出电子表格非常有用。 

Nifty 统一了 eBay、Poshmark、Mercari、Depop、Etsy 和 Whatnot 上经销商的库存和销售。

source_long: Connect Nifty to build and run your projects straight from chat. Ask your assistant to create a project with phases, tasks, owners, and due dates — it’s live in Nifty in seconds. Search across your workspace, generate status reports, surface stalled tasks, and post updates back, all without leaving the conversation. Nifty stays the single source of truth for your team, so everything your AI creates is organized, shared, and ready to run.
plugin_details.target_long: 连接 Nifty 直接通过聊天构建和运行您的项目。让你的助手创建一个包含阶段、任务、所有者和截止日期的项目——几秒钟内它就会在 Nifty 中上线。在您的工作空间中进行搜索、生成状态报告、显示停滞的任务以及发回更新，所有这些都无需离开对话。 Nifty 仍然是您团队的单一事实来源，因此您的 AI 创建的所有内容都经过组织、共享并准备运行。

source_long:
If you have a body, you're an athlete. And if you're a runner, you need the right shoes. This tool is designed to help runners find the fit, feel, and footwear style they need to get the most out of the run.

All product has been obsessed by runners and engineered to the exact specifications of championship athletes.
plugin_details.target_long:
如果你有身体，你就是一名运动员。如果您是跑步者，则需要合适的鞋子。该工具旨在帮助跑步者找到他们所需的合脚性、感觉和鞋型，以充分享受跑步的乐趣。

所有产品都深受跑步者的青睐，并按照冠军运动员的具体规格进行设计。

source_long:
Nimble gives agents governed, accurate access to the public web, at a lower token cost per answer. Search finds current pages with ranked results and snippets. Extract returns clean, structured content from any URL, including pages needing JavaScript or interaction. Extraction Templates give consistently shaped records from known sites. Web Search Agents handle open-ended work across many sources, returning findings with citations, for research, enrichment, and dataset building.

Also included: ready-made workflows for competitor research, company profiles, meeting prep, market discovery, brand monitoring, SEO, and talent sourcing.
plugin_details.target_long:
Nimble 为代理提供了受管理的、准确的公共网络访问权限，并且每个答案的令牌成本较低。搜索可查找包含排名结果和片段的当前页面。 Extract 从任何 URL 返回干净、结构化的内容，包括需要 JavaScript 或交互的页面。提取模板提供来自已知站点的一致形状的记录。网络搜索代理处理跨多个来源的开放式工作，返回带有引用的结果，用于研究、丰富和数据集构建。

还包括：用于竞争对手研究、公司简介、会议准备、市场发现、品牌监控、搜索引擎优化和人才采购的现成工作流程。

source_long: Ninjo helps operators run their AI engagement agents in plain language: diagnose an agent's setup and get prioritized fixes, review the conversations it handled, edit prompts and triggers, audit the contact limits, follow-up workflows and notifications wired around it, and segment the contact directory by custom-property values.
plugin_details.target_long: Ninjo 帮助操作员以简单的语言运行 AI 参与代理：诊断代理的设置并获得优先修复、查看其处理的对话、编辑提示和触发器、审核联系人限制、后续工作流程和围绕其连接的通知，并按自定义属性值对联系人目录进行分段。

source_long:
Nitrosend is the AI-native email marketing platform. Connect it to ChatGPT and control your entire email stack through conversation.

What you can do:
- Create and send email campaigns with GPT/Codex written copy
- Build automation flows (welcome series, onboarding, win-back, cart abandonment)
- Send transactional email (password resets, receipts, verification)
- Manage contacts, lists, and segments
- Monitor email analytics and get improvement recommendations
- Design emails that match your brand automatically

Nitrosend learns your brand voice and gets smarter with every send. Bring your own sending infrastructure (SendGrid, SES, Postmark, Resend) or use ours. Unlimited contacts on every plan.

Built by the team behind SmartrMail (10 billion emails, acquired 2022) and Sendicate (28,000 users).

Get started: sign up at app.nitrosend.com, then connect Nitrosend from the ChatGPT App Directory.
plugin_details.target_long:
Nitrosend 是人工智能原生电子邮件营销平台。将其连接到 ChatGPT 并通过对话控制您的整个电子邮件堆栈。

你可以做什么：
- 使用 GPT/Codex 书面副本创建和发送电子邮件活动
- 构建自动化流程（欢迎系列、入职、赢回、放弃购物车）
- 发送交易电子邮件（密码重置、收据、验证）
- 管理联系人、列表和细分
- 监控电子邮件分析并获取改进建议
- 自动设计与您的品牌相匹配的电子邮件

Nitrosend 会学习您的品牌声音，并在每次发送时变得更加智能。自带发送基础设施（SendGrid、SES、Postmark、Resend）或使用我们的。每个计划的联系次数不受限制。

由 SmartrMail（100 亿封电子邮件，2022 年收购）和 Sendicate（28,000 名用户）背后的团队构建。

开始使用：在 app.nitrosend.com 上注册，然后从 ChatGPT 应用程序目录连接 Nitrosend。

source_long:
NivaDesk helps custom-order studios manage orders, customers, personal notes, tasks, schedules and financial summaries from ChatGPT. After connecting a NivaDesk workspace, users can search orders, view dashboard summaries, check permitted financial information, create personal notes and update order statuses.

It is designed for small teams and studios that work on made-to-order projects, including bespoke art, handmade products, repairs, photography, tailoring, jewellery and other client-based workflows.
plugin_details.target_long:
NivaDesk 帮助定制订单工作室通过 ChatGPT 管理订单、客户、个人笔记、任务、日程安排和财务摘要。连接 NivaDesk 工作区后，用户可以搜索订单、查看仪表板摘要、检查允许的财务信息、创建个人注释和更新订单状态。

它专为从事定制项目的小型团队和工作室而设计，包括定制艺术、手工产品、维修、摄影、裁缝、珠宝和其他基于客户的工作流程。

source_long:
No Bike No Life beantwortet Motorradfragen mit Daten aus dem NBNL-Katalog.

Kaufberatung: Ein Dialog aus neun Fragen zu Nutzung, Erfahrung, Führerschein, Körpergröße und Budget führt zu passenden Modellen — mit Bild, Eckdaten und Begründung, warum ein Motorrad passt.

Katalog: Modelle suchen, Details ansehen, bis zu fünf Maschinen in einer Tabelle vergleichen.

Routen: Strecken zwischen zwei Punkten oder Rundtouren planen, mit Kurvigkeit, Höhenprofil und dem Wetter entlang der Route auf der Karte.

Wetter: Mehrtägige Vorhersage mit Fahrbarkeits-Bewertung, Zustand der Alpenpässe und ein Kompass, der zeigt, in welche Himmelsrichtung sich die Ausfahrt heute lohnt.

Anfängerwissen: Über 200 beantwortete Einsteigerfragen zu Technik, Wartung und Fahrpraxis.

Alle Angaben stammen aus dem redaktionell gepflegten Katalog von nbnl.de. Modellfotos sind Herstellermaterial und mit Quelle gekennzeichnet.
plugin_details.target_long:
No Bike No Life 的豆瓣Motorradfragen 与 NBNL-Katalog 的数据。

Kaufberatung: E​​in Dialog aus neun Fragen zu Nutzung, Erfahrung, Führerschein, Körpergröße und Budget führt zu passenden Modellen — mit Bild, Eckdaten und Begründung, warum ein Motorrad passt.

目录：模型，详细信息，bis zu fünf Maschinen in einer Tabelle vergleichen。

路线：在赛车路线上进行两次 Punkten 或 Rundtouren planen、Kurvigkeit、Höhenprofil 和 dem Wetter entlang。

湿润：Mehrtägige Vorhersage mit Fahrbarkeits-Bewertung，Zustand der Alpenpässe und ein Kompass，der zeigt，in welche Himmelsrichtung sich die Ausfahrt heute lohnt。

Anfängerwissen: Über 200 beantwortete Einsteigerfragen zu Technik, Wartung und Fahrpraxis。

所有内容都由 nbnl.de 上的目录编辑而成。模型照片由 Hersteller 材料和数据制成。

source_long:
NoBrainner connects your flashcard study progress and spaced repetition decks directly to ChatGPT. Once signed in, you can ask ChatGPT for a detailed overview of your current study stats, check your recent review activity, pinpoint your weakest cards, and get personalized recommendations on what to review next.

Additionally, you can use ChatGPT to instantly draft new study decks (such as vocabulary lists, practice questions, or topic summaries) and save them directly to your NoBrainner account after reviewing the draft.
plugin_details.target_long:
NoBrainner 将您的抽认卡学习进度和间隔重复卡片直接连接到 ChatGPT。登录后，您可以向 ChatGPT 询问您当前学习统计数据的详细概述，检查您最近的复习活动，查明您最薄弱的卡片，并获得有关下一步复习内容的个性化建议。

此外，您还可以使用 ChatGPT 立即起草新的学习材料（例如词汇列表、练习题或主题摘要），并在审阅草稿后将其直接保存到您的 NoBrainner 帐户。

source_long:
NoPressure is a communication-skills practice for the workplace. It turns a hard conversation into a live voice roleplay you can rehearse before the real one: delivering critical feedback, saying no to a request, handling a performance review, pushing back on a stakeholder, negotiating a raise, running a first 1:1 with a new team.

Describe the situation once — who the other person is, where they stand, and what makes it hard. ChatGPT can assemble that brief from what is already in the conversation, including anything you have brought in from the other tools you use, so the character is built on the real people and the real stakes instead of a generic template. NoPressure sees only the brief it is handed: it has no access to your calendar, mail, or documents. From that brief, it generates the character, a scene image, and a voice, then shows a start card in the chat. Pressing Start opens the voice call in the NoPressure web app, where you speak out loud with someone who holds their own position and pushes back.

When the session ends, the debrief comes back to the card: the key insight, how you handled the core challenge, and where to focus next. Send it into the chat, with the transcript of what was said, and work through it with ChatGPT. Simulations are reusable, so you can run one again and compare the attempt against an earlier try, or edit its title, card description, and character first. Each one lives in your own private NoPressure workspace.
plugin_details.target_long:
NoPressure 是一种针对工作场所的沟通技巧实践。它将一场艰难的对话变成了一场现场语音角色扮演，你可以在真正的对话之前排练：提供关键反馈、拒绝请求、处理绩效评估、回击利益相关者、谈判加薪、与新团队进行第一次 1:1 的讨论。

描述一次情况——对方是谁，他们的立场是什么，以及是什么让事情变得困难。 ChatGPT 可以根据对话中已有的内容组装该摘要，包括您从使用的其他工具中引入的任何内容，因此该角色是基于真实的人和真实的利害关系而不是通用模板构建的。 NoPressure 只能看到它收到的摘要：它无法访问您的日历、邮件或文档。根据该摘要，它生成角色、场景图像和声音，然后在聊天中显示启动卡。按“开始”会在 NoPressure 网络应用程序中打开语音通话，您可以在其中与坚持自己立场并进行反击的人大声交谈。

会议结束后，汇报会回到卡片上：关键见解、您如何应对核心挑战以及下一步要关注的重点。将其连同所说内容的文字记录一起发送到聊天中，然后使用 ChatGPT 完成它。模拟是可重复使用的，因此您可以再次运行一次并将该尝试与之前的尝试进行比较，或者先编辑其标题、卡牌描述和角色。每个人都生活在自己的私人 NoPressure 工作空间中。

source_long: Search for a French company and view its Nogogo grade and principal director. Nogogo AI uses public data to provide an indicative assessment of a company’s apparent reliability.

source_long: Nomas Research lets ChatGPT look up structured SEC data: company facts, parsed filings (8-K, 10-K/Q, 13D, 144, D, 14A, S-1/S-3), insider trades, 13F holdings, and failure-to-deliver. Tools are read-only retrieval against Nomas RAG APIs. Users sign in on nomas.fyi; Free, Pro, and API plans still apply.
plugin_details.target_long: Nomas Research 允许 ChatGPT 查找结构化 SEC 数据：公司事实、解析的文件（8-K、10-K/Q、13D、144、D、14A、S-1/S-3）、内幕交易、13F 持仓和未能交付。工具是针对 Nomas RAG API 的只读检索。用户登录 nomas.fyi；免费、专业版和 API 计划仍然适用。

source_long: Access your Noodle Seed workspace in ChatGPT to find information faster, stay organized, and keep your work moving without switching tools.
plugin_details.target_long: 访问 ChatGPT 中的 Noodle Seed 工作区，可以更快地查找信息、保持井井有条，并让您的工作顺利进行，而无需切换工具。

source_long:

西北注册代理是一家家族拥有和经营的企业身份服务，为您提供创业和发展业务所需的一切。我们在全美 50 个州成立公司，提供注册代理服务，并提供免费身份服务，包括免费地址、域名、网站、电子邮件和本地电话号码。

source_long: Stay protected while you chat. Norton brings real-time, AI-powered scam detection directly into your ChatGPT experience, backed by the Norton Genie AI assistant. Share suspicious emails, texts, messages, images, or links for instant analysis and clear cyber safety guidance to help you avoid phishing, scams, and malicious content before you click. You can also ask everyday questions about security, privacy, identity protection, and device performance, and get trusted answers right where you’re already chatting.
plugin_details.target_long: 聊天时保持保护。诺顿将基于 AI 的实时诈骗检测直接带入您的 ChatGPT 体验，并由 Norton Genie AI 助手提供支持。共享可疑电子邮件、文本、消息、图像或链接以进行即时分析和清晰的网络安全指导，帮助您在点击之前避免网络钓鱼、诈骗和恶意内容。您还可以询问有关安全、隐私、身份保护和设备性能的日常问题，并在聊天时获得可信答案。

source_long:
Noteithub lets you create TODO lists from conversations and save important chats as journal entries.

You can organize tasks by goal, update their status, and keep notes or decisions from your chats in one place. This makes it easy to track what you need to do and refer back to important discussions.
plugin_details.target_long:
Noteithub 允许您从对话中创建 TODO 列表，并将重要的聊天保存为日记条目。

您可以按目标组织任务、更新其状态，并将聊天记录或决定保存在一个地方。这样可以轻松跟踪您需要做的事情并参考重要的讨论。

source_long:
Notifly is a marketing automation platform for sending and managing customer messages across channels such as mobile push, web push, popups, email, SMS, KakaoTalk, and webhooks.
Teams can build behavior-based campaigns and user journeys, personalize audiences, review delivery and conversion performance, and connect Notifly through SDKs, HTTP APIs, and external integrations.

Notifly 是一个营销自动化平台，用于跨移动推送、网络推送、弹出窗口、电子邮件、短信、KakaoTalk 和 Webhooks 等渠道发送和管理客户消息。

source_long: Notion workflows for turning specs into implementation plans, synthesizing research into structured documentation, preparing meeting materials with workspace context, and capturing decisions or conversations into durable knowledge pages.

source_long:
NOVASOL helps travelers discover holiday homes, holiday apartments, and vacation destinations across Europe. 

Search thousands of bookable holiday properties across 18 European countries, all within a conversation. 

Tell ChatGPT where you want to go, when, how many guests, your budget, and any must-have features, and it will surface a ranked carousel of matching homes with names, locations, prices, review scores, bedroom counts, and pet policies. Refine on the fly: change dates, shift your destination, tighten your budget, or add amenities and the results update instantly. Standout properties are highlighted so you can go straight to the card to see photos, full amenity lists, and booking options. This app covers self-catering holiday rental search only. It does not cover hotels, flights, car hire, package holidays, city apartments for short-term urban stays, aggregate price statistics, or any booking or payment action.
plugin_details.target_long:
NOVASOL 帮助旅行者发现欧洲各地的度假屋、度假公寓和度假目的地。 

在对话中搜索 18 个欧洲国家的数千个可预订度假酒店。 

告诉 ChatGPT 您想去哪里、什么时候、有多少客人、您的预算以及任何必备功能，它就会显示一个排名轮播的匹配房屋，其中包括名称、位置、价格、评论分数、卧室数量和宠物政策。即时优化：更改日期、改变目的地、收紧预算或添加便利设施，结果会立即更新。突出显示了杰出的酒店，因此您可以直接转到卡片查看照片、完整的设施列表和预订选项。该应用程序仅涵盖自助式度假租赁搜索。它不包括酒店、航班、汽车租赁、度假套餐、短期城市住宿的城市公寓、总价格统计或任何预订或付款操作。

source_long: NoveLandは、小説の作品・章・エピソード・キャラクター・用語・ドキュメント・相関図・伏線をChatGPTから管理できる執筆支援アプリです。ユーザーは自分の非公開ワークスペースを確認し、NoveLand Markdownで本文を下書き・更新し、キャラクターや用語の設定を整理しながら、物語構造を作品内で一貫して管理できます。
plugin_details.target_long: NoveLandは、小说の作品・章・エピソード・キャラクター・用语・ドキュメント・相关図・伏线をCha tGPTから管理できる执笔支持apuriです。ユーザーは自分の非公开ワークスペーsuを确认し、NoveLand Markdownで论文を下书き・更新し、キャラクターや用语の设定を整理しながら、物语构造を作品内で一贯して管理できます。

source_long: Nowistay helps vacation rental hosts manage daily operations in ChatGPT. Check bookings, availability, prices, guest messages, tasks, and welcome guides for your Nowistay properties, and make updates in seconds without switching between tools.
plugin_details.target_long: Nowistay 帮助度假租赁房东管理 ChatGPT 中的日常运营。检查 Nowistay 酒店的预订、空房情况、价格、宾客留言、任务和欢迎指南，并在几秒钟内进行更新，无需在工具之间切换。

source_long: Get home insurance quotes from multiple insurers by filling in a single form. The app provides pricing, coverage details, and policy differences based on data from multiple insurers. Compare results side by side and select an option to continue your purchase through Nsure’s website.
plugin_details.target_long: 只需填写一份表格即可获取多家保险公司的家庭保险报价。该应用程序根据多家保险公司的数据提供定价、承保范围详细信息和保单差异。并排比较结果并选择一个选项以通过 Nsure 网站继续购买。

source_long:
Just tell ChatGPT what to remember and when. Nudges confirms the exact time, then emails you the moment it's due. No app to install, no phone number, no cap on how many you set, and no paywall.

It understands the way you actually talk: "in 30 minutes," "tomorrow at 9," "every morning at 8," "every other Friday." Every reminder comes back with the exact local time and the inbox it's headed to, so you catch a mistake before it matters. Ask for your reminders any time, and cancel any one in a sentence.

Nudges is free and unlimited, and it reaches you in the inbox you already check. Your email is verified the moment you connect, so there's nothing to set up. We deliver reminders to that address and count basic usage events to run the service. We never store what your reminders say.
plugin_details.target_long:
只需告诉 ChatGPT 要记住什么以及何时记住即可。 Nudges 会确认确切的时间，然后在到期时通过电子邮件发送给您。无需安装应用程序，没有电话号码，没有设置数量上限，也没有付费专区。

它理解您实际说话的方式：“30 分钟后”、“明天 9 点”、“每天早上 8 点”、“每隔一个星期五”。每个提醒都会返回准确的当地时间和收件箱，因此您可以在重要的事情发生之前发现错误。随时请求您的提醒，并在一句话中取消任何提醒。

Nudges 是免费且不受限制的，它会通过您已查看的收件箱到达您。您的电子邮件在您连接时就会得到验证，因此无需进行任何设置。我们向该地址发送提醒，并统计基本使用事件以运行服务。我们从不存储您的提醒内容。

source_long: NugIt.ai helps you keep the ChatGPT answers worth finding again. Type “NugIt” beneath a useful answer to save it as a private, titled Nug in your personal library. Over time, NugIt.ai becomes a searchable home for the useful answers you want to find and use again.
plugin_details.target_long: NugIt.ai 帮助您保持值得再次寻找的 ChatGPT 答案。在有用的答案下方输入“NugIt”，将其保存为私人图书馆中的私人标题，名为 Nug。随着时间的推移，NugIt.ai 会成为您想要查找和再次使用的有用答案的可搜索之家。

source_long:
Nutshell brings your CRM into the conversation. Connect your Nutshell account to ChatGPT and instantly ask questions about your pipeline, look up contacts, track leads, and surface sales insights — without leaving your AI tool. 

Whether you're prepping for a call, checking deal status, or reviewing team performance, your CRM data is always one question away.
plugin_details.target_long:
Nutshell 将您的 CRM 纳入对话中。将您的 Nutshell 帐户连接到 ChatGPT，并立即询问有关您的渠道的问题、查找联系人、跟踪潜在客户并显示销售见解 - 无需离开您的 AI 工具。 

无论您是在准备通话、检查交易状态还是审查团队绩效，您的 CRM 数据始终一问一答。

source_long: Connect ChatGPT to your Nuvemshop store and manage your business using natural language. Search, create, and edit products and categories, check orders, customers, coupons, promotions, shipping methods, and payment options — all from a single conversation. Perfect for store owners who want to run their e-commerce without leaving the chat.
plugin_details.target_long: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Nuvemshop 商店并使用自然语言管理您的业务。搜索、创建和编辑产品和类别、检查订单、客户、优惠券、促销、运输方式和付款选项——所有这些都通过一次对话完成。非常适合想要在不离开聊天室的情况下运行电子商务的店主。

source_long: Connect your Nuwa Pen to ChatGPT. Search, recall, and summarize your handwritten notes using natural language. Ask what you wrote today, find notes about a specific topic, browse your notebooks, or view a rendered image of your handwriting — all without leaving the conversation. Nuwa turns your pen-and-paper notes into part of your AI workflow.
plugin_details.target_long: 将您的女娲笔连接至 ChatGPT。使用自然语言搜索、回忆和总结您的手写笔记。询问您今天写了什么，查找有关特定主题的笔记，浏览您的笔记本，或查看您的笔迹的渲染图像 - 所有这些都无需离开对话。 Nuwa 将您的纸笔笔记变成 AI 工作流程的一部分。

source_long:
Nylon gives ChatGPT direct access to primary legal source material across New Zealand, Australia and the UK — legislation, case law and commentary (including government guidance) — so answers to legal and tax questions are grounded in real, current sources.
Ask a question in plain language and Nylon runs keyword and semantic searches across the library. It handles precise lookups, as well as open research. 
Every result carries citation links to the original, so you can verify what you're reading and cite it with confidence. Nylon is built for lawyers, tax advisers and anyone who needs trusted and meticulous legal research.
plugin_details.target_long:
Nylon 使 ChatGPT 能够直接访问新西兰、澳大利亚和英国的主要法律来源材料——立法、判例法和评论（包括政府指导）——因此法律和税务问题的答案都基于真实的、当前的来源。
用简单的语言提出问题，Nylon 会在整个图书馆中运行关键字和语义搜索。它处理精确查找以及开放研究。 
每个结果都带有原始引用链接，因此您可以验证您正在阅读的内容并自信地引用它。 Nylon 专为律师、税务顾问和任何需要值得信赖和细致的法律研究的人而设计。

source_long: Tap into NyquistAI's comprehensive database of FDA medical device intelligence, including all 510(k), PMA, De Novo, and HDE clearances and approvals, adverse events, recalls, guidance, and more. This app provides FDA regulatory and safety intelligence for research, compliance, and monitoring purposes only. It does not provide medical advice or clinical recommendations.
plugin_details.target_long: 利用 NyquistAI 的 FDA 医疗器械情报综合数据库，包括所有 510(k)、PMA、De Novo 和 HDE 许可和批准、不良事件、召回、指南等。该应用程序提供 FDA 监管和安全情报，仅用于研究、合规和监控目的。它不提供医疗建议或临床建议。

source_long: Get real-time crypto prices, market stats, and trading volume powered by OKX. View interactive candlestick charts across multiple timeframes and compare tokens side by side — all within your conversation.
plugin_details.target_long: 获取由 OKX 提供支持的实时加密货币价格、市场统计数据和交易量。查看多个时间范围内的交互式蜡烛图并并排比较代币——所有这一切都在您的对话中。

source_long:
Just tell the app your event details (purpose, date, time, etc.), and it will automatically create an attendance poll. Share the generated link and anyone can respond instantly—no sign-up required. You can view responses and see which dates have the most participants directly from the poll in ChatGPT.

Try requests like these:

“@OK幹事 Create an attendance poll for a New Year’s party next week at 7 PM at Shibuya Station.”

If there are conditions you want to exclude (e.g., weekends), just mention them.

“@OK幹事 We’re planning a drinking party, so create an attendance poll for weekdays only over the next two weeks.”

Note: All dates and times in this app are handled in Japan Standard Time (JST).
plugin_details.target_long:
只需告诉应用程序您的活动详细信息（目的、日期、时间等），它就会自动创建出席投票。分享生成的链接，任何人都可以立即回复，无需注册。您可以直接通过 ChatGPT 中的投票查看回复并查看哪些日期的参与者最多。

尝试这样的请求：

“@OK 为下周晚上 7 点在涩谷站举办的新年派对创建一个出席率调查。”

如果您想排除某些条件（例如周末），只需提及即可。

“@OK消耗我们正在计划举办一场酒会，因此仅在接下来的两周内对工作日进行一次出席率调查。”

注意：此应用程序中的所有日期和时间均按日本标准时间 (JST) 处理。

source_long: OLX India helps users find marketplace listings in India through ChatGPT. The app can resolve listing locations and categories, inspect category-specific filters, search listings with structured constraints, show results in an embedded catalogue widget, and open listing details for a selected item.
plugin_details.target_long: OLX India 通过 ChatGPT 帮助用户查找印度的市场列表。该应用程序可以解析列表位置和类别，检查特定于类别的过滤器，搜索具有结构化约束的列表，在嵌入式目录小部件中显示结果，以及打开所选项目的列表详细信息。

source_long: OSuite.ai helps teams review important AI actions before they happen. It can route risky work into approval, check whether an action is cleared to continue, summarize runtime exposure, and keep an audit-ready record of what was reviewed, approved, and completed.
plugin_details.target_long: OSuite.ai 帮助团队在重要的人工智能操作发生之前对其进行审查。它可以将有风险的工作转入批准，检查操作是否已获准继续，总结运行时风险，并保留审核、批准和完成内容的审计记录。

source_long:
Znajdź samochód marzeń w OTOMOTO, używając prostego języka. Zapomnij o skomplikowanych filtrach i formularzach wyszukiwania. Wystarczy, że opiszesz na OTOMOTO, czego szukasz, np. „SUV z niskim przebiegiem, idealny dla 4-osobowej rodziny" albo „młody rocznik, auto miejskie".
Kluczowe funkcje:

Inteligentne wyszukiwanie – opisz wymarzone auto prostym językiem
Trafne wyniki – uzyskaj informacje o każdym ogłoszeniu i porównaj dostępne opcje
Interaktywne doprecyzowanie – zadawaj dodatkowe pytania, aby zawęzić wyszukiwanie

Niezależnie od tego, czy kupujesz auto po raz pierwszy, czy jesteś zaprawionym pasjonatem motoryzacji, OTOMOTO sprawia, że zakup samochodu jest tak prosty jak zwykła rozmowa.
plugin_details.target_long:
Znajdź samochód marzeń w OTOMOTO，używając prostego języka。 Zapomnij 或 skomplikowanych filtrach 和 Formularzach wyszukiwania。 Wystarczy，że opiszesz na OTOMOTO，czego szukasz，np。 “SUV z niskim przebiegiem，理想的 dla 4-osobowej rodziny” albo “młody rocznik，auto miejskie”。
Kluczowe funkcje：

Inteligentne wyszukiwanie – opisz wymarzone auto prostym językiem
Trafne wyniki – 乌兹卡伊信息或 każdym ogłoszeniu 和 porównaj dostępne opcje
Interaktywne doprecyzowanie – zadawaj dodatkowe pytania, aby zawęzić wyszukiwanie

请注意，您的汽车是 pierwszy，您的汽车名称是 Motoryzacji、OTOMOTO sprawia、您的汽车是 samochodu 玩笑的。

source_long: OTTASIA answers the question streaming search gets wrong outside the US: where can I legally watch this, HERE? Coverage spans 34 markets (India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Korea, Japan, the Gulf and more, plus the US, UK, Canada and Australia for the diaspora) and 60+ services, including regional platforms global tools miss (JioHotstar, ZEE5, Sun NXT, Aha, Hoichoi, Chorki, ARY Plus, Shahid, Viu, iQIYI). Availability comes from live data, including OTTASIA's own daily catalog scans of local services and free official-YouTube channels for Pakistani dramas. Also answers what's new on any service in any market, and finds titles across languages (English, romanized, or original script).
plugin_details.target_long: OTTASIA 回答了美国境外流媒体搜索出错的问题：我可以在哪里合法地观看此内容？覆盖范围涵盖 34 个市场（印度、巴基斯坦、孟加拉国、印度尼西亚、韩国、日本、海湾地区等，以及海外侨民的美国、英国、加拿大和澳大利亚）和 60 多个服务，包括全球工具缺失的区域平台（JioHotstar、ZEE5、Sun NXT、Aha、Hoichoi、Chorki、ARY Plus、Shahid、Viu、爱奇艺）。可用性来自实时数据，包括 OTTASIA 自己的本地服务每日目录扫描以及巴基斯坦电视剧的免费官方 YouTube 频道。还可以回答任何市场中任何服务的新增内容，并查找跨语言（英语、罗马化或原始文字）的标题。

source_long: OWOX Data Marts connects ChatGPT/Codex to your company's governed analytics layer. Data Analysts define trusted data marts — metrics, dimensions, and join logic — on top of your own warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, Athena). From ChatGPT/Codex you can discover the right data mart with natural-language search, inspect its fields, query governed data and get answers with server-side totals — computed from analyst-defined metrics and joins, never guessed from raw tables — and manage recurring report run schedules. Your data stays in your warehouse; OWOX connects to it but never retains it.
plugin_details.target_long: OWOX 数据集市将 ChatGPT/Codex 连接到您公司的受管分析层。数据分析师在您自己的仓库（BigQuery、Snowflake、Databricks、Redshift、Athena）之上定义可信数据集市（指标、维度和联接逻辑）。从 ChatGPT/Codex，您可以通过自然语言搜索发现正确的数据集市、检查其字段、查询受管理的数据并通过服务器端总计（根据分析师定义的指标和联接计算，从未从原始表猜测）获得答案，并管理定期报告运行计划。您的数据保留在您的仓库中； OWOX 连接到它但从不保留它。

source_long:
OakbrookOne in ChatGPT helps you explore how turning multiple debts into one monthly payment could work for you - through a simple conversation. 

Share details about the debts you’re managing and see illustrative repayment scenarios. You can understand how combining balances into one structured plan might affect your monthly payment and overall repayment timeline. 

If you choose to proceed, you can continue your application securely on Oakbrook’s website. OakbrookOne will arrange repayment directly with your existing creditors if your application is approved. 

OakbrookOne provides general information and example calculations only. Eligibility, loan terms and creditor repayment are subject to Oakbrook’s standard lending assessment.
plugin_details.target_long:
ChatGPT 中的 OakbrookOne 可帮助您探索如何通过简单的对话将多笔债务转化为每月还款额。 

分享有关您正在管理的债务的详细信息，并查看说明性的还款方案。您可以了解将余额合并到一个结构化计划中可能会如何影响您的每月付款和总体还款时间表。 

如果您选择继续，您可以在 Oakbrook 网站上安全地继续您的申请。如果您的申请获得批准，OakbrookOne 将直接与您现有的债权人安排还款。 

OakbrookOne 仅提供一般信息和示例计算。资格、贷款条款和债权人还款均须遵守奥克布鲁克的标准贷款评估。

source_long: OathMCP helps users find, inspect, and run 39 established clinical calculators with explicit units, deterministic results, plausibility checks, limitations, and evidence links.
plugin_details.target_long: OathMCP 帮助用户查找、检查和运行 39 个已建立的临床计算器，具有明确的单位、确定性结果、合理性检查、限制和证据链接。

source_long: Obolus helps users calculate net income from gross salary and compare salary, tax, and social contribution outcomes across supported countries. The app supports detailed payroll calculations for one or two persons, cross-country net income comparisons, and a ChatGPT result panel for relocation, job offer, and salary planning workflows.
plugin_details.target_long: Obolus 帮助用户根据工资总额计算净收入，并比较受支持国家/地区的工资、税收和社会贡献结果。该应用程序支持一两个人的详细工资计算、跨国净收入比较以及用于搬迁、工作机会和薪资规划工作流程的 ChatGPT 结果面板。

source_long: Ocoya helps users inspect social profiles and posts, create AI-assisted drafts and campaigns, schedule or publish social content, and manage automation workflows from ChatGPT.

source_long:

source_long: Octopad is a shared back-office where your team's strategy, work, and memory live in one place that every AI you use can read and update. Connect it, and your AI can plan and track tasks tied to your goals, write and search your team's pages and decisions, and get a briefing tailored to each task so it starts already caught up.

source_long: Octopart Component Finder helps users search electronic components by description or manufacturer part number, compare distributor pricing, check stock availability, and view regional pricing and availability in a ChatGPT widget.

source_long: Olostep turns the web into clean, structured data for AI. source_long:
Omphalis is the place where what you read, hear, and note begins to cohere. You save an article, and Omphalis shows its structure. You listen to a podcast on your commute, and Omphalis helps you come back to what mattered. You watch a two-hour talk, and Omphalis shows you the shape of it in seconds. You record a voice note at midnight, and Omphalis places it beside the article, talk, or paper that belongs with it.

The paper you read last spring meets the book you are reading now, and your voice note from a walk last month sits beside both. What changed in the field, what changed in your understanding, what still holds: all part of the same library, still in reach, still connected. Not a pile that grows heavier. A place that gets clearer.

It is for people who need what they consume to stay usable later — in writing, teaching, decision-making, research, or reflection — where understanding can compound over time.

Omphalis is a companion for long content: a map for structure, a margin for meaning, and a way back to the moments that matter.
plugin_details.target_long:
脐是你所读、所听、所记的内容开始融为一体的地方。您保存一篇文章，Omphalis 会显示其结构。您在上下班途中收听播客，Omphalis 可以帮助您回到重要的事情上。你观看一个两个小时的演讲，Omphalis 会在几秒钟内向你展示它的形状。你在午夜录制一条语音笔记，Omphalis 将其放在与之相关的文章、演讲或论文旁边。

你去年春天读过的报纸和你现在正在读的书相遇，你上个月散步时的语音笔记就位于两者旁边。现场发生了什么变化，你的理解发生了什么变化，什么仍然有效：同一个图书馆的所有部分，仍然触手可及，仍然相连。不是一堆越来越重的东西。一个变得更加清晰的地方。

它适合那些需要他们所消费的东西以便以后可以使用的人——在写作、教学、决策、研究或反思中——随着时间的推移，理解会变得更加复杂。

Omphalis 是长内容的伴侣：结构图、意义边距以及回到重要时刻的方式。

source_long:
Exercise now or wait. Sell at vest or hold. Which lots to sell first. Each of these has a right answer for your specific situation, and it turns on how alternative minimum tax (AMT), holding periods, state tax, and the time value of taxes paid early interact across several years. That is where rules of thumb break down. Ask in plain language and OptionsAhoy returns the answer with the year-by-year schedule behind it.

1. Which incentive stock options (ISOs) to exercise in which year, to hold down AMT and recover the credit later. We optimize across multiple years, with your tax status in mind.

2. Whether to sell restricted stock units (RSUs) at vest or hold for long-term capital gains, and what the twelve-month cliff is actually worth. We show you the optimal solution.

3. Which vested RSU lots to sell and in what order, and what that saves against selling oldest-first (the default order your broker's UI will offer). This sounds like a minute optimization. On a $725,000 sale from a concentrated position, the gap between the optimal order and your broker's default could be over $100,000 in tax.

4. Whether non-qualified stock options (NSOs) are better exercised and sold, or exercised and held.

5. Whether your shares pass the six statutory tests for qualified small business stock (QSBS). Best to check early for potential tax savings, the rules just changed.

6. How exposed a single position leaves you, and what selling down, holding, or hedging each cost. We calculate and compare different strategies across three years, with your taxes in mind.

7. What a protective put or a zero-cost collar prices at. If you need to protect your holdings, you're probably considering a hedge. But which one? We make it easy to decide.

8. How to convert some of your holdings to a target amount of after-tax cash by a deadline with the smallest tax bill. We optimize against your inputs and risk tolerance, then you choose, the way an investment firm would.

Every result is computed against the federal tax code plus all fifty states and the District of Columbia. The 2026 federal constants match IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32. Federal cases reproduce to the cent against the independently maintained PSL Tax-Calculator, and state results reproduce to the cent against OpenTaxSolver across California, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Massachusetts. That proof recomputes live in your browser at optionsahoy.com/verification.

This matters because language models are confident and wrong at exactly this task. In a published benchmark, five frontier models were given the same multi-year ISO problem, three runs each. All five overstated the after-tax value of their own proposed schedules, by 1.6x to 17.6x against the provable optimum. One model claimed $3.9M, $5.2M, and $13.0M on three runs of identical input. The prompt and full transcripts are public at optionsahoy.com/benchmark. The arithmetic here is deterministic instead: the same inputs on the same date give the same answer every time, with no model inference anywhere in the number.

Free, no account, no API key, and your figures are not retained. United States tax logic only. This is a planning calculator, not tax advice.
plugin_details.target_long:
现在就锻炼或者等待。卖出或持有。首先出售哪些拍品。每个问题都有适合您具体情况的正确答案，并且取决于替代最低税 (AMT)、持有期、州税和提前缴纳税款的时间价值在几年内如何相互作用。这就是经验法则失效的地方。用简单的语言询问，OptionsAhoy 会返回答案，并附上每年的时间表。

1. 在哪一年行使哪种激励股票期权（ISO），以压低 AMT 并在以后收回信用。我们会根据您的税务状况进行多年优化。

2. 是出售归属限制性股票单位（RSU）还是持有以获得长期资本收益，以及十二个月悬崖的实际价值是多少。我们向您展示最佳解决方案。

3. 哪些既得 RSU 手数要出售，按什么顺序出售，以及相对于出售最旧的优先（您的经纪商 UI 将提供的默认顺序）可以节省什么。这听起来像是一个微小的优化。如果集中头寸的销售额为 725,000 美元，最佳订单与经纪商违约订单之间的差距可能会超过 100,000 美元的税金。

4. 非合格股票期权（NSO）是更好地行使和出售，还是行使和持有。

5. 您的股票是否通过了合格小型企业股票（QSBS）的六项法定测试。最好尽早检查是否有可能节省税收，因为规则刚刚发生了变化。

6. 单个头寸给您带来的风险有多大，以及抛售、持有或对冲各自的成本是多少。我们会计算并比较三年内的不同策略，并考虑到您的税收。

7. 保护性看跌期权或零成本项圈的价格是多少。如果您需要保护您的资产，您可能会考虑进行对冲。但哪一个呢？我们让您轻松做出决定。

8. 如何在截止日期前以最少的税款将您的部分资产转换为目标金额的税后现金。我们根据您的投入和风险承受能力进行优化，然后您选择，就像投资公司那样。

每个结果都是根据联邦税法以及所有五十个州和哥伦比亚特区计算的。 2026 年联邦常量与 IRS 收入程序 2025-32 相符。针对独立维护的 PSL 税务计算器的联邦案件可精确到分，加利福尼亚州、纽约州、新泽西州、宾夕法尼亚州和马萨诸塞州针对 OpenTaxSolver 的州结果可精确到分。该证明会在您的浏览器中重新计算，网址为 optionsahoy.com/verification。

这很重要，因为语言模型在这项任务上是自信的，但却是错误的。在发布的基准测试中，五个前沿模型面临相同的多年 ISO 问题，每个模型运行 3 次。所有五个人都高估了自己提议的时间表的税后价值，比可证明的最佳值高出 1.6 倍到 17.6 倍。一款模型在三轮相同输入中分别获得了 390 万美元、520 万美元和 1300 万美元的回报。提示和完整记录在 optionsahoy.com/benchmark 上公开。这里的算术是确定性的：同一日期的相同输入每次都会给出相同的答案，数字中的任何地方都没有模型推断。

免费，无需帐户，无需API密钥，并且您的数据不会被保留。仅限美国税收逻辑。这是一个规划计算器，而不是税务建议。

1. Connect: Connect the Outliner app to ChatGPT.

Easily edit, annotate, and sign PDF documents right in your browser. PDF Editor Pro lets you modify text, add images, highlight important sections, and edit PDFs using simple text prompts.

Key features:

* Edit text and images directly in PDFs
* Edit PDFs using AI-powered prompts (just describe what you want to change)
* Add annotations, comments, and highlights
* Sign documents with your signature
* Fill and save PDF forms
* Merge and split PDF files
* Convert PDFs to other formats
* Password protect sensitive documents

Perfect for students, professionals, and anyone who works with PDFs daily. No installation required - start editing immediately with our intuitive interface. Your documents are processed securely and never stored on our servers.
plugin_details.target_long:
直接在浏览器中轻松编辑、注释和签署 PDF 文档。 PDF Editor Pro 允许您修改文本、添加图像、突出显示重要部分以及使用简单的文本提示编辑 PDF。

主要特点：

* 直接在 PDF 中编辑文本和图像
* 使用人工智能提示编辑 PDF（只需描述您想要更改的内容）
* 添加注释、评论和亮点
* 用您的签名签署文件
* 填写并保存 PDF 表格
* 合并和分割PDF文件
* 将PDF转换为其他格式
* 密码保护敏感文档

非常适合学生、专业人士和任何每天使用 PDF 的人。无需安装 - 使用我们直观的界面立即开始编辑。您的文档将得到安全处理，并且绝不会存储在我们的服务器上。

source_long: Convert PDFs and Office files, compress PDFs, merge documents, extract tables, and manage PDF pages in ChatGPT using attachments or an upload widget. Results are returned as downloadable files.
plugin_details.target_long: 使用附件或上传小部件在 ChatGPT 中转换 PDF 和 Office 文件、压缩 PDF、合并文档、提取表格以及管理 PDF 页面。结果以可下载文件的形式返回。

source_long:
Connect pdf.net to edit, generate, and organize PDFs in ChatGPT. Your pdf.net library connects directly — no re-uploading every time.

Edit PDFs in place: change text, fix dates, fill forms. Generate new PDFs from a prompt — invoices, contracts, proposals. Merge up to 20 PDFs, split by page range, compress, and convert to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint. Translate full documents while keeping the layout. Organize your library into folders.

---

Working with PDFs can be slow. You convert to Word to edit, switch tools to merge, pay extra to translate, and dig through folders to find the file. pdf.net puts all of it in one chat.

Edit PDFs in place — no Word roundtrip. Generate invoices, contracts, and proposals from a prompt. Merge up to 20 files, split by page, compress, and convert to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint. Translate full documents while keeping the layout. Your pdf.net library stays connected, so files are one message away.
plugin_details.target_long:
连接 pdf.net 在 ChatGPT 中编辑、生成和组织 PDF。您的 pdf.net 库直接连接 — 无需每次重新上传。

就地编辑 PDF：更改文本、修复日期、填写表格。根据提示生成新的 PDF - 发票、合同、提案。合并最多 20 个 PDF、按页面范围拆分、压缩并转换为 Word、Excel 或 PowerPoint。翻译完整文档，同时保持布局。将您的库组织到文件夹中。

---

使用 PDF 可能会很慢。您可以转换为 Word 进行编辑，切换工具进行合并，支付额外费用进行翻译，并在文件夹中挖掘以查找文件。 pdf.net 将所有内容集中在一次聊天中。

就地编辑 PDF — 无需 Word 往返。根据提示生成发票、合同和提案。合并最多 20 个文件、按页面拆分、压缩并转换为 Word、Excel 或 PowerPoint。翻译完整文档，同时保持布局。您的 pdf.net 图书馆保持连接，因此只需一则消息即可获取文件。

source_long:
PDF4me delivers an intelligent and efficient solution for all your PDFs.
Boost your productivity with PDF4me: access crucial data, make edits, and convert files to PDFs directly —all in ChatGPT. From single-document conversion to mega data files, PDF4me is there.
plugin_details.target_long:
PDF4me 为您的所有 PDF 提供智能且高效的解决方案。
使用 PDF4me 提高您的工作效率：访问关键数据、进行编辑以及直接将文件转换为 PDF - 一切都在 ChatGPT 中进行。从单文档转换到大型数据文件，PDF4me 无处不在。

source_long:
PFT EdgeBook connects your AI assistant to your own trading journal. Once linked, your assistant can read your real trading data. Just ask about your performance in plain language instead of digging through spreadsheets.

Ask things like "How did my breakout setups perform this month?", "Where am I losing the most?" or "Am I sticking to my own rules?" — and get answers based on your actual trades.

Your assistant can read:
- Trades — entries, exits, size, P&L, R-multiple, tags
- Statistics — win rate, profit factor, average win/loss
- Journal & notes — your daily reflections and voice notes
- Playbook — your setups and rules, to check compliance
- Prop-firm & broker accounts — balances, drawdown, transactions

Private and read-only by design. The connector can only read your data — it can never change or delete anything. You sign in securely with your PFT account (OAuth), every request is limited to your own data, and account numbers are masked. Your data is stored in the EU.

Requires an EdgeBook account (part of the PFT Terminal) with the AI add-on enabled.
plugin_details.target_long:
PFT EdgeBook 将您的人工智能助手连接到您自己的交易日志。连接后，您的助手可以读取您的真实交易数据。只需用通俗易懂的语言询问您的表现，而不是翻阅电子表格。

问诸如“这个月我的突破设置表现如何？”、“我在哪里损失最多？”之类的问题。或者“我遵守自己的规则吗？” — 并根据您的实际交易获得答案。

您的助理可以阅读：
- 交易 — 入场、出场、规模、盈亏、R 倍数、标签
- 统计数据——赢率、盈利系数、平均赢/输
- 日记和笔记——你的日常反思和语音笔记
- Playbook — 您的设置和规则，用于检查合规性
- 自营公司和经纪商账户——余额、提款、交易

设计上是私有且只读的。连接器只能读取您的数据 - 它永远无法更改或删除任何内容。您使用 PFT 帐户 (OAuth) 安全登录，每个请求仅限于您自己的数据，并且帐号被屏蔽。您的数据存储在欧盟。

需要启用 AI 插件的 EdgeBook 帐户（PFT 终端的一部分）。

source_long:
Get personalized coaching from a PGA of America Golf Professional, whose expertise and on-course insight helps you understand your game more clearly and improve where it matters most. Find a golf coach matched to your goals, skill level, location, and schedule.

Use this app to compare coach offerings, view their availability, and book a lesson that fits your schedule. Online tips and videos can help, but taking a lesson with the right coach is the most effective way to make lasting improvements and play better golf with confidence.
plugin_details.target_long:
从美国 PGA 高尔夫专业人士处获得个性化指导，他们的专业知识和球场洞察力可帮助您更清楚地了解您的比赛并在最重要的方面进行改进。寻找一位与您的目标、技能水平、地点和日程相匹配的高尔夫教练。

使用此应用程序可以比较教练服务、查看其可用性并预订适合您日程安排的课程。在线技巧和视频可能会有所帮助，但与合适的教练一起上课是实现持久进步并自信地打出更好高尔夫球的最有效方法。

source_long: PGicover helps Canadian business owners understand personal guarantee insurance, get an indicative monthly cost estimate for insuring a personal guarantee on commercial debt, and check basic eligibility. Underwritten by Markel, rated A plus by AM Best. Applications are completed at app.pgicover.com.
plugin_details.target_long: PGicover 帮助加拿大企业主了解个人担保保险，获得为商业债务提供个人担保的指示性每月成本估算，并检查基本资格。由 Markel 承保，AM Best 评级为 A+。申请可在 app.pgicover.com 上完成。

source_long: Operated by mediaconstructor GmbH & Co. KG on behalf of PLAZA Hotelgroup GmbH. Ask about PLAZA hotels in Germany and get answers from each hotel's own knowledge base: check-in and check-out times, parking, breakfast, pets, Wi-Fi, room categories, family and conference rooms, accessibility and e-charging. Ask what is worth seeing nearby, or what is on in the city during your stay. For every hotel you can also check live room availability with real prices for your dates and create a real reservation in the hotel's booking system without leaving the conversation. Payment never happens in chat: reservations under EUR 200 are confirmed directly and paid at the hotel, and from EUR 200 the booking system issues a three-day offer which the guest confirms with a card on its own secure page. No PLAZA account and no sign-in required.
plugin_details.target_long: 由 mediaconstructor GmbH & Co. KG 代表 PLAZA Hotelgroup GmbH 运营。询问德国的 PLAZA 酒店，并从每家酒店自己的知识库中获取答案：入住和退房时间、停车、早餐、宠物、Wi-Fi、房型、家庭和会议室、无障碍设施和电子充电。询问附近有什么值得参观的地方，或者您入住期间城里有什么活动。对于每家酒店，您还可以查看实时客房供应情况以及您所在日期的实际价格，并在酒店的预订系统中创建真实的预订，而无需离开对话。聊天中永远不会付款：200 欧元以下的预订可直接在酒店确认并付款，200 欧元起，预订系统会发出为期三天的优惠，客人可以在自己的安全页面上使用银行卡进行确认。没有 PLAZA 帐户，也无需登录。

source_long:
Paardplaats Horse Finder helps buyers find the right horse using advanced, structured filtering. Search by discipline, age, budget, level, and suitability to quickly narrow down the best matches.

Paardplaats.nl is a Dutch online equestrian marketplace.

Paardplaats Horse Finder 使用先进的结构化过滤功能帮助买家找到合适的马匹。按纪律、年龄、预算、水平和适合性进行搜索，以快速缩小最佳匹配范围。

Paardplaats.nl 是荷兰在线马术市场。

source_long: Pablooo.club helps users search a large screenshot library of iOS, Android, and web apps, compare real product UI patterns, filter by app, screen type, and device type, display results in a carousel, and fetch individual screenshots for closer visual analysis.
plugin_details.target_long: Pablooo.club 帮助用户搜索 iOS、Android 和 Web 应用程序的大型屏幕截图库，比较真实的产品 UI 模式，按应用程序、屏幕类型和设备类型进行过滤，在轮播中显示结果，并获取单个屏幕截图以进行更仔细的视觉分析。

source_long: Pace is the context layer for your sales pipeline. It pre-computes deal intelligence from your CRM, emails, and call recordings, then serves it to your AI assistant as live, structured context on every deal. Ask what's really going on with an account, get AI risk and forecast assessments backed by evidence, catch deals that have gone quiet, and know precisely where your team is going to land. No more digging through Salesforce or HubSpot, no more guessing.
plugin_details.target_long: Pace 是销售渠道的上下文层。它根据您的 CRM、电子邮件和通话录音预先计算交易情报，然后将其作为每笔交易的实时结构化上下文提供给您的人工智能助手。询问账户的实际情况，获取有证据支持的人工智能风险和预测评估，捕捉已经平静的交易，并准确了解您的团队将在哪里落地。不再需要通过 Salesforce 或 HubSpot 进行挖掘，不再需要猜测。

source_long: PaceKeeper helps athletes review their profile and sport settings, inspect planned and completed training, understand wellness and recovery trends, and analyze compressed activity streams from their connected intervals.icu account.
plugin_details.target_long: PaceKeeper 帮助运动员查看他们的个人资料和运动设置，检查计划和已完成的训练，了解健康和恢复趋势，并分析来自其连接的 Interval.icu 帐户的压缩活动流。

source_long: Pacelab Intervals helps users create structured interval workouts, schedule them in their Pacelab calendar, update saved workouts, and review recent workout history through ChatGPT.
plugin_details.target_long: Pacelab Intervals 帮助用户创建结构化的间歇锻炼，在 Pacelab 日历中安排它们，更新保存的锻炼，并通过 ChatGPT 查看最近的锻炼历史记录。

source_long: Design your run in ChatGPT, then go run it. Pacing takes the workout or training plan you put together in conversation and turns it into a real, coached session on your phone, so nothing gets lost copying splits into a notes app. Ask for whatever you're training for: a 6x800m interval session, an easy long run, a threshold tempo, or a full multi-week build from couch-to-5K to marathon. When it's ready, Pacing hands it off with a card, code, deep link, or QR scan. Open it in the Pacing mobile app and it becomes a live workout, with real-time voice cues that talk you through every interval, nudge you when your pace drifts, and give you a heads-up before each change. Prefer to train by feel? Turn on heart-rate zone guidance, including live heart rate from AirPods Pro 3 on supported iOS devices. Review the session, adjust the paces, save it, schedule it, or just hit start. No GPS watch needed.
plugin_details.target_long: 在 ChatGPT 中设计您的运行，然后运行它。节奏将您在对话中整理的锻炼或训练计划转化为手机上真实的、经过指导的课程，因此将拆分复制到笔记应用程序中不会丢失任何内容。询问您的训练目的：6x800 米间歇训练、轻松长跑、阈值节奏，或者从沙发到 5 公里再到马拉松的完整多周训练。准备就绪后，Pacing 会通过卡片、代码、深层链接或二维码扫描将其交给您。在 Pacing 移动应用程序中打开它，它就变成了实时锻炼，带有实时语音提示，可以引导您完成每个间隔，在您的配速漂移时提醒您，并在每次改变之前给您提醒。喜欢凭感觉训练？打开心率区指导，包括支持的 iOS 设备上 AirPods Pro 3 的实时心率。查看训练、调整节奏、保存、安排时间或直接开始。无需 GPS 手表。

source_long:
Get instant answers about professional padel.

Look up any player's profile, ranking history and career stats. Compare head-to-head records between players or pairs. Explore tournament results, match scores, detailed match statistics and point-by-point breakdowns. Simulate matchups based on real performance data. 查找任何球员的个人资料、排名历史和职业统计数据。比较玩家或配对之间的交锋记录。探索锦标赛结果、比赛得分、详细的比赛统计数据和逐点细分。根据真实表现数据模拟比赛。覆盖范围涵盖 Premier Padel 和 FIP 巡回赛，以及历史的 World Padel 巡回赛和 Pro Padel 巡回赛数据。

source_long:
PagePulse brings your Google Search Console data, Google Analytics 4 metrics, and detected on-page change history into ChatGPT. Ask about your sites by project, page, or topic and get answers grounded in your actual analytics.
The unique angle is correlation. PagePulse tracks every detected change to your pages — title rewrites, content updates, schema edits, link changes — and scores each one by importance. So when you ask "why did traffic drop on the pricing page last week?", ChatGPT can pull the analytics, surface the relevant page changes, and show you which edits lined up with the shift.
Use it to investigate traffic dips, audit what's been changing across your site, find the queries driving impressions to a specific page, browse pages by tag, or get a quick read on how a project is performing — without switching between dashboards.
plugin_details.target_long:
PagePulse 将您的 Google Search Console 数据、Google Analytics 4 指标以及检测到的页面更改历史记录引入 ChatGPT。按项目、页面或主题询问您的网站，并根据您的实际分析获得答案。
独特的角度是相关性。 PagePulse 跟踪检测到的每一项页面更改（标题重写、内容更新、架构编辑、链接更改），并按重要性对每一项进行评分。因此，当您询问“为什么上周定价页面上的流量下降？”时，ChatGPT 可以提取分析，显示相关页面更改，并向您显示哪些编辑与转变一致。
使用它来调查流量下降、审核整个网站的变化、查找推动特定页面展示的查询、按标签浏览页面或快速了解项目的执行情况，而无需在仪表板之间切换。

source_long: PageShare lets you share and protect HTML pages generated with ChatGPT. Publish new and update existing pages, control access with passwords or email rules, manage custom domains and tracking links, and review analytics for your sites.
plugin_details.target_long: PageShare 允许您共享和保护使用 ChatGPT 生成的 HTML 页面。发布新页面和更新现有页面，使用密码或电子邮件规则控制访问，管理自定义域和跟踪链接，以及查看网站的分析。

source_long: Paloma helps you find and book venues for private parties, events, and large group dining. source_long:
Everything your favorite kitchen management app does, and more, inside ChatGPT.

Pantry Persona remembers what's in your fridge, what your family can and can't eat, and which brands you prefer. It stores your recipes, plans your meals, builds your shopping lists, and tracks the nutrition behind it all, then keeps everything in sync as you cook and shop through the week

**Recipes** — Save a recipe from a website, a cooking video, or a social post, or just create one in conversation. Search by ingredient, cuisine, or what you can make right now with what's on hand, and group your favorites into collections.

**Meal plans** — Generate a full week of meals in one ask, or build it day by day. Plans respect your household's food preferences and eating rules automatically, and carry per-meal nutrition so you can see how the week shapes up.

**Shopping lists** — Visual, interactive lists organized by store. One tap checks items off. Ask for a shopping list from your meal plan and it skips anything already in your pantry. Send it to Instacart when you're ready to buy.

**Cook Mode** — Start cooking a recipe and get step-by-step guidance. When you're done, ingredients are deducted from your pantry and leftovers are tracked with expiration dates.

**Nutrition** —  See calories and macros on every recipe and meal, set your own daily targets for each person, and check how today or the week is stacking up. Log what you actually ate, even a meal out, and it counts toward your totals.

**Your kitchen, personalized** — Household profiles store each family member's food preferences, eating rules, favorite brands, and nutrition targets. Every suggestion, plan, and search filters through them so you don't have to repeat yourself. Invite other family members and everyone works from the same pantry, recipes, and shopping lists in real time.

Also tracks pantry expiration dates, predicts when you'll run low on staples, learns the brands and prices you buy, and turns grocery receipts into an up-to-date inventory and a clear picture of your spending.
plugin_details.target_long:
您最喜欢的厨房管理应用程序所做的一切以及更多功能都在 ChatGPT 中。

Pantry Persona 会记住您冰箱里的东西、您的家人可以吃什么、不能吃什么以及您喜欢哪些品牌。它存储您的食谱，计划您的膳食，建立您的购物清单，并跟踪这一切背后的营养成分，然后在您一周烹饪和购物时保持所有内容同步

**食谱** — 从网站、烹饪视频或社交帖子中保存食谱，或者只是在对话中创建食谱。按食材、美食或您现在可以用现有材料制作的食物进行搜索，并将您最喜欢的食物分组到集合中。

**膳食计划** — 一次性生成一整周的膳食，或逐日制定。计划会自动尊重您家庭的食物偏好和饮食规则，并提供每餐营养，以便您了解一周的情况。

**购物清单** — 按商店组织的可视化交互式清单。一键检查项目。从你的膳食计划中索要一份购物清单，它会跳过你食品储藏室里已有的任何东西。当您准备购买时，将其发送到 Instacart。

**烹饪模式** — 开始烹饪菜谱并获得分步指导。完成后，配料将从您的食品储藏室中扣除，并跟踪剩余的食品和过期日期。

**营养** — 查看每份食谱和膳食的卡路里和宏量，为每个人设定自己的每日目标，并检查今天或本周的进展情况。记录你实际吃了什么，甚至是外出就餐，它都会会计入你的总数。

**您的个性化厨房** — 家庭档案存储每个家庭成员的食物偏好、饮食规则、喜爱的品牌和营养目标。每个建议、计划和搜索都会经过它们的过滤，因此您不必重复自己。邀请其他家庭成员，每个人都可以实时使用同一个食品储藏室、食谱和购物清单。

还可以跟踪食品储藏室的有效期，预测您的主食何时会耗尽，了解您购买的品牌和价格，并将杂货收据转化为最新的库存和清晰的支出情况。

source_long: PaperDock helps researchers work on private LaTeX projects through ChatGPT. Users can create projects, find and edit source files, add or replace project files, and collaborate through Comments and Chat. Every action follows the user's current PaperDock project role, and source edits remain inspectable through Review changes.

source_long: Your official digital concierge for Paradise Beach Cozumel. Easily manage or modify your reservations, explore day pass packages, check pricing, and get instant answers about amenities, add-ons, and everything you need for the ultimate beach day.

source_long:
Connect your Parallel financial plan to Claude, ChatGPT, and any other MCP-compatible assistant. Ask questions about your model in plain language and get grounded, real-time answers pulled straight from your live data, with no exporting, no copy-paste, and no stale spreadsheets.

The server exposes Parallel's core planning surface as a set of tools: query your P&L, revenue and expense forecasts, headcount and hiring plans, monthly reports, and the assumptions driving your model. Your assistant can pull the exact numbers it needs to answer a question, compare scenarios, or summarize where the business is headed.

Access is read-only and secured with OAuth. Your assistant can explore and report on your financials but never modify them. You connect once, scope what it can see, and revoke access any time.
plugin_details.target_long:
将您的并行财务计划连接到 Claude、ChatGPT 和任何其他 MCP 兼容的助手。用简单的语言询问有关模型的问题，并直接从实时数据中获得可靠的实时答案，无需导出、复制粘贴，也没有过时的电子表格。

服务器将 Parallel 的核心规划界面作为一组工具公开：查询您的损益表、收入和费用预测、员工人数和招聘计划、月度报告以及驱动模型的假设。您的助手可以提取回答问题、比较场景或总结业务发展方向所需的确切数字。

访问权限是只读的，并通过 OAuth 进行保护。您的助手可以探索并报告您的财务状况，但绝不能修改它们。您连接一次，确定它可以看到的范围，并随时撤销访问权限。

An intuitive platform to use, even without experience in the Dutch rental market. Search for the home that fits you, from studios and apartments in Amsterdam to family houses in Apeldoorn.
plugin_details.target_long: 有了Pararius，每个人都可以轻松找到合适的家。打开网站或应用程序，只需几秒钟即可搜索荷兰最大的私营住房供应。输入城市、社区或邮政编码来发现房产，使用过滤器按价格、面积、房间或家具数量细化列表，设置提醒以成为第一个了解新房的人，并直接联系代理商。即使没有荷兰租赁市场经验，也可以使用直观的平台。寻找适合您的家，从阿姆斯特丹的单间公寓和普通公寓到阿珀尔多伦的家庭住宅。

source_long: Parra-Glideator helps pilots narrow down where and when conditions look most promising. source_long:
Search and read patents, trademarks, and registered designs from the major IP offices - right inside ChatGPT.

Patents: full search and documents (claims, abstracts, descriptions) for the US (USPTO), Europe (EPO), and Germany (DPMA); patent search for Australia (IP Australia); and bibliography and legal status for Japan (JPO) and Taiwan (TIPO). Plus patent families, prosecution history and USPTO office actions, side-by-side comparison, and ownership/assignment records.

Trademarks: search the EU (EUIPO) and Australia registers; status and documents for the US (USPTO/TSDR), EU, Japan, Australia, and Taiwan.

Designs: search registered designs and view images for the EU (EUIPO), Japan, and Australia.

Requires free API credentials from the offices you want to use - set up in minutes at patent.dev/patent-connector (free).
plugin_details.target_long:
搜索并阅读来自主要知识产权局的专利、商标和注册设计 - 就在 ChatGPT 内。

专利：美国 (USPTO)、欧洲 (EPO) 和德国 (DPMA) 的完整检索和文件（权利要求书、摘要、说明书）；澳大利亚专利检索（澳大利亚知识产权局）；日本 (JPO) 和台湾 (TIPO) 的参考书目和法律地位。加上专利族、起诉历史和美国专利商标局审查意见、并排比较以及所有权/转让记录。

商标：检索欧盟 (EUIPO) 和澳大利亚注册簿；美国 (USPTO/TSDR)、欧盟、日本、澳大利亚和台湾的状态和文件。

外观设计：搜索欧盟 (EUIPO)、日本和澳大利亚的注册外观设计并查看图像。

需要您想要使用的办公室提供免费的 API 凭据 - 只需几分钟即可在 patent.dev/patent-connector 上设置（免费）。

source_long: A professional tool enabling deep, integrated search across the Patsnap global patent and literature databases simultaneously. This MCP also allows users to fetch basic bibliographic data for patents or literature in Markdown format.

source_long:
Patlytics brings concept-level, AI-native patent search into your assistant: semantic, not keyword-based. Describe an invention in plain prose and get the most relevant patents, look up any patent's claims, search the scientific literature, and pull your own organization's saved patents, all through structured, predictable tools (not a black box).


The five tools are read-only: semantic patent search (optionally anchored to a reference patent), patent lookup (bibliographic data and full claims), non-patent literature search (via OpenAlex), and listings of your organization's private portfolios and vault. Search is semantic, so a richer description (how an invention works, the problem it solves, its components) returns better results.


Access is for existing Patlytics users: each member signs in with their own account (OAuth), and results are scoped to their organization. Deeper work like freedom-to-operate opinions, infringement and invalidity claim charts, and patent drafting runs in the Patlytics web app, linked from every result.
plugin_details.target_long:
Patlytics 将概念级、人工智能原生专利搜索带入您的助手中：语义搜索，而不是基于关键字的搜索。用简单的散文描述一项发明，获取最相关的专利，查找任何专利的权利要求，搜索科学文献，并提取您自己组织保存的专利，所有这些都通过结构化、可预测的工具（而不是黑匣子）实现。


这五个工具是只读的：语义专利检索（可选择锚定到参考专利）、专利查找（书目数据和完整权利要求）、非专利文献检索（通过 OpenAlex）以及组织的私人专利组合和库列表。搜索是语义的，因此更丰富的描述（发明如何工作、它解决的问题、其组成部分）会返回更好的结果。


访问权限适用于现有 Patlytics 用户：每个成员使用自己的帐户 (OAuth) 登录，结果仅限于其组织。诸如自由操作意见、侵权和无效索赔图表以及专利起草等更深层次的工作在 Patlytics 网络应用程序中运行，并与每个结果相关联。

source_long:
Pendar gives you the shape of a research field, not a summary of it.

Point it at a topic and it reports how many papers exist, whether output is growing or flattening, which disciplines and countries produce them, and which papers to read first. Every figure is counted across the whole corpus rather than estimated from a sample, so you can plan around it.

Point it at a paper and it traces what happened next: whether citations are rising or fading, which fields picked the work up, whether industry or academia is building on it, and which authors cite it most. That is how you tell a paper quietly becoming foundational from one that peaked years ago.

Paste a bibliography and it checks each reference against the published record: whether the paper exists, whether the citation describes it accurately, and whether it has been retracted. A reference it cannot find is reported as unverified rather than swapped for the nearest real paper, which matters when the citations came from a model.

Every tool is read-only. Pendar looks things up and reports what it finds.
plugin_details.target_long:
Pendar 为您提供了一个研究领域的轮廓，而不是它的摘要。

将其指向一个主题，它会报告存在多少篇论文、产量是增长还是持平、哪些学科和国家产生了这些论文，以及首先阅读哪些论文。每个数字都是在整个语料库中计算的，而不是根据样本估计的，因此您可以围绕它进行计划。

将其指向一篇论文，它会追踪接下来发生的事情：引用是上升还是下降，哪些领域选择了该作品，工业界还是学术界是否在其基础上进行构建，以及哪些作者引用最多。这就是你如何区分一篇论文从几年前达到顶峰的论文悄然成为基础性的论文。

粘贴参考书目，它会根据已发布的记录检查每个参考文献：该论文是否存在，引文是否准确描述它，以及它是否已被撤回。它找不到的参考文献被报告为未经验证，而不是交换为最近的真实论文，当引用来自模型时，这一点很重要。

每个工具都是只读的。 Pendar 进行查找并报告所发现的内容。

source_long:
"Pet Project Co-Founder AI" is your market research assistant.

It will help you validate product ideas using real data from trusted market research services. No more guesses or hallucinations. Instead of relying on plain LLM-only answers, you will use raw market data interpreted by ChatGPT as clear insights.

You do not need prior marketing experience. You just ask a question and the app builds a market research plan for you. The plan will include gathering data from third-party services. You are guided through what services to use and what queries to run there. After you use the recommended service, you copy-paste their data back to the app and get a clear interpretation from ChatGPT.

Examples of questions you can get answers to:
- "I have an idea for the app X. Is there enough demand to justify building it?"
- "What are people searching for when they want Y?"
- "Who exactly is my target user for the app Z? What platforms do they use?"
- "I built an app W. Where do I find users for it?"

For now, the following services are supported:
- SparkToro — audience intelligence (who your users are, what they read, who they follow)
- Ubersuggest — keyword demand and SEO metrics
- AnswerThePublic — real search questions and phrasing

Disclaimers:
- This app does not automatically gather data from the recommended market research services. The app helps with building search queries for these services and reporting the resulting data back. But you will need to visit and use these services yourself. We do not automatically scrape data from these services.
- This app does not provide paid subscriptions to the recommended market research services. You use these services according to their terms of use.
- This app currently supports a limited set of services: SparkToro, Ubersuggest, and AnswerThePublic. Only these services may be recommended during marketing research. Keep in mind that there are other good services for market research on the internet, we just do not support them yet. You can request adding new services by emailing the [developer@petprojectcofounder.ai](mailto:developer@petprojectcofounder.ai)
- For the best experience, it is recommended to use this app on desktop
plugin_details.target_long:
“宠物项目联合创始人AI”是您的市场研究助手。

它将帮助您使用来自可信市场研究服务的真实数据来验证产品创意。不再有猜测或幻觉。您将使用 ChatGPT 解释的原始市场数据作为清晰的见解，而不是依赖纯 LLM 的答案。

您不需要事先的营销经验。您只需提出问题，应用程序就会为您制定市场研究计划。该计划将包括从第三方服务收集数据。系统会指导您使用哪些服务以及要运行哪些查询。使用推荐的服务后，您将其数据复制粘贴回应用程序，并从 ChatGPT 获得清晰的解释。

您可以获得答案的问题示例：
- “我对应用程序 X 有一个想法。是否有足够的需求来证明构建它的合理性？”
- “当人们想要 Y 时，他们在寻找什么？”
- “我的应用 Z 的目标用户到底是谁？他们使用什么平台？”
- “我构建了一个应用程序 W。我在哪里可以找到它的用户？”

目前，支持以下服务：
- SparkToro — 受众情报（您的用户是谁，他们读什么，他们关注谁）
- Ubersuggest — 关键词需求和 SEO 指标
- AnswerThePublic — 真实的搜索问题和措辞

免责声明：

source_long:
Pexafy searches photographs the way you would describe them to a person.

Ask for "someone working alone late at night in a quiet apartment, lit only by a
warm desk lamp" and you get photographs that match the scene — not photographs
tagged with those words. Search runs across nine free-license sources at once
(Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, Kaboompics, Burst, StockSnap, Picjumbo, Skitterphoto,
NegativeSpace) instead of one provider at a time.

Three tools, all read-only:

search_photos — describe a scene in a sentence, optionally filtered by colour,
orientation, source, licence, photographer or date.

search_photos_by_image — give a reference image and get visually similar
photographs, optionally adjusted in words: "like this, but at night".

get_similar_photos — more photographs like one already found, which is how you
keep a set visually consistent across an article or a deck.

Every result carries the credit line to display, the image at several sizes, and
its dimensions, dominant colour, orientation, source and licence. Results are
numbered, so you refer to a photograph the way you would in conversation —
"more like the third one" — rather than copying identifiers around.

In clients that render MCP Apps, results appear as a thumbnail grid inside the
conversation, and clicking one opens its full metadata without another call.

The connector is hosted, so there is nothing to install and no API key to paste
into a configuration file: you sign in to Pexafy once in a browser and the
connector receives its own credential, separate from your password and revocable
on its own. It is granted read access only and never asks for more.

A free Pexafy account covers 5,000 searches a month, with no card required.
plugin_details.target_long:
Pexafy 搜索照片的方式就像向某人描述照片一样。

要求“有人深夜在安静的公寓里独自工作，只有灯光照亮
温暖的台灯”，你会得到与场景相符的照片——而不是照片
标有这些词。搜索同时跨九个免费许可源运行
（Unsplash、Pexels、Pixabay、Kaboompics、Burst、StockSnap、Picjumbo、Skitterphoto、
NegativeSpace），而不是一次只提供一个提供者。

三个工具，均为只读：

search_photos — 用句子描述场景，可以选择按颜色过滤，
方向、来源、许可证、摄影师或日期。

search_photos_by_image — 提供参考图像并获得视觉相似度
照片，可选择用文字进行调整：“像这样，但在晚上”。

get_similar_photos — 更多类似已找到的照片，这就是您的方式
使整套文章或套牌在视觉上保持一致。

每个结果都带有要显示的信用额度、多种尺寸的图像，以及
它的尺寸、主色、方向、来源和许可。结果是
编号，这样你就可以像在谈话中那样引用照片——
“更像第三个”——而不是复制标识符。

在呈现 MCP 应用程序的客户端中，结果显示为缩略图网格内
对话，单击其中一个即可打开其完整元数据，无需再次调用。

连接器已托管，因此无需安装任何内容，也无需粘贴 API 密钥
进入配置文件：您在浏览器中登录 Pexafy 一次，然后
连接器接收自己的凭据，与您的密码分开并且可撤销
靠它自己。它仅被授予读取访问权限，并且不会要求更多权限。

免费的 Pexafy 帐户每月可进行 5,000 次搜索，无需银行卡。

source_long: PhysioKeys helps clinicians, students, educators, and researchers search physiotherapy and rehabilitation evidence from ChatGPT. Users can search curated PhysioKeys records or PubMed, fetch article details, review abstracts and rights-verified cached full text when available, generate citations, view saved-article metadata, save PMIDs to their private library, and check account allowances. The plugin is intended only for de-identified research and citation workflows and may refuse requests containing patient-identifiable information. It does not provide emergency diagnosis or personalized medical advice.
plugin_details.target_long: PhysioKeys 帮助临床医生、学生、教育工作者和研究人员从 ChatGPT 中搜索物理治疗和康复证据。用户可以搜索精选的 PhysioKeys 记录或 PubMed、获取文章详细信息、查看摘要和经过权限验证的缓存全文（如果可用）、生成引文、查看保存的文章元数据、将 PMID 保存到其私人图书馆以及检查帐户限额。该插件仅适用于去识别化的研究和引文工作流程，可能会拒绝包含患者身份信息的请求。它不提供紧急诊断或个性化医疗建议。

source_long: Placer.ai Pi answers business questions that turn on measured real-world behavior. Ask a full analytical question in plain language and Pi runs a complete Placer.ai analysis - foot traffic trends, visitor demographics and journeys, trade areas, cross-shopping, and sales and spend - then returns a written answer with data-honesty caveats, any web sources it used, and a deep link that opens the same analysis, with its interactive map, in Pi. A full analysis normally takes several minutes: ask_pi starts it and returns a handle, and get_pi_result collects the answer, reporting progress while the work runs. Typical workflows include store and portfolio performance, trade-area and site analysis, competitive benchmarking, tenant mix and co-tenancy review, market feasibility, and category or market-share tracking. Follow-up questions can reuse a previous analysis so the numbers stay consistent across a conversation. Access requires a Placer.ai account with Pi and the MCP access entitlement; Pi returns only the data the signed-in Placer user is entitled to see.
plugin_details.target_long: Placer.ai Pi 回答了基于可测量的现实世界行为的业务问题。用简单的语言提出一个完整的分析问题，Pi 会运行完整的 Placer.ai 分析 - 客流量趋势、游客人口统计和旅程、贸易区域、交叉购物以及销售和支出 - 然后返回一个书面答案，其中包含数据诚实警告、它使用的任何网络资源，以及在 Pi 中打开相同分析及其交互式地图的深层链接。完整的分析通常需要几分钟：ask_pi 启动它并返回句柄，get_pi_result 收集答案，在工作运行时报告进度。典型的工作流程包括商店和投资组合绩效、贸易区域和场地分析、竞争基准、租户组合和共同租赁审查、市场可行性以及类别或市场份额跟踪。后续问题可以重复使用之前的分析，以便数字在整个对话中保持一致。访问需要具有 Pi 的 Placer.ai 帐户和 MCP 访问权限； Pi 仅返回已登录 Placer 用户有权查看的数据。

source_long:

source_long:
PlatoForms is an online form builder for web forms, fillable PDF forms and PDF documents. This plugin connects your PlatoForms account so you can work with your own forms and their submissions in conversation, instead of opening the dashboard.

What you can do

• Find forms. List published, draft or archived forms with their folder, publish state and submission count, or search by name.

• Understand a form. Read a form's full field schema — every field's id, type, label, whether it is required, its options and its validation rules — so you can reason about the data before you touch it.

• Review submissions. List a form's submissions newest-first, filter them by date range or keyword, find one by an exact field value (for example the submission where the email field is a particular address), and read every answer of a single submission with its field labels.

• Export. Mint a time-limited download URL for a submission's PDF, CSV, signing certificate, zipped attachments or a single attachment. Files are never streamed through the conversation — you get a link that expires.

• Share a prefilled link. Create one or more tracked invitation links to a form with fields already filled in, optionally single-use, optionally with an expiry. The plugin returns the URLs for you to send; it never sends email itself.

• Submit an entry. Post an entry to a published form after reading its schema, with validation errors returned verbatim so mistakes can be corrected and resubmitted.

• Start something new. Describe a form or a PDF document in plain English and get a builder link back. The design happens in the PlatoForms builder when you open the link, with its own AI asking you the clarifying questions.

How it connects

Sign in with your PlatoForms account over OAuth — your password is never shared with the assistant, access is scoped to read or read-and-write, and you can revoke it at any time from your PlatoForms account. The plugin can only see what your own account can see. A team owner controls whether the team is reachable this way at all, from Account → API.

Requirements

A PlatoForms account on a plan that includes API access. Actions count against your plan's API allowance. Teams in HIPAA mode have this access switched off by default and must opt in explicitly; data sent to a third-party AI assistant is not covered by the PlatoForms Business Associate Agreement.

What the plugin cannot do

It cannot edit an existing form or document, publish, delete, rename or duplicate anything, send email, or configure workflows, integrations or notifications. Those stay in the PlatoForms editor.
plugin_details.target_long:
PlatoForms 是一个在线表单生成器，适用于 Web 表单、可填写的 PDF 表单和 PDF 文档。该插件连接您的 PlatoForms 帐户，以便您可以在对话中处理您自己的表单及其提交内容，而无需打开仪表板。

你能做什么

• 查找表格。列出已发布、草稿或存档的表单及其文件夹、发布状态和提交计数，或按名称搜索。

• 了解表格。阅读表单的完整字段架构 - 每个字段的 ID、类型、标签、是否必需、其选项及其验证规则 - 这样您就可以在接触数据之前对其进行推理。

• 审核提交的内容。按最新的顺序列出表单的提交内容，按日期范围或关键字过滤它们，按精确的字段值查找（例如电子邮件字段是特定地址的提交内容），并读取单个提交内容的每个答案及其字段标签。

• 出口。为提交的 PDF、CSV、签名证书、压缩附件或单个附件创建一个限时下载 URL。文件永远不会通过对话进行流式传输 - 您会得到一个过期的链接。

• 分享预先填写的链接。创建一个或多个指向已填写字段的表单的跟踪邀请链接，可以选择一次性使用，也可以选择过期。该插件返回 URL 供您发送；它本身从不发送电子邮件。

• 提交参赛作品。阅读其架构后将条目发布到已发布的表单，并逐字返回验证错误，以便可以更正并重新提交错误。

• 开始新的事情。用简单的英语描述表单或 PDF 文档并获取构建器链接。当您打开链接时，设计会在 PlatoForms 构建器中进行，它自己的 AI 会向您询问澄清问题。

如何连接

通过 OAuth 使用您的 PlatoForms 帐户登录 - 您的密码永远不会与助手共享，访问权限仅限于读取或读写，并且您可以随时从 PlatoForms 帐户中撤销它。该插件只能看到您自己的帐户可以看到的内容。团队所有者通过帐户 → API 控制是否可以通过这种方式访问​​团队。

要求

包含 API 访问权限的计划中的 PlatoForms 帐户。操作将计入您计划的 API 限额。处于 HIPAA 模式的团队默认关闭此访问权限，并且必须明确选择加入； PlatoForms 业务伙伴协议不涵盖发送给第三方人工智能助手的数据。

插件不能做什么

它无法编辑现有表单或文档、发布、删除、重命名或复制任何内容、发送电子邮件或配置工作流程、集成或通知。这些保留在 PlatoForms 编辑器中。
