source_long:
Bring an AI-powered visual design workflow into ChatGPT and Codex. Create, refine, review, and export polished, editable designs through natural conversation.

What you can create: AI presentations and pitch decks, posters and flyers, social media graphics, infographics, diagrams, cards, email designs, web concepts, UI mockups, and visual documents.

Create presentations: Turn a topic, outline, brief, or existing content into a polished, editable presentation. Create posters: Design event posters, promotional graphics, flyers, and visual art in any supported format. Create social media content: Produce editable designs for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and other channels. Create infographics and diagrams: Transform complex ideas, processes, and data into clear visual stories.

Recreate designs: Provide an image, screenshot, website, document, or design.md file as a visual reference. StarryKit analyzes its composition, typography, colors, hierarchy, and visual language, then recreates the direction with editable elements—without requiring a template.

Edit and refine: Rewrite complete pages or request focused changes to text, layout, colors, imagery, hierarchy, and formatting while preserving the rest of the design. Review generated page drafts in StarryKit before accepting them into your document.

Export designs: Download your finished work as PowerPoint, PDF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, or HTML, or export an editable presentation to Google Slides.

Once installed, describe what you want in plain language or invoke StarryKit directly with @StarryKit.

Try prompts like:
- @StarryKit, create a 10-slide investor pitch deck for a sustainable urban farming startup.
- @StarryKit, design a bold poster for an electronic music festival in Tokyo.
- @StarryKit, turn this report into a clear, visual infographic.
- @StarryKit, recreate this website screenshot as an editable visual design.
- @StarryKit, make the headline larger, highlight the key metric, and preserve everything else.
- @StarryKit, export this presentation to PowerPoint and Google Slides.
plugin_details.target_long:
将人工智能驱动的视觉设计工作流程引入 ChatGPT 和 Codex。通过自然对话创建、完善、审查和导出精美的可编辑设计。

您可以创建什么：人工智能演示文稿和宣传材料、海报和传单、社交媒体图形、信息图表、图表、卡片、电子邮件设计、网页概念、UI 模型和视觉文档。

创建演示文稿：将主题、大纲、摘要或现有内容转变为精美的、可编辑的演示文稿。创建海报：以任何支持的格式设计活动海报、宣传图形、传单和视觉艺术。创建社交媒体内容：为 Instagram、LinkedIn、Facebook 和其他渠道制作可编辑的设计。创建信息图表和图表：将复杂的想法、流程和数据转化为清晰的视觉故事。

重新创建设计：提供图像、屏幕截图、网站、文档或 design.md 文件作为视觉参考。 StarryKit 分析其构成、版式、颜色、层次结构和视觉语言，然后使用可编辑元素重新创建方向，而无需模板。

编辑和优化：重写完整页面或请求对文本、布局、颜色、图像、层次结构和格式进行重点更改，同时保留设计的其余部分。在将生成的页面草稿接受到文档中之前，先查看 StarryKit 中生成的页面草稿。

导出设计：将完成的作品下载为 PowerPoint、PDF、SVG、PNG、JPEG 或 HTML 格式，或将可编辑的演示文稿导出到 Google 幻灯片。

安装后，用简单的语言描述您想要的内容或直接使用 @StarryKit 调用 StarryKit。

尝试如下提示：
- @StarryKit，为可持续城市农业初创公司创建一个包含 10 张幻灯片的投资者推介材料。
- @StarryKit，为东京电子音乐节设计一张大胆的海报。
- @StarryKit，将此报告变成清晰、直观的信息图。
- @StarryKit，重新创建此网站屏幕截图作为可编辑的视觉设计。
- @StarryKit，使标题更大，突出显示关键指标，并保留其他所有内容。
- @StarryKit，将此演示文稿导出到 PowerPoint 和 Google 幻灯片。

source_long:
Sticklight is an AI-powered builder designed for professional web creators who want to build real digital products faster - without compromising on quality, control, or design standards.
You start by describing what you want to create in natural language, and Sticklight generates a working project with structure, interface, and core logic already in place. From there, creators can refine every detail - manually editing elements, adjusting layouts and interactions, and accessing the underlying code whenever needed. This allows professionals to keep full control over every pixel and maintain the level of craft their work demands.

What makes Sticklight especially valuable for experienced creators is the ability to produce non-generic results. Instead of templated outputs, the platform is designed to support custom design decisions and unique product ideas while still accelerating the building process. Creators can combine AI-assisted generation with their own expertise to deliver polished, high-quality experiences that are ready for real users and real traffic.

With Sticklight, creators can build complete applications - including dashboards, client portals, internal tools, MVPs, marketing platforms, and interactive products - not just static sites. The result is a stable, flexible environment where professionals can move from idea to fully functional application while maintaining the precision, reliability, and creative control their work requires.
plugin_details.target_long:
Sticklight 是一款人工智能驱动的构建器，专为想要更快地构建真正的数字产品的专业网络创建者而设计，同时又不影响质量、控制或设计标准。
您首先用自然语言描述您想要创建的内容，Sticklight 会生成一个工作项目，其中的结构、界面和核心逻辑已经就位。从那里，创建者可以完善每个细节 - 手动编辑元素、调整布局和交互，以及在需要时访问底层代码。这使得专业人员能够完全控制每个像素并保持其工作要求的工艺水平。

Sticklight 对于经验丰富的创作者来说尤其有价值，因为它能够产生非通用的结果。该平台不是模板化的输出，而是旨在支持定制设计决策和独特的产品创意，同时仍然加速构建过程。创作者可以将人工智能辅助生成与自己的专业知识相结合，提供精致、高质量的体验，为真实用户和真实流量做好准备。

借助 Sticklight，创建者可以构建完整的应用程序 - 包括仪表板、客户端门户、内部工具、MVP、营销平台和交互式产品 - 而不仅仅是静态网站。其结果是一个稳定、灵活的环境，专业人员可以从想法转向功能齐全的应用程序，同时保持工作所需的精确性、可靠性和创造性控制。

source_long:
The Stockholm Archipelago Trail app brings Sweden's 270 km island hiking trail into ChatGPT. Ask about any of the trail's ~20 island stages — from Arholma in the north to Landsort in the south — and get structured, up-to-date details: distance, difficulty, harbours and piers, and points of interest such as cafés, viewpoints, swimming spots, and shelters. The island stages are linked by public ferries, so you can plan routes that combine walking and boats.

Ask ChatGPT to show any stage on an interactive map, compare stages for a day trip or a multi-day hike, or pull practical details for the sections you're planning. All trail data is open (CC-BY-4.0) and read-only — the app stores no personal data. Place data comes from OpenStreetMap and Wikidata; the trail route is published by the Stockholm Archipelago Trail under CC-BY-4.0.
plugin_details.target_long:
斯德哥尔摩群岛步道应用程序将瑞典 270 公里的岛屿远足步道引入 ChatGPT。询问这条步道的约 20 个岛屿赛段（从北部的 Arholma 到南部的 Landsort）中的任何一个，并获取结构化的最新详细信息：距离、难度、港口和码头，以及咖啡馆、观景点、游泳点和避难所等景点。岛上各个舞台由公共渡轮连接，因此您可以规划步行和乘船相结合的路线。

要求 ChatGPT 在交互式地图上显示任何阶段，比较一日游或多日徒步旅行的阶段，或者提取您计划的路段的实用详细信息。所有轨迹数据都是开放的 (CC-BY-4.0) 和只读 — 该应用程序不存储个人数据。地点数据来自 OpenStreetMap 和 Wikidata；该步道路线由斯德哥尔摩群岛步道以 CC-BY-4.0 名义发布。

source_long:
StrategyTune is a backtesting platform for trading strategies, and this plugin gives ChatGPT hands-on access to it.

ChatGPT can write and save the pieces you build with — chart indicators, reusable market conditions (StrategyTune calls them signals and filters), and full trading strategies — then run them tick-by-tick against real historical market data in StrategyTune's sandboxed cloud. A simple strategy backtests a year of history in seconds, so you can iterate fast.

It is not limited to automated strategy backtesting. ChatGPT can run custom research code in the same sandbox: count how often a condition occurred, measure values at specific moments, gather your own statistics and write logs during the run. You say what you want to check, ChatGPT writes the code, runs it, reads the output back, and tells you what it found.

When a run finishes you get the full report — performance statistics and the individual trades behind them. ChatGPT can also work with a StrategyTune chart you already have open: read the bars and each indicator's computed values, add and configure indicators, mark those conditions on the timeline so you can see exactly when they held, and switch instrument or timeframe. Reading the computed values also lets it debug its own work: if an indicator it wrote looks wrong on your chart, it can check the actual numbers behind the line instead of guessing.

Everything runs on historical data. The plugin does not connect to a broker, place live orders, or give investment advice.
plugin_details.target_long:
StrategyTune 是一个交易策略回测平台，该插件让 ChatGPT 可以实际操作它。

ChatGPT 可以编写并保存您构建的部分 - 图表指标、可重复使用的市场条件（StrategyTune 将其称为信号和过滤器）以及完整的交易策略 - 然后在 StrategyTune 的沙盒云中针对真实的历史市场数据逐笔运行它们。一个简单的策略可以在几秒钟内回测一年的历史，因此您可以快速迭代。

它不仅限于自动化策略回测。 ChatGPT 可以在同一沙箱中运行自定义研究代码：计算情况发生的频率、测量特定时刻的值、收集您自己的统计数据并在运行期间写入日志。您说出要检查的内容，ChatGPT 会编写代码，运行它，读回输出，并告诉您发现了什么。

运行结束后，您将获得完整的报告——绩效统计数据以及背后的各个交易。 ChatGPT 还可以使用您已经打开的 StrategyTune 图表：读取柱形图和每个指标的计算值、添加和配置指标、在时间线上标记这些条件，以便您可以准确地看到它们何时保持，以及切换工具或时间范围。读取计算值还可以让它调试自己的工作：如果它编写的指标在图表上看起来错误，它可以检查线条后面的实际数字而不是猜测。

一切都基于历史数据。该插件不会连接到经纪人、下实时订单或提供投资建议。

source_long:
Stratyfix is an AI-driven sales intelligence platform. This plugin lets managers and reps ask about their own Stratyfix data in the chat they already use. Are we going to make the quarter? Who needs my attention this week? The answers come from the live platform.

Every person connects as themselves. A rep sees their own book and a manager sees their team, with the same permissions as the app itself. It is read only, so nothing in Stratyfix can be changed from chat. And it does not bluff. When Stratyfix withholds a number on purpose, because the odds are not calibrated yet or a target is not set, the plugin says exactly that instead of guessing.

You need a Stratyfix workspace, with the connector enabled by your administrator.
plugin_details.target_long:
Stratyfix 是一个人工智能驱动的销售智能平台。该插件可以让经理和代表在他们已经使用的聊天中询问他们自己的 Stratyfix 数据。我们要完成这个季度吗？这周谁需要我的关注？答案来自直播平台。

每个人都像自己一样相互联系。代表看到他们自己的书，经理看到他们的团队，具有与应用程序本身相同的权限。它是只读的，因此无法通过聊天更改 Stratyfix 中的任何内容。而且它不会虚张声势。当 Stratyfix 由于尚未校准赔率或未设定目标而故意保留某个数字时，该插件会准确地说出这一点，而不是猜测。

您需要一个 Stratyfix 工作区，并由管理员启用连接器。

source_long:
Create, edit, and download professional PDFs with graphs and math notation — all without leaving ChatGPT.
Describe what you need in plain language or use the built-in LaTeX editor, then download the final PDF instantly.

Example Prompts
  • Teachers:
"Create a quadratic equations worksheet PDF with 10 questions and include an answer key."
  • Parents:
"Here is my daughter's math exam. Create a math worksheet PDF with questions targeting her growth areas."
  • Students:
"Create a mock IB Physics exam PDF focused on kinematics."
  • Professors:
"Format this abstract and introduction into a two-column IEEE-style PDF with citation placeholders."
  • Professionals:
"Create a PDF résumé based on the following LinkedIn data."
  • Developers:
"Compile this LaTeX code and generate a polished PDF."

No more copying LaTeX into external tools. Edit, recompile, and refine PDFs entirely within ChatGPT. Advanced users can open the PDF in full screen to manually edit and recompile the LaTeX — all in one place.

Key Features
  • Natural language input – Just describe what you want to create
  • LaTeX-powered formatting – Clean, professional math notation
  • Instant PDF generation – Download your PDF in seconds
  • Flexible viewing options – Full-screen, distraction-free PDF and LaTeX view
plugin_details.target_long:
创建、编辑和下载带有图表和数学符号的专业 PDF — 所有这些都无需离开 ChatGPT。
用简单的语言描述您的需求或使用内置的 LaTeX 编辑器，然后立即下载最终的 PDF。

提示示例
  • 教师：
“创建包含 10 个问题并包含答案要点的二次方程工作表 PDF。”
  • 家长：
“这是我女儿的数学考试。创建一份数学工作表 PDF，其中包含针对她成长领域的问题。”
  • 学生：
“创建一个专注于运动学的模拟 IB 物理考试 PDF。”
  • 教授：
“将此摘要和简介格式化为带有引文占位符的两列 IEEE 风格的 PDF。”
  • 专业人士：
“根据以下 LinkedIn 数据创建 PDF 简历。”
  • 开发商：
“编译此 LaTeX 代码并生成精美的 PDF。”

不再需要将 LaTeX 复制到外部工具中。完全在 ChatGPT 中编辑、重新编译和优化 PDF。高级用户可以全屏打开 PDF，手动编辑和重新编译 LaTeX — 一切都在一处完成。

主要特点
  • 自然语言输入 – 只需描述您想要创建的内容
  • LaTeX 支持的格式 – 简洁、专业的数学符号
  • 即时 PDF 生成 – 在几秒钟内下载 PDF
  • 灵活的查看选项 – 全屏、无干扰的 PDF 和 LaTeX 视图

source_long:
**Subtext is session replay built for agents instead of humans.**

Connect Subtext, and your Codex agents can open real production sessions and investigate them directly—no scrubbing a timeline, no video to watch.

Hand your agent a Subtext link from wherever it already connects—a Sentry issue, a Linear ticket, a support thread, a PR—and it uses Agentic Session Review to jump to the right moment, inspect screenshots and accessibility trees, diff DOM state, and read console and network activity to find the root cause. Then it files the fix or hands you the finding. You review the answer, not the replay.

What your agent gets:
* **Session tools it calls directly**: open a session, jump to a moment, inspect and compare state—purpose-built so agents traverse dense session data efficiently, with fewer tokens than pointing a general agent at raw replay.
* **Best-in-class capture from Fullstory**: Fullcapture behavior, pixel-perfect screenshots on demand, DOM diffs, and windowed console and network context.
* **Privacy built for production**: precision tools for agents to mask or exclude sensitive fields, plus agent-friendly DLP scanning tools over MCP.
* **Cost-effective**: Capture every session without sampling and never miss a critical user experience or bug report. Agents review the ones that matter most.

Works with Codex or any MCP-compatible agent. Code-first install, self-serve signup, generous free tier, usage-based pricing. Bring your own agent harness—Subtext is the session context it was missing.
plugin_details.target_long:
**潜台词是为代理而不是人类构建的会话重放。**

连接 Subtext，您的 Codex 代理可以打开真实的制作会话并直接调查它们 - 无需清理时间线，也无需观看视频。

从已经连接的任何地方（Sentry 问题、线性票证、支持线程、PR）向您的代理提供 Subtext 链接，它使用 Agentic Session Review 跳转到正确的时刻，检查屏幕截图和可访问性树，比较 DOM 状态，并读取控制台和网络活动以查找根本原因。然后它会提交修复程序或将结果交给您。您查看答案，而不是重播。

您的代理人会得到什么：
* **它直接调用的会话工具**：打开会话，跳转到某个时刻，检查和比较状态 - 专门构建的，因此代理可以有效地遍历密集的会话数据，比在原始重放中指向通用代理所需的令牌更少。
* **来自 Fullstory 的一流捕获**：完整捕获行为、按需完美像素屏幕截图、DOM 差异以及窗口控制台和网络上下文。
* **为生产而构建的隐私**：供代理屏蔽或排除敏感字段的精密工具，以及基于 MCP 的代理友好型 DLP 扫描工具。
* **经济高效**：无需采样即可捕获每个会话，并且绝不会错过关键的用户体验或错误报告。代理会审查最重要的内容。

可与 Codex 或任何 MCP 兼容代理配合使用。代码优先安装、自助注册、慷慨的免费套餐、基于使用的定价。带上您自己的代理工具 - Subtext 是它缺少的会话上下文。

source_long:
Success.co MCP Server lets you control your entire Success.co workspace directly from ChatGPT.

Instead of clicking around inside the app, you can simply talk to ChatGPT and ask it to do things for you. You can draft a new process document, complete a to do, create or update an Issue, review your Rocks, check on scorecard numbers, or prepare for an upcoming session. It works like a natural conversation, but it is connected to your real data.

Because Success.co already holds a clear, structured picture of how your company runs EOS, ChatGPT can use that data to generate powerful insights and reports. You can ask it to summarize execution across teams, highlight risks, spot patterns in Issues, or generate a planning brief. The only limit is what you choose to ask. It is your data, your operating system, simply made available to ChatGPT so you can leverage it more fully.

It is also especially useful when you are on the move. Using the ChatGPT app, you can add to dos or Issues with your voice, capture ideas as they happen, and keep execution moving without waiting to get back to your desk.

The Success.co MCP Server makes ChatGPT a practical control layer for your company’s EOS data, helping you move faster, think more clearly, and stay aligned.
plugin_details.target_long:
Success.co MCP 服务器可让您直接从 ChatGPT 控制整个 Success.co 工作区。

您无需在应用程序内四处点击，只需与 ChatGPT 对话并要求它为您做一些事情即可。您可以起草新的流程文档、完成待办事项、创建或更新问题、查看您的 Rocks、检查记分卡数字或为即将到来的会议做准备。它的工作方式就像自然对话，但它与您的真实数据相关。

由于 Success.co 已经掌握了您公司如何运行 EOS 的清晰、结构化的图片，ChatGPT 可以使用该数据生成强大的见解和报告。您可以要求它总结跨团队的执行情况、突出风险、发现问题中的模式或生成计划摘要。唯一的限制是你选择问什么。这是您的数据、您的操作系统，只需向 ChatGPT 提供即可，以便您可以更充分地利用它。

当您在旅途中时，它也特别有用。使用 ChatGPT 应用程序，您可以用语音添加待办事项或问题，捕捉发生的想法，并继续执行，而无需等待回到办公桌前。

Success.co MCP 服务器使 ChatGPT 成为您公司 EOS 数据的实用控制层，帮助您更快地行动、更清晰地思考并保持一致。

source_long: Sugra API is intelligence infrastructure for AI agents and decision platforms: one key and one normalized format for cross-domain primary-source data, surfaced to agents through the Model Context Protocol. The connector exposes a small, stable tool surface over the full Sugra catalog of more than 1,300 endpoints aggregating 130+ primary sources across data domains including markets, macroeconomics and central banks, corporate filings, public finance, trade flows, agriculture, climate and natural events, maritime activity, prediction markets, global news, network intelligence, and entity screening. Main workflows: discover endpoints by natural-language search and inspect their schemas, run a one-step find-and-call to retrieve data, pull macroeconomic series and central-bank rates, fetch market prices, history and fundamentals through Sugra Finance, screen a person or organization name against sanctions corpora, resolve free text to a canonical entity, and compose a normalized current view or bounded timeseries for an entity with freshness and provenance. Works with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and xAI model families and any MCP-enabled client. A free Sugra account is the only connection requirement; the read-only surface never writes, deletes, sends, or publishes.
plugin_details.target_long: Sugra API 是人工智能代理和决策平台的智能基础设施：跨域主要源数据的一种密钥和一种标准化格式，通过模型上下文协议呈现给代理。该连接器在包含 1,300 多个端点的完整 Sugra 目录中公开了一个小型、稳定的工具界面，聚合了跨数据领域的 130 多个主要来源，包括市场、宏观经济和中央银行、公司备案、公共金融、贸易流、农业、气候和自然事件、海事活动、预测市场、全球新闻、网络情报和实体筛选。主要工作流程：通过自然语言搜索发现端点并检查其模式，运行一步查找和调用来检索数据，拉动宏观经济序列和央行利率，通过 Sugra Finance 获取市场价格、历史和基本面，根据制裁语料库筛选个人或组织名称，将自由文本解析为规范实体，并为具有新鲜度和出处的实体构建规范化的当前视图或有界时间序列。适用于 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google 和 xAI 模型系列以及任何支持 MCP 的客户端。免费的 Sugra 帐户是唯一的连接要求；只读表面永远不会写入、删除、发送或发布。

source_long:
SuperMCP prices a shopping list against Israeli online supermarkets and tells you which store delivers it for the least, to your address.

Give it a list in Hebrew and a delivery address. It matches each item to real products in each chain's catalogue, adds delivery fees where the chain publishes verified terms, and returns a per-store total with a per-item breakdown, plus a link to each product on the retailer's own site.

It is built not to guess. Items a store does not carry are marked missing rather than swapped silently, every price carries the date it was last seen in the chain's price file, and a delivery fee is quoted only when the chain publishes terms that have been verified. When several products match one line, it asks you instead of picking for you.

Prices come from the price files Israeli retailers publish under the Price Transparency Law, ingested nightly.

Coverage is Israeli online supermarket delivery, and the product catalogue is in Hebrew.
plugin_details.target_long:

给它一份希伯来语列表和送货地址。它将每个商品与每个连锁店目录中的真实产品进行匹配，在连锁店发布经过验证的条款的情况下添加送货费用，并返回每个商店的总计以及每个商品的详细信息，以及零售商自己网站上每个产品的链接。

它的建立不是为了猜测。商店不销售的商品会被标记为丢失，而不是默默地交换，每个价格都带有该连锁店价格文件中最后一次出现的日期，并且只有当连锁店发布经过验证的条款时才会报价送货费。当多个产品与一条线匹配时，它会询问您而不是为您挑选。

价格来自以色列零售商根据价格透明度法发布的价格文件，每晚获取。

覆盖范围为以色列在线超市配送，产品目录为希伯来语。

source_long:
Create surveys and forms, distribute them to respondents, and analyze the results — all within a single ChatGPT conversation using the SurveySparrow app.

What you can do:
- Design surveys and forms for any use-case (NPS, feedback, employee engagement, and more)
- Publish surveys to your SurveySparrow account and distribute them via email, SMS, or WhatsApp
- Review live response counts and track survey activity across your account
- Analyze responses and surface patterns or key themes from collected data

Example prompts:

1. Build a survey
"Create an NPS survey for customers who purchased in the last 30 days with a rating scale and an open-ended follow-up question"

2. Edit a survey
"Add a required email field and make question 5 more concise"

3. Publish a survey
"Publish this survey to my SurveySparrow account so it's ready to collect responses"

4. Share a survey
"Send this NPS survey to my customer list via email"

5. Check response activity
"How many people have completed the customer feedback form?"

6. Track your survey library
"How many NPS surveys are active right now?"

7. Analyze responses
"Group the responses by common themes and show me the top 3 insights"

Requirements: An active SurveySparrow account is required to use this app.
plugin_details.target_long:
创建调查和表格，将其分发给受访者并分析结果 - 所有这些都在使用 SurveySparrow 应用程序的单个 ChatGPT 对话中完成。

你可以做什么：
- 为任何用例（NPS、反馈、员工敬业度等）设计调查和表格
- 将调查发布到您的 SurveySparrow 帐户并通过电子邮件、短信或 WhatsApp 分发
- 查看实时回复计数并跟踪整个帐户的调查活动
- 从收集的数据中分析反应和表面模式或关键主题

提示示例：

1. 开展调查
“为过去 30 天内购买过商品的客户创建 NPS 调查，其中包含评级量表和开放式后续问题”

2. 编辑调查
“添加必填电子邮件字段并使问题 5 更加简洁”

3. 发布调查
“将此调查发布到我的 SurveySparrow 帐户，以便准备收集回复”

4. 分享调查
“通过电子邮件将此 NPS 调查发送到我的客户列表”

5. 检查响应活动
“有多少人填写了客户反馈表？”

6. 跟踪您的调查库
“目前有多少 NPS 调查正在进行？”

7. 分析回应
“按共同主题对回复进行分组，并向我展示最重要的 3 个见解”

要求：使用此应用程序需要有效的 SurveySparrow 帐户。

source_long:
Swarm helps you discover places, check in to where you go, and keep a personal history of your favorite spots. Find restaurants, cafés, parks, museums, bars, and other places nearby or anywhere in the world. Get recommendations based on location, save places to visit later, create and manage lists, and see where you've been over time.

Whether you're planning a trip, exploring a new neighborhood, or trying to remember the great coffee shop you visited last year, Swarm makes it easy to find, organize, and revisit the places that matter to you.
plugin_details.target_long:
Swarm 可以帮助您发现地点、查看您去过的地方，并保留您最喜欢的地点的个人历史记录。查找附近或世界任何地方的餐馆、咖啡馆、公园、博物馆、酒吧和其他地方。获取基于位置的建议、保存稍后访问的地点、创建和管理列表以及查看您在一段时间内去过的地方。

无论您是计划旅行、探索新社区，还是想记住去年去过的很棒的咖啡店，Swarm 都可以让您轻松查找、组织和重新访问对您重要的地方。

source_long:
Get answers about Sweat & Tonic, a boutique fitness studio in Toronto, straight from the studio's own published information. This connector searches the studio's live content and pulls full details on class programs, the current class schedule, pricing, instructors, treatments, and booking, so you can plan a visit or compare options without hunting across the web.

It exposes two read-only tools. search returns ranked results, each with a title, a source URL, and a text snippet. fetch returns a document's full text and its canonical URL. Every result carries a link back to the exact page it came from, so answers stay grounded in the studio's real content and are citable to source.

Courtyard AI operates this connector for Sweat & Tonic with the studio's explicit authorization, and keeps its content current automatically as the studio updates its programs, schedule, and pricing. All information is public business content. No account, login, or personal data is required. The connector is strictly read-only: it never makes bookings, processes payments, or performs any other action on your behalf. It only retrieves and cites the studio's published information.
plugin_details.target_long:
直接从工作室自己发布的信息中获取有关多伦多精品健身工作室 Sweat & Tonic 的答案。该连接器搜索工作室的实时内容，并提取有关课程计划、当前课程安排、定价、讲师、治疗和预订的完整详细信息，以便您可以计划访问或比较选项，而无需在网络上搜索。

它公开了两个只读工具。搜索返回排名结果，每个结果都有标题、源 URL 和文本片段。 fetch 返回文档的全文及其规范 URL。每个结果都带有一个返回其来源的确切页面的链接，因此答案始终以工作室的真实内容为基础，并且可以引用来源。

Courtyard AI 在工作室的明确授权下为 Sweat & Tonic 操作此连接器，并在工作室更新其节目、时间表和定价时自动保持其内容最新。所有信息均为公开商业内容。不需要帐户、登录名或个人数据。该连接器是严格只读的：它绝不会代表您进行预订、处理付款或执行任何其他操作。它仅检索并引用工作室已发布的信息。

source_long:
Sweescape is an all-in-one event management suite for organizers — ticketing, badges, check-in, analytics, and audience campaigns. This connector lets you run your own Sweescape workspace directly from ChatGPT.

Ask ChatGPT to look up your events, ticket types and sales, attendance and analytics, and to list your audiences and automations. You can also draft newticketing pages, automations, and email or SMS campaigns — all inside your own workspace.

Everything stays a draft: the connector can prepare and edit content, but publishing a page, activating an automation, or sending a campaign always remains a manual action you take inside Sweescape. It is a first-party connector that accesses only your own Sweescape data.
plugin_details.target_long:
Sweescape 是一款面向组织者的一体化活动管理套件 - 票务、徽章、签到、分析和受众活动。此连接器可让您直接从 ChatGPT 运行自己的 Sweescape 工作区。

要求 ChatGPT 查找您的活动、门票类型和销售、出席率和分析，并列出您的受众和自动化。您还可以起草新的票务页面、自动化以及电子邮件或短信活动——所有这些都在您自己的工作空间内进行。

一切都只是草稿：连接器可以准备和编辑内容，但发布页面、激活自动化或发送营销活动始终仍然是您在 Sweescape 中执行的手动操作。它是仅访问您自己的 Sweescape 数据的第一方连接器。

source_long:
Sweet helps ecommerce teams understand sales, marketing, customer, product, discount, refund, and profit performance using their connected Sweet data.

Ask questions in plain language, such as what drove sales growth, which marketing channels are most efficient, how customer retention is changing, which products or discounts are affecting margin, or where refunds are impacting profitability. Sweet returns clear summaries, KPI comparisons, segment breakdowns, and practical insights so teams can make faster trading, marketing, and retention decisions from the data they already use.
plugin_details.target_long:
Sweet 使用关联的 Sweet 数据帮助电子商务团队了解销售、营销、客户、产品、折扣、退款和利润绩效。

用通俗易懂的语言提出问题，例如是什么推动了销售增长，哪些营销渠道最有效，客户保留率如何变化，哪些产品或折扣正在影响利润率，或者退款在哪些方面影响盈利能力。 Sweet 返回清晰的摘要、KPI 比较、细分细分和实用见解，以便团队可以根据他们已使用的数据更快地做出交易、营销和保留决策。

source_long: Swiggy Food brings India's largest food delivery network into ChatGPT. source_long: Ask ChatGPT about your Softone ERP. Look up customer details and purchase history, check product stock by warehouse, and review daily sales and invoices per store and channel. Read-only — each company connects its own Softone installation.

source_long:
Synci connects your real bank, brokerage, and crypto-exchange accounts to AI assistants,
read-only. Ask about balances, transactions, holdings, and spending across all your
accounts in one place:

"What did I spend on groceries last month?"
"Which subscriptions am I paying for, and what do they cost per year?"
"How is my portfolio allocated across stocks, ETFs, and crypto?"

All connected accounts are visible through one MCP server, in their native currencies.

帐户集中在一处：

所有连接的帐户都可以通过一台 MCP 服务器查看其本币。

source_long: Bring Syncly's social intelligence into ChatGPT and Codex. Search brand mentions across social, including video. Track sentiment and mention volume over time, surface top creators, keywords, and trends, and rank posts by performance to see what is working.

source_long:
TABLEALL helps travelers and diners discover and reserve fine dining restaurants across Japan through ChatGPT. Users can search by region, area, or cuisine, check real-time availability, view course menus and pricing, review cancellation policies, and create reservations or reservation requests.

TABLEALL supports Michelin-starred restaurants and a wide range of cuisines including sushi, kaiseki, tempura, wagyu, French, Italian, and more. Payments are completed securely on TableAll's website after a payment link is returned.
plugin_details.target_long:
TABLEALL 通过 ChatGPT 帮助旅行者和食客发现并预订日本各地的高级餐厅。用户可以按地区、区域或美食进行搜索，查看实时可用性，查看课程菜单和价格，查看取消政策，以及创建预订或预订请求。

source_long:
A connector that lets AI agents search the official knowledge base of TALON, a low-code platform for building business applications. It searches thousands of pages of official manuals, support Q&A, a database of 900+ real-world function configuration examples, and specification analyses, and returns answers with source URLs as evidence. Typical uses include feature design consultation, configuration value lookups, error-cause investigation, browsing similar real-world examples, and automated validation of generated settings.

A TALON maintenance contract and a TALON support site (Zendesk) account are required. Users authenticate by signing in to the support site when connecting. All tools are read-only, and users' conversation content, code, and attachments are never sent to our servers (details: https://mcp.talon.jp/privacy).
plugin_details.target_long:
一个连接器，可让人工智能代理搜索 TALON 的官方知识库，TALON 是一个用于构建业务应用程序的低代码平台。它搜索数千页官方手册、支持问答、900多个实际功能配置示例的数据库和规范分析，并以源 URL 为证据返回答案。典型用途包括功能设计咨询、配置值查找、错误原因调查、浏览类似的现实示例以及生成的设置的自动验证。

需要 TALON 维护合同和 TALON 支持站点 (Zendesk) 帐户。用户通过在连接时登录支持站点进行身份验证。所有工具都是只读的，用户的对话内容、代码和附件永远不会发送到我们的服务器（详情：https://mcp.talon.jp/privacy）。

source_long:
Book ferry tickets, longtail boats, speedboats, snorkeling trips, and island tours across Thailand — directly in ChatGPT and social chat channels like WhatsApp, Instagram DM, Telegram, and Facebook Messenger. No forms, no redirects to a website. Just tell the app where you want to go and when, confirm the option you like, and get your ticket by email.
Covers 50+ destinations and 40+ local boat operators, including Koh Samui, Koh Phangan, Koh Tao, Bangkok, Phi Phi, Phuket, Krabi, Koh Lanta, and Koh Lipe — plus access to every island in Thailand. Compares routes by speed, price, and comfort, and handles multi-leg journeys that combine bus and ferry, or several ferries in a row, as a single booking.
Often cheaper than booking each leg separately, with a faster, simpler flow than traditional booking sites. Every booking is double-checked by a human team based in Thailand, so connection times actually work. Real support is available any time at no extra cost — through ChatGPT, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, or Telegram.
Pay in any major currency with cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, Alipay, WeChat Pay, and more. Officially licensed and registered in Thailand.

source_long:
TaxMCP gives ChatGPT citation-grounded access to U.S. tax authority. It searches and retrieves the Internal Revenue Code, Treasury Regulations, IRS publications and guidance, selected state tax statutes, and U.S. Tax Court opinions.

Seven read-only research tools support broad tax-law search, direct section lookup, IRS publication and guidance retrieval, Tax Court opinion retrieval, case citation-activity research, and statutory cross-reference analysis. Results include source identifiers and citation URLs so users can inspect the underlying authority.

TaxMCP is built for CPAs, enrolled agents, tax attorneys, researchers, and others who need source-linked tax research inside their existing AI workflow. It does not file returns, submit forms, make payments, edit records, or provide legal or tax advice. Case citation activity is not a substitute for Shepard's, KeyCite, or another authoritative current-validity check.
plugin_details.target_long:

七个只读研究工具支持广泛的税法搜索、直接部分查找、国税局出版物和指南检索、税务法院意见检索、案例引用活动研究以及法定交叉引用分析。结果包括来源标识符和引用 URL，以便用户可以检查潜在的权威。

TaxMCP 专为注册会计师、注册代理人、税务律师、研究人员以及其他需要在现有人工智能工作流程中进行来源链接税务研究的人而构建。它不提交申报表、提交表格、付款、编辑记录或提供法律或税务建议。案例引用活动不能替代 Shepard、KeyCite 或其他权威的当前有效性检查。

plugin_details.target_long: tela 是一个 Markdown 原生团队 wiki，其中 AI 代理是一流的参与者。将 ChatGPT 连接到您团队的知识库，以大规模阅读、编写和维护文档。 • 语义搜索（“研究”）— 按含义回答问题，从整页正文中返回已标记的来源分歧的组装基础 • 关键字搜索 — 排名、片段突出显示的全文查找 • 创作 — 创建、更新和外科手术式修补页面；移动、删除、通过公共链接共享 • 知识健康 — 显示近乎重复的页面、识别未解答的问题、建议链接 • Atlas — 从 git 存储库和 Jira 自动生成技术文档；触发重新摄取、民意调查报道 • 演示文稿 — 作者、lint 和预览存储为 wiki 页面的 Slidev 幻灯片。使用您的 tela 帐户登录进行连接。通过 docker compose (AGPL) 自托管或使用 telawiki.com。

source_long:
Draft, revise, and organize the scripts you read on camera, without leaving the conversation. Connect your Teleprompter.com account and ChatGPT can write a script with you, then save it straight to your workspace, filed in the right folder and ready for your next take.

What ChatGPT can do:

- Create scripts with playback settings applied as they're written: font size, scroll speed, timed-speed mode, text alignment, and estimated duration
- Revise existing scripts in place. Updates touch only the fields you ask for, so the rest of your setup stays as you left it
- Read your library: list scripts newest first, pull the full text of any script, and see what's inside each folder
- Organize: create folders, rename them, and move scripts between folders or back to the root

Because ChatGPT can read what you've already written, you can work from your own back catalogue: ask for a tighter cut of last month's intro, a 30-second version of a product explainer, or a consistent sign-off across everything in one folder.

You'll need a Teleprompter.com account; the integration is available on every account tier. Connecting uses OAuth, so there are no keys to copy or store, and you choose which permissions to grant: reading and writing scripts and folders are separate approvals, so read-only access is a valid choice. ChatGPT only ever sees your own personal workspace.

Scripts saved here are the same scripts your Teleprompter apps read, so anything drafted in a conversation is waiting for you the next time you open one up.

Differences from the Claude description, both deliberate:
plugin_details.target_long:
起草、修改和组织您在镜头上阅读的脚本，而无需离开对话。连接您的 Teleprompter.com 帐户，ChatGPT 可以与您一起编写脚本，然后将其直接保存到您的工作区，归档到正确的文件夹中，并为您的下一次拍摄做好准备。

ChatGPT 可以做什么：

- 创建脚本并在编写时应用播放设置：字体大小、滚动速度、定时速度模式、文本对齐和预计持续时间
- 修改现有脚本。更新仅涉及您要求的字段，因此其余设置将保持原样
- 阅读您的库：首先列出最新的脚本，提取任何脚本的全文，并查看每个文件夹中的内容
- 组织：创建文件夹、重命名文件夹以及在文件夹之间移动脚本或移回根目录

由于 ChatGPT 可以读取您已经编写的内容，因此您可以根据自己的过往目录进行工作：要求对上个月的介绍进行更严格的剪辑、30 秒版本的产品解释，或者对一个文件夹中的所有内容进行一致的签核。

您需要一个 Teleprompter.com 帐户；该集成适用于每个帐户级别。连接使用 OAuth，因此无需复制或存储密钥，并且您可以选择授予哪些权限：读取和写入脚本和文件夹是单独的批准，因此只读访问是有效的选择。 ChatGPT 只能看到您自己的个人工作区。

此处保存的脚本与提词器应用程序读取的脚本相同，因此对话中起草的任何内容都会在您下次打开对话时等待您。

与克劳德描述的差异，都是有意为之：

source_long: Connect ChatGPT to Templafy Document Agents and turn AI-generated content and company knowledge into business-ready PowerPoint presentations. Users can discover relevant document agents, choose company approved themes, collect requirements, and generate a branded PPTX. Every output is built from approved templates, brand assets, and best-practice content, ensuring documents are consistent and compliant without copying, reformatting, or manual cleanup.
plugin_details.target_long: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Templafy Document Agents，将 AI 生成的内容和公司知识转化为业务就绪的 PowerPoint 演示文稿。用户可以发现相关的文档代理，选择公司认可的主题，收集需求，并生成品牌PPTX。每个输出都是根据批准的模板、品牌资产和最佳实践内容构建的，确保文档一致且合规，无需复制、重新格式化或手动清理。

source_long:
Temponia is a time-tracking and timesheet app for freelancers, agencies, and in-house teams who want their hours logged without it feeling like a chore.

Instead of a long list of empty fields, Temponia gives you a calendar view: drag to log hours the way you'd block out a meeting. Connect Google Calendar or Outlook and turn existing events into billable entries in a click. Native iOS and Android apps keep your week up to date when you're away from your desk.

What you can do with it:
  - Log time on a calendar, list, or timer, whichever fits the moment
  - Track tasks and projects with groupable dashboards by week, month, or year
  - Manage expenses alongside hours in one place
  - Sign in with Google or Microsoft SSO; provision teams via SCIM/JIT
  - Export clean timesheets and reports for clients or payroll
  
Good for solo consultants tracking billable hours, agencies invoicing clients, and teams that need a tidy record of where the week went.
plugin_details.target_long:
Temponia 是一款时间跟踪和时间表应用程序，适合自由职业者、代理机构和内部团队，他们希望记录自己的工作时间，但又不想让自己感觉是一件苦差事。

Temponia 为您提供了日历视图，而不是一长串的空字段：通过拖动来记录时间，就像您安排会议一样。连接 Google 日历或 Outlook，只需点击一下即可将现有事件转变为可计费条目。当您离开办公桌时，本机 iOS 和 Android 应用程序可让您了解一周的最新情况。

你可以用它做什么：
  - 在日历、列表或计时器上记录时间（以适合的时刻为准）
  - 使用可分组的仪表板按周、月或年跟踪任务和项目
  - 在一个地方管理费用和时间
  - 使用 Google 或 Microsoft SSO 登录；通过 SCIM/JIT 提供团队
  - 为客户或工资单导出干净的时间表和报告
  
非常适合跟踪计费时间的独立顾问、为客户开具发票的代理机构以及需要整洁记录一周工作情况的团队。

source_long: Comprehensive guidance for working with Temporal — developing workflows, activities, and workers across Python, TypeScript, Go, and Java SDKs; using the Temporal CLI for local development and operations; running and managing self-hosted Temporal Server; and working with Temporal Cloud for production deployments.

source_long: Temso tracks your brand's visibility across AI assistants — share of voice, sentiment, which sources they cite, and recommended actions to improve. Connect Temso to ask about your AI-visibility data in natural language and pull live analytics straight into the chat.
plugin_details.target_long: Temso 跟踪您的品牌在人工智能助手中的知名度 - 声音份额、情绪、他们引用的来源以及建议的改进行动。连接 Temso，以自然语言询问您的 AI 可见性数据，并将实时分析直接引入聊天中。

source_long: Tenzo connects ChatGPT to your restaurant data. Ask questions in plain English about sales, labour, covers, average check, item mix, customer reviews and manager logs across all your locations. The app reads the same metrics and dimensions you already see in your Tenzo dashboard, respects your existing user permissions and business access, and can save useful queries back as cards and dashboards in your Tenzo account.

source_long:
Ask your recruiting data anything. The Tenzo AI MCP server connects your AI assistant to your hiring pipeline, so instead of clicking through screens you can just ask: who applied for this role, where each candidate stands, how they did on their AI screening call, and what's changed this week.

Pull up a candidate and follow them end to end - their applications and stages, resume, SMS and email history, and the full screening-call transcript, grade, and summary. Check how a job is configured, review meeting notes, and surface hiring analytics, all in plain language.

Access is read-only and OAuth-authenticated, so the assistant can read your data but never change it, and everything stays scoped to your organization.
plugin_details.target_long:
向你的招聘数据询问任何事情。 Tenzo AI MCP 服务器将您的 AI 助手连接到您的招聘渠道，因此您无需点击屏幕，只需询问：谁申请了该职位、每个候选人的立场、他们在 AI 筛选电话中的表现以及本周发生了什么变化。

找到一名候选人并从头到尾跟踪他们——他们的申请和阶段、简历、短信和电子邮件历史记录，以及完整的筛选电话记录、成绩和摘要。检查工作的配置方式、查看会议记录和表面招聘分析，所有这些都以简单的语言进行。

访问权限是只读的并且经过 OAuth 身份验证，因此助理可以读取您的数据但永远不会更改它，并且所有内容都仅限于您的组织范围。

source_long:
Terac connects your AI agent to verified human experts, right from the chat. Describe the work you need done, whether that's an expert interview, a round of customer research, a code review, or a model evaluation. We price it with a human confirmed quote, recruit and screen the right people, return the work as structured results, and pay experts only on verified completion.

Everything happens within the same conversation, so involving a human no longer means a separate platform, new vendors, or a project timeline of its own. Your agent defines the work, confirms the cost, and sees it through to finished results, making expert labor available on demand the moment your workflow needs it.
plugin_details.target_long:
Terac 直接通过聊天将您的 AI 代理与经过验证的人类专家连接起来。描述您需要完成的工作，无论是专家访谈、一轮客户研究、代码审查还是模型评估。我们通过人工确认的报价进行定价，招募和筛选合适的人员，将工作作为结构化结果返回，并仅在经过验证的完成情况下向专家付款。

一切都发生在同一个对话中，因此涉及人类不再意味着单独的平台、新的供应商或自己的项目时间表。您的代理定义工作、确认成本并监督其最终结果，从而在您的工作流程需要时按需提供专家劳动力。

source_long: Tessie allows you to access and control your Tesla right from ChatGPT.
plugin_details.target_long: Tessie 允许您直接从 ChatGPT 访问和控制您的 Tesla。

source_long:
The Tessun Immobilien app makes property searching in Munich and the Isar-Loisach Valley clearer and more locally focused.

Instead of browsing through long property lists, users can see available properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easier to quickly understand which location best fits their daily life — whether in Munich, Wolfratshausen, Geretsried, or the surrounding areas.

Faster geographic orientation
Users can immediately see where a property is located and what the surrounding area looks like.

Better understanding of the location
Especially in regions like Munich or the Isar-Loisach Valley, the micro-location is often crucial. The map view helps users better evaluate distances, infrastructure, and the surrounding environment realistically.

Focus on relevant regional properties
Instead of thousands of random listings, the app focuses on selected properties from a regionally specialized real estate agency.

Easier comparison of different locations
Users can directly recognize how residential areas differ — for example, between urban Munich and quieter surrounding towns.

Less time wasted on unsuitable listings
Many users choose based on location first. The visual search makes this step much faster.

Direct contact with a local expert
Interested users can easily send inquiries or arrange viewings without having to switch between multiple platforms.

More enjoyable mobile experience
The search feels more intuitive because users can browse the map and actively explore different regions.

The app is designed not to make property searching more complicated, but more understandable — with a clear focus on location, regional expertise, and easier navigation through the real estate market around Munich and the Isar-Loisach Valley.
plugin_details.target_long:
Tessun Immobilien 应用程序使慕尼黑和伊萨尔-洛伊萨赫山谷的房产搜索更加清晰、更加注重本地化。

用户可以直接在交互式地图上查看可用的属性，而不是浏览长的属性列表。这样可以更轻松地快速了解哪个位置最适合他们的日常生活 - 无论是在慕尼黑、沃尔夫拉茨豪森、格雷茨里德还是周边地区。

更快的地理定位
用户可以立即看到房产所在位置以及周边地区的情况。

更好地了解位置
尤其是在慕尼黑或伊萨尔-洛伊萨赫山谷等地区，微观位置往往至关重要。地图视图可帮助用户更好地真实评估距离、基础设施和周围环境。

聚焦相关区域物业
该应用程序不是成千上万的随机列表，而是专注于来自区域专业房地产机构的精选房产。

更轻松地比较不同位置
用户可以直接识别住宅区的不同之处，例如慕尼黑市区和周边较安静的城镇之间的差异。

减少在不合适的列表上浪费的时间
许多用户首先根据位置进行选择。视觉搜索使这一步变得更快。

直接联系当地专家
感兴趣的用户可以轻松发送询问或安排看房，而无需在多个平台之间切换。

更畅快的移动体验
搜索感觉更直观，因为用户可以浏览地图并主动探索不同的区域。

该应用程序的设计目的不是让房产搜索变得更加复杂，而是更容易理解——明确关注位置、区域专业知识，以及更轻松地浏览慕尼黑和伊萨尔-洛伊萨赫山谷周围的房地产市场。

source_long: Use Test Android Apps to build and install app variants, drive a booted Android emulator with adb input events, inspect UI trees, capture screenshots, collect logcat output, and gather Simpleperf, Perfetto, gfxinfo, or memory/leak evidence while reproducing issues.

source_long:
Testifly helps developers, QA engineers, and product teams validate websites and web applications with automated end-to-end (E2E) testing, website checks, and UI validation directly from a URL. Run browser-based tests to verify user flows, page behavior, redirects, availability, performance, accessibility, and overall site health without any setup. Whether you're testing a production site, staging environment, preview deployment, or local environment, Testifly quickly identifies issues before they reach users.

Testifly is especially valuable for AI-assisted and vibe coding workflows, where code is generated rapidly by AI coding agents. As development accelerates, automated end-to-end validation is critical to ensure features actually work in the browser. Testifly provides an independent verification layer that catches broken user flows, regressions, UI issues, and deployment problems that AI-generated code or unit tests may miss.

Integrated with ChatGPT, Testifly lets you create, run, and analyze end-to-end tests using natural language. It works alongside AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, and other coding agents, enabling developers to verify changes continuously without writing test code. Generate structured test reports, validate bug fixes, monitor regressions, and confidently ship high-quality web applications.
plugin_details.target_long:
Testifly 可帮助开发人员、QA 工程师和产品团队直接从 URL 进行自动化端到端 (E2E) 测试、网站检查和 UI 验证来验证网站和 Web 应用程序。运行基于浏览器的测试来验证用户流、页面行为、重定向、可用性、性能、可访问性和整体站点运行状况，而无需任何设置。无论您是测试生产站点、临时环境、预览部署还是本地环境，Testifly 都能在问题到达用户之前快速识别问题。

Testifly 对于人工智能辅助和氛围编码工作流程特别有价值，其中代码由人工智能编码代理快速生成。随着开发的加速，自动化的端到端验证对于确保功能在浏览器中实际运行至关重要。 Testifly 提供了一个独立的验证层，可以捕获人工智能生成的代码或单元测试可能遗漏的损坏的用户流程、回归、UI 问题和部署问题。

Testifly 与 ChatGPT 集成，让您可以使用自然语言创建、运行和分析端到端测试。它与 Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Windsurf 和其他编码代理等 AI 开发工具配合使用，使开发人员能够持续验证更改，而无需编写测试代码。生成结构化测试报告、验证错误修复、监控回归并自信地交付高质量的 Web 应用程序。

The app helps users evaluate options before choosing a plan; it does not enroll users or change electric service.
plugin_details.target_long: 德克萨斯州电力计划帮助用户比较放松管制的德克萨斯州邮政编码中的住宅电力计划。输入邮政编码和可选的每月使用量，即可查看匹配的计划以及估计的每月账单、有效费率、合同条款、可更新内容、零售商详细信息、评级、EFL 链接和注册链接。该应用程序可以帮助用户在选择计划之前评估选项；它不会招募用户或改变电力服务。

source_long: Text lets authorized users search and retrieve customer conversations, HelpDesk tickets, archived LiveChat chats, transcripts, and tags in ChatGPT. Results are limited to data the user can already access in their Text workspace. The app is read-only and cannot create, update, send, or delete Text data.
plugin_details.target_long: 文本允许授权用户搜索和检索 ChatGPT 中的客户对话、HelpDesk 票证、存档的 LiveChat 聊天、文字记录和标签。结果仅限于用户可以在其文本工作区中访问的数据。该应用程序是只读的，无法创建、更新、发送或删除文本数据。

source_long: TextExpander helps users search, read, create, update, move, and delete snippets and snippet groups from their TextExpander account, plus inspect profile, organization member, and usage statistics data when authorized.
plugin_details.target_long: TextExpander 帮助用户从其 TextExpander 帐户中搜索、读取、创建、更新、移动和删除片段和片段组，并在获得授权后检查个人资料、组织成员和使用统计数据。

source_long: Textmagic brings business SMS into your AI assistant. Send and schedule text messages, preview cost and recipients before sending, track delivery, and read incoming replies without leaving the chat. Manage your address book too: search contacts, create and update them, organize lists and tags. Every send is previewed and confirmed before it goes out, and messaging always respects your account balance and permissions. Ideal for appointment reminders, alerts, follow-ups and quick customer replies.
plugin_details.target_long: Textmagic 将商业短信带入您的人工智能助手。发送和安排短信、发送前预览费用和收件人、跟踪递送情况以及在不离开聊天的情况下阅读收到的回复。还可以管理您的地址簿：搜索联系人、创建和更新联系人、组织列表和标签。每次发送之前都会经过预览和确认，并且消息传递始终尊重您的帐户余额和权限。非常适合预约提醒、警报、跟进和快速客户回复。

source_long: Textxt lets users connect their Textxt account to ChatGPT so they can search, summarize, and retrieve their own readable Textxt chats in conversation. source_long:
Theia Insights brings professional thematic equity research into ChatGPT. Ask about a structural trend: artificial intelligence, robotics, clean energy, cybersecurity; and surface the public companies most exposed, ranked by research-driven exposure scores rather than keyword matching or self-reported tags.

The data is built on the Theia Insights Industry Classification (TIIC): a five-level, one-to-many taxonomy mapping companies to 3,000+ investable themes based on what they actually do. Performance is tracked through Theme Watch Indices (TWI), with 10+ years of daily history across global regions.

What you can do in ChatGPT:

* Profile any company by ticker, ISIN, FIGI, or ticker — see its full thematic exposure from sector down to micro-theme.
* Screen for thematic exposure across public markets — find the companies most exposed to a given theme, sub-industry, or industry.
* Benchmark theme performance over time and rank themes by recent returns to identify leaders, laggards, and rotation trends.

Built for portfolio managers, research analysts, index providers, and allocators who need defensible, data-driven answers to thematic questions.
plugin_details.target_long:
Theia Insights 将专业的主题股权研究引入 ChatGPT。询问结构性趋势：人工智能、机器人、清洁能源、网络安全；并显示曝光度最高的上市公司，按照研究驱动的曝光度分数而不是关键词匹配或自我报告的标签进行排名。

该数据基于 Theia Insights 行业分类 (TIIC)：一个五级、一对多的分类法，根据公司的实际业务将其映射到 3,000 多个可投资主题。通过主题观察指数 (TWI) 跟踪表现，该指数具有全球各地区 10 多年的每日历史记录。

您可以在 ChatGPT 中执行以下操作：

* 通过股票代码、ISIN、FIGI 或股票代码来介绍任何公司 — 查看其从行业到微观主题的完整主题曝光。
* 筛选公开市场中的主题曝光度 - 查找最受特定主题、子行业或行业影响的公司。
* 对一段时间内的主题表现进行基准测试，并根据最近的回报对主题进行排名，以确定领先者、落后者和轮换趋势。

专为需要对主题问题提供可靠的、数据驱动的答案的投资组合经理、研究分析师、指数提供商和分配者而设计。

source_long:
Create beautiful design themes for apps, websites, dashboards, landing pages, and more with AI. Describe what you want, explore different visual styles, compare ideas side by side, and preview your concepts in seconds. Whether you are starting from a blank page or refreshing an existing idea, this tool helps you quickly discover design directions without needing advanced design skills.

Simply tell ChatGPT what you want to build. You can ask for a mobile app, website, online store, portfolio, blog, dashboard, admin panel, marketing page, or almost any digital product. Then describe the feeling, audience, colors, or style you want. The AI turns your ideas into polished design themes that are easy to explore and refine.

Try many different looks without starting over. Generate clean, modern, minimal, playful, dark, colorful, premium, futuristic, glass, soft, bold, elegant, or creative themes. Compare different styles to find the one that best matches your project, brand, or personal taste. Small changes in your prompt can create fresh ideas that help you think in new ways.

Preview your ideas before spending time designing or building them. Seeing different themes early makes it easier to choose colors, layouts, typography, spacing, and overall visual direction. You can quickly decide what works and what does not before moving into design or development.

This tool is useful for designers, developers, founders, students, marketers, creators, agencies, and anyone who wants visual inspiration. It can help you explore ideas for business websites, startup landing pages, mobile apps, software dashboards, ecommerce stores, educational platforms, portfolios, travel sites, finance apps, health apps, productivity tools, entertainment services, and much more.

Use it when you need inspiration, want to overcome creative blocks, or simply want to see new possibilities. Generate many design directions in just a few moments instead of searching through endless galleries. Explore ideas that fit your goals and keep improving them until you find a style you love.

Experiment with color palettes, page layouts, interface styles, navigation, buttons, cards, forms, icons, sections, typography, and visual hierarchy. Ask for themes inspired by modern trends or timeless design principles. Mix different ideas together to create something unique for your own project.

The AI understands simple instructions, so you do not need special design words. Describe your project in everyday language. You can be detailed or brief. Ask for changes, request another style, or keep exploring until the result feels right. Every new prompt can lead to fresh concepts and unexpected ideas.

Whether you are planning your first website or improving a product used by thousands of people, this tool makes early design exploration faster and easier. It helps you discover themes, compare visual directions, and build confidence before investing time in detailed design work.

Perfect for brainstorming, creative exploration, product planning, design reviews, client presentations, prototypes, concept development, and visual inspiration. Turn simple ideas into attractive design themes, explore multiple possibilities, and find the look that best fits your project with the help of ChatGPT.
plugin_details.target_long:

只需告诉 ChatGPT 您想要构建什么即可。您可以索要移动应用程序、网站、在线商店、作品集、博客、仪表板、管理面板、营销页面或几乎任何数字产品。然后描述您想要的感觉、受众、颜色或风格。人工智能将您的想法转化为易于探索和完善的精美设计主题。

在花时间设计或构建您的想法之前预览它们。尽早看到不同的主题可以更轻松地选择颜色、布局、排版、间距和整体视觉方向。在开始设计或开发之前，您可以快速决定哪些有效，哪些无效。

该工具对于设计师、开发人员、创始人、学生、营销人员、创作者、代理机构以及任何想要视觉灵感的人都很有用。它可以帮助您探索商业网站、初创企业登陆页面、移动应用程序、软件仪表板、电子商务商店、教育平台、投资组合、旅游网站、金融应用程序、健康应用程序、生产力工具、娱乐服务等的想法。

当您需要灵感、想要克服创意障碍或只是想看到新的可能性时，请使用它。只需几分钟即可生成许多设计方向，而不是在无尽的画廊中搜索。探索适合您目标的想法并不断改进它们，直到找到您喜欢的风格。

无论您是规划您的第一个网站还是改进成千上万人使用的产品，此工具都可以让早期设计探索变得更快、更轻松。它可以帮助您在投入时间进行详细设计工作之前发现主题、比较视觉方向并建立信心。

With a simple tap, add your tasks and remind yourself about them, enjoy multiple views like calendar, list and boards, filter tasks by work and/or personal life, collaborate on projects, and achieve peace of mind.

Why choose Todoist?
Todoist is a simple yet powerful planner tool that organizes both your life and work.

• Create a habit of adding tasks like “Plan next week’s work every Friday afternoon” or “Do homework every Wednesday at 6pm” using Todoist’s powerful language recognition and recurring dates.

• Use one-tap templates to tackle everything from meeting agendas and accounting tasks, to packing lists and wedding planning.
• Instantly see what’s most important by setting visual task priority levels.
• Get to know your routine better with insights into your personalized productivity streaks.

Todoist on Apple iOS

• Stay organized from your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, while also syncing across desktop and all other devices.
• With natural language, write tasks like "tomorrow at 4pm" or “every other wednesday starting in two weeks” and Todoist will instantly parse it all out for you.

source_long:
Tonita is a search engine for apparel and accessories, built to work with how you actually think about shopping. It brings together products from hundreds of stores, thousands of brands, and millions of items — all in one place, from clothing and footwear to cosmetics and everyday essentials.

There isn’t just one way to shop. Sometimes you’re focused on price or practicality; other times it’s about style, fit, materials, or longevity. What matters can shift with the situation — work, travel, special occasions, outdoor use, or everyday wear. Tonita brings these options together, making it easier for you to browse, compare, and make an informed choice.

Within ChatGPT, Tonita works best as part of a conversation. You can explore broad questions, half-formed ideas, or specific constraints naturally — whether that means thinking through what to buy for a particular occasion, learning about materials or categories, or narrowing in on a specific kind of product. ChatGPT helps shape your thoughts into useful searches, and Tonita surfaces a wide set of relevant results for you to browse, compare, and refine as the picture becomes clearer. (For more advanced tools like virtual try-on, saving favorites, and deeper browsing, Tonita can also be used directly at Tonita.co.)

Tonita is built to support the way you actually think about shopping — by priorities, context, and tradeoffs — rather than forcing everything into rigid categories. This includes the ability to search and explore across aspects like:

• Budget and value: From fast fashion and sale finds to higher-end pieces, investment items, and everyday staples.
• Style and aesthetic: Minimalist, maximalist, classic, streetwear, formal, playful, utilitarian, fashion-forward, or timeless — and combinations of these.
• Trends and longevity: What’s popular right now, last season’s styles, and pieces meant to stay relevant beyond a trend cycle.
• Use case and setting: Work, travel, special occasions, outdoor use, events, lounging, or everyday wear.
• Fit, sizing, and comfort: Different body types and needs, including petite and extended sizing, relaxed or tailored fits, and comfort-first designs.
• Materials and feel: Natural fibers, synthetics, performance fabrics, lightweight layers, structured pieces, or materials chosen for warmth, breathability, or softness.
• Durability and care: Easy-care basics, machine-washable items, wrinkle-resistant pieces, or garments meant to be worn, repaired, and kept longer.
• Sustainability priorities: Interest in materials, production methods, longevity, or brands taking different approaches to environmental impact.
• Brand familiarity and discovery: Well-known labels alongside emerging brands, niche designers, and alternatives to the usual options.
• Putting a full look together: Apparel, footwear, accessories, jewelry, and cosmetics, considered side by side rather than in isolation.
plugin_details.target_long:
Tonita 是一个服装和配饰搜索引擎，专为了解您对购物的实际想法而设计。它汇集了数百家商店、数千个品牌和数百万种商品的产品——从服装和鞋类到化妆品和日常必需品，全部集中在一个地方。

购物方式不只有一种。有时您会关注价格或实用性；有时则与风格、合身性、材料或寿命有关。重要的事情可能会随着情况而变化——工作、旅行、特殊场合、户外使用或日常穿着。 Tonita 将这些选项整合在一起，让您更轻松地浏览、比较并做出明智的选择。

在 ChatGPT 中，Tonita 作为对话的一部分效果最好。您可以自然地探索广泛的问题、半成形的想法或特定的限制——无论这意味着思考在特定场合购买什么，了解材料或类别，还是缩小范围到特定类型的产品。 ChatGPT 可以帮助您将想法转化为有用的搜索，而 Tonita 会提供大量相关结果供您浏览、比较，并随着图片变得更加清晰而进行细化。 （对于更高级的工具，如虚拟试穿、保存收藏夹和更深入的浏览，也可以直接在 Tonita.co 上使用 Tonita。）

Tonita 旨在支持您实际考虑购物的方式（通过优先级、背景和权衡），而不是强迫所有内容都归入严格的类别。这包括跨方面搜索和探索的能力，例如：

• 预算和价值：从快时尚和促销品到高端单品、投资品和日常必需品。
• 风格和审美：极简主义、极简主义、经典、街头服饰、正式、俏皮、实用、时尚前卫或永恒——以及这些的组合。
• 趋势和长寿：现在流行什么、上一季的款式以及在流行周期之外保持相关性的单品。
• 使用案例和环境：工作、旅行、特殊场合、户外使用、活动、休闲或日常穿着。
• 合身、尺码和舒适度：不同的体型和需求，包括娇小和加长的尺码、宽松或定制版型以及舒适至上的设计。
• 材料和手感：天然纤维、合成材料、高性能织物、轻质层、结构件或选择保暖、透气或柔软的材料。
• 耐用性和护理：易于护理的基本款、可机洗的物品、抗皱单品或适合穿着、修理和保存更长时间的服装。
• 可持续发展优先事项：对材料、生产方法、寿命或采取不同方法应对环境影响的品牌感兴趣。
• 品牌熟悉度和发现度：知名品牌以及新兴品牌、利基设计师以及常规选择的替代品。
• 将整体外观放在一起：服装、鞋类、配饰、珠宝和化妆品，并排而不是孤立地考虑。

source_long: Tool4seller helps Amazon sellers inspect their authorized store, sales, profit, inventory, review, inbound shipment, advertising, and sales traffic data directly in ChatGPT. source_long: ToolCheck is M8ven's trust layer for the MCP ecosystem. Give it a GitHub URL or npm package name and it returns an independent trust score (0–100) and a clear verdict (Trusted / Caution / Concern), backed by static code analysis, runtime behavioral observation in a sandbox, CVE scanning, and a semantic check comparing the tool's  declared behavior against what its code actually does — catching the gap between "read-only market data" and code that can move your funds.
plugin_details.target_long: ToolCheck 是 M8ven 针对 MCP 生态系统的信任层。给它一个 GitHub URL 或 npm 包名称，它会返回一个独立的信任评分 (0-100) 和一个明确的结论（可信/警告/关注），并由静态代码分析、沙箱中的运行时行为观察、CVE 扫描以及将工具声明的行为与其代码实际功能进行比较的语义检查提供支持 - 找出“只读市场数据”和可以转移资金的代码之间的差距。

source_long: Describe a task or problem to find relevant ChatGPT apps from a curated catalog. Each result explains why it fits and highlights important limitations. ToolMatch links to app pages in ChatGPT, requires no login, and does not sell products or process payments.

source_long: Planning a caravan, camping, or cabin trip around Australia? Ask for parks near a place, options that look open for a travel window, powered or ensuite sites, accessible or spa cabins, whether a park welcomes dogs, if your caravan or motorhome will fit a site, or what a cabin actually includes - and get answers based on current Total Parks listing, capability, policy, and planning availability checks instead of guesswork. In compatible ChatGPT surfaces, search and stay-assessment results can also appear as Total Parks cards with photos, badges, availability labels, prices, and Book Now or View Park links. Every answer links back to totalparks.com.au, and when a stay looks like a good fit you'll get a booking link with your dates, guests, and pet or rig details already filled in. Coverage spans the parks and site types listed on Total Parks; planning search is indicative, and booking and payment always happen on the Total Parks website.
plugin_details.target_long: 计划在澳大利亚各地进行房车旅行、露营或小屋旅行吗？ Total Parks 可帮助您按目的地、特色、房间或地点详细信息、旅行氛围、日期、客人、宠物和装备详细信息查找假日公园、房车公园和露营地，然后在决定之前检查真实情况。询问某个地点附近的公园、可提供旅行窗口的选项、供电或套间场地、无障碍小屋或水疗小屋、公园是否欢迎狗、您的大篷车或房车是否适合场地，或者小屋实际包括什么 - 并根据当前 Total Parks 列表、能力、政策和规划可用性检查而不是猜测来获得答案。在兼容的 ChatGPT 界面中，搜索和住宿评估结果还可以显示为 Total Parks 卡，其中包含照片、徽章、可用性标签、价格以及立即预订或查看公园链接。每个答案都会链接回totalparks.com.au，当住宿看起来很合适时，您将获得一个预订链接，其中包含已填写的日期、客人以及宠物或装备详细信息。覆盖范围涵盖 Total Parks 上列出的公园和场地类型；规划搜索是指示性的，预订和付款始终在 Total Parks 网站上进行。

source_long: Townline tracks public construction opportunities so contractors don't have to: open government bids, RFPs, and solicitations plus fresh building-permit filings across New York, Connecticut, and New Jersey — Westchester, Fairfield, Hartford, New Haven, Nassau, Bergen, and more. source_long:
Trabber is a travel metasearch engine. Search for a flight, a place to stay or a rental car, and you get the current prices from the airline, travel agency, hotel and car rental websites that sell it, side by side, plus a direct link to book the one you pick on that seller's own website.

Why that helps: the identical trip can cost quite different amounts depending on where you buy it, and the cheapest seller changes from one route or property to the next. Checking by hand means a dozen browser tabs. Here you ask once.

What you can search:

- Flights, one way, return or multi-city.

- Accommodation of any kind: hotels, apartments, aparthotels, hostels, guest houses, villas, campgrounds.

- Rental cars.

- Flight deals, for when you have no destination or dates in mind yet.

Narrow any search down by asking: direct flights only, morning departures, breakfast and free cancellation, automatic with unlimited mileage. Connect your Trabber account and you can pick your recent searches back up.

Trabber doesn't sell travel. You book, pay and get support on the seller's website, under their terms.
plugin_details.target_long:
Trabber 是一个旅游元搜索引擎。搜索航班、住宿地点或租车，您可以从出售该航班、旅行社、酒店和汽车租赁网站并排获得当前价格，以及在该卖家自己的网站上预订您选择的航班的直接链接。

为什么这有帮助：同样的旅行可能花费完全不同的金额，具体取决于您在哪里购买，而且最便宜的卖家从一条路线或房产到另一条路线或房产。手动检查意味着要使用十几个浏览器选项卡。在这里你问一次。

您可以搜索什么：

- 航班，单程、返程或多城市。

- 任何类型的住宿：酒店、公寓、公寓式酒店、旅馆、招待所、别墅、露营地。

- 租车。

- 航班优惠，适用于您还没有目的地或日期的情况。

通过询问以下内容来缩小搜索范围：仅限直飞航班、早上出发、早餐和免费取消、自动无里程限制。连接您的 Trabber 帐户，您可以备份最近的搜索。

特拉伯不卖旅行。您可以根据卖家的条款在卖家的网站上预订、付款并获得支持。

source_long:
Effortless Global Shipping and Tracking with TX Logis

TX Logis is a global logistics and parcel delivery assistant that helps users navigate international shipping services with ease.

Whether you are sending personal parcels overseas, booking a pickup, submitting a shipping request, or tracking a business shipment, TX Logis provides step-by-step guidance for smooth and reliable delivery support.

TX Logis supports users looking for logistics services, parcel delivery, courier service, shipping reservations, shipment requests, personal shipping, quick delivery, international shipping, and shipment tracking.

Key Features:

- Real-time Tracking: Learn how to check your shipment status instantly using your tracking number or waybill.
- SmartPost Booking: Guidance for C2C international parcel delivery, personal shipping, pickup booking, and door-to-door services.
- Shipping Reservation and Request Support: Help with delivery reservations, shipment requests, parcel booking, and international shipping applications.
- Global Shipping Guide: Instructions for shipping to 70+ countries including Japan, Singapore, the US, and other major destinations.
- Logistics and Courier Support: Quick answers about logistics services, parcel delivery, courier service, quick delivery, shipping rates, prohibited items, and required documentation.
- Personal and Business Shipping: Support for both individual customers and business users sending parcels or managing shipments.

Simplify your international logistics, parcel delivery, booking, and tracking experience with the TX Logis assistant.
plugin_details.target_long:
使用 TX Logis 轻松进行全球运输和跟踪

TX Logis 是一款全球物流和包裹递送助手，可帮助用户轻松导航国际运输服务。

无论您是向海外寄送个人包裹、预订取件、提交运输请求还是跟踪商业货件，TX Logis 都会提供分步指导，以实现平稳可靠的递送支持。

TX Logis 支持寻求物流服务、包裹递送、快递服务、运输预订、运输请求、个人运输、快速交付、国际运输和运输跟踪的用户。

主要特点：

- 实时跟踪：了解如何使用您的跟踪号码或运单立即检查您的货件状态。
- SmartPost预订：C2C国际包裹递送、个人寄件、取件预订、上门服务指南。
- 运输预订和请求支持：帮助进行运输预订、运输请求、包裹预订和国际运输申请。
- 全球运送指南：运送至 70 多个国家/地区（包括日本、新加坡、美国和其他主要目的地）的说明。
- 物流和快递支持：有关物流服务、包裹递送、快递服务、快速配送、运费、违禁物品和所需文件的快速解答。
- 个人和企业运输：支持个人客户和企业用户发送包裹或管理货件。

使用 TX Logis 助手简化您的国际物流、包裹递送、预订和跟踪体验。

source_long:
TraderSpy connects ChatGPT to live crypto futures data, so you can ask about the market instead of tab-hopping between exchanges.

Ask what the AI signal engine has published for a coin and you get the entry, the take-profit ladder, the stop and what actually happened to earlier signals — not just a direction. Ask what the whales are doing and you get real positions held by top-performing traders on Binance, Hyperliquid, Bybit and OKX, plus a leaderboard scored on PnL, win rate, ROI and consistency. Prices, candles and 13 technical indicators are one question away, and with your own account connected you can ask how far a position sits from liquidation.

Every tool is read-only. TraderSpy cannot place, close or modify an order and has no withdrawal or transfer tool — it answers questions, you place your own trades. A free account is enough to start.
plugin_details.target_long:
TraderSpy 将 ChatGPT 连接到实时加密货币期货数据，因此您可以询问市场情况，而不是在交易所之间跳来跳去。

询问人工智能信号引擎已发布的代币信息，您会得到入场点、止盈阶梯、止损点以及早期信号实际发生的情况，而不仅仅是一个方向。询问鲸鱼在做什么，您可以获得币安、Hyperliquid、Bybit 和 OKX 上表现最好的交易者持有的真实头寸，以及在盈亏、胜率、投资回报率和一致性方面得分的排行榜。价格、蜡烛图和 13 种技术指标只需一问即可，通过连接您自己的账户，您可以询问仓位距清算还有多远。

每个工具都是只读的。 TraderSpy 无法下达、关闭或修改订单，也没有提款或转账工具——它回答问题，您下达自己的交易。一个免费帐户足以开始。

source_long: TradingCursor delivers structured, multi-signal analysis for stocks, crypto, forex, and ETFs.
plugin_details.target_long: TradingCursor 为股票、加密货币、外汇和 ETF 提供结构化、多信号分析。

source_long: TradingNX Risk Manager helps traders check planned trades before entry. It calculates position size, risk amount, risk/reward, daily loss exposure, open risk exposure, rule violations, and a TradingNX Risk Score. It supports forex, metals, crypto, stocks, indices, futures, and CFDs. TradingNX is educational risk-management software only and does not provide buy, sell, hold, investment, or financial advice.
plugin_details.target_long: TradingNX 风险管理器可帮助交易者在入场前检查计划交易。它计算头寸规模、风险金额、风险/回报、每日损失暴露、未平仓风险暴露、违反规则和 TradingNX 风险评分。它支持外汇、金属、加密货币、股票、指数、期货和差价合约。 TradingNX 只是教育风险管理软件，不提供购买、出售、持有、投资或财务建议。

source_long: Traffik measures the movement of the world's superyachts and private aviation from live public safety broadcasts. Ask for the weekly Traffik Index (100 = an ordinary week on the water), the measured pulse of any tracked yachting harbor — Monaco, Newport, Miami, Porto Cervo, the Hamptons and 150 more — plus private jets and helicopters into executive airports, or measured superyacht attendance at marquee events like the Monaco Grand Prix. Every number is a floor, not an estimate: only broadcasting vessels inside named geofences are counted, and every answer states its method and date.
plugin_details.target_long: Traffik 通过现场公共安全广播来衡量世界超级游艇和私人航空的移动情况。询问每周的交通指数（100 = 水上的正常一周）、测量的任何跟踪游艇港口的脉搏（摩纳哥、纽波特、迈阿密、切尔沃港、汉普顿等 150 个）以及进入行政机场的私人飞机和直升机，或者测量超级游艇参加摩纳哥大奖赛等大型活动的情况。每个数字都是楼层，而不是估计值：仅计算指定地理围栏内的广播船只，每个答案都说明了其方法和日期。

source_long: Trail Hits connects your bike maintenance data from Trail Hits app to your AI assistant. Ask what condition your bike is in, what service is due, and how to do it, then get walked through the job step by step using your assistant's own knowledge. Bike shops running Trail Hits Hub can also check work orders, customer history, and technician labor. Access is read-only unless you choose to let the assistant take actions, like approving one of your own estimates or adding a note to a work order.
plugin_details.target_long: Trail Hits 将您的自行车维护数据从 Trail Hits 应用程序连接到您的人工智能助手。询问您的自行车状况如何、需要什么服务以及如何进行，然后利用助手自己的知识逐步完成这项工作。运行 Trail Hits Hub 的自行车店还可以检查工作订单、客户历史记录和技术人员劳动力。访问权限是只读的，除非您选择让助理执行操作，例如批准您自己的估算或向工作订单添加注释。

source_long:
TrailVerse brings national parks exploration into ChatGPT.

Live data for 470+ U.S. national parks, monuments, and historic sites — plus day-by-day trip planning. Tell Trailie you’re a beginner with kids visiting Zion in July, and it can build a pace-matched itinerary using live NPS alerts and weather, with hike limits and family-friendly pacing when you ask. Always confirm safety-critical details on NPS.gov before you go.

Five focused capabilities:

• Plan a trip — Constraint-aware day-by-day itineraries (dates, hike difficulty/distance, pace). Revise the plan in the same chat. Best for NPS parks; also useful for broader U.S. trip ideas.

• Park details — Live weather, alerts, entrance fees, and top activities for NPS sites.

• Compare parks — Side-by-side 2–4 NPS parks with clear highlights.

• Search parks — Find NPS sites by state, activity, or name across the full catalog.

• Find events — Upcoming ranger programs, guided tours, and park-hosted events.

Read tools use the National Park Service API and live weather. Campground and permit inventory are not guaranteed live — confirm on Recreation.gov or NPS before booking. Free to use in ChatGPT. For saved trips, PDF export, and full Trailie history, continue at nationalparksexplorerusa.com/plan-ai.
plugin_details.target_long:
TrailVerse 将国家公园探索带入 ChatGPT。

470 多个美国国家公园、纪念碑和历史古迹的实时数据 - 以及每日旅行计划。告诉 Trailie，您是一位带着孩子在 7 月访问锡安的初学者，它可以使用实时 NPS 警报和天气来制定适合节奏的行程，并根据您的要求提供徒步限制和适合家庭的节奏。出发前请务必在 NPS.gov 上确认安全关键详细信息。

五项重点能力：

• 计划旅行——了解限制因素的每日行程（日期、徒步难度/距离、步速）。在同一次聊天中修改计划。最适合 NPS 公园；对于更广泛的美国旅行想法也很有用。

• 公园详细信息— NPS 站点的实时天气、警报、入场费和热门活动。

• 比较公园——并排列出2-4 个具有明显亮点的NPS 公园。

• 搜索公园— 在整个目录中按州、活动或名称查找NPS 站点。

• 查找活动— 即将推出的护林员计划、导游和公园举办的活动。

阅读工具使用国家公园服务 API 和实时天气。露营地和许可证库存不保证实时 - 预订前请在 Recreation.gov 或 NPS 上确认。可在 ChatGPT 中免费使用。如需保存的行程、PDF 导出和完整的 Trailie 历史记录，请继续访问Nationalparksexplorerusa.com/plan-ai。

source_long:
Stay informed. Travel smarter. Stay safe.

Before you book or travel, you can quickly check:

Official Travel Advisories
View government travel advisory levels, key safety concerns, and official warnings for any destination.

Traveler-Specific Risk Insights
Understand how safety conditions may differ for solo travelers, families, business trips, and remote workers.

Political & Stability Context
Review governance, freedom, and security indicators to better understand local conditions.

Country Comparisons
Compare travel advisories and risk factors across multiple countries to help choose between destinations.

Whether you’re planning a vacation, a work trip, or a long-term stay, Travel Advisory makes it easier to make informed travel decisions using clear, official safety information.

Try asking questions like:
- “Is France safe to visit right now?”
- “Which is safer for travel, Mexico or Costa Rica?”

Travel Advisory is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. government.
Advisory information reflects the latest published updates from official sources and is refreshed daily.

source_long:
Travelsearch is a structured travel search and discovery tool that returns highly relevant holiday options based on natural language queries.

It enables AI agents to match user intent (e.g. destination, budget, dates, amenities, travel style) to real, bookable travel inventory using enriched, multi-source product data.

Users can describe their trip in plain language, such as:

“Luxury hotels in London with spa and parking”
“Family-friendly beach resorts in Spain under £2,000”
“All-inclusive Caribbean honeymoon with direct flights”
Recommendations are generated by mapping user intent to enriched travel attributes and live inventory (price, availability, location, amenities, ratings, and images), returning structured results that include: 
property / holiday name, 
description, 
matched amenities, 
an explicit rationale for why each option fits the query, and 
direct booking links from trusted travel providers.
Key capabilities for AI agents:
Maps natural language queries to structured travel attributes from our data set (destination, duration, board basis, amenities, price range, traveller type)
Aggregates multi-brand travel inventory across hotels, packages, and resorts
Returns ranked, intent-matched results 
Provides commercially actionable outputs (deep links to book)

Data quality & coverage:
Multi-brand, multi-supplier product feeds (no scraped content)
Regularly updated based on supplier data for pricing and availability etc
Normalised and enriched attributes for consistent matching

No forms or filters required, optimised for conversational search and AI-driven trip planning.

When to use this tool:
When a user is searching for holidays, hotels, or travel recommendations
When queries include preferences (budget, amenities, travel style, group type)
When bookable options with links are required
When results should be personalised or filtered beyond generic search
plugin_details.target_long:
Travelsearch 是一种结构化的旅行搜索和发现工具，可根据自然语言查询返回高度相关的假期选项。

它使人工智能代理能够使用丰富的多源产品数据将用户意图（例如目的地、预算、日期、便利设施、旅行方式）与真实的、可预订的旅行库存相匹配。

用户可以用通俗易懂的语言描述他们的旅行，例如：

“伦敦的豪华酒店，设有水疗中心和停车场”
“西班牙适合家庭入住的海滩度假村，价格低于 2,000 英镑”
“全包加勒比蜜月直飞航班”
通过将用户意图映射到丰富的旅行属性和实时库存（价格、可用性、位置、设施、评级和图像）来生成推荐，返回结构化结果，包括： 
属性/假期名称， 
描述， 
配套设施、 
每个选项适合查询的明确理由，以及 
来自值得信赖的旅行提供商的直接预订链接。
AI 代理的关键功能：
将自然语言查询映射到我们数据集中的结构化旅行属性（目的地、持续时间、乘车基础、便利设施、价格范围、旅行者类型）
聚合酒店、套餐和度假村的多品牌旅游库存
返回排名一致、意图匹配的结果 
提供商业上可行的输出（书籍的深层链接）

数据质量和覆盖范围：
多品牌、多供应商产品提要（无抓取内容）
根据供应商数据定期更新定价和可用性等
标准化和丰富的属性以实现一致匹配

无需表格或过滤器，针对对话式搜索和人工智能驱动的旅行计划进行了优化。

何时使用此工具：
当用户搜索假期、酒店或旅行推荐时
当查询包含偏好时（预算、便利设施、旅行方式、团体类型）
当需要带有链接的可预订选项时
何时应对结果进行个性化或过滤以超出通用搜索范围
