Once configured, you can manage your to-do’s without having to switch between tabs. Start tackling your Trello tasks with the help of ChatGPT!
plugin_details.target_long: Trello 插件允许 ChatGPT 使用自然语言与您的 Trello 看板、卡片和任务进行交互。 ChatGPT 和 Trello 之间的所有通信都经过加密以保护隐私，并使用安全最佳实践进行身份验证。配置完成后，您无需在选项卡之间切换即可管理待办事项。在 ChatGPT 的帮助下开始处理您的 Trello 任务！

source_long: Trendata connects you to real-time market intelligence and consumer search data. It allows you to easily analyze global locations, product categories, and specific brands or retailers directly within your workflow. By providing historical search volumes and concrete growth metrics, you can accurately spot consumer preferences and changing market trends. It turns complex data into clear, actionable insights for smarter business decisions.
plugin_details.target_long: Trendata 将您连接到实时市场情报和消费者搜索数据。它允许您直接在工作流程中轻松分析全球位置、产品类别以及特定品牌或零售商。通过提供历史搜索量和具体的增长指标，您可以准确地发现消费者偏好和不断变化的市场趋势。它将复杂的数据转化为清晰、可操作的见解，以做出更明智的业务决策。

source_long:
TriAstra creates personalized birth charts and natal horoscopes in ChatGPT across three traditions: Western astrology, Vedic astrology (Jyotish/Kundli), and Korean Saju (Korean Four Pillars/Myeongri).

Enter your birth date, birth time, and birthplace, then choose the tradition you want to explore. The interactive result highlights the placements and patterns that matter most in your chart and explains the calculation behind them in plain language. If your birth time is unknown, TriAstra keeps the reading to what can still be calculated reliably and leaves out houses, angles, and other time-dependent conclusions. For Saju, biological sex is used only to determine the traditional Daeun direction.

Western and Vedic charts use Swiss Ephemeris astronomical data; Saju follows Korean Myeongri principles. TriAstra is designed for individual natal readings rather than daily forecasts or relationship matching. Results are for reflection and entertainment and are not medical, legal, financial, or other professional advice.
plugin_details.target_long:
TriAstra 在 ChatGPT 中创建了跨越三种传统的个性化出生图和本命星座：西方占星学、吠陀占星学 (Jyotish/Kundli) 和韩国 Saju (韩国四柱/明里)。

输入您的出生日期、出生时间和出生地，然后选择您想要探索的传统。交互式结果突出显示了图表中最重要的位置和模式，并用简单的语言解释了它们背后的计算。如果您的出生时间未知，TriAstra 会将读数保留为仍然可以可靠计算的值，并忽略房屋、角度和其他与时间相关的结论。对于 Saju 来说，生物性别仅用于确定传统的 Daeun 方向。

西方和吠陀图表使用瑞士星历表天文数据； Saju 遵循韩国明里原则。 TriAstra 专为个人出生读数而设计，而不是每日预测或关系匹配。结果仅供思考和娱乐，并非医疗、法律、财务或其他专业建议。

source_long:
Trilogy Health Services Jobs helps job seekers explore open roles at Trilogy Health Services. Search by job title, location, or both — the assistant surfaces relevant opportunities and lets you dig into the details before applying. 
Powered by Appcast.
plugin_details.target_long:
Trilogy Health Services 职位帮助求职者探索 Trilogy Health Services 的空缺职位。按职位、地点或两者进行搜索 - 助理会显示相关机会，并让您在申请前深入了解详细信息。 
由 Appcast 提供支持。

source_long:
Search and compare flights, hotels, and trains directly in ChatGPT with Trip.com, your all-in-one travel companion. Explore one-way, round-trip and multi-city flights; select hotels in your target cities; pick suitable rail journeys across Europe and Asia.

Trip.com is perfect for your journey inspiration, itinerary planning, and travel product booking. Enjoy secure instant booking, and 24/7 support with multiple languages.
plugin_details.target_long:
使用您的一体化旅行伴侣 Trip.com 直接在 ChatGPT 搜索并比较航班、酒店和火车。探索单程、往返和多城市航班；选择您的目标城市的酒店；选择横跨欧洲和亚洲的合适铁路旅程。

Trip.com 是您获取旅程灵感、行程规划和旅游产品预订的完美选择。享受安全的即时预订和多种语言的 24/7 支持。

source_long:
TripHelm turns trip planning into a real calendar instead of a tangle of notes, tabs, and screenshots. Describe your trip in plain language and TripHelm lays it out for you — flights, meals, check-ins, activities, and downtime, each placed on the right day at the right time.

Need to change something? Just say it: "push dinner to 8," "add a coffee stop before the museum," "lighten up day 3" — and the schedule updates. Everything saves to your TripHelm account and opens in the full web app, where you can drag, drop, and fine-tune any block by hand.

Plan a whole trip from scratch or adjust one already underway. Either way you walk away with a clear, hour-by-hour schedule you can actually follow — not a wall of text you're re-reading at the gate.
plugin_details.target_long:
TripHelm 将旅行计划转变为真正的日历，而不是一堆笔记、选项卡和屏幕截图。用简单的语言描述您的旅行，TripHelm 会为您安排好航班、餐饮、办理登机手续、活动和休息时间，每一项都安排在正确的日期和时间。

需要改变一些东西吗？只要说出来：“把晚餐推迟到 8 点”、“在博物馆前增加一个喝咖啡的地方”、“让第三天放松一下”——然后日程就会更新。所有内容都会保存到您的 TripHelm 帐户并在完整的网络应用程序中打开，您可以在其中手动拖放和微调任何块。

从头开始计划整个旅行或调整已经开始的旅行。不管怎样，你离开时都会得到一个清晰的、可以实际遵循的每小时时间表——而不是你在门口重新阅读的一堵文字墙。

source_long:
TripO lets you book hotels worldwide right inside ChatGPT — and unlike most booking sites, you don't give anything up to do it.
Add your loyalty membership when you book, and you keep what you've earned: points, elite status recognition, member benefits — all honored just as if you booked direct with IHG, Marriott, Hilton, and other major chains.
At select luxury and business hotels, TripO goes further. Our preferred rates come with extra benefits like complimentary breakfast, room upgrades when available, hotel credits, and early check-in or late check-out — perks normally reserved for high-end travel advisors.
Just describe what you need in plain language — "a hotel near Shinjuku Station next weekend, breakfast included, under $150 a night" — and TripO returns live availability and real rates from professional travel inventory. Compare room types, bed configurations, and cancellation policies, refine conversationally, and book without ever leaving the chat.
TripO is built by FreeTravel, a travel technology company connecting AI assistants with global hotel inventory.
plugin_details.target_long:
TripO 可让您在 ChatGPT 内预订全球酒店 - 与大多数预订网站不同，您无需为此付出任何代价。
预订时添加您的忠诚会员资格，您就可以保留您所赚取的一切：积分、精英身份认可、会员福利 - 所有这些都将享受到，就像您直接通过 IHG、万豪、希尔顿和其他主要连锁酒店预订一样。
在精选的豪华和商务酒店，TripO 更进一步。我们的优惠房价附带额外福利，例如免费早餐、客房升级（如有）、酒店积分以及提前入住或延迟退房——这些福利通常为高端旅行顾问保留。
只需用简单的语言描述您的需求 - “下周末新宿站附近的酒店，含早餐，每晚 150 美元以下” - TripO 就会从专业旅游库存中返回实时空房情况和实际价格。比较房间类型、床型配置和取消政策，通过对话进行完善，无需退出聊天即可预订。
TripO 由 FreeTravel 打造，FreeTravel 是一家将人工智能助手与全球酒店库存连接起来的旅游科技公司。

source_long: TripPocket plans domestic trips across South Korea. Ask in plain language and it searches real attractions, recommends regions and travel courses, builds day-by-day itineraries, and answers weather, festival, and transport-cost questions using TripPocket's curated Korea travel data. It supports family, couple, solo, and barrier-free / stroller / pet-friendly / low-walking travel conditions. All places, hours, prices, and scores come from TripPocket's backend — nothing is invented.
plugin_details.target_long: TripPocket 计划韩国国内旅行。用简单的语言询问，它就会搜索真正的景点、推荐地区和旅行路线、制定每日行程，并使用 TripPocket 精选的韩国旅行数据回答天气、节日和交通费用问题。支持家庭、情侣、单人、无障碍/婴儿车/宠物/低步行出行条件。所有地点、时间、价格和分数都来自 TripPocket 的后端——没有任何发明。

source_long: The Tripadvisor app brings trusted reviews and hotel insights into ChatGPT, offering a faster, more confident way to find the perfect place to stay. Travelers can explore top-rated hotels on an interactive, map-first view to instantly understand neighborhoods, distance, and vibe. They can refine results naturally through conversational follow-ups, access rich hotel details including traveler photos, recent reviews, amenities, compare price offers and click out seamlessly to booking partners or Tripadvisor for deeper research.
plugin_details.target_long: Tripadvisor 应用程序将值得信赖的评论和酒店见解引入 ChatGPT，提供更快、更自信的方式来找到完美的住宿地点。旅行者可以通过交互式地图优先视图探索顶级酒店，立即了解街区、距离和氛围。他们可以通过对话式跟进自然地完善结果，访问丰富的酒店详细信息，包括旅行者照片、最近的评论、设施、比较价格，并无缝点击预订合作伙伴或 Tripadvisor 进行更深入的研究。

source_long:
Tripbtoz is a hotel booking assistant that helps travelers find the right stay with less effort. Search hotels by city, district, or landmark, browse results in a clean list, and open any hotel to see key details—such as room options and rates for your dates—so you can compare quickly and decide with confidence. 

Why people will love it
- Find hotels by location or landmark in seconds
- Compare stays with a simple, readable results view
- Check room options and prices in one place before booking
plugin_details.target_long:
Tripbtoz 是一款酒店预订助手，可帮助旅行者轻松找到合适的住宿。按城市、地区或地标搜索酒店，在干净的列表中浏览结果，然后打开任何酒店查看关键详细信息，例如客房选项和您所选日期的房价，以便您可以快速比较并自信地做出决定。 

为什么人们会喜欢它
- 在几秒钟内按地点或地标找到酒店
- 通过简单易读的结果视图来比较停留时间
- 预订前在一个地方查看客房选项和价格

source_long: Triple Whale helps users analyze connected e-commerce stores in ChatGPT by retrieving store context, configured KPIs, attribution results, metric-change explanations, documentation, and read-only warehouse query results.
plugin_details.target_long: Triple Whale 通过检索商店上下文、配置的 KPI、归因结果、指标更改说明、文档和只读仓库查询结果，帮助用户分析 ChatGPT 中连接的电子商务商店。

source_long:
Tripuck is a flight meta-search and trip-planning service. This connector
lets you search live flight prices, explore a route's cheapest days of the
month, browse popular destinations from any origin city, and open full
segment / baggage details for any result — all without leaving the chat.

Tripuck's signature feature is **Meeting Point**: given 2-5 travelers flying
from different cities, it computes the cheapest and fairest common
destination, along with a per-person price breakdown and a fairness score.
It's ideal for coordinating trips where the group is spread across several
countries.

Every result deep-links back to tripuck.com for booking review and
checkout. The connector itself is read-only — it does not book, charge,
modify accounts, or hold any user payment information.

Supported user languages: Turkish, English, Arabic, Azerbaijani, German,
Georgian, and Uzbek. The tool infers the user's language from the
conversation and returns responses in that language, including right-to-
left layout for Arabic.
plugin_details.target_long:
Tripuck 是一项航班元搜索和旅行规划服务。这个连接器
让您搜索实时航班价格，探索航线中最便宜的日子
月，浏览任意始发城市的热门目的地，并打开完整
任何结果的航段/行李详细信息 - 无需离开聊天即可完成所有操作。

Tripuck 的标志性功能是**集合点**：给定 2-5 名乘坐飞机的旅客
它计算来自不同城市的最便宜和最公平的普通
目的地，以及每人价格细目和公平得分。
它非常适合协调团队分散在多个地点的旅行
国家。

每个结果都会深层链接回 tripuck.com 以进行预订审核和
结帐。连接器本身是只读的——它不会预订、充电、
修改帐户，或持有任何用户付款信息。

支持的用户语言：土耳其语、英语、阿拉伯语、阿塞拜疆语、德语、
格鲁吉亚语、乌兹别克语。该工具根据用户的语言推断出用户的语言
对话并返回该语言的响应，包括权利-
阿拉伯语的左侧布局。

source_long: Trivana Study turns what you're learning into a playable, AI-hosted practice quiz. Paste up to 2000 characters of notes, share a supported public webpage URL, name a subject, or ask to practice material from the current conversation. Trivana builds questions from that material and returns an unlisted link you can play or share with a study group. An unlisted quiz is not automatically featured publicly, but anyone with its link can open and play it. Choose a quick 5-question check, a balanced 7-question round, or a 10-question deep dive in 10 languages with one of 8 AI host personalities. Questions remain on screen while you answer, scoring is automatic, and your selected host guides the round; voice availability varies by host, language, and production level. Players do not need an account. When available, use Save & track scores on the result card to keep plays, scores, and replays. Useful for class revision, lecture review, certification and exam practice, self-testing, and checking whether the material actually stuck. Trivana Study does not ingest ChatGPT file attachments or PDFs; paste the relevant text or provide a supported public webpage URL instead.
plugin_details.target_long: Trivana Study 将您正在学习的内容转变为可玩的、由 AI 托管的练习测验。粘贴最多 2000 个字符的注释、共享受支持的公共网页 URL、命名主题或要求练习当前对话中的材料。 Trivana 根据该材料构建问题，并返回一个未列出的链接，您可以在学习小组中播放或分享。未列出的测验不会自动公开，但任何知道其链接的人都可以打开并玩它。选择包含 5 个问题的快速检查、包含 7 个问题的平衡轮，或者由 8 位 AI 主持人个性之一以 10 种语言进行 10 个问题的深入探讨。当您回答时，问题会保留在屏幕上，评分是自动的，并且您选择的主持人会指导整个回合；语音可用性因主持人、语言和制作水平而异。玩家不需要帐户。如果可用，请使用结果卡上的“保存并跟踪分数”来保存比赛、分数和重播。对于课堂复习、讲座复习、认证和考试练习、自测以及检查材料是否真正被粘住很有用。 Trivana Study 不会摄取 ChatGPT 文件附件或 PDF；请粘贴相关文本或提供受支持的公共网页 URL。

source_long: Create a playable, AI-hosted trivia gameshow from any topic or public webpage. Trivana is built for game nights, parties, family gatherings, classroom warm-ups, team icebreakers, and live events. Choose 5, 7, or 10 questions, 10 supported languages, and one of 8 distinct hosts—or let Trivana cast a host for the topic. The in-chat card previews a sample question, then a shareable trivana.ai link opens the full free-to-play game with automatic scoring and reusable host moments. Players do not need an account. Every ChatGPT-created game starts as an unlisted share link. When the private card offers Claim your game, use it to take ownership and view play results. A claimed creator can separately opt into Community and search discovery on Trivana after confirming publication rights; quality and traction checks still apply. Voice availability varies by host, language, and production level. For private self-study, exam or certification practice, and quizzes grounded in pasted notes, use the separate Trivana Study app.
plugin_details.target_long: 从任何主题或公共网页创建可玩的、由 AI 托管的问答游戏节目。 Trivana 专为游戏之夜、聚会、家庭聚会、课堂热身、团队破冰活动和现场活动而打造。选择 5、7 或 10 个问题、10 种支持的语言以及 8 个不同主持人之一，或者让 Trivana 为该主题选择一位主持人。聊天卡预览示例问题，然后可共享的 trivana.ai 链接打开完整的免费游戏，其中包含自动评分和可重复使用的主机时刻。玩家不需要帐户。每个 ChatGPT 创建的游戏都以不公开的共享链接开始。当私人卡提供“认领您的游戏”时，请使用它来获取所有权并查看游戏结果。声称的创作者在确认出版权后可以分别选择加入 Trivana 上的社区和搜索发现；质量和牵引力检查仍然适用。语音可用性因主持人、语言和制作水平而异。对于私人自学、考试或认证练习以及基于粘贴笔记的测验，请使用单独的 Trivana Study 应用程序。

source_long:
Create live trivia games and quizzes with ChatGPT. Turn any topic, lesson, meeting, or event into a playable quiz you can instantly publish for friends, students, or colleagues. Share a QR code, start the game, and host with live scoreboards, timers, sound effects, and a monitoring dashboard.

- Instant Quiz Publishing: Go from a ChatGPT prompt to a live player link and QR code in seconds.

- Live Game Hosting: Run timed questions, track players, and follow scoreboards as answers come in.

- Host Dashboard: Monitor players, responses, progress, and results from a private admin view.

Ideal Use Cases: For teachers, trainers, workshop hosts, team leads, and trivia fans who want to create engaging live quizzes for classrooms, meetings, events, demos, or game nights.

How to Use in ChatGPT

1. Connect App: Connect TriviaQuiz to ChatGPT.

2. Trigger: Type “@TriviaQuiz”.

Sample prompts:

- "@TriviaQuiz Create a 6-question trivia game about the Apollo program."

- "@TriviaQuiz Make a classroom quiz on photosynthesis with multiple-choice and true/false questions."

- "@TriviaQuiz Turn this workshop agenda into a live team quiz with a QR code."

- "@TriviaQuiz Create a fun Friday quiz for my team about product launches."
plugin_details.target_long:
使用 ChatGPT 创建实时问答游戏和测验。将任何主题、课程、会议或活动变成可玩的测验，您可以立即发布给朋友、学生或同事。共享二维码、启动游戏并使用实时记分牌、计时器、音效和监控仪表板进行主持。

- 即时测验发布：在几秒钟内从 ChatGPT 提示转到实时播放器链接和二维码。

- 实时游戏托管：运行定时问题、跟踪玩家并在答案出现时关注记分牌。

- 主机仪表板：从私人管理视图监控玩家、响应、进度和结果。

理想用例：适合希望为课堂、会议、活动、演示或游戏之夜创建引人入胜的实时测验的教师、培训师、研讨会主持人、团队领导和问答爱好者。

如何在 ChatGPT 中使用

1. 连接应用程序：将 TriviaQuiz 连接到 ChatGPT。

2. 触发：输入“@TriviaQuiz”。

提示示例：

- “@TriviaQuiz 创建一个有关阿波罗计划的 6 个问题问答游戏。”

- “@TriviaQuiz 通过多项选择题和对错题进行光合作用课堂测验。”

- “@TriviaQuiz 通过二维码将此研讨会议程转变为现场团队测验。”

- “@TriviaQuiz 为我的团队创建一个关于产品发布的有趣的周五测验。”

source_long:
Trocafone is Brazil's leading marketplace for certified pre-owned tech. We specialize in smartphones but also offer a wide range of devices including tablets, notebooks, smartwatches and accessories from various brands.

Every product goes through rigorous quality testing and is assigned a clear grade so you know exactly what you're getting. All purchases include warranty and are processed securely through our website.

Use this GPT to discover available devices, check specs, compare grades and find the best deals. Purchases and payments are completed at trocafone.com.
plugin_details.target_long:
Trocafone 是巴西领先的经过认证的二手技术市场。我们专注于智能手机，但也提供各种设备，包括平板电脑、笔记本电脑、智能手表和各个品牌的配件。

每件产品都经过严格的质量测试，并被分配一个明确的等级，因此您确切地知道您得到的是什么。所有购买均包含保修，并通过我们的网站安全处理。

使用此 GPT 来发现可用设备、检查规格、比较等级并找到最优惠的价格。购买和付款在trocafone.com 上完成。

source_long:
Software + AI pricing isn't public, so searching the internet won't tell you if you're overpaying. Tropic will.

Connect Tropic to ChatGPT to benchmark your pricing against $18B+ in verified technology spend, access negotiation playbooks from 100,000+ real deals, and get supplier intelligence on competitors and contract terms. Upload a proposal, ask if you're getting a good price, and go into your next negotiation with real leverage.

Your existing Tropic permissions apply. You only see data you're authorized to access in the Tropic app.
plugin_details.target_long:
软件+人工智能的定价并不公开，因此通过互联网搜索并不能告诉你是否支付过高。热带意志。

将 Tropic 连接到 ChatGPT，将您的定价与经过验证的技术支出超过 18B 美元进行比较，访问来自 100,000 多个真实交易的谈判手册，并获取有关竞争对手和合同条款的供应商情报。上传提案，询问您是否能得到一个好的价格，并以真正的优势进入下一次谈判。

您现有的 Tropic 权限适用。您只能在 Tropic 应用程序中看到您有权访问的数据。

source_long: Trovaprezzi helps users find purchasable physical products, compare current prices and offers, and open relevant Trovaprezzi listings from a carousel widget inside ChatGPT. The app supports shopping-oriented searches for specific models, variants, availability, and budget-filtered product discovery while avoiding purely informational or non-shopping requests.

source_long:
The ChatGPT Trucordia Go tool helps users explore estimated auto and home insurance premiums in the United States (U.S.) through ChatGPT. End users answer a series of questions and receive a preliminary estimate of U.S. auto and home insurance premiums. When they're ready to get personalized quotes, they receive a URL containing encoded parameters for the Trucordia Go AI assistant, which resumes the process from where they left off.
What Users Can Do:

Get rough monthly premium estimates for U.S. auto and home insurance.
Switch between auto and home quotes in the same conversation — their information carries over.
Continue with Trucordia's own AI assistant for personalized quotes, or get connected with a licensed advisor at Trucordia.
See bundling options for U.S. home and auto insurance.
Collects only limited estimate factors such as ZIP code, driver count, primary driver age, young-driver status, vehicle count, home year built, and square footage. 

What This App Does Not Do:

Does not collect name, street address, date of birth, SSN, email address, payment details, bank details, or health information inside ChatGPT.
Does not collect personal health information.
Does not generate binding quotes or exact pricing.
Does not bind coverage or issue policies.
Does not collect payment card, credit card, or any financial information.
Does not take payments.
plugin_details.target_long:
ChatGPT Trucordia Go 工具可帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 探索美国 (U.S.) 的汽车和家庭保险保费预估。最终用户回答一系列问题并收到美国汽车和家庭保险保费的初步估算。当他们准备好获得个性化报价时，他们会收到一个 URL，其中包含 Trucordia Go AI 助手的编码参数，该助手会从他们中断的地方恢复该过程。
用户可以做什么：

获取美国汽车和家庭保险的每月保费粗略估算。
在同一对话中在汽车报价和家庭报价之间切换 - 他们的信息会保留。
继续使用 Trucordia 自己的人工智能助手进行个性化报价，或与 Trucordia 的授权顾问联系。
查看美国家庭和汽车保险的捆绑选项。
仅收集有限的估计因素，例如邮政编码、驾驶员数量、主要驾驶员年龄、年轻驾驶员状态、车辆数量、房屋建成年份和平方英尺。 

这个应用程序不做什么：

不会在 ChatGPT 内收集姓名、街道地址、出生日期、SSN、电子邮件地址、付款详细信息、银行详细信息或健康信息。
不收集个人健康信息。
不生成具有约束力的报价或准确的定价。
不约束承保范围或签发保单。
不收集支付卡、信用卡或任何财务信息。
不接受付款。

source_long:
TwinMind captures everything you say and hear in your meetings, lectures, and in-person conversations. It automatically transcribes, summarizes, proactively offers suggestions and tasks, and continuously builds context for your AI Second Brain.
TwinMind is a productivity tool leveraging AI to function as your second brain. It captures everything heard, seen, and said—growing with you the more you interact and engage with TwinMind to build a comprehensive context of your digital life. This captured context enables several key features:
Personalized and Proactive Assistance: TwinMind provides tailored suggestions and ideas based on your captured memories, anticipating needs and offering relevant insights.
Streamlined Productivity: It enhances your notetaking by having your AI assistant automate tasks such as generating summaries and action items from meetings and conversations. You can search their entire memory bank, ask questions, generate emails and study guides, investor memos, project plans, and more.
Privacy Focus: TwinMind prioritizes user privacy through on-device transcription, options to save transcripts locally or on the cloud. We're committed to zero third-party data sharing. Audio is processed on-the-fly and never stored.
Key Features and Functionality:

Capture and Context Building: Captures your activity (audio, visual, text) on mobile and desktop if partnered with the TwinMind chrome extension.
Personalized Suggestions: Your AI sidekick will offer tailored insights based on captured memories.
Automated Summaries and Action Items: Extracts key information from meetings, conversations, and class lectures.
Searchable Memory Bank: Allows you to search your captured history and notes.
Ask TwinMind Anything: Enables you to ask questions and receive answers with context of your memories or active meetings.
Content Generation: Facilitates the creation of follow up emails, study guides, and other documents to help increase your productivity.
Privacy Protection: Employs on-device transcription, choice to switch to private mode to store transcriptions locally, and no third-party data sharing.

TwinMind aims to boost your productivity by providing a centralized, AI-powered platform that captures, organizes, and leverages your captured memories to offer personalized assistance and automate tasks, all while safeguarding your privacy.
plugin_details.target_long:
TwinMind 捕捉您在会议、讲座和面对面对话中所说和听到的一切。它自动转录、总结、主动提供建议和任务，并持续为您的人工智能第二大脑构建上下文。
TwinMind 是一款利用人工智能作为您的第二大脑的生产力工具。它捕捉了听到、看到和说过的一切——随着您与 TwinMind 的互动和参与越多，它就会与您一起成长，从而构建您数字生活的全面背景。捕获的上下文可实现以下几个关键功能：
个性化和主动的帮助：TwinMind 根据您捕获的记忆、预测需求并提供相关见解提供量身定制的建议和想法。
简化生产力：它通过让人工智能助手自动执行任务（例如从会议和对话中生成摘要和行动项目）来增强您的笔记记录。您可以搜索他们的整个记忆库、提出问题、生成电子邮件和学习指南、投资者备忘录、项目计划等。
隐私关注：TwinMind 通过设备上转录以及在本地或云端保存转录的选项来优先考虑用户隐私。我们致力于零第三方数据共享。音频是即时处理的并且从不存储。
主要特性和功能：

捕获和上下文构建：如果与 TwinMind chrome 扩展程序配合使用，则可以在移动设备和桌面上捕获您的活动（音频、视觉、文本）。
个性化建议：您的人工智能助手将根据捕获的记忆提供量身定制的见解。
自动摘要和行动项目：从会议、对话和课堂讲座中提取关键信息。
可搜索记忆库：允许您搜索捕获的历史记录和笔记。
询问 TwinMind 任何事情：使您能够根据您的记忆或正在进行的会议提出问题并获得答案。
内容生成：帮助创建后续电子邮件、学习指南和其他文档，以帮助提高您的工作效率。
隐私保护：采用设备上转录，选择切换到隐私模式以在本地存储转录，并且不共享第三方数据。

TwinMind 旨在通过提供一个集中式、人工智能驱动的平台来提高您的工作效率，该平台捕获、组织和利用您捕获的记忆来提供个性化帮助和自动化任务，同时保护您的隐私。

source_long:

Edit it by hand like any normal presentation, or use the Twistly add-in for PowerPoint to keep refining and redesigning your slides. Nothing stays locked in a separate editor.

- Ask questions about a paper's full text, including its figures, tables, and equations, and check the answers against the source.

- Keep your work organized in workspaces with folders, starred papers, saved searches, and notes, all synced with your account at undermind.ai.

Scientists at thousands of research institutions use Undermind, from university labs to pharma R&D teams. Use it to check whether an idea is new, get oriented in an unfamiliar field, or track down the one method paper you need.

source_long:
Unpack AI — Minimize the Cost of Solving the Wrong Problem

For freelancers, entrepreneurs, and knowledge workers, solving the wrong problem is expensive: wasted hours, misdirected effort, client rework, abandoned projects. Unpack helps you map the problem before you commit to a solution.

Questions Are the Answers:
Unpack flips traditional brainstorming on its head - instead of jumping to solutions, you start with questions. Why? Because how you frame a problem changes everything. The right questions surface assumptions, blind spots, and angles you'd miss on your own. Better questions lead to better solutions.

When to Use: 
- when you feel stuck and can’t tell what the real problem or solution  is
- when a situation is complex and you don't know where to start
- when an issue feels vague but acting anyway feels risky

How It Works:
Kick off the Unpack flow with a message like this:
“Use Unpack to help me brainstorm this problem: [describe your situation]”

1. State your problem — however unpolished
2. Brainstorm questions — as many as possible, not solutions
3. See themes and patterns emerge — Unpack clusters your questions visually
4. Choose a focus — Unpack reframes it into a working hypothesis 

With a clear working hypothesis, you deliberately exit Unpack and choose what to do next:
explore solution options, or design small experiments to test the hypothesis. Unpack ends once the thinking is clear enough to act on.

The AI acts as facilitator: it asks, clarifies, facilitates, so that YOU think better.
plugin_details.target_long:
解开人工智能——最小化解决错误问题的成本

对于自由职业者、企业家和知识工作者来说，解决错误的问题代价高昂：浪费时间、误导工作、客户返工、放弃项目。 Unpack 可帮助您在提交解决方案之前找出问题所在。

问题即是答案：
Unpack 颠覆了传统的头脑风暴法——你不再直接寻求解决方案，而是从问题开始。为什么？因为你如何解决问题会改变一切。正确的问题可以揭示你自己可能会错过的假设、盲点和角度。更好的问题带来更好的解决方案。

何时使用： 
- 当您感到陷入困境并且无法说出真正的问题或解决方案是什么时
- 当情况复杂而你不知道从哪里开始时
- 当一个问题感觉模糊但无论如何采取行动都感觉有风险时

运作原理：
使用如下消息启动 Unpack 流程：
“使用 Unpack 帮助我集思广益这个问题：[描述你的情况]”

1. 陈述你的问题——无论多么粗糙
2.集思广益——尽可能多的问题，而不是解决方案
3. 查看主题和模式的出现——以可视化方式解开您的问题集群
4. 选择一个焦点——Unpack 将其重新构建为可行的假设 

有了明确的工作假设，您有意退出 Unpack 并选择下一步要做什么：
探索解决方案，或设计小实验来检验假设。一旦思路清晰到可以采取行动，解压就结束了。

人工智能充当促进者的角色：它提出问题、澄清问题、提供便利，以便您更好地思考。

source_long: Validis connects ChatGPT to transaction level accounting data extracted from a company's source ledgers. Search and select engagements, pull standardized general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and trial balance data through a single consistent schema, regardless of the underlying accounting system. Run built-in analytics including financial ratios, AR and AP aging, working capital, revenue quality, ledger integrity, and fraud indicators, or query the underlying data directly. Designed for lenders, auditors, and finance teams who need fast, reliable access to financial data inside their AI workflows.
plugin_details.target_long: Validis 将 ChatGPT 连接到从公司源分类账中提取的交易级会计数据。无论底层会计系统如何，都可以通过单一一致的模式搜索和选择业务，提取标准化总账、应收账款、应付账款和试算表数据。运行内置分析，包括财务比率、AR 和 AP 账龄、营运资金、收入质量、账本完整性和欺诈指标，或直接查询基础数据。专为需要快速、可靠地访问人工智能工作流程中的财务数据的贷方、审计师和财务团队而设计。

source_long:
Search for hotels equipped with Valpas patented bed bug prevention technology.  Every hotel in our results is Valpas-certified, so you can travel with confidence knowing your accommodation prioritises hygiene, cleanliness, and guest safety.

What you can do:
  - Search for Valpas-protected hotels by city, neighbourhood, price, and style
  - Browse detailed hotel information including photos, amenities, ratings, and guest reviews
  - Get direct booking links to reserve your room

Whether you're planning a leisure trip, a business stay, or managing travel for a group, simply describe what you're looking for - "Find a boutique hotel in Paris with great reviews" or "Show me safe, clean hotels in Berlin near the city center" - and Valpas will recommend verified properties that match.

All results are limited to hotels using Valpas anti-bed-bug technology. If no protected hotels match your exact criteria, the app will let you know and suggest adjusting your filters.
plugin_details.target_long:
搜索配备 Valpas 专利臭虫预防技术的酒店。  我们搜索结果中的每家酒店均经过瓦尔帕斯认证，因此您可以放心旅行，因为您知道您的住宿优先考虑卫生、清洁和客人安全。

你可以做什么：
  - 按城市、街区、价格和风格搜索受瓦尔帕斯保护的酒店
  - 浏览详细的酒店信息，包括照片、设施、评级和住客评论
  - 获取直接预订链接以预订房间

无论您是计划休闲旅行、商务住宿还是团体旅行，只需描述您的需求 - “在巴黎寻找一家好评如潮的精品酒店”或“向我展示柏林市中心附近安全、干净的酒店” - 瓦尔帕斯就会推荐经过验证的匹配酒店。

所有结果仅限于使用 Valpas 防臭虫技术的酒店。如果没有受保护的酒店符合您的具体标准，该应用程序会通知您并建议调整您的筛选条件。

source_long: Valuecase MCP connects ChatGPT to your Valuecase workspace, letting you create, manage, and monitor digital sales rooms and onboarding spaces directly from the conversation. Spin up personalised spaces from templates, set custom properties, and filter your Spaces – all without switching tools. ChatGPT gets full context on your spaces, so you can review engagement, check progress, and keep customer-facing workflows moving from one place.
plugin_details.target_long: Valuecase MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Valuecase 工作区，让您可以直接通过对话创建、管理和监控数字销售室和入职空间。从模板启动个性化空间、设置自定义属性并过滤您的空间 - 所有这些都无需切换工具。 ChatGPT 获取您空间的完整上下文，以便您可以查看参与度、检查进度并保持面向客户的工作流程从一个地方转移。

source_long:
ValveRide Flow provides live US diesel pricing and route-based fuel planning for commercial trucks.

Ask for the diesel market in any US state and get the median price per gallon, the 10th and 90th percentile spread, the number of stations covered, and when the snapshot was taken, drawn from retail prices at 8,034 US truck stops.

Ask for a fuel plan between two locations and get a stop-by-stop plan: which truck stops to use, how many gallons to buy at each, the price per gallon, the estimated cost, and the estimated fuel remaining on arrival. Plans are calculated from the route, tank capacity, fuel economy, current fuel level, and state fuel taxes, and can be updated mid-trip from the truck's current position.

Coverage is the 48 contiguous US states. Market snapshots carry no charge. Fuel plans draw on prepaid credits in a ValveRide Flow account, set up at valverideflow.com.
plugin_details.target_long:
ValveRide Flow 为商用卡车提供实时美国柴油定价和基于路线的燃油规划。

询问美国任何州的柴油市场，并获取每加仑的中位价格、第 10 个和第 90 个百分位价差、覆盖的加油站数量以及拍摄快照的时间（从 8,034 个美国卡车站的零售价格中得出）。

询问两个地点之间的燃油计划并获得逐站计划：要使用哪个卡车停靠站、每个卡车要购买多少加仑、每加仑的价格、预计成本以及抵达时预计剩余的燃油。计划是根据路线、油箱容量、燃油经济性、当前燃油水平和州燃油税计算得出的，并且可以在行程中从卡车的当前位置进行更新。

覆盖范围为美国 48 个相邻州。市场快照不收取任何费用。燃油计划利用 ValveRide Flow 帐户（在 ValveRideflow.com 上设置）中的预付积分。

source_long: Vantixs is a visual algorithmic trading platform for building, validating, and testing strategy pipelines. The ChatGPT app connects to the Vantixs MCP server so users can inspect node schemas, validate pipeline JSON, browse templates, review saved strategies, run backtests, and monitor portfolios from natural-language conversations. Trading-related actions are protected by OAuth and explicit confirmation flows.

source_long:
Vasara connects ChatGPT to Lithuania's primary legal sources: national legislation, EU regulations and directives, and case law from the Constitutional Court, Supreme Court, Supreme Administrative Court, the Court of Justice of the EU, and the European Court of Human Rights.

Use it to look up a specific court decision by case number, search case law and legislation by topic, pull relevant passages from long legal documents, or find guidance from state authorities and municipalities — with sources ChatGPT can cite directly in its answers.

Plugin searches and retrieves legal sources, doesn't create, edit, or submit anything. Requires a Vasara account.
plugin_details.target_long:
Vasara 将 ChatGPT 与立陶宛的主要法律来源连接起来：国家立法、欧盟法规和指令以及宪法法院、最高法院、最高行政法院、欧盟法院和欧洲人权法院的判例法。

使用它可以按案件编号查找特定的法院判决，按主题搜索判例法和立法，从冗长的法律文件中提取相关段落，或查找州当局和市政府的指导 - ChatGPT 可以在其答案中直接引用来源。

插件搜索和检索合法来源，不会创建、编辑或提交任何内容。需要瓦萨拉帐户。

source_long: Vegas helps you plan a Las Vegas trip in chat. Check weather and a 7-day forecast, find live concerts and shows, browse curated hotels and attractions, and build a day-by-day itinerary in an interactive planner. source_long: Vegas Guide is an independent Las Vegas travel guide, not a booking site. Ask it anything about a Vegas trip: it answers with fact-checked advice from its own editorial guides (planning, budgets, itineraries, honest comparisons like which Cirque show or hotel to pick), current Las Vegas news (openings, closings, residencies), and a curated catalog of 174 shows and concerts, 121 hotels, 130 attractions, 69 tours, plus restaurants, bars, nightclubs and pools - every entry reviewed editorially with honest prices, insider tips and downsides included. It can also tell you what's near any point in the city.
plugin_details.target_long: Vegas Guide是一家独立的拉斯维加斯旅游指南，而不是预订网站。向其询问有关拉斯维加斯之旅的任何问题：它会根据自己的编辑指南提供经过事实核查的建议（计划、预算、行程、诚实的比较，例如选择哪一家马戏团演出或酒店）、当前的拉斯维加斯新闻（开幕、闭幕、驻场）以及包含 174 场演出和音乐会、121 家酒店、130 个景点、69 个旅游项目的精选目录，以及餐厅、酒吧、夜总会和游泳池 - 每个条目都会经过审核社论包含诚实的价格、内幕消息和缺点。它还可以告诉您城市中任意地点附近的情况。

source_long:
Velaris Basic lets you access your customer data directly from ChatGPT, using plain language — no dashboards, no switching tabs.

What you can do:

Look up accounts and organizations — check health scores, churn status, ARR, lifecycle stage, and assigned CSM for any customer.
Search contacts — find individuals by name, account, or role and review their details.
Track risks and opportunities — surface at-risk accounts or open expansion opportunities across your book of business.
Manage notes and tasks — read existing notes, create new ones, and update tasks tied to customer records.
Who it's for:
Customer Success Managers and CS leaders who want a faster way to access and update their Velaris data without leaving their workflow.

Requires a Velaris account. Read and write access is governed by your Velaris role permissions.
plugin_details.target_long:
Velaris Basic 可让您使用简单的语言直接从 ChatGPT 访问客户数据 — 无需仪表板，无需切换选项卡。

需要 Velaris 帐户。读取和写入访问权限由您的 Velaris 角色权限控制。

source_long:

Search listings by location, price, revenue, industry, and 20+ other filters. Find brokers by city, specialty, or language. Pull up full details on any listing or broker profile, and send inquiries to sellers or brokers — all without leaving ChatGPT.

What you can do:

- Search businesses for sale by location, price range, revenue, industry, SBA eligibility, and more
- Find and compare verified business brokers
- Get detailed listing info including financials, employee count, and deal structure
- Contact sellers and brokers directly from the chat

Free to search and browse. Messaging sellers and brokers requires a free Venturu account.
plugin_details.target_long:
从对话中找到您的下一个业务。 Venturu 将您连接到美国最大的待售企业在线市场之一，其中有数千个经过验证的列表和一千多名经纪人。

按位置、价格、收入、行业和 20 多个其他过滤器搜索列表。按城市、专业或语言查找经纪人。获取任何列表或经纪人资料的完整详细信息，并向卖家或经纪人发送查询 - 所有这些都无需离开 ChatGPT。

免费搜索和浏览。向卖家和经纪人发送消息需要一个免费的 Venturu 帐户。

source_long: Verne helps users save travel itineraries from a ChatGPT conversation, look up place candidates with coordinates, revise saved trips with structured changes, and remove itinerary items they no longer want before continuing in the Verne map and timeline workspace.
plugin_details.target_long: Verne 帮助用户从 ChatGPT 对话中保存旅行行程，查找具有坐标的候选地点，通过结构化更改修改保存的行程，并在继续 Verne 地图和时间线工作区之前删除不再需要的行程项目。

source_long: VerticalResponse lets you manage email marketing workflows directly in ChatGPT. Search and review contacts, list contact lists, create or update contacts, add contacts to lists, view email campaigns, check campaign performance, and create draft email campaigns.
plugin_details.target_long: VerticalResponse 可让您直接在 ChatGPT 中管理电子邮件营销工作流程。搜索和查看联系人、列出联系人列表、创建或更新联系人、将联系人添加到列表、查看电子邮件营销活动、检查营销活动绩效以及创建草稿电子邮件营销活动。

source_long: Connect VesselTwin to ask ChatGPT about the boat records you already keep. New to VesselTwin? Visit vesseltwin.io to create a free account, then select Connect and sign in. Basic access shows approved boat, maintenance, equipment, and document metadata. Owner Pro customers can separately opt in to let ChatGPT read private records, including extracted document text, for boats they own. An optional second permission lets ChatGPT send proposed notes, checklists, maintenance entries, and measurements to the VesselTwin Inbox for owner review. Nothing becomes a saved record until the owner accepts it, and customers can turn either permission off at any time. Photo files and private records from collaborator-only boats are never included.
plugin_details.target_long: 连接 VesselTwin 向 ChatGPT 询问您已保存的船舶记录。 VesselTwin 新手？访问 Vesseltwin.io 创建免费帐户，然后选择“连接”并登录。基本访问权限显示批准的船只、维护、设备和文档元数据。 Owner Pro 客户可以单独选择让 ChatGPT 读取他们拥有的船只的私人记录，包括提取的文档文本。可选的第二个权限允许 ChatGPT 将建议的注释、清单、维护条目和测量结果发送到 VesselTwin 收件箱以供所有者审核。在所有者接受之前，任何内容都不会成为保存的记录，并且客户可以随时关闭任一权限。仅限合作者的船只上的照片文件和私人记录永远不包括在内。

source_long:
An information and calculation tool for visa applications by citizens of Türkiye (ordinary/burgundy passport).

It answers questions like "Do I need a visa for Japan?", "How much does a German visa cost?" and "How many Schengen days do I have left?" — always with its source.

What it covers:

· Visa status for 172 countries — 55 visa-free, 23 visa on arrival, 30 e-visa, 64 requiring a consulate application
· Per country: the fee, the published processing time, the application centre and the required documents
· Refusal rates for Schengen applications made from Türkiye, based on European Commission statistics (27 countries)
· Appealing a refusal: the competent authority, deadline, language and fee for seven Schengen countries, and the meaning of all 17 refusal grounds on the standard form
· Calculators: the Schengen 90/180 day allowance, multiple-entry (cascade) eligibility, and the total cost in Turkish lira at the central bank rate

How the data is collected:

Every amount and duration is verified against an official consulate, ministry or legislative source, quoted verbatim. A value that cannot be verified is not published — nothing is estimated; the field is left empty and said to be empty. Answers carry their source and last-updated date.

Only the consulate of the country concerned can grant a visa. We are not an agency: we do not file applications, book appointments, or guarantee approval.
plugin_details.target_long:
土耳其公民（普通/勃艮第护照）签证申请的信息和计算工具。

它回答诸如“我需要日本签证吗？”、“德国签证费用是多少？”等问题。和“我还剩多少申根天？” ——始终有其来源。

它涵盖的内容：

· 172 个国家的签证状态 — 55 个免签国家、23 个落地签证国家、30 个电子签证国家、64 个需要领事馆申请的国家
· 每个国家：费用、公布的处理时间、申请中心和所需文件
· 根据欧盟委员会统计数据（27 个国家），土耳其申根申请的拒绝率
· 拒绝上诉：七个申根国家的主管机关、截止日期、语言和费用，以及标准表格上所有 17 个拒绝理由的含义
· 计算器：申根 90/180 天津贴、多次入境（级联）资格以及按央行汇率计算的土耳其里拉总费用

数据收集方式：

每笔金额和持续时间均根据官方领事馆、部委或立法来源进行核实，并逐字引用。无法验证的值不会被发布——没有任何估计；该字段留空并称为空。答案带有来源和最后更新日期。

只有有关国家的领事馆才能签发签证。我们不是代理机构：我们不提交申请、预约或保证批准。

Vynix MCP 专为产品、工程和 QA 团队而构建，通过将讨论和实施连接到一处来减少来回次数。

source_long:
WordPress sites managed entirely from ChatGPT — connect your site once and ChatGPT can write, edit, publish, schedule, and maintain it end to end. WP Agent is keyless: you don't bring an AI API key. ChatGPT authors the content, image prompts, and SEO; WP Agent executes them on your WordPress site through purpose-built tools.

Create, edit, schedule, and publish posts and pages, update existing content, and manage revisions.

Handle the full media library: upload images, generate AI hero images or pull free stock photos, and set featured images sized for WordPress.

Run complete SEO workflows — titles, meta descriptions, focus keywords, and per-post SEO analysis.

Manage categories, tags, menus, comments, authors, site settings, custom CSS, and plugins — all from ChatGPT. Safe by design: destructive actions are confirm-gated, publishing is explicit, and every tool call is audited.

Works with any self-hosted WordPress site: connect with a one-time approval link in wp-admin, using a standard, revocable application password.

The optional WP Agent Connector plugin adds SEO meta support (Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO) and compatibility with restrictive hosts.
plugin_details.target_long:
WordPress 网站完全由 ChatGPT 管理 - 一旦连接您的网站，ChatGPT 就可以端到端地编写、编辑、发布、安排和维护它。 WP Agent 是无密钥的：您无需携带 AI API 密钥。 ChatGPT 创作内容、图像提示和 SEO； WP Agent 通过专用工具在您的 WordPress 网站上执行它们。

创建、编辑、安排和发布帖子和页面，更新现有内容以及管理修订。

处理完整的媒体库：上传图像、生成 AI 英雄图像或提取免费库存照片，以及设置适合 WordPress 的特色图像大小。

运行完整的 SEO 工作流程 - 标题、元描述、焦点关键词和每篇文章的 SEO 分析。

管理类别、标签、菜单、评论、作者、站点设置、自定义 CSS 和插件 — 全部来自 ChatGPT。设计安全：破坏性行为经过确认，发布是明确的，并且每个工具调用都经过审核。

适用于任何自托管 WordPress 网站：使用标准、可撤销的应用程序密码连接 wp-admin 中的一次性批准链接。

可选的 WP Agent Connector 插件添加了 SEO 元支持（Yoast、Rank Math、AIOSEO）以及与限制性主机的兼容性。

source_long: WPVibe connects ChatGPT to self-hosted WordPress sites so users can manage content, inspect plugins and themes, upload media, run safe WordPress admin commands, use plugin abilities, and build draft themes through conversation. It includes tested WordPress skills and playbooks for Gutenberg, Elementor, SeedProd, classic themes, editable fields, design, and SEO audits, plus one-click authorization, permission-checked tools, and draft-preview-publish workflows so changes are visible and reviewable before risky actions.
plugin_details.target_long: WPVibe 将 ChatGPT 连接到自托管 WordPress 站点，以便用户可以管理内容、检查插件和主题、上传媒体、运行安全的 WordPress 管理命令、使用插件功能以及通过对话构建草稿主题。它包括经过测试的 WordPress 技能和针对 Gutenberg、Elementor、SeedProd、经典主题、可编辑字段、设计和 SEO 审核的手册，以及一键授权、权限检查工具和草稿-预览-发布工作流程，因此在采取危险操作之前更改是可见和可审查的。

source_long:
WPWriter connects ChatGPT to WordPress so users can manage their sites directly from a chat window.

Instead of jumping between WordPress admin screens, SEO plugins, media tools, and separate AI apps, users can ask ChatGPT to create, edit, schedule, publish, and optimize content in natural language.

With WPWriter, users can manage posts, pages, categories, tags, menus, SEO metadata, featured images, media, plugins, themes, and publishing status. They can also set up autoblogging workflows with topic queues and publishing schedules, so new posts can be generated and published automatically.

WPWriter is built for bloggers, creators, agencies, marketers, and WordPress site owners who want a faster way to run their WordPress sites while staying in control of every change.
plugin_details.target_long:
WPWriter 将 ChatGPT 连接到 WordPress，以便用户可以直接从聊天窗口管理他们的网站。

用户可以要求 ChatGPT 以自然语言创建、编辑、安排、发布和优化内容，而不是在 WordPress 管理屏幕、SEO 插件、媒体工具和单独的 AI 应用程序之间跳转。

使用 WPWriter，用户可以管理帖子、页面、类别、标签、菜单、SEO 元数据、特色图像、媒体、插件、主题和发布状态。他们还可以使用主题队列和发布计划设置自动博客工作流程，以便自动生成和发布新帖子。

WPWriter 专为博主、创作者、代理商、营销人员和 WordPress 网站所有者而构建，他们希望以更快的方式运行 WordPress 网站，同时保持对每项更改的控制。

source_long: Waldo helps users research brands, advertising, social conversations, trends, and captured workspace intelligence by combining specialized skills with external data and authenticated workspace context.
plugin_details.target_long: Waldo 通过将专业技能与外部数据和经过身份验证的工作空间环境相结合，帮助用户研究品牌、广告、社交对话、趋势并捕获工作空间情报。

source_long:
Describe the home you want — "a 10 by 10 house with a master bedroom and a private bathroom, two kids' rooms, an open kitchen and living room, a garden with trees" — and WalkMyPlan builds it in one go: real walls, doors, windows, furniture and garden. Open the live link and walk through it in 3D.

Keep designing in conversation. "Make the living room bigger." "Put a TV on the north wall." "I marked pin A — put the front door exactly there." Furniture placement is automatic — it finds a free spot, away from doorways. Every edit lands in a revision history you can undo or roll back to any point. Edits are for visualization and planning; WalkMyPlan does not check structural safety or building codes.

Ask about what you built. "How big is the kitchen?", "Is there room for a double bed in the small bedroom?" Answers are measured from the model's real geometry.

Share and collaborate. Share a plan privately with named people as viewers or editors, or with a link. See who changed what, when.

Already have a plan? Upload the real CAD file your architect sent — DWG or vector PDF, up to 100MB — and WalkMyPlan converts it into the same editable, walkable 3D model, so you start from reality instead of a blank page.

Great for home design, interior design, room planning, renovation, and planning a build. Your plans stay private to your account unless you share them, are never used to train AI models, and can be deleted any time (trash keeps them recoverable for 30 days).

Try: "Build me a three-bedroom house with a garden" — then "walk me through it."
plugin_details.target_long:
描述你想要的家——“一座 10 x 10 的房子，有一间主卧室和一间私人浴室、两间儿童房、一个开放式厨房和客厅、一个种有树木的花园”——WalkMyPlan 会一次性建造它：真实的墙壁、门、窗户、家具和花园。打开实时链接并以 3D 方式浏览它。

继续在对话中进行设计。 “把客厅弄大一点。” “在北墙上放一台电视。” “我标记了 A 针——将前门准确地放在那里。”家具的放置是自动的——它会找到一个远离门口的空闲位置。每次编辑都会进入修订历史记录，您可以撤消或回滚到任何点。编辑用于可视化和规划； WalkMyPlan 不检查结构安全或建筑规范。

询问你建造了什么。 “厨房有多大？”、“小卧室可以放一张双人床吗？”答案是根据模型的真实几何形状测量的。

分享和协作。与指定的查看者或编辑者或通过链接私下共享计划。查看谁在何时更改了哪些内容。

已经有计划了吗？上传建筑师发送的真实 CAD 文件（DWG 或矢量 PDF，最大 100MB），WalkMyPlan 会将其转换为相同的可编辑、可步行的 3D 模型，因此您可以从现实开始，而不是从空白页面开始。

非常适合家居设计、室内设计、房间规划、翻新和规划建造。除非您共享，否则您的计划对您的帐户保密，永远不会用于训练 AI 模型，并且可以随时删除（垃圾保留它们可在 30 天内恢复）。

尝试：“给我建一栋带花园的三居室房子”，然后“带我参观一下它”。

source_long: Build and manage Walla forms from ChatGPT: create a form, add and edit questions (including conditional jump logic, appearance, and page sections), publish it for respondents, and read submitted responses with PII automatically masked. Users can also connect webhook automations that deliver responses to their own endpoint, and Enterprise teams can build reusable custom field types from a natural-language description. Six built-in reference documents describe the form model and editing payloads so the assistant can author correct edits on the first try.
plugin_details.target_long: 从 ChatGPT 构建和管理 Walla 表单：创建表单、添加和编辑问题（包括条件跳转逻辑、外观和页面部分）、将其发布给受访者，并在自动屏蔽 PII 的情况下读取提交的回复。用户还可以连接 Webhook 自动化，将响应传递到自己的端点，企业团队可以根据自然语言描述构建可重用的自定义字段类型。六个内置参考文档描述了表单模型和编辑负载，以便助手可以在第一次尝试时进行正确的编辑。

source_long: WalleK is your AI-powered personal finance manager — manage your entire financial life right from chat. Record expenses and income in natural language; track recurring payments and subscriptions with auto-pay; manage loans and installment plans with a full payment schedule; import and reconcile card and bank statements with smart merchant matching; set budgets and get alerts; record your salary; and see your net worth across all accounts at a glance. Keep records in any currency — fiat or crypto — with live market and exchange rates, and gauge the real purchasing power of any amount using built-in inflation data (TR/US/EU/UK). Ask "How much did I spend on dining last month?", "Show my upcoming bills", or "Import this statement" — WalleK keeps everything organized in 4 languages. Your financial data stays on your device and is encrypted server-side; you approve every change WalleK proposes before it's saved.
plugin_details.target_long: WalleK 是您的人工智能个人财务经理 - 直接通过聊天管理您的整个财务生活。用自然语言记录支出和收入；通过自动付款跟踪定期付款和订阅；管理贷款和分期付款计划以及完整的付款计划；通过智能商户匹配导入和核对卡和银行对账单；设置预算并获取提醒；记录你的工资；一目了然地查看您所有账户的净资产。以任何货币（法定货币或加密货币）保存实时市场和汇率记录，并使用内置通胀数据（TR/US/EU/UK）衡量任何金额的实际购买力。问“我上个月在餐饮上花了多少钱？”、“显示我即将到来的账单”或“导入此报表”——WalleK 以 4 种语言整理所有内容。您的财务数据保留在您的设备上并在服务器端加密；您在保存之前批准 WalleK 提出的每项更改。

plugin_details.target_long: 在领队的带领下，与同龄人一起探索 WeRoad 的小团体（8-15 名旅行者）冒险之旅。专为想要与志同道合的人一起探索世界的独行旅行者而设计。按目的地、日期和旅行心情搜索行程，查看完整的每日计划，并找到横跨欧洲、亚洲、非洲、美洲、大洋洲和中东的合适团体旅行。

source_long:
Send files straight from your conversation with WeTransfer.

Connect your WeTransfer account and share any file from your chat — documents, images, exports, generated assets — without leaving the conversation. Just ask, and the connector uploads the files to WeTransfer and returns a clean, shareable download link. Prefer to send it directly? Add recipients and WeTransfer will email the transfer for you, sent from your own account.

What you can do
- Share one or many files at once and get a ready-to-share download link
- Email a transfer to one or more recipients, with an optional title and message
- Send large files without bloating the conversation

How it works
Every transfer is created in your own WeTransfer account, so it appears in your transfer history and follows your plan's limits and expiry. You sign in securely with your WeTransfer account — the assistant only ever gets permission to send files on your behalf, and never sees your WeTransfer password. You can disconnect at any time to revoke access.
plugin_details.target_long:
直接通过 WeTransfer 对话发送文件。

连接您的 WeTransfer 帐户并共享聊天中的任何文件 - 文档、图像、导出、生成的资产 - 无需离开对话。只需询问，连接器就会将文件上传到 WeTransfer 并返回干净、可共享的下载链接。想要直接发送吗？添加收件人，WeTransfer 将从您自己的帐户通过电子邮件为您发送转账。

你能做什么
- 一次共享一个或多个文件并获取可立即共享的下载链接
- 通过电子邮件将转账发送给一个或多个收件人，并带有可选的标题和消息
- 发送大文件而不会使对话变得臃肿

它是如何运作的
每次转账都是在您自己的 WeTransfer 帐户中创建的，因此它会显示在您的转账历史记录中，并遵循您的计划的限制和到期时间。您使用 WeTransfer 帐户安全登录 - 助手仅获得代表您发送文件的权限，而永远不会看到您的 WeTransfer 密码。您可以随时断开连接以撤销访问权限。

source_long: Get a complete snapshot of your financial health in seconds. WealthCheck analyzes your income, expenses, savings, and debt to calculate your net worth, savings rate, and monthly spending — then gives you a personalized action plan to improve. Whether you're budgeting for the first time or optimizing an existing plan, see exactly where your money goes and what to do next.
plugin_details.target_long: 在几秒钟内获得您财务健康状况的完整快照。 WealthCheck 分析您的收入、支出、储蓄和债务，以计算您的净资产、储蓄率和每月支出，然后为您提供个性化的改进行动计划。无论您是第一次制定预算还是优化现有计划，都可以准确了解您的资金去向以及下一步该做什么。

source_long:
Protect your trip with WeatherPromise and get back the full cost if it rains more than promised during your vacation, automatically.
Tell us your destination, travel dates and trip cost and we'll show you an offer, personalized to your trip. Once you purchase the offer, your trip is protected.
You will get a link to your personal dashboard where you can monitor the weather during your trip. Rain is measured using independent, accurate data from official sources like NASA and NOAA.
If it rains more than the specified threshold, we'll email you automatically. Just confirm your details and the payment is sent right away, no additional proof required.
Go on your trip and if it rains more than promised, you get a full refund, automatically.
plugin_details.target_long:
使用 Wea​​therPromise 保护您的旅行，如果假期期间降雨量超过承诺的量，则自动收回全额费用。
告诉我们您的目的地、旅行日期和旅行费用，我们将向您展示针对您的旅行个性化的优惠。一旦您购买了该优惠，您的旅行将受到保护。
您将获得指向个人仪表板的链接，您可以在其中监控旅行期间的天气。降雨量是使用来自 NASA 和 NOAA 等官方来源的独立、准确的数据来测量的。
如果降雨量超过指定阈值，我们会自动向您发送电子邮件。只需确认您的详细信息，付款就会立即发送，无需额外证明。
继续您的旅行，如果降雨量超过承诺的范围，您将自动获得全额退款。

source_long:
Weave Fabric is a personal memory layer for AI. Connect it to ChatGPT and your assistant finally knows the specifics of your life: your people, preferences, routines, purchases, calendar, and history.
You build your memory in the Fabric iOS app. Capture quick notes, fill out short questionnaires about parts of your life (food, work, health, travel, and more), or connect accounts like Gmail, Google Calendar, Apple Health, YouTube, Eventbrite, Receipts, Instagram, LinkedIn, Slack, Discord, and HubSpot to generate memories automatically from data you already have. Once connected, ChatGPT can read, create, and update memories on your behalf.
plugin_details.target_long:
Weave Fabric 是人工智能的个人记忆层。将其连接到 ChatGPT，您的助手最终会了解您生活的细节：您的人、偏好、日常事务、购买、日历和历史记录。
您可以在 Fabric iOS 应用程序中建立您的记忆。捕捉快速笔记，填写有关您生活的各个部分（食物、工作、健康、旅行等）的简短调查问卷，或者连接 Gmail、Google Calendar、Apple Health、YouTube、Eventbrite、Receipts、Instagram、LinkedIn、Slack、Discord 和 HubSpot 等帐户，以根据您已有的数据自动生成记忆。连接后，ChatGPT 可以代表您读取、创建和更新记忆。

source_long:
Create surveys, registration forms, lead capture forms, NPS and CSAT surveys, and more for free. No templates, no drag-and-drop.

Supports file uploads, signatures, dropdowns, multi-step flows, conditional logic, rating scales, and all the field types you'd expect from a full form builder.

支持文件上传、签名、下拉菜单、多步骤流程、条件逻辑、评级量表以及您期望从完整表单生成器获得的所有字段类型。

source_long: Weavify connects you to Bangkok's dining and nightlife. Search restaurants, bars, and nightclubs by area, cuisine, vibe, or price; pull up a venue's full profile, menu, and live availability; then hold and confirm a reservation and get a confirmation code — all without leaving the chat. You can also look up or cancel an existing booking by its confirmation code at any time. Reservations are free; the app does not sell digital goods or process payments in-chat.
plugin_details.target_long: Weavify 将您带入曼谷的餐饮和夜生活。按地区、美食、氛围或价格搜索餐厅、酒吧和夜总会；调出场地的完整资料、菜单和实时可用性；然后按住并确认预订并获取确认码——所有这些都无需离开聊天室。您还可以随时通过确认码查找或取消现有预订。免费预订；该应用程序不销售数字商品或在聊天中处理付款。

source_long: Build, edit, and publish complete websites directly from ChatGPT using Web on Demand. Create responsive, production-ready websites with modern layouts, custom content, and interactive features—then deploy them instantly without complicated setup, plugins, or traditional back-end development.

source_long:

source_long: Webless connects ChatGPT and Codex to your authenticated Webless analytics workspace. plugin_details.target_long: Webless 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到经过身份验证的 Webless 分析工作区。询问网站搜索需求、内容参与度、访问者旅程、获取来源和意图差距。该插件读取当前的分析目录，运行租户范围的语义查询，并可以在网络隔离的沙箱中计算比较或可视化。它不接受原始 SQL 或允许用户选择其他租户的数据。

source_long: Website Launches lets ChatGPT look up a website’s public launch record, including when the site was first detected, whether the owner has verified the listing, and available launch milestones. It provides public launch and presence context for reviewing new or unfamiliar websites, but it does not determine whether a site is safe or unsafe.
plugin_details.target_long: 网站启动可让 ChatGPT 查找网站的公开启动记录，包括首次检测到该网站的时间、所有者是否已验证列表以及可用的启动里程碑。它提供公开启动和存在上下文以供审查新的或不熟悉的网站，但它不能确定网站是否安全。

source_long:
Find Creators and Influencers with Wednesday.app inside ChatGPT

Wednesday.app inside ChatGPT makes creator discovery faster, more intuitive, and easier to act on.

通过 ChatGPT 中的 Wednesday.app 寻找创作者和影响者

source_long:
Weft is a Scrumban task manager: a kanban board for flow, sprints for focus, no standups or ceremonies. It's built for solo founders, indie makers, and small startup teams who ship without a project manager.

 Once your Weft account is connected, you can manage your board in a conversation:
• Ask "what's on my board?" to get a summary of your columns and active sprint
• Search tasks by keyword across the whole board
• Add new tasks to the backlog and update their details
• Move work across Backlog, Todo, Doing, and Done
• Plan a sprint, start it, and mark it complete — without leaving the chat

Your board stays in sync with Weft on web, desktop, and mobile.
plugin_details.target_long:
Weft 是一个 Scrumban 任务管理器：一个用于流程的看板，用于焦点的冲刺，没有站立或仪式。它是为独立创始人、独立制作人和没有项目经理的小型初创团队而构建的。

 连接您的 Weft 帐户后，您可以在对话中管理您的董事会：

• 计划冲刺、开始冲刺并将其标记为完成 — 无需离开聊天室

您的主板在网络、桌面和移动设备上与 Weft 保持同步。

source_long:
Wego helps you find the best prices for flights and hotels inside ChatGPT. We search across 700+ travel websites to surface accurate, highly competitive rates—then show them in a beautiful, clean, easy-to-understand interface.

Compare and refine results with the filters you expect. For flights, filter by airline, departure time, and other essentials to quickly find the right itinerary. For hotels, narrow options by property type, star rating, location, price range, and amenities so you can find the right stay faster.

Trusted by 83M+ travelers worldwide, Wego is top-rated with a 4.7 rating on the iOS App Store and 4.5 on Google Play. Need help? Our 24/7 support connects you with a real person.

Wego 帮助您找到ChatGPT 内的最优惠航班和酒店价格。我们搜索 700 多个旅游网站，以提供准确、极具竞争力的价格，然后以美观、干净、易于理解的界面显示它们。

将结果与您期望的过滤器进行比较和优化。对于航班，请按航空公司、出发时间和其他要素进行筛选，以快速找到合适的行程。对于酒店，可按酒店类型、星级、位置、价格范围和设施缩小选择范围，以便您更快地找到合适的住宿。

Wego 受到全球超过 8300 万旅客的信赖，在 iOS App Store 上获得 4.7 的评分，在 Google Play 上获得 4.5 的评分，名列前茅。需要帮助吗？我们的 24/7 支持将您与真人联系起来。

source_long: The WeightWatchers app helps people taking GLP-1 medications find meal ideas that work for their lifestyle. source_long:
Whisper Money is a privacy-first personal finance app: your financial data is yours, and it is never shared with third parties. This app connects ChatGPT to your own Whisper Money account so you can analyse your money in plain language instead of clicking through dashboards.

Ask questions like "how much did I spend on groceries last month", "what's my net worth trend this year", "which subscriptions are draining me" or "break down Q2 by category" — the app reads your transactions, accounts, categories, labels, cashflow and net worth and answers with your real numbers. You can also keep your books tidy from the conversation: log manual transactions, recategorize and label existing ones, record balances for manual accounts, and manage categories, labels and automation rules.

Your synced bank data is protected: transactions imported from a bank connection can be categorized and labelled, but never edited or deleted, and balances can only be recorded on manual accounts. You can still add your own manual transactions to a bank-connected account — a sync never removes them. Data is scoped to the account you sign in with, including any shared spaces you belong to. The app reads and writes bookkeeping records only — it can never move money, make payments or reach any account outside Whisper Money.

Requires a Whisper Money account on a paid (Pro) plan. Sign in happens through Whisper Money's own OAuth flow — ChatGPT never sees your password, and access can be revoked at any time from your account settings.
plugin_details.target_long:
Whisper Money 是一款隐私至上的个人理财应用程序：您的财务数据是您自己的，并且永远不会与第三方共享。该应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到您自己的 Whisper Money 帐户，这样您就可以用简单的语言分析您的资金，而无需点击仪表板。

提出诸如“上个月我在杂货上花了多少钱”、“今年我的净资产趋势是什么”、“哪些订阅让我精疲力尽”或“按类别细分第二季度”等问题 - 该应用程序会读取您的交易、账户、类别、标签、现金流和净资产，并用您的真实数字进行回答。您还可以通过对话保持账簿整洁：记录手动交易、重新分类和标记现有交易、记录手动账户余额以及管理类别、标签和自动化规则。

您同步的银行数据受到保护：从银行连接导入的交易可以进行分类和标记，但永远不会编辑或删除，并且余额只能记录在手动帐户上。您仍然可以将自己的手动交易添加到与银行关联的帐户中 - 同步永远不会删除它们。数据的范围仅限于您登录所用的帐户，包括您所属的任何共享空间。该应用程序仅读取和写入记账记录，它永远无法转移资金、付款或访问 Whisper Money 之外的任何账户。

需要付费（专业）计划的 Whisper Money 帐户。登录通过 Whisper Money 自己的 OAuth 流程进行 - ChatGPT 永远不会看到您的密码，并且可以随时从您的帐户设置撤销访问权限。

source_long: WhisperTranscribe is an AI transcription app that converts audio, video, meetings, lectures, interviews, podcasts, voice memos, webinars, and YouTube links into accurate transcripts, subtitles, captions, and summaries inside ChatGPT. It supports speech to text, audio to text, video to text, meeting transcription, podcast transcription, lecture transcription, interview transcription, subtitle generation, progress tracking, recent job history, completed transcript review, and share links. It helps students, creators, journalists, researchers, podcasters, educators, and business teams turn spoken content into searchable text, meeting notes, subtitles, and reusable content.
plugin_details.target_long: WhisperTranscribe 是一款 AI 转录应用程序，可将音频、视频、会议、讲座、访谈、播客、语音备忘录、网络研讨会和 YouTube 链接转换为 ChatGPT 内的准确文字记录、字幕、说明文字和摘要。它支持语音转文本、音频转文本、视频转文本、会议转录、播客转录、讲座转录、采访转录、字幕生成、进度跟踪、最近的工作历史记录、已完成的记录审核和共享链接。它可以帮助学生、创作者、记者、研究人员、播客、教育工作者和业务团队将语音内容转换为可搜索文本、会议记录、字幕和可重复使用的内容。

source_long:
Whiteboard by Athena AI (Athenaboard) is a AI-native Collaborative Whiteboard that can generate and share AI contents in realtime with your team.  

How to Get Started
- Simply describe what you want (e.g., "wireframes for a mobile app", "create a flowchart for user login", "show me the quadratic formula", "generate an image of a sunset")
- The app will automatically use the appropriate tool to render your request
- Use "add to whiteboard" to save any visualization for later

Core Features
1. Diagram Visualization
   - Render complex diagrams directly in ChatGPT including: flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, pie charts, mindmaps, timelines, and more
   - Powered by Mermaid.js for beautiful, interactive diagrams
   - Diagrams can be copied or added to your whiteboard

2. Wireframe Recommendation
   - Brainstorm UI/UX designs with your team in realtime
   - Over 10,000 editable templates for the AI to pick from
   - Get design components like buttons, cards, navigation elements, forms, etc.
   - Supports mobile, web, desktop, and tablet platforms

3. Collaborative Whiteboard
   - Add any visualization (diagrams, wireframes, images, LaTeX formulas) to a realtime collaborative whiteboard
   - Collaborate with your team in real-time
   - Persistent storage - your whiteboards are saved and accessible anytime
   - Each user has an active board that persists across conversations

4. LaTeX Visualization
   - Render complex scientific formulas and math equations in ChatGPT
   - Supports inline equations, full documents, and chemistry notation
   - Beautiful typesetting using KaTeX and full LaTeX compilation

5. Generate Image and Print on Product
   - Generate AI images from text descriptions with various styles (realistic, artistic, cartoon, sketch, abstract)
   - Create and buy custom products: T-shirts, mugs, hoodies, and pillows
   - Products are created via Printify and can be purchased directly

source_long:
Who What Wear brings the women's fashion publication's editorial voice into ChatGPT. It works like having a stylist who already knows your taste — once you've set up a short style profile, every fashion question gets a personalised, brand-aware answer instead of a generic one.

Setup takes about a minute. A guided four-step widget asks for your style words (Low-Key Luxury, Tailored, French, Sporty, Trend-Forward and others), the brands you actually shop across contemporary, luxury, denim and accessories, the style icons whose looks you'd happily borrow, and the price range you're comfortable with. The profile is saved per user, so it carries across conversations rather than starting over every time you open ChatGPT.

After onboarding, three things become useful.

Shopping for a specific item. Tell the app what you're looking for — "find me a black blazer under £250", "I need a coat for a winter wedding", "what jeans should I buy" — and it returns three to five picks weighted toward the brands you already buy from, plus a complete outfit built around the piece: what to wear on top, on the bottom, on your feet, and one or two accessories. The aim is to leave with a wearable answer, not a list of links.

Editorial inspiration. Ask what you should be wearing or looking at right now, and the app pulls fresh articles from Who What Wear UK's live editorial feed, then picks the two or three that match your taste using the brand and category tags on each article. The picks render as a horizontal carousel of cards in the publication's own visual language: editorial image, kicker, headline, byline credit, and a link straight back to the article on whowhatwear.com.

Refining your profile. Taste shifts. Reopen the onboarding to update any answer (and only the answers you want to change), or reset the profile entirely if you're starting fresh.

A few things worth knowing. The editorial feed is Who What Wear UK, so the content leans British in voice, currency and seasonality. Recommendations are always anchored in real Who What Wear articles or in brand suggestions drawn from the list you provided — the app does not invent URLs, images, or articles to fill out a result, and the carousel only renders when there are real links and images to attach. If the feed has nothing relevant on a given day, you get an honest reply rather than a fabricated one.

What the app is not: it does not cover men's fashion, beauty product search, home decor, or non-fashion shopping. It does not surface live retailer inventory or live prices. If a request falls outside this scope, it says so instead of guessing.

Built by Future PLC, publisher of Who What Wear.
plugin_details.target_long:
Who What Wear 将女性时尚出版物的社论声音引入 ChatGPT。它就像拥有一位已经了解您品味的造型师一样——一旦您建立了简短的风格简介，每个时尚问题都会得到个性化的、品牌意识的答案，而不是通用的答案。

设置大约需要一分钟。引导式四步小部件会询问您的风格词（低调奢华、定制、法式、运动、潮流等）、您实际购买的现代、奢华、牛仔布和配饰品牌、您乐意借用的时尚偶像，以及您满意的价格范围。配置文件是按用户保存的，因此它可以跨对话进行，而不是每次打开 ChatGPT 时都重新开始。

入职后，三件事变得有用。

购买特定商品。告诉应用程序你要找什么——“给我找一件 250 英镑以下的黑色西装外套”、“我需要一件冬季婚礼外套”、“我应该买什么牛仔裤”——它会根据你已经购买过的品牌返回三到五个选项，再加上围绕这件单品打造的完整服装：上衣、下衣、脚上穿什么，以及一两个配饰。目的是留下一个可穿戴的答案，而不是一个链接列表。

编辑灵感。如果询问您现在应该穿什么或看什么，该应用程序会从 Who What Wear UK 的实时编辑提要中提取新鲜文章，然后使用每篇文章上的品牌和类别标签挑选两到三篇符合您品味的文章。这些精选内容以出版物自己的视觉语言呈现为水平轮播卡片：编辑图片、踢球者、标题、署名信用以及直接返回 whowhatwear.com 上文章的链接。

完善您的个人资料。口味发生变化。重新打开入门以更新任何答案（并且仅更新您想要更改的答案），或者如果您是全新的，则完全重置个人资料。

有几件事值得了解。编辑提要是“Who What Wear UK”，因此内容在声音、货币和季节性方面都倾向于英国风格。推荐始终以真实的 Who What Wear 文章或从您提供的列表中提取的品牌建议为基础——应用程序不会发明 URL、图像或文章来填写结果，并且轮播仅在存在要附加的真实链接和图像时才会呈现。如果提要在某一天没有任何相关内容，您会得到诚实的答复，而不是捏造的答复。

该应用程序不是什么：它不涵盖男士时尚、美容产品搜索、家居装饰或非时尚购物。它不会显示实时零售商库存或实时价格。如果请求超出此范围，它会直接说明而不是猜测。

由《Who What Wear》的出版商 Future PLC 打造。

source_long:

source_long:
Explore your fleet data effortlessly through conversation. Wialon — the ultimate fleet digitalization solution tracking 4 million vehicles in 160 countries — brings your real-time operational insights directly into ChatGPT.

Simply ask questions about your vehicle statuses, trips, fuel activity, or geofences, and get clear, visual answers in seconds. It’s a faster, more intuitive way to stay on top of your operations, right where you already chat.

The app is read-only by design, ensuring a secure and transparent way to explore your data at any time.
plugin_details.target_long:
通过对话轻松探索您的车队数据。 Wialon 是终极车队数字化解决方案，可跟踪 160 个国家/地区的 400 万辆车辆，将您的实时运营洞察直接带入 ChatGPT。

只需询问有关您的车辆状态、行程、燃油活动或地理围栏的问题，即可在几秒钟内获得清晰、直观的答案。这是一种更快、更直观的方式，让您可以在聊天的地方掌握运营情况。

该应用程序设计为只读，确保以安全、透明的方式随时探索您的数据。

source_long: Wialon Platform helps authorized fleet-management users understand product documentation, discover API endpoints and schemas, and retrieve read-only data from their Wialon Platform account.
plugin_details.target_long: Wialon 平台帮助授权车队管理用户了解产品文档、发现 API 端点和架构，并从其 Wialon 平台帐户检索只读数据。

source_long: WikiFX is a third-party financial information platform specializing in the global foreign exchange (Forex) industry. source_long:

See over 140 million photos taken along the trails so you know what awaits before you plan your next adventure.

Try asking:

- "I'm visiting Italy next week. Find me 3 beautiful hikes near the Dolomites with lake views"

source_long: Tell Wild Calf Coffee how you brew and what you enjoy. It matches you to current coffees using catalog details and Wild Calf tasting and brewing information, explains why each suggestion fits, and says when a lot-specific detail has not been verified. It can troubleshoot weak, bitter, sour, or inconsistent coffee before recommending a purchase. When you are ready, it prepares a one-time Shopify cart. You review price, shipping, tax, and payment in Shopify; the plugin does not place or charge an order in ChatGPT.
plugin_details.target_long: 告诉 Wild Calf Coffee 您如何冲泡以及您喜欢什么。它使用目录详细信息以及野牛品尝和冲泡信息将您与当前的咖啡进行匹配，解释每个建议适合的原因，并在批次特定细节尚未得到验证时进行说明。它可以在推荐购买之前解决咖啡淡、苦、酸或不一致的问题。当您准备好时，它会准备一个一次性 Shopify 购物车。您在 Shopify 中查看价格、运费、税费和付款；该插件不会在 ChatGPT 中下订单或收取订单。

source_long:
Windsock estimates the market value of general aviation aircraft and provides the supporting market data behind that estimate. Enter an aircraft's tail number (N-number) to get an estimated current market value, comparable aircraft, and recent price trends for that make and model.
You can ask follow-up questions in plain language — how avionics, engine time since overhaul, damage history, or location affect value; how long similar aircraft typically take to sell; and how the broader segment is moving. Windsock also pulls FAA registry details, airworthiness directives, and airport-level information including current weather and fuel-price forecasts.
It's built for aircraft owners, buyers, sellers, brokers, and anyone who needs a defensible read on what an aircraft is worth and how its market is behaving. Estimates are model-generated for informational purposes and are not a certified appraisal.
plugin_details.target_long:
Windsock 估算通用航空飞机的市场价值，并提供该估算背后的支持市场数据。输入飞机的尾号（N 号）即可获取该品牌和型号的估计当前市场价值、可比飞机以及近期价格趋势。
您可以用简单的语言提出后续问题——航空电子设备、大修后的发动机时间、损坏历史或位置如何影响价值；类似的飞机通常需要多长时间才能出售；以及更广泛的细分市场如何发展。 Windsock 还提取美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 的注册详细信息、适航指令和机场级别的信息，包括当前天气和燃油价格预测。
它是为飞机所有者、买家、卖家、经纪人以及任何需要对飞机的价值及其市场表现进行合理解读的人而设计的。估算值是模型生成的，仅供参考，并非经过认证的评估。

source_long:

Common data sources customers connect include: Google Ads, Meta (Facebook) Ads, Instagram, LinkedIn Ads, LinkedIn Company Pages, TikTok Ads, GA4, Google Search Console, YouTube Analytics, Google Business Profile, HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, Klaviyo, Amazon Ads, Microsoft Ads (Bing), Google Merchant Center, Stripe, GoHighLevel, and more.  ￼
plugin_details.target_long:
Windsor.ai 将您的营销和业务数据源连接到 ChatGPT，以便您可以用自然语言提出问题并从连接的帐户中获得答案。

客户连接的常见数据源包括：Google Ads、Meta (Facebook) 广告、Instagram、LinkedIn 广告、LinkedIn 公司页面、TikTok 广告、GA4、Google Search Console、YouTube Analytics、Google Business Profile、HubSpot、Salesforce、Shopify、Klaviyo、Amazon Ads、Microsoft Ads (Bing)、Google Merchant Center、Stripe、GoHighLevel 等。  ￼

source_long: Windsor.ai Facebook Ads helps marketers analyze live Facebook Ads and Meta Ads performance in ChatGPT. Users can discover connected ad accounts, inspect valid fields and attribution options, query campaign, ad set, and ad metrics, connect the Facebook connector, and safely run supported Meta Ads actions such as creating, pausing, enabling, or changing budgets after confirmation.
plugin_details.target_long: Windsor.ai Facebook Ads 帮助营销人员分析 ChatGPT 中的实时 Facebook 广告和元广告表现。用户可以发现连接的广告帐户，检查有效字段和归因选项，查询广告系列、广告集和广告指标，连接 Facebook 连接器，并安全地运行受支持的元广告操作，例如确认后创建、暂停、启用或更改预算。

source_long: Windsor.ai Google Ads helps marketers analyze live Google Ads performance. Users can discover connected ad accounts, inspect valid fields and segmentation options, query campaign, ad group, and keyword metrics, connect the Google Ads connector, and safely run supported Google Ads actions such as creating, pausing, enabling, and updating campaigns, ad groups, ads, and keywords, setting budgets, managing bidding, and managing Customer Match audience lists, after confirmation. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
plugin_details.target_long: Windsor.ai Google Ads 可帮助营销人员分析实时 Google Ads 效果。用户可以在确认后发现已连接的广告帐户、检查有效字段和细分选项、查询广告系列、广告组和关键字指标、连接 Google Ads 连接器并安全地运行支持的 Google Ads 操作，例如创建、暂停、启用和更新广告系列、广告组、广告和关键字、设置预算、管理出价以及管理目标客户匹配受众群体名单。 Windsor.ai 是一个独立的产品，不隶属于其所连接的平台，也不受其认可。

source_long: Windsor.ai Instagram helps creators and marketers analyze live Instagram organic performance. Users can discover connected Instagram Business or Creator accounts, inspect valid fields and options, query account and media insights — followers, reach, impressions, profile and website clicks, and engagement — and connect the Instagram connector. It covers organic Instagram analytics only: it does not run write actions (Instagram publishing is not enabled), cover Instagram Ads (use the Meta Ads connector), or provide ad cost data. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
plugin_details.target_long: Windsor.ai Instagram 帮助创作者和营销人员分析 Instagram 的实时有机表现。用户可以发现已连接的 Instagram Business 或 Creator 帐户，检查有效字段和选项，查询帐户和媒体见解（关注者、覆盖范围、展示次数、个人资料和网站点击量以及参与度）并连接 Instagram 连接器。它仅涵盖有机 Instagram 分析：它不运行写入操作（未启用 Instagram 发布）、涵盖 Instagram 广告（使用元广告连接器）或提供广告成本数据。 Windsor.ai 是一个独立的产品，不隶属于其所连接的平台，也不受其认可。

source_long: Windsor.ai Google Search Console helps SEOs and marketers explore live Search Console data. Users can discover connected Search Console sites, inspect valid dimensions and metrics, and query organic search performance — clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position by query, page, country, device, and date — over any date range, and connect the Search Console connector. It provides read-only analytics: it does not run write actions, submit or change sitemaps, or modify any Search Console settings. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
plugin_details.target_long: Windsor.ai Google Search Console 可帮助 SEO 和营销人员探索实时 Search Console 数据。用户可以发现连接的 Search Console 网站，检查有效的维度和指标，并查询任何日期范围内的自然搜索性能（点击次数、展示次数、点击率以及按查询、页面、国家/地区、设备和日期划分的平均排名），并连接 Search Console 连接器。它提供只读分析：它不运行写入操作、提交或更改站点地图或修改任何 Search Console 设置。 Windsor.ai 是一个独立的产品，不隶属于其所连接的平台，也不受其认可。

source_long: Wingify helps teams analyze experimentation performance, review behavior insights, and manage testing campaigns directly from ChatGPT.
plugin_details.target_long: Wingify 帮助团队直接从 ChatGPT 分析实验性能、审查行为见解并管理测试活动。

source_long: Winnow helps growers answer questions about their own farm operations in ChatGPT. The app exposes schema discovery and read-only SQL query tools over the farm's scoped operation, field, and weather tables, with server-side validation that rejects non-SELECT statements and out-of-scope datasets.
plugin_details.target_long: Winnow 帮助种植者在 ChatGPT 中回答有关其农场运营的问题。该应用程序在场的范围操作、字段和天气表上公开架构发现和只读 SQL 查询工具，并通过服务器端验证拒绝非 SELECT 语句和超出范围的数据集。

source_long: Allow ChatGPT to access your meeting notes, action items, and transcripts.
plugin_details.target_long: 允许 ChatGPT 访问您的会议记录、操作项目和记录。

source_long: An MCP which allows you to read, modify and destroy your Wistia data including videos, audios, folders, channels and more.
plugin_details.target_long: 一个 MCP，允许您读取、修改和销毁 Wistia 数据，包括视频、音频、文件夹、频道等。

source_long: WitCloud connects ChatGPT to your marketing, sales, and ecommerce data. Ask questions in plain language and get answers straight from your business data - explore customers, campaigns, revenue, and trends without writing SQL. WitCloud uses your business context to keep answers relevant. All access is read-only.
plugin_details.target_long: WitCloud 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的营销、销售和电子商务数据。用简单的语言提出问题并直接从业务数据中获得答案 - 无需编写 SQL 即可探索客户、营销活动、收入和趋势。 WitCloud 使用您的业务上下文来保持答案的相关性。所有访问都是只读的。

source_long: Bring your organization's processes and operational knowledge into your AI assistant. The Within MCP connects to your Within workspace so you can query your organization's processes, explore the process index knowledge graph linking processes to systems and teams, and ground answers in how your business actually runs — not generic guesses.
plugin_details.target_long: 将您组织的流程和运营知识带入您的 AI 助手中。 Within MCP 连接到您的 Within 工作区，以便您可以查询组织的流程、探索将流程链接到系统和团队的流程索引知识图，并根据您的业务实际运行情况提供基本答案，而不是一般性猜测。

source_long: Build your entire site and buy a domain right from the chat. Just ask Wix for the website you want, including all the functionality you need, and get a complete, business-ready site generated for you in minutes. You can also connect the perfect custom domain to your site and manage everything seamlessly in one place. If you like, you can continue editing it inside the Wix Harmony editor using tons more AI tools and smooth drag and drop.
plugin_details.target_long: 构建您的整个网站并直接通过聊天购买域名。只需向 Wix 询问您想要的网站，包括您需要的所有功能，几分钟内即可为您生成一个完整的、可用于业务的网站。您还可以将完美的自定义域连接到您的网站，并在一处无缝管理一切。如果您愿意，您可以使用更多 AI 工具和流畅的拖放功能在 Wix Harmony 编辑器中继续编辑它。

source_long: WoWSQL lets users manage their PostgreSQL database-as-a-service projects directly from ChatGPT. Users can list and inspect projects, browse database tables, execute SQL queries and statements, search platform documentation, read full doc pages, and list file storage buckets — all within their authenticated WoWSQL workspace.
plugin_details.target_long: WoWSQL 允许用户直接从 ChatGPT 管理他们的 PostgreSQL 数据库即服务项目。用户可以列出和检查项目、浏览数据库表、执行 SQL 查询和语句、搜索平台文档、阅读完整的文档页面以及列出文件存储桶 - 所有这些都在其经过身份验证的 WoWSQL 工作区中进行。

source_long: Wolfee records, transcribes, and analyzes your meetings, then makes that intelligence available to your AI assistant. Connect Wolfee to ask natural-language questions about any meeting: pull a full transcript, surface action items and commitments, search your entire meeting history by meaning (not just keywords), review video recordings, and see which upcoming calendar meetings Wolfee will record next. All access is read-only and scoped to your own data.
plugin_details.target_long: Wolfee 记录、转录和分析您的会议，然后将这些情报提供给您的人工智能助手。连接 Wolfee，询问有关任何会议的自然语言问题：提取完整的记录、显示行动项目和承诺、按含义（不仅仅是关键字）搜索整个会议历史记录、查看视频记录，以及查看 Wolfee 接下来将记录哪些即将举行的日历会议。所有访问都是只读的，并且仅限于您自己的数据。

source_long:
The Wolfram MCP Server transforms your AI environment into a rigorous computational powerhouse. By integrating Wolfram Language and Wolfram|Alpha, this server provides access to curated data and sophisticated algorithms. When a user submits a query, the LLM works with Wolfram to convert it into Wolfram Language for precise evaluation, and these exact results are incorporated into the response provided by the LLM.

Whether you are solving complex differential equations, analyzing chemical structures or querying real-time socioeconomic data, the MCP Server ensures your AI has the "computational brain" necessary to deliver verified, high-level technical results that can be trusted.
plugin_details.target_long:
Wolfram MCP 服务器将您的 AI 环境转变为严格的计算引擎。通过集成 Wolfram 语言和 Wolfram|Alpha，该服务器提供对精选数据和复杂算法的访问。当用户提交查询时，LLM 与 Wolfram 合作将其转换为 Wolfram 语言以进行精确评估，并且这些准确的结果将合并到 LLM 提供的响应中。

无论您是求解复杂的微分方程、分析化学结构还是查询实时社会经济数据，MCP 服务器都能确保您的 AI 拥有提供可信赖的经过验证的高级技术结果所需的“计算大脑”。

source_long:
Find hidden words, have fun every day, and give your brain a happy workout. Our Word Search game is easy to play, relaxing, and full of exciting puzzles for every age. Whether you have a few minutes or a whole afternoon, you can enjoy thousands of word searches anytime. Play at home, on the bus, during a break, or before bed. There is always a new puzzle waiting for you.

Each puzzle is filled with hidden words. Look across, down, up, backward, or diagonal to find them all. Tap or drag across the letters to mark each word. Finish the list to solve the puzzle and move on to the next challenge. The controls are simple, so anyone can start playing in seconds.

There are puzzles for beginners and experts. Start with easy games or test yourself with harder challenges. As you play, you will spot words faster, learn new words, and build your confidence. Every completed puzzle feels rewarding and keeps you coming back for one more game.

Choose from many fun topics. Search for animals, food, nature, space, sports, travel, music, holidays, science, colors, jobs, and much more. Every theme brings a fresh collection of words to discover, making each puzzle feel new and exciting.

Play whenever you want, even without an internet connection. This makes the game perfect for travel, waiting rooms, flights, road trips, camping, or anywhere you want quiet entertainment. Your next puzzle is always ready.

Need a little help? Use hints if you get stuck. They point you in the right direction so you can keep having fun without feeling frustrated. Whether you are learning or challenging yourself, hints make every puzzle enjoyable.

The clean design is easy on your eyes. Bright letters, smooth controls, and clear layouts make finding words simple and comfortable. Play for a few minutes or enjoy longer sessions without distractions.

Word Search is more than a game. It is a relaxing way to exercise your mind. Finding hidden words helps improve focus, attention, spelling, vocabulary, and pattern recognition while keeping gameplay calm and enjoyable. Many players enjoy using word searches to unwind after a busy day.

There is no rush unless you want one. Take your time and enjoy every puzzle, or challenge yourself to finish as quickly as possible. Play your way and set your own pace.

The game is designed for everyone. Children can practice reading and spelling. Teens can sharpen their vocabulary. Adults can relax after work. Seniors can enjoy gentle brain exercise while having fun. Families can even play together and see who finds the most words.

New puzzles and fresh challenges help keep the adventure going. With so many word lists and themes, there is always something different to discover. You can play again and again without running out of fun.

Why players love Word Search:
• Thousands of fun word search puzzles.
• Easy to learn and simple to play.
• Great for kids, adults, and seniors.
• Multiple difficulty levels.
• Fun themed word packs.
• Relaxing gameplay.
• Helpful hints when needed.
• Play online or offline.
• Quick games or long play sessions.
• Smooth controls and clean design.
• Great for improving vocabulary.
• Exercises your brain while you play.
• Perfect for daily play.
• Suitable for beginners and experienced players.

If you enjoy word games, brain games, spelling games, hidden object puzzles, or relaxing puzzle games, this is the perfect choice. Download today and start your next word search adventure. Find hidden words, complete every puzzle, improve your vocabulary, challenge your mind, and enjoy hours of relaxing fun. Your next favorite word search game is ready whenever you are.

找到隐藏的单词，享受每一天，让你的大脑得到快乐的锻炼。我们的单词搜索游戏玩法简单、轻松，并且充满了适合各个年龄段的令人兴奋的谜题。无论您有几分钟还是一整个下午，您都可以随时享受数千个单词的搜索。在家里、在公共汽车上、休息时或睡觉前玩。总有新的谜题等着你。

每个谜题都充满了隐藏的单词。横向、向下、向上、向后或对角线看，都能找到它们。点击或拖动字母来标记每个单词。完成列表以解决难题并继续下一个挑战。控制很简单，所以任何人都可以在几秒钟内开始玩。

需要一点帮助吗？如果遇到困难，请使用提示。他们为您指明了正确的方向，这样您就可以继续享受乐趣而不会感到沮丧。无论您是在学习还是在挑战自己，提示都会让每个谜题变得有趣。

简洁的设计让您的眼睛感到舒适。明亮的字母、流畅的控制和清晰的布局使查找单词变得简单而舒适。不受干扰地玩几分钟或享受更长时间的游戏。

除非你想要，否则不着急。慢慢来，享受每一个谜题，或者挑战自己尽快完成。按照您的方式进行游戏并设定您自己的节奏。

该游戏是为每个人设计的。孩子们可以练习阅读和拼写。青少年可以提高词汇量。大人下班后可以放松一下。老年人可以在玩乐的同时享受温和的大脑锻炼。家人甚至可以一起玩，看看谁找到最多的单词。

为什么玩家喜欢单词搜索：

• 非常适合儿童、成人和老年人。

如果您喜欢文字游戏、益智游戏、拼写游戏、隐藏物体谜题或轻松的益智游戏，那么这是您的完美选择。立即下载并开始您的下一个单词搜索冒险。找到隐藏的单词，完成每个谜题，提高词汇量，挑战你的思维，享受数小时的轻松乐趣。您的下一个最喜欢的单词搜索游戏随时准备就绪。
