Describe what you need and WordPress builds it: a portfolio, a restaurant menu, a blog, an online store. Tell WordPress about your business, your audience, what pages you need. It plans the site, writes the content, picks a design, and launches it on WordPress.com. 

Already have a WordPress.com site? Connect it to publish and schedule posts, check your traffic, moderate comments, manage plugins, and update settings. 70+ abilities across your full site. 

WordPress.com's plugin connects ChatGPT or Codex directly to WordPress.com, so you can build a new site or manage an existing one — all through conversation.

If you are running locally in Codex, you can also connect to WordPress Studio for local site builds, theme and plugin development, site edits and site administration.
plugin_details.target_long:
描述您的需求，WordPress 会构建它：作品集、餐厅菜单、博客、在线商店。告诉 WordPress 有关您的业务、您的受众以及您需要哪些页面的信息。它规划网站、编写内容、选择设计并在 WordPress.com 上发布。 

已经有 WordPress.com 网站？连接它来发布和安排帖子、检查流量、审核评论、管理插件和更新设置。整个网站有 70 多种功能。 

WordPress.com 的插件将 ChatGPT 或 Codex 直接连接到 WordPress.com，因此您可以构建新网站或管理现有网站 - 全部通过对话进行。

如果您在 Codex 中本地运行，您还可以连接到 WordPress Studio 进行本地站点构建、主题和插件开发、站点编辑和站点管理。

source_long:
Read and write anything with AI highlighting that explains difficult words, ideas, arguments, and writing techniques as you go.

Paste any passage into the chat and get a clean, readable version with highlights that open simple explanations beside the text. Instead of jumping between search results, dictionaries, and websites, you stay focused on what you are reading. Tap a highlighted phrase to see why it matters, what it means, or how it fits into the bigger picture.

The app is built for curiosity. Read literature, history, science, news, speeches, legal writing, essays, research papers, blog posts, and your own drafts. Each annotation is created for the specific passage, so the explanations match the surrounding context instead of giving a one-size-fits-all definition.

Highlights can explain:
• Vocabulary and unfamiliar phrases
• Literary devices and writing techniques
• Themes, symbols, and motifs
• Historical and cultural references
• Character development and motivation
• Arguments, evidence, and reasoning
• Tone, mood, and style
• Grammar and sentence structure
• Rhetorical strategies
• Important facts and key ideas

The reading experience stays simple. The original text remains front and center while annotations appear only where they are useful. Open one note at a time to avoid clutter, or move through every annotation in order. Whether you want a quick answer or a deeper explanation, the information is always close to the text that inspired it.

Students can use the app to prepare for class, review assigned readings, or understand challenging passages before discussions and exams. Teachers can use it to explore different ways of explaining the same text. Lifelong learners can finally tackle books and articles that once felt too difficult.

Writers and editors can also benefit. Paste your own work into the app to see explanations of structure, language, and rhetorical choices. Use the annotations to spot places where readers may need more context or where a sentence could be clearer.

Every passage is different. A line from Shakespeare needs different notes than a scientific article or a court opinion. The app adapts its explanations to the text instead of forcing every document into the same template.

Designed with a clean interface, the app keeps reading comfortable on phones and tablets. Text is easy to scan, annotations are easy to open, and the layout keeps your place while you explore each note.

Whether you are studying for school, preparing for work, learning a new subject, or reading for fun, the app helps you spend less time searching for explanations and more time understanding what you read. Paste a passage, explore the highlights, and discover more in every paragraph.

You decide how much detail you want. Read straight through without interruptions, or pause on any highlight when something catches your attention. Short notes give fast answers. Longer notes connect ideas across the passage and explain why a sentence, quote, or example matters. This makes it easier to build understanding one step at a time instead of feeling overwhelmed.

The app works well for homework, book clubs, workplace training, language practice, and personal reading goals. If you enjoy asking questions while you read, this app brings those answers directly into the page. It can help you recognize patterns, follow complex arguments, remember important details, and appreciate strong writing.

Features include:
• Paste almost any text
• AI-generated contextual annotations
• Clear highlighted passages
• Simple side-by-side explanations
• Easy navigation between notes
• Clean, distraction-free reading experience
• Fast exploration of complex material

Understanding starts with context. Instead of reading around confusing parts, read through them with guidance that appears exactly where you need it. Read confidently, stay curious, and turn difficult passages into clear learning every day. today.
plugin_details.target_long:
阅读和书写任何带有人工智能突出显示的内容，可以随时解释困难的单词、想法、论点和写作技巧。

将任何段落粘贴到聊天中，即可获得干净、可读的版本，其中包含突出显示，可在文本旁边打开简单的解释。您无需在搜索结果、词典和网站之间跳转，而是可以专注于正在阅读的内容。点击突出显示的短语即可了解其重要性、含义或如何融入大局。

该应用程序是为了满足好奇心而构建的。阅读文学、历史、科学、新闻、演讲、法律写作、论文、研究论文、博客文章和您自己的草稿。每个注释都是针对特定段落创建的，因此解释与周围的上下文相匹配，而不是给出一刀切的定义。

亮点可以解释：
• 词汇和不熟悉的短语
• 文学手段和写作技巧
• 主题、符号和主题
• 历史和文化参考
• 性格发展和动机
• 论证、证据和推理
• 语气、情绪和风格
• 语法和句子结构
• 修辞策略
• 重要事实和关键想法

阅读体验保持简单。原始文本保留在前面和中间，而注释仅出现在有用的地方。一次打开一个注释以避免混乱，或按顺序浏览每个注释。无论您想要快速答案还是更深入的解释，信息总是接近激发它的文本。

学生可以使用该应用程序准备课堂、复习指定的阅读材料或在讨论和考试前理解具有挑战性的段落。教师可以用它来探索解释同一文本的不同方式。终身学习者终于可以解决曾经觉得太困难的书籍和文章了。

作家和编辑也可以受益。将您自己的作品粘贴到应用程序中以查看结构、语言和修辞选择的解释。使用注释来找出读者可能需要更多上下文或句子可以更清晰的地方。

每一段都是不同的。莎士比亚的一句话需要与科学文章或法庭意见不同的注释。该应用程序会根据文本调整其解释，而不是强制每个文档都使用相同的模板。

该应用程序采用简洁的界面设计，可在手机和平​​板电脑上保持舒适的阅读体验。文本易于浏览，注释易于打开，并且布局可在您探索每个笔记时保持您的位置。

无论您是在为学校学习、为工作做准备、学习新学科还是为了娱乐而阅读，该应用程序都可以帮助您花更少的时间搜索解释，而将更多的时间用于理解您所阅读的内容。粘贴一段文章，探索亮点，并在每个段落中发现更多内容。

您决定需要多少细节。不间断地直读，或者在某些内容引起您注意时暂停在任何亮点上。简短的笔记可以快速给出答案。较长的注释将整个段落的想法联系起来，并解释为什么句子、引文或示例很重要。这使得一次一步地建立理解变得更容易，而不是感到不知所措。

该应用程序非常适合家庭作业、读书俱乐部、工作场所培训、语言练习和个人阅读目标。如果您喜欢在阅读时提出问题，此应用程序会将这些答案直接带入页面。它可以帮助您识别模式、遵循复杂的论点、记住重要的细节并欣赏精彩的写作。

特点包括：
• 粘贴几乎任何文本
• AI 生成的上下文注释
• 清除突出显示的段落
• 简单的并排解释
• 笔记之间轻松导航
• 干净、无干扰的阅读体验
• 快速探索复杂材料

理解从上下文开始。不要阅读令人困惑的部分，而是按照您需要的地方的指导通读它们。自信地阅读，保持好奇心，每天将困难的段落变成清晰的学习。今天。

source_long:
Workopia AI brings the full job search experience into ChatGPT — no extra tabs, no separate sign-ups.

Key Highlights

• Employer-direct, real-time jobs
Listings are pulled live from company career pages and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), so you see roles as soon as they’re posted — not recycled from third-party job boards.

• Must-have vs. nice-to-have, at a glance
Each role is pre-tagged to help you scan quickly: required skills are clearly highlighted, while additional “nice-to-have” criteria are separated out.

• Tailor your resume inline
Open any job and click *Tailor* to instantly adapt your resume. A live widget highlights missing skills and lets you add supporting evidence in real time. Export an ATS-friendly PDF in one click.

• Cover letter + apply
Generate a role-specific cover letter from the same chat, download it as a PDF, and apply directly via the employer’s official posting.

Search → Read → Tailor → Cover Letter → Apply
All in one conversation, end to end.
plugin_details.target_long:

• 雇主直接的实时工作
列表是从公司职业页面和申请人跟踪系统 (ATS) 中实时提取的，因此您一发布就可以看到职位，而不是从第三方招聘委员会回收。

一切都在一次对话中，端到端。

Tell the assistant you want to incorporate and it collects the details one step at a time: company name and purpose, share capital, the shareholder(s) and managing director, and how you'd like to notarize. source_long:
Structured decision-making using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) , a proven framework for comparing options and resolving trade-offs.

Whether you're evaluating cars, comparing job offers, choosing a vendor, or weighing any set of alternatives, decisionpoint.io guides you through the process step by step. You define the goal, identify the factors that matter, list your options, and then compare them two at a time. AHP derives ranked results from your comparisons, showing which option best matches your priorities and why.

The app provides:
- A visual overview of your decision structure
- An interactive comparison interface within the conversation
- Ranked results with scores and criteria weights
- Consistency analysis to identify contradictory judgments

Decisions are saved to your decisionpoint.io account and can be revisited, refined, or continued at any time.
plugin_details.target_long:
使用层次分析法 (AHP) 进行结构化决策，这是一种经过验证的比较选项和解决权衡的框架。

该应用程序提供：
- 决策结构的直观概览
- 对话内的交互式比较界面
- 带有分数和标准权重的排名结果

决策将保存到您的 Decisionpoint.io 帐户中，并且可以随时重新访问、完善或继续。

source_long:
Der ecoExperten-Connector bringt den deutschen Energieausweis in den KI-Chat. Wer eine Wohnimmobilie vermieten oder verkaufen will, braucht gesetzlich einen Energieausweis — mit dieser App lässt er sich vollständig im Gespräch bestellen:

1. Beraten: Die App erklärt, welcher Ausweistyp passt und welche Angaben nötig sind (Gebäudedaten plus drei aufeinanderfolgende Jahres-Heizabrechnungen).
2. Prüfen: Alle Angaben werden vorab kostenlos gegen die gesetzlichen Regeln des Gebäudeenergiegesetzes (GEG) validiert — z. B. 18-Monats-Frist der Verbrauchsdaten, Bedarfsausweis-Pflicht nach § 80 Abs. 3, Leerstandsgrenzen — ohne dass eine Bestellung ausgelöst wird.
3. Bestellen: Nach ausdrücklicher Zustimmung zu AGB und zahlungspflichtiger Bestellung legt die App eine schwebende Bestellung an und sendet einen Bestätigungslink an die angegebene E-Mail-Adresse. Erst der Klick auf diesen Link macht die Bestellung verbindlich; unbestätigte Bestellungen verfallen nach 48 Stunden automatisch. Kauf auf Rechnung, kein Zahlungsvorgang im Chat. Ein Doppelbestellungs-Schutz verhindert versehentliche Mehrfachkäufe.
4. Verfolgen: Der Bearbeitungsstand ist über Bestellnummer plus die bei der Bestellung angegebene E-Mail-Adresse abrufbar; die Antwort enthält nur den Bearbeitungsstand, keine Personen- oder Gebäudedaten.

Die Ausstellung erfolgt durch eingetragene Energieberater des CO5 Ingenieurbüros für nachhaltiges Bauen (PartG mbB, Berlin); jeder Ausweis erhält eine amtliche DIBt-Registriernummer und wird in der Regel innerhalb von 1–2 Werktagen als PDF per E-Mail zugestellt. Preis: 59 € brutto (Verbrauchsausweis); der Bedarfsausweis (119 €) ist über das Web-Formular erhältlich.

2. Prüfen：Alle Angaben werden vorab kostenlos gegen die gesetzlichen Regeln des Gebäudeenergiegesetzes (GEG) validiert — z。 B. 18-Monats-Frist der Verbrauchsdaten，Bedarfsausweis-Pflicht nach § 80 Abs。 3、Leerstandsgrenzen — ohne dass eine Bestellung ausgelöst wrd。
3. 通知：Nach ausdrücklicher Zustimmung zu AGB 和 zahlungspflichtiger Bestellung Legt die App eine schwebende Bestellung and sendet einen Bestätigungslink an die angegebene E-Mail-Adresse。 Erst der Klick auf diesen Link macht die Bestellung verbindlich； unbestätigte Bestellungen verfallen nach 48 Stunden automatisch。 Kauf auf Rechnung，kein Zahlungsvorgang im Chat。 Ein Doppelbestellungs-Schutz verhindert versehentliche Mehrfachkäufe。
4. Verfolgen：Der Bearbeitungsstand ist über Bestellnummer plus die bei der Bestellung angegebene E-Mail-Adresse abrufbar； Die Antwort enthält nur den Bearbeitungsstand, keine Personen-oder Gebäudedaten。

Die Ausstellung erfolgt durch eingetragene Energieberater des CO5 Ingenieurbüros für nachhaltiges Bauen（PartG mbB，柏林）； jeder Ausweis erhält eine amtliche DIBt-Registriernummer 和 der Regel insidehalb von 1–2 Werktagen als PDF per E-Mail zugestellt.价格：59 € brutto (Verbrauchsausweis)； der Bedarfsausweis (119 €) ist über das Web-Formular erhältlich。

source_long:
Shopping online feels like a trust exercise you're destined to fail. You find a product with 5,000 five-star reviews, but half of them look like bots and the other half are people just happy the box arrived on time. It's impossible to know what's actually good.

This app cuts through the junk. You tell us what you need, and we ignore the sponsored placements to build you a shortlist based on merit, not marketing budget.

This is where we do the heavy lifting. We don't just show you the star rating; we dig into the text to find the truth. We scan forum discussions, Reddit threads, and verified purchase comments to summarize the actual consensus.

- The Good: We highlight the specific features real people love.
- The Bad: We spot the patterns in the complaints - like if a "waterproof" boot actually leaks after a month.
- The Verdict: We tell you if the hype is real or if you should keep looking.

Once you have a few options, we stack them side-by-side. You get a clean look at the specs and prices without opening twenty tabs or building your own spreadsheet. It's the deep research you want to do, done for you in seconds.
plugin_details.target_long:
网上购物感觉就像是一场你注定会失败的信任练习。你发现一款产品有 5,000 条五星级评论，但其中一半看起来像机器人，另一半则是人们只是因为盒子准时到达而感到高兴。不可能知道什么是真正好的。

这个应用程序可以清除垃圾。您告诉我们您的需求，我们会忽略赞助广告位，根据绩效而不是营销预算为您构建候选名单。

这是我们进行繁重工作的地方。我们不只是向您展示星级；我们还向您展示星级。我们深入研究文本以寻找真相。我们扫描论坛讨论、Reddit 帖子和经过验证的购买评论，以总结实际的共识。

- 优点：我们突出了人们喜爱的具体功能。
- 缺点：我们在投诉中发现了一些模式 - 例如“防水”靴子在一个月后实际上是否漏水。
- 结论：我们会告诉您炒作是否真实，或者您是否应该继续寻找。

一旦您有了一些选择，我们就会将它们并排堆叠。您无需打开二十个选项卡或构建自己的电子表格，即可清楚地了解规格和​​价格。这是您想要进行的深入研究，只需几秒钟即可完成。

Search, compare, and book airport transfers, airport taxis, ride-hailing, shuttles and ski transfers across Europe, the Americas, Asia, Oceania, and Africa.

@hoppa is a global mobility platform offering seamless door-to-door ground transportation across 182+ countries, 2,600+ airports, and thousands of resorts. We empower 40 million+ customers to instantly compare and book the best fares for airport transfers, private taxis, ride-hailing, and shared shuttles in one place.

With real-time access to a network of 70,000+ vetted local providers, @hoppa ensures reliable fixed-price travel tailored to every journey and budget. Trusted by the world’s leading payment networks, including Mastercard, Visa, UnionPay, and Alipay, we simplify last-mile travel for every traveller.
How to use @hoppa: Ask the @hoppa app to compare routes or find the most cost-effective way to reach your destination. You can filter by vehicle type, price, or travel time to ensure your arrival is as smooth as your flight.

Key Features:
1: Compare & Save: Instant access to private transfers, shared shuttles, and taxis.
2: Global Reach: Coverage in 182+ countries and 2,600+ airports.
3: Fixed Pricing: No hidden fees; know what you pay before you book.
4: Vetted Providers: 70,000+ reliable local fleets.

Useful for:
1: Planning stress-free transport before you land.
2: Comparing ride-hailing vs private transfers in real-time.
3: Securing reliable transport for large groups or solo holiday travel.

Conversation Starters (Try asking)
“@hoppa, find a private transfer from Barcelona Airport to the City Centre.”
“@hoppa, what are the cheapest shuttle options from Malaga Airport?”
“@hoppa, book a taxi from Heathrow to Central London for 4 people.”
“@hoppa, show me airport transportation options in Miami airport.”

source_long:
mfloow is a business process improvement platform that uses AI to provide end-to-end support, from visualizing operations to ensuring that improvements are successfully embedded across the organization.

By visualizing task progress, assignees, deadlines, and approval statuses, mfloow enables users to quickly understand the overall state of their operations. It also standardizes business workflows to reduce inconsistencies between individuals and prevent processes from becoming dependent on specific employees. In addition, mfloow automates routine activities such as initiating workflows, assigning tasks, and sending notifications, thereby reducing administrative effort and human error. Its AI-assisted workflow creation capabilities help organizations reduce the time required to design processes, improve operational quality, and establish a sustainable framework for continuous improvement.

The mfloow plugin allows users to access flow and task information stored in mfloow and check progress, deadlines, and assigned work through a conversational interface. Users can review ongoing flows, identify their assigned tasks, and detect overdue tasks, as well as view detailed information such as task comments, checklists, related tasks, and approval statuses.
plugin_details.target_long:
mfloow 是一个业务流程改进平台，它使用人工智能提供端到端支持，从可视化操作到确保改进成功嵌入整个组织。

通过可视化任务进度、受让人、截止日期和审批状态，mfloow 使用户能够快速了解​​其操作的整体状态。它还标准化业务工作流程，以减少个人之间的不一致，并防止流程依赖于特定员工。此外，mfloow 还可以自动执行日常活动，例如启动工作流程、分配任务和发送通知，从而减少管理工作和人为错误。其人工智能辅助工作流程创建功能可帮助组织减少设计流程所需的时间、提高运营质量并建立持续改进的可持续框架。

mfloow 插件允许用户访问 mfloow 中存储的流程和任务信息，并通过对话界面检查进度、截止日期和分配的工作。用户可以查看正在进行的流程、识别其分配的任务、检测过期任务，以及查看详细信息，例如任务注释、清单、相关任务和审批状态。

source_long:
microfn is a sandboxed cloud environment for building, deploying, and running tiny JavaScript functions - designed to be AI-friendly. Give ChatGPT its own workspace to write functions, deploy them, manage their code and secrets, and run the functions you've already built.

With microfn, ChatGPT can:

- Write and deploy a new JavaScript function on request
- Inspect, update, and validate the code of existing functions
- Manage function settings and secrets securely
- Run your functions and use their results in the conversation

Each function runs in an isolated sandbox, so ChatGPT can safely create and compose its own tools - fetch a weather API, build a key-value store, post to Slack, send a Telegram message, and much more.
plugin_details.target_long:
microfn 是一个沙盒云环境，用于构建、部署和运行小型 JavaScript 函数 - 旨在对 AI 友好。为 ChatGPT 提供自己的工作区来编写函数、部署它们、管理它们的代码和机密，以及运行您已经构建的函数。

借助 microfn，ChatGPT 可以：

- 根据要求编写和部署新的 JavaScript 函数
- 检查、更新和验证现有函数的代码
- 安全地管理功能设置和机密
- 运行您的函数并在对话中使用它们的结果

每个函数都在隔离的沙箱中运行，因此 ChatGPT 可以安全地创建和编写自己的工具 - 获取天气 API、构建键值存储、发布到 Slack、发送 Telegram 消息等等。

source_long: Manage your mittwald (mStudio) hosting infrastructure from ChatGPT. Read-only tools inspect resources, while write tools create, update or remove them on the authenticated user's behalf.
plugin_details.target_long: 从 ChatGPT 管理您的 mittwald (mStudio) 托管基础设施。列出并检查项目、应用程序、服务器和域；配置和管理 MySQL 和 Redis 数据库、用户、备份和备份计划；使用容器、堆栈、cron 作业和卷；配置域名、DNS 区域、虚拟主机、SSL 证书和邮件地址；管理组织和项目成员、SSH 用户和密钥以及 API 令牌。只读工具检查资源，而写入工具代表经过身份验证的用户创建、更新或删除资源。

source_long:
trainedby.ai connects your wearables to ChatGPT, so your AI coach knows your real training load, sleep patterns, and recovery without you typing a word.

**The problem with AI fitness coaching today**

People are turning to ChatGPT to plan their marathon training, strength programs, or HYROX prep. It makes sense, because AI is available 24/7, extremely patient, and quite knowledgeable.

But somehow it doesn't quite work.

And that is because you have to tell it everything. Every. Single. Time.

Every conversation starts from zero. You have to describe in detail your current level, recent workouts, schedule, and goals. You paste in screenshots from Garmin. You try to remember what you did last week, how you slept, that your resting HR has been elevated, or that your HRV has been trending down for weeks.

The advice is based on what you told it, not what actually happened.

And what you tell it is incomplete, subjective, and often wrong.

What if your AI coach could see everything?

We connect your wearables (Garmin, Oura, Whoop, Apple Health, and 50+ other platforms) directly to your AI assistant.

When you open ChatGPT and ask about your training, it already knows:
- Workouts from the past weeks, months, and year
- Sleep quality and patterns
- Heart rate variability and resting heart rate trends
- Daily activity and recovery metrics
- Nutrition and menstrual cycle data (if you track it)

No more context dumps. No more subjective self-reporting.

**How it works**

We use smart compression to turn weeks of wearable data into something an AI can understand and analyze. Instead of dumping raw heart rate readings into a chat window, we surface the trends and patterns that matter—elevated resting HR, declining HRV, increasing training load, poor sleep consistency.

The data rolls up from days to weeks to months to years, so you can spot trends.

And because it's integrated into ChatGPT, you just start chatting.

Beyond wearable data, you can add notes like workout goals, feedback, and other personal information such as availability and injuries. This way, the AI gets that bit of subjective context it needs to give you the best advice.

**Who this is for**

If you're already wearing a watch or ring, and using AI to help plan your training, whether that's for a marathon, strength program, or general fitness, trainedby.ai makes that experience dramatically better.

**Get started**

The product is free to use.

Connect your wearables, add the integration to your AI assistant, and start chatting.
plugin_details.target_long:
Trainingby.ai 将您的可穿戴设备连接到 ChatGPT，这样您的 AI 教练就可以知道您的真实训练负荷、睡眠模式和恢复情况，而无需您输入任何文字。

**当今人工智能健身教练的问题**

人们开始使用 ChatGPT 来计划他们的马拉松训练、力量计划或 HYROX 准备。这是有道理的，因为人工智能是 24/7 可用的，非常有耐心，而且知识渊博。

但不知怎的，它不太有效。

那是因为你必须告诉它一切。每一个。单身的。时间。

每一次对话都是从零开始。您必须详细描述您当前的水平、最近的锻炼、日程安排和目标。您粘贴 Garmin 的屏幕截图。您尝试记住上周做了什么、睡眠情况、静息心率有所升高，或者心率变异数周以来一直呈下降趋势。

该建议基于您所说的内容，而不是实际发生的情况。

你所说的内容是不完整的、主观的，而且常常是错误的。

如果你的人工智能教练可以看到一切怎么办？

我们将您的可穿戴设备（Garmin、Oura、Whoop、Apple Health 和 50 多个其他平台）直接连接到您的 AI 助手。

当您打开 ChatGPT 并询问您的训练时，它已经知道：
- 过去几周、几个月和一年的锻炼
- 睡眠质量和模式
- 心率变异性和静息心率趋势
- 日常活动和恢复指标
- 营养和月经周期数据（如果您跟踪的话）

不再有上下文转储。不再有主观的自我报告。

**它是如何运作的**

我们使用智能压缩将数周的可穿戴数据转化为人工智能可以理解和分析的数据。我们不是将原始心率读数倾倒到聊天窗口中，而是显示重要的趋势和模式——静息心率升高、心率变异性下降、训练负荷增加、睡眠一致性差。

数据从几天到几周、几个月甚至几年不断累积，因此您可以发现趋势。

由于它已集成到 ChatGPT 中，因此您只需开始聊天即可。

除了可穿戴数据之外，您还可以添加锻炼目标、反馈等注释以及其他个人信息（例如可用性和受伤情况）。这样，人工智能就能获得所需的主观背景信息，为你提供最好的建议。

**这是给谁的**

如果您已经佩戴了手表或戒指，并使用 AI 来帮助计划您的训练，无论是马拉松、力量训练还是一般健身，trainedby.ai 都会显着改善您的体验。

**开始**

该产品可免费使用。

连接您的可穿戴设备，将集成添加到您的人工智能助手，然后开始聊天。

从那里，您可以验证版权和分割，建立所有权，跟踪版税和报表，与您的合作者共享单一事实来源，并为您的 PRO（表演权组织）导出注册就绪文件或完整的目录资产报告。每部精心编目的作品在公共目录中都具有同等的可发现性。

音乐目录管理、元数据、权利和版税——清晰、准确，属于您。

source_long:
Free AI astrology that runs the real math. Give your birth date, time and city, and Astrology Doctor Fortune finds your zodiac signs and draws a full birth chart — Sun, Moon and Rising, all ten planets, twelve houses and every major aspect — on an interactive chart wheel you can explore right inside the chat.

Three readings in one app. Natal chart: what your zodiac placements say about your personality, your strengths and your blind spots. Horoscope: today's, this week's or any date's planetary transits read against your own chart instead of a generic sun-sign column. Compatibility: two charts overlaid for a synastry reading with mutual aspects, a match score and house overlays.

Positions are computed on the server from VSOP87D and ELP-2000 ephemeris data — the same astronomy professional astrology software runs on — with time zone and longitude correction applied automatically. Birth cities work in any language or script: Seoul or 서울, Hanoi or Hà Nội, Munich or München. Readings and chart labels come in 12 languages, including English, Korean, Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Hindi, Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Arabic and Vietnamese. No account, no setup, and it still works when you don't know your birth time.
plugin_details.target_long:
免费的人工智能占星学可以进行真正的数学运算。给出您的出生日期、时间和城市，占星学财富博士会找到您的星座并绘制完整的出生图 - 太阳、月亮和上升，所有十颗行星，十二宫和每个主要相位 - 在交互式图表轮上，您可以在聊天中探索。

一个应用程序中的三个读数。本命盘：你的十二生肖位置反映了你的个性、优势和盲点。星座运势：今天、本周或任何日期的行星过境是根据您自己的星盘而不是通用的太阳星座栏来读取的。兼容性：两个图表重叠，用于相互方面、比赛得分和房屋叠加的联盘解读。

位置是在服务器上根据 VSOP87D 和 ELP-2000 星历数据（运行相同的天文学专业占星软件）计算出来的，并自动应用时区和经度校正。出生城市可以使用任何语言或文字：首尔或서울、河内或河内、慕尼黑或慕尼黑。读数和图表标签有 12 种语言版本，包括英语、韩语、繁体中文和简体中文、日语、印地语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语、德语、法语、阿拉伯语和越南语。无需帐户，无需设置，即使您不知道自己的出生时间，它仍然有效。

source_long:

Trusted by over 1 million monthly users, Saju DoctorFortune is the world's leading AI-powered Saju service. Every reading is grounded in authentic Myeongrihak (명리학) principles, delivering the same depth and accuracy you'd expect from a top-tier in-person consultation — but available anytime, right inside your conversation.

Whether you're curious about career timing, relationship compatibility, or what the year ahead holds, ask ChatGPT with Saju DoctorFortune and get clear, honest insights rooted in centuries of Korean fortune-telling tradition.

只需分享您的出生日期、时间和性别，即可立即收到经过专业分析的出生图 - 包括您的四大支柱 (사주팔자)、五行分布、主要财富周期 (대운) 和年度财富预测 (세운)，所有这些都以干净的交互式卡片的形式呈现。

Saju DoctorFortune 是全球领先的人工智能驱动的 Saju 服务，深受每月超过 100 万用户的信赖。每一篇阅读都基于真实的明里学 (명리학) 原则，提供与顶级面对面咨询相同的深度和准确性 - 但可以随时在您的对话中使用。

无论您是对职业时机、人际关系兼容性还是未来一年感到好奇，都可以向 Saju DoctorFortune 的 ChatGPT 询问，并获得植根于几个世纪的韩国算命传统的清晰、诚实的见解。

Positive cards are celebrated, while challenging cards are explained directly without sugarcoating. 티에이치스터디는 개인이 작성한 콘텐츠와 데이터를 검색하고 활용할 수 있는 MCP 기반 AI 서비스입니다.
사용자는 개발 문서, 여행 정보, 맛집 후기, 카페 기록, 일상 정보 등 다양한 콘텐츠를 자연어로 검색할 수 있습니다.
본 서비스는 분산된 개인 데이터를 하나의 플랫폼으로 통합하고 ChatGPT와 연동하여 보다 편리한 정보 검색 경험을 제공합니다.
향후에는 개인 데이터 기반 SaaS 및 사용자 맞춤형 AI 서비스 플랫폼으로 확장될 예정입니다.
plugin_details.target_long:
TH Study 是一项基于 MCP 的 AI 服务，可让您搜索和利用个人创建的内容和数据。
用户可以使用自然语言搜索各种内容，包括开发文档、旅游信息、餐厅评论、咖啡馆记录和日常生活信息。
该服务将分散的个人数据整合到一个平台，并通过与ChatGPT联动提供更便捷的信息搜索体验。
未来，我们计划扩展到基于个人数据的SaaS和用户定制的AI服务平台。

plugin_texts.source: Use the AI Passport connector as the user's portable, owner-controlled memory across their AI apps. Reach for it whenever the user wants to remember, save, note, or recall personal context (preferences, decisions, names, code words, projects, goals), or when live data from a source they have linked (calendar, email, fitness) would help, instead of relying on this app's built-in memory or claiming the data is unreachable.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 AI Passport 连接器作为用户在其 AI 应用程序中的便携式、所有者控制的内存。每当用户想要记住、保存、记下或回忆个人背景（偏好、决定、名称、代码词、项目、目标）时，或者当来自他们链接的源（日历、电子邮件、健身）的实时数据有帮助时，就可以使用它，而不是依赖此应用程序的内置内存或声称数据无法访问。

plugin_texts.source: AWS SDK for JavaScript v3 development patterns. Use when writing JavaScript or TypeScript code that uses AWS services via @aws-sdk/* packages (aws-sdk-js-v3), or when asked about schemas, runtime validation, serialization, or code generation in the context of the JS/TS AWS SDK.
plugin_texts.target: 适用于 JavaScript v3 开发模式的 AWS 开发工具包。在编写通过 @aws-sdk/* 包 (aws-sdk-js-v3) 使用 AWS 服务的 JavaScript 或 TypeScript 代码时，或者在 JS/TS AWS 开发工具包上下文中询问架构、运行时验证、序列化或代码生成时使用。

plugin_texts.source: AWS SDK for Python (boto3/botocore) development patterns. You MUST use this skill when writing Python code that uses AWS services via boto3 or botocore. This includes creating service clients or resources, configuring sessions and credentials, handling errors with ClientError, using paginators and waiters, S3 file transfers and presigned URLs, DynamoDB table operations, and any boto3/botocore client configuration. Use this skill whenever Python code imports boto3 or botocore, or when the user asks about AWS operations in Python.
plugin_texts.target: 适用于 Python (boto3/botocore) 开发模式的 AWS 开发工具包。在编写通过 boto3 或 botocore 使用 AWS 服务的 Python 代码时，必须使用此技能。这包括创建服务客户端或资源、配置会话和凭证、使用 ClientError 处理错误、使用分页器和等待程序、S3 文件传输和预签名 URL、DynamoDB 表操作以及任何 boto3/botocore 客户端配置。每当 Python 代码导入 boto3 或 botocore 时，或者当用户询问有关 Python 中的 AWS 操作时，请使用此技能。

plugin_texts.source: AWS SDK for Swift development patterns. Use when writing Swift code that uses AWS services via aws-sdk-swift package.
plugin_texts.target: 适用于 Swift 开发模式的 AWS 开发工具包。在编写通过 aws-sdk-swift 包使用 AWS 服务的 Swift 代码时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Author, validate, and troubleshoot AWS CloudFormation templates. Covers template authoring with secure defaults, pre-deployment validation (cfn-lint, cfn-guard, change sets), and root-cause diagnosis of failed stacks using CloudFormation events and CloudTrail correlation.
plugin_texts.target: 创作、验证 AWS CloudFormation 模板并对其进行故障排除。涵盖使用安全默认值进行模板创作、部署前验证（cfn-lint、cfn-guard、更改集）以及使用 CloudFormation 事件和 CloudTrail 关联对失败堆栈进行根本原因诊断。

plugin_texts.source: Authors, deploys, and troubleshoots AWS infrastructure using CDK with TypeScript or Python. Covers best practices, stack architecture, and construct patterns. Always use when writing CDK constructs, bootstrapping environments, running cdk deploy/synth/diff, fixing CDK or CloudFormation errors, planning stack structure, importing existing resources, resolving drift, or refactoring stacks without resource replacement.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 CDK 和 TypeScript 或 Python 编写、部署 AWS 基础设施并进行故障排除。涵盖最佳实践、堆栈架构和构造模式。在编写 CDK 构造、引导环境、运行 cdk deploy/synth/diff、修复 CDK 或 CloudFormation 错误、规划堆栈结构、导入现有资源、解决偏差或在不替换资源的情况下重构堆栈时始终使用。

plugin_texts.source: Builds generative AI applications on Amazon Bedrock. Covers model invocation (Converse API, InvokeModel), RAG with Knowledge Bases, Bedrock Agents, Guardrails, and AgentCore. Use when invoking models, setting up Knowledge Bases, creating agents, applying guardrails, deploying to AgentCore, troubleshooting Bedrock errors (ThrottlingException, AccessDeniedException), or choosing models (Claude, Llama, Nova, Titan). ALSO USE for prompt caching setup and debugging, quota health checks and throttling diagnosis, cost attribution and tracking, migrating between Claude model generations (4.5 to 4.6 to 4.7), chunking strategies, API selection (Converse vs InvokeModel), guardrail capabilities, and model selection. Also covers AgentCore Payments setup (x402, microtransactions, Payment Manager, Connector, Instrument, Coinbase CDP, Stripe Privy, 402 Payment Required, pay for content, paid endpoint, agent payments). NOT for custom model training, Rekognition, or Comprehend.
plugin_texts.target: 在 Amazon Bedrock 上构建生成式 AI 应用程序。涵盖模型调用（Converse API、InvokeModel）、带有知识库的 RAG、Bedrock Agents、Guardrails 和 AgentCore。在调用模型、设置知识库、创建代理、应用护栏、部署到 AgentCore、排除基岩错误（ThrotdlingException、AccessDeniedException）或选择模型（Claude、Llama、Nova、Titan）时使用。还可以用于提示缓存设置和调试、配额运行状况检查和节流诊断、成本归因和跟踪、Claude 模型生成（4.5 到 4.6 到 4.7）之间的迁移、分块策略、API 选择（Converse 与 InvokeModel）、护栏功能和模型选择。还涵盖 AgentCore 付款设置（x402、微交易、付款管理器、连接器、仪器、Coinbase CDP、Stripe Privy、402 付款要求、内容付款、付费端点、代理付款）。不适用于自定义模型训练、Rekognition 或 Comprehend。

plugin_texts.source: Builds, configures, debugs, and optimizes AWS observability with CloudWatch (Log Insights, Metrics, Alarms, Dashboards, EMF), X-Ray, CloudTrail, and ADOT (AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry), AND enables/onboards services to Application Signals using ADOT auto-instrumentation SDKs. Covers Log Insights queries, alarms (metric, composite, anomaly), dashboards, custom metrics/EMF, X-Ray tracing and sampling, ADOT collector config, CloudTrail auditing, and end-to-end Application Signals enablement via ADOT SDKs (CloudWatch Observability EKS add-on, CloudWatch Agent IAM, OTLP endpoints, ServiceEvents, Dynamic Instrumentation) on EC2, ECS, EKS, and Lambda in Python, Node.js, Java, and .NET. Applies to CloudWatch, alarms, dashboards, EMF, X-Ray, traces, CloudTrail, ADOT, monitoring, synthetics/canaries, OR enabling/onboarding/instrumenting a service for Application Signals using ADOT, ServiceEvents, auto-instrumentation, or making a service show up in Application Signals. Not for app logging or security threat detection.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 CloudWatch（日志洞察、指标、警报、仪表板、EMF）、X-Ray、CloudTrail 和 ADOT（AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry）构建、配置、调试和优化 AWS 可观测性，并使用 ADOT 自动检测 SDK 为应用程序信号启用/加载服务。涵盖 Log Insights 查询、警报（指标、复合、异常）、仪表板、自定义指标/EMF、X-Ray 跟踪和采样、ADOT 收集器配置、CloudTrail 审核以及通过 ADOT SDK（CloudWatch Observability EKS 附加组件、CloudWatch Agent IAM、OTLP 端点、ServiceEvents、动态检测）在 Python、Node.js 中的 EC2、ECS、EKS 和 Lambda 上启用端到端应用程序信号， Java 和 .NET。适用于 CloudWatch、警报、仪表板、EMF、X-Ray、跟踪、CloudTrail、ADOT、监控、合成/金丝雀，或使用 ADOT、ServiceEvents、自动检测为应用程序信号启用/加入/检测服务，或使服务显示在应用程序信号中。不适用于应用程序日志记录或安全威胁检测。

plugin_texts.source: Builds, deploys, manages, debugs, configures, and optimizes serverless applications on AWS using Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, and SAM/CDK. Covers cold starts, CORS debugging, event source mappings, troubleshooting, concurrency, SnapStart, Powertools, function URLs, EventBridge Scheduler, Lambda layers, and production readiness. Triggers on mentions of Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, SAM templates, CDK serverless stacks, DynamoDB stream triggers, SQS event sources, cold starts, timeouts, 502/504 errors, throttling, concurrency, CORS, Powertools, or any event-driven architecture on AWS, even without the word "serverless." Does not apply to EC2, ECS/Fargate containers, or Amplify hosting.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 Lambda、API Gateway、Step Functions、EventBridge 和 SAM/CDK 在 AWS 上构建、部署、管理、调试、配置和优化无服务器应用程序。涵盖冷启动、CORS 调试、事件源映射、故障排除、并发、SnapStart、Powertools、函数 URL、EventBridge Scheduler、Lambda 层和生产准备情况。在提及 Lambda、API 网关、Step Functions、SAM 模板、CDK 无服务器堆栈、DynamoDB 流触发器、SQS 事件源、冷启动、超时、502/504 错误、限制、并发、CORS、Powertools 或 AWS 上的任何事件驱动架构时触发，即使没有“无服务器”一词。不适用于 EC2、ECS/Fargate 容器或 Amplify 托管。

plugin_texts.source: Configures CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodeConnections, and CodeArtifact. Covers CodePipeline V2 (triggers, variables, execution modes, cross-account), buildspec.yml (caching, VPC, Docker), CodeDeploy strategies (blue/green, canary, linear), CodeArtifact (private package registries, auth tokens, cross-account), and source connections (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket). Applies when CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodeConnections, CodeArtifact, buildspec.yml, appspec.yml, or CI/CD pipeline orchestration is referenced. Does NOT cover: ECS Fargate services or task definitions (use aws-containers), CDK Pipelines or cdk deploy (use aws-cdk), sam deploy (use aws-serverless), Amplify deployments (use aws-amplify), or GitHub Actions/GitLab CI.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 AWS CodePipeline、CodeBuild、CodeDeploy、CodeConnections 和 CodeArtifact 配置 CI/CD 管道。涵盖 CodePipeline V2（触发器、变量、执行模式、跨账户）、buildspec.yml（缓存、VPC、Docker）、CodeDeploy 策略（蓝/绿、金丝雀、线性）、CodeArtifact（私有包注册表、身份验证令牌、跨账户）和源连接（GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket）。当引用 CodePipeline、CodeBuild、CodeDeploy、CodeConnections、CodeArtifact、buildspec.yml、appspec.yml 或 CI/CD 管道编排时适用。不涵盖：ECS Fargate 服务或任务定义（使用 aws-containers）、CDK Pipelines 或 cdk 部署（使用 aws-cdk）、sam 部署（使用 aws-serverless）、Amplify 部署（使用 aws-amplify）或 GitHub Actions/GitLab CI。

plugin_texts.source: Deploys and operates containerized workloads on ECS, Fargate, and ECR. Covers task definitions, Fargate services, ECR repository setup and lifecycle policies, ECS Exec debugging, service scaling, deployment strategies, load balancer integration, and logging configuration. Use when deploying, debugging, or optimizing containers on AWS. ALSO USE for container deployment options (ECS vs ECS Express Mode), networking modes, health check troubleshooting, OOM errors, secrets injection, blue/green deployments, ECR image management, and App Runner sunset guidance and migration. NOT for Kubernetes, EKS, or CI/CD pipelines.
plugin_texts.target: 在 ECS、Fargate 和 ECR 上部署和运行容器化工作负载。涵盖任务定义、Fargate 服务、ECR 存储库设置和生命周期策略、ECS Exec 调试、服务扩展、部署策略、负载均衡器集成和日志记录配置。在 AWS 上部署、调试或优化容器时使用。还可用于容器部署选项（ECS 与 ECS Express 模式）、网络模式、运行状况检查故障排除、OOM 错误、机密注入、蓝/绿部署、ECR 映像管理以及 App Runner 日落指导和迁移。不适用于 Kubernetes、EKS 或 CI/CD 管道。

plugin_texts.source: Gets AWS credentials for CLI/SDK access via `aws login`. Activates when a developer needs to authenticate to AWS for local development, when an AWS operation fails due to missing or expired credentials, or when someone asks about setting up AWS access. Triggers: "set up AWS", "configure AWS", "aws login", "get credentials", "authenticate", "session expired", "token expired", "no credentials", "AccessDeniedException" with no configured credentials.
plugin_texts.target: 通过“aws login”获取 CLI/SDK 访问的 AWS 凭证。当开发人员需要向 AWS 进行身份验证以进行本地开发时、当 AWS 操作由于凭证丢失或过期而失败时，或者当有人询问如何设置 AWS 访问权限时，激活。触发器：“设置 AWS”、“配置 AWS”、“aws 登录”、“获取凭证”、“身份验证”、“会话已过期”、“令牌已过期”、“无凭证”、“AccessDeniedException”（未配置凭证）。

plugin_texts.source: Guides building full-stack applications with AWS Blocks — an Infrastructure-from-Code framework. Applies when creating APIs, selecting Building Blocks (KVStore, DistributedTable, Database, AuthBasic, AuthCognito, Realtime, AsyncJob, FileBucket, etc.), running local development, or deploying AWS Blocks applications. Also covers AWS Blocks topics with validated, version-specific patterns that prevent common mistakes. Triggers when user mentions AWS Blocks; project has aws-blocks/ directory; code imports @aws-blocks packages.
plugin_texts.target: 指南使用 AWS Blocks（一种基于代码的基础设施框架）构建全栈应用程序。在创建 API、选择构建块（KVStore、DistributedTable、数据库、AuthBasic、AuthCognito、Realtime、AsyncJob、FileBucket 等）、运行本地开发或部署 AWS Blocks 应用程序时适用。还涵盖 AWS Blocks 主题以及经过验证的特定于版本的模式，以防止常见错误。当用户提及 AWS Blocks 时触发；项目有 aws-blocks/ 目录；代码导入 @aws-blocks 包。

plugin_texts.source: Guides use of AWS messaging and streaming services. Covers Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon MQ, Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, Amazon Data Firehose, Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink, and Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (MSK). Use when implementing messaging and streaming patterns.
plugin_texts.target: 指导使用 AWS 消息传递和流媒体服务。涵盖 Amazon SQS、Amazon SNS、Amazon EventBridge、Amazon MQ、Amazon Kinesis Data Streams、Amazon Data Firehose、Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink 和 Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (MSK)。在实现消息传递和流模式时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Routes any task involving AWS databases — choosing, comparing, recommending, getting started with, or operating a database — to the correct service-specific skill. Supersedes general training-data knowledge with post-training service updates, corrected limitations, and decision procedures for relational (Aurora, DSQL, RDS), key-value (DynamoDB), wide-column (Keyspaces), document (DocumentDB), graph (Neptune), time-series (Timestream), and in-memory/caching (ElastiCache, MemoryDB) workloads. Activates when a user describes building an application on AWS that will store, retrieve, or manage data, even if they do not mention 'database' explicitly.
plugin_texts.target: 将涉及 AWS 数据库的任何任务（选择、比较、推荐、入门或操作数据库）路由到正确的特定于服务的技能。通过培训后服务更新、更正的限制以及关系（Aurora、DSQL、RDS）、键值（DynamoDB）、宽列（Keyspaces）、文档（DocumentDB）、图形（Neptune）、时间序列（Timestream）和内存/缓存（ElastiCache、MemoryDB）工作负载的决策过程取代一般培训数据知识。当用户描述在 AWS 上构建将存储、检索或管理数据的应用程序时激活，即使他们没有明确提及“数据库”。

plugin_texts.source: Secret safety for AWS Secrets Manager, secret management, credentials, API keys, tokens, and passwords. Prevents AI agents from directly fetching secret values and teaches runtime dynamic references with asm-exec so plaintext never enters the LLM context window.
plugin_texts.target: AWS Secrets Manager、秘密管理、凭证、API 密钥、令牌和密码的秘密安全。防止 AI 代理直接获取秘密值，并使用 asm-exec 教授运行时动态引用，因此明文永远不会进入 LLM 上下文窗口。

plugin_texts.source: Verified corrections for IAM behaviors that AI agents frequently get wrong — policy evaluation edge cases, trust policy gotchas, STS session limits, Organizations quirks, and SAML/MFA specifics. Also provides structured workflows for IAM role management and least-privilege policy generation. Covers condition operator safety (ForAnyValue/ForAllValues with Null checks for absent keys), bucket policy deny patterns (VPC endpoint restrictions, org path conditions), resource-based policy confused deputy protection, and service role creation for AWS services (Glue, CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, Firehose, DataSync, S3 replication, Lambda, Step Functions, ECS, etc.) including trust policies with aws:SourceAccount/aws:SourceArn conditions. Applies when creating or configuring IAM roles, writing IAM or bucket policies, working with STS, Organizations, condition operators, or any task requiring an IAM service role or execution role. Does not cover non-IAM authorization like Cognito user-pool policies or app-level RBAC.
plugin_texts.target: 已验证对 AI 代理经常出错的 IAM 行为的更正 - 策略评估边缘情况、信任策略陷阱、STS 会话限制、组织怪癖和 SAML/MFA 细节。还提供用于 IAM 角色管理和最小权限策略生成的结构化工作流程。涵盖条件运算符安全性（ForAnyValue/ForAllValues，使用 Null 检查缺失的键）、存储桶策略拒绝模式（VPC 终端节点限制、组织路径条件）、基于资源的策略混淆代理保护以及 AWS 服务的服务角色创建（Glue、CloudTrail、VPC 流日志、Firehose、DataSync、S3 复制、Lambda、Step Functions、ECS 等），包括具有 aws:SourceAccount/aws:SourceArn 条件的信任策略。适用于创建或配置 IAM 角色、编写 IAM 或存储桶策略、使用 STS、组织、条件运算符或任何需要 IAM 服务角色或执行角色的任务。不涵盖非 IAM 授权，例如 Cognito 用户池策略或应用程序级 RBAC。

plugin_texts.source: Amazon Redshift is NOT PostgreSQL — corrects PostgreSQL-derived LLM mistakes; covers Redshift-specific SQL, DDL, COPY/UNLOAD, system views, metadata discovery, and operational patterns. Applies ONLY when the task is about Redshift itself (cluster, Serverless workgroup, or Redshift SQL). Pushes back on: CREATE INDEX, string_agg, pg_catalog, text type, SERIAL, stl_query, LATERAL, RETURNING. Triggers on: Redshift SQL, Redshift CREATE TABLE, Redshift COPY/UNLOAD, slow Redshift query, Redshift permission denied, Redshift disk full, Redshift system views, QUALIFY, PIVOT, MERGE, Redshift Data API, Redshift WLM, concurrency scaling, Redshift resize, Redshift Spectrum external tables. Does NOT apply to (defer to that service's own skill): Amazon S3 storage/bucket policies, Athena or Glue queries/catalogs, data-lake or Iceberg work outside Redshift, Aurora, RDS, or DynamoDB — but S3/Glue ARE in scope for Redshift COPY, UNLOAD, or data-lake queries (external schemas/tables on S3).
plugin_texts.target: Amazon Redshift 不是 PostgreSQL — 纠正了 PostgreSQL 派生的 LLM 错误；涵盖 Redshift 特定的 SQL、DDL、COPY/UNLOAD、系统视图、元数据发现和操作模式。仅当任务涉及 Redshift 本身（集群、无服务器工作组或 Redshift SQL）时适用。推回：CREATE INDEX、string_agg、pg_catalog、文本类型、SERIAL、stl_query、LATERAL、RETURNING。触发条件：Redshift SQL、Redshift CREATE TABLE、Redshift COPY/UNLOAD、Redshift 查询速度慢、Redshift 权限被拒绝、Redshift 磁盘已满、Redshift 系统视图、QUALIFY、PIVOT、MERGE、Redshift 数据 API、Redshift WLM、并发扩展、Redshift 调整大小、Redshift Spectrum 外部表。不适用于（取决于该服务自身的技能）：Amazon S3 存储/存储桶策略、Athena 或 Glue 查询/目录、数据湖或 Iceberg 在 Redshift、Aurora、RDS 或 DynamoDB 之外工作 — 但 S3/Glue 属于 Redshift COPY、UNLO​​AD 或数据湖查询（S3 上的外部架构/表）的范围。

plugin_texts.source: Create and troubleshoot AWS Glue connections to JDBC databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, RDS), Redshift, Snowflake, and BigQuery. Gathers connection hints from user, discovers existing connections and RDS/Redshift candidates, registers credentials in Secrets Manager or IAM DB auth, configures VPC, and tests. Triggers on: connect to database, set up Glue connection, register data source, connect to Snowflake/BigQuery/RDS, connection timeout, test connection, troubleshoot connection. Do NOT use for moving data (use ingesting-into-data-lake), creating tables (use creating-data-lake-table), queries (use querying-data-lake), catalog exploration (use exploring-data-catalog), or SaaS (Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, MongoDB, Kafka).
plugin_texts.target: 创建与 JDBC 数据库（Oracle、SQL Server、PostgreSQL、MySQL、RDS）、Redshift、Snowflake 和 BigQuery 的 AWS Glue 连接并排查问题。收集用户的连接提示，发现现有连接和 RDS/Redshift 候选连接，在 Secrets Manager 或 IAM DB 身份验证中注册凭证，配置 VPC 并进行测试。触发条件：连接到数据库、设置 Glue 连接、注册数据源、连接到 Snowflake/BigQuery/RDS、连接超时、测试连接、排除连接故障。请勿用于移动数据（使用 ingesting-into-data-lake）、创建表（使用创建数据湖表）、查询（使用查询数据湖）、目录探索（使用探索数据目录）或 SaaS（Salesforce、ServiceNow、SAP、MongoDB、Kafka）。

plugin_texts.source: Create managed Iceberg tables using Amazon S3 Tables (s3tables API namespace) with automatic compaction and snapshot management. Sets up table bucket, namespace, table, schema, Glue catalog registration, partitioning, IAM access control. Triggers on: create table, data lake table, analytics table, structured data storage, S3 Tables, Iceberg, Athena table, partitioning strategy, access permissions. Do NOT use  for: importing files (use ingesting-into-data-lake), vector storage (use storing-and-querying-vectors), querying existing tables (use querying-data-lake), or locating existing table (use finding-data-lake-assets).
plugin_texts.target: 使用 Amazon S3 表（s3tables API 命名空间）创建托管 Iceberg 表，并进行自动压缩和快照管理。设置表存储桶、命名空间、表、模式、Glue 目录注册、分区、IAM 访问控制。触发条件：创建表、数据湖表、分析表、结构化数据存储、S3 表、Iceberg、Athena 表、分区策略、访问权限。请勿用于：导入文件（使用 ingesting-into-data-lake）、矢量存储（使用 storage-and-querying-vectors）、查询现有表（使用 querying-data-lake）或定位现有表（使用finding-data-lake-assets）。

plugin_texts.source: Execute and manage Athena SQL queries across default and federated catalogs (Glue, S3 Tables, Redshift). Triggers on phrases like: query data, run SQL, athena query, analyze table, SQL query, workgroup status, profile table, query Redshift catalog, query S3 Tables. Do NOT use for finding specific data assets (use finding-data-lake-assets), full catalog audits (use exploring-data-catalog), importing data (use ingesting-into-data-lake).
plugin_texts.target: 跨默认目录和联合目录（Glue、S3 表、Redshift）执行和管理 Athena SQL 查询。在以下短语上触发：查询数据、运行 SQL、athena 查询、分析表、SQL 查询、工作组状态、配置文件表、查询 Redshift 目录、查询 S3 表。请勿用于查找特定数据资产（使用finding-data-lake-assets）、完整目录审核（使用exploring-data-catalog）、导入数据（使用ingesting-into-data-lake）。

plugin_texts.source: Full inventory and audit of AWS Glue Data Catalog assets across S3 Tables, Redshift-federated, and remote Iceberg catalogs. Triggers on: inventory the catalog, audit databases, list all tables, catalog overview, data landscape, enumerate catalogs, data inventory, search the catalog. Do NOT use for finding specific data (use finding-data-lake-assets), running queries (use querying-data-lake), or creating tables (use creating-data-lake-table).
plugin_texts.target: 对 S3 表、Redshift 联合和远程 Iceberg 目录中的 AWS Glue 数据目录资产进行全面盘点和审计。触发器：清点目录、审计数据库、列出所有表、目录概述、数据景观、枚举目录、数据清单、搜索目录。请勿用于查找特定数据（使用finding-data-lake-assets）、运行查询（使用querying-data-lake）或创建表（使用create-data-lake-table）。

plugin_texts.source: Guides migration, provisioning, search, log-analytics, trace-analytics, and Agentic AI Assistant workflows for Amazon OpenSearch Service and Serverless across six capabilities — migration (Solr/ES/self-managed into AOS/AOSS, schema/query translation, sizing, cutover); provisioning (domain + AOSS lifecycle, upgrades, FGAC, monitoring); search (vector / semantic / hybrid / RAG with Bedrock); log-analytics (PPL, OSI, anomaly detection, Dashboards); trace-analytics (OTel spans, service maps, Data Prepper); ai-assistant (natural language data exploration, incident investigation, root cause analysis). Triggers on OpenSearch, AOS, AOSS, Elasticsearch, Solr, vector/k-NN/semantic/hybrid search, RAG, log analytics, PPL, trace analytics, ISM, FAISS, HNSW, Migration Assistant, UltraWarm, OR1, query my data, analyze logs, investigate errors, root cause analysis.
plugin_texts.target: 跨六种功能指导 Amazon OpenSearch Service 和 Serverless 的迁移、配置、搜索、日志分析、跟踪分析和 Agentic AI Assistant 工作流程 — 迁移（Solr/ES/自行管理到 AOS/AOSS、架构/查询转换、规模调整、切换）；配置（域+AOSS生命周期、升级、FGAC、监控）；搜索（矢量/语义/混合/RAG 与 Bedrock）；日志分析（PPL、OSI、异常检测、仪表板）；跟踪分析（OTel 范围、服务地图、数据准备器）；人工智能助手（自然语言数据探索、事件调查、根本原因分析）。在 OpenSearch、AOS、AOSS、Elasticsearch、Solr、向量/k-NN/语义/混合搜索、RAG、日志分析、PPL、跟踪分析、ISM、FAISS、HNSW、迁移助手、UltraWarm、OR1 上触发，查询我的数据、分析日志、调查错误、根本原因分析。

plugin_texts.source: Import data into the AWS data lake from S3 files, local uploads, JDBC databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, RDS, Aurora), Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, DynamoDB, or existing Glue catalog tables (migration). Default target is S3 Tables; standard Iceberg on a general purpose bucket is supported where S3 Tables is not adopted. Handles one-time loads, recurring pipelines, migrations. Triggers on: import data, load data, ingest, sync database, migrate table, move data to AWS, set up pipeline, ETL, pull from Snowflake, query BigQuery into S3, export DynamoDB, CTAS, convert to Iceberg. Do NOT use for setting up or troubleshooting Glue connections (use connecting-to-data-source), creating empty tables (use creating-data-lake-table), running queries (use querying-data-lake), finding tables by fuzzy name (use finding-data-lake-assets), catalog audit (use exploring-data-catalog), or SaaS platforms like Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, MongoDB, Kafka.
plugin_texts.target: 将数据从 S3 文件、本地上传、JDBC 数据库（Oracle、SQL Server、PostgreSQL、MySQL、RDS、Aurora）、Amazon Redshift、Snowflake、BigQuery、DynamoDB 或现有 Glue 目录表导入到 AWS 数据湖（迁移）。默认目标是S3表；在不采用 S3 表的情况下，支持通用存储桶上的标准 Iceberg。处理一次性加载、重复管道、迁移。触发条件：导入数据、加载数据、摄取、同步数据库、迁移表、将数据移动到 AWS、设置管道、ETL、从 Snowflake 中提取、将 BigQuery 查询到 S3、导出 DynamoDB、CTAS、转换到 Iceberg。请勿用于设置 Glue 连接或对其进行故障排除（使用连接到数据源）、创建空表（使用创建数据湖表）、运行查询（使用查询数据湖）、按模糊名称查找表（使用查找数据湖资产）、目录审核（使用探索数据目录）或 SaaS 平台（例如 Salesforce、ServiceNow、SAP、MongoDB、Kafka）。

plugin_texts.source: Resolve data lake and lakehouse asset references across Glue Data Catalog, S3, S3 Tables, and Redshift. Triggers on: find the table, where is our data, which table has, locate dataset, find data for, search catalog, what tables match, Redshift table, lakehouse table, data lake table, warehouse table, reverse lookup S3 path. Do NOT use for: full catalog audits (use exploring-data-catalog), running queries (use querying-data-lake), creating tables (use creating-data-lake-table).
plugin_texts.target: 解决 Glue 数据目录、S3、S3 表和 Redshift 之间的数据湖和 Lakehouse 资产引用。触发条件：查找表、我们的数据在哪里、哪个表有、定位数据集、查找数据、搜索目录、匹配哪些表、Redshift 表、lakehouse 表、数据湖表、仓库表、反向查找 S3 路径。请勿用于：完整目录审核（使用探索数据目录）、运行查询（使用查询数据湖）、创建表（使用创建数据湖表）。

plugin_texts.source: Store and query vector embeddings using Amazon S3 Vectors, a cost-effective long-term vector storage service with its own API namespace (s3vectors). Triggers on: create S3 vector bucket, vector index, store embeddings, semantic search, RAG vector storage, similarity search, vector database, migrate from other vector databases. Do NOT use for: querying tabular data (use querying-data-lake), S3 object storage, or hundreds/thousands of sustained QPS (use OpenSearch).
plugin_texts.target: 使用 Amazon S3 Vectors 存储和查询向量嵌入，这是一种具有成本效益的长期向量存储服务，具有自己的 API 命名空间 (s3vectors)。触发条件：创建 S3 向量存储桶、向量索引、存储嵌入、语义搜索、RAG 向量存储、相似性搜索、向量数据库、从其他向量数据库迁移。请勿用于：查询表格数据（使用 querying-data-lake）、S3 对象存储或数百/数千的持续 QPS（使用 OpenSearch）。

plugin_texts.source: Use before researching anything where knowing the current state of the world would be helpful, where being out of date would cause errors. Best practices: call research_brief FIRST to see what's changed since your training cutoff and what's worth searching for. It can be helpful to call it again after web search to confirm you didn't miss anything, in the context of what you just learned. Not helpful for timeless facts (e.g. the speed of light), math/reasoning, or creative writing.
plugin_texts.target: 在研究任何事物之前使用，了解世界的当前状态会有所帮助，而过时会导致错误。最佳实践：首先致电 Research_brief，了解自培训截止以来发生了哪些变化以及哪些内容值得搜索。在网络搜索后再次调用它会很有帮助，以确认您没有错过任何内容（根据您刚刚学到的内容）。对于永恒的事实（例如光速）、数学/推理或创意写作没有帮助。

plugin_texts.source: Diagnose stalled, blocked, overloaded, or unhealthy Agiflow projects and recommend specific corrective actions. Use for project health checks, blocked work, conflicting priorities, obsolete tasks, overloaded assignees, or an unmanageable backlog.
plugin_texts.target: 诊断停滞、受阻、超载或不健康的 Agiflow 项目，并建议具体的纠正措施。用于项目健康检查、工作受阻、优先级冲突、任务过时、受让人超负荷或无法管理的积压。

plugin_texts.source: Produce a concise read-only Agiflow status summary covering completed work, work in progress, blockers, and recommended next priorities. Use for daily standups, morning checks, stakeholder updates, or a quick project pulse.
plugin_texts.target: 生成简明的只读 Agiflow 状态摘要，涵盖已完成的工作、正在进行的工作、阻碍因素以及建议的下一步优先事项。用于每日站立会议、晨间检查、利益相关者更新或快速项目脉搏。

plugin_texts.source: Refine an existing Agiflow task into an unambiguous, testable specification without expanding its intended outcome. Use when a task is vague, lacks acceptance criteria, has unclear scope or dependencies, or is not ready for backlog grooming.
plugin_texts.target: 将现有 Agiflow 任务细化为明确的、可测试的规范，而无需扩展其预期结果。当任务含糊、缺乏验收标准、范围或依赖性不明确或尚未准备好进行待办事项整理时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Review Agiflow Planning tasks for readiness, prioritize approved work, group related tasks into work units, and promote ready tasks to Todo. Use when grooming a backlog, organizing planned tasks, creating work units, or deciding what should be executed next.
plugin_texts.target: 审查 Agiflow Planning 任务的准备情况，确定已批准工作的优先级，将相关任务分组到工作单元，并将准备好的任务提升到 Todo。在整理待办事项、组织计划任务、创建工作单元或决定下一步应该执行什么时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Turn a product goal or feature request into a clear Agiflow project plan with small, testable tasks in Planning status. Use when starting a project, decomposing a feature, clarifying requirements, or converting an idea into an actionable backlog.
plugin_texts.target: 将产品目标或功能请求转化为清晰的 Agiflow 项目计划，其中包含处于计划状态的小型可测试任务。在启动项目、分解功能、澄清需求或将想法转换为可操作的积压工作时使用。

plugin_texts.source:
**Required for Beam pipeline tools: create_beam_config, deploy_beam_pipeline, etc.**
**Beam** is Allium's custom real-time data pipeline product, built on top of
[Allium Datastreams](https://app.allium.so/build/datastreams). It lets you tap into
any of Allium's real-time blockchain data streams — covering 80+ chains — and apply
your own filters and JavaScript transformations before delivering the results to
Kafka, SNS, or other destinations.

Common use cases: real-time alerts on contract events, custom data feeds filtered
to specific wallets or protocols, and streaming enriched data to your own pipeline.

Browse available data streams at [app.allium.so/build/datastreams](https://app.allium.so/build/datastreams).
To get access or learn more, reach out to support@allium.so.

Read this skill for detailed configuration guides and examples.
plugin_texts.target:
**Beam 管道工具所需：create_beam_config、deploy_beam_pipeline 等**
**Beam** 是 Allium 的定制实时数据管道产品，构建于
[Allium Datastreams](https://app.allium.so/build/datastreams)。它可以让你进入
Allium 的任何实时区块链数据流（覆盖 80 多个链）并应用
您自己的过滤器和 JavaScript 转换，然后将结果传递给
Kafka、SNS 或其他目的地。

常见用例：合同事件实时警报、自定义数据源过滤
到特定的钱包或协议，并将丰富的数据流式传输到您自己的管道。

在 [app.allium.so/build/datastreams](https://app.allium.so/build/datastreams) 浏览可用的数据流。
如需访问或了解更多信息，请联系 support@allium.so。

阅读此技能以获取详细的配置指南和示例。

plugin_texts.source:
**Required reading before writing or running any SQL.** Patterns for Snowflake
query performance and chain-specific pitfalls.

Covers: default time ranges, partition-pruning rules, CTE filtering, `QUALIFY`
for dedup, `UNION ALL` over `UNION`, `APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT` for exploration,
pre-aggregated `*.metrics.*` tables vs raw aggregation, EVM address lowercasing
(and when not to), per-chain vs `crosschain.*` tables, verifying guessed
categorical filter values with `SELECT DISTINCT`, and Solana voting/non-voting
optimized views.

Call `get_skill(name="sql-optimization")` before writing SQL —
especially for large tables, long time ranges, or crosschain queries.
plugin_texts.target:
**编写或运行任何 SQL 之前需要阅读。** Snowflake 模式
查询性能和链特定的陷阱。

涵盖：默认时间范围、分区修剪规则、CTE 过滤、“QUALIFY”
对于重复数据删除，“UNION ALL”优于“UNION”，“APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT”用于探索，
预聚合“*.metrics.*”表与原始聚合，EVM 地址小写
（以及何时不这样做），每个链与“crosschain.*”表，验证猜测
使用“SELECT DISTINCT”和 Solana 投票/不投票的分类过滤器值
优化的视图。

在编写 SQL 之前调用 `get_skill(name="sql-optimization")` —
特别是对于大表、长时间范围或跨链查询。

plugin_texts.source:
Guide to Allium's four core products: Explorer, Realtime APIs, Datastreams,
and Datashares. Explains what each product does, who it's for, and how to
choose the right one for a customer's use case.

Read this skill when a customer asks about Allium's products, wants to
understand the difference between them, needs help choosing a product, or
asks questions like "which product should I use?" or "what does Allium offer?"
It also carries the canonical, dated list of supported blockchains — read it
for any "what chains / how many chains does Allium support?" question and cite
that list instead of answering from memory.
plugin_texts.target:
Allium 四大核心产品指南：Explorer、Realtime API、Datastreams、
和数据共享。解释每种产品的用途、适用人群以及如何使用
为客户的使用案例选择合适的产品。

当客户询问 Allium 的产品、想要
了解它们之间的区别，需要帮助选择产品，或者
提出诸如“我应该使用哪种产品？”之类的问题。或“Allium 提供什么？”
它还带有受支持的区块链的规范的、过时的列表 - 阅读它
对于任何“Allium 支持哪些链/多少条链？”提问并引用
该列表而不是凭记忆回答。

plugin_texts.target: 当 Noodle Seed MCP 产品创意在实施之前需要对话契合度、用户利益、范围、交互或证据设计时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Use when a Noodle Seed bug, misleading instruction, missing capability, or concrete product improvement should be proposed to the user.
plugin_texts.target: 当应该向用户建议 Noodle Seed 错误、误导性说明、缺失功能或具体产品改进时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Use when all four API-evidence inputs exist—and only then: API base URL, authentication scheme, representative safe read, and observed response.
plugin_texts.target: 当所有四个 API 证据输入都存在时使用，并且只有在那时：API 基本 URL、身份验证方案、代表性安全读取和观察到的响应。

plugin_texts.source: Use when an existing Noodle Seed MCP project has a concrete validation, runtime, connector, App, host, deployment, or production failure.
plugin_texts.target: 当现有 Noodle Seed MCP 项目出现具体验证、运行时、连接器、应用程序、主机、部署或生产故障时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Use when an existing application has no stable usable API and needs a read-only, identity-first Noodle Seed integration plan before implementation.
plugin_texts.target: 当现有应用程序没有稳定可用的 API 并且在实施之前需要只读、身份优先的 Noodle Seed 集成计划时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Use when creating or extending a headless Noodle Seed MCP server, tool, resource, prompt, or typed model-facing capability.
plugin_texts.target: 在创建或扩展无头 Noodle Seed MCP 服务器、工具、资源、提示或面向类型模型的功能时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Use when embedding a Noodle assistant into an existing SaaS or web application with browser, identity, session, and credential boundaries.
plugin_texts.target: 将 Noodle 助手嵌入到具有浏览器、身份、会话和凭证边界的现有 SaaS 或 Web 应用程序时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Use when preparing, reviewing, or submitting a Noodle Seed MCP integration to a host or app directory.
plugin_texts.target: 在准备、审查 Noodle Seed MCP 集成或将其提交到主机或应用程序目录时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Use when proving a Noodle Seed MCP project works at a named compile, local, connector, App, host, deployment, or production evidence level.
plugin_texts.target: 当证明 Noodle Seed MCP 项目在指定编译、本地、连接器、应用程序、主机、部署或生产证据级别正常工作时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Use when the user asks to execute an approved, decision-complete implementation plan for a Noodle Seed project task by task with test-first changes, review, recovery, and final verification.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户要求逐项执行 Noodle Seed 项目已批准的、决策完整的实施计划时使用，其中包括测试优先的更改、审查、恢复和最终验证。

plugin_texts.target: 当用户明确请求 Noodle Seed 托管链接、配置写入、部署、访问更改、回滚或连接写入时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Develop a Base44 app remotely from your own coding agent (Claude Code, claude.ai, or any MCP client) by connecting it to the Base44 sandbox. Cloud agents connect over MCP; local agents can connect over MCP or drive the same sandbox with the `base44 sandbox` CLI subcommands (the CLI uses shorter names — e.g. read_file is `sandbox read`, list_directory is `sandbox ls`, run_command is `sandbox run`). Covers connecting/ authenticating, the available sandbox tools (run_command, read_file, write_file, edit_file, grep, list_directory, create_checkpoint, get_app_preview_url, get_app_status, list_user_apps, and the connector tools list_connectors / initiate_connector_connection), the edit→preview→verify loop, how changes persist, builder/external-agent concurrency, the in-editor "Send to Coding Agent" button + onboarding README URLs, and tips like reading the Vite dev-server logs. Triggers on "develop my Base44 app remotely", "connect Claude Code to Base44", "bring my own agent", "edit a Base44 app over MCP", "Base44 sandbox MCP", or "Send to Coding Agent".
plugin_texts.target: 通过将 Base44 应用程序连接到 Base44 沙箱，从您自己的编码代理（Claude Code、claude.ai 或任何 MCP 客户端）远程开发 Base44 应用程序。云代理通过 MCP 连接；本地代理可以通过 MCP 连接或使用“base44 sandbox”CLI 子命令驱动相同的沙箱（CLI 使用较短的名称 - 例如，read_file 是“sandbox read”，list_directory 是“sandbox ls”，run_command 是“sandbox run”）。涵盖连接/身份验证、可用的沙箱工具（run_command、read_file、write_file、edit_file、grep、list_directory、create_checkpoint、get_app_preview_url、get_app_status、list_user_apps 和连接器工具 list_connectors/initiate_connector_connection）、编辑→预览→验证循环、更改如何持久、构建器/外部代理并发、编辑器内“发送”到 Coding Agent”按钮 + 加入 README URL，以及阅读 Vite 开发服务器日志等提示。在“远程开发我的 Base44 应用程序”、“将 Claude Code 连接到 Base44”、“自带代理”、“通过 MCP 编辑 Base44 应用程序”、“Base44 沙箱 MCP”或“发送到编码代理”时触发。

plugin_texts.source: Develop a Base44 app remotely inside Base44's cloud sandbox using your own agent — no local checkout and no deploy/push commands. The implementation is remote: writing a resource file into the sandbox is what ships it (backend functions, entities, and agents all auto-sync from the file you write), and OAuth connectors are set up against the remote app via MCP tools or the projectless `base44 connectors` CLI. This skill is the place for learning what you can author in the sandbox, how backend functions, entities, and agents are structured, and how to connect a connector without a local filesystem. Triggers on 'develop my Base44 app remotely', 'no local files', 'cloud sandbox', 'create an entity/agent remotely', 'connect a connector remotely', 'bring my own agent', or any work editing a Base44 app inside a sandbox.
plugin_texts.target: 使用您自己的代理在 Base44 的云沙箱内远程开发 Base44 应用程序 — 无需本地结账，也无需部署/推送命令。实现是远程的：将资源文件写入沙箱就是它的运送（后端函数、实体和代理都从您编写的文件自动同步），并且 OAuth 连接器是通过 MCP 工具或无项目“base44 连接器” CLI 针对远程应用程序设置的。通过此技能，您可以学习可以在沙箱中创作什么，后端函数、实体和代理的结构如何，以及如何在没有本地文件系统的情况下连接连接器。触发“远程开发我的 Base44 应用程序”、“无本地文件”、“云沙箱”、“远程创建实体/代理”、“远程连接连接器”、“自带代理”或在沙箱内编辑 Base44 应用程序的任何工作。

plugin_texts.source: Audit an existing BrightSite site for visual-editor editability — walk every page, component, and layout and flag what a non-technical user cannot edit (no data-bs-edit markers, components with empty props_schema, bare loops for repeating content, hardcoded internal links), then optionally fix it. Use when the user says "check what's editable," "the client can't edit X in the editor," "why can't I edit this," "audit the site for the visual editor," "make the existing site editable," "fix editability," or wants a pre-handoff QA pass on whether the site is editable. For authoring new content correctly the first time, use the visual-editor-authoring skill instead.
plugin_texts.target: 审核现有 BrightSite 站点的可视化编辑器可编辑性 — 遍历每个页面、组件和布局，并标记非技术用户无法编辑的内容（无数据 bs 编辑标记、具有空 props_schema 的组件、用于重复内容的裸循环、硬编码的内部链接），然后有选择地修复它。当用户说“检查可编辑内容”、“客户端无法在编辑器中编辑 X”、“为什么我不能编辑此内容”、“使用可视化编辑器审核站点”、“使现有站点可编辑”、“修复可编辑性”或希望对站点是否可编辑进行预移交 QA 时使用。为了第一次正确地创作新内容，请使用可视化编辑器创作技巧。

plugin_texts.source: Audit every page and post on a BrightSite site for on-page SEO issues. Checks title length, meta description length and presence, H1 presence and uniqueness, canonical URLs, og:image, robots directives, and slug quality. Outputs a prioritized fix list grouped by severity. Use when the user mentions "SEO audit," "on-page SEO," "check my pages for SEO," "find SEO issues," "before launch SEO check," or wants a pre-handoff QA pass on a client site.
plugin_texts.target: 审核 BrightSite 网站上的每个页面和帖子是否存在页面 SEO 问题。检查标题长度、元描述长度和存在、H1 存在和唯一性、规范 URL、og:image、机器人指令和 slug 质量。输出按严重性分组的优先修复列表。当用户提及“SEO 审核”、“页面 SEO”、“检查我的页面是否有 SEO”、“查找 SEO 问题”、“启动 SEO 检查之前”或希望在客户端站点上获得预移交 QA 通行证时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Author BrightSite pages, components, and layouts whose content is editable in the visual editor — so a non-technical user can click and change text, images, links, and component props without a second pass. Use when creating or editing a page/component/layout via the BrightSite MCP (create_page, update_page, create_component, create_layout), when building a site or template, or when the user says "make this editable," "the client should be able to edit this," "build the site so they can change it themselves," or "use the visual editor / components properly." Load this BEFORE writing HEEx, not after.
plugin_texts.target: 创作 BrightSite 页面、组件和布局，其内容可在可视化编辑器中编辑 - 因此非技术用户可以单击并更改文本、图像、链接和组件道具，而无需第二遍。通过 BrightSite MCP（create_page、update_page、create_component、create_layout）创建或编辑页面/组件/布局时、构建站点或模板时，或者当用户说“使其可编辑”、“客户端应该能够编辑此内容”、“构建站点以便他们可以自行更改它”或“正确使用可视化编辑器/组件”时使用。在写入 HEEx 之前加载此内容，而不是之后。

plugin_texts.source: Build a BrightSite redesign or large change safely on a staging site, preview it, then promote it live in one atomic flip — instead of editing the live site directly. Use when the user wants a "staging site," "redesign safely," "build a new version without breaking the live site," "preview before it goes live," "rebuild the homepage," "flip the whole site at once," "a safe place to work," or is doing a full visual rebuild (new fonts/layout/multiple pages) they don't want visitors to see until it's ready. For per-entity staged edits on the live site (a single page's unpublished draft), the normal `*_staged` + `publish_page` flow is enough — use this skill only when you want a full isolated copy.
plugin_texts.target: 在暂存站点上安全地构建 BrightSite 重新设计或大型更改，预览它，然后通过一次原子翻转将其实时推广 - 而不是直接编辑实时站点。当用户想要“暂存站点”、“安全地重新设计”、“在不破坏实时站点的情况下构建新版本”、“上线前预览”、“重建主页”、“立即翻转整个站点”、“安全的工作场所”，或者正在进行完整的视觉重建（新字体/布局/多个页面）时，他们不希望访问者在准备好之前看到它。对于实时站点上的每个实体分阶段编辑（单个页面的未发布草稿），正常的“*_staged”+“publish_page”流程就足够了——仅当您需要完整的独立副本时才使用此技能。

plugin_texts.source: Pre-launch QA pass for a BrightSite site before handing it to a client or going live. Verifies site identity, error pages, blog settings, forms, redirects, analytics, and meta defaults are all configured. Outputs a checklist with green/yellow/red status. Use when the user mentions "client handoff," "pre-launch checklist," "launch QA," "going live," "ready to ship," "is this site ready," or wants a final QA pass before publishing a site.
plugin_texts.target: 在将 BrightSite 站点交给客户或上线之前，对其进行预启动 QA 通过。验证站点身份、错误页面、博客设置、表单、重定向、分析和元默认值均已配置。输出具有绿色/黄色/红色状态的清单。当用户提及“客户端移交”、“启动前检查清单”、“启动 QA”、“上线”、“准备好发货”、“此网站准备好了吗”或希望在发布网站之前获得最终 QA 通过时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Check a Canva design against a brand kit and report where it diverges — off-palette colors, non-brand fonts, logo misuse, and off-tone copy. Read-only; makes no changes. Use when the user asks "is this on brand", "check this against our brand kit", "do a brand review", "does this match our brand guidelines", or "brand-check my design".
plugin_texts.target: 将 Canva 设计与品牌套件进行对比，并报告其差异之处——偏离调色板的颜色、非品牌字体、徽标滥用和跑调的文案。只读；不做任何改变。当用户询问“这是品牌上的吗”、“根据我们的品牌套件检查这一点”、“进行品牌审查”、“这是否符合我们的品牌指南”或“对我的设计进行品牌检查”时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Create on-brand Canva presentations from an outline or brief. Use when the user asks to create a branded presentation, make an on-brand deck, turn an outline into slides, or generate a presentation from a brief. Input can be text directly in the message, a Canva design ID, a reference to a Canva doc by name, or a Canva design link (e.g., https://www.canva.com/design/...).
plugin_texts.target: 根据大纲或简介创建品牌 Canva 演示文稿。当用户要求创建品牌演示文稿、制作品牌演示文稿、将大纲转换为幻灯片或从摘要生成演示文稿时使用。输入可以是直接在消息中的文本、Canva 设计 ID、按名称对 Canva 文档的引用或 Canva 设计链接（例如 https://www.canva.com/design/...）。

plugin_texts.source: Implement reviewer feedback on a Canva design. Reads all comment threads, synthesises what reviewers want, makes the clear-cut changes directly, and flags anything that needs a human decision. Use when the user asks to "implement feedback on my deck", "address comments on a design", "apply review feedback", "fix the comments on my presentation", or "implement the feedback".
plugin_texts.target: 落实审阅者对 Canva 设计的反馈。阅读所有评论线程，综合审阅者想要的内容，直接进行明确的更改，并标记任何需要人工决定的内容。当用户要求“在我的演示文稿上实施反馈”、“处理设计上的评论”、“应用审阅反馈”、“修复我的演示文稿上的评论”或“实施反馈”时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Make edits to an existing Canva design — change or fix text, replace/insert/delete images and videos, reformat text (size, weight, style, color, alignment, lists, line height), reposition or resize elements, and update the title. Use when the user wants to change, edit, update, fix, translate, replace, or reformat content in a specific Canva design. This is the safe edit engine that other Canva skills (e.g. implement-feedback) build on.
plugin_texts.target: 对现有 Canva 设计进行编辑 - 更改或修复文本、替换/插入/删除图像和视频、重新格式化文本（大小、粗细、样式、颜色、对齐方式、列表、行高）、重新定位元素或调整元素大小以及更新标题。当用户想要更改、编辑、更新、修复、翻译、替换或重新格式化特定 Canva 设计中的内容时使用。这是其他 Canva 技能（例如实施反馈）构建的安全编辑引擎。

plugin_texts.source: Read a Canva design and return structured, actionable design feedback — visual hierarchy, copy/messaging, layout & spacing, consistency, readability, and accessibility. Read-only; makes no changes to the design. Use when the user asks to "review my design", "give me feedback on this", "critique my deck/poster/flyer", "how can I improve this design", or "what's wrong with this slide".
plugin_texts.target: 阅读 Canva 设计并返回结构化、可操作的设计反馈 - 视觉层次结构、复制/消息、布局和间距、一致性、可读性和可访问性。只读；不对设计进行任何更改。当用户要求“审查我的设计”、“对此提供反馈”、“批评我的幻灯片/海报/传单”、“我如何改进此设计”或“这张幻灯片有什么问题”时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Resize a Canva design into multiple social media formats (Facebook post, Facebook story, Instagram post, Instagram story, LinkedIn post). Use this skill when users want to resize Canva designs specifically for multiple social media platforms in one operation, rather than resizing to a single format manually.
plugin_texts.target: 将 Canva 设计的大小调整为多种社交媒体格式（Facebook 帖子、Facebook 故事、Instagram 帖子、Instagram 故事、LinkedIn 帖子）。当用户想要在一次操作中专门针对多个社交媒体平台调整 Canva 设计的大小，而不是手动调整为单一格式时，请使用此技能。

plugin_texts.source: Translate all text in a Canva design to another language, creating a translated copy. Faster than manually copying and editing each text box in Canva's editor. Use when users say "translate my design to [language]", "make a Spanish/French/etc version", or "localize my Canva design".
plugin_texts.target: 将 Canva 设计中的所有文本翻译为另一种语言，创建翻译副本。比在 Canva 编辑器中手动复制和编辑每个文本框更快。当用户说“将我的设计翻译为[语言]”、“制作西班牙语/法语/等版本”或“本地化我的 Canva 设计”时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Author, edit, validate, and safely publish workflows and agents on the clearskies workflow-builder MCP (tools workflow_capabilities_get, workflows_create/update/publish, workflow_validate, workflow_variables_get, workflow_test_run_start, workflow_runs_get/list, agents_*, object_*). Use whenever the user wants to build, change, debug, or publish a clearskies workflow or agent — e.g. "make a workflow that…", "update the workflow that…", "why did my workflow fail", "publish this workflow" — or describes a scheduled/call/Salesforce-triggered automation that finds CRM records, runs an agent, posts Slack, sends email, or writes Salesforce, even without saying "workflow" (e.g. "every morning DM me my open deals"). Key rule: workflow_validate checks structure and references but not runtime behavior, so ALWAYS dry-run with workflow_test_run_start before publishing.
plugin_texts.target: 在clearskies工作流构建器MCP上创作、编辑、验证和安全地发布工作流和代理（工具workflow_capability_get、workflows_create/update/publish、workflow_validate、workflow_variables_get、workflow_test_run_start、workflow_runs_get/list、agents_*、object_*）。每当用户想要构建、更改、调试或发布clearskies工作流程或代理时使用 - 例如“制定一个工作流程……”、“更新工作流程……”、“为什么我的工作流程失败”、“发布此工作流程”——或者描述一个计划/呼叫/Salesforce 触发的自动化，用于查找 CRM 记录、运行代理、发布 Slack、发送电子邮件或写入 Salesforce，即使不说“工作流程”（例如“每天早上私信我我的未结交易”）。关键规则：workflow_validate 检查结构和引用，但不检查运行时行为，因此在发布之前始终使用workflow_test_run_start 进行试运行。

plugin_texts.source: Put one Salesforce field under AI maintenance with a clearskies workflow: after a relevant call, AI finds the right record, checks the transcript is actually useful, generates a value, and writes it to the field. Use when a RevOps user wants AI to automatically keep a specific SFDC field up to date from meeting content — e.g. "have AI keep Opportunity Next Steps updated", "auto-fill our Onboarding Next Step field after calls", "update a chosen SFDC field automatically after customer meetings", or when they pick a field for AI to own. Builds the call-ended → role filter → find record → relevance-agent → should-continue gate → generation-agent → updateSalesforce pattern, using two reusable field-agnostic agents with all field-specifics in the step messages. It proposes or drafts first and never publishes or edits a live workflow without explicit approval.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 Clearskies 工作流程将一个 Salesforce 字段置于 AI 维护之下：在相关调用之后，AI 找到正确的记录，检查记录是否确实有用，生成一个值，并将其写入该字段。当 RevOps 用户希望 AI 自动更新会议内容中的特定 SFDC 字段时使用 - 例如“让 AI 保持机会后续步骤更新”、“在通话后自动填写我们的 Onboarding Next Step 字段”、“在客户会议后自动更新选定的 SFDC 字段”，或者当他们选择 AI 拥有的字段时。使用两个可重用的字段不可知代理以及步骤消息中的所有字段特定信息，构建呼叫结束 → 角色过滤器 → 查找记录 → 相关代理 → 应该继续门 → 生成代理 → updateSalesforce 模式。它首先提出建议或起草，并且在未经明确批准的情况下绝不会发布或编辑实时工作流程。

plugin_texts.source: Troubleshoot and resolve common issues with the ClickHouse Node.js client (@clickhouse/client). Use this skill whenever a user reports errors, unexpected behavior, or configuration questions involving the Node.js client specifically — including socket hang-up errors, Keep-Alive problems, stream handling issues, data type mismatches, read-only user restrictions, proxy/TLS setup problems, or long-running query timeouts. Trigger even when the user hasn't precisely named the issue; vague symptoms like "my inserts keep failing" or "connection drops randomly" in a Node.js context are strong signals to use this skill. Do NOT use for browser/Web client issues.
plugin_texts.target: 排查并解决 ClickHouse Node.js 客户端 (@clickhouse/client) 的常见问题。每当用户报告错误、意外行为或特别涉及 Node.js 客户端的配置问题时，请使用此技能 - 包括套接字挂起错误、Keep-Alive 问题、流处理问题、数据类型不匹配、只读用户限制、代理/TLS 设置问题或长时间运行的查询超时。即使用户没有准确命名问题也会触发；在 Node.js 上下文中，诸如“我的插入不断失败”或“连接随机断开”之类的模糊症状是使用此技能的强烈信号。请勿用于解决浏览器/Web 客户端问题。

Do NOT use for browser/Web client code.

plugin_texts.source: Use $triage-finding to triage supplied or imported security findings against <repo/path>. For Jira, use Atlassian Rovo only as an intake connector to import Jira issues matching <JQL or project/search>; for Linear, use Linear only as an intake connector for supplied issue URLs/IDs or search results. Return one static-evidence verdict per finding: confirmed, not_actionable, or needs_review. Finding(s) or source: <paste SARIF, CVE/GHSA/advisory text, scanner ticket, Jira/Linear security or vulnerability tickets, bug bounty report, Codex Security artifact, or GitHub finding source here>.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 $triage-finding 对 <repo/path> 提供或导入的安全结果进行分类。对于 Jira，仅使用 Atlassian Rovo 作为入口连接器来导入与 <JQL 或项目/搜索> 匹配的 Jira 问题；对于 Linear，仅使用 Linear 作为所提供的问题 URL/ID 或搜索结果的入口连接器。针对每个发现返回一个静态证据判决：confirmed、not_actionable 或 Needs_review。查找结果或来源：<在此处粘贴 SARIF、CVE/GHSA/咨询文本、扫描仪票证、Jira/Linear 安全或漏洞票证、错误赏金报告、Codex 安全工件或 GitHub 查找来源>。

plugin_texts.source: Analyzes a multi-step conversion funnel to find where users drop off and which steps have the worst leakage. Use this skill when someone describes a journey or funnel and asks about conversion rates, drop-off, fallout, or step completion. Trigger for phrases like "analyze our onboarding funnel," "where are users dropping off," "what's our checkout conversion rate," "funnel analysis," "show me fallout between these steps," or "which step loses the most users."

plugin_texts.source: Compares the performance of two or more audience segments across key metrics side by side. Use this skill when someone wants to compare audiences, cohorts, or groups — for example, "how do mobile users compare to desktop users on conversion," "compare new vs. returning visitors," "show me the difference between these two segments," "compare these audiences on our KPIs," or "which segment performs better." Also trigger for "segment comparison," "audience comparison," or "cohort comparison."
plugin_texts.target: 并排比较两个或多个细分受众群在关键指标上的表现。当有人想要比较受众群体、群组或群体时，请使用此技能 - 例如，“移动用户与桌面用户的转化率如何”、“比较新访问者与回访者”、“显示这两个细分受众群之间的差异”、“比较这些受众群体的 KPI”或“哪个细分受众群表现更好”。还触发“细分比较”、“受众比较”或“群组比较”。

plugin_texts.source: Comprehensive dimension analysis and reporting for CJA. Use this skill whenever the user wants to analyze one or more dimensions — including cardinality, distribution/skew, trends, anomalies, data quality errors, comparisons, and forecasting. Also trigger when someone asks "what are the top values for...", "dimension health", "explore this dimension", "dimension dashboard", "dimension statistics", "data quality check on a dimension", "dimension cardinality", "dimension trends", "dimension skew", "dimension anomalies", "compare dimensions", or any similar request to understand what's inside a CJA dimension. Produces an interactive HTML dashboard or a markdown report. Works with the CJA MCP server.
plugin_texts.target: CJA 的全面维度分析和报告。每当用户想要分析一个或多个维度（包括基数、分布/偏斜、趋势、异常、数据质量错误、比较和预测）时，请使用此技能。当有人询问“...的最高值是什么”、“维度运行状况”、“探索此维度”、“维度仪表板”、“维度统计信息”、“维度数据质量检查”、“维度基数”、“维度趋势”、“维度倾斜”、“维度异常”、“比较维度”或任何类似的了解 CJA 维度内部内容的请求时，也会触发。生成交互式 HTML 仪表板或 Markdown 报告。与 CJA MCP 服务器配合使用。

plugin_texts.source: Generates a polished, leadership-ready performance briefing with KPI tiles, executive narrative bullets, and a driver analysis — all as a print-ready HTML document. Always use this skill when someone asks for an executive summary, performance briefing, leadership readout, stakeholder update, or business review — even if they don't say "executive" explicitly. Trigger phrases include: "write a summary of last week's performance," "create a briefing for our leadership team," "produce a monthly business review," "what should I tell executives about our metrics," "generate a performance narrative," "QBR summary," "weekly business review," "board update," "stakeholder briefing," "how did we do last week," or "give me a performance snapshot." When in doubt, use this skill — it is always better to produce a polished briefing than a raw data dump.
plugin_texts.target: 生成一份精美的、可供领导使用的绩效简报，其中包含 KPI 块、执行叙述项目符号和驱动程序分析 - 全部作为可打印的 HTML 文档。当有人要求执行摘要、绩效简报、领导力宣读、利益相关者更新或业务审查时，请始终使用此技能 - 即使他们没有明确地说“执行”。触发短语包括：“撰写上周绩效摘要”、“为我们的领导团队创建简报”、“制作每月业务回顾”、“我应该向高管介绍我们的指标哪些内容”、“生成绩效叙述”、“QBR 摘要”、“每周业务回顾”、“董事会更新”、“利益相关者简报”、“我们上周做得怎么样”或“给我一个绩效快照”。如有疑问，请使用此技能 - 制作精美的简报总是比原始数据转储更好。

plugin_texts.source: Identifies which items (pages, campaigns, products, channels, regions) had the biggest increases or decreases for a key metric between two time periods. Use this skill when someone asks "what's up and what's down," "which campaigns moved the most," "top gainers and losers," "what pages are trending," "show me what changed by channel," or any variation of identifying the biggest movers and decliners for a metric.
plugin_texts.target: 确定哪些项目（页面、营销活动、产品、渠道、区域）在两个时间段之间关键指标的增幅或下降幅度最大。当有人询问“上涨和下跌”、“哪些营销活动变动最大”、“涨幅最大和涨幅最大”、“哪些页面正在流行”、“显示哪些渠道发生了变化”或识别某个指标的最大变动和下跌的任何变化时，请使用此技能。

plugin_texts.source: Produces a compact KPI digest showing how key metrics changed over a period and what's driving the movement. Use this skill when someone asks for a performance summary, a weekly recap, a morning briefing, a KPI update, or any variation of "how did we do this week/month." Also trigger for requests like "give me a performance overview," "what moved in the last 7 days," "pull our KPI report," or "summarize our metrics."
plugin_texts.target: 生成紧凑的 KPI 摘要，显示关键指标在一段时间内如何变化以及推动变化的因素。当有人询问绩效摘要、每周回顾、早间简报、KPI 更新或“我们本周/本月的表现如何”的任何形式时，请使用此技能。还会触发诸如“给我性能概述”、“过去 7 天内发生了什么变化”、“提取我们的 KPI 报告”或“总结我们的指标”等请求。
