plugin_texts.source: Use this skill when the user wants a quick, factual weekly or periodic overview of marketing metrics across channels. This is a lightweight report with numbers and anomalies — no subagents, no strategic synthesis. Activate when the user says "weekly report", "how did we do this week", "give me a marketing summary", "cross-channel report", "what happened with our marketing", "channel performance", "marketing digest", "weekly metrics", or asks for a combined view of organic and paid results. Do NOT use when the user wants strategic recommendations or cross-channel connections — that belongs to ds-brain. Works best with Dataslayer MCP connected. Also works with manual data.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户想要快速、真实地每周或定期概述跨渠道的营销指标时，请使用此技能。这是一份包含数字和异常情况的轻量级报告——没有子代理，没有战略综合。当用户说“每周报告”、“这周我们做得怎么样”、“给我一份营销摘要”、“跨渠道报告”、“我们的营销发生了什么”、“渠道绩效”、“营销摘要”、“每周指标”或要求有机结果和付费结果的综合视图时激活。当用户需要战略建议或跨渠道连接时请勿使用——这属于 ds-brain。与连接的 Dataslayer MCP 配合使用效果最佳。也适用于手动数据。

plugin_texts.source: Use this skill when the user wants a strategic, cross-functional analysis that connects paid, organic, content, and retention into one unified view. This is NOT a weekly summary — it is a decision engine that finds the hidden connections between channels. Activate when the user says "full marketing review", "how is everything doing", "weekly brain", "give me the full picture", "marketing intelligence report", "what should I focus on this week", "retention and acquisition together", "connect the dots across channels", or any request that implies synthesizing all marketing dimensions into one strategic recommendation. Do NOT use for simple weekly overviews or single-channel questions — those belong to ds-channel-report or the individual channel skills. This skill launches parallel subagents. Works best with Dataslayer MCP connected. Also works with manual data.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户想要进行战略性跨职能分析，将付费、有机、内容和保留连接到一个统一的视图时，请使用此技能。这不是每周总结——它是一个发现渠道之间隐藏联系的决策引擎。当用户说“全面的营销回顾”、“一切进展如何”、“每周大脑”、“给我全面了解”、“营销情报报告”、“本周我应该关注什么”、“保留和获取在一起”、“跨渠道连接点”或任何暗示将所有营销维度综合为一项战略建议的请求时激活。请勿用于简单的每周概述或单渠道问题 - 这些属于 ds-channel-report 或个人渠道技能。该技能启动并行子代理。与连接的 Dataslayer MCP 配合使用效果最佳。也适用于手动数据。

plugin_texts.source: Use this skill when the user wants to audit, review, or diagnose their paid media campaigns. Activate when the user says "audit my campaigns", "check my Google Ads", "why is my CPA high", "review my paid media", "what's wrong with my ads", "analyze my campaigns", or asks about campaign performance on Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, or any other paid channel. Works best with Dataslayer MCP connected. Also works with manual data.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户想要审核、审查或诊断他们的付费媒体活动时，请使用此技能。当用户说“审核我的广告系列”、“检查我的 Google Ads”、“为什么我的每次转化费用很高”、“查看我的付费媒体”、“我的广告有什么问题”、“分析我的广告系列”或询问 Google Ads、Meta、LinkedIn 广告、TikTok 广告或任何其他付费渠道上的广告系列效果时激活。与连接的 Dataslayer MCP 配合使用效果最佳。也适用于手动数据。

plugin_texts.source: Use this skill when the user wants to generate a professional PDF report for a client or for internal use. Activate when the user says "generate a PDF report", "create a client report", "export to PDF", "make a report for my client", "monthly report PDF", "branded report", or any request that implies a downloadable, shareable, professional document with marketing performance data. Works best with Dataslayer MCP connected. Also works with manual data. Reads branding config from dataslayer-config.json if present.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户想要为客户或内部使用生成专业的 PDF 报告时，请使用此技能。当用户说“生成 PDF 报告”、“创建客户报告”、“导出为 PDF”、“为我的客户制作报告”、“月度报告 PDF”、“品牌报告”或任何暗示可下载、可共享、包含营销绩效数据的专业文档的请求时激活。与连接的 Dataslayer MCP 配合使用效果最佳。也适用于手动数据。从 dataslayer-config.json 中读取品牌配置（如果存在）。

plugin_texts.source: Use this skill when the user wants to identify accounts at risk of churning, understand why users are cancelling, or find early warning signals before churn happens. Activate when the user says "churn analysis", "who might cancel", "accounts at risk", "why are people leaving", "usage drop", "inactive accounts", "retention analysis", "predict churn", or asks about subscription health, cancellation patterns, or which users are disengaged. Works best with Dataslayer MCP connected (Stripe + analytics). Also works with manual data.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户想要识别有流失风险的帐户、了解用户取消的原因或在流失发生之前找到早期预警信号时，请使用此技能。当用户说“流失分析”、“谁可能取消”、“帐户面临风险”、“人们为什么离开”、“使用量下降”、“不活跃帐户”、“保留分析”、“预测流失”或询问订阅状况、取消模式或哪些用户脱离时激活。与连接的 Dataslayer MCP（Stripe + 分析）配合使用效果最佳。也适用于手动数据。

plugin_texts.source: Use this skill when the user wants to review organic search performance, identify SEO opportunities, or diagnose ranking drops. Activate when the user says "SEO report", "how is our organic doing", "check Search Console", "why did we lose rankings", "find quick wins for SEO", "which queries should we target", "impressions dropped", "CTR is low", or any question about organic traffic, rankings, or search visibility. plugin_texts.source: Use this skill when the user wants to understand how their blog or content is performing in terms of traffic, engagement, and conversions. Activate when the user says "how is our blog doing", "which posts are driving trials", "content performance", "is our content working", "what should we write next", "which articles bring the most signups", "content audit", "blog SEO", "content SEO performance", or asks about the relationship between content and registrations or conversions. plugin_texts.source: Author, edit, or apply a Descope FGA schema using the ReBAC/ABAC DSL. Use this skill whenever the user asks to create a new FGA schema, modify an existing one, add types/relations/permissions/conditions, review an authorization model, or apply schema changes to a Descope project. Trigger even if the user says things like "set up authorization", "define roles and permissions", "add team-based access", "make this endpoint check FGA", or "update my authz model" — these almost always mean an FGA schema change.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 ReBAC/ABAC DSL 创作、编辑或应用 Descope FGA 架构。每当用户要求创建新的 FGA 模式、修改现有模式、添加类型/关系/权限/条件、检查授权模型或将模式更改应用于 Descope 项目时，请使用此技能。即使用户说出“设置授权”、“定义角色和权限”、“添加基于团队的访问权限”、“使此端点检查 FGA”或“更新我的 authz 模型”等内容，也会触发 — 这些几乎总是意味着 FGA 架构更改。

plugin_texts.source: Static security review for authentication and authorization vulnerabilities. Use when the user invokes /auth-review, asks to audit auth, find identity breaches, review access control, hunt for IDOR/BOLA, or check authorization. Framework- and vendor-agnostic. Enumerates every route/endpoint, builds an authorization matrix, applies a vulnerability catalog, and writes a triage report ready to turn into issues or PRs.
plugin_texts.target: 针对身份验证和授权漏洞的静态安全审查。当用户调用 /auth-review、要求审核身份验证、查找身份泄露、审查访问控制、寻找 IDOR/BOLA 或检查授权时使用。与框架和供应商无关。枚举每个路由/端点，构建授权矩阵，应用漏洞目录，并编写准备转化为问题或 PR 的分类报告。

plugin_texts.source: Use this skill whenever anyone asks about migrating from Auth0 to Descope — whether they're a developer doing it themselves or a technical lead evaluating the move. Triggers on: "how do I migrate from Auth0", "replace Auth0 with Descope", "we're moving off Auth0", "Auth0 to Descope", "switch from Auth0", "our app uses express-openid-connect / nextjs-auth0 / auth0-fastapi / other Auth0 SDK and we want to use Descope instead", or any question about Auth0 features (Actions, FGA, Organizations, Token Vault, CIBA) in the context of Descope. Works for any language or framework with a Descope SDK. Always use this skill before producing migration guidance — do not rely on memory alone.

plugin_texts.target: 在 Descope 流之上构建 React“自带屏幕”(BYOS) 自定义 UI 时使用 - 获取导出的流 JSON，提取真实的交互 ID 和输出，生成与托管奇偶校验匹配的 BYOS 组件，并避免重新发现困难的失败模式（静默表单拒绝、共享屏幕名称冲突、匿名会话粘性、嵌套表单水合错误、错误的表单键、死端按钮、缺少 OAuth 提供程序字段）。

plugin_texts.source: Analyzes a LinkedIn profile and identifies the perfect outbound attack angle for personalized outreach. Use this skill whenever the user shares a LinkedIn profile URL, a screenshot, or copy-pasted profile data and wants to know how to approach this prospect — even if they just say "analyze this profile", "how do I reach out to this person", "find me an angle for this lead", "write me an icebreaker for this prospect", or "what's the best hook for this LinkedIn profile". Always asks for company context, ICP, and value prop before analyzing. Produces a prioritized angle recommendation with ready-to-use outreach hooks.
plugin_texts.target: 分析 LinkedIn 个人资料并确定个性化外展的完美出站攻击角度。每当用户分享 LinkedIn 个人资料 URL、屏幕截图或复制粘贴的个人资料数据并想知道如何接近该潜在客户时，请使用此技能 - 即使他们只是说“分析此个人资料”、“我如何联系此人”、“为我找到此线索的角度”、“为该潜在客户写一个破冰游戏”或“此 LinkedIn 个人资料的最佳吸引力是什么”。在分析之前始终询问公司背景、ICP 和价值支撑。通过即用型外展挂钩生成优先角度建议。

plugin_texts.source: Analyzes a target persona and context to generate 3 distinct campaign angles for outbound sequences. Use this skill whenever the user wants to find the right angle for a campaign, asks "what angle should I use for this persona", "give me campaign ideas for this target", "how should I approach this audience", or provides a target and some context before writing emails. Pulls persona and prospect context directly from Enginy when a real contact or company is named. Always produces exactly 3 differentiated angles with rationale, campaign hook, and pain focus for each.
plugin_texts.target: 分析目标角色和背景，为出站序列生成 3 个不同的活动角度。每当用户想要为营销活动找到正确的角度，询问“我应该为这个角色使用什么角度”，“给我这个目标的营销想法”，“我应该如何接近这个受众”，或者在撰写电子邮件之前提供目标和一些背景时，请使用此技能。当真实的联系人或公司被命名时，直接从 Enginy 中提取角色和潜在客户背景。始终准确地生成 3 个不同的角度，并为每个角度提供基本原理、活动钩子和痛点焦点。

plugin_texts.source: Analyzes sales call transcripts to produce deep, structured persona intelligence reports. plugin_texts.source: Audits, scores, and rewrites B2B cold emails, LinkedIn messages, and outreach sequences. Even if they just say "I have an idea", "what do you think about this", "help me think through this campaign", or "is this a good GTM move". Always challenges assumptions, identifies blind spots, and produces a concrete execution plan alongside the creative expansion.
plugin_texts.target: 集思广益、挑战并将任何 GTM 想法发挥到最大潜力（无论是想法本身还是执行），然后命名执行每个动作的确切引擎技能/工具路径。每当用户分享活动创意、出站角度、工作流程概念、定位假设或任何 GTM 计划并想要深入思考时，请使用此技能。即使他们只是说“我有一个想法”、“你对此有何看法”、“帮助我思考这个活动”或“这是一个好的 GTM 举措吗”。始终挑战假设，识别盲点，并在创意扩展的同时制定具体的执行计划。

plugin_texts.source: Buying trigger analysis skill for outbound sales teams. Identifies and interprets trigger events (funding, hiring, tool changes, job changes, LinkedIn activity, M&A, etc.) to help time outreach and sharpen messaging, and states exactly how to act on each trigger through Enginy. Works in two modes: (1) Strategic — given an ICP, recommends the best triggers to activate and the right messaging angle for each; (2) Tactical — given a specific company or signal, explains how to exploit it right now. ALWAYS use this skill when the user mentions signals, triggers, buying intent, "right time to reach out", timing outreach, "they just raised", "they just hired", "they changed jobs", job postings, funding rounds, tech stack changes, LinkedIn activity, or any event-based prospecting. Use it even if the user just says "when should I reach out to X".
plugin_texts.target: 外向销售团队的购买触发分析技能。识别和解释触发事件（融资、招聘、工具变更、工作变动、LinkedIn 活动、并购等），以帮助安排时间和强化消息传递，并准确说明如何通过 Enginy 对每个触发事件采取行动。有两种模式工作：(1) 战略性 — 给定 ICP，建议激活的最佳触发器以及每个触发器的正确​​消息传递角度； (2) 战术——给定一个特定的公司或信号，解释如何立即利用它。当用户提及信号、触发因素、购买意图、“伸出援手的正确时间”、时机外展、“他们刚刚筹集资金”、“他们刚刚雇用”、“他们换了工作”、职位发布、融资回合、技术堆栈变化、LinkedIn 活动或任何基于事件的勘探时，请始终使用此技能。即使用户只是说“我什么时候应该联系 X”，也可以使用它。

plugin_texts.source: Compare reps and senders on outreach activity and outcomes using live Enginy data — pulls per-identity campaign analytics, conversation outcomes, and task discipline into a side-by-side scorecard with coaching notes. Use when asked "compare my reps", "how is my team doing", "who's my top performer", "which SDR is underperforming", "team performance review", "rep scorecard", "who has the most overdue tasks", "compare sender performance", or "how do my senders stack up". Fetches identities, task owners, campaigns per sender, campaign analytics, conversation outcomes, and task counts. Honest about the CRM boundary — Enginy sees outreach and tasks, not closed-won revenue.
plugin_texts.target: 使用实时 Enginy 数据比较代表和发送者的外展活动和结果 - 将每个身份的活动分析、对话结果和任务纪律放入带有指导说明的并排记分卡中。当被问及“比较我的代表”、“我的团队表现如何”、“谁是我的最佳表现者”、“哪个 SDR 表现不佳”、“团队绩效审核”、“代表记分卡”、“谁的逾期任务最多”、“比较发送者表现”或“我的发送者表现如何”时使用。获取身份、任务所有者、每个发送者的活动、活动分析、对话结果和任务计数。诚实地对待 CRM 边界 — Enginy 看到的是外展和任务，而不是已赢得的收入。

plugin_texts.source: Comprehensive SaaS market research skill for identifying Existential Data Points (EDPs) — the critical metrics that transform a solution from nice-to-have to must-have — then turning the findings directly into Enginy prospecting lists, AI variables, and outbound angles. Use this skill whenever the user asks to research a SaaS market, identify outbound plays, find pain points for a category, analyze a vertical, or discover urgency triggers for outbound campaigns. Trigger on phrases like "research the [X] market", "find EDPs for [X]", "outbound play for [category]", "analyze [SaaS] market", "what's the pain in [vertical]", or any request to understand a SaaS category for sales/growth purposes. ALWAYS use this skill when the user is doing market research for outbound or sales enablement.
plugin_texts.target: 全面的 SaaS 市场研究技能，用于识别存在数据点 (EDP)——将解决方案从“必备”转变为“必备”的关键指标——然后将研究结果直接转化为 Enginy 勘探列表、AI 变量和出站角度。每当用户要求研究 SaaS 市场、识别出站游戏、查找类别的痛点、分析垂直市场或发现出站活动的紧急触发因素时，请使用此技能。触发诸如“研究 [X] 市场”、“查找 [X] 的 EDP”、“[类别] 的出站游戏”、“分析 [SaaS] 市场”、“[垂直] 的痛点”等短语，或出于销售/增长目的而了解 SaaS 类别的任何请求。当用户进行外拨或销售支持的市场研究时，请始终使用此技能。

plugin_texts.source: Conduct competitive analysis to identify direct and indirect competitors, map their positioning, build a battlecard, and then act on it in Enginy — block competitor accounts from outreach and find companies currently using them for displacement targeting. Use when asked "who are our competitors", "competitive analysis for [company]", "how do we compare to X", "find alternatives to [product]", "competitive positioning", "battlecard", "how to beat [competitor]", "what do competitors offer", "differentiate from X in outreach", "block companies using [competitor]", or "find companies using [competitor] to target". Always use this skill before writing competitive positioning or handling competitor objections.
plugin_texts.target: 进行竞争分析，识别直接和间接竞争对手，绘制他们的定位，构建战斗卡，然后在 Enginy 中对其采取行动 - 阻止竞争对手帐户的外展，并找到当前使用它们进行位移定位的公司。当被问到“谁是我们的竞争对手”、“[公司]的竞争分析”、“我们与 X 相比如何”、“寻找[产品]的替代品”、“竞争定位”、“战斗卡”、“如何击败[竞争对手]”、“竞争对手提供什么”、“在外展方面与 X 不同”、“阻止使用[竞争对手]的公司”或“查找使用[竞争对手]作为目标的公司”时使用。在撰写竞争定位或处理竞争对手的异议之前，请务必使用此技能。

plugin_texts.source: Create AI Messages in Enginy — channel-aware, AI-written outreach messages generated per contact at send time (email, LinkedIn message/InMail/connection note, WhatsApp). Use when asked "create an AI message", "have the AI write the email for each lead", "AI-generated LinkedIn message", "personalized message per contact in my campaign", or "set up an AI message for my sequence". Handles both Enginy systems: uses the new AI Messages entity where the workspace has the AI split enabled, and falls back automatically to a legacy AI Variable when it doesn't. For stored research facts use ai-research-builder; for reusable copy fragments use ai-snippet-builder.
plugin_texts.target: 在 Enginy 中创建 AI 消息 — 每个联系人在发送时生成的渠道感知、AI 编写的外展消息（电子邮件、LinkedIn 消息/InMail/连接注释、WhatsApp）。当询问“创建 AI 消息”、“让 AI 为每个潜在客户编写电子邮件”、“AI 生成的 LinkedIn 消息”、“我的营销活动中每个联系人的个性化消息”或“为我的序列设置 AI 消息”时使用。处理两个引擎系统：使用新的 AI 消息实体，其中工作区启用了 AI 拆分，并在未启用 AI 拆分时自动回退到旧版 AI 变量。对于存储的研究事实，请使用 ai-research-builder；对于可重复使用的副本片段，请使用 ai-snippet-builder。

plugin_texts.source: Create AI Snippets in Enginy — reusable, channel-agnostic AI-generated copy fragments (a personalized opener line, a proof point, a signal reference) computed per contact and embedded inside messages across sequences. Use when asked "create an AI snippet", "reusable personalized line", "one AI-generated sentence I can drop into all my emails", "personalization block for my sequences", or "snippet with a fallback". Handles both Enginy systems: uses the new AI Snippets entity where the workspace has the AI split enabled, and falls back automatically to a legacy AI Variable when it doesn't. For stored research facts use ai-research-builder; for full AI-written messages use ai-message-builder.
plugin_texts.target: 在 Enginy 中创建 AI 片段 — 可重复使用、与通道无关的 AI 生成的副本片段（个性化的开场白、证明点、信号参考），根据联系人计算并嵌入跨序列的消息内。当被问及“创建人工智能片段”、“可重复使用的个性化行”、“我可以将一个人工智能生成的句子放入我的所有电子邮件中”、“我的序列的个性化块”或“带有后备的片段”时使用。处理两个引擎系统：使用新的 AI 片段实体，其中工作区启用了 AI 分割，并在未启用 AI 分割时自动回退到旧版 AI 变量。对于存储的研究事实，请使用 ai-research-builder；对于完整的人工智能编写的消息，请使用 ai-message-builder。

plugin_texts.source: Create, test, and run AI Research fields in Enginy — per-contact/per-company AI-generated research, classifications, and personalization facts. Use when asked "create an AI research field", "create an AI variable", "research every company on my list", "build a smart field", "add a custom AI field", "auto-fill [X] for all my leads", "score/classify each lead with AI", or "generate a personalized fact for each contact". Works on every Enginy workspace: on workspaces with the AI split, this creates AI Research; on workspaces still on the legacy system, the same flow creates an AI Variable — same tool, same behavior. For AI-written outreach messages use ai-message-builder; for reusable copy fragments use ai-snippet-builder.
plugin_texts.target: 在 Enginy 中创建、测试和运行 AI 研究字段 — 每个联系人/每个公司的 AI 生成的研究、分类和个性化事实。当被问及“创建人工智能研究领域”、“创建人工智能变量”、“研究我的列表上的每家公司”、“构建智能领域”、“添加自定义人工智能字段”、“为我的所有潜在客户自动填充 [X]”、“使用人工智能对每个潜在客户进行评分/分类”或“为每个联系人生成个性化事实”时使用。适用于每个 Enginy 工作区：在具有 AI 拆分的工作区上，这将创建 AI 研究；在仍然位于旧系统上的工作区上，相同的流程创建 AI 变量 - 相同的工具，相同的行为。对于人工智能编写的外展消息，请使用 ai-message-builder；对于可重复使用的副本片段，请使用 ai-snippet-builder。

plugin_texts.source: Deep-dive customer-voice intelligence — why customers really buy — using an Enginy-first pipeline (existing company data, LinkedIn/AccountIQ/StoreLeads enrichment) topped up with web research on case studies and reviews, with findings persisted back into Enginy. Use when asked "research my customers", "analyze our ICP", "find customer pain points", "what do customers say about us", "why do people buy from us", "customer insights for [company]", "competitive positioning research", or "find customer language for messaging". Use this BEFORE defining ICP/personas — it reveals what customers actually care about.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 Enginy 优先的管道（现有公司数据、LinkedIn/AccountIQ/StoreLeads 丰富）深入了解客户声音情报（客户真正购买的原因），并辅以案例研究和评论的网络研究，并将研究结果保留回 Enginy。当被问及“研究我的客户”、“分析我们的 ICP”、“查找客户痛点”、“客户对我们的评价如何”、“人们为什么向我们购买产品”、“[公司]的客户洞察”、“竞争定位研究”或“查找用于消息传递的客户语言”时使用。在定义 ICP/人物角色之前使用它——它揭示了客户真正关心的是什么。

plugin_texts.source: Define, score, and live-validate narrow Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) for outbound targeting, then prove reachability directly in Enginy AI Finder. Use when asked "who should we target", "define ICP", "best customers for X", "outbound targeting", "who gets most value", "segment customers", "narrow audience", "prioritize accounts", "who should we reach out to", or "build me an outbound ICP". Always use this skill before building any list or writing any outreach.
plugin_texts.target: 为出站定位定义、评分和实时验证狭窄的理想客户档案 (ICP)，然后直接在 Enginy AI Finder 中证明可达性。当被问到“我们应该定位谁”、“定义 ICP”、“X 的最佳客户”、“出站定位”、“谁获得最大价值”、“细分客户”、“狭窄受众”、“优先考虑帐户”、“我们应该联系谁”或“为我建立一个出站 ICP”时使用。在建立任何列表或撰写任何外展活动之前，请务必使用此技能。

plugin_texts.source: Design a multi-step outbound campaign and take it from draft to live, executing directly in Enginy. Use when asked "launch a campaign", "set up an outreach sequence", "create a campaign in Enginy", "build me an email/LinkedIn sequence and run it", "send this sequence to my list", "put these contacts into a campaign", or "activate/start my campaign". Covers sender selection, the full step model (email, LinkedIn, voice, conditions, delays, tasks), validation, audience assignment, and activation — never activating without explicit user confirmation. Routes to copywriting-*, outbound-campaign-architect, and campaign-performance-analyzer.
plugin_texts.target: 设计一个多步骤的出站营销活动，并将其从草稿付诸实施，直接在 Enginy 中执行。当询问“启动营销活动”、“设置外展序列”、“在 Enginy 中创建营销活动”、“为我构建电子邮件/LinkedIn 序列并运行它”、“将此序列发送到我的列表”、“将这些联系人放入营销活动”或“激活/启动我的营销活动”时使用。涵盖发件人选择、完整步骤模型（电子邮件、LinkedIn、语音、条件、延迟、任务）、验证、受众分配和激活 - 未经用户明确确认，绝不激活。通往文案写作*、出站营销活动架构师和营销活动绩效分析器的路线。

plugin_texts.source: Design personalized, value-based call-to-actions (CTAs) for cold outreach that spark conversations instead of demanding meetings. Use when asked "what CTA should I use", "help me with my call to action", "how to end my email", "what lead magnet should I offer", "how to get a reply", "how to close my cold email", "CTA ideas for outreach", "what should I ask for in my sequence", or any request about how to end an outreach message or what to offer prospects. Always use this skill before writing or finalizing any outreach CTA. This skill replaces generic "book a call" CTAs with Permissionless Value Promises that make prospects respond out of genuine interest, not obligation.
plugin_texts.target: 设计个性化、基于价值的号召性用语 (CTA) 进行冷外展，激发对话而不是要求召开会议。当被问及“我应该使用什么 CTA”、“帮助我采取行动”、“如何结束我的电子邮件”、“我应该提供什么引导磁铁”、“如何获得回复”、“如何关闭我的冷邮件”、“CTA 外展想法”、“我应该在我的序列中要求什么”或任何有关如何结束外展消息或向潜在客户提供什么的请求时使用。在撰写或最终确定任何外展 CTA 之前，请务必使用此技能。这项技能用无需许可的价值承诺取代了通用的“预约电话”CTA，让潜在客户出于真正的兴趣而不是义务做出回应。

plugin_texts.source: Discover 3–5 high-quality, complementary B2B data sources with strong buying intent signals for a specific industry, solution, or target market, then bring the harvested records into Enginy and route them into enrichment and list-building. Use when asked "find data sources for [vertical]", "where can I find companies that [characteristic]", "how do I build a list of [target]", "best sources for [industry] leads", "alternatives to generic prospecting databases", "where to find companies with [signal]", or "data sources for [use case]". Do NOT use for individual contact data, email verification, or CRM/tool functionality questions.
plugin_texts.target: 发现 3-5 个高质量、互补的 B2B 数据源，这些数据源具有针对特定行业、解决方案或目标市场的强烈购买意向信号，然后将收集到的记录导入 Enginy 中，并将其用于丰富和列表构建。当询问“查找[垂直]的数据源”、“在哪里可以找到具有[特征]的公司”、“如何构建[目标]列表”、“[行业]潜在客户的最佳来源”、“通用勘探数据库的替代品”、“在哪里可以找到具有[信号]的公司”或“[用例]的数据源”时使用。请勿用于个人联系数据、电子邮件验证或 CRM/工具功能问题。

plugin_texts.source: Draft the follow-up message after a sales meeting, demo, or discovery call from your notes or transcript — a tight recap plus next steps split into "On my side" and "On your side", with zero invented action items. Use when asked "write my follow-up", "send a recap after this call", "post-demo email", "follow up on the meeting", "draft a thank-you after the call", "recap and next steps", "summarize the demo and what's next", or "they want a summary of what we discussed". Pulls the Enginy thread for context when the prospect lives in Enginy, and sends only after explicit confirmation.
plugin_texts.target: 在销售会议、演示或发现电话会议后，根据笔记或文字记录起草后续消息 - 严格回顾以及分为“我这边”和“您那边”的后续步骤，零发明行动项目。当被问到“写我的后续行动”、“在这次通话后发送回顾”、“演示后电子邮件”、“跟进会议”、“在通话后起草感谢信”、“回顾和下一步”、“总结演示和下一步”或“他们想要我们讨论的内容的摘要”时使用。当潜在客户位于 Enginy 中时，拉取 Enginy 线程以获取上下文，并且仅在明确确认后才发送。

plugin_texts.source: End-to-end "build me a list of prospects" workflow that executes directly in Enginy AI Finder — from targeting criteria to an imported, optionally enriched list. Use when asked "build me a list", "find me prospects/leads/contacts/companies", "source new accounts", "get me a list of [role] at [company type]", "who should I reach out to", "pull companies matching my ICP", or "find people at companies that [signal]". Also handles querying EXISTING CRM/Enginy data when the user wants records already in the workspace rather than net-new sourcing. Routes to icp-definer, enrich-and-score-lead, and launch-campaign as needed.
plugin_texts.target: 直接在 Enginy AI Finder 中执行的端到端“构建潜在客户列表”工作流程 — 从定位标准到导入的可选丰富列表。当被问及“为我建立一个列表”、“为我寻找潜在客户/潜在客户/联系人/公司”、“寻找新客户”、“为我提供[公司类型]的[角色]列表”、“我应该联系谁”、“提取与我的 ICP 匹配的公司”或“在具有[信号]的公司中寻找人员”时使用。当用户想要工作区中已有的记录而不是新的来源时，还可以处理现有 CRM/Enginy 数据的查询。根据需要路由至 icp-definer、rich-and-score-lead 和 launch-campaign。

plugin_texts.source: Enrich a prospect (email, phone, LinkedIn, company data) and produce an ICP-fit score, single-record or in bulk. Use when the user says "enrich this lead", "fill in the missing contact info", "find this person's email and phone", "score this contact against our ICP", "how well does this prospect fit", "grade my list against our ideal customer profile", or "enrich and qualify these contacts".
plugin_texts.target: 丰富潜在客户（电子邮件、电话、LinkedIn、公司数据）并生成单个记录或批量的 ICP 拟合分数。当用户说“丰富此潜在客户”、“填写缺失的联系信息”、“查找此人的电子邮件和电话”、“根据我们的 ICP 对此联系人进行评分”、“此潜在客户的适合度如何”、“根据我们理想的客户资料对我的列表进行评分”或“丰富并限定这些联系人”时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Extract every value proposition from a company's materials into a tiered, persona-mapped inventory, then frame the strongest ones into ready-to-use offers at three granularities (one-liner, value proposition, full offer). Use when asked "list my value props", "what value do we provide", "extract our benefits", "summarize our value propositions", "organize our messaging", "what do we offer customers", "how to frame my offer", "what should I say in cold emails", "how to pitch my product", "make my offer clearer", "value proposition for outreach", "how do I explain what we do", "turn features into benefits", or "write a one-liner for my product". Use after ICP and persona are defined, before writing outreach copy.
plugin_texts.target: 将公司材料中的每个价值主张提取到分层的、角色映射的库存中，然后将最强的价值主张构建成三种粒度（单行、价值主张、完整报价）的即用型报价。当被问及“列出我的价值主张”、“我们提供什么价值”、“提取我们的利益”、“总结我们的价值主张”、“组织我们的消息传递”、“我们为客户提供什么”、“如何制定我的报价”、“我应该在冷冰冰的电子邮件中说些什么”、“如何推销我的产品”、“使我的报价更清晰”、“外展的价值主张”、“我如何解释我们的工作”、“将功能转化为优势”或“写一个我的产品的一句话”。在定义 ICP 和人物角色之后、撰写推广文案之前使用。

plugin_texts.source: Find companies showing buying signals (hiring, tech adoption, funding) and reach their decision-makers with signal-aware outreach. Use when the user says "find companies that are hiring for X", "find accounts using [technology]", "find recently funded companies", "who's showing buying signals in my market", "build a list off a trigger event", or "find companies expanding and get me the right person to contact".
plugin_texts.target: 查找显示出购买信号（招聘、技术采用、融资）的公司，并通过信号感知外展来接触其决策者。当用户说“查找正在为 X 招聘的公司”、“查找使用[技术]的帐户”、“查找最近获得资助的公司”、“谁在我的市场中显示出购买信号”、“根据触发事件建立列表”或“查找正在扩张的公司并为我找到合适的联系人”时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Generates a structured cold call script from a target description (job title, company type, industry, trigger, etc.). Use this skill whenever the user wants to write a cold call script, says "give me a call script", "how do I open this call", "write me a cold call for [persona]", or describes a target and needs a phone outreach framework. Pulls prospect/company context from Enginy when a real target is named, and can schedule the resulting call as an Enginy task or a campaign step. Always produces a full script following the 6-part framework: opener, permission-based framing, 3 pain hypotheses, discovery questions, mini proof, and meeting ask.
plugin_texts.target: 根据目标描述（职位名称、公司类型、行业、触发点等）生成结构化的电话推销脚本。每当用户想要编写冷电话脚本时，比如“给我一个电话脚本”、“我如何打开此电话”、“为我写一个电话推销脚本”，或者描述一个目标并需要电话外展框架时，请使用此技能。当命名真实目标时，从 Enginy 中提取潜在客户/公司上下文，并可以将生成的调用安排为 Enginy 任务或营销活动步骤。始终按照 6 部分框架生成完整的脚本：开场白、基于许可的框架、3 个痛苦假设、发现问题、迷你证明和会议提问。

plugin_texts.source: Identify and prioritize buyer personas at the contact level for outbound targeting, then translate the final persona into Enginy AI Finder search criteria mapped to real workspace contact fields. Use when asked "who should I email", "define buyer persona", "what role to target", "who is the decision maker", "who has this pain", "which title to reach out to", "should I target VPs or Directors", or "contact-level targeting". Use AFTER ICP is defined (ICP = which companies, Persona = which person at those companies).
plugin_texts.target: 在联系人级别识别买家角色并确定其优先级以进行出站定位，然后将最终角色转换为映射到真实工作区联系人字段的 Enginy AI Finder 搜索条件。当被问到“我应该向谁发送电子邮件”、“定义买家角色”、“目标角色是什么”、“决策者是谁”、“谁有这种痛苦”、“应该联系哪个职位”、“我应该定位副总裁或总监”或“联系人级别定位”时使用。定义 ICP 后使用（ICP = 哪些公司，Persona = 这些公司的哪个人员）。

plugin_texts.source: Identify and prioritize evidence-based pain points a target company likely faces, based on growth signals, tech stack, hiring activity, and industry context — sourced from the company's actual Enginy record and filled in via Enginy scraping/enrichment actions, not hand-waved research. Use when asked "what are [company]'s pain points", "research pain points for [company]", "why would [company] buy", "what problems does [company] face", "qualify this lead", "account research for [company]", "help me personalize outreach to [company]", or "what signals should I mention in my email to [company]".
plugin_texts.target: 根据增长信号、技术堆栈、招聘活动和行业背景，识别目标公司可能面临的基于证据的痛点并确定其优先顺序——这些痛点源自公司的实际 Enginy 记录，并通过 Enginy 抓取/丰富操作而不是手动研究来填写。当被问及“[公司]的痛点是什么”、“研究[公司]的痛点”、“[公司]为什么要购买”、“[公司]面临什么问题”、“确定该潜在客户的资格”、“[公司]的客户研究”、“帮助我个性化与[公司]的联系”或“我应该在发给[公司]的电子邮件中提及哪些信号”时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Pull and diagnose real outbound campaign performance from your Enginy account — no need to type your stats, this skill fetches them. Use when asked "how is my campaign doing", "analyze my campaign", "why am I not getting replies", "is my reply rate good", "which of my campaigns performs best", "compare my campaigns", "audit my outbound", "my campaign is underperforming", "what's wrong with my sequence", "is X% good for cold email", or any request to evaluate live outreach performance. Fetches campaigns, campaign analytics, and conversation outcomes, verdicts each metric against benchmarks, finds the root cause, and hands off fixes to the right sibling skill.
plugin_texts.target: 从您的 Enginy 帐户中提取并诊断真实的出站营销活动绩效 - 无需输入您的统计数据，此技能即可获取它们。当被问到“我的营销活动表现如何”、“分析我的营销活动”、“为什么我没有得到回复”、“我的回复率是否良好”、“我的哪一个营销活动表现最好”、“比较我的营销活动”、“审核我的出站”、“我的营销活动表现不佳”、“我的顺序有什么问题”、“冷电子邮件是否适合 X%”或任何评估实时外展绩效的请求时使用。获取活动、活动分析和对话结果，根据基准判断每个指标，找到根本原因，并将修复交给正确的同级技能。

plugin_texts.source: Pull real replies from the Enginy inbox, classify them, tag the thread, draft the right response per a relationship-first doctrine, and send it only after explicit confirmation. Use when asked "how to reply to this", "they said X what do I say", "handle this objection", "got a response from a prospect", "check my inbox", "handle my replies", "interested reply", "not interested reply", "next step after reply", "competitor objection", "pricing question", or "how do I respond to this email/LinkedIn message". Always use this skill before writing or sending any reply to a prospect in Enginy.
plugin_texts.target: 从 Enginy 收件箱中提取真实回复，对它们进行分类，标记线程，根据关系优先原则起草正确的回复，并仅在明确确认后才发送。当被问及“如何回复此问题”、“他们说 X 我该说什么”、“处理此异议”、“得到潜在客户的回复”、“检查我的收件箱”、“处理我的回复”、“感兴趣的回复”、“不感兴趣的回复”、“回复后的下一步”、“竞争对手的反对”、“定价问题”或“我如何回复此电子邮件/LinkedIn 消息”时使用。在 Enginy 中向潜在客户撰写或发送任何回复之前，请务必使用此技能。

plugin_texts.source: Run a strategic, whole-account review of your outbound motion and produce a next-quarter plan. Pulls every recent campaign's performance, conversation outcomes, identity health, and list sizes, diagnoses them against benchmarks, interviews you on TAM and real ICP criteria, then outputs 6–12 month objectives, priority actions, reference KPIs, and a concrete 90-day plan. Use when asked "review my outbound", "quarterly outbound review", "plan next quarter", "how's my whole outbound doing", "build my Q_ outbound plan", "outbound strategy review", "what should I focus on next quarter", or "audit my entire outbound motion". Broader than a single-campaign audit — this is the account-level strategy pass.
plugin_texts.target: 对您的外派动议进行战略性的、全客户的审查，并制定下一季度的计划。提取最近每个活动的绩效、对话结果、身份健康状况和列表规模，根据基准对其进行诊断，根据 TAM 和真实 ICP 标准与您进行访谈，然后输出 6-12 个月的目标、优先行动、参考 KPI 和具体的 90 天计划。当被问及“审核我的出站”、“季度出站审核”、“下个季度的计划”、“我的整个出站进展如何”、“制定我的 Q_ 出站计划”、“出站策略审核”、“下个季度我应该关注什么”或“审核我的整个出站动议”时使用。比单一营销活动审计更广泛——这是帐户级别的策略通行证。

plugin_texts.source: Runs a full sales pipeline analysis — pipeline value, stage conversion, stuck deals, forecast, rep performance, and sales velocity — starting from your Enginy outreach data and extending into your CRM for deal-stage/revenue analysis. Use this skill whenever the user wants to analyze their pipeline — even if they just say "analyze my pipeline", "how's my pipeline looking", "show me my deals", "analyze my campaign pipeline", "forecast this month", or "who's my top rep". Works from Enginy campaigns, CSV, HubSpot, or Salesforce. Delivers a markdown analysis by default, with an optional interactive dashboard where the client supports artifacts.
plugin_texts.target: 运行完整的销售渠道分析 - 渠道价值、阶段转换、停滞交易、预测、代表绩效和销售速度 - 从您的 Enginy 外展数据开始，延伸到 CRM 中进行交易阶段/收入分析。每当用户想要分析他们的管道时，就可以使用此技能 - 即使他们只是说“分析我的管道”、“我的管道看起来怎么样”、“向我展示我的交易”、“分析我的竞选管道”、“本月预测”或“谁是我的最高代表”。适用于 Enginy 营销活动、CSV、HubSpot 或 Salesforce。默认情况下提供降价分析，并带有可选的交互式仪表板，其中客户端支持工件。

plugin_texts.source: Set up a personal writing-voice profile that every other message-producing skill writes through, so AI-assisted outreach sounds like one consistent person instead of a committee of drafts. Interviews you (or analyzes a few real messages you paste), then generates a compact voice spec you save as your own skill. Use when asked "set up my voice", "create my voice profile", "make the AI write like me", "capture my writing style", "why does my outreach sound like AI", "make my emails sound like me", "define my tone of voice", or "train the copywriting skills on how I write". Foundation for copywriting-sequence, copywriting-first-touch, copywriting-follow-up, meeting-follow-up, and reply-handler.
plugin_texts.target: 建立一个个人写作声音配置文件，其他所有消息生成技能都可以通过该配置文件进行写入，因此人工智能辅助的外展听起来像是一个一致的人，而不是一个草稿委员会。采访您（或分析您粘贴的一些真实消息），然后生成一个紧凑的语音规范，您可以将其保存为自己的技能。当被问及“设置我的声音”、“创建我的声音配置文件”、“让人工智能像我一样写作”、“捕捉我的写作风格”、“为什么我的外展听起来像人工智能”、“让我的电子邮件听起来像我”、“定义我的语气”或“根据我的写作方式训练文案写作技巧”时使用。文案序列、文案首次接触、文案后续、会议后续和回复处理程序的基础。

plugin_texts.source: Strategy front-door for prospect lists — translates an ICP/persona into a targeting approach (contacts, companies, or both) and routes execution to build-targeted-lead-list. Use when asked "build me a list", "find me leads", "find me prospects", "how do I find companies to target", "help me build a prospect list", "where do I start to find leads", or any request to identify or compile a list of potential customers. This skill does NOT find leads directly — it decides targeting strategy and hands off execution to build-targeted-lead-list. Always use before build-targeted-lead-list.
plugin_texts.target: 潜在客户列表的战略前门 - 将 ICP/角色转化为目标方法（联系人、公司或两者），并将执行路由到构建目标潜在客户列表。当被问及“为我建立一个列表”、“为我寻找潜在客户”、“为我寻找潜在客户”、“如何找到目标公司”、“帮助我建立潜在客户列表”、“我从哪里开始寻找潜在客户”或任何识别或编制潜在客户列表的请求时使用。该技能不会直接找到潜在客户 - 它决定目标策略并将执行交给构建目标潜在客户列表。始终在 build-targeted-lead-list 之前使用。

plugin_texts.source: Turn a raw idea into a LinkedIn post for a founder or seller's personal brand, built on the hook → connection → value → CTA formula, with AI-tells stripped out aggressively. Use when asked "draft a LinkedIn post", "write a post about X", "turn this idea into a LinkedIn post", "make this a founder post", "help me post on LinkedIn", "write something for my personal brand", "post idea about X", or "rewrite this so it doesn't sound like AI". Pulls persona/pain context from your ICP work or a real contact when the post targets a specific segment, and applies your voice profile if you have one set up.
plugin_texts.target: 将原始创意转化为创始人或卖家个人品牌的 LinkedIn 帖子，建立在挂钩 → 连接 → 价值 → CTA 公式的基础上，并积极剔除人工智能告诉内容。当被问到“起草一篇 LinkedIn 帖子”、“写一篇关于 X 的帖子”、“将此想法变成 LinkedIn 帖子”、“将此作为创始人帖子”、“帮助我在 LinkedIn 上发帖”、“为我的个人品牌写一些东西”、“发布关于 X 的想法”或“重写此内容，使其听起来不像人工智能”时使用。当帖子针对特定细分时，从您的 ICP 工作或真实联系人中提取角色/痛苦背景，并应用您的语音配置文件（如果您已设置）。

plugin_texts.source: Writes a 2-message LinkedIn DM sequence sent after a connection request is accepted. Use this skill whenever the user wants to write LinkedIn outreach messages, says "write me a LinkedIn sequence", "draft my LinkedIn DMs", "what do I send after they accept my connection?", or asks for LinkedIn-specific outreach copy. Works for any industry, any product, any seniority level. Maps the finished sequence onto Enginy campaign steps (linkedin_connection with acceptance branching, linkedin_message, optional linkedin_voice_message) when the user wants it built and launched. Always produces a complete 2-message LinkedIn sequence calibrated for the platform's conversational context and character constraints.
plugin_texts.target: 写入接受连接请求后发送的 2 条消息 LinkedIn DM 序列。每当用户想要编写 LinkedIn 外展消息、说“给我写一个 LinkedIn 序列”、“起草我的 LinkedIn DM”、“他们接受我的连接后我要发送什么？”或要求提供特定于 LinkedIn 的外展副本时，请使用此技能。适用于任何行业、任何产品、任何资历级别。当用户希望构建和启动时，将完成的序列映射到 Enginy 活动步骤（带有接受分支的 linkedin_connection、linkedin_message、可选 linkedin_voice_message）。始终生成针对平台的对话上下文和字符限制进行校准的完整 2 条消息 LinkedIn 序列。

plugin_texts.source: Writes a complete 3-email outbound sequence, calibrated to the buyer's seniority (VP / Manager / IC). Use this skill whenever the user wants a full cold-email sequence — says "write me a sequence", "draft a 3-email campaign", "write emails for a VP of Sales / a Sales Manager / SDRs", "build outreach copy for [persona]", or provides a target persona and asks for a sequence. First determines buyer seniority (asks if unknown), then produces a full 3-email campaign under strict copywriting rules, with per-tier tone, pain framing, proof, and CTA calibration. For a single standalone email use copywriting-first-touch; for one ad-hoc bump use copywriting-follow-up. Can pull prospect context from Enginy and push the finished sequence into a campaign.
plugin_texts.target: 编写完整的 3 封电子邮件出站序列，根据买家的资历（副总裁/经理/IC）进行校准。每当用户想要完整的冷电子邮件序列时，请使用此技能 - 说“给我写一个序列”、“起草 3 封电子邮件营销活动”、“为销售副总裁/销售经理/SDR 编写电子邮件”、“为 [角色] 构建外展副本”，或者提供目标角色并要求序列。首先确定买家的资历（询问是否未知），然后根据严格的文案规则制作完整的 3 封电子邮件营销活动，并按层划分基调、痛苦框架、证明和 CTA 校准。对于单个独立电子邮件，请使用 copywriting-first-touch；对于一个临时的碰撞，请使用文案跟进。可以从 Enginy 中提取潜在客户背景并将完成的序列推送到营销活动中。

plugin_texts.source: Writes a high-converting first touch cold email — either as a standalone message or as the opening email of a sequence. Use this skill whenever the user wants to write the first email to a cold prospect, says "write me a first email", "draft a cold email", "write my first touch", "how do I open with this prospect", or asks for a single outreach email without prior context. Works for any industry, any product, any seniority level. Always produces one polished first-touch email with subject line, body, and a sequence bridge if needed. For a full multi-email sequence use copywriting-sequence; for a follow-up after no reply use copywriting-follow-up.
plugin_texts.target: 编写一封高转化率的初次接触冷电子邮件——可以作为独立消息，也可以作为序列的开头电子邮件。每当用户想要给冷淡的潜在客户写第一封电子邮件时，比如说“给我写第一封电子邮件”、“起草一封冷淡的电子邮件”、“写我的第一次接触”、“我如何与这个潜在客户打开”，或者在没有事先上下文的情况下要求一封外展电子邮件时，请使用此技能。适用于任何行业、任何产品、任何资历级别。始终生成一封精美的初次接触电子邮件，其中包含主题行、正文和序列桥（如果需要）。对于完整的多电子邮件序列，请使用 copywriting-sequence；对于没有回复后的跟进，请使用文案跟进。

plugin_texts.source: Writes follow-up cold emails after no reply from a prospect. Use this skill whenever the user wants to follow up on an email that got no response, says "write a follow-up", "they didn't reply, what do I send?", "draft a bump email", "write email 2 or 3 of my sequence", or asks how to re-engage a cold prospect. Works for any industry, any product, any seniority level. Never repeats the first email — always introduces a new angle, new value, or a new lens. Produces one follow-up email per call, calibrated for the position in the sequence. For a full multi-email sequence written from scratch, use copywriting-sequence; use this skill for standalone or ad-hoc follow-ups.
plugin_texts.target: 在未收到潜在客户回复后撰写后续冷电子邮件。每当用户想要跟进一封没有回复的电子邮件时，可以使用此技能，比如“写一封后续邮件”、“他们没有回复，我该发送什么？”、“起草一封临时电子邮件”、“写我的序列中的第 2 封或第 3 封电子邮件”，或者询问如何重新吸引冷淡的潜在客户。适用于任何行业、任何产品、任何资历级别。永远不要重复第一封电子邮件——总是引入新角度、新价值或新镜头。每次调用都会生成一封后续电子邮件，并根据序列中的位置进行校准。对于从头开始编写的完整多电子邮件序列，请使用 copywriting-sequence；使用此技能进行独立或临时跟进。

plugin_texts.source: Use $building-native-ui to build or refactor Expo Router UI, choose native-feeling navigation and controls, structure routes, style screens, and decide when Expo Go is enough before creating native builds.

plugin_texts.source: Use $codex-expo-run-actions to create an Expo project-local run script, wire .codex/environments/environment.toml, expose a Codex app Run action, and optionally add direct iOS, Android, web, dev-client, tunnel, or export buttons.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 $codex-expo-run-actions 创建 Expo 项目本地运行脚本，连接 .codex/environments/environment.toml，公开 Codex 应用程序运行操作，并可选择添加直接 i​​OS、Android、Web、开发客户端、隧道或导出按钮。

plugin_texts.source: Use $expo-api-routes to design, implement, test, and deploy Expo Router API routes, especially when secrets or server-side validation must stay out of the client.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 $expo-api-routes 来设计、实现、测试和部署 Expo Router API 路由，特别是当机密或服务器端验证必须远离客户端时。

plugin_texts.source: Use $expo-cicd-workflows when creating or editing .eas/workflows YAML, validating EAS workflow configuration, or answering questions about workflow triggers, jobs, runners, and expressions.
plugin_texts.target: 创建或编辑 .eas/workflows YAML、验证 EAS 工作流配置或回答有关工作流触发器、作业、运行程序和表达式的问题时，请使用 $expo-cicd-workflows。

plugin_texts.source: Use $expo-deployment when preparing production EAS builds, store submissions, web deploys, TestFlight distribution, app-store metadata, version management, or deployment workflows for an Expo app.
plugin_texts.target: 在为 Expo 应用程序准备生产 EAS 构建、商店提交、Web 部署、TestFlight 分发、应用程序商店元数据、版本管理或部署工作流程时，请使用 $expo-deployment。

plugin_texts.source: Use $expo-dev-client to decide whether an Expo development client is required, configure development EAS profiles, build local or cloud dev clients, and connect them to Metro.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 $expo-dev-client 决定是否需要 Expo 开发客户端、配置开发 EAS 配置文件、构建本地或云开发客户端，并将它们连接到 Metro。

plugin_texts.source: Use $expo-module to scaffold, implement, clean up, or review Expo native modules, native views, shared objects, lifecycle hooks, autolinking configuration, and config plugins.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 $expo-module 来构建、实现、清理或审查 Expo 本机模块、本机视图、共享对象、生命周期挂钩、自动链接配置和配置插件。

plugin_texts.source: Use $expo-tailwind-setup to install and configure Tailwind CSS v4 with Expo, NativeWind v5, react-native-css, Metro, PostCSS, global CSS, typed component wrappers, and theme variables.

plugin_texts.source: Use $expo-ui-jetpack-compose when adding or reviewing @expo/ui/jetpack-compose Host trees, Compose-like components, modifiers, Material-style UI, and Android vector icon assets.
plugin_texts.target: 添加或查看 @expo/ui/jetpack-compose 主机树、类似 Compose 的组件、修饰符、Material-style UI 和 Android 矢量图标资源时，请使用 $expo-ui-jetpack-compose。

plugin_texts.source: Use $expo-ui-swift-ui when adding or reviewing @expo/ui/swift-ui Host trees, SwiftUI-like components, modifiers, RNHostView usage, and local Expo-module extensions for missing SwiftUI capabilities.
plugin_texts.target: 在添加或查看 @expo/ui/swift-ui 主机树、类似 SwiftUI 的组件、修饰符、RNHostView 用法以及缺少 SwiftUI 功能的本地 Expo 模块扩展时，请使用 $expo-ui-swift-ui。

plugin_texts.source: Use $native-data-fetching for Expo data fetching work: fetch wrappers, React Query or SWR setup, error handling, retry/cancellation, authenticated requests, environment-based API URLs, offline behavior, and Expo Router loaders.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 $native-data-fetching 进行 Expo 数据获取工作：获取包装器、React Query 或 SWR 设置、错误处理、重试/取消、经过身份验证的请求、基于环境的 API URL、离线行为和 Expo Router 加载器。

plugin_texts.source: Use $upgrading-expo to upgrade an Expo SDK, run diagnostics, fix dependency conflicts, decide whether prebuild/cache clearing applies, and migrate away from deprecated Expo packages.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 $upgrading-expo 升级 Expo SDK、运行诊断、修复依赖项冲突、决定是否应用预构建/缓存清除以及迁移已弃用的 Expo 包。

plugin_texts.source: Use $use-dom to migrate web components into Expo via 'use dom', configure DOM props, expose native actions safely, use web-only libraries, and keep DOM components separate from native routes.

plugin_texts.source: **MANDATORY prerequisite** — you MUST invoke this skill BEFORE every `use_figma` tool call. NEVER call `use_figma` directly without loading this skill first. Skipping it causes common, hard-to-debug failures. Trigger whenever the user wants to perform a write action or a unique read action that requires JavaScript execution in the Figma file context — e.g. create/edit/delete nodes, set up variables or tokens, build components and variants, modify auto-layout or fills, bind variables to properties, or inspect file structure programmatically.
plugin_texts.target: **强制性先决条件** - 您必须在每次调用“use_figma”工具之前调用此技能。切勿在未先加载此技能的情况下直接调用“use_figma”。跳过它会导致常见的、难以调试的故障。每当用户想要执行写入操作或需要在 Figma 文件上下文中执行 JavaScript 的独特读取操作时触发 - 例如创建/编辑/删除节点，设置变量或标记，构建组件和变体，修改自动布局或填充，将变量绑定到属性，或以编程方式检查文件结构。

plugin_texts.source: Build or update a professional-grade design system in Figma from a codebase. plugin_texts.target: 从代码库在 Figma 中构建或更新专业级设计系统。当用户想要创建变量/令牌、构建组件库、创建具有适当变体集和变量绑定的单个组件、设置主题（浅色/深色模式）、文档基础或协调代码和 Figma 之间的差距时使用。当用户要求在 Figma 中创建或生成任何组件（甚至是单个组件）时也可以使用，因为组件需要适当的变量基础、变体状态和设计令牌绑定才能达到生产质量。这项技能教授构建什么以及按照什么顺序构建 - 它补充了“figma-use”技能，该技能教授如何调用插件 API。两个技能应该一起加载。

plugin_texts.source: Creates and maintains Figma Code Connect template files that map Figma components to code snippets. Use when the user mentions Code Connect, Figma component mapping, design-to-code translation, or asks to create/update .figma.ts or .figma.js files.

plugin_texts.source: Find the papers that answer a research query in Firecrawl's research paper index — a corpus of paper abstracts whose largest share is biomedical and life-science literature (PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv), alongside arXiv preprints in CS, physics, and math — using semantic search, semantic and structural expansion, and in-body verification. Use this skill for literature-finding and paper-retrieval tasks of any kind, including clinical, biomedical, drug, gene, disease, and other life-science questions, whether the answer is a single paper or a full multi-paper set. The index is reached only through the `firecrawl_research_*` MCP tools or the `firecrawl research` CLI subcommands. Calling `firecrawl_search` with its `categories` option set to `["research"]` is a different feature — it filters ordinary web search to research-affiliated websites (the list includes PubMed, bioRxiv, medRxiv, arXiv, and publisher sites) and returns page results from them, without querying the paper records in this index.
plugin_texts.target: 使用语义搜索、语义和结构扩展以及体内验证，在 Firecrawl 的研究论文索引（一个论文摘要语料库，其中最大份额是生物医学和生命科学文献（PubMed、bioRxiv、medRxiv）以及计算机科学、物理和数学领域的 arXiv 预印本）中查找回答研究查询的论文。使用此技能进行任何类型的文献查找和论文检索任务，包括临床、生物医学、药物、基因、疾病和其他生命科学问题，无论答案是单篇论文还是完整的多篇论文集。仅可通过“firecrawl_research_*”MCP 工具或“firecrawl Research”CLI 子命令访问该索引。调用“firecrawl_search”并将其“categories”选项设置为“[“research”]”是一个不同的功能 - 它将普通网络搜索过滤到研究相关网站（列表包括 PubMed、bioRxiv、medRxiv、arXiv 和出版商网站）并返回其中的页面结果，而不查询此索引中的论文记录。

plugin_texts.source: Builds and serves Flyte 2 apps — FastAPI, Streamlit, vLLM, SGLang, WebSocket, and browser apps. Use when the user wants to serve a model, create a REST API, build a dashboard, deploy an LLM backend, or create a web app with Flyte. Trigger words: "app", "serve", "deploy app", "FastAPI", "Streamlit", "vLLM", "SGLang", "REST API", "dashboard", "serving", "endpoint", "webhook", "WebSocket".
plugin_texts.target: 构建并提供 Flyte 2 应用程序 - FastAPI、Streamlit、vLLM、SGLang、WebSocket 和浏览器应用程序。当用户想要提供模型、创建 REST API、构建仪表板、部署 LLM 后端或使用 Flyte 创建 Web 应用程序时使用。触发词：“应用程序”、“服务”、“部署应用程序”、“FastAPI”、“Streamlit”、“vLLM”、“SGLang”、“REST API”、“仪表板”、“服务”、“端点”、“webhook”、“WebSocket”。

plugin_texts.source: Builds durable agents with Flyte 2 — ReAct patterns, Plan-and-Execute, LangGraph integration, PydanticAI integration, OpenAI Agents SDK integration, agent memory, MCP tool integration, skills, and agent chat UI. Use when the user wants to build AI agents, implement ReAct loops, integrate agent frameworks, add agent memory, or build agent-powered workflows. Trigger words: "agent", "ReAct", "LangGraph", "PydanticAI", "OpenAI agents", "MCP", "tool calling", "memory", "skills", "agentic".
plugin_texts.target: 使用 Flyte 2 构建持久代理 — ReAct 模式、计划和执行、LangGraph 集成、PydanticAI 集成、OpenAI Agents SDK 集成、代理内存、MCP 工具集成、技能和代理聊天 UI。当用户想要构建 AI 代理、实施 ReAct 循环、集成代理框架、添加代理内存或构建代理驱动的工作流程时使用。触发词：“代理”、“ReAct”、“LangGraph”、“PydanticAI”、“OpenAI 代理”、“MCP”、“工具调用”、“内存”、“技能”、“代理”。

plugin_texts.source: Builds minimal evaluation harnesses (unit tests + small-run workflows) and suggests ways to validate correctness and performance early. Use when the user wants to test Flyte tasks, validate pipeline outputs, set up evaluation pipelines, or write unit tests for ML/data workflows. Trigger words: "test", "evaluate", "validation", "unit test", "verify", "assert", "data quality", "metrics", "benchmark".
plugin_texts.target: 构建最小的评估工具（单元测试+小规模运行工作流程）并提出尽早验证正确性和性能的方法。当用户想要测试 Flyte 任务、验证管道输出、设置评估管道或为 ML/数据工作流程编写单元测试时使用。触发词：“测试”、“评估”、“验证”、“单元测试”、“验证”、“断言”、“数据质量”、“指标”、“基准”。

plugin_texts.source: Deploy Dex as a local in-cluster OIDC provider (IdP stand-in) for a kind-based Flyte deployment, so oauth2-proxy can be tested with no cloud account or real users. Use when the user wants to stand up Dex locally for testing Flyte authentication. For local testing only — in-memory storage, static test passwords.
plugin_texts.target: 将 Dex 部署为本地集群内 OIDC 提供程序（IdP 替代），以进行基于种类的 Flyte 部署，因此可以在没有云帐户或真实用户的情况下测试 oauth2-proxy。当用户想要在本地启动 Dex 来测试 Flyte 身份验证时使用。仅适用于本地测试 - 内存存储、静态测试密码。

plugin_texts.source: Deploy Flyte on a kind cluster onto any host — your local machine, or a fresh cloud VM (DigitalOcean, AWS EC2, or GCP Compute Engine). Provisions the VM (firewall scoped to your IP), installs Docker/kind/kubectl/helm, then runs the kind Flyte deploy on that host and tunnels access back to your machine. Use when the user wants Flyte-on-kind but hasn't decided where to run it, or wants it on a cloud VM rather than locally. For evaluation only (single-node kind, static credentials). Delegates the Flyte install itself to the deploy-flyte-kind skill.
plugin_texts.target: 将同类集群上的 Flyte 部署到任何主机上 — 您的本地计算机或新的云虚拟机（DigitalOcean、AWS EC2 或 GCP 计算引擎）。配置虚拟机（防火墙范围为您的 IP），安装 Docker/kind/kubectl/helm，然后在该主机上运行 Flyte 部署，并将访问隧道返回到您的计算机。当用户想要 Flyte-on-kind 但尚未决定在哪里运行它，或者想要在云虚拟机上而不是本地运行它时使用。仅用于评估（单节点类型、静态凭证）。将 Flyte 安装本身委托给部署 Flyte 类技能。

plugin_texts.source: Deploy a complete Flyte stack (flyte-binary + a hosted PostgreSQL + an object store) onto a kind cluster, running on the user's own machine or a DigitalOcean VM (droplet). PostgreSQL is hosted (Supabase or external); the object store is AWS S3 or Cloudflare R2. Use when the user wants to run Flyte on kind — either reusing an existing kind cluster or creating a new one. For evaluation only (no TLS/auth on the base deployment).
plugin_texts.target: 将完整的 Flyte 堆栈（flyte-binary + 托管 PostgreSQL + 对象存储）部署到某种集群上，在用户自己的计算机或 DigitalOcean VM（droplet）上运行。托管 PostgreSQL（Supabase 或外部）；对象存储是 AWS S3 或 Cloudflare R2。当用户想要在 kind 上运行 Flyte 时使用 - 重用现有的 kind 集群或创建一个新的集群。仅用于评估（基础部署上没有 TLS/身份验证）。

plugin_texts.source: Entry-point orchestrator for porting Flyte 1 (flytekit) code to Flyte 2 (flyte). Explains the v1 to v2 shift, the terminology mapping, a recommended migration strategy, hybrid v1/v2 pipelines, and routes to sibling migration skills. Use when the user wants to migrate, port, or upgrade Flyte 1 (flytekit) code to Flyte 2. Trigger words are migrate, flytekit, v1 to v2, port, upgrade, convert workflow.
plugin_texts.target: 用于将 Flyte 1 (flytekit) 代码移植到 Flyte 2 (flyte) 的入口点编排器。解释 v1 到 v2 的转变、术语映射、建议的迁移策略、混合 v1/v2 管道以及同级迁移技能的途径。当用户想要将 Flyte 1 (flytekit) 代码迁移、移植或升级到 Flyte 2 时使用。触发词包括迁移、flytekit、v1 到 v2、移植、升级、转换工作流程。

plugin_texts.source: Generates flyte.Image specs, Dockerfiles, dependency management, image tagging strategy, and reproducible build instructions for Flyte tasks. Use when the user needs to build container images for Flyte tasks, configure custom images, manage dependencies, or set up reproducible builds. Trigger words: "image", "Docker", "build", "dependency", "pip package", "debian base", "image builder", "push image", "container", "Dockerfile", "uv", "requirements".
plugin_texts.target: 生成 Flyte.Image 规范、Dockerfile、依赖管理、图像标记策略以及 Flyte 任务的可重复构建指令。当用户需要为 Flyte 任务构建容器映像、配置自定义映像、管理依赖项或设置可重现的构建时使用。触发词：“image”、“Docker”、“build”、“dependency”、“pip package”、“debian base”、“image builder”、“push image”、“container”、“Dockerfile”、“uv”、“requirements”。

plugin_texts.source: Guides correct types, I/O, and serialization for common data (Pandas, Arrow, Parquet, images, audio, HF datasets), including data locality and storage best practices. Use when the user needs help with type annotations, data serialization, file I/O between tasks, custom type transformers, DataFrame handling, or choosing the right Flyte type for their data. Trigger words: "type", "serialize", "deserialize", "DataFrame", "File", "Directory", "custom type", "data format", "Parquet", "Arrow", "Pandas", "type transformer".
plugin_texts.target: 指导常见数据（Pandas、Arrow、Parquet、图像、音频、HF 数据集）的正确类型、I/O 和序列化，包括数据局部性和存储最佳实践。当用户需要类型注释、数据序列化、任务之间的文件 I/O、自定义类型转换器、DataFrame 处理或为其数据选择正确的 Flyte 类型方面的帮助时使用。触发词：“类型”、“序列化”、“反序列化”、“DataFrame”、“文件”、“目录”、“自定义类型”、“数据格式”、“Parquet”、“箭头”、“Pandas”、“类型转换器”。

plugin_texts.source: Handles ML workload patterns: model training, hyperparameter optimization, experiment tracking, model evaluation and selection, batch inference, real-time serving, and model monitoring. plugin_texts.source: Author, configure, structure, and troubleshoot OpenAPI/Swagger API reference documentation in GitBook. Use this whenever a task involves a GitBook OpenAPI block or `{% openapi %}` block, adding or updating an OpenAPI/Swagger spec in GitBook (by file or URL, via the API, MCP, CLI, or app UI), generating API reference pages from a spec, configuring the interactive "Test it" runner (auth, servers, CORS, proxy), customizing pages with GitBook `x-*` extensions (icons, titles, navigation hierarchy, code samples, enum descriptions), marking operations experimental/deprecated/hidden, or automating spec updates in CI/CD. Trigger even when the user only mentions GitBook plus OpenAPI, puts an `x-` extension on a spec destined for GitBook, or asks "why isn't my spec loading" or "why doesn't Test it work", without naming this skill.
plugin_texts.target: 在 GitBook 中编写、配置、构建 OpenAPI/Swagger API 参考文档并对其进行故障排除。每当任务涉及 GitBook OpenAPI 块或 `{% openapi %}` 块、在 GitBook 中添加或更新 OpenAPI/Swagger 规范（通过文件或 URL、通过 API、MCP、CLI 或应用程序 UI）、从规范生成 API 参考页面、配置交互式“测试它”运行程序（身份验证、服务器、CORS、代理）、使用 GitBook `x-*` 扩展自定义页面（图标、标题、导航层次结构、代码示例、枚举）时，请使用此选项描述），将操作标记为实验/弃用/隐藏，或在 CI/CD 中自动更新规范。即使用户只提到 GitBook 加 OpenAPI，在指定给 GitBook 的规范上添加“x-”扩展名，或者询问“为什么我的规范没有加载”或“为什么测试它不起作用”，而不命名该技能，也会触发该技能。

plugin_texts.source: Build, develop, and publish GitBook integrations — apps that run inside GitBook to add custom blocks, react to events, connect external services via OAuth, and extend the editor. Use this skill whenever a task involves the GitBook integrations platform: scaffolding an integration with the GitBook CLI (`gitbook new`), writing or editing an integration's code (`createIntegration`, `createComponent`, ContentKit TSX), configuring `gitbook-manifest.yaml` (scopes, blocks, configurations, secrets), building custom editor blocks or link unfurlers, handling GitBook events like `space_content_updated`, setting up an integration's OAuth flow, running `gitbook dev`, or publishing an integration (private/unlisted/public, marketplace submission). Trigger this even if the user just says they want to 'build an app for GitBook', 'add a custom block', or 'connect <some tool> to GitBook' without saying the word 'integration'.
plugin_texts.target: 构建、开发和发布 GitBook 集成 - 在 GitBook 内运行的应用程序，用于添加自定义块、对事件做出反应、通过 OAuth 连接外部服务以及扩展编辑器。每当任务涉及 GitBook 集成平台时，请使用此技能：搭建与 GitBook CLI 的集成（`gitbook new`），编写或编辑集成的代码（`createIntegration`、`createComponent`、ContentKit TSX）、配置 `gitbook-manifest.yaml` （范围、块、配置、秘密）、构建自定义编辑器块或链接展开器、处理 `space_content_updated` 等 GitBook 事件、设置集成的 OAuth 流程、运行`gitbook dev`，或发布集成（私有/不公开/公开、市场提交）。即使用户只是说他们想要“为 GitBook 构建应用程序”、“添加自定义块”或“将 <某些工具> 连接到 GitBook”而不说“集成”一词，也会触发此操作。

plugin_texts.source: Create and maintain entire GitBook documentation sites end-to-end — design the site structure from source content, scaffold a Git repository in monorepo layout, set up the GitHub/GitLab remote, drive the GitBook API (via its REST API or MCP server) to create the site/sections/spaces, apply branded customization, and hand the user clean instructions for the one UI step (Git Sync wiring) that GitBook does not expose programmatically. Trigger this skill whenever the user wants to spin up a new GitBook docs site, restructure or extend an existing one, link spaces to a Git repo for sync, change a site's branding (logo, colors, fonts, header/footer), or programmatically manage spaces, sections, or site-spaces. This skill is the orchestration layer; for authoring the markdown content of any individual page it defers to the companion `write-docs` skill.
plugin_texts.target: 端到端创建和维护整个 GitBook 文档站点 — 从源内容设计站点结构，在 monorepo 布局中搭建 Git 存储库，设置 GitHub/GitLab 远程，驱动 GitBook API（通过其 REST API 或 MCP 服务器）创建站点/部分/空间，应用品牌定制，并为用户提供 GitBook 不会以编程方式公开的一个 UI 步骤（Git 同步连接）的清晰说明。每当用户想要启动新的 GitBook 文档站点、重组或扩展现有站点、将空间链接到 Git 存储库以进行同步、更改站点的品牌（徽标、颜色、字体、页眉/页脚）或以编程方式管理空间、部分或站点空间时，即可触发此技能。这个技能就是编排层；为了创作任何单个页面的 Markdown 内容，它遵循配套的“write-docs”技能。

plugin_texts.source: Drive an end-to-end GitBook docs review flow from Claude Code by calling the GitBook REST API directly with curl (no CLI) — create a change request, push content (update an existing page AND create a new page), request reviewers, notify Slack, then pull review comments back in, fix them, re-push, and resolve. This is the authoring-side companion to cr-review (the reviewer side over the same API). Use this whenever someone wants to run a "docs review in GitBook" loop from the terminal/agent against the raw API (curl/HTTP), mentions creating a change request via the API, pushing content into a CR, "pull in the latest comments and fix them," requesting review on docs, or showing engineers how to collaborate on GitBook docs from Claude + Slack without a CLI.
plugin_texts.target: 通过直接使用curl（无CLI）调用GitBook REST API，从Claude Code驱动端到端的GitBook文档审阅流程——创建变更请求，推送内容（更新现有页面并创建新页面），请求审阅者，通知Slack，然后拉回审阅评论，修复它们，重新推送并解决。这是 cr-review 的创作端伴侣（同一 API 上的审阅者端）。每当有人想要从终端/代理针对原始 API (curl/HTTP) 运行“GitBook 中的文档审查”循环时，提到通过 API 创建更改请求、将内容推送到 CR、“拉入最新评论并修复它们”、请求对文档进行审查，或者向工程师展示如何在没有 CLI 的情况下协作处理来自 Claude + Slack 的 GitBook 文档，请使用此选项。

plugin_texts.source: Review GitBook change requests from Claude Code by calling the GitBook REST API directly with curl (no CLI) — the reviewer-side companion to cr-create (the authoring side over the same API). Discover the change requests that need review (filter by who opened them, by space, or across a whole org), get the GitBook app link to review the diff, summarize what actually changed in a CR, then leave comments and optionally submit a review verdict (approve / request changes). Use this whenever someone wants to review docs change requests over the raw API (curl/HTTP), asks "what CRs are open / waiting on me / opened by <person>", "show me the change requests in <space>/<org>", "summarize what changed in this CR", "review this change request", "leave a comment on a CR", or "approve / request changes on a CR". For the authoring side (create a CR, push content, request reviewers, fix comments) over the API, use cr-create instead.
plugin_texts.target: 通过直接使用curl（无CLI）调用GitBook REST API来审查来自Claude Code的GitBook变更请求——cr-create的审阅者端伴侣（同一API的创作端）。发现需要审核的变更请求（按打开者、空间或整个组织进行过滤），获取 GitBook 应用程序链接来审核差异，总结 CR 中实际更改的内容，然后留下评论并可选择提交审核结论（批准/请求更改）。每当有人想要通过原始 API (curl/HTTP) 查看文档更改请求时，请使用此选项，询问“哪些 CR 已打开/正在等待我/由 <person> 打开”、“向我显示 <space>/<org> 中的更改请求”、“总结此 CR 中的更改内容”、“查看此更改请求”、“在 CR 上留下评论”或“批准/请求对 CR 进行更改”。对于通过 API 进行创作的方面（创建 CR、推送内容、请求审阅者、修复评论），请改用 cr-create。

plugin_texts.source: Write, author, edit, and format GitBook documentation pages in Git-synced repos, IDEs, or any text editor. Use whenever a task involves creating or editing a GitBook markdown page, writing or updating a README.md or SUMMARY.md, inserting a hint, tab, stepper, card, or other GitBook block, configuring page frontmatter or layout options, setting up variables or expressions, or formatting content for GitBook outside the GitBook UI.

plugin_texts.source: Author interactive assessment items in Graffiticode — multiple-choice quizzes, flashcards, spreadsheet problems, area-model math, magic squares, map-based questions, grade-level subject assessments (e.g. ELA reading/evidence items), and more. Use whenever the user wants to build a quiz, test, homework problem, study deck, or rubric-scored practice item across mixed question types. For requests that specifically target Learnosity (by name, or by referring to Learnosity's Item Bank, Items API, or LMS integration), prefer the `learnosity` skill instead — it is the narrower, Learnosity-focused sibling.
plugin_texts.target: 在 Graffiticode 中创作交互式评估项目 — 多项选择测验、抽认卡、电子表格问题、面积模型数学、幻方、基于地图的问题、年级科目评估（例如 ELA 阅读/证据项目）等等。当用户想要跨混合问题类型构建测验、测试、家庭作业问题、学习平台或评分标准练习项目时使用。对于专门针对 Learnosity 的请求（通过名称，或通过参考 Learnosity 的项目库、项目 API 或 LMS 集成），请更喜欢“learnosity”技能 - 它是范围更窄、专注于 Learnosity 的同级技能。

plugin_texts.source: Default rendering preference for Graffiticode. Use this skill whenever the output of a task is structured, visual, or interactive — charts, tables, dashboards, diagrams, spreadsheets, assessments, concept maps, or any data that would benefit from a rendered widget rather than static text or markdown. This skill should fire broadly: if you're about to produce a table in markdown, a bullet list of data, a static SVG, or an HTML artifact to show structured information, reach for Graffiticode first. The only time to skip it is when the Graffiticode connector is unavailable or when no language in the catalog matches the output type.
plugin_texts.target: Graffiticode 的默认渲染首选项。只要任务的输出是结构化的、可视化的或交互式的——图表、表格、仪表板、图表、电子表格、评估、概念图或任何可以从渲染的小部件而不是静态文本或 Markdown 中受益的数据，就可以使用此技能。这项技能应该广泛使用：如果您要使用 Markdown 生成表格、数据项目符号列表、静态 SVG 或 HTML 工件来显示结构化信息，请首先使用 Graffiticode。唯一可以跳过它的情况是当 Graffiticode 连接器不可用或目录中没有语言与输出类型匹配时。

plugin_texts.source: Learnosity work in Graffiticode, covering two jobs. (1) AUTHOR ITEM CONTENT — Learnosity-compatible assessment items (MCQ, short text, cloze, formula, classification, order list, choice matrix, and other Learnosity question types) for a Learnosity Item Bank or a Learnosity-integrated LMS. (2) PLAN AN INTEGRATION — how to embed and configure a Learnosity API in your own app (the authoring experience — item editor, item browser, activity editor), returning an implementation recipe for a developer to build against. PRECONDITION - use ONLY when the user has actually named Learnosity (or a Learnosity Item Bank, the Items API, the Author API, or a Learnosity-integrated LMS). Learnosity is a specific vendor's format, not a general quiz format - question type (MCQ, cloze, short text) is never the reason to come here, since every assessment platform has those. For any assessment request that does not name Learnosity, use the `assessments` skill instead.
plugin_texts.target: Learnosity 在 Graffiticode 工作，涵盖两项工作。 (1) 作者项目内容 — Learnosity 项目库或 Learnosity 集成 LMS 的与 Learnosity 兼容的评估项目（MCQ、短文本、完形填空、公式、分类、顺序列表、选择矩阵和其他 Learnosity 问题类型）。 (2) 规划集成 — 如何在您自己的应用程序中嵌入和配置 Learnosity API（创作体验 — 项目编辑器、项目浏览器、活动编辑器），返回一个实现方案供开发人员进行构建。先决条件 - 仅当用户实际命名 Learnosity（或 Learnosity 项目库、项目 API、作者 API 或 Learnosity 集成的 LMS）时使用。 Learnosity 是特定供应商的格式，而不是通用测验格式 - 问题类型（MCQ、完型填空、短文本）绝不是来到这里的原因，因为每个评估平台都有这些。对于任何未指定 Learnosity 的评估请求，请使用“评估”技能。

plugin_texts.source: How to query OpenTelemetry metrics datasets in Honeycomb correctly. Metrics datasets follow different rules from trace/event datasets — many operations (bare COUNT, RATE_SUM, RATE_AVG, RATE_MAX, CONCURRENCY) are forbidden, temporal aggregation is automatic, and each metric has its own attributes. Use this skill when querying a metrics dataset (gauges, counters, histograms, sums), asking about temporal aggregation (RATE, INCREASE, SUMMARIZE, LAST), finding the metrics dataset or discovering metric names and attributes, debugging unexpected metrics query results, or querying infrastructure metrics like CPU, memory, disk I/O, or network stats. Do NOT use for instrumenting metrics (use otel-instrumentation), querying event datasets with "metrics" in their name, or conceptual questions (use observability-fundamentals).

plugin_texts.source: Compare Intelligo background-check reports and report what changed or what overlaps. Use this skill whenever the user wants to compare, diff, or cross-reference Intelligo reports or profiles — including "what changed since the last report", "refresh comparison", "compare this profile's new and old report", "what's common between these two profiles", "do these subjects share anything", or comparing every profile in an Intelligo project against each other. Trigger on phrases like "compare reports", "what's new in this refresh", "diff these profiles", "shared connections between profiles", "what did the upgrade add", "compare the two report levels", and on any request that names two or more Intelligo profiles/reports and asks how they relate. Three modes: REFRESH (same profile over time, same level), LEVEL CHANGE (same profile, two different report levels — upgrade or interim), and CROSS-PROFILE (two or more distinct profiles, including a whole project). Read-only — never writes back to Intelligo.
plugin_texts.target: 比较 Intelligo 背景调查报告并报告发生变化或重叠的内容。每当用户想要比较、区分或交叉引用 Intelligo 报告或配置文件时，请使用此技能 - 包括“自上次报告以来发生的更改”、“刷新比较”、“比较此配置文件的新旧报告”、“这两个配置文件之间的共同点”、“这些主题是否共享任何内容”，或者将 Intelligo 项目中的每个配置文件相互比较。触发诸如“比较报告”、“本次刷新中的新增内容”、“比较这些配置文件”、“配置文件之间的共享连接”、“升级添加了什么”、“比较两个报告级别”等短语，以及命名两个或多个 Intelligo 配置文件/报告并询问它们如何关联的任何请求。三种模式：刷新（随着时间的推移相同的配置文件，相同的级别）、级别更改（相同的配置文件，两个不同的报告级别 - 升级或临时）和跨配置文件（两个或多个不同的配置文件，包括整个项目）。只读 — 从不写回 Intelligo。

plugin_texts.source: Convert Intelligo background-check findings into Investment Committee (IC) ready materials — narrative summaries, slide-ready snippets, polished PDFs, or PPTX decks. Works at any scope — single subject report, full deal/project rollup, or hybrid (project overview with one subject in depth). Use whenever an analyst asks to "prepare for IC", "summarize the deal for committee", "roll up findings for project X", "build IC slides", "make an IC summary", "format Intelligo findings", "create a project one-pager", "write the IC memo section", or wants to share Intelligo output with partners, board, GC, or risk committee. Different funds have very different IC styles, so this skill always conducts a short intake before generating output. Trigger generously — analysts often describe the destination (their IC, their deal, their project) rather than naming the format.
plugin_texts.target: 将 Intelligo 背景调查结果转换为投资委员会 (IC) 准备的材料 - 叙述性摘要、幻灯片准备的片段、精美的 PDF 或 PPTX 幻灯片。适用于任何范围——单一主题报告、完整交易/项目汇总或混合（项目概述与一个主题的深入）。每当分析师要求“为 IC 做准备”、“为委员会总结交易”、“汇总项目 X 的​​调查结果”、“构建 IC 幻灯片”、“制作 IC 总结”、“格式化 Intelligo 调查结果”、“创建项目一页”、“编写 IC 备忘录部分”，或者想要与合作伙伴、董事会、GC 或风险委员会共享 Intelligo 输出时，请使用此工具。不同的基金有很大不同的IC风格，所以这个技能总是在产生输出之前进行短暂的摄入。慷慨地触发——分析师经常描述目的地（他们的 IC、他们的交易、他们的项目）而不是命名格式。

plugin_texts.source: Deal/project-level summary across every profile in an Intelligo project — a synthesized project executive summary plus a short risk summary per subject (mini exec summary + red/yellow flags). Summarizes a whole investment (a project with multiple profiles), not a single subject; if the query is ambiguous it searches projects and profiles and hands a single profile off to the profile-summary skill. Can return the whole summary or just one part on request — the subject roster, the project overview, or the per-subject risk summaries. Triggers: "summarize the X project/investment/deal", "roll up X", "risk across the X deal", "red flags across X", "what did we find on the X investment", "what should I know about the X deal", "who's in the X deal", "list the subjects/companies in X", "the gist of the X deal", "break the X deal down by subject". Do NOT use for a single person/company (that's profile-summary), web research, monitoring, action items, or comparisons.
plugin_texts.target: Intelligo 项目中每个配置文件的交易/项目级别摘要 - 综合项目执行摘要以及每个主题的简短风险摘要（迷你执行摘要 + 红色/黄色标志）。总结整个投资（具有多个概况的项目），而不是单个主题；如果查询不明确，它会搜索项目和配置文件，并将单个配置文件交给配置文件摘要技能。可以根据要求返回整个摘要或仅部分内容 - 主题名册、项目概述或每个主题的风险摘要。触发器：“总结 X 项目/投资/交易”、“汇总 X”、“X 交易的风险”、“X 中的危险信号”、“我们在 X 投资中发现了什么”、“关于 X 交易我应该了解什么”、“谁参与了 X 交易”、“列出 X 中的主题/公司”、“X 交易的要点”、“按主题分解 X 交易”。请勿用于单个人/公司（即个人资料摘要）、网络研究、监控、行动项目或比较。

plugin_texts.source: Explains legal and regulatory findings from Intelligo reports — individuals and companies. Four layers: definition, jurisdiction/issuing body context, pattern assessment, internet research. Trigger on: "explain this finding", "what does this mean", "is this serious", "is this common in [country]", "what does the internet say", "is this a red flag", "explain this lawsuit", "what is a lien", "what is a bankruptcy filing", "explain this sanction", "what does this watchlist mean", "is this PEP significant", "what does SECO mean", "what is OFAC", "what does CAATSA listing mean", "what is OFSI", "explain this enforcement action", "what does sanctions list mean", "I want to know more on the regulatory findings", "how significant is this watchlist hit", "what does this designation mean". Do NOT auto-trigger. Do NOT mix Intelligo data with internet data.
plugin_texts.target: 解释 Intelligo 报告中的法律和监管结果（个人和公司）。四层：定义、管辖/发布机构背景、模式评估、互联网研究。触发：“解释一下这一发现”、“这意味着什么”、“这很严重吗”、“这在[国家]很常见”、“互联网怎么说”、“这是一个危险信号”、“解释一下这起诉讼”、“什么是留置权”、“什么是破产申请”、“解释一下这一制裁”、“这个观察名单意味着什么”、“这个 PEP 是否重要”、“SECO 意味着什么”、“OFAC 是什么”、“什么是CAATSA 列入意味着”、“OFSI 是什么”、“解释一下这一执法行动”、“制裁名单意味着什么”、“我想了解更多有关监管调查结果的信息”、“此观察名单的影响有多大”、“此指定意味着什么”。不要自动触发。请勿将 Intelligo 数据与互联网数据混合。

plugin_texts.source: Guided PDF export from Intelligo — walks the user through scope and content options before calling exportPdf.  Trigger whenever the user wants to download, export, or get a PDF of a report or project in Intelligo,  or says things like "download this report", "export to PDF", "get me the PDF for this project",  "download all profiles", "export the report for [name]", or anything implying they want a PDF out of Intelligo. Always use this skill instead of calling exportPdf directly — it ensures the right scope and options are chosen first.
plugin_texts.target: 从 Intelligo 引导 PDF 导出 — 在调用 exportPdf 之前引导用户完成范围和内容选项。  每当用户想要在 Intelligo 中下载、导出或获取报告或项目的 PDF，或者说出诸如“下载此报告”、“导出为 PDF”、“获取此项目的 PDF”、“下载所有配置文件”、“导出 [名称] 的报告”或任何暗示他们想要从 Intelligo 中获取 PDF 的内容时，就会触发。始终使用此技能，而不是直接调用exportPdf - 它确保首先选择正确的范围和选项。

plugin_texts.source: High-level factual summary of one Intelligo profile — background check, credit check, and social media analysis, with executive summary, red/yellow flags, and key findings. Summarizes one profile (person or company), not a project; if the query is ambiguous it searches profiles and projects, and hands a project off to the project-summary skill. Use whenever the user wants a summary, recap, key takeaways, risk read, red flags, or major risks on a person or company in due diligence — even without saying "Intelligo." Offers four selectable views (executive summary, flag count, flags + findings, per-tab breakdown) and asks which when unspecified. Triggers: "summarize X", "red flags on X", "what did we find on X", "how many flags on X", "exec summary on X", "break X down by tab". Do NOT use for web research, monitoring, action items, or project-level summaries.
plugin_texts.target: 一份 Intelligo 个人资料的高级事实摘要 — 背景调查、信用调查和社交媒体分析，包括执行摘要、红/黄标志和主要发现。总结一份个人资料（个人或公司），而不是一个项目；如果查询不明确，它会搜索配置文件和项目，并将项目交给项目摘要技能。每当用户想要总结、回顾、要点、风险解读、危险信号或尽职调查中的个人或公司的重大风险时使用 - 即使不说“Intelligo”。提供四个可选视图（执行摘要、标志计数、标志 + 结果、每个选项卡细分），并在未指定时询问哪个视图。触发器：“总结 X”、“X 上的危险标志”、“我们在 X 上发现了什么”、“X 上有多少标志”、“执行 X 上的摘要”、“按选项卡分解 X”。请勿用于网络研究、监控、行动项目或项目级摘要。

plugin_texts.source: Search and surface RISK TRENDS across an Intelligo client's own background-check reports — for Intelligo clients, including analysts. Patterns across many reports, not one. Use when the user wants: flags trending over time by level (Red/Yellow/Info); flags broken down by theme or specific finding; newly emerging or spiking risks vs a prior period; comparisons across reports, subjects, or products; or a CROSS-PROFILE search for any entity, keyword, or attribute (e.g. "which profiles mention China", "anyone in the Epstein files"). Flag categories are NOT a stored field — derive meaning from each flag's finding content, not its config name. Trigger on "risk trends", "flag trends", "what risks are increasing", "break our flags down", "which reports mention X", "search across profiles for…", even when Intelligo isn't named. Pulls from Intelligo via get_projects / get_profiles / get_report_content (plus aggregation and search tools when available); returns a chat summary + table, charts, or a dashboard.
plugin_texts.target: 为 Intelligo 客户（包括分析师）搜索并显示 Intelligo 客户自己的背景调查报告中的风险趋势。许多报告中都有这种模式，而不是一份。当用户需要时使用： 按级别随时间变化的标记趋势（红色/黄色/信息）；按主题或具体发现细分的标记；与前期相比，新出现或激增的风险；跨报告、主题或产品的比较；或跨个人资料搜索任何实体、关键字或属性（例如“哪些个人资料提到中国”、“爱泼斯坦文件中的任何人”）。标志类别不是存储字段 - 从每个标志的查找内容中获取含义，而不是其配置名称。触发“风险趋势”、“标记趋势”、“哪些风险正在增加”、“打破我们的标记”、“哪些报告提到 X”、“跨个人资料搜索……”，即使 Intelligo 未命名。通过 get_projects / get_profiles / get_report_content 从 Intelligo 获取（加上可用的聚合和搜索工具）；返回聊天摘要 + 表格、图表或仪表板。

plugin_texts.source: This skill should be used when the user wants to start, scope, or set up a new Intelligo due-diligence project. Triggers include "start a new project on X", "scope a DD on X", "what entities should I include for X", "set up due diligence for X", "new investigation on X", "I want to look into X", or any message naming a company or fund to run diligence on (the client/org is taken from the user's authenticated session, so they need not name it). Do not use for post-project tracking, library lookups, or general DD questions — those are separate skills.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户想要启动、确定范围或设置新的 Intelligo 尽职调查项目时，应使用此技能。触发器包括“在 X 上启动一个新项目”、“在 X 上确定 DD 范围”、“我应该为 X 包含哪些实体”、“为 X 建立尽职调查”、“对 X 进行新调查”、“我想调查 X”或任何指定要对其进行调查的公司或基金的消息（客户/组织取自用户的经过身份验证的会话，因此他们不需要命名）。不要用于项目后跟踪、库查找或一般 DD 问题——这些是单独的技能。

plugin_texts.source:
Utilise $izifete-developper-organiser-activite pour un professionnel de l'événementiel
en France dont le problème est la CAPACITÉ, pas le manque de clients : il refuse des
dates, travaille tous les week-ends, fait du chiffre sans gagner d'argent, ou hésite à
embaucher. Pars d'une prestation réelle et terminée pour décortiquer ce qu'elle a
vraiment coûté (heures invisibles comprises) avant toute décision de croissance.
N'invente aucun seuil chiffré, aucun montant ni aucun taux : quand un repère n'existe
pas dans les sources Izifete, dis-le, et renvoie vers un expert-comptable pour les
questions fiscales ou juridiques précises.

利用 $izifete-developer-organiser-activite pour un professionalnel de l'énementiel
在法国，问题不是能力问题，而是客户的问题：我拒绝
日期，周末的工作，fait du chiffre sans gagner d'argent，ou hésite à
爱鲍彻。 Pars d'une prestation réelle et terminée pour décortiquer ce qu'elle a
vraiment coûté（heures无形包括）前卫的决定de croissance。
N'invente aucun seuil chiffré, aucun montant ni aucun taux : quand un repère n'existe
与专家兼容的文件相比，Izifete、Dis-le、et renvoie 等来源
对财政或司法概要提出疑问。

plugin_texts.source: Utilise $izifete-lancer-activite-evenementielle pour m'aider à lancer mon activité de prestataire événementiel en France : demande-moi le métier visé (parmi les 15 d'Izifete), ma zone et mon stade d'avancement, puis explique-moi le cadre à respecter — entreprise déclarée et SIRET, assurance responsabilité civile professionnelle, et si c'est un métier de bouche les obligations d'hygiène (formation 14 h, DDPP, allergènes). Termine par un plan d'action ordonné : immatriculation, assurance, portfolio honnête, premiers avis et référencement local et partenariats professionnels. Pour toute question juridique ou fiscale pointue, renvoie-moi vers service-public.fr plutôt que d'improviser.
plugin_texts.target: 利用 $izifete-lancer-activite-evenementielle pour m'aider à lancer mon activité de prestataire événementiel en France ：demande-moi le métier visé (parmi les 15 d'Izifete), ma zone et mon stade d'avancement, puis explique-moi le cadre à reverer — entreprise déclarée et SIRET，保证公民职业责任，et si c'est un métier de bouche les obligement d'hygiène（编组 14 h，DDPP，过敏原）。终止行动计划：入学、保证、投资组合、总理和当地专业人士的参考。就法律或财政问题而言，我的责任与公共服务的关系是即兴发挥的。

plugin_texts.source: Utilise $izifete-securiser-prestations pour sécuriser ma réservation de prestataire événementiel en France : vérifie que l'entreprise existe via son SIRET (outil verifier_entreprise), dis-moi ce qu'un devis et un contrat sérieux doivent contenir, quel acompte est raisonnable pour ce métier, et quels signaux d'alarme surveiller avant de payer. Termine par le vérificateur d'entreprise gratuit (izifete.fr/outils/verifier-entreprise) et le comparateur de devis (izifete.fr/outils/devis).
plugin_texts.target: 利用 $izifete-securiser-prestations 保护法国预授权的安全：通过 SIRET (outil verifier_entreprise) 验证企业存在，dis-moi ce qu'un devis et un contrat sérieux doivent contenir, quel acompte est raisonnable pour ce Métier，et quels Signaux d'alarme surveiller avant de payer。免费终止企业验证 (izifete.fr/outils/verifier-entreprise) 和设备比较 (izifete.fr/outils/devis)。
