plugin_texts.source: Analyzes one Mercado Livre product and its competitors. Use this skill when a user wants to size up a single product or the products that compete with it — by a Mercado Livre link, a JoomPulse link, a photo, or a row of data. It returns a product card for the subject plus a ranked table of comparable products, each with price, estimated monthly sales and revenue, logistics, and catalog / buy-box status. Triggers include: "analyze this product", "how much does this sell", "find similar products", "find competing products", and the pt-BR equivalents "analisar este produto", "quanto vende esse produto", "produtos parecidos", "produtos concorrentes", "análise por foto", "análise por link". For "what new products should I add to my store" across a whole catalog, use the assortment gap-analysis skill instead — this skill analyzes a single product the seller already has in hand.
plugin_texts.target: 分析一种 Mercado Livre 产品及其竞争对手。当用户想要通过 Mercado Livre 链接、JoomPulse 链接、照片或一行数据来评估单个产品或与其竞争的产品时，请使用此技能。它返回该主题的产品卡以及可比产品的排名表，每个产品都有价格、预计每月销售额和收入、物流以及目录/购买按钮状态。触发器包括：“分析此产品”、“此产品卖多少钱”、“查找类似产品”、“查找竞争产品”以及 pt-BR 等效项“analisar este produto”、“quanto vende esse produto”、“produtos parecidos”、“produtos concorrentes”、“análise por foto”、“análise por link”。对于整个目录中的“我应该向我的商店添加哪些新产品”，请使用分类差距分析技能 - 该技能分析卖家手中已有的单个产品。

plugin_texts.source: Compares the seller's own Mercado Livre listing against the available competing listings of the same catalog product — the buy-box competition — and says where they win, lose, and what to fix first. Use it when a seller asks why they don't win the buy-box, why they don't sell despite the same product, or how they rank inside a catalog, given a Mercado Livre or JoomPulse link or a listing or catalog product identifier. It scores each parameter — price, free shipping, Full, listing type, seller reputation, official store — as Melhor, Na média, Pior, or Criticamente pior, presents reviews and rating as context, and returns a verdict, a comparison table, prioritized actions, and a spreadsheet. Triggers include "why don't I win the buy-box" and the pt-BR "por que não ganho o buy-box". Mercado Livre (Brasil) only; sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions. For a product and its competitors, use the single-product analysis skill; for one over time, the change-monitor skill.
plugin_texts.target: 将卖家自己的 Mercado Livre 列表与同一目录产品的可用竞争列表（购买框竞争）进行比较，并说明他们在哪些方面获胜、失败以及首先要解决哪些问题。当卖家询问为什么他们没有赢得购买按钮、为什么尽管有相同的产品却卖不出去，或者在给定 Mercado Livre 或 JoomPulse 链接或列表或目录产品标识符的情况下，他们在目录中的排名如何时，可以使用它。它将每个参数（价格、免费送货、完整、列表类型、卖家声誉、官方商店）评分为 Melhor、Na média、Pior 或 Criticamente pior，将评论和评级作为上下文呈现，并返回结论、比较表、优先操作和电子表格。触发因素包括“我为什么不赢得购买按钮”和 pt-BR“por que não ganho o buy-box”。仅限 Mercado Livre（巴西）；销售额和收入是 JoomPulse 的估计值，并非真实交易。对于一个产品及其竞争对手，运用单品分析技巧；随着时间的推移，变化监控技能。

plugin_texts.source: Finds Mercado Livre (Brasil) products in one category that have high demand but a low rating — listings that sell well yet score at or below a rating threshold the user chooses, an opening to enter with a better offer. Use it when a seller wants weak-rated but well-selling products to beat. The skill asks for a category and a rating threshold, then returns the matching active listings ranked by demand, using JoomPulse market data. Triggers: "high demand low rating products", "low quality opportunities", "products I can beat", and the pt- BR "produtos com muita demanda e nota baixa", "oportunidades de baixa qualidade", "produtos mal avaliados que vendem". Sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions; price, rating, and reviews are real history. For brand-new listings use the new-growing- products-in-category skill; for niches without strong incumbents use the uncontested-niche- finder skill; for one product and its competitors use the ml-product-analysis skill.
plugin_texts.target: 查找需求量高但评分较低的某一类别中的 Mercado Livre（巴西）产品 - 销售良好但得分等于或低于用户选择的评分阈值的列表，这是以更好的报价进入的机会。当卖家想要打败评级较低但畅销的产品时，可以使用它。该技能要求输入类别和评级阈值，然后使用 JoomPulse 市场数据返回按需求排名的匹配活跃列表。触发因素：“高需求低评级产品”、“低质量机会”、“我可以击败的产品”和 pt-BR“produtos com muitademanda e nota baixa”、“oportunidades de baixa qualidade”、“produtos mal avaliados que vendem”。销售额和收入是 JoomPulse 估计值，并非真实交易；价格、评级和评论都是真实的历史。对于全新的列表，请使用类别中新增长的产品技能；对于没有强大现有企业的利基市场，请使用无争议的利基市场发现者技能；对于一种产品及其竞争对手，使用机器学习产品分析技能。

plugin_texts.source: Finds fast-growing international (imported) products ACROSS ALL Mercado Livre (Brasil) categories, using JoomPulse, and returns them as one product table that includes each item's category, with price, estimated weekly sales and revenue, rating, time on air, shipping, listing type, seller medal, and a JoomPulse link per item. Use it when a seller wants rising imported products marketwide, not inside a single niche. Triggers include: "fast-growing international products", "imported products that are taking off", "cross-border winners across all categories", and the pt-BR equivalents "produtos internacionais em alta", "produtos importados crescendo rápido", "produtos internacionais que mais crescem em todas as categorias". Sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions. For the same search limited to one category, use the single-category international skill.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 JoomPulse 查找所有 Mercado Livre（巴西）类别中快速增长的国际（进口）产品，并将其作为一个产品表返回，其中包括每件商品的类别、价格、预计每周销售额和收入、评级、播出时间、运输、列表类型、卖家奖牌以及每件商品的 JoomPulse 链接。当卖家希望在整个市场而不是在单一利基市场内增加进口产品时，可以使用它。触发点包括：“快速增长的国际产品”、“正在起飞的进口产品”、“所有类别的跨境赢家”以及 pt-BR 对应的“produtos internacionais em alta”、“produtos importados crescendo rápido”、“produtos internacionais que mais crescem em todas as categorias”。销售额和收入是 JoomPulse 的估计值，并非真实交易。对于仅限于一个类别的同一搜索，请使用单类别国际技能。

plugin_texts.source: Finds fast-growing international (imported) products inside ONE chosen Mercado Livre (Brasil) category, using JoomPulse, and returns them as a product table with price, estimated weekly sales and revenue, rating, reviews, time on air, shipping, listing type and seller medal, a JoomPulse link per item, and a pointer to JoomPro for sourcing. Use it when a seller wants the trending imported items in a specific category. Triggers include: "popular international products in this category", "fast-growing imported products", and the pt-BR equivalents "produtos internacionais em alta nessa categoria", "produtos importados que mais crescem", "achados internacionais para importar". Sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions. For the same search across all categories at once, use the all-categories international skill.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 JoomPulse 在选定的 Mercado Livre（巴西）类别中查找快速增长的国际（进口）产品，并将其作为产品表返回，其中包含价格、预计每周销售额和收入、评级、评论、播出时间、运输、列表类型和卖家奖牌、每个商品的 JoomPulse 链接以及指向 JoomPro 采购的指针。当卖家想要特定类别中的流行进口商品时使用它。触发器包括：“该类别中的热门国际产品”、“快速增长的进口产品”以及 pt-BR 对应词“produtos internacionais em alta nessa categoria”、“produtos importados que mais crescem”、“achados internacionais para importar”。销售额和收入是 JoomPulse 的估计值，并非真实交易。要同时在所有类别中进行相同的搜索，请使用所有类别国际技能。

plugin_texts.source: Finds low-competition niche products on Mercado Livre (Brasil) — active listings in deep sub-categories (deeper than the third level) of a chosen category that have no platinum seller at all, surfaced via JoomPulse. Use it when a seller wants uncontested niches, gaps without strong incumbents, or where to enter without fighting a dominant platinum seller. Triggers (EN): "uncontested niche", "low-competition products", "categories without platinum sellers", "find a niche to enter"; (pt-BR): "nicho sem concorrência", "produtos sem vendedor platinum", "nicho pouco disputado", "subcategorias sem platinum". It returns one table of niche products, each with a competition signal (number of sellers) and a JoomPulse link. Sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions; price, rating, and reviews are real history. For one product and its competitors use the ml-product-analysis skill; for fast-growing deep categories rather than products use the growing-leaf-category-tracker skill.
plugin_texts.target: 在 Mercado Livre（巴西）上查找低竞争的利基产品 - 所选类别的深层子类别（比第三级更深）中的活跃列表，根本没有白金卖家，通过 JoomPulse 出现。当卖家想要无争议的利基市场、没有强大现有企业的空白，或者在不与占主导地位的白金卖家竞争的情况下进入的地方时，可以使用它。触发器（EN）：“无竞争的利基市场”、“低竞争产品”、“没有白金卖家的类别”、“找到一个利基市场进入”； (pt-BR)：“nicho sem concorrência”、“produtos sem vendor Platinum”、“nicho pouco disputado”、“subcategorias sem Platinum”。它返回一张利基产品表，每个表都有一个竞争信号（卖家数量）和一个 JoomPulse 链接。销售额和收入是 JoomPulse 估计值，并非真实交易；价格、评级和评论都是真实的历史。对于一种产品及其竞争对手，使用机器学习产品分析技能；对于快速增长的深层类别而不是产品，请使用“生长叶子类别跟踪器”技能。

plugin_texts.source: Finds new, already-selling product listings inside one Mercado Livre (Brasil) category on JoomPulse — recent listings (by default under about 30 days on air) that are well rated (rating above 3) and have real traction (more than about 30 estimated sales in the last month), all thresholds overridable — and returns them as a product table with a JoomPulse link per listing. Use it when a seller wants fresh, promising entrants in a niche. Triggers include: "new products in category", "what's launching and already selling", "recent best-sellers in my category", and the pt-BR equivalents "produtos novos na categoria", "novos anúncios que já vendem", "lançamentos em alta na minha categoria". Mercado Livre (Brasil) only; sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions, while price, rating, and review count are real history. For weak-rated but well-selling products to beat, use the high-demand low-quality skill; for tracking one product over time, use the product change-monitor skill.
plugin_texts.target: 在 JoomPulse 上的 Mercado Livre（巴西）类别中查找新的、已在售的产品列表 - 最近的列表（默认情况下播出约 30 天以内），评级良好（评级高于 3）并且具有真正的吸引力（上个月估计销售超过约 30 个），所有阈值均可覆盖 - 并将它们作为产品表返回，每个列表都有一个 JoomPulse 链接。当卖家想要在某个利基市场中找到新鲜的、有前途的进入者时，可以使用它。触发器包括：“类别中的新产品”、“正在推出和已经销售的产品”、“我的类别中最近最畅销的产品”以及 pt-BR 等效项“produtos novos na categoria”、“novos anúncios que já vendem”、“lançamentos em alta na minha categoria”。仅限 Mercado Livre（巴西）；销售额和收入是 JoomPulse 的估计值，而不是真实的交易量，而价格、评级和评论数是真实的历史记录。对于评分弱但畅销的产品，使用高要求的低质量技能；要随着时间的推移跟踪一种产品，请使用产品变更监控技能。

plugin_texts.source: Finds product listings that appear to represent the same real-world product as a reference item. Use this skill when a user wants to find duplicate listings, match a product across listings, identify identical products by title or URL, compare product photos against marketplace listings, or find the same product on Mercado Livre.
plugin_texts.target: 查找似乎代表与参考商品相同的真实产品的产品列表。当用户想要查找重复的列表、在列表中匹配产品、通过标题或 URL 识别相同的产品、将产品照片与市场列表进行比较或在 Mercado Livre 上查找相同的产品时，请使用此技能。

plugin_texts.source: Finds products with no brand (unbranded / no-name / generic) in one Mercado Livre (Brasil) category via JoomPulse — an opening to enter with your own brand / private label, since buyers there aren't anchored to a brand name. Asks for a category, lists the active no-brand listings ranked by estimated weekly demand, and returns a product table (price, estimated weekly sales and revenue, rating, reviews, time on air, shipping, listing type, seller medal) with a JoomPulse link per item. Triggers: "unbranded products", "products without a brand", "private-label opportunities", and the pt-BR "produtos sem marca", "genéricos que vendem", "oportunidade de marca própria". Sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions. NOT for ranking brands (use top-brand-position-tracker), brand-new listings (use new-growing-products-in-category), high-demand low-rated products (use high- demand-low-quality-finder), or niches without platinum sellers (use uncontested-niche- finder).
plugin_texts.target: 通过 JoomPulse 在 Mercado Livre（巴西）的一个类别中查找没有品牌（无品牌/无名/通用）的产品 - 这是一个使用您自己的品牌/自有品牌进入的机会，因为那里的买家不依赖于品牌名称。请求一个类别，列出按估计每周需求排名的活跃无品牌列表，并返回一个产品表（价格、估计每周销售额和收入、评级、评论、播出时间、运输、列表类型、卖家奖牌），每个项目都有一个 JoomPulse 链接。触发器：“无品牌产品”、“没有品牌的产品”、“自有品牌机会”和 pt-BR“produtos sem marca”、“genericos que vendem”、“oportunidade de marca própria”。销售额和收入是 JoomPulse 的估计值，并非真实交易。不适用于排名品牌（使用顶级品牌位置跟踪器）、全新列表（使用类别中的新增长产品）、高需求低评级产品（使用高需求低质量查找器）或没有白金卖家的利基市场（使用无争议利基市场查找器）。

plugin_texts.source: Finds the fastest-growing deep sub-categories (leaf categories, deeper than the third level) under a chosen Mercado Livre (Brasil) category, ranked by month-over-month revenue growth, using JoomPulse market data. Use it when a seller picks a category and wants the niches inside it that are growing fastest right now. Triggers include: "fast-growing subcategories", "which niches are growing in this category", "deep growing categories", and the pt-BR equivalents "subcategorias em crescimento", "nichos que mais crescem nesta categoria", "categorias profundas em alta". Sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions. For one category's opportunity index, use the category-opportunity-index skill; for comparing category aggregates against a user-supplied previous snapshot, use the category-monitor skill; for new products inside a category, use the new-growing-products-in-category skill.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 JoomPulse 市场数据，在选定的 Mercado Livre（巴西）类别下查找增长最快的深层子类别（叶子类别，比第三级更深），按月收入增长排名。当卖家选择一个类别并想要其中目前增长最快的利基市场时，请使用它。触发器包括：“快速增长的子类别”、“该类别中哪些利基正在增长”、“深度增长的类别”以及 pt-BR 等效项“subcategorias em crescimento”、“nichos que mais crescem Nesta categoria”、“categorias profundas em alta”。销售额和收入是 JoomPulse 的估计值，并非真实交易。对于某一类别的机会指数，使用类别-机会-指数技能；为了将类别聚合与用户提供的先前快照进行比较，请使用类别监控技能；对于类别内的新产品，请使用类别中的新增长产品技能。

plugin_texts.source: Lists the top trending search keywords for one Mercado Livre (Brasil) category — the real Mercado Livre search-trends ranking of what shoppers look for — with each keyword's rank and how many products compete for it. Use it when a seller wants to know what people search in their niche, which terms to put in titles and ads, or where demand is concentrated. Triggers include: "top keywords in my category", "trending search terms", "what do people search for", "best keywords for my listings", and the pt-BR equivalents "palavras-chave mais buscadas", "termos em alta na categoria", "o que as pessoas pesquisam", "melhores palavras-chave para meus anúncios". The keywords and ranks are real search-trend data, not estimates. For category market size and opportunity, use the category-opportunity-index skill; for ranking the sellers in a category, use the top-sellers-in-category skill.
plugin_texts.target: 列出 Mercado Livre（巴西）某一类别的热门搜索关键词 — 购物者所寻找商品的真正 Mercado Livre 搜索趋势排名 — 以及每个关键词的排名以及与之竞争的产品数量。当卖家想知道人们在他们的利基市场搜索什么、在标题和广告中添加哪些术语或者需求集中在哪里时，可以使用它。触发器包括：“我的类别中的热门关键词”、“趋势搜索词”、“人们搜索什么”、“我的列表的最佳关键词”以及 pt-BR 等效项“palavras-chave maisbuscadas”、“termos em alta na categoria”、“o que as pessoas pesquisam”、“melhores palavras-chave para meus anúncios”。关键词和排名是真实的搜索趋势数据，而不是估计值。对于品类市场规模和机会，使用品类-机会-指数技巧；要对某个类别中的卖家进行排名，请使用类别中最畅销的技能。

plugin_texts.source: Monitors how one or a few Mercado Livre products or listings changed over a period — by default week over week. Use it when a user wants to track how a named product changes over time, given a Mercado Livre link, a JoomPulse link, a Mercado Livre listing identifier, or a catalog product identifier. It returns a change table: per product the current value and the difference versus about a week ago for price, rating, and review count, plus the current estimated weekly sales and revenue, logistics, listing type, seller medal, and time on air, with a JoomPulse link per product. Triggers include: "monitor this product", "track price changes", "what changed this week", "did the price drop", and the pt-BR equivalents "monitorar este produto", "acompanhar este anúncio", "o preço caiu", "variação de avaliações". Sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions; price, rating, and reviews are real history. For point-in-time product and competitor analysis, use the single-product analysis skill.
plugin_texts.target: 监控一个或多个 Mercado Livre 产品或列表在一段时间内的变化情况（默认情况下每周变化）。当用户想要跟踪指定产品如何随时间变化时，请使用它，给定 Mercado Livre 链接、JoomPulse 链接、Mercado Livre 列表标识符或目录产品标识符。它返回一个变化表：每个产品的当前价值以及与大约一周前的价格、评级和评论计数的差异，加上当前估计的每周销售额和收入、物流、列表类型、卖家奖牌和播出时间，以及每个产品的 JoomPulse 链接。触发器包括：“监控此产品”、“跟踪价格变化”、“本周发生了什么变化”、“价格下降了吗”以及 pt-BR 等效项“monitorar este produto”、“acompanhar este anúncio”、“o preço caiu”、“variação de avaliações”。销售额和收入是 JoomPulse 估计值，并非真实交易；价格、评级和评论都是真实的历史。对于时间点产品和竞争对手分析，请使用单一产品分析技能。

plugin_texts.source: Monitors one Mercado Livre (Brasil) category's aggregate health via JoomPulse — estimated sales, number of products and catalog products, active sellers, the seller-medal distribution, and the monopolization level. Each run builds today's snapshot table and offers it for download; to see what changed, the user sends a table from a previous period and the skill shows the metric-by-metric difference. The baseline is whatever table the user supplies — no hidden session memory. Triggers: "monitor this category", "what changed in this category", "track category sales and sellers", and the pt-BR "monitorar esta categoria", "o que mudou na categoria", "comparar a categoria com o período anterior". Sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions. To track one named product over time use the product-change-monitor skill; for a one-shot market-size or opportunity snapshot use the category-opportunity-index skill.
plugin_texts.target: 通过 JoomPulse 监控 Mercado Livre（巴西）类别的总体健康状况 - 估计销售额、产品和目录产品数量、活跃卖家、卖家奖牌分布以及垄断水平。每次运行都会构建今天的快照表并提供下载；要查看发生了什么变化，用户发送前一时期的表格，技能会显示逐个指标的差异。基线是用户提供的任何表——没有隐藏的会话内存。触发器：“监控此类别”、“此类别发生了什么变化”、“跟踪类别销售和卖家”以及 pt-BR“monitorar esta categoria”、“o que mudou na categoria”、“comparar a categoria com o período anterior”。销售额和收入是 JoomPulse 的估计值，并非真实交易。要随时间跟踪某一指定产品，请使用产品变更监控技能；对于一次性市场规模或机会快照，请使用类别机会指数技能。

plugin_texts.source: Ranks the brands within one Mercado Livre (Brasil) category by estimated weekly revenue and tracks how each brand's position changes between periods, using JoomPulse. Each run builds today's brand-ranking table and offers it for download; to see how positions moved, the user sends a brand table from a previous period and the skill shows each brand's movement (rose, fell, new, or out). The baseline is whatever table the user supplies — no hidden session memory. Use it to see the top brands in a category and which are rising or falling. Triggers: "top brands in this category", "which brands are growing", "brand ranking", and the pt-BR "principais marcas da categoria", "ranking de marcas", "quais marcas estão crescendo". Mercado Livre (Brasil) only; sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions. To rank sellers (shops) rather than brands use the top-sellers-in-category skill; for category market size use the category-opportunity-index skill.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 JoomPulse，根据估计的每周收入对 Mercado Livre（巴西）的一个类别中的品牌进行排名，并跟踪每个品牌的排名在不同时期之间的变化。每次运行都会构建当今的品牌排名表并提供下载；为了查看仓位如何变化，用户发送前一时期的品牌表，技能会显示每个品牌的走势（上涨、下跌、新增或退出）。基线是用户提供的任何表——没有隐藏的会话内存。用它来查看某个类别中的顶级品牌以及哪些品牌正在上升或下降。触发器：“该类别中的顶级品牌”、“哪些品牌正在增长”、“品牌排名”以及 pt-BR“principais marcas da categoria”、“ranking de marcas”、“quais marcas estão crescendo”。仅限 Mercado Livre（巴西）；销售额和收入是 JoomPulse 的估计值，并非真实交易。要对卖家（商店）而不是品牌进行排名，请使用类别中最畅销的技能；对于类别市场规模，请使用类别机会指数技能。

plugin_texts.source: Ranks the top sellers in one Mercado Livre (Brasil) category by estimated average monthly revenue via JoomPulse, and returns a downloadable leaderboard — per seller: estimated monthly sales and revenue, 365-day completed sales, cancellation rate, sales trend, brands, product counts, international shipping, and listing-type counts, with a JoomPulse link each. It can also track how the ranking moved: supply a previous-period leaderboard for the same category and it shows each seller's movement (rose / fell / new) plus the biggest movers. Triggers: "top sellers in this category", "biggest stores in a category", "rank sellers by revenue", and the pt-BR "principais vendedores da categoria", "maiores lojas da categoria", "quem mais vende nessa categoria". Sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions. To monitor one seller over time use the seller-overview-tracker skill; to rank brands use the top-brand-position-tracker skill.
plugin_texts.target: 通过 JoomPulse 根据估计的平均每月收入对 Mercado Livre（巴西）类别中的顶级卖家进行排名，并返回可下载的排行榜 - 每个卖家：估计的每月销售额和收入、365 天完成的销售额、取消率、销售趋势、品牌、产品数量、国际运输和列表类型计数，每个排行榜都有一个 JoomPulse 链接。它还可以跟踪排名如何变化：提供同一类别的前一时期排行榜，它显示每个卖家的动向（上升/下降/新）以及最大的变化。触发器：“该类别中的顶级卖家”、“类别中最大的商店”、“按收入排名卖家”和 pt-BR“principais vendores da categoria”、“maiores lojas da categoria”、“quem mais vende nessa categoria”。销售额和收入是 JoomPulse 的估计值，并非真实交易。要随着时间的推移监控一位卖家，请使用卖家概览跟踪器技能；使用顶级品牌位置跟踪技能对品牌进行排名。

plugin_texts.source: Reports the JoomPulse opportunity index (low, medium, or high) for one Mercado Livre (Brasil) category, alongside that category's current monthly market stats — estimated GMV, estimated sales, number of active sellers, number of active listings, and average ticket — then writes a plain-language read on how attractive the category is to enter. Use it when a seller wants a one-shot market snapshot for a category they name. Triggers include: "is this category worth entering", "show the opportunity index for this category", "how big is this market", and the pt-BR equivalents "qual o índice de oportunidade", "vale a pena entrar nessa categoria", "tamanho de mercado da categoria". Sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions. For ranking the sellers in a category, use the top-sellers-in-category skill; for trending search terms, use the top-keywords-in-my-category skill; for comparing category aggregates against a user-supplied previous snapshot, use the category-monitor skill.
plugin_texts.target: 报告 Mercado Livre（巴西）一个类别的 JoomPulse 机会指数（低、中或高），以及该类别当前的每月市场统计数据（估计 GMV、估计销售额、活跃卖家数量、活跃列表数量和平均门票），然后以通俗易懂的语言说明该类别对进入的吸引力有多大。当卖家想要获得他们指定的类别的一次性市场快照时，请使用它。触发器包括：“这个类别值得进入吗”、“显示这个类别的机会指数”、“这个市场有多大”，以及 pt-BR 的等效词“qual o índice de oportunidade”、“vale a pena entrar nessa categoria”、“tamanho de Mercado da categoria”。销售额和收入是 JoomPulse 的估计值，并非真实交易。要对某个类别中的卖家进行排名，请使用类别中最畅销的技能；对于热门搜索词，请使用“我的类别中的热门关键词”技能；为了将类别聚合与用户提供的先前快照进行比较，请使用类别监控技能。

plugin_texts.source: Snapshot tracker for one Mercado Livre (Brasil) seller via JoomPulse — estimated monthly revenue and sales, listing count, sales trend, reputation, seller medal, categories covered, and cancellation rate. Each run builds today's snapshot table and offers it for download; to see what changed, the user sends the seller's table from a previous period and the skill shows the metric-by-metric difference (old → new). The baseline is whatever table the user supplies — no hidden session memory. Use it to track one specific seller over time. Triggers: "track this seller", "monitor this store", "what changed for this seller", "compare this seller with last period", and the pt-BR "monitorar este vendedor", "acompanhar esta loja", "o que mudou nesse vendedor". Sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions. To rank many sellers in a category and track how that ranking moves, use the top-sellers-in-category skill. Mercado Livre (Brasil) only.
plugin_texts.target: 通过 JoomPulse 对 Mercado Livre（巴西）卖家进行快照跟踪 — 估计每月收入和销售额、列表数量、销售趋势、声誉、卖家奖章、涵盖的类别和取消率。每次运行都会构建今天的快照表并提供下载；要查看发生了什么变化，用户发送前一时期的卖家表格，技能会显示逐个指标的差异（旧→新）。基线是用户提供的任何表——没有隐藏的会话内存。用它来跟踪某一特定卖家一段时间的情况。触发器：“跟踪此卖家”、“监控此商店”、“此卖家发生了什么变化”、“将此卖家与上一时期进行比较”以及 pt-BR“monitorar este vendor”、“acompanhar esta loja”、“o que mudou nesse vendor”。销售额和收入是 JoomPulse 的估计值，并非真实交易。要对某个类别中的许多卖家进行排名并跟踪排名的变化，请使用类别中最畅销的技能。仅限 Mercado Livre（巴西）。

plugin_texts.target: 通过将预期内容与日历实际内容进行比较，显示时间如何在日历之间分配，并在未来几天为每个未完成的任务提供具体的时间段来结束这一天。用于诸如回顾我的一天、今天过得怎么样或总结我的一天之类的请求。

plugin_texts.source: Go through the user's connected calendars once and establish which is which, so every later planning session works from knowledge instead of guesswork. Use when the user has just connected Kalender Sync, asks what you can see, or when a planning request would otherwise require guessing which calendar is work and which is private.
plugin_texts.target: 浏览一次用户连接的日历并确定哪个是哪个，因此以后的每个计划会话都是根据知识而不是猜测进行的。当用户刚刚连接 Kalender Sync、询问您可以看到什么时，或者当计划请求需要猜测哪个日历是工作日历、哪个日历是私人日历时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Plan the coming week across every calendar. Collects the fixed points, does the capacity arithmetic out loud, names overloaded days before anything is planned into them, then places the week's goals into what is genuinely left. Use for plan my week, weekly planning, or how much time do I actually have next week.
plugin_texts.target: 在每个日历上计划下一周。收集固定点，大声计算容量，在计划任何内容之前列出超负荷的日期，然后将一周的目标放入真正剩下的目标中。用于计划我的一周、每周计划或我下周实际有多少时间。

plugin_texts.source: Plan the user's day across all their calendars. Surfaces what is scheduled, finds clashes and impossible transitions, then places the user's priorities into the gaps that actually exist. Use for requests like plan my day, what does my day look like, or help me get through today.
plugin_texts.target: 在用户的所有日历中规划用户的一天。列出计划内容，发现冲突和不可能的转换，然后将用户的优先事项放入实际存在的间隙中。用于诸如计划我的一天、我的一天是什么样的或帮助我度过今天之类的请求。

plugin_texts.source: Take a whole schedule the user pastes in, a term plan, shift rota, course series or project plan, structure it, show every clash with what is already there, enter it in one go, and be able to undo all of it. Use whenever the user wants many events entered at once.
plugin_texts.target: 获取用户粘贴的整个时间表、学期计划、轮班表、课程系列或项目计划，对其进行构建，显示与现有内容的每一个冲突，一次性输入，并能够撤消所有这些。当用户想要一次输入多个事件时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Translate recurring intentions into fixed slots that survive a real week, and check later whether they held. Use for goals like exercising three times a week, regular study time, or any I want to do X regularly request.
plugin_texts.target: 将反复出现的意图转化为能够持续一周的固定时段，并稍后检查它们是否有效。用于实现每周锻炼 3 次、定期学习时间或我想要定期执行的任何目标等目标。

plugin_texts.source: Turn a handful of leave days into as many days off as possible. Computes the bridge days around public holidays, checks each candidate against every calendar, then enters the absence everywhere it belongs. Use for planning holidays, booking time off, or making the most of remaining leave days.
plugin_texts.target: 将少数假期变成尽可能多的假期。计算公共假期周围的过渡日，根据每个日历检查每个候选人，然后在其所属的任何地方输入缺勤情况。用于计划假期、预订休假时间或充分利用剩余休假日。

plugin_texts.source: Turn a task list into a timeboxed day across all the user's calendars, with buffers, travel time and a what-if pass before anything is written. Use for requests like timebox my day, help me schedule these tasks, or I have too much on today.
plugin_texts.target: 将任务列表变成跨所有用户日历的时间盒日期，并在写入任何内容之前提供缓冲区、行程时间和假设分析。用于诸如“我的一天的时间框”之类的请求，帮助我安排这些任务，或者我今天的任务太多。

plugin_texts.source: Explore several distinct UI design directions for a screen or component in Magic Patterns (magicpatterns.com). First recreates the current UI as a faithful baseline, then creates a shareable magicpatterns.com/inspiration/<id> document and streams in four self-contained HTML concepts tuned to the kind of exploration wanted (entrypoint/discoverability, information architecture/navigation, or visual display). The hosted comparison link is the deliverable. Use when the user wants design inspiration, alternative directions, layout options, variations, or a "show me a few approaches" exploration before committing to an implementation.
plugin_texts.target: 在 Magic Patterns (magicpatterns.com) 中探索屏幕或组件的几种不同的 UI 设计方向。首先将当前 UI 重新创建为忠实的基线，然后创建一个可共享的 magicpatterns.com/inspiration/<id> 文档，并以四个独立的 HTML 概念进行流传输，以适应所需的探索类型（入口点/可发现性、信息架构/导航或视觉显示）。托管的比较链接是可交付成果。当用户在实施之前需要设计灵感、替代方向、布局选项、变化或“向我展示一些方法”探索时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Prototype an idea in Magic Patterns (magicpatterns.com) starting from your local UI. Use when the user gives a prompt for something they want to prototype or explore and wants an iterable Magic Patterns design grounded in their existing code. Seeds a design by recreating the relevant local UI (recreate-as-react) and uploading it, then prompts Magic Patterns to design the new idea, returns the editor link, and opens it in the browser. Requires the Magic Patterns MCP server.
plugin_texts.target: 从本地 UI 开始，在 Magic Patterns (magicpatterns.com) 中对想法进行原型设计。当用户提示他们想要原型或探索的东西，并希望基于现有代码的可迭代魔法模式设计时使用。通过重新创建相关的本地 UI (recreate-as-react) 并上传来播种设计，然后提示 Magic Patterns 设计新想法，返回编辑器链接，并在浏览器中打开它。需要 Magic Patterns MCP 服务器。

plugin_texts.source: Recreate a component, screen, or pasted code from any codebase as a self-contained React + TypeScript + Tailwind prototype (App.tsx / index.tsx / index.css, named exports, one component per file) that renders in the Magic Patterns prototype environment and faithfully reproduces the original's styling, colors, spacing, and fonts. Use when the user asks for a "React recreation", a "React version" of a component, "recreate X as React", or as the porting engine for the upload-to-magic-patterns and prototype skills.
plugin_texts.target: 从任何代码库重新创建组件、屏幕或粘贴的代码作为独立的 React + TypeScript + Tailwind 原型（App.tsx / index.tsx / index.css，命名导出，每个文件一个组件），在 Magic Patterns 原型环境中呈现并忠实地再现原始的样式、颜色、间距和字体。当用户请求“React 重新创建”、组件的“React 版本”、“将 X 重新创建为 React”或作为上传到魔法模式和原型技能的移植引擎时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Recreate a component, screen, or pasted code from any codebase as a single self-contained raw HTML file (Tailwind Play CDN + web fonts) that faithfully reproduces its styling, colors, spacing, and fonts. Use when the user asks for a "raw HTML recreation", an "HTML version" of a component, "make an HTML copy of X", or references a component/screen by name (e.g. "Take the <ComponentName> and give me raw HTML").
plugin_texts.target: 将任何代码库中的组件、屏幕或粘贴代码重新创建为单个独立的原始 HTML 文件（Tailwind Play CDN + Web 字体），忠实地再现其样式、颜色、间距和字体。当用户请求“原始 HTML 重新创建”、组件的“HTML 版本”、“制作 X 的 HTML 副本”或按名称引用组件/屏幕（例如“获取 <ComponentName> 并给我原始 HTML”）时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Upload UI you are building locally into Magic Patterns (magicpatterns.com) and return the editor link. plugin_texts.source: Load this first whenever working against Make's ChatGPT App tool surface — tools named environment_get, scenario_*, app_find, module_spec, module_options_get, connection_*, or anything else served on the `/openai` MCP entrypoint. Covers naming conventions, the all-or-nothing scope model, the data/remark contract, and — most important — which capabilities this surface deliberately cannot perform and how to refuse them correctly. Does not apply to Make's standard MCP server (`mcp.make.com`), which uses different tool names and a different scope model entirely; use it only when the tools actually visible in this conversation match the `{subject}_{action}` naming below.
plugin_texts.target: 每当使用 Make 的 ChatGPT 应用程序工具界面时，请首先加载此工具 - 名为environment_get、scenario_*、app_find、module_spec、module_options_get、connection_* 的工具或“/openai” MCP 入口点上提供的任何其他内容。涵盖命名约定、全有或全无范围模型、数据/评论契约，以及最重要的——该表面故意无法执行哪些功能以及如何正确拒绝它们。不适用于 Make 的标准 MCP 服务器 (`mcp.make.com`)，它使用不同的工具名称和完全不同的范围模型；仅当此对话中实际可见的工具与下面的“{subject}_{action}”命名匹配时才使用它。

plugin_texts.source: Use when finding Make apps/modules for a goal, resolving or requesting a connection, creating a new scenario, or editing an existing scenario's structure or module configuration through the ChatGPT App tool surface. Covers app_find, module_spec, module_options_get, connection_create, connection_get, scenario_create, and scenario_patch. Not for explaining an already-built scenario (see make-chatgpt-scenario-explore) or running/debugging one (see make-chatgpt-scenario-operations). Read make-chatgpt-app-reference first for scopes, the write model, and the refusal contract.
plugin_texts.target: 在查找为目标创建应用程序/模块、解决或请求连接、创建新场景或通过 ChatGPT 应用程序工具界面编辑现有场景的结构或模块配置时使用。涵盖app_find、module_spec、module_options_get、connection_create、connection_get、scenario_create 和scenario_patch。不适用于解释已构建的场景（请参阅 make-chatgpt-scenario-explore）或运行/调试场景（请参阅 make-chatgpt-scenario-operations）。首先阅读 make-chatgpt-app-reference 了解范围、写入模型和拒绝契约。

Use when the user asks to build, create, analyze, read, understand, explain, modify, update, enhance, or manage dashboards, or asks about dashboard layout, text cards, or report arrangement. Covers dashboard analysis (read + understand existing), creation (new builds), modification (update existing), and explanation (data-driven annotation).

plugin_texts.source: This skill installs mixpanel_headless, pandas, numpy, matplotlib, seaborn, networkx, anytree, scipy (and pyarrow on Python 3.11+), then verifies Mixpanel credentials. It should be invoked when setting up a new environment for Mixpanel data analysis, when dependencies are missing, or when configuring service account or OAuth credentials for the first time.
plugin_texts.target: 此技能会安装 mixpanel_headless、pandas、numpy、matplotlib、seaborn、networkx、anytree、scipy（以及 Python 3.11+ 上的 pyarrow），然后验证 Mixpanel 凭据。当为 Mixpanel 数据分析设置新环境、缺少依赖项或首次配置服务帐户或 OAuth 凭据时，应调用它。

plugin_texts.source: This skill should be used when the user asks about Mixpanel product analytics, event data, funnel analysis, retention curves, cohort analysis, segmentation queries, user behavior, conversion rates, churn, DAU/MAU, ARPU, revenue metrics, feature adoption, A/B test results, user paths, flow analysis, or any request to query, explore, visualize, or analyze Mixpanel data using Python. Also use when the user asks to read, write, or manage Mixpanel "business context" — the markdown documentation that grounds AI assistants in an organization's structure and goals.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户询问 Mixpanel 产品分析、事件数据、漏斗分析、保留曲线、群组分析、细分查询、用户行为、转化率、流失、DAU/MAU、ARPU、收入指标、功能采用、A/B 测试结果、用户路径、流量分析或使用 Python 查询、探索、可视化或分析 Mixpanel 数据的任何请求时，应使用此技能。当用户要求阅读、编写或管理 Mixpanel“业务上下文”时也可使用 - 将 AI 助手置于组织结构和目标中的 Markdown 文档。

plugin_texts.source: Produce natural dialogue and pacing in Moknah - detect speakers, cast a voice per character, merge consecutive same-speaker lines, and place [break_X] pauses at speaker changes, sentence ends and scene beats. Use when the text contains dialogue, or when rendered audio sounds choppy, rushed, or abruptly cut between voices.
plugin_texts.target: 在 Moknah 中生成自然的对话和节奏 - 检测说话者、为每个角色投射声音、合并连续的同一说话者台词，并在说话者变化、句子结束和场景节拍处放置 [break_X] 暂停。当文本包含对话，或者渲染的音频听起来断断续续、仓促或声音之间突然中断时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Generate read-only MongoDB queries (find) or aggregation pipelines using natural language, with collection schema context and sample documents. Use this skill whenever the user asks to write, create, or generate MongoDB queries, wants to filter/query/aggregate data in MongoDB, asks "how do I query...", needs help with query syntax, or discusses finding/filtering/grouping MongoDB documents. Also use for translating SQL-like requests to MongoDB syntax. Does NOT handle Atlas Search ($search operator), vector/semantic search ($vectorSearch operator), fuzzy matching, autocomplete indexes, or relevance scoring - use search-and-ai for those. Does NOT analyze or optimize existing queries - use mongodb-query-optimizer for that. Does NOT handle aggregation pipelines that involve write operations. Requires MongoDB MCP server.
plugin_texts.target: 使用自然语言以及集合架构上下文和示例文档生成只读 MongoDB 查询（查找）或聚合管道。每当用户要求编写、创建或生成 MongoDB 查询、想要过滤/查询/聚合 MongoDB 中的数据、询问“我如何查询...”、需要查询语法方面的帮助或讨论查找/过滤/分组 MongoDB 文档时，请使用此技能。还用于将类似 SQL 的请求转换为 MongoDB 语法。不处理 Atlas 搜索（$search 运算符）、向量/语义搜索（$vectorSearch 运算符）、模糊匹配、自动完成索引或相关性评分 - 对这些使用 search-and-ai。不分析或优化现有查询 - 为此使用 mongodb-query-optimizer。不处理涉及写入操作的聚合管道。需要 MongoDB MCP 服务器。

plugin_texts.source: Guides MongoDB users through implementing and optimizing Atlas Search (full-text), Vector Search (semantic), and Hybrid Search solutions. Use this skill when users need to build search functionality for text-based queries (autocomplete, fuzzy matching, faceted search), semantic similarity (embeddings, RAG applications), or combined approaches. Also use when users need text containment, substring matching ('contains', 'includes', 'appears in'), case-insensitive or multi-field text search, or filtering across many fields with variable combinations. Provides workflows for selecting the right search type, creating indexes, constructing queries, and optimizing performance using the MongoDB MCP server.
plugin_texts.target: 指导 MongoDB 用户实施和优化 Atlas 搜索（全文）、矢量搜索（语义）和混合搜索解决方案。当用户需要为基于文本的查询（自动完成、模糊匹配、分面搜索）、语义相似性（嵌入、RAG 应用程序）或组合方法构建搜索功能时，请使用此技能。当用户需要文本包含、子字符串匹配（“包含”、“包含”、“出现在”）、不区分大小写或多字段文本搜索或使用变量组合跨多个字段进行过滤时，也可使用。提供使用 MongoDB MCP 服务器选择正确的搜索类型、创建索引、构建查询和优化性能的工作流程。

plugin_texts.source: Help with MongoDB query optimization and indexing. Use only when the user asks for optimization or performance: "How do I optimize this query?", "How do I index this?", "Why is this query slow?", "Can you fix my slow queries?", "What are the slow queries on my cluster?", etc. Do not invoke for general MongoDB query writing unless user asks for performance or index help. Prefer indexing as optimization strategy. Use MongoDB MCP when available.
plugin_texts.target: 帮助 MongoDB 查询优化和索引。仅当用户要求优化或性能时使用：“我如何优化此查询？”、“我如何对此建立索引？”、“为什么此查询很慢？”、“你能修复我的慢查询吗？”、“我的集群上的慢查询是什么？”等。除非用户请求性能或索引帮助，否则不要调用一般 MongoDB 查询写入。优先选择索引作为优化策略。如果可用，请使用 MongoDB MCP。

plugin_texts.source: Manages MongoDB Atlas Stream Processing (ASP) workflows. Handles workspace provisioning, data source/sink connections, processor lifecycle operations, debugging diagnostics, and tier sizing. Supports Kafka, Atlas clusters, S3, HTTPS, and Lambda integrations for streaming data workloads and event processing. NOT for general MongoDB queries or Atlas cluster management. Requires MongoDB MCP Server with Atlas API credentials.
plugin_texts.target: 管理 MongoDB Atlas 流处理 (ASP) 工作流程。处理工作区配置、数据源/接收器连接、处理器生命周期操作、调试诊断和层大小调整。支持 Kafka、Atlas 集群、S3、HTTPS 和 Lambda 集成，以实现流数据工作负载和事件处理。不适用于一般 MongoDB 查询或 Atlas 集群管理。需要具有 Atlas API 凭证的 MongoDB MCP 服务器。

plugin_texts.source: MongoDB schema design patterns and anti-patterns. Use when designing data models, reviewing schemas, migrating from SQL, or troubleshooting performance issues caused by schema problems. Triggers on "design schema", "embed vs reference", "MongoDB data model", "schema review", "unbounded arrays", "one-to-many", "tree structure", "16MB limit", "schema validation", "JSON Schema", "time series", "schema migration", "polymorphic", "TTL", "data lifecycle", "archive", "index explosion", "unnecessary indexes", "approximation pattern", "document versioning".
plugin_texts.target: MongoDB 模式设计模式和反模式。在设计数据模型、检查架构、从 SQL 迁移或解决由架构问题引起的性能问题时使用。触发“设计架构”、“嵌入与引用”、“MongoDB 数据模型”、“架构审查”、“无界数组”、“一对多”、“树结构”、“16MB 限制”、“架构验证”、“JSON 架构”、“时间序列”、“架构迁移”、“多态”、“TTL”、“数据生命周期”、“归档”、“索引爆炸”、“不必要的索引”、 “近似模式”、“文档版本控制”。

plugin_texts.source: Optimize MongoDB client connection configuration (pools, timeouts, patterns) for any supported driver language. Use this skill when working/updating/reviewing on functions that instantiate or configure a MongoDB client (eg, when calling `connect()`), configuring connection pools, troubleshooting connection errors (ECONNREFUSED, timeouts, pool exhaustion), optimizing performance issues related to connections. This includes scenarios like building serverless functions with MongoDB, creating API endpoints that use MongoDB, optimizing high-traffic MongoDB applications, creating long-running tasks and concurrency, or debugging connection-related failures.
plugin_texts.target: 针对任何受支持的驱动程序语言优化 MongoDB 客户端连接配置（池、超时、模式）。在工作/更新/审查实例化或配置 MongoDB 客户端的函数（例如，调用“connect()”时）、配置连接池、排除连接错误（ECONNREFUSED、超时、池耗尽）、优化与连接相关的性能问题时，请使用此技能。这包括使用 MongoDB 构建无服务器函数、创建使用 MongoDB 的 API 端点、优化高流量 MongoDB 应用程序、创建长时间运行的任务和并发性或调试与连接相关的故障等场景。

plugin_texts.source:
Builds Databricks data products from live web data, end to end: discovers the right Nimble
web-data agents, scrapes into Delta tables, and produces an AI/BI dashboard and/or a deployed
Databricks App — a table → dashboard → app workflow, for production data products or quick demos.
Use whenever a request pairs live or scraped web data WITH a Databricks destination — e.g. "scrape
Amazon/Walmart prices into a Delta table and build a dashboard", "load Zillow/Instagram/Maps/search
results into Databricks and build a dashboard or app", "showcase Nimble + Databricks to a prospect".
Prefer it over nimble-web-expert or competitor-intel when the data lands in Databricks. Do NOT use
for one-off web fetches or CSV exports with no Databricks destination — use nimble-web-expert
instead. Do NOT use for competitor or company research briefings — use competitor-intel or
company-deep-dive instead. Do NOT use for generic Databricks work with no Nimble/web-data angle —
use the official databricks-* skills instead.
plugin_texts.target:
从实时 Web 数据端到端构建 Databricks 数据产品：发现合适的 Nimble
Web 数据代理，抓取到 Delta 表，并生成 AI/BI 仪表板和/或部署的
Databricks 应用程序 — 表格→仪表板→应用程序工作流程，用于生产数据产品或快速演示。
每当请求将实时或抓取的 Web 数据与 Databricks 目标配对时使用 - 例如“刮
亚马逊/沃尔玛将价格存入 Delta 表并构建仪表板”，“加载 Zillow/Instagram/地图/搜索
结果导入 Databricks 并构建仪表板或应用程序”、“向潜在客户展示 Nimble + Databricks”。
当数据到达 Databricks 时，更喜欢它而不是灵活的网络专家或竞争对手情报。请勿使用
对于没有 Databricks 目标的一次性 Web 获取或 CSV 导出 — 使用 nimble-web-expert
相反。请勿用于竞争对手或公司研究简报 — 使用竞争对手情报或
相反，公司深入研究。不要用于没有 Nimble/web 数据角度的通用 Databricks 工作 —
请改用官方的 databricks-* 技能。

plugin_texts.source:
Discovers all businesses of a given type in any geography using Nimble
WSAs. Two modes: Discovery finds businesses from scratch; Audit compares
a user's existing list (Google Sheet, CSV, inline) against fresh
discovery, categorizing entries as matched, discovered-only, or
reference-only. Vertical presets (Healthcare, SaaS, Restaurants, Legal,
Auto/Home) auto-select WSA routing.

Triggers: "find all X in Y", "build a list of", "market sizing",
"account universe", "how many X in Y", "TAM for", "discover all",
"audit my list", "compare against", "what am I missing", "gap analysis",
"verify my business list", "prospect list".

Do NOT use for competitor monitoring — use competitor-intel instead.
Do NOT use for company deep dives — use company-deep-dive instead.
Do NOT use for neighborhood-level exploration with social enrichment
— use local-places instead.
plugin_texts.target:
使用 Nimble 发现任何地理位置的给定类型的所有企业
WSA。两种模式：Discovery从无到有发现企业；审计比较
用户的现有列表（Google Sheet、CSV、内联）与新列表
发现，将条目分类为匹配的、仅发现的或
仅供参考。垂直预设（医疗保健、SaaS、餐厅、法律、
Auto/Home）自动选择 WSA 路由。

触发器：“找到 Y 中的所有 X”、“构建列表”、“市场规模”、
“账户宇宙”、“Y中有多少个X”、“TAM”、“发现全部”、
“审核我的清单”、“比较”、“我缺少什么”、“差距分析”、
“验证我的业务清单”、“潜在客户清单”。

请勿用于竞争对手监控——而是使用竞争对手情报。
请勿用于公司深度潜水 - 请改用公司深度潜水。
请勿用于社区层面的社交丰富探索
— 使用 local-places 代替。

plugin_texts.source:
Discovers, enriches, and scores local businesses in any neighborhood using
Nimble Web Search Agents (WSAs) and web data. Returns a structured, ranked
list with confidence scores, reviews, social presence, and an interactive map.

Use this skill when the user asks about local businesses, places, or
neighborhood discovery. Common triggers: "find all coffee shops in",
"map every bar in", "local businesses in", "discover gyms near",
"what restaurants are in", "neighborhood guide for", "local places in",
"find places near", "list all [business type] in [area]", "best [type]
near [location]", "build a neighborhood guide", "local place search".

Requires the Nimble CLI (nimble extract:templates run, nimble search, nimble extract)
for live web data via WSAs and fallback search.
Do NOT use for competitor analysis or monitoring (use competitor-intel),
company research or deep dives (use company-deep-dive), general web search
or extraction (use nimble-web-expert).
plugin_texts.target:
使用以下方式发现、丰富任何社区的本地企业并对其进行评分
Nimble Web 搜索代理 (WSA) 和 Web 数据。返回结构化的、排名的
包含置信度分数、评论、社交存在和交互式地图的列表。

当用户询问当地企业、地点或信息时，请使用此技能
邻里发现。常见触发器：“查找所有咖啡店”，
“绘制每个酒吧的地图”、“当地企业”、“发现附近的健身房”、
“有哪些餐馆”、“社区指南”、“当地地方”、
“查找附近的地点”、“列出[区域]中的所有[业务类型]”、“最佳[类型]
[位置]附近”、“建立社区指南”、“本地地点搜索”。

需要 Nimble CLI（灵活提取：模板运行、灵活搜索、灵活提取）
通过 WSA 和后备搜索获取实时网络数据。
请勿用于竞争对手分析或监控（使用竞争对手情报），
公司研究或深入研究（使用company-deep-dive），一般网络搜索

plugin_texts.source:

"who can I hire for", "find me a [role]", "recruiting for", "talent search",

description followed by a sourcing request.

Do NOT use for job market research or salary benchmarking — use
market-finder instead. Do NOT use for researching a single known person
— use company-deep-dive or meeting-prep instead.

plugin_texts.source:
Get web data now — fast, incremental, immediately responsive to what the user needs.
The only way Claude can access live websites.

USE FOR:
- Fetching any URL or reading any webpage
- Scraping prices, listings, reviews, jobs, stats, docs from any site
- Running Extraction Templates — reusable, site-specific structured scrapers
- Running Web Search Agents — open-ended research, enrichment, and dataset building with citations
- Discovering URLs on a site before bulk extraction
- Calling public REST/XHR API endpoints
- Web search and research (8 focus modes)
- Bulk crawling website sections

Must be pre-installed and authenticated. Run `nimble --version` to verify (>= 1.2.0).
plugin_texts.target:
立即获取网络数据 - 快速、增量、立即响应用户需求。
克劳德访问实时网站的唯一方式。

用于：
- 获取任何 URL 或阅读任何网页
- 从任何网站抓取价格、列表、评论、工作、统计数据、文档
- 运行提取模板——可重复使用、特定于站点的结构化刮刀
- 运行网络搜索代理——开放式研究、丰富和通过引用构建数据集
- 在批量提取之前发现网站上的 URL
- 调用公共 REST/XHR API 端点
- 网络搜索和研究（8 种焦点模式）
- 批量抓取网站栏目

必须预先安装并经过身份验证。运行 `nimble --version` 进行验证 (>= 1.2.0)。

plugin_texts.source:
Monitors press, social, developer communities, and competitor channels from any point around
a product launch — tracking sentiment, flagging mischaracterizations, surfacing competitor
responses, and recommending actions in real time. Covers press, Reddit, LinkedIn,
JavaScript-heavy pages, and live community forums, triaging every signal by urgency.
Delivers a Response War Room dashboard with a live signal feed, mischaracterization tracker,
competitor response panel, and sentiment velocity chart.

Use when asked to "monitor this launch", "track the launch", "what's being said about the
launch", "flag any mischaracterizations", "competitor response to the launch", "post-launch
coverage", "check press coverage for the launch", or "what's the reaction to the
announcement".

Do NOT use for ongoing brand monitoring unrelated to a launch — use brand-mention-monitor
instead. Do NOT use for ongoing competitor intelligence unrelated to a specific launch
window — use competitor-intel instead.
plugin_texts.target:
随时随地监控媒体、社交、开发者社区和竞争对手渠道
产品发布——跟踪情绪、标记错误描述、暴露竞争对手
实时响应和建议行动。涵盖媒体、Reddit、LinkedIn、
JavaScript 密集的页面和实时社区论坛，按紧急程度对每个信号进行分类。
提供响应作战室仪表板，其中包含实时信号馈送、错误特征跟踪器、
竞争对手反应面板和情绪速度图表。

当被要求“监控此次发布”、“跟踪此次发布”、“关于该发布的内容时，请使用”
发布”、“标记任何错误描述”、“竞争对手对发布的反应”、“发布后
报道”、“查看媒体对此次发布会的报道”或“人们对此有何反应”
公告”。

请勿用于与发布无关的持续品牌监控 - 使用品牌提及监控
相反。请勿用于与特定发布无关的持续竞争对手情报
window — 使用竞争对手英特尔代替。

plugin_texts.source:
Researches meeting attendees and their companies before any meeting using
real-time web data. Surfaces roles, recent activity, company context, and
talking points — then maps cross-attendee relationships.

Use this skill when the user asks to prepare for a meeting, research someone
they're meeting, or wants context on attendees. Common triggers: "prepare me
for my meeting", "who am I meeting with", "research this person", "meeting
prep", "brief me on [person]", "I have a meeting with [person/company]",
"get me ready for my call", "what should I know about [person]",
"background on [person] before our meeting", "attendee research".

Requires the Nimble CLI (nimble search, nimble extract) for live web data.
Do NOT use for multi-company competitor monitoring (use competitor-intel)
or single-company deep dives without attendees (use company-deep-dive).

plugin_texts.source:
SEO intelligence toolkit covering the full lifecycle via live web data:
keyword research, rank tracking, site audits, content gap analysis,
competitor keyword reverse-engineering, AI visibility across five platforms
(ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI, Gemini, Grok), and GitHub repo SEO.
Crawls real sites and SERPs via Nimble CLI — no fabricated metrics.

Triggers: "SEO", "keywords", "rank tracker", "site audit", "content gap",
"competitor keywords", "AI visibility", "GitHub SEO", "SERP analysis",
"keyword research", "technical SEO", "keyword difficulty", "topic
clusters", "ranking delta", "on-page SEO", "AI citation audit".

Do NOT use for competitor business signals — use `competitor-intel`
instead. Do NOT use for competitor messaging — use
`competitor-positioning` instead. Do NOT use for general web scraping
— use `nimble-web-expert` instead.
plugin_texts.target:
SEO 智能工具包通过实时网络数据覆盖整个生命周期：
关键词研究、排名跟踪、网站审核、内容差距分析、
竞争对手关键词逆向工程、跨五个平台的人工智能可见性
（ChatGPT、Perplexity、Google AI、Gemini、Grok）和 GitHub 存储库 SEO。
通过 Nimble CLI 抓取真实网站和 SERP——没有捏造的指标。

触发器：“SEO”、“关键字”、“排名跟踪器”、“网站审核”、“内容差距”、
“竞争对手关键词”、“AI 可见性”、“GitHub SEO”、“SERP 分析”、
“关键词研究”、“技术SEO”、“关键词难度”、“主题
集群”、“排名增量”、“页面搜索引擎优化”、“人工智能引文审计”。

相反。请勿用于竞争对手消息传递 — 使用
相反，“竞争对手定位”。请勿用于一般网页抓取
— 使用“nimble-web-expert”代替。

plugin_texts.source:
Scans Reddit, X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, blogs, news, and review platforms
for brand mentions — scoring each across four dimensions (reach, velocity, sentiment, and
risk-topic match) so teams can respond before one spirals. Sources adapt to the market: B2B
brands weight LinkedIn, G2, and trade press; consumer brands weight TikTok, Instagram, and
YouTube. Each is bucketed into Crisis / Watch / Engage / Log with a suggested owner and
response window.

Use when asked to "monitor brand mentions", "scan for brand mentions", "what are people
saying about [brand]", "brand monitoring", "social listening", "run a brand sweep",
"find high-risk mentions", or any variation of brand monitoring across web and social.

Do NOT use for one-time company research or due diligence — use company-deep-dive instead.
Do NOT use for competitor messaging/positioning analysis — use competitor-positioning instead.
Do NOT use for funding/hiring/business signals on a competitor — use competitor-intel instead.
plugin_texts.target:
扫描 Reddit、X、LinkedIn、Instagram、TikTok、YouTube、博客、新闻和评论平台
对于品牌提及——对四个维度进行评分（覆盖范围、速度、情感和
风险主题匹配），这样团队就可以在事情螺旋式上升之前做出反应。来源适应市场：B2B
品牌重视 LinkedIn、G2 和贸易媒体；消费品牌重视 TikTok、Instagram 和
YouTube。每个都与建议的所有者一起放入危机/观察/参与/日志中，并且
响应窗口。

当被要求“监控品牌提及”、“扫描品牌提及”、“人们是谁”时使用
关于[品牌]的说法”、“品牌监控”、“社交聆听”、“进行品牌扫荡”、
“查找高风险提及”，或跨网络和社交的品牌监控的任何变体。

请勿用于一次性公司研究或尽职调查，而是使用公司深入研究。
请勿用于竞争对手消息传递/定位分析——而是使用竞争对手定位。
请勿用于向竞争对手提供资金/招聘/业务信号——而是使用竞争对手情报。

plugin_texts.source:
Searches the live web via Nimble APIs to monitor competitors and produce a
structured intelligence briefing. Runs parallel searches for news, product
launches, hiring signals, and funding — then compares against previous
findings to highlight only what's new.

Use this skill when the user asks about competitors, competitive intelligence,
or what rival companies are doing. Common triggers: "what are my competitors
doing", "competitor update", "competitor news", "competitive landscape",
"market intel", "what's new with [company]", "track [company]", "competitor
briefing", "who's making moves", "competitive analysis", "losing deals to
[company]", "battlecard". Also use before board meetings or strategy sessions
when the user wants competitive context.

Requires the Nimble CLI (nimble search, nimble extract) for live web data.
Do NOT use for single-company deep dives (use company-deep-dive), meeting
prep with attendees (use meeting-prep), or non-business queries.
plugin_texts.target:

当用户询问竞争对手、竞争情报、
或者竞争对手公司正在做什么。常见触发因素：“我的竞争对手是什么？

[公司]”、“战斗卡”。也可在董事会会议或战略会议之前使用
当用户想要竞争环境时。

plugin_texts.source:
Tracks how competitors position themselves online — scrapes homepages,
features, pricing, and blogs to extract messaging, value props, CTAs, and
pricing models. Compares against previous snapshots to surface positioning
shifts with before/after tracking. Produces messaging matrices, content gap
analysis, white space maps, and battlecard inputs.

Use when anyone asks about competitor messaging, positioning, website copy,
content strategy, or how competitors present themselves. Triggers: "competitor
positioning", "messaging comparison", "content gap", "what changed on their
site", "competitor homepage", "landing page teardown", "marketing battlecard",
"how do they describe their product", "share of voice", "counter-messaging".

Do NOT use for business signals like funding/hiring (use competitor-intel),
single-company deep dives (use company-deep-dive), or meeting prep (use
meeting-prep).
plugin_texts.target:

定价模型。与之前的表面定位快照进行比较
随跟踪前/后变化。生成消息传递矩阵、内容间隙
分析、空白地图和战斗卡输入。

当有人询问竞争对手的消息、定位、网站文案、
内容策略，或者竞争对手如何展示自己。触发因素：“竞争对手
定位”、“消息比较”、“内容差距”、“他们的变化是什么”
网站”、“竞争对手主页”、“着陆页拆解”、“营销战卡”、
“他们如何描述他们的产品”、“声音份额”、“反信息”。

单个公司深度潜水（使用公司深度潜水），或会议准备（使用
会议准备）。

plugin_texts.source:
Use this skill ANY TIME the user asks about a specific company. Triggers:

market position, news, and strategic outlook with dates and URLs.

plugin_texts.target:

licenses", "verify NPI numbers", "cross-check credentials against NPI",
"compliance audit on providers", "are these practitioners still licensed",
"validate my provider list". Accepts CSV, Google Sheet URL, or pasted data.

Do NOT use for extracting providers from practice URLs — use healthcare-providers-extract instead.
Do NOT use for filling data gaps — use healthcare-providers-enrich instead.
Do NOT use for discovering practices — use market-finder or local-places instead.
Do NOT use for general extraction — use nimble-web-expert instead.

plugin_texts.source: NoPressure is communication-skills practice for the workplace — it turns a hard conversation into a live voice roleplay the user can rehearse before the real one, whether that is delivering critical feedback, saying no to a request, handling a performance review, pushing back on a stakeholder, negotiating a raise, or running a first 1:1 with a new team. Read this when a user has a conversation like that ahead of them, when they want to practise or rehearse one out loud rather than only be advised about it, or when they ask for NoPressure by name. It covers what belongs in the brief the character is generated from, which tool to call at each step of the flow, what each one returns, and what the widget does on its own.
plugin_texts.target: NoPressure 是针对工作场所的沟通技巧练习——它将艰难的对话变成了用户可以在真正的对话之前排练的现场语音角色扮演，无论是提供关键反馈、对请求说不、处理绩效评估、拒绝利益相关者、谈判加薪，还是与新团队进行第一次 1:1 的讨论。当用户面前有这样的对话时，当他们想要大声练习或排练对话而不只是被建议时，或者当他们通过名字要求 NoPressure 时，请阅读本文。它涵盖了角色生成的摘要中的内容、在流程的每个步骤中调用哪个工具、每个工具返回什么以及小部件自己做什么。

plugin_texts.source: Research U.S. codified law — statutes, regulations, and constitutional provisions, federal or any jurisdiction OpenLaws covers — when the user needs law FOUND, COMPARED, or EXPLORED rather than a citation they already hold read back. Covers topic questions ("what does [state] law say about..."), multi-jurisdiction surveys, and open-ended research where the user does NOT name a specific citation. ALSO take questions about court decisions, controlling cases, holdings, or precedent: case law is outside the corpus, so claim them and decline with discipline — name the boundary, cite the governing statute, point to case-law sources — rather than leave them to an unverified answer. Same for pending rule changes or past-date rules. If the user hands you one named citation to confirm or read back, that is citation-validator's job. Ground every claim in the OpenRegs MCP tools FIRST (never training data; web only via the official-source exception), produce a research log, and refuse when a claim can't be grounded.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户需要找到、比较或探索的法律而不是他们已经保留的引文时，研究美国成文法律 - 联邦或 OpenLaws 涵盖的任何司法管辖区的法规、法规和宪法条款。涵盖主题问题（“[州]法律对……有何规定”）、多司法管辖区调查和开放式研究（用户未指定具体引文）。还要回答有关法院判决、控制案件、控股或先例的问题：判例法不在语料库范围内，因此主张它们并按纪律拒绝——指出边界，引用管辖法规，指出判例法来源——而不是让它们得到未经验证的答案。对于待定的规则更改或过去的规则也是如此。如果用户给你一个命名的引文来确认或读回，那就是引文验证器的工作。首先验证 OpenRegs MCP 工具中的每项声明（绝不是训练数据；仅通过官方来源的例外网络），生成研究日志，并在无法验证声明时拒绝。

plugin_texts.source: Validate or read a SINGLE U.S. statutory or regulatory citation the user names — confirm it resolves to real, in-force law and return the official text with a clickable provenance link. This is the free OpenRegs capability: one named citation in, verified text out. The trigger is a specific citation in hand: use this skill, in preference to the research assistant, whenever the user names one to check or read (e.g. "is Tex. Lab. Code § 411.103 real?", "is 29 U.S.C. § 201 still good law?", "pull Cal. Lab. Code § 512"). It does NOT search by topic, compare jurisdictions, or do open research — when the user names no specific citation and needs law found, compared, or explored, that is the research assistant's job, and this skill points there.
plugin_texts.target: 验证或阅读用户名的单个美国法律或监管引文 - 确认其符合真实有效的法律，并返回带有可点击来源链接的官方文本。这是免费的 OpenRegs 功能：输入命名引用，输出验证文本。触发因素是手头的特定引文：每当用户指定要检查或阅读的引文时，优先于研究助理使用此技能（例如“Tex. Lab. Code § 411.103 是真实的吗？”、“29 U.S.C. § 201 仍然是好的法律吗？”、“pull Cal. Lab. Code § 512”）。它不会按主题搜索、比较司法管辖区或进行开放研究——当用户没有指定具体引文并且需要发现、比较或探索法律时，这就是研究助理的工作，而这项技能就在那里。

plugin_texts.source: Design trendy, professional, on-brand Orshot studio templates. Use when creating or refining a template design via the Orshot MCP — social posts, ads, stories, carousels, banners, thumbnails. Applies the craft rules (clear hierarchy, 2-font typography, 60-30-10 color), consults the brand kit first, varies layouts so designs never repeat by type, and runs a render-and-critique loop. Pairs with the orshot MCP create/update/patch tools.
plugin_texts.target: 设计时尚、专业、品牌化的 Orshot 工作室模板。通过 Orshot MCP 创建或完善模板设计时使用 - 社交帖子、广告、故事、轮播、横幅、缩略图。应用工艺规则（清晰的层次结构、2 种字体排版、60-30-10 颜色），首先查阅品牌套件，改变布局，使设计不会按类型重复，并运行渲染和评论循环。与 orshot MCP 创建/更新/修补工具配对。

plugin_texts.source: Generate images, PDFs, and videos from templates with Orshot — via the REST API, SDKs (Node/Python/PHP/Ruby), the remote MCP server, or no-code tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Airtable), and wire those renders into a recurring automation. Use whenever the user mentions Orshot, connects Orshot to an AI agent or MCP client, wants a render to run unattended on a schedule or trigger, or needs to programmatically produce marketing visuals, OG images, social carousels, certificates/invoices/tickets as PDF, or video from templates — including when migrating from Bannerbear, Placid, Creatomate, RenderForm, Abyssale, or similar. Always load this skill for Orshot tasks, even simple ones, because it carries gotchas (modifications key by parameterId, multi-page needs a page1@ prefix, video output needs video elements in the template) that otherwise cause failed renders. Not for generating standalone AI images with no template or Orshot involved.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 Orshot 从模板生成图像、PDF 和视频 - 通过 REST API、SDK (Node/Python/PHP/Ruby)、远程 MCP 服务器或无代码工具（Zapier、Make、n8n、Airtable），并将这些渲染连接到重复的自动化中。每当用户提到 Orshot、将 Orshot 连接到 AI 代理或 MCP 客户端、希望渲染按计划或触发器在无人值守的情况下运行，或者需要以编程方式生成营销视觉效果、OG 图像、社交轮播、PDF 格式的证书/发票/票据或来自模板的视频时，包括从 Bannerbear、Placid、Creatomate、RenderForm、Abyssale 或类似版本迁移时，请使用。始终为 Orshot 任务加载此技能，即使是简单的任务，因为它带有陷阱（通过参数 ID 修改键、多页面需要 page1@ 前缀、视频输出需要模板中的视频元素），否则会导致渲染失败。不适用于生成不涉及模板或 Orshot 的独立 AI 图像。

plugin_texts.source: Analyze a single-family home, condo, or 2–4 unit residential property. Two purposes: (A) investor — evaluate as a rental property with a GO / NO-GO / GO WITH CONDITIONS verdict; (B) homeowner or buyer — produce a home valuation memo with a confidence-banded value range and 3-year appreciation forecast. Runs on the residential data layer (the property + property_residential datamart tables, with web search for comparable sales) — distinct from the MF/CRE semantic datamart. Activate on phrasings like: 'single family rental', 'SFR', 'home as a rental', 'should I buy this house', 'what's my home worth', 'home valuation', 'should I renovate the kitchen', 'should I sell or rent'. Use realai-investment / realai-valuation for multifamily and CRE; this skill is residential-only.
plugin_texts.target: 分析单户住宅、公寓或 2-4 单元住宅物业。两个目的： (A) 投资者 — 评估为出租房产，并做出“允许”/“不予允许”/“符合条件允许”的判决； (B) 房主或买家 — 制作一份房屋估价备忘录，其中包含置信带价值范围和 3 年升值预测。在住宅数据层上运行（property + property_residential 数据集市，通过网络搜索可比较的销售）——与 MF/CRE 语义数据集市不同。激活诸如“单户出租”、“SFR”、“出租房屋”、“我应该买这栋房子吗”、“我的房子值多少钱”、“房屋估价”、“我应该翻新厨房”、“我应该出售还是出租”等措辞。对多户住宅和 CRE 使用 realai-investment / realai-valuation；该技能仅限住宅。

plugin_texts.source: Apply RealAI house formatting to a finished deliverable (docx today; xlsx/pptx stubbed for future). Re-skins the document — palette, fonts, type scale, paragraph rhythm, tables, charts — to the RealAI brand WITHOUT changing any text, number, table value, or chart data. Trigger after a document is generated and before it is returned to the user, or whenever the user asks to 'format,' 'brand,' or 'clean up' a deliverable to the RealAI style. Do NOT use to author content, recompute figures, or summarize. Every report-producing skill in this plugin should invoke this skill as the last step before returning a deliverable.
plugin_texts.target: 将 RealAI house 格式应用于已完成的可交付成果（今天为 docx；为将来存根 xlsx/pptx）。将文档（调色板、字体、字体比例、段落节奏、表格、图表）重新设计为 RealAI 品牌，而不更改任何文本、数字、表格值或图表数据。在生成文档之后和将其返回给用户之前，或者每当用户要求将可交付成果“格式化”、“品牌化”或“清理”为 RealAI 样式时触发。请勿用于创作内容、重新计算数字或总结。此插件中的每个报告生成技能都应调用此技能作为返回可交付成果之前的最后一步。

plugin_texts.source: Capital-deployment verdict (GO / NO-GO / CONDITIONAL) on a real estate acquisition, value-add play, ground-up development, or conversion. Internally invokes realai-pro-forma to populate the underwriting workbook, then wraps outputs in an analytical writeup (verdict + thesis + comps + market context + risks + bottom line). Returns BOTH the populated .xlsx AND the writeup. Activate on: 'underwrite this deal', 'underwrite this acquisition', 'should I buy', 'screen this deal', 'run the numbers on', 'evaluate this development site', 'is this conversion feasible', 'investment thesis', 'go/no-go on this'. NOT for refi, partner buyouts, or disposition pricing (use realai-valuation). NOT for document verification without a pro forma run (use realai-underwriting Branch B). NOT for assets the user already owns and wants to diagnose (use realai-property-analysis).
plugin_texts.target: 关于房地产收购、增值活动、基础开发或转换的资本部署判决（通过/不通过/有条件）。内部调用 realai-pro-forma 来填充承保工作簿，然后将输出包装在分析报告中（结论 + 论文 + 比较 + 市场背景 + 风险 + 底线）。返回填充的 .xlsx 和 writeup。激活：“承销此交易”、“承销此收购”、“我应该购买”、“筛选此交易”、“运行数字”、“评估此开发站点”、“此转换是否可行”、“投资论点”、“进行/不进行此操作”。不适用于再融资、合作伙伴收购或处置定价（使用 realai-valuation）。不适用于未经形式运行的文件验证（使用 realai-underwriting Branch B）。不适用于用户已经拥有并想要诊断的资产（使用 realai-property-analysis）。

plugin_texts.source: Characterize and diagnose a held real estate asset (typically multifamily). Use when the user owns or operates the asset and wants to understand how it's running, who the tenants are, whether expenses are reasonable, how much rent upside exists in the rent roll, or whether the property manager is doing a good job. Four diagnostic frames: Tenant Analysis, Operating Efficiency, Mark-to-Market Rent, Property Manager Assessment. Activate on phrasings like: 'how is this property performing', 'who lives here', 'are we overpaying for management', 'is the operator doing a good job', 'what's our rent upside', 'why is OpEx so high', 'mark to market', 'tenant quality', 'retention is weak', 'should we replace the property manager'. Do NOT use this skill for buy/sell verdicts (route to realai-investment or realai-valuation), for document verification (route to realai-underwriting), or for market-level reads (route to realai-market-analysis).
plugin_texts.target: 描述和诊断持有的房地产资产（通常是多户住宅）。当用户拥有或经营资产并希望了解其运行情况、租户是谁、费用是否合理、租金清单中存在多少租金上涨空间或物业经理是否做得很好时使用。四个诊断框架：租户分析、运营效率、按市价计算的租金​​、物业经理评估。激活诸如以下措辞：“该物业表现如何”、“谁住在这里”、“我们是否为管理支付了过高的费用”、“运营商做得好吗”、“我们的租金上涨幅度是多少”、“运营支出为什么这么高”、“按市场定价”、“租户质量”、“保留率很弱”、“我们是否应该更换物业经理”。请勿将此技能用于买入/卖出判断（通往 realai 投资或 realai 评估的路径）、文件验证（通往 realai 承销的路径）或市场级别的读取（通往 realai 市场分析的路径）。

plugin_texts.source: INTERNAL ENGINE — do NOT activate on general underwriting requests. This skill is the workbook-populating engine called BY other skills (realai-investment dispatches here for every branch's pro forma math; realai-underwriting Branch A dispatches here for engine-only output). It should fire as a standalone trigger ONLY when the user has uploaded their own cleaned template + manifest pair AND explicitly asks to populate that specific workbook ('populate this template with my deal,' 'run my manifest with these numbers'). General intent like 'underwrite this deal' goes to realai-investment — which internally invokes this engine and wraps the outputs in an analytical writeup. The Excel model is the sole authority for NOI, cap rate, yield on cost, DSCR, debt yield, IRR, equity multiple, waterfall, multi-year projections, and sensitivity.
plugin_texts.target: 内部引擎 — 请勿根据一般承保请求激活。该技能是由其他技能称为的工作簿填充引擎（realai-investment 在此处调度每个分支的预计数学；realai-underwriting Branch A 在此处调度仅引擎输出）。仅当用户上传了自己清理的模板+清单对并明确要求填充该特定工作簿（“用我的交易填充此模板”，“用这些数字运行我的清单”）时，它才应作为独立触发器触发。像“承保这笔交易”这样的一般意图会转到 realai-investment——它在内部调用这个引擎并将输出包装在分析报告中。 Excel 模型是 NOI、资本化率、成本收益率、DSCR、债务收益率、IRR、股本倍数、瀑布、多年预测和敏感性的唯一权威。

plugin_texts.source: INTERNAL ENGINE — only invoked by other RealAI skills, never on user intent. The centralized forecasting engine for this plugin. Any domain skill needing a forward-looking projection (rent growth, occupancy, home value, expense growth, NOI growth, population, job growth, income, household formation, permits) or a directional read on an oscillating capital-markets metric (cap rates) MUST dispatch to this engine rather than computing inline. Runs scripts/forecast.py — the sole math authority — and returns a structured response. Trend mode for compounding series; directional mode for oscillating series (no projection, only band position). Do NOT activate on direct user requests like 'forecast Charlotte rent' — those go through realai-market-analysis, realai-valuation, realai-investment, realai-single-family, or realai-discovery, which then dispatches here. The engine description exists for invocation by sibling skills, not for user trigger matching.
plugin_texts.target: 内部引擎——仅由其他 RealAI 技能调用，从不根据用户意图调用。该插件的集中预测引擎。任何需要前瞻性预测（租金增长、入住率、房屋价值、费用增长、NOI 增长、人口、就业增长、收入、家庭构成、许可证）或对波动的资本市场指标（上限利率）进行定向解读的领域技能都必须分派到此引擎，而不是内联计算。运行 script/forecast.py（唯一的数学权威）并返回结构化响应。复合系列的趋势模式；振荡系列的方向模式（无投影，仅带位置）。不要激活诸如“预测夏洛特租金”之类的直接用户请求，这些请求会经过 realai-market-analysis、realai-valuation、realai-investment、realai-single-family 或 realai-discovery，然后发送到此处。引擎描述的存在是为了由同级技能调用，而不是为了用户触发器匹配。

plugin_texts.source: INTERNAL ENGINE — only invoked by other RealAI skills, never on user intent. The centralized multifamily operating-statement engine for this plugin. Any domain skill needing an MF operating statement, forward projection, direct-cap value, DCF, levered returns, or yield-on-cost MUST dispatch to this engine rather than computing inline. Runs scripts/operating.py — the sole math authority on the no-template path. Two roles: authority (no workbook present — the engine's figures are binding) and cross_check (a realai-pro-forma workbook IS present — the workbook wins; this role returns a bounded advisory variance on headline NOI/EGI/cap only and can never override). Do NOT activate on direct user requests like 'underwrite this deal' — those go through realai-investment / realai-underwriting, which then dispatch here. The engine description exists for invocation by sibling skills, not for user trigger matching.
plugin_texts.target: 内部引擎——仅由其他 RealAI 技能调用，从不根据用户意图调用。该插件的集中式多系列操作语句引擎。任何需要 MF 运营报表、前瞻预测、直接上限价值、DCF、杠杆回报或成本收益率的领域技能都必须分派到此引擎，而不是内联计算。运行scripts/operating.py——无模板路径上的唯一数学权威。两个角色：权威（不存在工作簿 - 引擎的数据具有约束力）和 cross_check（存在真实的预计工作簿 - 工作簿胜出；该角色仅返回标题 NOI/EGI/cap 上的有限咨询差异，并且永远不能覆盖）。不要激活诸如“承保这笔交易”之类的直接用户请求——这些请求会通过 realai-investment / realai-underwriting，然后发送到此处。引擎描述的存在是为了由同级技能调用，而不是为了用户触发器匹配。

plugin_texts.source: Profile or characterize a NAMED real estate market (or 2–4 named peer markets). Three frames: Rental Market Analysis (where rents are headed — asking-vs-in-place spread, tradeouts, supply pipeline, tenant ceiling), Market Demand Drivers (migration cohort delta, employment, household formation), Market Entry Scorecard (strategy-weighted go/no-go for stabilized MF, value-add MF, ground-up MF, SFR aggregation, BTR, or mixed). Activate on phrasings like: 'rental market read', 'where are rents going', 'demand drivers', 'who's moving to', 'market entry scorecard', 'should we enter Charlotte', 'is Austin still good for value-add'. Do NOT use this skill to DISCOVER markets (route to realai-discovery), to analyze a single property (route to realai-property-analysis or realai-investment), or for capital-deployment verdicts on a specific deal (route to realai-investment).
plugin_texts.target: 描述或描述指定的房地产市场（或 2-4 个指定的同行市场）。三个框架：租赁市场分析（租金走向——要价与就地价差、交易、供应管道、租户上限）、市场需求驱动因素（移民群体增量、就业、家庭形成）、市场进入记分卡（稳定 MF、增值 MF、基础 MF、SFR 聚合、BTR 或混合的策略加权走/不走）。激活诸如“租赁市场阅读”、“租金去哪里”、“需求驱动因素”、“谁要搬到”、“市场进入记分卡”、“我们应该进入夏洛特”、“奥斯汀是否仍然有利于增值”等措辞。请勿使用此技能来发现市场（通往 realai-discovery 的路线）、分析单个房产（通往 realai-property-analysis 或 realai-investment 的路线）或对特定交易进行资本部署判决（通往 realai-investment 的路线）。

plugin_texts.source: Route real-estate intent across the RealAI Institutional skill suite. Activate this skill at the START of any real-estate task to disambiguate scope (one entity vs. 5+, market vs. property vs. deal), purpose (capital-deployment verdict vs. asset diagnosis vs. valuation vs. discovery), and the correct downstream skill. Trigger-collision avoidance is the priority — this skill exists so the seven analysis skills below fire correctly. Activate when the user mentions any of: real estate, multifamily, MF, property, market, submarket, MSA, deal, acquisition, underwriting, valuation, pro forma, comps, tenant, operator, manager, NOI, cap rate, IRR, rent, rental, occupancy, lease, OpEx, value-add, ground-up, development, conversion, BTR, SFR, single family, homeowner, refinance, disposition, buyout, due diligence, OM, T12, rent roll, appraisal, find, screen, rank, market entry, demand drivers.
plugin_texts.target: 在 RealAI 机构技能套件中传递房地产意图。在任何房地产任务开始时激活此技能，以消除范围（一个实体与 5 个以上实体、市场与财产与交易）、目的（资本部署判决与资产诊断、评估与发现）以及正确的下游技能的歧义。避免触发碰撞是首要任务——该技能的存在是为了确保下面的七个分析技能能够正确触发。当用户提到以下任何一项时激活：房地产、多户住宅、MF、财产、市场、子市场、MSA、交易、收购、承保、估值、备考、比较、租户、运营商、经理、NOI、资本化率、IRR、租金、出租、占用、租赁、运营支出、增值、基础、开发、转换、BTR、SFR、单户、房主、再融资、处置、买断、尽职调查、OM、T12、租金清单、评估、寻找、筛选、排名、市场进入、需求驱动因素。

plugin_texts.source: Search and rank a POPULATION (multifamily properties or markets) against criteria; return a ranked candidate list. Two branches: Find Properties — multifamily only via the RealAI semantic datamart; Find & Rank Markets — markets, counties, neighborhoods, zip codes within a larger parent area that best match concrete or fuzzy criteria. Activate on phrasings like: 'find me MF properties that', 'search for multifamily over 300 units', 'where should I buy for cashflow', 'rank the fastest-growing suburbs', 'screen markets for', 'top zip codes for', 'which neighborhoods are emerging'. Returns a candidate list, NOT analysis of one named thing. Single-family and commercial property search is NOT available in this skill — no Zillow integration. Do NOT use to PROFILE a single named market (route to realai-market-analysis), to underwrite a specific property (route to realai-investment), or to value a property (route to realai-valuation). Always invokes multi-entity discipline.

plugin_texts.source: Skill factory. The user uploads their populated, macro-free Excel underwriting model; this skill runs the three-phase Analysis → Remediation → Manifest workflow interactively and then emits a personalized, downloadable .plugin zip containing a cloned realai-pro-forma skill with the customer's cleaned template + manifest bundled and the description specialized to their deal type. Versioned re-emission supported (v1.0, v1.1, etc.) when the customer's model changes. Activate on phrasings like: 'clean my model', 'prepare this template', 'build a manifest for my underwriting model', 'turn this Excel model into a RealAI template', 'make this reusable', 'I want to use my own pro forma'. Output is a packaged installable skill, NOT loose files. Do NOT use this skill to run a deal — that's realai-pro-forma. Do NOT use to populate an already-prepared template — that's also realai-pro-forma.
plugin_texts.target: 技能工厂。用户上传其填充的、无宏的 Excel 承保模型；该技能以交互方式运行三阶段分析 → 修复 → 清单工作流程，然后发出个性化的可下载 .plugin zip，其中包含克隆的 realai-pro-forma 技能，其中包含客户清理后的模板 + 捆绑清单以及专门针对其交易类型的描述。当客户的模型发生变化时，支持版本重新发布（v1.0、v1.1 等）。激活以下措辞：“清理我的模型”、“准备此模板”、“为我的承保模型构建清单”、“将此 Excel 模型转换为 RealAI 模板”、“使其可重复使用”、“我想使用我自己的备考模型”。输出是打包的可安装技能，而不是松散的文件。不要用这个技能来进行交易——那是真正的形式。不要用于填充已经准备好的模板——这也是 realai-pro-forma。

plugin_texts.source: Triangulate a defensible value range for a commercial real estate asset (multifamily, office, industrial, retail, hotel, self-storage, senior housing, mixed-use). Serves four purposes: acquisition underwriting, refinance LTV testing, partner buyout or mark-to-market, disposition pricing. NOT acquisition-scoped — valuation is a shared input. Activate on phrasings like: 'what's this worth', 'value range', 'valuation memo', 'refi value', 'buyout price', 'mark to market this asset', 'disposition pricing', 'find me comps', 'sale comps', 'rental comps', 'what cap rate'. Produces a value memo, NOT a formal appraisal. Sale and rental comp methodology lives inside this skill (references/) and is also referenced by realai-investment, realai-underwriting, and realai-property-analysis.

plugin_texts.source: Two narrow purposes — do NOT use for general 'underwrite this deal' intent (route to realai-investment, which returns both workbook and writeup). Use ONLY when: (A) Engine-only output — user explicitly asks for raw workbook without writeup ('just populate the template', 'run the manifest', 'workbook only no writeup'). Dispatches to realai-pro-forma, returns .xlsx + short receipt with NO narrative. (B) Document verification / due diligence — user uploaded OM, T12, rent roll, or appraisal AND explicitly wants pressure-testing ('verify the OM', 'reconcile the T12', 'due diligence on', 'pressure test the broker package', 'do the numbers tie'). Produces Clear / Conditional / Material Concerns verdict. Branch B does NOT run a pro forma. For full underwriting analysis with verdict and writeup, use realai-investment.
plugin_texts.target: 有两个狭隘的目的 - 不要用于一般的“承保这笔交易”意图（通往 realai-investment 的路线，它返回工作簿和书面报告）。仅在以下情况下使用：(A) 仅引擎输出 - 用户明确要求提供原始工作簿而不进行写入（“仅填充模板”、“运行清单”、“仅工作簿，不写入”）。发送至 realai-pro-forma，返回 .xlsx + 简短收据，无任何说明。 (B) 文件验证/尽职调查 - 用户上传 OM、T12、租金清单或评估，并明确希望进行压力测试（“验证 OM”、“协调 T12”、“尽职调查”、“对经纪人包进行压力测试”、“数字匹配”）。产生明确/有条件/重大问题的裁决。分行 B 不进行备考。如需完整的承保分析（包括判决和记录），请使用 realai-investment。

plugin_texts.source: Configures Render private services—internal-only apps that accept traffic exclusively from other Render services over the private network. plugin_texts.source: Get production context from Resolve for the area you're about to change — so the work is grounded in what production looks like and aware of how the change could affect it, before you start rather than after the PR is up. Use before implementing a fix or feature, when finalizing a plan or approach, or before editing anything that affects a production system — application code, infrastructure, or config-as-code (Helm, Terraform, Dockerfiles, CI/CD, SQL/migrations, protos) — or when the user says "let's build/fix/implement X". Surfaces the area's normal operational profile (traffic and usage, telemetry coverage, baseline latency/error rate), the regression risk of the change, plus any active alerts, open investigations, recent incidents or deploys, and known fragility.

plugin_texts.source: How Runpod works and how to work it — pods vs serverless, GPU/VRAM selection, storage, building a container, networking, plus the agentic pod development loop (provision → ssh-exec → set up → poll readiness) and on-pod install hygiene (uv/apt). Use to answer "how does X work", "which GPU", "how do I build a container", or "how do I stand up a workload on a pod". Guidance, not a tool — execute with runpodctl, runpod-mcp, or flash.
plugin_texts.target: Runpod 的工作原理以及如何工作 — Pod 与无服务器、GPU/VRAM 选择、存储、构建容器、网络，以及代理 Pod 开发循环（配置 → ssh-exec → 设置 → 轮询准备）和 Pod 上安装卫生 (uv/apt)。用于回答“X 如何工作”、“哪个 GPU”、“如何构建容器”或“如何在 Pod 上承受工作负载”。指导，而不是工具 — 使用 runpodctl、runpod-mcp 或 flash 执行。

plugin_texts.source: Manage Runpod infrastructure — pods, serverless endpoints, jobs, templates, network volumes, container-registry auth, GPU/CPU catalog, and billing — via the Runpod MCP server's structured tool calls. Use when the Runpod MCP tools (create-pod, list-endpoints, …) are connected in this session, or to connect them (hosted OAuth or local npx). Prefer this over runpodctl for plain infra CRUD when MCP is available; use runpodctl for the terminal, file transfer, or SSH setup.
plugin_texts.target: 通过 Runpod MCP 服务器的结构化工具调用来管理 Runpod 基础设施 - Pod、无服务器端点、作业、模板、网络卷、容器注册表身份验证、GPU/CPU 目录和计费。当 Runpod MCP 工具（create-pod、list-endpoints 等）在此会话中连接时使用，或连接它们（托管 OAuth 或本地 npx）。当 MCP 可用时，对于简单的基础设施 CRUD 而言，优先使用此选项而不是 runpodctl；使用 runpodctl 进行终端、文件传输或 SSH 设置。

plugin_texts.source: Runpod CLI for managing GPU/CPU workloads from the terminal — pods, serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes, Hub deploys, models, SSH, and file transfer (send/receive). Use for terminal/CI/scripting, Hub browse/deploy, SSH setup, `doctor`, or when the Runpod MCP tools are not connected. For structured tool calls in an MCP-enabled session, prefer runpod-mcp.
plugin_texts.target: Runpod CLI 用于从终端管理 GPU/CPU 工作负载 — Pod、无服务器端点、模板、网络卷、集线器部署、模型、SSH 和文件传输（发送/接收）。用于终端/CI/脚本、集线器浏览/部署、SSH 设置、`doctor` 或未连接 Runpod MCP 工具时。对于启用 MCP 的会话中的结构化工具调用，首选 runpod-mcp。

plugin_texts.source: Start here for any Runpod task — running GPU/CPU pods, deploying serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes, building images, or understanding how Runpod works. Routes the request to the right Runpod skill (runpod-mcp, runpodctl, flash, companion-clis, or runpod-usage). Use when it is unclear which Runpod skill applies.
plugin_texts.target: 从此处开始执行任何 Runpod 任务 - 运行 GPU/CPU Pod、部署无服务器端点、模板、网络卷、构建映像或了解 Runpod 的工作原理。将请求路由到正确的 Runpod 技能（runpod-mcp、runpodctl、flash、companion-clis 或 runpod-usage）。当不清楚适用哪种 Runpod 技能时使用。

plugin_texts.source: runpod-flash — code-first serverless: write Python locally, run it on remote Runpod GPUs/CPUs with `flash dev` (hot-reload + live worker logs), then `flash deploy`. Use for @Endpoint/@remote functions, resource config, and debugging flash deployments. For CLI-only infra management use runpodctl or runpod-mcp.
plugin_texts.target: runpod-flash — 代码优先的无服务器：在本地编写 Python，使用“flash dev”（热重载 + 实时工作日志）在远程 Runpod GPU/CPU 上运行它，然后“flash 部署”。用于@Endpoint/@remote 功能、资源配置和调试闪存部署。对于仅限 CLI 的基础设施管理，请使用 runpodctl 或 runpod-mcp。

Covers identity resolution, competitive intelligence, due diligence, org chart mapping, relationship mapping, risk signal detection, and answering any question about who someone is or what a company does. AI research agents return verified, source-backed answers with no fixed schema — you define the fields you need.
