plugin_texts.source: Guide for upgrading Stripe API versions and SDKs
plugin_texts.target: Stripe API版本和SDK升级指南

plugin_texts.source: Guides Stripe integration decisions across API selection (Checkout Sessions vs PaymentIntents), Connect platform setup (Accounts v2, controller properties), billing/subscriptions, tax and registrations (Stripe Tax, automatic_tax, product tax codes), Treasury financial accounts, integration options (Checkout, Payment Element), migrating from deprecated Stripe APIs, and security best practices (API key management, restricted keys, webhooks, OAuth). Use when building, modifying, or reviewing any Stripe integration, including accepting payments, building marketplaces, integrating Stripe, processing payments, setting up subscriptions, collecting sales tax, VAT, or GST, creating connected accounts, or implementing secure key handling.
plugin_texts.target: 指导 Stripe 跨 API 选择（结帐会话与 PaymentIntents）、Connect 平台设置（帐户 v2、控制器属性）、计费/订阅、税务和注册（Stripe 税、自动税、产品税代码）、财务财务帐户、集成选项（结帐、付款元素）、从已弃用的 Stripe API 迁移以及安全最佳实践（API 密钥管理、受限密钥、Webhooks、OAuth）的 Stripe 集成决策。在构建、修改或审查任何 Stripe 集成时使用，包括接受付款、构建市场、集成 Stripe、处理付款、设置订阅、征收销售税、增值税或商品及服务税、创建连接帐户或实施安全密钥处理。

plugin_texts.source: Use this skill when the user asks about Stripe Connect configuration, charge patterns, Dashboard access, or how to get started with Connect, is building a marketplace, platform, multi-vendor store, gig platform, or subscription platform, needs to pay out sellers, vendors, or providers, mentions split payments, revenue sharing, multi-party payments, or similar payment distribution concepts, provides a company URL or business description for a recommendation, builds SaaS that routes money between parties (for example, POS, booking, invoicing — not operational SaaS without payment routing), asks about onboarding or KYC for merchants, sellers, and vendors, mentions connected account Dashboard or responsibility configurations, or asks about payment flows, white-label payments, or embedded payments.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户询问 Stripe Connect 配置、收费模式、仪表板访问或如何开始使用 Connect、正在构建市场、平台、多供应商商店、零工平台或订阅平台、需要向卖家、供应商或提供商付款、提及分摊付款、收入共享、多方付款或类似的付款分配概念、提供公司 URL 或业务描述以进行推荐、构建在各方之间路由资金的 SaaS（例如 POS、预订、开票 — 而不是）时，请使用此技能没有支付路由的可操作 SaaS），询问商家、卖家和供应商的入职或 KYC，提及连接帐户仪表板或责任配置，或询问支付流程、白标支付或嵌入式支付。

plugin_texts.source: Use when building, modifying, or reviewing a Stripe App — or when the user describes something that implies one (e.g. "add a panel to the customer page", "customize my Stripe Dashboard", "react to Stripe events from my app", "connect my service to Stripe without sharing API keys"). Covers the full app development workflow (scaffold, preview, upload, versioning), UI extension architecture (sandboxed iframe, Stripe UI toolkit, viewports), extension types (UI extensions, backend-only, extension interfaces, embedded apps), authentication (platform keys, OAuth, restricted API keys), stripe-app.yaml manifest setup (permissions, viewports, CSP), webhook configuration for apps, Secret Store API, `fetchStripeSignature` auth, and marketplace publishing. Use when the user mentions Stripe Apps, UI extensions, @stripe/ui-extension-sdk, stripe-app.yaml, Dashboard extensions, or customizing the Stripe Dashboard.
plugin_texts.target: 在构建、修改或审查 Stripe 应用程序时使用，或者当用户描述暗示某项内容时使用（例如“向客户页面添加面板”、“自定义我的 Stripe 仪表板”、“对我的应用程序中的 Stripe 事件做出反应”、“将我的服务连接到 Stripe 而不共享 API 密钥”）。涵盖完整的应用程序开发工作流程（支架、预览、上传、版本控制）、UI 扩展架构（沙盒 iframe、Stripe UI 工具包、视口）、扩展类型（UI 扩展、仅后端、扩展接口、嵌入式应用程序）、身份验证（平台密钥、OAuth、受限 API 密钥）、stripe-app.yaml 清单设置（权限、视口、CSP）、应用程序的 Webhook 配置、Secret Store API、“fetchStripeSignature”授权和市场发布。当用户提到 Stripe 应用程序、UI 扩展、@stripe/ui-extension-sdk、stripe-app.yaml、仪表板扩展或自定义 Stripe 仪表板时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Use when the user or agent needs to read, search, or look up Stripe documentation or API reference. Prefer this over curl or WebFetch for any docs.stripe.com content.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户或代理需要阅读、搜索或查找 Stripe 文档或 API 参考时使用。对于任何 docs.stripe.com 内容，首选此方法而不是curl 或 WebFetch。

plugin_texts.source: Use when the user wants to find businesses, software, service providers, or partners for a specific industry, workflow, pain point, capability, or job to be done. Also use when the agent needs to programmatically purchase or consume a service. Use Stripe Directory to build a short relevant shortlist, even if the user does not mention Stripe Directory explicitly.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户想要为特定行业、工作流程、痛点、能力或待完成的工作寻找企业、软件、服务提供商或合作伙伴时使用。当代理需要以编程方式购买或使用服务时也可以使用。即使用户没有明确提及 Stripe Directory，也可以使用 Stripe Directory 构建简短的相关候选列表。

plugin_texts.source: Use when the user wants to provision infrastructure or third-party services using Stripe Projects. Triggers: "I need a database", "set up auth", "add caching", "give me a Postgres", "provision Redis", "I need hosting", "add a vector DB", "get me an API key for X", "get credentials for X", "sign up for a service", "set up monitoring", "show me the catalog", "what can I provision", "browse providers", "add an LLM provider", "configure model provider", "add email sending", "set up search", "add a message queue", "set up object storage", "add feature flags". Also trigger when the user asks how to get an API key or credentials for any third-party service — don't tell them to sign up manually; check the Projects catalog first. Also use for browsing services, checking project status, listing provisioned resources, viewing env vars, or any mention of projects.dev or adding/provisioning/connecting a cloud service.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户想要使用 Stripe 项目配置基础设施或第三方服务时使用。触发器：“我需要一个数据库”、“设置身份验证”、“添加缓存”、“给我一个 Postgres”、“配置 Redis”、“我需要托管”、“添加矢量数据库”、“为我获取 X 的 API 密钥”、“获取 X 的凭据”、“注册服务”、“设置监控”、“向我显示目录”、“我可以配置什么”、“浏览提供商”、“添加 LLM 提供商”、 “配置模型提供程序”、“添加电子邮件发送”、“设置搜索”、“添加消息队列”、“设置对象存储”、“添加功能标志”。当用户询问如何获取任何第三方服务的 API 密钥或凭证时也会触发 — 不要告诉他们手动注册；首先检查项目目录。还可用于浏览服务、检查项目状态、列出已配置的资源、查看环境变量或提及projects.dev 或添加/配置/连接云服务。

plugin_texts.source: Use when a user asks for something outside flight search (hotels, airport transfers, car rentals, activities, cruises, visas, refund/reschedule, customer support tickets, etc.). Honestly state the current limitation and point the user to the matching page on Traveloka's website instead of fabricating results or pretending the request was handled. Trigger scenarios - any request for hotel booking, airport transfer, car rental, activities/tickets, cruises, or any non-flight-search travel service.

plugin_texts.source: Let's setup Unabyss
plugin_texts.target: 让我们设置 Unabyss

plugin_texts.source: Coach the user on customer-discovery interviews using the principles from The Mom Test. Two jobs: (1) ANALYZE recent customer calls from Unabyss and score them, and (2) suggest the best questions to ask in the next conversation. Trigger this whenever the user mentions a sales call, customer interview, discovery call, user interview, a transcript, Mom Test, feedback on my call, how did my call go, what should I ask, prep for a call, or wants to get better at talking to customers — even if they do not name the Mom Test explicitly.
plugin_texts.target: 使用妈妈测试中的原则指导用户进行客户发现访谈。两项工作：(1) 分析 Unabyss 最近的客户来电并对其进行评分，(2) 建议在下次对话中提出的最佳问题。每当用户提到销售电话、客户访谈、发现电话、用户访谈、文字记录、妈妈测试、我的通话反馈、我的通话进展如何、我应该问什么、准备通话或想要更好地与客户交谈时，即使他们没有明确提及妈妈测试，也会触发此功能。

plugin_texts.source: Compare what the user said they were focused on against what they have actually been working on, and surface the gap. Use this skill whenever the user asks about focus, priorities, drift, alignment, whether they are working on the right things, what they have been spending time on, why they feel scattered, or says things like are we focused, am I on track, what did I actually work on this week, or I feel like I am losing focus.
plugin_texts.target: 将用户所说的他们关注的内容与他们实际正在做的内容进行比较，并找出差距。每当用户询问焦点、优先级、漂移、一致性、他们是否在做正确的事情、他们花了时间在什么上、为什么他们感到分散，或者说诸如我们是否专注、我是否在正轨上、我本周实际在做什么，或者我感觉我正在失去焦点之类的问题时，请使用此技能。

plugin_texts.source: Conduct market and competitive research grounded in the user's actual positioning, deals, and customer conversations — not generic web research. Use this skill whenever the user wants to understand their market, analyze competitors, size an opportunity, research investors, or make a decision that requires external intelligence. Also trigger when someone asks who else does what they do, how they compare to alternatives, or what the market looks like.
plugin_texts.target: 根据用户的实际定位、交易和客户对话进行市场和竞争研究，而不是一般的网络研究。每当用户想要了解市场、分析竞争对手、评估机会、研究投资者或做出需要外部情报的决策时，请使用此技能。当有人询问还有谁在做他们所做的事情、他们与替代品相比如何或市场状况如何时，也会触发。

plugin_texts.source: Derive a founder or company voice profile from real writing samples found in connected sources, then use it to ensure all content sounds like the actual person — not generic AI copy. Use this skill whenever the user asks about their writing style, brand voice, tone of voice, how they sound, or wants any content to match their voice. Also trigger when another skill needs a voice profile before writing copy, posts, emails, or outreach.
plugin_texts.target: 从互联来源中找到的真实写作样本中得出创始人或公司的声音资料，然后用它来确保所有内容听起来都像真人——而不是通用的人工智能副本。每当用户询问他们的写作风格、品牌声音、语气、声音或希望任何内容与他们的声音相匹配时，请使用此技能。当另一项技能在撰写文案、帖子、电子邮件或外展之前需要语音配置文件时也会触发。

plugin_texts.source: Draft a monthly or quarterly investor update email from real company data — what shipped, key metrics, wins, blockers, and what help is needed — without the founder having to compile anything manually. Use this skill whenever the user wants to write an investor update, send a monthly update to investors, draft a board update, or keep investors in the loop on progress. Also trigger when someone says it's time to update investors or they haven't sent an update in a while.

plugin_texts.source: Use when a val needs simple key/value persistence — JSON documents, cached responses, uploaded files, or binary assets. Covers the std/blob API, listing and deleting keys, account-global or val scoping, and storage limits.
plugin_texts.target: 当 val 需要简单的键/值持久性时使用 - JSON 文档、缓存的响应、上传的文件或二进制资产。涵盖 std/blob API、列出和删除密钥、帐户全局或 val 范围以及存储限制。

plugin_texts.source: Use when a val needs to require login with a Val Town account — gating routes behind authentication, identifying the current user, building user-specific dashboards. Covers std/oauth's `oauthMiddleware` and `getOAuthUserData`, the auto-managed `/auth/*` routes, and session behavior. For third-party OAuth providers (Google, GitHub, etc.) see the `third-party-integrations` skill instead.
plugin_texts.target: 当 val 需要要求使用 Val Town 帐户登录时使用 - 控制身份验证后的路由、识别当前用户、构建特定于用户的仪表板。涵盖 std/oauth 的“oauthMiddleware”和“getOAuthUserData”、自动管理的“/auth/*”路由和会话行为。对于第三方 OAuth 提供商（Google、GitHub 等），请参阅“第三方集成”技能。

plugin_texts.source: Use when a val needs to ship JavaScript that runs in the browser — React apps, vanilla DOM scripts, canvas/games, htmx/Alpine, or any client-side module beyond a single inline snippet. Explains how Val Town serves transpiled .ts/.tsx/.jsx modules with no build step, how the browser resolves their imports, and how to load third-party deps.
plugin_texts.target: 当 val 需要传送在浏览器中运行的 JavaScript 时使用 - React 应用程序、vanilla DOM 脚本、画布/游戏、htmx/Alpine 或超出单个内联片段的任何客户端模块。解释 Val Town 如何在没有构建步骤的情况下提供转译的 .ts/.tsx/.jsx 模块、浏览器如何解析其导入以及如何加载第三方 deps。

plugin_texts.source: Use when a val needs to store structured or relational data. Covers the std/sqlite API, parameterized queries, transactions, and the val-scoped vs organization-scoped database distinction.
plugin_texts.target: 当 val 需要存储结构化或关系数据时使用。涵盖 std/sqlite API、参数化查询、事务以及 val 范围与组织范围数据库的区别。

plugin_texts.source: Use when a val sends email, receives email, or is triggered by an incoming email. Covers email-type vals (the Email handler shape, attachment limits, the assigned val email address) and sending mail via std/email.
plugin_texts.target: 当 val 发送电子邮件、接收电子邮件或由传入电子邮件触发时使用。涵盖电子邮件类型 vals（电子邮件处理程序形状、附件限制、分配的 val 电子邮件地址）和通过 std/email 发送邮件。

plugin_texts.source: Use when a val talks to an external service — Slack, Discord, Telegram, Stripe, GitHub, Gmail, Google Sheets, Postgres/Supabase/Upstash/Neon, browser automation (Playwright, Browserbase, Kernel, Steel), web scraping, PDF generation, push notifications, RSS, or any other third-party API. Covers the required workflow (fetch the Val Town guide, get credentials, test, store secrets) and the catalog of available guides.
plugin_texts.target: 当 val 与外部服务通信时使用 - Slack、Discord、Telegram、Stripe、GitHub、Gmail、Google Sheets、Postgres/Supabase/Upstash/Neon、浏览器自动化（Playwright、Browserbase、Kernel、Steel）、网页抓取、PDF 生成、推送通知、RSS 或任何其他第三方 API。涵盖所需的工作流程（获取瓦尔镇指南、获取凭证、测试、存储秘密）和可用指南的目录。

plugin_texts.source: Use when a val's HTTP endpoints should not be open to the whole internet — limiting an app to a team, understanding why an endpoint redirects to a login page, letting a webhook through, or identifying which Val Town user is viewing an app. Covers app access (`httpPrivacy`), org grants, bypass tokens for automation, and the `X-Val-Town-User` identity header. For building your own login flow inside a val, see the `oauth` skill instead.
plugin_texts.target: 当 val 的 HTTP 端点不应向整个互联网开放时使用 - 将应用程序限制为团队、了解端点重定向到登录页面的原因、让 Webhook 通过或识别哪个 Val Town 用户正在查看应用程序。涵盖应用程序访问（“httpPrivacy”）、组织拨款、绕过自动化令牌以及“X-Val-Town-User”身份标头。要在 val 内构建您自己的登录流程，请参阅“oauth”技能。

plugin_texts.source: Use when building a val that runs on a schedule — periodic jobs, recurring tasks, polling, cron jobs, monitoring, alerting. Covers the interval handler signature, cron expressions, the UTC timezone constraint, and the `lastRunAt` pattern for detecting new items since the previous run.
plugin_texts.target: 在构建按计划运行的 val 时使用 - 定期作业、重复任务、轮询、cron 作业、监控、警报。涵盖间隔处理程序签名、cron 表达式、UTC 时区约束以及用于检测自上次运行以来的新项目的“lastRunAt”模式。

plugin_texts.source: Use when building an HTTP val — a web endpoint, API route, webhook receiver, or any val that responds to HTTP requests. Covers the handler signature, Hono usage, the endpoint URL, CORS behavior, redirects, and Val Town-specific limitations.
plugin_texts.target: 在构建 HTTP val 时使用 - Web 端点、API 路由、webhook 接收器或响应 HTTP 请求的任何 val。涵盖处理程序签名、Hono 用法、端点 URL、CORS 行为、重定向和 Val Town 特定的限制。

plugin_texts.source: Use when building any val with a user interface — dashboards, web apps, landing pages, forms, admin tools, anything users see in a browser. Covers JSX/React conventions, Twind/Tailwind styling, React version pinning, the view-source link requirement, and what to avoid (template-string HTML, external assets).
plugin_texts.target: 在使用用户界面构建任何 val 时使用 - 仪表板、Web 应用程序、登录页面、表单、管理工具以及用户在浏览器中看到的任何内容。涵盖 JSX/React 约定、Twind/Tailwind 样式、React 版本固定、视图源链接要求以及应避免的内容（模板字符串 HTML、外部资源）。

plugin_texts.source: Use when the user wants to persist a preference, skill, or knowledge. Use when it would aid future val development to store a memory of how best to build something.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户想要保留偏好、技能或知识时使用。当它有助于未来的验证开发时使用，以存储如何最好地构建某些东西的记忆。

plugin_texts.source: Research what's trending — cultural shifts, emerging signals, viral hashtags, forward-looking patterns — by running social trending tools, the Waldo Trends database, and web search in parallel, then synthesizing by trend rather than by source. Trigger on velocity-shaped prompts: "what's trending", "what should we watch", "what's happening this week/month", "what's on consumers' minds", "viral hashtags", "rising topics", "emerging signals", "what's the media talking about". ALSO trigger on trend-grounded ideation: "what should we build around right now", "brief around a trending [topic]", "what's an emerging angle for [X]". Always load this skill before calling trending MCP tools or native WebSearch on trend-shaped queries — never ideate from training alone. Do NOT trigger for steady-state brand deep dives (use Web Research) or perception of a known brand (use Social Intelligence).
plugin_texts.target: 通过并行运行社交趋势工具、Waldo 趋势数据库和网络搜索，研究流行趋势 - 文化转变、新兴信号、病毒式标签、前瞻性模式，然后按趋势而不是按来源进行综合。触发速度形状的提示：“趋势是什么”、“我们应该看什么”、“本周/本月发生了什么”、“消费者的想法是什么”、“病毒式标签”、“新兴话题”、“新出现的信号”、“媒体在谈论什么”。还触发基于趋势的想法：“我们现在应该围绕什么构建”、“围绕趋势[主题]进行简要介绍”、“[X] 的新兴角度是什么”。在针对趋势型查询调用趋势 MCP 工具或本机 WebSearch 之前，请始终加载此技能 - 切勿仅通过培训来构思。不要触发稳态品牌深入研究（使用网络研究）或对已知品牌的认知（使用社交情报）。

plugin_texts.source: Trigger when the user says "crunch the numbers", "compare Q3 vs Q4", "what does this data show", "break down these numbers", "analyze this CSV", "build a pivot", "calculate growth rate", "find outliers", provides a data file, references workspace spreadsheets/reports, or pastes a table. Performs calculations, statistical analysis, trend identification, period-over-period comparisons, distribution analysis, and data transformations on CSV, Excel, PDF tables, and JSON. Always load before calling file MCP tools (file_repo_reader, file_search, file_repository_*) directly — never freelance these without the skill's methodology. Do NOT trigger for ad performance metrics (no API access to ad accounts) or live brand signals (use Archival Knowledge).
plugin_texts.target: 当用户说“计算数字”、“比较第三季度与第四季度”、“此数据显示什么”、“分解这些数字”、“分析此 CSV”、“构建数据透视表”、“计算增长率”、“查找异常值”、提供数据文件、引用工作区电子表格/报告或粘贴表格时触发。对 CSV、Excel、PDF 表和 JSON 执行计算、统计分析、趋势识别、周期比较、分布分析和数据转换。始终在直接调用文件 MCP 工具（file_repo_reader、file_search、file_repository_*）之前加载 — 切勿在没有技能方法的情况下自由使用这些工具。请勿触发广告效果指标（无法通过 API 访问广告帐户）或实时品牌信号（使用档案知识）。

plugin_texts.source: Trigger when the user says "research [topic]", "deep dive on [X]", "compare [A] vs [B]", "audit [website]", "what does [brand] do", "draft a POV on [topic]", "summarize this PDF", "how does [competitor] position", or asks any open-ended brand/category/competitor question, persona simulation, or demographic breakdown. ALSO trigger on research-design / population framings: "% breakdown of [population]", "representative sample of [region]", "who should I survey to reach [audience]", "audience composition for research", "priority populations". ALSO trigger on creative-ideation framings: "give me ideas for [X]", "shape a campaign around [Y]", "brainstorm around [topic]", "draft a creative brief for [Z]". POV, persona, creative- ideation, and research-design prompts always need fresh research grounding — never answer from training alone, never freelance native WebSearch. Do NOT trigger for ad library (use Ad Intelligence), social sentiment (use Social Intelligence), or trending queries (use Trends Research).
plugin_texts.target: 当用户说“研究[主题]”、“深入研究[X]”、“比较[A]与[B]”、“审核[网站]”、“[品牌]做什么”、“起草关于[主题]的POV”、“总结此PDF”、“[竞争对手]定位如何”或询问任何开放式品牌/类别/竞争对手问题、角色模拟或人口统计细分时触发。还触发研究设计/人口框架：“[人口]的百分比细分”、“[地区]的代表性样本”、“我应该调查谁以接触[受众]”、“研究的受众构成”、“优先人群”。还触发创意构想框架：“给我关于 [X] 的想法”、“围绕 [Y] 制定活动”、“围绕 [主题] 集思广益”、“为 [Z] 起草创意简报”。 POV、人物角色、创意构思和研究设计提示始终需要新的研究基础——永远不要仅通过培训来回答，也永远不要自由的本地网络搜索。不要触发广告库（使用广告智能）、社交情绪（使用社交智能）或趋势查询（使用趋势研究）。

plugin_texts.source: Trigger when the user says "what ads is [brand] running", "show me [competitor] creatives", "how is [brand] advertising", "what's [brand] saying in ads", "compare ad strategies", "ad library", "find ads for [keyword]", or asks about competitor ads, paid media presence, ad creative, ad messaging, hook/value-prop comparisons, or regional campaign mapping on Meta/Google/LinkedIn — even without saying "ad". plugin_texts.source: Trigger when the user says "what are people saying about [brand]", "how is [brand] perceived", "sentiment on [X]", "what's the buzz around [X]", "how are people reacting to [X]", "show me TikToks of [product]", "is [brand] going viral", or asks about social sentiment, audience perception, audience overlap, creator/influencer activity, viral content, fan behavior, or reactions on Reddit/Instagram/TikTok/X/Facebook/LinkedIn/YouTube. plugin_texts.source: Use when the user asks for a WorkOS docs URL, term, or dashboard field (Sign-in endpoint, initiate_login_uri, Redirect URI, `WORKOS_*` env vars), or is implementing, debugging, or migrating WorkOS — AuthKit, SSO/SAML, Directory Sync, RBAC, FGA, MFA, Vault, Audit Logs, Admin Portal, Pipes (Connected Apps), Feature Flags, Radar (bot/fraud detection), webhooks, Custom Domains, running the `workos` CLI in agent or sandbox sessions (`WORKOS_MODE`, `workos doctor`), or migrating from Auth0, Clerk, Cognito, Firebase, Supabase, Stytch, Descope, or Better Auth. Also triggers on @workos-inc/* imports.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户请求 WorkOS 文档 URL、术语或仪表板字段（登录端点、initiate_login_uri、重定向 URI、`WORKOS_*` 环境变量）或正在实施、调试或迁移 WorkOS 时使用 - AuthKit、SSO/SAML、目录同步、RBAC、FGA、MFA、Vault、审核日志、管理门户、管道（连接的应用程序）、功能标志、雷达（机器人/欺诈）检测）、webhooks、自定义域、在代理或沙箱会话中运行“workos”CLI（“WORKOS_MODE”、“workos doctor”），或者从 Auth0、Clerk、Cognito、Firebase、Supabase、Stytch、Descope 或 Better Auth 迁移。也会在 @workos-inc/* 导入时触发。

plugin_texts.source: Use when the user is implementing, embedding, or debugging a WorkOS Widget — specifically the User Management, User Profile, Admin Portal SSO Connection, or Admin Portal Domain Verification widgets. Handles the full stack — detecting the frontend (Next.js, React, React Router, TanStack Start, Vite, SvelteKit), generating access tokens via the backend SDK in use (Node, Python, Go, Ruby, PHP, Java, .NET), and wiring up the widget component correctly per the bundled OpenAPI spec. Also use when code imports from @workos-inc/widgets or the user pastes <UserManagement /> or <UserProfile /> JSX.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户实施、嵌入或调试 WorkOS 小部件时使用 - 特别是用户管理、用户配置文件、管理门户 SSO 连接或管理门户域验证小部件。处理完整的堆栈 - 检测前端（Next.js、React、React Router、TanStack Start、Vite、SvelteKit），通过使用中的后端 SDK（Node、Python、Go、Ruby、PHP、Java、.NET）生成访问令牌，并根据捆绑的 OpenAPI 规范正确连接小部件组件。当代码从 @workos-inc/widgets 导入或用户粘贴 <UserManagement /> 或 <UserProfile /> JSX 时也可使用。

plugin_texts.source: Assemble a QBR prep pack for a business review — value moments, usage and adoption themes, risks, and open items, with a deal and relationship snapshot. Combines account_research for the account picture with conversation_intelligence over recent calls (scoped to individual engagements) for what the customer actually said. Identify the account by ZoomInfo company ID (preferred) or name/domain (triggers a lookup). Use when someone says "prep me for the Acme QBR", "build a QBR pack", "what should I cover in the business review", or needs a review-ready summary. Evidence-based: value moments, themes, and risks come from the conversations and CRM, not from assumption.
plugin_texts.target: 为业务审查组装 QBR 准备包 - 价值时刻、使用和采用主题、风险和未清项目，以及交易和关系快照。将帐户图片的 account_research 与最近通话（范围为个人参与）中的 conversation_intelligence 结合起来，了解客户实际所说的内容。通过 ZoomInfo 公司 ID（首选）或名称/域（触发查找）识别帐户。当有人说“让我为 Acme QBR 做好准备”、“构建 QBR 包”、“我应该在业务审核中涵盖哪些内容”或需要准备审核摘要时使用。基于证据：价值时刻、主题和风险来自对话和 CRM，而不是来自假设。

plugin_texts.source: Assess the health of an account from its recent conversations — sentiment trajectory and risk signals — backed by an engagement timeline and an account_research snapshot. Identify the account by ZoomInfo company ID (preferred) or name/domain (triggers a lookup). Use when someone asks "how healthy is Acme", "are we at risk of churn here", "what's the sentiment trend", or wants a risk read before a QBR or renewal. Strictly evidence-based: it does not invent risk or generic advice, and it asks the user for input where the conversations do not settle the question.
plugin_texts.target: 根据最近的对话（情绪轨迹和风险信号）评估账户的健康状况，并以参与时间表和账户研究快照为支持。通过 ZoomInfo 公司 ID（首选）或名称/域（触发查找）识别帐户。当有人询问“Acme 的健康状况如何”、“我们是否面临客户流失的风险”、“情绪趋势是什么”，或者想要在 QBR 或续订之前了解风险时使用。严格基于证据：它不会发明风险或通用建议，并且会在对话无法解决问题的情况下要求用户输入。

plugin_texts.source: Brief the user on their day. Pull today's (or a named day's) meetings and, for each, synthesize the current state of play, a suggested focus or objective, and any follow-ups needed. Uses browse_engagements for the schedule, then account_research, contact_research, and conversation_intelligence per meeting. Use when someone says "what's on my plate today", "brief me for my meetings", "prep my day", or wants a morning rundown before back-to-back calls. Because it researches every meeting, it can consume meaningful AI credits — it confirms scope before fanning out across a full day.
plugin_texts.target: 向用户简要介绍他们的一天。拉出今天（或指定日期）的会议，并针对每次会议综合当前的进展情况、建议的重点或目标以及所需的任何后续行动。使用 browser_engagements 作为日程安排，然后为每个会议使用 account_research、contact_research 和 Conversation_intelligence。当有人说“今天我的盘子里有什么”、“向我介绍我的会议情况”、“准备我的一天”，或者想要在连续通话之前了解早上的情况时使用。因为它会研究每次会议，所以它可以消耗有意义的 AI 积分——它会在全天展开会议之前确认范围。

plugin_texts.source: Build a "why now" case for reaching out to a company — the timing thesis and the specific hooks to lead with — by combining company signals (intent, news, scoops), account_research, your GTM context, and web research. Identify the company by ZoomInfo company ID (preferred) or name/domain (triggers a lookup). Use when someone asks "why should I reach out to Acme now", "what's our angle into this account", "give me a reason to call", or is planning outbound and needs timely, evidence-based hooks. Each hook ties a real signal to one of your offerings.
plugin_texts.target: 通过结合公司信号（意图、新闻、独家新闻）、account_research、GTM 背景和网络研究，构建一个“为什么现在”的案例来联系一家公司——时机主题和具体的挂钩。通过 ZoomInfo 公司 ID（首选）或名称/域（触发查找）来识别公司。当有人询问“为什么我现在应该联系 Acme”、“我们对这个帐户的看法是什么”、“给我一个打电话的理由”，或者正在计划出站并需要及时、基于证据的挂钩时使用。每个挂钩都将一个真实信号与您的产品之一联系起来。

plugin_texts.source: Build a ledger of what we promised versus what they promised, and what is still outstanding, across the last few engagements with an account or contact. Uses conversation_intelligence as the primary source. Identify the account or contact by ZoomInfo ID (preferred) or name (triggers a lookup), or point it at specific calls. Use when someone asks "what did we commit to", "what are they supposed to send us", "what's still outstanding with this account", or wants an accountability check before a follow-up. Covers the last few engagements only, not full history.
plugin_texts.target: 建立一个分类账，记录最近几次与客户或联系人的互动中我们承诺的内容与他们承诺的内容以及尚未完成的内容。使用conversation_intelligence 作为主要来源。通过 ZoomInfo ID（首选）或名称（触发查找）识别帐户或联系人，或将其指向特定呼叫。当有人询问“我们承诺了什么”、“他们应该向我们发送什么”、“该帐户还有哪些未完成的任务”，或者想要在后续行动之前进行责任检查时使用。仅涵盖最近的几次交战，而不是完整的历史。

plugin_texts.source: Build a list of contacts or companies matching specific criteria. Describe what you're looking for in natural language and get a structured, tabular list you can export. Supports filtering by title, seniority, department, industry, company size, location, tech stack, growth rate, and more. Outputs a clean table artifact.
plugin_texts.target: 建立符合特定标准的联系人或公司列表。用自然语言描述您要查找的内容，并获得可导出的结构化表格列表。支持按职称、资历、部门、行业、公司规模、地点、技术堆栈、增长率等进行过滤。输出一个干净的表工件。

plugin_texts.source: Build a mutual action plan (MAP) from what was actually discussed on recent calls — the shared, dated set of steps each side owns to reach the goal. Reviews recent engagements and goes deep with conversation_intelligence scoped to individual calls to pull open items, agreed next steps, owners, and the timelines discussed. Identify the account by ZoomInfo company ID (preferred) or name/domain (triggers a lookup). Use when someone says "build a mutual action plan for Acme", "turn our last calls into a MAP", "what are the next steps and dates on both sides", or needs a close or onboarding plan. Evidence-based: it plans only what was discussed and asks for the target date if one was not stated.
plugin_texts.target: 根据最近通话中实际讨论的内容制定共同行动计划（MAP）——双方为实现目标而共享的、注明日期的一组步骤。回顾最近的活动，并深入讨论对话情报，范围包括单独的电话，以拉动开放项目、商定的后续步骤、所有者和讨论的时间表。通过 ZoomInfo 公司 ID（首选）或名称/域（触发查找）识别帐户。当有人说“为 Acme 制定共同行动计划”、“将我们最后的通话转化为 MAP”、“双方下一步的步骤和日期是什么”或者需要一个结束或入职计划时使用。基于证据：它仅计划讨论的内容，如果没有说明，则询问目标日期。

plugin_texts.source: Build a timeline of engagements (meetings and emails) with an account or contact over a date range. Identify the account or contact by ZoomInfo ID (preferred), or by name or domain (triggers a lookup), or omit both to time-line your own recent engagements. Defaults to the last 90 days and can slide the window further back for a longer history. Returns a chronological timeline, a breakdown by engagement type, and a participant list with per-person engagement counts — and keeps each engagement's ID in context so you can immediately double-click any one to ask what was discussed. Use when someone asks "when did we last meet with X", "how often have we engaged this account", "show me the history with this contact", or wants a relationship timeline before a call.
plugin_texts.target: 建立一个日期范围内与客户或联系人的互动（会议和电子邮件）时间表。通过 ZoomInfo ID（首选）或名称或域（触发查找）来识别帐户或联系人，或者忽略这两者以安排您自己最近的活动的时间安排。默认为最近 90 天，并且可以将窗口进一步向后滑动以获得更长的历史记录。返回按时间顺序排列的时间线、按参与类型细分以及包含每人参与计数的参与者列表，并将每个参与的 ID 保留在上下文中，以便您可以立即双击任何一个来询问讨论的内容。当有人询问“我们上次与 X 见面是什么时候”、“我们使用此帐户的频率”、“向我显示与此联系人的历史记录”或想要在通话前了解关系时间表时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Coach a rep on how they handled a specific call — discovery quality, objection handling, talk dynamics, and next-call focus. Name the call if you know it, or let the skill pull recent calls and identify the most likely candidate to confirm. Uses conversation_intelligence to read how the conversation actually went. Use when someone asks "how did I do on the Acme call", "coach me on my last discovery call", "where did I lose them", or wants actionable feedback before the next conversation. Analyzes one call at a time.
plugin_texts.target: 指导销售代表如何处理特定的通话——发现质量、异议处理、谈话动态和下一个通话的焦点。如果您知道的话，请命名该通话，或者让技能提取最近的通话并确定最有可能确认的候选人。使用对话智能来了解对话的实际进展情况。当有人询问“我在 Acme 通话中表现如何”、“在上次发现通话中指导我”、“我在哪里失去了他们”或在下一次对话之前需要可操作的反馈时使用。一次分析一个呼叫。

plugin_texts.source: Draft a follow-up email after a call by extracting the commitments and next steps that were actually agreed, then writing a compact, friendly-professional message. Name the call if you know it, or let the skill pull recent calls to pick from. Uses conversation_intelligence to read what was said and committed. Use when someone says "draft a follow-up to that call", "send a recap email", "write the follow-up for my Acme meeting", or needs a post-call note. Drafts only what the conversation supports — it does not invent commitments.
plugin_texts.target: 通话后起草一封后续电子邮件，提取实际商定的承诺和后续步骤，然后撰写简洁、友好、专业的信息。如果您知道的话，请命名该呼叫，或者让该技能提取最近的呼叫以供选择。使用对话智能来读取所说内容和承诺内容。当有人说“起草该通话的后续行动”、“发送一封回顾电子邮件”、“为我的 Acme 会议编写后续行动”或需要通话后说明时使用。只起草对话支持的内容——它不会发明承诺。

plugin_texts.source: Find companies or contacts similar to a given reference. Provide a company name/domain or a person's name/email and get a ranked list of lookalikes scored by similarity. Useful for territory expansion, TAM analysis, competitive mapping, expanding buyer networks, and building targeted prospecting lists.
plugin_texts.target: 查找与给定参考相似的公司或联系人。提供公司名称/域名或人名/电子邮件，并获取按相似度评分的相似者的排名列表。对于领土扩张、TAM 分析、竞争性映射、扩大买家网络和建立有针对性的勘探列表很有用。

plugin_texts.source: Generate 1-3 personalized email variants for a single prospect. The composition bar adapts to the use case — cold_outbound demands a signal → pain → positioning chain; follow-ups / recaps / renewals lean on prior context and next-step framing. Supports cold_outbound, discovery_follow_up, demo_recap, re_engagement, renewal, expansion, objection_handling. Returns subject lines and mobile-readable bodies with a rationale chain. Use for sales prospecting, lead generation, account-based selling, buyer-intent-driven outreach, B2B prospecting. Triggers on phrases like "write a cold email", "personalize an email", "draft outreach", "follow up on this prospect", "email this prospect", "outbound to X", "send a chaser".
plugin_texts.target: 为单个潜在客户生成 1-3 个个性化电子邮件变体。组合栏适应用例——cold_outbound需要信号→疼痛→定位链；后续/回顾/更新依赖于先前的背景和下一步框架。支持cold_outbound、discovery_follow_up、demo_recap、re_engagement、续订、扩展、objection_handling。返回主题行和移动可读的正文以及理由链。用于销售勘探、潜在客户开发、基于帐户的销售、买方意图驱动的外展、B2B 勘探。触发诸如“写一封冷淡的电子邮件”、“个性化电子邮件”、“草稿外展”、“跟进此潜在客户”、“向此潜在客户发送电子邮件”、“出站至 X”、“发送追踪者”等短语。

plugin_texts.source: Get AI-powered contact recommendations at a target company based on your ZoomInfo interaction history. Provide a company name or domain and optionally a use case.
plugin_texts.target: 根据您的 ZoomInfo 互动历史记录，获取目标公司由 AI 支持的联系人推荐。提供公司名称或域名以及可选的用例。

plugin_texts.source: Look up a company's full profile. Provide a company name, domain, ticker symbol, or ZoomInfo company ID. Returns firmographics, financials, corporate structure, growth signals, and contact counts.
plugin_texts.target: Look up a company's full profile.提供公司名称、域名、股票代码或 ZoomInfo 公司 ID。返回企业结构、财务状况、公司结构、增长信号和联系人数量。

plugin_texts.source: Look up a person's full professional profile. Provide a name and company, email address, phone number, or ZoomInfo person ID. Returns title, department, contact details, accuracy score, and company info.
plugin_texts.target: 查找一个人的完整职业档案。提供姓名和公司、电子邮件地址、电话号码或 ZoomInfo 人员 ID。返回职位、部门、联系方式、准确度分数和公司信息。

plugin_texts.source: Map a prospect's buying process as voiced on recent calls — their stated decision criteria, timeline, steps, and approvers. Uses conversation_intelligence over an account's recent engagements, with account_research for stakeholder context. Identify the account by ZoomInfo company ID (preferred) or name/domain (triggers a lookup). Use when someone asks "what's their buying process", "who actually signs off", "what's the timeline and what do they need to decide", or wants to qualify a deal against MEDDIC-style criteria. Captures only what was actually stated; gaps are marked as unknown rather than inferred.
plugin_texts.target: 绘制潜在客户在最近电话会议中表达的购买流程——他们规定的决策标准、时间表、步骤和批准人。对帐户最近的参与情况使用对话情报，并使用帐户研究了解利益相关者背景。通过 ZoomInfo 公司 ID（首选）或名称/域（触发查找）识别帐户。当有人询问“他们的购买流程是什么”、“谁实际签署”、“时间表是什么以及他们需要决定什么”，或者想要根据 MEDDIC 风格的标准来确定交易资格时使用。仅捕获实际陈述的内容；差距被标记为未知而不是推断。

plugin_texts.source: Map the buying committee at a target account. Identifies decision-makers, prioritizes who to engage, and surfaces gaps and multi-thread risks. Leads with a TL;DR (top 3 to engage, biggest gap, multi-thread risk), uses compact tables, and deep-researches top stakeholders to catch stale records. Identify the account by ZoomInfo account/company ID (preferred) or by company name, domain, or ticker (which triggers a lookup step). Include detailed context on the deal, situation, and persona priorities driving the map.
plugin_texts.target: 将采购委员会映射到目标帐户。识别决策者，确定参与对象的优先顺序，并找出差距和多线程风险。以 TL;DR（参与度最高的 3 个、最大差距、多线程风险）为线索，使用紧凑的表格，并对顶级利益相关者进行深入研究以捕获过时的记录。通过 ZoomInfo 帐户/公司 ID（首选）或公司名称、域或股票代码（触发查找步骤）来识别帐户。包括有关交易、情况和驱动地图的角色优先级的详细背景。

plugin_texts.source: Monitor a company's buyer-intent signals and assess fit against your GTM context. Uses company signals scoped to intent for a single account, returns the recent topics it is researching, and analyzes which ones align with your offerings and ICP. Identify the company by ZoomInfo company ID (preferred) or name/domain (triggers a lookup). Use when someone asks "what is Acme researching", "are they showing intent on anything we sell", "monitor intent for this account", or wants an intent read before prioritizing an account.
plugin_texts.target: 监控公司的买家意向信号并评估是否适合您的 GTM 环境。使用针对单个帐户意图的公司信号，返回其正在研究的最新主题，并分析哪些主题与您的产品和 ICP 一致。通过 ZoomInfo 公司 ID（首选）或名称/域（触发查找）来识别公司。当有人询问“Acme 研究什么”、“他们是否对我们销售的任何产品表现出意图”、“监控此帐户的意图”或希望在优先考虑帐户之前阅读意图时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Monitor recent news and business events for a company and deliver a quick digest. Uses company signals scoped to news and scoops for a single account, grouped by type and recency, with a "so what" for each. Identify the company by ZoomInfo company ID (preferred) or name/domain (triggers a lookup). Use when someone asks "what's the latest news on Acme", "any recent developments at this account", "catch me up on what's happening there", or wants a news digest before a touchpoint.
plugin_texts.target: 监控公司最近的新闻和商业事件并提供快速摘要。使用针对单个帐户的新闻和独家新闻的公司信号，按类型和新近度分组，每个帐户都有一个“那又怎样”。通过 ZoomInfo 公司 ID（首选）或名称/域（触发查找）来识别公司。当有人询问“Acme 上的最新消息是什么”、“此帐户的最新动态”、“让我了解那里发生的事情”或想要在接触点之前查看新闻摘要时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Prepare for a renewal by assembling pre-renewal context — value delivered and value moments, risk handles, and stakeholder state — from recent conversations and account_research. Identify the account by ZoomInfo company ID (preferred) or name/domain (triggers a lookup). Use when someone asks "prep me for the Acme renewal", "what's our case for renewal", "what are the risks going into this renewal", or wants a renewal brief. Strictly evidence-based: it does not assume the renewal date or terms; if those are not provided, it asks the user before drafting.
plugin_texts.target: 通过从最近的对话和 account_research 中收集更新前的背景（价值交付和价值时刻、风险处理和利益相关者状态）来为更新做好准备。通过 ZoomInfo 公司 ID（首选）或名称/域（触发查找）识别帐户。当有人询问“让我为 Acme 续订做好准备”、“我们续订的理由是什么”、“本次续订的风险是什么”或想要一份续订简介时使用。严格基于证据：不假定续订日期或条款；如果未提供，则会在起草前询问用户。

plugin_texts.source: Prepare for an upcoming meeting with a company. Identify the account by ZoomInfo account/company ID (preferred) or by company name, domain, or ticker (which triggers a lookup step) — or name no account at all and let the skill pick the meeting from your upcoming calendar. Provide attendee names or emails and rich context on the meeting purpose, stakes, and known dynamics to get a tight, decision-ready brief — headline, relationship posture per attendee, prior-conversation context (open threads and unresolved questions from past calls and emails), ranked talking points, discovery questions, suggested agenda, and what NOT to do. Use when prepping for a sales or customer call, QBR, renewal, or demo. Optimized for a 30-min slot.
plugin_texts.target: 为即将召开的与公司的会议做准备。通过 ZoomInfo 帐户/公司 ID（首选）或公司名称、域或股票代码（触发查找步骤）来识别帐户，或者根本不命名任何帐户，让技能从您即将到来的日历中选择会议。提供与会者姓名或电子邮件以及关于会议目的、利害关系和已知动态的丰富背景信息，以获得一份紧凑的、可供决策的简报——标题、每个与会者的关系状况、之前的对话背景（过去通话和电子邮件中的开放主题和未解决的问题）、排名谈话要点、发现问题、建议议程以及不该做的事情。在准备销售或客户电话、QBR、续订或演示时使用。针对 30 分钟时段进行了优化。

plugin_texts.source: Produce a fact-led competitive intel brief on one or more competitors — firmographics, recent strategic moves, product positioning, ICP overlap, and discovery questions. Defaults to your configured competitors from GTM context if none specified. Combines ZoomInfo data (account_research, scoops, intent, exec teams, similar companies) with web search for product/pricing/customer-sentiment intelligence. Identify competitors by ZoomInfo account/company ID (preferred) or name; include rich context on why the brief is being pulled and what decision it supports.
plugin_texts.target: 制作一份以事实为导向的关于一个或多个竞争对手的竞争情报简报——企业结构、最近的战略举措、产品定位、ICP 重叠和发现问题。如果未指定，则默认为 GTM 上下文中配置的竞争对手。将 ZoomInfo 数据（帐户研究、独家新闻、意图、执行团队、类似公司）与产品/定价/客户情绪情报的网络搜索相结合。通过 ZoomInfo 帐户/公司 ID（首选）或名称识别竞争对手；包含有关为何撤回简报及其支持哪些决定的丰富背景信息。

plugin_texts.source: Produce a full intelligence brief on a target company — firmographics, CRM/account context, intent signals, recent news, scoops, and competitive landscape — framed by your GTM context and led with a TL;DR summary. Identify the account by ZoomInfo account/company ID (preferred) or by company name, domain, or ticker (which triggers a lookup step). Include detailed context on why the brief is being pulled.
plugin_texts.target: 制作一份关于目标公司的完整情报简报——公司结构、CRM/账户背景、意图信号、最新新闻、独家新闻和竞争格局——以您的 GTM 背景为框架，并以 TL;DR 摘要为主导。通过 ZoomInfo 帐户/公司 ID（首选）或公司名称、域或股票代码（触发查找步骤）来识别帐户。包含有关为何撤回简报的详细背景信息。

plugin_texts.source: Produce a succinct one-pager for an executive dropping into a call with zero context. Blends account_research (who they are, deal state), conversation_intelligence (what has been discussed and what is open), and contact_research (who is in the room). Identify the account by ZoomInfo company ID (preferred) or name/domain (triggers a lookup); name the key attendees if known. Use when someone says "brief the VP for the Acme call", "exec one-pager for tomorrow", "my SVP is joining cold", or needs a tight pre-call brief for a senior stakeholder. Built to be read in two minutes.
plugin_texts.target: 为一位在零上下文中插入通话的高管制作一份简洁的单页寻呼机。混合 account_research（他们是谁、交易状态）、conversation_intelligence（已讨论的内容和开放的内容）和 contact_research（谁在房间里）。通过 ZoomInfo 公司 ID（首选）或名称/域名（触发查找）识别帐户；如果知道的话，请说出主要参加者的姓名。当有人说“向副总裁简要介绍 Acme 电话会议”、“明天执行一页寻呼机”、“我的高级副总裁即将加入”或需要为高级利益相关者提供一份简短的电话会议前简报时使用。专为两分钟内阅读而设计。

plugin_texts.source: Produce a technology-stack snapshot for one or more companies — what CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, data warehouse, analytics, conversation intelligence, and other tools they have tagged in ZoomInfo's database. Groups detected products by category, surfaces displacement plays for competitive tools, integration angles for partner tools, and coverage gaps honestly. Resolves mixed-identifier inputs (IDs / names / domains) with explicit ambiguity surfacing. Useful for sales prospecting, account-based selling, competitive battle-card prep, integration partner research, technographic signal analysis, B2B prospecting. Triggers on phrases like "what tech does X use", "tech stack for", "technographic snapshot", "what's in their stack", "do they use Salesforce", "competitive displacement angle".
plugin_texts.target: 为一个或多个公司制作技术堆栈快照 - 他们在 ZoomInfo 数据库中标记了哪些 CRM、营销自动化、销售参与、数据仓库、分析、对话智能以及其他工具。小组按类别检测产品、竞争工具的表面位移、合作伙伴工具的集成角度以及诚实的覆盖范围差距。通过明确的歧义显示来解决混合标识符输入（ID/名称/域）。对于销售勘探、基于帐户的销售、竞争性战斗卡准备、集成合作伙伴研究、技术信号分析、B2B 勘探非常有用。触发诸如“X 使用什么技术”、“技术堆栈的用途”、“技术快照”、“他们的堆栈中有什么”、“他们使用 Salesforce 吗”、“竞争位移角度”等短语。

plugin_texts.source: Produce an AE-to-CS handoff brief — everything the incoming CSM needs from the sales conversations. Builds an engagement timeline, then runs conversation_intelligence in parallel on the key engagements to pull requirements, success criteria, stakeholders and how they like to work, and the relationship state. Identify the account by ZoomInfo company ID (preferred) or name/domain (triggers a lookup). Use when someone says "build the handoff for Acme", "what does the CSM need to know", "prep the post-sale transition", or closes a deal that needs a clean handoff.
plugin_texts.target: 制作 AE 到 CS 的交接简报 — 即将到来的 CSM 在销售对话中需要的一切。构建参与时间表，然后在关键参与上并行运行对话智能，以拉取需求、成功标准、利益相关者及其喜欢的工作方式以及关系状态。通过 ZoomInfo 公司 ID（首选）或名称/域（触发查找）识别帐户。当有人说“为 Acme 建立交接”、“CSM 需要了解什么”、“准备售后过渡”或完成需要干净交接的交易时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Recap a recent call with a tight summary, the decisions made, action items, and open questions. Name the call (account and/or date) if you know it, or let the skill pull your most recent calls and offer a shortlist to pick from. Uses conversation_intelligence to read what was actually said, with light account_research for deal context. Use when someone says "recap my last call", "what came out of the Acme meeting", "summarize yesterday's call", or needs a post-call writeup. The output adapts to the request — for example decisions-only or action-items-only.
plugin_texts.target: 回顾一下最近的一次电话会议，其中包含严密的总结、所做的决定、行动项目和未解决的问题。如果您知道的话，请命名该通话（帐户和/或日期），或者让该技能提取您最近的通话并提供一个可供选择的候选名单。使用conversation_intelligence 来阅读实际所说的内容，并使用light account_research 来了解交易背景。当有人说“回顾我上次通话”、“Acme 会议的结果”、“总结昨天的通话”或需要通话后记录时使用。输出适应请求——例如仅决策或仅行动项目。

plugin_texts.source: Recap where things stand with a company across recent conversations, with emphasis on how the relationship is evolving. Identify the account by ZoomInfo company ID (preferred) or by name or domain (triggers a lookup). Blends account_research for deal and firmographic context with company-scoped conversation_intelligence for what has actually been said recently. Use when someone asks "where are we with Acme", "how is the relationship trending", "recap our recent conversations with this account", or wants a relationship read before a check-in. Reasons over the last few engagements only.
plugin_texts.target: 回顾一下最近对话中与公司的情况，重点是关系的发展情况。通过 ZoomInfo 公司 ID（首选）或通过名称或域（触发查找）来识别帐户。将交易和公司背景的账户研究与最近实际谈论的公司范围的对话情报相结合。当有人询问“我们与 Acme 的关系如何”、“关系趋势如何”、“回顾一下我们最近与此帐户的对话”或希望在签到之前阅读关系时使用。仅说明最近几次约会的原因。

plugin_texts.source: Recap where things stand with a specific person across recent conversations, with emphasis on how the relationship is evolving. Identify the contact by ZoomInfo contact ID (preferred) or by name plus company (triggers a lookup). Blends contact-scoped conversation_intelligence for what this person has actually said recently with contact_research for their role and background. Use when someone asks "where are we with Jane", "is this person still our champion", "recap my conversations with this contact", or wants a read on an individual relationship before reaching out. Reasons over the last few engagements only.
plugin_texts.target: 回顾一下最近谈话中与特定人的情况，重点是关系的演变。通过 ZoomInfo 联系人 ID（首选）或通过姓名加公司（触发查找）来识别联系人。将联系人范围内的对话情报（此人最近实际所说的话）与联系人研究（其角色和背景）混合在一起。当有人问“我们和简在哪里”、“这个人仍然是我们的支持者吗”、“回顾一下我与此联系人的对话”或想要在联系之前了解个人关系时使用。仅说明最近几次约会的原因。

plugin_texts.source: Recommend the next best action on a deal or relationship, grounded in the current conversation state. Uses conversation_intelligence as the primary source, with account_research for deal context. Identify the account or contact by ZoomInfo ID (preferred) or name (triggers a lookup), or point it at a specific engagement. Use when someone asks "what should I do next with Acme", "what's my next move here", "how do I advance this deal", or wants an evidence-based recommendation rather than a generic playbook. Reasons over the last few engagements only.
plugin_texts.target: 根据当前对话状态，推荐针对交易或关系的下一个最佳行动。使用conversation_intelligence作为主要来源，使用account_research作为交易背景。通过 ZoomInfo ID（首选）或名称（触发查找）识别帐户或联系人，或将其指向特定的参与。当有人询问“我下一步应该对 Acme 做什么”、“我的下一步行动是什么”、“我如何推进这笔交易”，或者想要基于证据的建议而不是通用的剧本时使用。仅说明最近几次约会的原因。

plugin_texts.source: Score and prioritize leads or cold contacts (mixed ZoomInfo person IDs, emails, or name+company rows). Returns Hot / Warm / Cold tier per lead with a response-time SLA tuned to the use case (live inbound routing, MQL triage, event follow-up, PQL triage, content follow-up, SDR queue ordering), per-axis breakdown (person fit · account fit · source signal · trigger), a "why now" reasoning snippet per lead, and recommended next action with verified contact data. Resolution by email is deterministic; name+company surfaces verification when needed; typo'd emails fail explicitly rather than fall back. Iteratively refinable. Triggers on phrases like "score these leads", "which lead/contact should I call first", "prioritize my MQLs", "rank inbound", "who should I prioritize?", "tier this list".
plugin_texts.target: 对潜在客户或冷联系人（混合 ZoomInfo 人员 ID、电子邮件或姓名+公司行）进行评分并确定优先级。返回每个潜在客户的热/暖/冷层，并根据用例调整响应时间 SLA（实时入站路由、MQL 分类、事件后续、PQL 分类、内容后续、SDR 队列排序）、每轴细分（人员适合度·帐户适合度·源信号·触发器）、每个潜在客户的“为什么现在”推理片段以及使用经过验证的联系数据建议的下一步操作。通过电子邮件解决是确定性的；需要时提供姓名+公司表面验证；拼写错误的电子邮件会明确失败，而不是退回。可迭代细化。触发诸如“对这些潜在客户进行评分”、“我应该首先致电哪个潜在客户/联系人”、“优先考虑我的 MQL”、“入站排名”、“我应该优先考虑谁？”、“对这个列表进行排序”等短语。

plugin_texts.source: Score and rank a list of accounts (mixed ZoomInfo company IDs, names, or domains) by ICP fit + buying intent + recent triggers. Returns per-account composite score (0–100), tier (A/B/C), explainable component breakdown (fit / intent / trigger / engagement), a specific "why now" sentence per account, and the working weight set as a saveable search filter set. Resolves name/domain inputs via search_companies with explicit confirmation for ambiguous matches. Iteratively refinable — adjust weights, swap axes, retier, or drill into a specific account. Use for account-based selling, ABM list prioritization, territory planning, sales prospecting prioritization, signal-based selling, buyer intent ranking, B2B prospecting. Triggers on phrases like "score these accounts", "prioritize this list", "rank by ICP fit and intent", "which accounts should I work first", "build a tiered account list".
plugin_texts.target: 按 ICP 匹配 + 购买意图 + 最近的触发因素对帐户列表（混合 ZoomInfo 公司 ID、名称或域）进行评分和排名。返回每个帐户的综合分数 (0–100)、等级 (A/B/C)、可解释的组件细分（适合/意图/触发/参与）、每个帐户的特定“为什么现在”句子以及设置为可保存搜索过滤器集的工作权重。通过 search_companies 解析名称/域输入，并明确确认不明确的匹配。可迭代优化——调整权重、交换轴、重新分层或钻取特定帐户。用于基于帐户的销售、ABM 列表优先级、区域规划、销售勘探优先级、基于信号的销售、买家意向排名、B2B 勘探。触发诸如“对这些帐户进行评分”、“确定此列表的优先级”、“按 ICP 适合度和意图进行排名”、“我应该首先处理哪些帐户”、“构建分层帐户列表”等短语。

plugin_texts.source: Summarize a long email thread into its current state, the decisions and key points, and the open questions. Finds the thread with browse_engagements (emails), then uses conversation_intelligence with includeContent to read the actual thread body. Name the account, contact, or subject if you know it, or let the skill list recent threads to pick from. Use when someone says "summarize this email thread", "what's the state of the Acme thread", "catch me up on this email chain", or faces a long back-and-forth before replying. Summarizes one thread at a time.
plugin_texts.target: 将长电子邮件线程总结为当前状态、决策和要点以及未解决的问题。使用 browser_engagements（电子邮件）查找线程，然后使用conversation_intelligence 和 includeContent 来读取实际的线程正文。如果您知道的话，请说出客户、联系人或主题的名称，或者让技能列出最近的主题以供选择。当有人说“总结此电子邮件线程”、“Acme 线程的状态如何”、“让我了解此电子邮件链”或在回复之前需要长时间来回时使用。一次总结一个线程。

plugin_texts.source: Track the open objections and blockers on a deal and how they have evolved across recent calls. Uses conversation_intelligence over an account's or contact's recent engagements. Identify the account or contact by ZoomInfo ID (preferred) or name (triggers a lookup). Use when someone asks "what objections are still open with Acme", "what's blocking this deal", "how has the security concern evolved", or wants a blocker check before a forecast or a next call. Reasons over the last few engagements only, so it tracks recent movement rather than full deal history.
plugin_texts.target: 跟踪交易中公开的反对意见和阻碍因素，以及它们在最近的电话会议中的演变情况。对客户或联系人最近的活动使用对话情报。通过 ZoomInfo ID（首选）或名称（触发查找）识别帐户或联系人。当有人询问“Acme 仍有哪些异议”、“是什么阻碍了这笔交易”、“安全问题如何演变”，或者想要在预测或下一次通话之前进行阻碍检查时使用。仅考虑最近几次交易的原因，因此它跟踪最近的动向，而不是完整的交易历史记录。

plugin_texts.target: 使用目标-问题-指标 (GQM) 结构创建功能测量计划 — 定义测量目标、学习目标、指标和实施（产品分析事件、仓库表、事件管道）。当用户说“测量计划”、“GQM”、“目标问题指标”、“目标-问题-指标”、“测量目标”、“我们如何衡量这一点”、“此功能的指标是什么”、“跟踪计划”、“分析要求”、“我们如何知道这是否有效”、“定义 KPI”时使用，或者在需要规划新功能和分析工具时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Create an evidence-backed bug report with reproduction, expected and actual behavior, impact, code context, and a regression-test requirement. plugin_texts.target: 创建一份有证据支持的错误报告，其中包含再现、预期和实际行为、影响、代码上下文和回归测试要求。当用户说“提交错误”、“报告此缺陷”、“将这些症状转化为故障单”或描述损坏或退化的行为时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Create and validate an AICtrl workflow v2 YAML file with typed parameters, inline task nodes, mappings, conditions, loops, retries, triggers, and approval gates. plugin_texts.target: 使用键入参数、内联任务节点、映射、条件、循环、重试、触发器和批准门创建并验证 AICtrl 工作流 v2 YAML 文件。当用户说“创建工作流程”、“编写工作流程 YAML”、“自动化此工程流程”或要求提供 .aictrl/workflows/ 下的文件时使用。

plugin_texts.source: End-to-end pipeline for producing a narrated product demo video from any repo with a web UI — the agent discovers and boots the app locally, preps demo data and auth, writes the narration and a scripted browser journey, records a time-locked Playwright take synced to an ElevenLabs voiceover, assembles a 1080p MP4 with branded title/agenda/end cards, and builds a publish kit (faststart MP4, 720p, poster, SRT captions, embed snippet, optional GCS/S3/YouTube upload). Use when the user says 'record a demo video', 'make a product demo', 'demo video for this app/repo', or wants to re-record an existing demo after UI changes.
plugin_texts.target: 用于使用 Web UI 从任何存储库生成带叙述的产品演示视频的端到端管道 — 代理在本地发现并启动应用程序，准备演示数据和身份验证，编写旁白和脚本化浏览器旅程，记录同步到 ElevenLabs 配音的时间锁定剧作家镜头，使用品牌标题/议程/结束卡组装 1080p MP4，并构建发布工具包（快速启动 MP4、 720p、海报、SRT 字幕、嵌入片段、可选 GCS/S3/YouTube 上传）。当用户说“录制演示视频”、“制作产品演示”、“此应用程序/存储库的演示视频”或想要在 UI 更改后重新录制现有演示时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Implement an engineering issue through tests, code, review, and CI, with separate story and bug paths and an optional connected AICtrl workflow. Use when the user says "implement issue 123", "fix this bug", "make this code change", or "take this ticket to a merge-ready PR".
plugin_texts.target: 通过测试、代码、审查和 CI 实现工程问题，并使用单独的故事和错误路径以及可选的连接 AICtrl 工作流程。当用户说“实施问题 123”、“修复此错误”、“更改此代码”或“将此票证提交到准备合并的 PR”时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Judge current-head review findings, fix accepted defects, run verification, post evidence-backed replies, and request bounded re-review. Use when the user says "address review comments", "reply to code review", "fix accepted findings", or "get this PR through review".
plugin_texts.target: 判断当前审查结果，修复已接受的缺陷，运行验证，发布有证据支持的答复，并请求有界重新审查。当用户说“处理审核意见”、“回复代码审核”、“修复已接受的发现”或“通过审核获取此 PR”时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Judge untriaged code-review findings for the current pull-request head as TRUE, FALSE, or UNCERTAIN and choose FIX, DEFER, or IGNORE without changing code. Use when the user says "triage review findings", "judge these comments", "which findings are real", or "decide what to fix from this review".
plugin_texts.target: 将当前拉取请求头的未分类代码审查结果判断为 TRUE、FALSE 或 UNCERTAIN，并选择 FIX、DEFER 或 IGNORE，而不更改代码。当用户说“对审核结果进行分类”、“判断这些评论”、“哪些结果是真实的”或“决定从该审核中修复哪些内容”时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Professional design review of any UI — a marketing page OR a product internal (dashboard, table, list, detail view, settings, a flow). Actionable, located critique against orientation, information architecture, primary task, visual hierarchy, friction/cognitive load, accessibility, and — for app screens — density, states, navigation, consistency, and data legibility. Use when the user says "review this design", "review this screen", "review this dashboard", "critique this UI", "is this UI good", "review this mock", "design review", "roast my design", "roast my landing page", or drops an HTML file / screenshot for feedback.
plugin_texts.target: 对任何 UI — 营销页面或产品内部（仪表板、表格、列表、详细视图、设置、流程）进行专业设计审查。针对方向、信息架构、主要任务、视觉层次、摩擦/认知负荷、可访问性以及应用程序屏幕的密度、状态、导航、一致性和数据易读性的可操作、定位的批评。当用户说“审阅此设计”、“审阅此屏幕”、“审阅此仪表板”、“批评此 UI”、“此 UI 好不好”、“审阅此模拟”、“设计审阅”、“烘烤我的设计”、“烘烤我的着陆页”或放置 HTML 文件/屏幕截图以获取反馈时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Review an engineering issue or specification against repository evidence for ambiguity, missing acceptance criteria, hidden scope, test gaps, and implementation risk. Use when the user says "review this spec", "check issue 123", "is this ready to build", or "find gaps in this ticket".

plugin_texts.source: Review the exact head revision of a pull request for actionable correctness, security, reliability, performance, and test findings without modifying code. plugin_texts.source: Build a Slack-ready weekly digest of all August research — interviews and focus groups — run against a given org (or across all orgs) in the past 7 days. Surfaces top themes with supporting quotes, standout twin verbatims, and unresolved questions to follow up on, so the team stays caught up on customer signal without skimming raw transcripts. This workflow can be scheduled to run every Monday morning. Triggers on: "weekly august digest", "august weekly recap", "summarize this week's research", "what did we learn from twins this week", "/august-weekly-digest".
plugin_texts.target: 针对过去 7 天内针对给定组织（或所有组织）的所有 8 月份研究（访谈和焦点小组）构建 Slack 就绪的每周摘要。通过支持性引言、突出的双字逐字记录以及需要跟进的未解决问题来呈现热门主题，因此团队可以随时了解客户信号，而无需浏览原始记录。该工作流程可以安排为每周一早上运行。触发点：“八月每周摘要”、“八月每周回顾”、“总结本周的研究”、“本周我们从双胞胎身上学到了什么”、“/八月每周摘要”。

plugin_texts.source: Get feedback on ideas, designs, copy, flows, products, dashboards, or research questions by routing to the August MCP — a directory of LLM twins organized by org. Twins represent BOTH end shoppers (per brand org, e.g., GNC, Backcountry) AND product/dashboard users (under the Fermat org, e.g., researchers, PMs, ops users of the Fermat or August dashboards). Picks the best twin or runs a focus group depending on the task. Use whenever the user asks for feedback, reactions, customer perspective, user testing, persona input, dashboard-UX feedback, or "what would shoppers / dashboard users think." Triggers on: "get feedback", "ask August", "what would customers say", "run this by a twin", "focus group this", "/august-feedback".
plugin_texts.target: 通过路由至 August MCP（由组织组织的法学硕士双胞胎目录）获取有关想法、设计、文案、流程、产品、仪表板或研究问题的反馈。双胞胎代表最终购物者（每个品牌组织，例如 GNC、Backcountry）和产品/仪表板用户（Fermat 组织下，例如 Fermat 或 August 仪表板的研究人员、PM、运营用户）。根据任务选择最好的双胞胎或组建焦点小组。每当用户要求反馈、反应、客户观点、用户测试、角色输入、仪表板用户体验反馈或“购物者/仪表板用户会怎么想”时使用。触发条件：“获取反馈”、“询问 August”、“客户会说什么”、“由双胞胎运行”、“焦点小组”、“/august 反馈”。

plugin_texts.source: Rewrite a loose or vague research question into a sharper, twin-friendly version that produces a better response from an August twin (or any human-like respondent). Standalone helper — invoke on its own to sharpen a question before sending to August, or let other skills (notably /feedback-loops) call it programmatically when a twin response comes back too vague to use. Does NOT call any August MCP tools — pure text rewrite. Triggers on: "rewrite this question", "make this question better", "sharpen my ask", "fix this research question", "this question is vague", "/fix-question".
plugin_texts.target: 将一个松散或模糊的研究问题重写为一个更清晰、对双胞胎友好的版本，这样八月双胞胎（或任何类似人类的受访者）就能做出更好的反应。独立助手——在发送给 August 之前自行调用以锐化问题，或者当孪生响应返回的结果过于模糊而无法使用时，让其他技能（特别是/反馈循环）以编程方式调用它。不调用任何 August MCP 工具 — 纯文本重写。触发条件：“重写这个问题”、“让这个问题变得更好”、“提高我的要求”、“解决这个研究问题”、“这个问题很模糊”、“/修复问题”。

plugin_texts.source: Run a Van Westendorp-style pricing sensitivity study across August twins for a product, plan, or feature. Ask each twin the four canonical price questions (too cheap = quality suspect, bargain = good deal, expensive = would pause, prohibitively expensive = wouldn't buy) and aggregate into the acceptable price band plus the four inflection points (PMC, PME, OPP, IPP). Better than eyeballing one twin's answer. Use whenever the user wants directional price sensitivity, willingness-to-pay, or a price-band read from twins instead of live shoppers. Triggers on: "price check with twins", "van westendorp", "pricing sensitivity", "how much would twins pay", "what should I charge", "price band", "/august-pricing-check".
plugin_texts.target: 对 August twins 的产品、计划或功能进行 Van Westendorp 式的定价敏感性研究。问每个双胞胎四个典型的价格问题（太便宜=质量可疑，讨价还价=好交易，昂贵=会暂停，太贵=不会购买），然后汇总到可接受的价格范围加上四个拐点（PMC，PME，OPP，IPP）。比盯着双胞胎的答案要好。每当用户想要从双胞胎而不是现场购物者那里读取定向价格敏感性、支付意愿或价格带时就可以使用。触发条件：“与双胞胎进行价格检查”、“van westendorp”、“定价敏感性”、“双胞胎需要支付多少钱”、“我应该收取什么费用”、“价格范围”、“/八月定价检查”。

plugin_texts.source: Run a structured 1:1 interview with a single August twin off a discussion guide (a list of questions or topics the user provides), and return a clean synthesized write-up instead of raw back-and-forth. Use when the user wants depth on one persona and does NOT want to read the full transcript themselves. Triggers on: "interview a twin", "structured interview", "run a discussion guide", "walk a twin through these questions", "1:1 twin interview", "/august-interview".
plugin_texts.target: 根据讨论指南（用户提供的问题或主题列表）对八月的单身双胞胎进行结构化的 1:1 采访，并返回干净的综合文章，而不是原始的来回。当用户想要深入了解某个角色并且不想自己阅读完整的文字记录时使用。触发条件：“采访双胞胎”、“结构化采访”、“运行讨论指南”、“引导双胞胎回答这些问题”、“1:1 双胞胎访谈”、“/八月采访”。

plugin_texts.source: Run an iterative feedback loop with August twins: put the same artifact (copy, design, concept, variant set) in front of a panel of twins round after round, applying the top suggestion from each round as a new variant, until the responses converge on a preferred direction. Auto-invokes /fix-question when a twin response is vague or hedged and re-asks that twin with a sharper prompt. Meta-skill that orchestrates other August skills so you don't have to manually kick each round. Triggers on: "run a feedback loop", "iterate feedback with twins", "keep iterating until", "loop twins on this", "converge on a variant", "/feedback-loops".
plugin_texts.target: 与八月双胞胎一起运行迭代反馈循环：将相同的工件（副本、设计、概念、变体集）一轮又一轮地放在双胞胎小组面前，将每轮的最佳建议应用为新的变体，直到反应集中在首选方向上。当双胞胎的回答含糊或回避时，自动调用/修复问题，并以更尖锐的提示重新询问该双胞胎。元技能可以协调其他八月技能，这样你就不必手动踢每一轮。触发条件：“运行反馈循环”、“用双胞胎迭代反馈”、“继续迭代直到”、“在此循环双胞胎”、“收敛到一个变体”、“/反馈循环”。

plugin_texts.source: Run the same concept, design, or copy past August twins across two or more variants (A/B/C/D) and return a side-by-side comparison instead of one twin's take at a time. Use whenever the user has multiple candidate concepts and wants twin-simulated preference signal before committing — landing page variants, packaging concepts, positioning angles, hero designs, pricing framings, ad creatives. Different from /august-feedback (single artifact). Also handles text-only variants (headlines, CTAs, taglines) — hard-scope output to phrase-level notes in that case. Triggers on: "compare these concepts", "A/B test with twins", "which variant do twins prefer", "run these variants past twins", "concept test", "/august-concept-compare".
plugin_texts.target: 在两个或多个变体 (A/B/C/D) 中运行相同的概念、设计或复制过去的 August twins，并返回并排比较，而不是一次只返回一个双胞胎的结果。当用户有多个候选概念并希望在提交之前获得双模拟偏好信号时使用 - 登陆页面变体、包装概念、定位角度、英雄设计、定价框架、广告创意。与 /august-feedback（单个工件）不同。还可以处理纯文本变体（标题、CTA、标语）——在这种情况下，硬范围输出为短语级注释。触发条件：“比较这些概念”、“与双胞胎进行 A/B 测试”、“双胞胎更喜欢哪种变体”、“运行这些变体过去双胞胎”、“概念测试”、“/august-concept-compare”。

plugin_texts.source: Take an already-finished August focus group and turn its raw results into an actual readout — consensus points, disagreements with named sides, standout quotes, a rough sentiment split, and unresolved follow-up questions. Post-hoc synthesis only; does NOT trigger a new focus group. Use when the user has an FG that already ran and wants it read out for them instead of scrolling raw output. Triggers on: "focus group report", "synthesize focus group", "read out this focus group", "FG readout", "summarize the focus group", "/august-focus-group-report".
plugin_texts.target: 以已经完成的八月焦点小组为例，将其原始结果转化为实际的读数——共识点、与指定一方的分歧、突出的引述、粗略的情绪分歧以及未解决的后续问题。仅事后合成；不会触发新的焦点小组。当用户有一个已经运行的 FG 并且希望为他们读出它而不是滚动原始输出时使用。触发条件：“焦点小组报告”、“综合焦点小组”、“读出此焦点小组”、“FG 读出”、“总结焦点小组”、“/august-focus-group-report”。

plugin_texts.source: Walk August twins through a proposed onboarding, checkout, signup, or funnel step-by-step and surface friction points before we ship. Screenshots, Figma frames, or step descriptions are attached as focus group stimuli one step at a time; twins call out where they'd get confused, hesitate, or drop off. Pre-launch, twin-simulated version of the friction points Commerce Graph measures post-launch. Triggers on: "audit this flow", "walkthrough with twins", "onboarding friction check", "test this funnel with twins", "friction check", "flow audit", "/august-flow-audit".
plugin_texts.target: 在发货前，让 August twins 逐步了解拟议的入职、结账、注册或漏斗流程以及表面摩擦点。屏幕截图、Figma 框架或步骤描述作为焦点小组刺激，一次一个步骤地附加；双胞胎会说出他们会感到困惑、犹豫或掉队的地方。 Commerce Graph 在发布前测量摩擦点的双模拟版本。触发条件：“审核此流程”、“使用双胞胎进行演练”、“入职摩擦检查”、“使用双胞胎测试此漏斗”、“摩擦检查”、“流程审核”、“/august-flow-audit”。

plugin_texts.source: Builds and modifies dbt models, writes SQL transformations using ref() and source(), creates tests, and validates results with dbt show. Use when doing any dbt work - building or modifying models, debugging errors, exploring unfamiliar data sources, writing tests, or evaluating impact of changes.
plugin_texts.target: 构建和修改 dbt 模型，使用 ref() 和 source() 编写 SQL 转换，创建测试并使用 dbt show 验证结果。在进行任何 dbt 工作时使用 - 构建或修改模型、调试错误、探索不熟悉的数据源、编写测试或评估更改的影响。

plugin_texts.source: Creates unit test YAML definitions that mock upstream model inputs and validate expected outputs. Use when adding unit tests for a dbt model or practicing test-driven development (TDD) in dbt.
plugin_texts.target: 创建模拟上游模型输入并验证预期输出的单元测试 YAML 定义。在为 dbt 模型添加单元测试或在 dbt 中练习测试驱动开发 (TDD) 时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Diagnoses dbt Cloud/platform job failures by analyzing run logs, querying the Admin API, reviewing git history, and investigating data issues. Use when a dbt Cloud/platform job fails and you need to diagnose the root cause, especially when error messages are unclear or when intermittent failures occur. Do not use for local dbt development errors.
plugin_texts.target: 通过分析运行日志、查询管理 API、查看 git 历史记录和调查数据问题来诊断 dbt Cloud/平台作业故障。当 dbt 云/平台作业失败并且需要诊断根本原因时使用，特别是当错误消息不清楚或发生间歇性故障时。不要用于本地 dbt 开发错误。

plugin_texts.source: Formats and executes dbt CLI commands, selects the correct dbt executable, and structures command parameters. Use when running models, tests, builds, compiles, or show queries via dbt CLI. Use when unsure which dbt executable to use or how to format command parameters.
plugin_texts.target: 格式化并执行 dbt CLI 命令，选择正确的 dbt 可执行文件，并构造命令参数。在通过 dbt CLI 运行模型、测试、构建、编译或显示查询时使用。当不确定要使用哪个 dbt 可执行文件或如何格式化命令参数时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Generates MCP server configuration JSON, resolves authentication setup, and validates server connectivity for dbt. Use when setting up, configuring, or troubleshooting the dbt MCP server for AI tools like Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, or VS Code.
plugin_texts.target: 生成 MCP 服务器配置 JSON、解析身份验证设置并验证 dbt 的服务器连接。在为 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor 或 VS Code 等 AI 工具设置、配置 dbt MCP 服务器或对其进行故障排除时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Generates a Mermaid flowchart diagram of dbt model lineage using MCP tools, manifest.json, or direct code parsing as fallbacks. Use when visualizing dbt model lineage and dependencies as a Mermaid diagram in markdown format.
plugin_texts.target: 使用 MCP 工具、manifest.json 或直接代码解析作为后备，生成 dbt 模型谱系的 Mermaid 流程图。在将 dbt 模型沿袭和依赖关系可视化为 Markdown 格式的 Mermaid 图时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Retrieves and searches dbt documentation pages in LLM-friendly markdown format. Use when fetching dbt documentation, looking up dbt features, or answering questions about dbt Cloud, dbt Core, or the dbt Semantic Layer.
plugin_texts.target: 以 LLM 友好的 Markdown 格式检索和搜索 dbt 文档页面。在获取 dbt 文档、查找 dbt 功能或回答有关 dbt Cloud、dbt Core 或 dbt 语义层的问题时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Use when a user is enabling, configuring, optimizing, or debugging dbt State (the server-backed reuse mechanism that clones or skips nodes instead of rebuilding them). Use when they conflate dbt State with the `state:modified` selector or `--state` deferral. Use when asked about models rebuilding unexpectedly, views with `select *` rebuilding, volatile SQL (`current_timestamp()`, `random()`) rebuilding or not, cross-developer cloning, lag_tolerance.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户启用、配置、优化或调试 dbt State（服务器支持的重用机制，克隆或跳过节点而不是重建节点）时使用。当他们将 dbt State 与 `state:modified` 选择器或 `--state` 延迟混为一谈时使用。当询问模型意外重建、使用“select *”重建的视图、是否重建易失性 SQL（“current_timestamp()”、“random()”）、跨开发人员克隆、lag_tolerance 时使用。

plugin_texts.source: Use when a user needs help triaging dbt-core to Fusion migration errors. Runs dbt-autofix first, then classifies remaining errors into actionable categories (auto-fixable, guided fixes, needs input, blocked).
plugin_texts.target: 当用户需要帮助对 dbt-core 到 Fusion 迁移错误进行分类时使用。首先运行 dbt-autofix，然后将剩余错误分类为可操作类别（可自动修复、引导修复、需要输入、已阻止）。

plugin_texts.source: Use when a user wants to upgrade, update, or migrate a dbt-core project to a newer or the latest version — e.g. "upgrade my dbt project," "migrate this off dbt-core 1.5," "get this project running on the latest dbt," "bump the dbt-core version." Upgrades a dbt-core v1 project (on 1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 1.6, or 1.7) all the way to 1.12, applying the required breaking, behavior, and deprecated changes from a data-driven issue corpus — replaying each pre-1.8 version boundary in order, then pinning post-1.8 behavior-change flags — running dbt-autofix first, then agentic and human-in-the-loop fixes, and verifying with dbt parse on dbt-core 1.12. Inputs — starting_version (the project's current dbt-core minor, one of 1.3/1.4/1.5/1.6/1.7) and adapter_type (snowflake/redshift/bigquery/databricks/spark); both are normally supplied by the caller (e.g. the dbt VS Code extension), with fallbacks described in the skill.
plugin_texts.target: 当用户想要升级、更新或迁移 dbt-core 项目到较新或最新版本时使用 - 例如“升级我的 dbt 项目”、“将其从 dbt-core 1.5 迁移”、“让该项目在最新的 dbt 上运行”、“升级 dbt-core 版本”。将 dbt-core v1 项目（在 1.3、1.4、1.5、1.6 或 1.7 上）一直升级到 1.12，从数据驱动的问题语料库应用所需的破坏、行为和弃用的更改 - 按顺序重放每个 1.8 之前的版本边界，然后固定 1.8 后的行为更改标志 - 首先运行 dbt-autofix，然后运行代理和人机交互修复，并在 dbt-core 1.12 上使用 dbt 解析进行验证。输入 —starting_version（项目当前的 dbt-core 次要版本，1.3/1.4/1.5/1.6/1.7 之一）和adapter_type（snowflake/redshift/bigquery/databricks/spark）；两者通常都由调用者提供（例如 dbt VS Code 扩展），并在技能中描述了后备。

plugin_texts.source: Use when changing a dbt model in a way that could break its consumers — renaming, removing, or retyping a column, or changing a model that downstream models, exposures, dashboards, or BI tools depend on — to judge whether the change is breaking and who it affects. Also use when versioning a model (model versions, latest_version, latest_version_pointer, deprecation_date, migration windows), enforcing contracts, setting access or groups, or doing multi-project dbt Mesh work (cross-project refs via dependencies.yml, disambiguating similarly-named models, splitting a monolith). Covers single- and multi-project, and planning or advising as well as implementing.
plugin_texts.target: 当以可能破坏其使用者的方式更改 dbt 模型时（重命名、删除或重新键入列，或更改下游模型、曝光、仪表板或 BI 工具所依赖的模型），请使用该模型来判断更改是否会破坏以及它会影响谁。还可以在对模型进行版本控制（模型版本、latest_version、latest_version_pointer、deprecation_date、迁移窗口）、强制执行合同、设置访问权限或组或执行多项目 dbt Mesh 工作（通过 dependency.yml 进行跨项目引用、消除名称相似的模型的歧义、拆分整体）时使用。涵盖单个和多个项目、规划或建议以及实施。

NOT for validating, testing, or building dbt models during development.
